m: Motie van de leden Segers en Van 't Wout over elders in het land vieren van Prinsjesdag zolang het Binnenhof niet beschikbaar is
Asks the presidium to explore celebrating Prinsjesdag elsewhere in the country while the Binnenhof is unavailable.
requests the presidium to consult with the Chair of the United Assembly

Motie van het lid Sneller c.s. over de wenselijkheid van 5 mei als vrije dag voor zo veel mogelijk mensen
Expresses the view that 5 May should be a day off for as many people as possible.
expresses its view that it is desirable for 5 May to be a day off for as many people as possible
spreekt als haar mening uit dat het wenselijk is dat 5 mei voor zo veel mogelijk mensen een vrije dag wordt
Motie van het lid Van 't Wout c.s. over de oproep om 5 mei voor zo veel mogelijk mensen een vrije dag te laten zijn
Asks the government to explore how to give more weight to the appeal to employers and unions to make 5 May a day off, and to report to the House by end April 2020.
requests the government to consider how the appeal to social partners to make 5 May a day off for as many people as possible can be given extra weight
verzoekt de regering, te bezien op welke wijze de oproep aan sociale partners om 5 mei voor zo veel mogelijk mensen een vrije dag te laten zijn extra betekenis en gewicht kan worden gegeven
Motie van het lid Van 't Wout c.s. over uitvoeren van een bedrijfseffectentoets
Asks the government to carry out a business impact test when drafting lower childcare regulations, individually and cumulatively, and to inform the Chamber about it.
requests the government to carry out a business impact test when elaborating lower regulations, and also requests it to inform the Chamber about the execution of this test
verzoekt de regering, bij de uitwerking van de lagere regelgeving een bedrijfseffectentoets uit te voeren en verzoekt de regering tevens, de Kamer over de uitvoering van deze toets te informeren
Motie van het lid Van 't Wout c.s. over monitoren van de voorbereiding op en de implementatie van de wet
Asks the government to monitor childcare and playgroup preparation and implementation of new quality rules and report bottlenecks to parliament in autumn 2017.
to monitor the progress of preparation and implementation by childcare centres and playgroups, as well as possible bottlenecks, and to report to the House in autumn 2017

de voortgang op de voorbereiding en implementatie door kinderdagopvang en peuterspeelzalen te monitoren, alsmede mogelijke knelpunten bij de implementatie van de wettelijke eisen, en de Kamer hierover in het najaar van 2017 te rapporteren
Amendement van het lid Van 't Wout over het invoeren van een evaluatiebepaling
Requires the minister to report to parliament within four years on the effectiveness and effects of the law's experimental pilot provisions, before a decision is taken.
Our Minister of Social Affairs and Employment shall send the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within four years of its entry into force.

Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid zendt binnen vier jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Amendement van het lid Van 't Wout c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het invoeren van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds a duty for the Minister of Social Affairs to report to the States General within four years on the effectiveness and effects of the law, including the experimental pilots.
within four years of the law entering into force sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice
zendt binnen vier jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Amendement van het lid Van 't Wout c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het invoeren van een evaluatiebepaling
Amendment adding an evaluation clause requiring the social affairs minister to report to parliament within four years on the effectiveness of the law and experimental pilot powers.
sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within four years of its entry into force
zendt binnen vier jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk

Motie van het lid Karabulut  c.s. over handhaven van het verbod op doorbrengen van de weekendrust in de vrachtwagen
Asks the government to actively enforce the ban on truck drivers spending their weekly rest period in their vehicle and to report results to parliament.
requests the government to actively enforce the rules on the ban on spending the weekend rest in the lorry and to inform the House of Representatives of the results
verzoekt de regering, de regels omtrent het verbod op het doorbrengen van de weekendrust in de vrachtauto actief te handhaven en de Tweede Kamer van de resultaten op de hoogte te stellen
Motie van de leden Kerstens en Van 't Wout over structurele uitbreiding van de Inspectie SZW
Motion asks the government to make the temporary extra capacity of the Labour Inspectorate structural and to finance it from the enforcement budget.
requests the government to make the agreed expansion of the Inspectorate SZW structural
verzoekt de regering, de in het kader van het sociaal akkoord overeengekomen uitbreiding van de Inspectie SZW structureel te maken
Amendement van de leden Kerstens en Van 't Wout over een eenmalige impuls voor klantprofielen
Moves 3.5 million euro from the Participation Act and Allowances budget to the unallocated reserve to fund client profiles for municipalities.

worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verlaagd met € 3.500
Amendement van de leden Kerstens en Van 't Wout over het inzetten van ervaringsdeskundigen
Shifts 100,000 euro from the Participatiewet budget to the unallocated reserve to fund experienced-expert projects for employers.
To make this possible in a number of labour market regions, 100,000 euro must be made available on a one-off basis.
Om dit in een aantal arbeidsmarktregio’s mogelijk te maken, moet incidenteel € 100.000 beschikbaar komen.

Motion asking the government to release the UWV candidate-finder application for use by municipalities and labour market regions.

Amendement van de leden Van 't Wout en Kerstens over versterking van initiatieven in de grensstreek
Shifts 1.4 million euro within the budget from the Participatiewet line to the unallocated reserve to fund cross-border job placement initiatives in border labour regions.
These funds will be reserved under article 99, Unallocated and contingencies, until the substantive use has been decided.
Deze middelen worden tot de inhoudelijke invulling heeft plaatsgevonden gereserveerd op «artikel 99, Nominaal en onvoorzien».
Motie van de leden Van 't Wout en Pieter Heerma over ondersteuning van het initiatief van de Ambachtsacademie voor 50-plussers
Asks the government to support the Ambachtsacademie initiative for workers aged 50 and over within the existing Perspectief plan.
requests the government to support the initiative of the Ambachtsacademie.

Amendement van de leden Van 't Wout en Kerstens over scholingsvouchers
Amendment shifting 20 million euro within the budget between the Participatiewet line and itself to raise the subsidy ceiling for training vouchers, funded from underspending in sector plans.
Raising the subsidy ceiling of the temporary training subsidy scheme ensures the scheme does not have to be closed now.

At the request of the insured person or their representative, the care provider involves the informal caregiver(s) in the discussions.

Requires the CIZ to issue an indication covering all necessary care, including structural extra care, on request from an insured person.
The right to care established in the indication decision matches the insured person's needs.

Een weigering van een vpt of een mpt op grond van het oordeel van de Wlz-uitvoerder dat een vpt of mpt niet verantwoord of doelmatig kan worden verleend, zal daarom alleen mogelijk zijn indien de Wlz-uitvoerder dit deugdelijk motiveert.
Amendement van de leden Van 't Wout en Otwin van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 42 over het instellen van een meet- en weetplicht voor Wlz-uitvoerders
Amendment requiring Wlz implementing bodies to state measurable criteria and outcome criteria for their intentions and to report against them.
This amendment establishes a duty to measure and know for Wlz implementing bodies.
Dit amendement regelt een meet-en weetplicht voor Wlz-uitvoerders.
Amendement van de leden Keijzer en Van 't Wout over het introduceren van de mogelijkheid van persoonsvolgende financiering.
Would allow general administrative orders to set rules for funding long-term care on a person-following basis.
By general administrative order, rules can be set by which care can be funded on a person-following basis.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen regels worden gesteld waarmee de zorg persoonsvolgend kan worden bekostigd.
Amendement van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Van 't Wout ter vervanging van nr. 47 over het overgangsrecht voor lage zzp's.
Amends transitional rules so people with low care packages under the old AWBZ keep a guaranteed right to residential care under the Wlz, overriding Wmo restrictions.
will always retain a right to enter Wlz residential care

At least four weeks before a proposal is made for the measure, the draft is submitted to the States General and made public.
Ten minste vier weken voordat een voordracht wordt gedaan voor de maatregel, wordt het ontwerp aan de Staten-Generaal overgelegd en aan een ieder bekend gemaakt.

With this amendment the provision that makes a certificate of conduct mandatory for social support is therefore deleted.
Met dit amendement wordt daarom de bepaling die een verklaring omtrent gedrag verplicht stelt voor de maatschappelijke ondersteuning geschrapt.

Ten minste vier weken voordat een voordracht wordt gedaan voor de maatregel, wordt het ontwerp aan de Staten-Generaal overgelegd en aan een ieder bekend gemaakt.

The municipal council must therefore include support in the policy plan.

Amendement van de leden Bergkamp en Van 't Wout over het nader expliciteren van goede kwaliteit als bedoeld artikel 3.1, tweede lid

Moves the quality test for personal budgets (pgb) so the client, not the municipality, is the party to whom the provider owes care, and makes the test explicit as safe, effective and client-centred provision.
The college must therefore, when the client requests a pgb, assess whether the third party providing the support does so safely, effectively and client-centred.
Het college moet derhalve, bij het verzoek van de cliënt om hem een pgb te verstrekken, beoordelen of de derde die de ondersteuning zal bieden, dat veilig, doeltreffend en cliëntgericht doet.

Amendement van de leden Van 't Wout en Van der Staaij dat regelt dat de algemene maatregel van bestuur waarin nadere eisen kunnen worden gesteld aan aanbieders van voorzieningen, aan een zware voorhan

Amendement van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Van 't Wout ter vervanging van nr. 30 over de mogelijkheidvan mandatering aan professionals.
Lets municipal executives delegate to professionals such as GPs or district nurses the power to determine a client's rights and duties under the WMO.
This amendment aims to also enable professionals involved in implementing the WMO, such as the GP or district nurse, to determine the client's rights and duties

Amendement van de leden Otwin van Dijk en van 't Wout ter vervanging van nr. 28 over een meet- en weetplicht voor gemeenten.

Amendement van het lid Otwin van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het waarborgen van onafhankelijke clientondersteuning
Amendment requiring that client support during municipal decisions on personal care or budgets be independent of the municipality deciding the case.

The client must be able to trust that the support offered to assist a client during decision-making on a personal care provision or personal budget is fully independent of the municipality that ultimately makes the decision

Asks the government to give municipalities early clarity on the budgets transferred with the new Wmo law.
requests the government to give individual municipalities clarity as early as possible on the budget transfers accompanying the new Wmo
verzoekt de regering, zo veel eerder als mogelijk aan afzonderlijke gemeenten duidelijkheid te geven over de met de nieuwe Wmo gepaard gaande overheveling van budgetten

Motion asking that the new Wmo bill explicitly require municipalities to provide tailored support for both the individual client and their informal carers.
explicitly include in the new Wmo bill that municipalities must offer tailored support

Amendement van het lid Van der Staaij cs. over het verhogen van de subsidie aan Siriz
Proposes structurally raising the subsidy to Siriz for unwanted pregnancy prevention and teen mothers by reallocating funds within the health budget article.
Coverage is found in the non-legally-mandatory part of the subsidies and assignments under article 3 of the budget.
Dekking wordt gevonden in het niet-juridisch-verplichte deel van de subsidies en opdrachten op artikel 3 van de begroting.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over aandacht voor de eiwittransitie op internationale conferenties

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether plant-based menus should be the default at international climate conferences such as COP26, and how Dutch meat and dairy exports and feed imports would be raised there. The government said it would raise protein transition and sustainable catering with the UK host and pursue sustainable agriculture and deforestation-free supply chains, without committing to a default vegetarian menu.
The cabinet will raise the importance of a healthy and sustainable offer in preparatory talks for COP26 with the United Kingdom.
Het kabinet zal het belang van een gezond en duurzaam aanbod in voorbereidende gesprekken op COP26 bij het Verenigd Koninkrijk onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Vestering over de aanleg van een elektriciteitskabel door een kwetsbaar stuk van het Werelderfgoed Waddenzee

MPs Van Raan and Vestering (PvdD) asked the government about routing an offshore electricity cable through the vulnerable Wadden Sea World Heritage area, including Schiermonnikoog, and why the Eemshaven West route was chosen over Eemshaven East. The State Secretary answered that no route decision is final, that a second-phase environmental assessment and further studies will be completed before any irreversible steps, and that the government considers the wider energy transition and future connections in its choice.
In the meantime, I am not taking any irreversible steps.
In de tussentijd neem ik geen onomkeerbare stappen.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat de Duitse Klimaatwet deels ongrondwettelijk is

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers how the German Constitutional Court ruling on the Climate Act relates to the Dutch Climate Act and whether Dutch climate policy protects the right to a future for present and future generations. The state secretary answered that the German ruling cannot be translated directly to Dutch law, that Dutch policy aims at emission reductions in line with the Paris Agreement, and that the Climate Act will be adjusted to EU targets.
This link between human rights and climate applies in particular to those who will most come to face the consequences of climate change, such as children and future generations.
Dit verband tussen mensenrechten en klimaat geldt in het bijzonder voor degenen die het meest met de gevolgen van klimaatverandering te maken gaan krijgen, zoals kinderen en toekomstige generaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over winsten die worden gemaakt met publiek geld voor verduurzaming

SP MPs asked the government about private profits from publicly subsidised wind and solar, electricity bills, overcompensation under the SDE+ scheme, and the Court of Audit's findings. The State Secretary maintained that overwinsten are limited by the tender design and PBL cost estimates, committed to a new evaluation and to monitoring participation, but refused to quantify private profits and rejected socialising renewable energy.
I have no direct insight into the amount of private profit made with SDE+ subsidies.
Ik heb geen direct inzicht in de hoeveelheid private winst die is gemaakt met SDE+-subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het Kinderklimaatakkoord

An MP asked ministers about the Children's Climate Agreement, its proposals (dike and dune strengthening, eating less meat, replacing felled trees), rising meat consumption and forest loss, and what further measures will be taken. The state secretary answers that the government is willing to meet the children's delegation, points to existing climate and nature policy and youth consultation, and says further tree-planting ambitions are for a future cabinet to decide.
Are you willing to talk with the delegation coming to The Hague to present the Children's Climate Agreement to national politics?
Bent u bereid om in gesprek te gaan met de afvaardiging die naar Den Haag komt om het Kinderklimaatakkoord aan te bieden aan de landelijke politiek?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zandwinning uit de Waddenzee

An MP asked the government about sand extraction from the Wadden Sea, including whether it harms the sandbar structure, how much sand is dredged, and whether sand from the North Sea is needed to offset subsidence from gas and salt mining. The minister answered that extraction at maintenance dredging ends in 2022, that dredged sand will instead be dumped in designated spots, and that mining subsidence is compensated by North Sea sand supplements under licence conditions.
From 2022 no more sand may be extracted from the Wadden Sea system during fairway maintenance.
Per 2022 mag er geen zand meer aan het waddensysteem worden onttrokken bij vaargeulonderhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boucke en Hagen over het bericht 'De wereld heeft veel meer grondstoffen nodig om de klimaatdoelen te halen'

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers how the Netherlands is raising raw material supply for the energy transition in a clean, recycling-focused way, and how it responds to an IEA report on critical minerals. The government answered that it works through EU critical materials and circular economy plans, a circular manufacturing transition agenda, and innovation programmes, without committing to new concrete measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Kops over het artikel 'Vogels overleven vlucht langs nieuwe windmolens Tweede Maasvlakte gegarandeerd dankzij deze radar'

PVV MPs Madlener and Kops asked the ministers about a planned wind park on the Tweede Maasvlakte, its bird and bat impacts, the loss of beach and kitesurfing amenity, and costs of stoppages. The minister answered that impacts were assessed under the Nature Protection Act, mitigation including a bird radar and bat shutdowns applies, the municipality consulted on kitesurfing, and Eneco bears stoppage costs.
The effectiveness of the radar system will be further investigated in the coming years.
De effectiviteit van het radarsysteem zal de komende jaren nader worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het bericht 'NS schrapt 341 banen; station zonder personeel wordt de norm'

SP MPs asked the government about news that NS would cut 341 station staff jobs, questioning whether this conflicts with its stated view that staff are essential and whether volunteers or temporary agency workers are displacing paid work. The minister and state secretary answered that NS decides its own staffing, cites falling counter sales and online ticketing, says safety is covered by camera monitoring and concession obligations, and commits only to help affected staff find other work within NS.
It is up to NS to determine where NS can deploy its personnel most effectively, taking into account the changing needs of travellers.
Het is aan NS om te bepalen waar NS haar personeel het meest effectief kan inzetten, waarbij NS rekening houdt met de veranderende behoefte van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Werner over dynamische evenementenvergunningen

MPs from the CDA asked about the status of more flexible, phased event permit procedures (dynamic permits), why fairgrounds are classed as events rather than throughflow locations, differentiation by event category, municipal hesitancy, timelines, and a handreiking for municipalities. The Minister answered that permitting is primarily a municipal responsibility, that talks with the VNG are ongoing, that the government has communicated conditions for events to ease planning, and that answers were timed with the 11 June communication.
Issuing permits is primarily a local responsibility of the municipality, which is advised by the safety region, emergency services and other parties.
Het verstrekken van vergunningen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid van gemeente, zij worden hierbij geadviseerd door de veiligheidsregio, hulpdiensten en andere partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat Duitsland haar broeikasgasreductiedoelen gaat aanscherpen

Two MPs (Teunissen and Van Raan, PvdD) asked the government about Germany's tightened 2030, 2040 and 2045 greenhouse gas targets, which follow a Constitutional Court ruling on Germany's climate law. The State Secretary answered that the targets are binding and cover all greenhouse gases, that Germany responded to the court ruling, and that the Netherlands will leave its own ambition for 2030 and 2050 to a next cabinet while welcoming the EU's higher target.
The Netherlands has in recent years repeatedly worked for ambitious European climate policy, including through the European Climate Ambition group.
Nederland heeft zich de afgelopen jaren veelvuldig ingezet voor ambitieus Europees klimaatbeleid, onder meer via de Europese klimaatkopgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bromet over het afsluiten van gasboorputten op LUT-5 in Losser

An MP asked the minister about permanently sealing gas wells in Losser, whether cement plugs fit the well integrity system, the cracked ROW-2 injection well in Rossum, and whether independent reviews of other wells are needed. The minister said SodM supervises sealing and post-closure monitoring, the ROW-2 investigation is still ongoing with a result expected by end of June 2021, and no independent investigation of other wells is currently deemed necessary.
No, there are currently no indications that this is necessary.
Nee, er zijn op dit moment geen aanwijzingen dat dat nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en De Graaf over het bericht dat het CBS gaat stoppen met onderscheid maken tussen een ‘westerse’ en ‘niet-westerse’ achtergrond

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether abandoning the 'western' versus 'non-western' background classification by Statistics Netherlands (CBS) hides immigration problems, and urged the CBS to be called to order. The government replied that the CBS will keep recording origin and migration background, that the categories lost meaning, and that the minister will not interfere with the CBS's statistical categorisation because it is an independent administrative body.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Erkens over het rapport ‘Energy Transition Monitor - Critical Metals' van ABN AMRO

MPs De Groot and Erkens asked about an ABN AMRO report warning that electrifying road transport alone will not solve critical-metal dependence, and about the government's plans on scarcity, circularity, hydrogen and biofuels. The state secretary answered that the government supports a mix of electric, hydrogen and biofuel paths, relies on recycling, the European Critical Raw Materials Action Plan and ERMA, and will use an efficiency-based allocation approach rather than a formal allocation framework.
I am aware that there may be scarcity of sustainable fuels. That is why efforts are directed at using the various fuels as efficiently as possible.
Ik ben mij ervan bewust dat er schaarste kan zijn aan duurzame brandstoffen. Daarom wordt er ingezet op een zo efficiënt mogelijke inzet van de verschillende brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over 'de belofte van het kabinet dat de versterking nu echt op stoom komt en de uitvoering van het bestuursakkoord'

MP Beckerman (SP) asks the government whether its promise that reinforcement of Groningen homes is finally gaining momentum is credible, whether the budget for batch 1588 is sufficient, and how the 2020 Bestuursakkoord (governance agreement) is being implemented across its blocks and categories. Minister Ollongren answers at length that implementation is progressing, that the amendment-Beckerman on restoring living space is being worked out with municipalities and NCG, and that various regulations, funds and plans are in preparation, but gives few firm figures on outcomes.
On the additional costs I am in consultation with municipalities, the National Coordinator Groningen (NCG) and the housing corporations.
Over de meerkosten ben ik met gemeenten, de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) en de woningcorporaties in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Wassenberg over CO2-uitstoot van bodemberoerende visserij, die even hoog is als de luchtvaartindustrie

MPs Teunissen and Wassenberg asked whether CO2 released from bottom trawling is counted in national emissions, whether it can be quantified, and whether the government will protect 30% of Dutch seas. The minister replied that seabed disturbance emissions are not counted nationally because IPCC rules provide no method and the CO2 share is unknown, and that protection follows the Noordzeeakkoord targets (13.7% rising to 15% by 2030) rather than 30%.
I will explore, with the State Secretary of EZK and Dutch knowledge institutions, the options for characterising the nature and severity of seabed disturbance as a source of CO2 emissions.
Ik zal in overleg met de Staatssecretaris van EZK met Nederlandse kennisinstellingen de mogelijkheden verkennen om de aard en ernst van bodemberoering als bron van CO 2 -uitstoot te duiden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Buitenweg over het bericht dat het CBS toegang kreeg tot privacygevoelige locatiedata van klanten van T-Mobile

MP Buitenweg asked about reports that Statistics Netherlands (CBS) had access to sensitive location data of T-Mobile customers, raising privacy, legal basis, oversight and contracting concerns. Minister Blok answered that the Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are investigating, that CBS says it only received anonymised or aggregated data, and that CBS is an independent body the minister cannot instruct on individual contracts.
The Agentschap Telecom and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens are currently jointly investigating the matter as supervisors following the NRC article.
Het Agentschap Telecom en de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doen op dit moment als toezichthouders samen onderzoek naar aanleiding van het NRC-artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Paul over de brief van de regering over de bekostiging van investeringsvoorstellen uit het Nationaal Groeifonds

Two VVD MPs asked how regional balance was ensured in Groeifonds investment allocations, why the advisory commission rejected the Rotterdam–Chemelot pipeline proposal, what the Flemish Antwerp–Chemelot pipeline consultation means for Rotterdam's competitiveness, and whether the government will act on the commission's advice for a pipeline bundle. The government answered that regional spread is not a goal in itself but a consideration, that the commission advised independently, that a Rotterdam-led follow-up study is underway with IenW, and that it endorses making capacity available but it is too early to commit budget.
The fund managers do not interfere in the commission's substantive weighing of proposals, in order to safeguard the commission's independent role.
De fondsbeheerders mengen zich niet in de inhoudelijke weging van voorstellen door de commissie, om zo de onafhankelijke rol van de commissie te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en van der Lee over duurzaamheidsrisico’s van staatsobligaties

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked the Finance and other ministers about the climate and sustainability risks of sovereign bonds, transparency on those risks, and how Nederland compares internationally on green recovery spending. The government answered that it supports transparency and integrating climate risks into IMF and World Bank debt analyses, that no current sovereign debt runs past 2060 and climate risks do not yet directly affect Dutch creditworthiness, and that it will raise climate risks more proactively with investors.
The Agency will therefore also proactively address climate risks and how the Netherlands tackles them in future presentations to prospective investors.
Het Agentschap zal daarom ook in de toekomst proactief in de presentaties voor beoogde investeerders aandacht besteden aan klimaatrisico’s en de wijze waarop Nederland deze risico’s adresseert.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf en Van ‘t Wout over het bericht ‘Einde van lintje voor brandweerlieden zorgt voor bittere smaak: “wij zetten een stap naar voren als anderen er een terug doen.”’

MPs Van der Graaf and Van 't Wout asked whether the end of automatic honours for long-serving volunteer firefighters, and the government's refusal to reconsider, undermines recruitment and retention, and whether the Royal Chancery would be consulted. The minister defended the decision, said volunteer firefighters can still be honoured on other grounds and that alternative brigade medals will be officially recognised this year.
I therefore see no reason to enter into discussion about this with the Chancery.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om hierover in gesprek te treden met de Kanselarij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en Koopmans over het bericht “Sollicitant niet meer vogelvrij op internet.”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about an Article 29 Working Party opinion on employers screening job applicants' social media profiles, and how it fits with Dutch privacy law and UWV training. The government answered that the opinion does not change existing rules, that the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (and later the AVG) leaves room for a necessary, transparent online check, and that no contradictory signal was given.
If a profile serves a professional purpose, it may more readily be justified than a private profile.
Als er sprake is van een profiel dat een professioneel doeleinde dient, zal daar eerder sprake van kunnen zijn dan als het een privé profiel betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van ’t Wout en De Boer over de veiligheid en leefbaarheid langs het goederenspoor in de gemeenten Moerdijk, Halderberge en Roosendaal

MPs Van 't Wout and De Boer asked about noise and safety from freight trains in Moerdijk, Halderberge and Roosendaal, and why sleepers and rail dampers are not being installed sooner. The Secretary of State answered that sleeper replacement runs to 2019 but cannot be accelerated within available track-free periods, that noise-reduction measures will be prioritised in 2018 under the MJPG, and that slower train speeds results are expected in autumn.
I expect to be able to share the results of this exploration next autumn.
Ik verwacht komend najaar resultaten van deze verkenning te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van ‘t Wout over uitbreiding van de werkingssfeer van een cao en/of de uitbreiding van de verplichtstellingsbeschikking van een bedrijfstakpensioenfonds

MPs Lodders and Van 't Wout asked how often and why the scope of collective agreements and pension fund compulsory membership decisions is changed, who decides, and whether 'clarifications' or 'editorial changes' disguise expansions. The ministers answered that scope is set by social partners, that Minister decides on extensions with representativeness rules and objections procedures, and gave counts of 2015-2016 scope-change decisions, while declining to investigate misuse of editorial changes.
Defining and adapting the scope of collective agreements and compulsory schemes is a responsibility of the social partners.
Het definiëren en aanpassen van werkingssferen van cao's en verplichtstellingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en De Boer over de effecten van de veranderde dienstregeling van NS op West-Brabant

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about the 2017 NS timetable change, which lengthened some West-Brabant to Randstad journeys (e.g. Oudenbosch–Schiphol), and whether NS consulted regional authorities and consumer groups as the concession requires. The State Secretary acknowledged some deteriorations but said the timetable is NS's responsibility, that the concession was respected, and that commercially confidential profitability data cannot be disclosed; she declined to study wider economic effects and offered only to discuss improvements for 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken- de Haan, Van ’t Wout en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht ‘Baan via gemeente of UWV? Vergeet het maar!’

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a Trouw report based on an Inspectorate SZW study showing weak cooperation between municipalities and UWV in placing jobseekers, and about knowledge management, the knowledge programme 'Vakkundig aan het werk', and how to raise employer uptake. The government acknowledged the cooperation problems, described existing and planned measures (knowledge programmes, Kandidatenverkenner, Programmaraad activities) and committed to a progress letter before 15 March 2017.
As promised during the Participation Act committee debate of 27 October, your House will be informed by letter before 15 March about progress.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het AO Participatiewet van 27 oktober jl., zal uw Kamer voor 15 maart per brief geïnformeerd worden over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Van ’t Wout over het bericht "Weinig Nederlanders zoeken een baan over de grens"

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the slow start of the cross-border job placement plan 'Grenzeloos Werken', the status of a related motion, and UWV's separate Limburg-Germany placement plan. The minister said the plan has not started yet due to difficulty raising private co-financing, that subsidy rules will be adapted to allow more public funding, and that the UWV cross-border work is financed from its regular budget and is distinct from the sectoral plan.
For the specific situation involving employers across the border, I am therefore willing to adjust the scheme and thereby create room for more public financing.
Voor de specifieke situatie waarbij men te maken heeft met werkgevers over de grens ben ik dan ook bereid de regeling aan te passen en daarmee ruimte te creëren voor meer publieke financiering
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk en 18 andere lidstaten oproepen tot doelstellingen om Europese regels te verminderen

An MP asked whether the Netherlands regrets not co-signing a 19-member-state call for EU regulatory-reduction targets and how it has implemented the motion on measurable better-regulation goals. The minister says the Netherlands supports the targets but did not co-sign for reasons of the upcoming EU presidency, and lists its prior efforts and plans to push the topic during the presidency.
During the presidency, the Netherlands will explicitly give attention to quantifying results and introducing reduction targets.
Nederland zal tijdens het voorzitterschap nadrukkelijk aandacht geven aan het onderwerp kwantificering van resultaten en invoering van reductiedoelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van ’t Wout over het bericht “France offers new farm aid as 1,500 tractors hit Paris streets”

MPs Lodders and Van 't Wout asked about reports that the French government would freeze implementation of new, mainly environmental, rules for livestock farming, and whether this distorts the EU level playing field. The government answered that the French moratorium until 1 February 2016 only checks for national rules stricter than EU requirements, that EU implementation is not frozen, and that the Netherlands has pressed for European rather than national action.
A specification of possibly stricter national measures cannot be given at this stage, as the French government's review has not yet been completed.
Een specificering van mogelijk stringentere nationale maatregelen is in dit stadium is niet te geven, daar de toetsing door de Franse overheid nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en Aukje de Vries over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer over aanhoudende problemen bij EU-aanbesteden

MPs Van 't Wout and Aukje de Vries asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Finance about the European Court of Auditors' report on persistent EU public procurement problems, including errors in about 40% of audited projects and possible suspension of payments. The minister answered that the government shares the recommendations, pushes for stricter Commission enforcement, notes new EU procurement directives and REFIT simplification efforts, and is still exploring whether regional and local procurement rules can be excluded for EFRO and ESF projects.

The cabinet shares the recommendations of the European Court of Auditors and believes the European Commission should strictly and uniformly supervise compliance by member state authorities when spending EU funds.

Het kabinet deelt genoemde aanbevelingen van de Europese Rekenkamer en is van mening dat de Europese Commissie bij besteding van EU fondsen op strikte en uniforme wijze moet toezien op naleving door autoriteiten in lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van ’t Wout en Anne Mulder over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof van Justitie dat reistijd gezien moet worden als werktijd

Two VVD MPs asked whether the European Court of Justice ruling that travel time for workers without a fixed workplace counts as working time will raise labour costs and weaken employment, and how much room it leaves for social partners and member states. The minister answered that no significant employment effect is expected in the Netherlands, that the ruling covers only workers without a fixed or habitual workplace and does not regulate pay, and that wage-setting remains with the social partners, so no national action is planned.
The ruling does not in any way limit the possibilities social partners have to make further agreements on the pay for travel time.
De uitspraak vormt geen enkele inperking van de mogelijkheden die sociale partners hebben om nadere afspraken te maken over de beloning van reistijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ark en Van ‘t Wout over het bericht ‘ Timmermans wil Brusselse afspraken om meer vrouwen aan het werk te helpen’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the EU should regulate women's labour participation and work-care balance, and whether the government would resist such regulation. The minister answered that the Commission is only at the roadmap and consultation stage, that subsidiarity applies, that work-care division is primarily a matter for partners, and that the government will inform Parliament via BNC fiches and a planned SER advice and 2016 consultation.
On these proposals and the Dutch position on them, the cabinet will inform you in due course in the usual way via BNC fiches.
Over deze voorstellen en het Nederlandse standpunt daarover zal het kabinet u te zijner tijd op de gebruikelijke wijze via BNC fiche(s) informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van ’t Wout over de fraude met en ineffectiviteit van Europese subsidies ten behoeve van sociale inclusie van Roma

An MP asked the ministers about a broadcast alleging waste and fraud in EU subsidies for Roma social inclusion in Romania, and whether the subsidies should be halted and recovered. The government said it relies on existing EU control rules, awaits the European Court of Auditors' investigation, and will not yet demand recovery of the subsidies.
The government, however, does not have specific (control) data on the projects mentioned in the broadcast or any controls on them.
Het kabinet beschikt echter niet over specifieke (controle-)gegevens over de in de uitzending genoemde projecten en eventuele controles daarop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over Europese informatieuitwisseling over visumverlening aan haatpredikers

An MP from the VVD asked the Foreign Minister whether EU Schengen states share information on visa applications from hate preachers and whether he would coordinate with European colleagues to refuse them entry. The minister answered that the Schengen acquis already allows SIS alerts and VIS recording of visa refusals, and saw no need for further coordination.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van het Wout over het bericht “Megaheffing voor cliënten van Ascensio”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health whether clients of care provider Ascensio, found to have committed abuses, face clawbacks of personal budget (pgb) funds, and whether the directors rather than clients should be held liable. The State Secretary confirmed Achmea zorgkantoor is recovering unverified pgb amounts but suspended recovery pending investigation, will explore support for good-faith budget holders, and noted directors can be held liable under civil law.
I have agreed with Achmea that, while that investigation is ongoing, the claim against budget holders to repay the pgb is suspended.
Ik heb met Achmea afgesproken dat lopende dat onderzoek de vordering op de budgethouders om het pgb terug te betalen, wordt opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van ’t Wout over het bericht «Mug met virus groeit hard in poldermoeras»

Two VVD MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers how mosquito-borne disease is monitored and whether wetland restoration raises public health risks such as dengue and West Nile virus. The minister answered that current mosquito species pose no significant disease risk, that monitoring and existing Alterra and RIVM studies continue, and that wetland expansion is a provincial matter with no current measured disease burden, so further RIVM advice is awaited.
The RIVM is currently working with the NVWA's Centre for Vector Monitoring on policy advice on the control of native mosquitoes.
Het RIVM werkt op dit moment in samenwerking met het Centrum Monitoring Vectoren van de NVWA aan een beleidsadvies over de inheemse muggenbestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over het artikel “Ondernemer profiteert van zorgboerderij; Fraudemelding tot op heden nog door niemand serieus genomen”

An MP asked the State Secretary about press reports of PGB (personal budget) fraud at care farms and claims that fraud reports were not taken seriously by oversight bodies. The government answered that it lacks data on PGB spending at care farms, cannot trace the specific reports, describes intensified home visits and an evaluation, and says a public blacklist is not permitted for privacy reasons.
For privacy reasons, however, it is not possible to make public the names of persons convicted under criminal law.
Om redenen van privacy is het echter niet mogelijk om de namen van personen die strafrechtelijk zijn veroordeeld openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over het bericht: “Zorgvernieuwing… Op papier”

The MP asks whether the paper-based reimbursement system for dental care in AWBZ institutions is outdated, why it has not been modernised, whether fraud risk warrants faster change, whether digitisation would reduce costs, and whether other long-term care systems are outdated. The Secretary of State agrees the system needs renewal but leaves timing to CAK and Zorgverzekeraars Nederland, sees no evidence of fraud, and says a digital system could be more user-friendly while declining to estimate costs.
I leave it to CAK and ZN to choose a suitable moment to renew this part of the declaration system.
Ik laat het aan CAK en ZN om een geschikt moment te kiezen om dit onderdeel van de declaratiesystematiek te vernieuwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Van ’t Wout over het bericht dat ouderen vaker slachtoffer zijn van geweld

Two MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary for Health about a CBS report showing a rise in violence against elderly people, its causes, and whether additional measures to protect older people are planned. The government said the causes are unclear, pointed to ongoing action plans, prevention campaigns and a care-sector warning register, and said police and prosecutors do not record elder abuse specifically so no sentencing figures can be given.
The police and the public prosecution service do not record specifically on elder abuse.
Politie en het openbaar ministerie registreren niet specifiek op ouderenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over het bericht “Malafide zorgondernemers komen te makkelijk weg”

An MP asked the State Secretary whether a care provider closed by the Inspectorate could reappear under another name, and whether the care office (Achmea) fulfilled its fraud-fighting duty in the Ascensio case. The State Secretary answered that the sanction also binds the successor Infinitus, that the care office acted correctly while its fraud investigation continues, and promised a programme plan on fraud in spring 2015.
I am therefore of the view that my order to cease care provision and transfer clients, as it now applies to Ascensio, also applies to Infinitus.
Ik ben dan ook van mening dat mijn aanwijzing tot staken van de zorgverlening en overdracht van de cliënten zoals die zich nu richt op Ascensio zich ook richt op Infinitus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van 't Wout en Visser over het bericht “Gehandicapte niet welkom in Utrecht door milieuregels”

MPs Van 't Wout and Visser asked the state secretary about reports that people with mobility-aid vehicles are excluded by Utrecht's environmental zone rules. The secretary said the zone targets vehicles rather than users, that the municipality offers subsidies and possible exemptions, and that the specific case is under municipal review.
I am of the view that measures benefiting the environment should in principle apply to both people with and without a disability.
Ik ben van mening dat maatregelen die ten goede komen aan het milieu in beginsel zowel voor mensen met als zonder een beperking dienen te gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van 't Wout over de artikelen “Persoonsgebonden bedrog”, “Hoe de geldzucht het won van de idealen” en “Thomashuizen gebruiken geld voor zorg om huur te betalen”

An MP asks the state secretary whether personal-budget (pgb) funds may indirectly cover property costs at Thomashuizen, whether the rules are clear enough, and whether controls ensure pgb money is spent on care. The secretary replies that housing costs cannot be paid from the pgb, sets out the cost breakdown, promises clearer rules on the 4,000-euro supplement and a pre-approval 'trekkingsrecht' from 2015, and says verification will be explored further with care offices.
The personal budget must be spent on care. That is the starting point.
Het pgb moet worden besteed aan zorg. Dat is het uitgangspunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van het Wout over het artikel “In de watten gelegd”

An MP asked the state secretary for health about a newspaper article reporting that sexual care providers were sometimes paid from personal budgets (pgb). The state secretary agreed such services are not insured care, said zorgkantoren would reject such claims, admitted they do not monitor these rejections, and pointed to the pgb reimbursement list that excludes sexual services.
I do not have this data.
Ik beschik niet over deze gegevens.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Schiermonnikoog vreest een blijvend litteken van de windstroomleiding'

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about the proposed wind power cable route under Schiermonnikoog in the Wadden Sea UNESCO area, its ecological risks, and alternatives. The state secretary defended the western route as the preferred option, said the eastern route is constrained, and committed to further research and regional consultation without irreversible steps.
In the meantime, I am not taking any irreversible steps.
In de tussentijd zet ik geen onomkeerbare stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het rapport 'Policies for a climate-neutral industry: Lessons from the Netherlands'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an OECD report on climate policy for industry, including the CO2 levy's effects, technology support and overall policy design. The ministers broadly welcomed the OECD's findings, defended the combined pricing and subsidy approach, and committed to some follow-up such as evaluations and infrastructure programmes while rejecting several recommendations.
The cabinet has also long worked with the broader Human Capital Agendas of the top sectors and the Techniekpact.
Het kabinet werkt daarnaast al langer met de bredere Human Capital Agenda's van de topsectoren en het Techniekpact.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Shell handelt volgens accountant niet in overeenstemming met eigen klimaatdoel'

An SP MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that Shell's climate plans are not aligned with its own 2050 net-zero goal, including its reliance on carbon intensity, vague planning, tree planting, greenwashing and subsidies for fossil fuels. The State Secretary replies that Shell must meet its own targets, that Dutch and EU carbon pricing and ETS rules apply to its emissions, and that it is not for the cabinet to set a company's global strategy.
It is not for the cabinet to determine a company's global strategy.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om de wereldwijde strategie van een bedrijf te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht “miljoenen liters diesel liggen bij de ’groene’ datacenters van Microsoft en Google in Hollands Kroon”

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports of millions of litres of diesel stored at Microsoft and Google data centres in Hollands Kroon, including who decides on permits, noise and smell nuisance, fire safety information and siting criteria. The minister answered that the competent authority (the province of Noord-Holland and the municipality are disputing this) assesses permits under law, that nuisance and safety are weighed in those permits, and that siting is primarily a matter for decentralised governments under the national environmental vision, without committing to new national siting rules.
I am not the competent authority for permit granting, and therefore I also do not know the substantive specifications of such cases.
Ik ben geen bevoegd gezag voor de vergunningverlening, en ken dus ook de inhoudelijke specificaties van dergelijke gevallen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Huis maximaal verduurzaamd en toch nog een torenhoge energierekening. Hoe kan dit?'

An MP asked the minister about higher capacity-based grid tariffs for households that have sustainably upgraded homes, and whether these discourage electrification. The minister said the number of higher-capacity connections is limited, that grid costs are shared among users under cost-reflective rules set by the ACM, and that Netbeheer Nederland is studying a new tariff structure.
This is not possible, since the allocation keys are set by the ACM. I am not competent to intervene in this.
Dit is niet mogelijk, aangezien de verdeelsleutels door de ACM worden vastgesteld. Ik ben niet bevoegd om hierop in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over berichten dat tot 50 procent van de overwinst van subsidies voor windmolens in de portemonnee van ondernemers verdwijnt

An MP asked the minister whether subsidies for onshore wind turbines leave up to half of excess profit with entrepreneurs, citing a Groningen University study and press reports. The state secretary rejected the picture of widespread oversubsidy, defended the SDE++ tender design, and promised to examine overstimulation in the upcoming evaluation of the scheme.
In addition, the scheme will be evaluated again this year, and the extent to which excess profits occur and can be further limited will also be examined.
Daarnaast zal de regeling dit jaar opnieuw worden geëvalueerd, waarbij de mate waarin overwinsten optreden en verder kunnen worden beperkt ook zal worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat grootwinkels aan de rand van de afgrond staan

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that large retail chains face bankruptcy, and whether the government would talk to them, extend aid, and cover their fixed costs. The minister replied that talks with the sector led to a decision not to create an extra subsidy scheme for large firms, pointed to existing measures (TVL, GO-C, Groeifaciliteit, case-by-case support) and said it would review remaining barriers to case-by-case aid.
All things considered, the cabinet has chosen not to introduce an additional subsidy scheme for large enterprises.
Alles overwegende heeft het kabinet ervoor gekozen om geen extra subsidieregeling voor het grootbedrijf in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul, Erkens en Van Strien over het rapport 'The Role of Critical Minerals in Clean Energy Transitions' van het Internationale Energieagentschap (IEA)

MPs Paul, Erkens and Van Strien asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the IEA report on critical minerals, including dependence on China, strategic stockpiles, nuclear energy and resource efficiency technology. The minister answered that Europe-level policy, circular strategies and industry-led risk management are the preferred response, that stockpiles are only sometimes useful and Europe should first improve risk analysis, and that nuclear could contribute to diversification without being decisive.
That is why the Netherlands is pursuing ambitious raw materials policy at the European level.
Daarom zet Nederland in op ambitieus grondstoffenbeleid op Europees niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Grinwis over het bericht 'Actiegroep: ministerie zwichtte voor vrees claim gaswinner'

MPs Bromet and Grinwis asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the ministry extended Vermilion's expired gas exploration licence out of fear of damage claims, and why relevant documents were redacted under the Wob. The minister denied this, citing the Mijnbouwwet's grounds, said extension differs legally from a new licence, and that existing licences are extended while new oil and gas licences are not issued per the coalition agreement.
The Mijnbouwwet has specific grounds for assessing (an extension of) an exploration licence.
De Mijnbouwwet kent specifieke afwegingsgronden voor de beoordeling van (een verlenging van) een opsporingsvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de stijgende energienota op lange termijn

An MP asked the minister about the projected rise in long-term energy bills, network investment of over 100 billion euros, the fairness of network tariffs between businesses and households, and whether the energy tax credit should be raised. The state secretary answered that the investment estimate is uncertain but not judged wrong, that tariff rules are set by the ACM, that cost-sharing changes are a matter for a future cabinet, and that a study on financing the energy transition has been sent to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Energienota onder druk – Uitbreiding stroomnet kost 102 miljard euro'

An MP from the PVV asks whether the energy transition, including a 102 billion euro grid expansion, is unaffordable, and whether the government will halt it. The Minister replies that the transition must be affordable, cites PwC's estimate of a modest rise in household grid tariffs, and rejects calls to abandon climate policy.
Network operators want the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) to decide to reimburse investments in the electricity grid more quickly.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) besluit om investeringen in het elektriciteitsnet sneller te vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Erkens over het bericht 'Van Hoogezand tot Siddeburen: iedereen wil ’s nachts een stil windpark'

MPs Agnes Mulder and Erkens asked whether the government would consider night-time shutdown of wind turbines at park N33 in Midden-Groningen to address noise nuisance, and about current policy, noise standards, RES planning, and the business-case effects of such shutdowns. The state secretary answered that enforcement lies with municipalities, that current noise norms are scientifically based and not to be revised for now, that night shutdown would cut output and a third more capacity would be needed, and that alternatives are being discussed with the sector.
It is therefore up to the municipalities concerned to establish whether the noise standards are exceeded and to decide on possible steps based on their findings.
Het is daarom aan de betreffende gemeenten om vast te stellen of er sprake is van overschrijding van de geluidsnormen en aan de hand van hun bevindingen te besluiten over eventuele stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Artsen uit Noord en IJburg: windmolens dicht bij woongebied wel degelijk riskant'

An MP from the PVV asks the minister whether wind turbines close to residential areas in Amsterdam pose health risks, citing a letter from over 100 doctors and a Danish study, and questions whether the RIVM literature review is outdated. The state secretary responds that the RIVM review remains valid, additional Dutch research will be scoped by end 2021, a Expertisepunt Windenergie en Gezondheid will be set up, and the noise norm with an accepted 9% seriously-annoyed risk is maintained.
Nevertheless, I share the need for more knowledge about the Dutch situation and therefore for additional research.
Desalniettemin deel ik de behoefte aan meer kennis over de Nederlandse situatie en dus aan aanvullend onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over berichtgeving in de media over het ingediende winningsplan Tietjerk voor gaswinning

An MP asks the minister about media reports that the state mines supervisor SodM advised negatively on a large gas extraction plan near Burgum, and whether that advice will be published and when a decision will be taken. The minister confirms the negative advice, refuses to publish it early because the law fixes publication alongside the draft decision, and says the decision will follow advice from other bodies and a public inspection period after the summer.
No, I am not willing to make the advice public prematurely.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid om het advies voortijdig openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Joba van den Berg over het artikel 'Een windcoöperatie in een neoliberale wereld. Het grootkapitaal duwt een burgerinitiatief de markt uit'

The CDA MPs Agnes Mulder and Joba van den Berg asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a newspaper article claiming large developers push out local wind cooperatives, including whether public tendering disadvantages citizen initiatives and whether local binding or ownership should be required. The State Secretary answered that tenders on state land aim for 50% local ownership, that municipalities already have instruments to make participation conditional, and that the government will monitor participation and consider additional measures if needed.
I will critically monitor whether participation indeed comes sufficiently to the fore, and consider additional measures if that proves insufficient.
Ik zal kritisch monitoren of participatie inderdaad voldoende uit de verf komt, en aanvullende maatregelen overwegen als dat onvoldoende gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Ook aardgas dreigt straks als 'groen' te worden gezien'

An SP MP asks whether the government accepts that the EU taxonomy could label gas-fired power as green, why NGOs left the sustainable finance platform, and whether nuclear energy should count as green. The minister states the Netherlands favours a science-based, technology-neutral taxonomy, that gas is not in line with the scientific advice, and that the government will press the Commission on its scientific basis while the nuclear assessment is still pending.
The Netherlands will continue to advocate a technology-neutral taxonomy in which economic activities are assessed on the basis of scientific criteria.
Nederland zal blijven pleiten voor een technologie-neutrale taxonomie, waarin economische activiteiten aan de hand van wetenschappelijke criteria worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'Miljardensubsidie voor CO2-opslag onder Noordzee is rond'

MP Leijten (SP) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why billions in subsidies for CO2 storage under the North Sea, benefiting polluters such as Shell, are justified and why this money is not spent on renewables, along with questions on evaluation, the CO2 levy, refineries and the Klimaatakkoord's democratic legitimacy. The state secretary replied that CCS is a cost-effective generic SDE++ subsidy technology, that subsidies cover only the unprofitable top and are capped and time-limited, and that the Klimaatakkoord was broadly supported and politically adopted.
The functioning of the SDE+ will be evaluated this year, and the functioning of the SDE++ (which also includes CO2-reducing techniques besides renewable energy production) will be evaluated in 2023.

Het functioneren van de SDE+ wordt dit jaar geëvalueerd, het functioneren van de SDE++ (waarin ook CO 2 -reducterende technieken, naast de productie van hernieuwbare energie) zal in 2023 worden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het Klimaatcrisis Beleid Team

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the minister why the government has not adopted an independent climate commission or treated the climate crisis as a crisis, as advised by the Council of State, Rli and WRR. The state secretary replied that the Council of State already fulfils an advisory role, that the outgoing cabinet will not give a full response on the KBT advice, and that choices on climate governance are for the new cabinet.
I am of the view that the Council of State fulfils its role well. It is for the new cabinet to make any changes to governance, including any amendment of the Climate Act.

Ik ben van mening dat de Raad van State haar rol goed vervult. Daarbij is het aan het nieuwe kabinet om eventuele wijzigingen in de governance, waaronder een eventuele wijziging van de Klimaatwet, aan te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over problemen bij de registratie van zendamateurs

An MP asked whether over 1,000 amateur radio registrations had been wrongly withdrawn by the Agentschap Telecom, leaving many operators without a valid licence. The State Secretary answered that no registrations were withdrawn; a database clean-up and an automated script caused a false impression, and the agency has since clarified the situation.
However, this was not the case.
Dit was echter niet het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters vragen om compensatie, want ook broeders bijten in coronatijd op houtje'

MPs asked whether monasteries whose income from abbey shops and guesthouses fell due to COVID-19 can access compensation, and whether they should be treated like shops and hospitality businesses. The government answered that these organisations can use the generic COVID schemes (NOW, Tozo, TVL) if they meet the conditions, and it does not plan additional measures specifically for them.
The cabinet is not currently planning to introduce additional support measures specifically for this group, beyond the existing generic support measures.
Het kabinet is vooralsnog niet voornemens om, naast de bestaande diverse generieke steunmaatregelen, aanvullende ondersteuningsmaatregelen te treffen specifiek voor deze groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over biomassacentrales bij kastuinbouwgebieden

An MP asks the minister why biomass plants for greenhouse horticulture keep receiving subsidies and whether cleaner heat alternatives should be prioritised, and whether building such plants should be discouraged or banned. The minister answers that biomass is considered a sustainable heat source, that low-temperature subsidies will be phased out as soon as feasible, that the final phase-out date is left to the next cabinet, and that a ban is not planned.
I cannot provide a list of built biomass plants at greenhouse horticulture areas because the type of heat customer is not registered.
Ik kan geen lijst met gebouwde biomassacentrales bij glastuinbouwgebieden overleggen omdat de aard van de afnemer van de warmte niet wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Aukje de Vries over de berichten 'Overvol stroomnet doet pijn in Leeuwarden' en 'Problemen op elektrisiteitsnet: gjin stroom foar nije skoallen yn Ljouwert'

MPs Erkens and Aukje de Vries asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid capacity shortages in Leeuwarden that block housing, schools and businesses. The minister confirmed the shortages, explained the timelines for a new substation (2026-2027), and pointed to measures and the Energy Act, without committing to a fast fix.
Expanding the infrastructure takes time, partly due to the scarcity of technical personnel and lengthy planning procedures.
Het uitbreiden van de infrastructuur kost tijd, mede door de schaarste van technisch personeel en door lange planologische procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Netbeheerder Stedin gaat bij gemeenten langs voor € 200 miljoen'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Stedin's request to its municipal shareholders for 200 million euros to reinforce the grid, the rise in network costs, municipal tax increases, and grid reliability linked to the energy transition. The minister answers that the investment is normal business and that the network tariffs are set and supervised by the independent regulator ACM, while promising to evaluate the n-1 regulation and examine the role of the state in grid capital needs.
ACM, as independent regulator, supervises that grid operators can recover their efficient costs including a reasonable return.
ACM ziet als onafhankelijke toezichthouder toe dat netbeheerders hun efficiënte kosten kunnen terugverdienen inclusief een redelijk rendement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boucke over het bericht 'Diederik Samsom: Nederland laat miljarden aan subsidies liggen voor energietransitie'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the Netherlands is leaving billions in EU recovery subsidies unclaimed, the delayed Recovery and Resilience Plan, and the government's position on hydrogen in mobility and home heating. The Minister replied that the plan is deliberately left for the next cabinet to decide, that about 6 billion euro is expected to be claimed without loss if submitted by summer 2022, and that hydrogen's role is still being explored through pilots.
As communicated in the same letter, the caretaker cabinet has commissioned an official exploration of the possible content of a Dutch recovery plan.
Zoals gecommuniceerd in dezelfde brief, heeft het demissionaire kabinet opdracht gegeven tot een ambtelijke verkenning naar de mogelijke inhoud van een Nederlands herstelplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Ophef over het gebruik van ‘foute’ Chinese zonnepanelen’

Rep. Van der Lee asked the ministers about reports that solar panels sold in the Netherlands may use polysilicon produced with Uyghur forced labour in Xinjiang, and about Dutch dependence on Chinese supply. The government said it lacks data on Xinjiang content, will raise IMVO due-diligence obligations with the solar sector and the EU, and cannot confirm forced labour beyond cited reports.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to comply with the OECD Guidelines and the UNGPs.
Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal ondernemen dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen en de UNGP’s naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zonnepanelen komen van Chinese bedrijven die worden verdacht van dwangarbeid’

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch solar panels are linked to Chinese firms suspected of forced labour in Xinjiang, and what the government would do about it. The government says it lacks data on Xinjiang content in Dutch panels, urges companies to apply due diligence under the OECD Guidelines and UN Guiding Principles, and says it will raise the issue at EU level and engage the sector.
It must be stated at the outset that the cabinet does not have data on the extent to which polysilicon from Xinjiang is processed in the panels used in the Netherlands.
Vooropgesteld staat dat het kabinet niet over gegevens beschikt in hoeverre de in Nederland gebruikte panelen polysilicium uit Xinjiang is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het bericht dat volgens de secretaris-generaal van de Verenigde Naties de wereld op de rand van de afgrond staat door de klimaatcrisis

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the minister about UN and IEA warnings on climate change and CO2 emissions, and whether the Dutch COVID recovery packages sufficiently support a green recovery. The minister acknowledges the urgency, says the packages aimed to preserve employment rather than break with fossil business as usual, and points to the Klimaatakkoord, the EU Recovery and Resilience Facility, and a decision left to the next cabinet.
Implementing reforms was an important condition for the cabinet to agree to establish the RRF.
Het doorvoeren van hervormingen was een belangrijke voorwaarde voor het kabinet om in te kunnen stemmen met de oprichting van de RRF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over onnodig hoge subsidies voor Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) en de lobby van de fossiele industrie

MP Van Raan asks whether the fossil industry lobbied the government for CCS subsidies, state liability and guarantees, and whether SDE++ subsidies for CCS are excessive given the CO2 levy and the PBL advice. The minister denies industry drafted the CCS plans or demanded guarantees, explains the SDE++ and CO2 levy mechanics, and defends the 2020 subsidy round, promising only to revisit SDE++ details in future rounds.
No, that is incorrect. In regular contacts with the companies involved, including state holdings, numerous topics are discussed.
Nee, dat is onjuist. In de reguliere contacten met de betrokken ondernemingen, waaronder staatsdeelnemingen, komen tal van onderwerpen aan bod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over bewoners die na een verwoestende brand in een door gaswinning onveilige woning nu alles kwijt zijn

An SP MP asked the Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about a family whose Groningen house, damaged by gas-extraction earthquakes and vacated in 2017, burned down in 2020, leaving them with no compensation or replacement home, and whether the government will ensure restitution and limit prolonged legal battles. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, said liability must be assessed case by case, pointed to NCG and IMG support and meetings with affected residents, and gave no concrete new commitment.
However, we do not make statements about the details of individual situations.
Wij doen echter geen mededelingen over de details van individuele situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de staking bij kolencentrale op de Maasvlakte

An SP MP asks the Economy and Climate minister why the owner of the Onyx coal plant requested a 238 million euro closure subsidy while allocating little for staff, and how the subsidy conditions and works council procedures protect employees. The minister replies that the subsidy is conditional on an adequate social plan and WOR procedures, that no agreement on the social plan exists yet, that the financial assessment and EU state-aid approval are pending, and that the minister is not a party to the social plan negotiations.
If the proposal submitted by Power Plant Rotterdam does not meet the stated requirements, the subsidy for the proposal will not be granted.
Als het voorstel dat door Power Plant Rotterdam is ingediend niet voldoet aan de gestelde eisen, wordt de subsidie voor het voorstel niet verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over ‘’belemmerende factoren voor een rechtvaardig herstel van kapotte en onveilige huizen’’

An SP MP asked the ministers about obstacles to fair repair of damaged and unsafe houses in Groningen caused by gas extraction, covering the evidential presumption, KNMI measurement errors, backlogs, foundation damage and value-loss compensation. The minister answered that the independent IMG handles claims under the statutory presumption, is working to speed up processing and refine its approach, and that the measurement errors had no effect on damage handling.
The IMG applies the statutory evidential presumption and uses the report of the expert panel the IMG commissioned in 2019.
Het IMG past het wettelijke bewijsvermoeden toe en gebruikt hierbij het rapport van het panel van deskundigen dat het IMG in 2019 heeft uitgevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Romke de Jong over de Duitse testplicht bij grenswerkers

Two D66 MPs asked why German COVID test requirements apply to cross-border workers living in the Netherlands, whether they were informed, who pays for tests, and whether the GGD can provide certificates. The State Secretary confirmed the test obligation applies to them, pointed to official information channels, declined to make GGD tests available for certificates, and said a free testing facility in the border region was being set up.
No. The GGDs test with the aim of combating infectious diseases; preventive testing and issuing test certificates are indeed not part of that.
Nee. De GGD'en testen met als doel om de infectieziektebestrijding tegen te gaan; het preventief testen en verstrekken van testbewijzen maken daar inderdaad geen onderdeel van uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Nijboer over ‘de compensatie van Shell en Exxon voor het verlagen van de gaswinning’

MPs Beckerman and Nijboer asked whether Shell and ExxonMobil received at least 1.5 billion euros in compensation for the Groningen gas closure, and pressed on the NAM's payments for damage and reinforcement costs, the stuwmeer scheme, the Norg storage dispute and possible taxation of the oil companies. The minister denied the 1.5 billion figure, said the profit-split change was about 1.3 billion for 2018-2023 but much lower in practice, and explained the cost recovery from NAM and the ongoing arbitration, while declining to disclose commercially confidential information and promising to inform parliament on a levy.
All agreements with Shell, ExxonMobil or the NAM are public, except for commercially confidential information.
Alle overeenkomsten met Shell, ExxonMobil of de NAM zijn, behoudens bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie, openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Groningers in bevingsgebied moeten nog langer wachten op smartengeld'

An MP asked why the Groningen compensation scheme for immaterial (emotional) damage from earthquakes is delayed, what the new timetable is, and how the Chamber was informed. The minister explains the scheme is new and complex, the IMG plans a phased start at end of Q2 2021 with 100 households, and the Chamber was informed proactively via the IMG website and regular updates.
I will also proactively inform your Chamber about developments regarding the procedure for compensation of immaterial damage.
Ik zal uw Kamer ook proactief informeren over de ontwikkelingen omtrent de werkwijze voor de vergoeding van immateriële schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht 'Gasunie vraagt om jaarlijkse bijdrage van €100 miljoen om draai te maken naar ‘groen’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why Gasunie's request for an annual state contribution of 100 million euros to make a hydrogen business case viable should not be seen as unjustified subsidy, and questioned the need for hydrogen infrastructure and higher gas taxes. The minister answered that the government is still researching with grid operators whether part of the gas network can carry hydrogen, will wait for results (due in May) before taking positions, and argued that temporary subsidies can be justified for CO2-reducing technologies not yet on a level playing field.
By mid-May the research will be ready and will be sent to the House.
Medio mei is het onderzoek gereed en zal het aan de Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over een extra subsidie voor de extra bijstook van houtige biomassa

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether RWE's Eemshaven coal plant received extra subsidy to raise woody biomass co-firing from 15% to 30%, and how this fits with the Energy Agreement cap and the ban on new biomass subsidies. The minister answered that no new or increased subsidy decision was issued, that the existing 2016 subsidy ceiling is about 930 million euros over 8 years, and that the co-firing category was closed in the SDE+ after 2017.
I cannot provide competition-sensitive data on the amount of biomass used.
Ik kan geen concurrentiegevoelige gegevens over de gebruikte hoeveelheid biomassa verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over watergebruik in datacenters

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about water use by data centres, including whether dikes must be raised, permitting, discharge rules and drinking water use for cooling. The minister answered that the Wieringermeer dike meets the legal norm, that the permitting authority and discharge rules are set out, and that she does not find national legislation on data centre water use necessary, while committing to a national drinking water policy exploration.
There is no information available on cooling water use for specific data centres in North Holland.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over gebruik van koelwater voor specifieke datacenters in Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat Nederland nog steeds een claimparadijs is voor brievenbusfirma’s
