An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch investment treaties allow letterbox companies to bring ISDS claims against states, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that the renegotiation of bilateral investment treaties on the modernised model text is largely stalled due to COVID-19 restrictions, that the government is committed to resuming it, and that the Energy Charter modernisation includes excluding letterbox firms.
The cabinet is committed to modernising the Dutch BITs and is looking at ways to resume the (re)negotiations as soon as possible.
Het kabinet is gecommitteerd aan de modernisering van de Nederlandse IBO's en bekijkt de mogelijkheden om de (her-)onderhandelingen zo snel mogelijk te hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de provincie ingrijpt bij een datacenter in Middenmeer (Hollands Kroon)

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether the dispute between the province of Noord-Holland and the municipality of Hollands Kroon over competence for data centre permits, and the wider sprawl of large warehouses and data centres, should prompt national rules or intervention. The minister answered that the province and municipality are in consultation, that the provincial executive considers itself competent, that spatial choices lie primarily with municipalities, and that further national rules are not currently on the table, with a first step being to develop and monitor siting policy with other authorities.
It is always preferable that governments reach a shared view through good mutual consultation.
Het heeft altijd de voorkeur dat overheden in goed onderling overleg tot een gezamenlijk inzicht komen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Beckerman over de enorme ambities van Vermillion

MP Beckerman asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about Vermilion's gas extraction plan under Burgum (11.5 billion cubic metres), its compatibility with the energy transition, timing and criteria of the decision, subsidence compensation, a presumption of causation for damage, why the plan was not public, and fracking. The minister answered that the plan is still in advisory procedure with a decision expected at least two months away, that gas remains needed, that a Commission Mijnbouwschade handles damage claims, that a statutory presumption of causation is not justified outside Groningen, and that the plan was published on signing the draft decision under the standard procedure.
The extraction plan is still in the first phase of the procedure in which I request advice from the statutory advisers.
Het winningsplan zit nog in de eerste fase van de procedure waarin ik advies vraag aan de wettelijk adviseurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht 'KLM maakt werk van pakketreizen, touroperators boos: ‘Dit mag de overheid nooit toelaten’'

An MP asked whether the state, as a 6% shareholder and creditor-supported rescue provider of KLM, should accept KLM's acquisition of a majority stake in AirTrade while it depends on state aid, and about the moral and state-aid implications including possible double support via BCD Group. The minister answered that acquisitions are a matter for KLM's board under Dutch corporate law, that Finance was only informed in outline as the aid conditions required, that the state agent was not informed, and that acquisition costs are for the parties to disclose.
The state agent was not informed by KLM and not involved in the decision-making on this acquisition.
De staatsagent is door KLM niet geïnformeerd en betrokken bij de besluitvorming over deze acquisitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht dat Nederland niet is uitgenodigd voor de door de VS georganiseerde klimaattop

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the Netherlands was excluded from the US-hosted climate summit and whether Dutch climate leadership is credible, and what the government will do to follow up on the summit and COP-26. The minister replied that the Netherlands was invited to the ministerial on adaptation and resilience, rejected the claim that the Netherlands is not seen as a climate leader, and promised to inform parliament through letters on climate diplomacy and COP-26.
You will receive this letter before the summer.
U ontvangt deze brief voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht dat de startersregeling Tegemoetkoming Vaste Lasten (TVL) pas medio mei open zal gaan

MP Aartsen asked why the TVL starter scheme for businesses registered between October 2019 and June 2020 will not open until mid-May, why Q4 2020 is not compensated, and what prospects exist for affected entrepreneurs. The state secretary explains that the scheme's design, EU pre-notification and system-building take time, that Q4 is not compensated to avoid double subsidy, and points to other measures and a forthcoming economic recovery letter.
I do not consider compensating the fourth quarter of 2020, whereby these companies would again receive double subsidy, defensible compared with other companies that can use only one of the schemes.

Ik vind het vergoeden van het vierde kwartaal van 2020, waarbij nog een keer al deze ondernemingen dubbele subsidie zouden ontvangen, niet verdedigbaar ten opzichte van andere ondernemingen, die slechts van één van de regelingen gebruik kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over aardgas als duurzame en klimaatvriendelijke brandstof

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked whether natural gas should be classed as a sustainable fuel under the EU Taxonomy, why households are being moved off gas, and whether the gas-free neighbourhood pilots should stop. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes the Commission's proposal to classify gas plants as sustainable, that the transition is voluntary and aligned with the Climate Agreement, and that the Netherlands remains committed to its climate targets.
The Netherlands therefore spoke out against the Commission's new proposal to classify private investments in gas power plants as sustainable under conditions.
Nederland heeft zich dan ook uitgesproken tegen het nieuwe Commissievoorstel om private investeringen in aardgascentrales onder voorwaarden als duurzaam aan te merken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sienot over de postcoderoosregeling

Two D66 MPs asked whether the conversion of the postcoderoos tax scheme into a subsidy scheme was meant to cut back support, and why the transitional arrangement does not let new members join and avoids cooperative bankruptcies when members leave. The State Secretary denies that a cutback was intended, admits the transitional rule may not achieve its aim, and says the government is studying an additional transitional rule in the next tax package.
That is why we are examining whether it is possible to introduce additional transitional arrangements in the upcoming Tax Plan package.
Daarom laten wij uitzoeken of het mogelijk is om aanvullend overgangsrecht te introduceren in het komende Belastingplanpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over het bericht 'Huizen aardgasvrij maken is complex en kost ook meer dan verwacht'

MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers whether the government would stop the natural-gas-free neighbourhoods programme, citing an EIB study estimating costs of about 40,000 euro per home and doubts about affordability. The Minister of Interior answered that the EIB case is not representative, that costs will fall through innovation, that the programme is a learning exercise, and that the government will not stop the transition.
I do not share that conclusion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Aartsen over ''pensioenfondsen die hurende ondernemers het vel over de oren halen''

MPs Amhaouch and Aartsen asked whether pension funds that own shops and restaurant premises are pressing tenant entrepreneurs hit by the COVID crisis with rent increases and indexation, and what the government will do. The minister says pension funds generally do not own such property, that most tenants reached individual accommodation deals, that pain should be shared fairly, and that the government keeps talking with the parties but leaves negotiations to private actors.
It is not centrally recorded how many and which pension funds own shop and restaurant premises, or how many and which invest in shop and restaurant property.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden hoeveel en welke pensioenfondsen eigenaar zijn van winkel- en horecapanden en hoeveel en welke pensioenfondsen beleggen in winkel- en horecavastgoed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Groot datalek bij NAM, 19.000 gedupeerden aardbevingsschade getroffen’

An MP asked the minister about a data breach at NAM affecting about 19,000 people with earthquake damage claims, including how it happened, what was leaked, and liability. The minister answered that NAM's file-transfer software was compromised, that mostly basic personal data was leaked with 122 cases of sensitive data, that affected people were contacted, and that NAM as controller is liable under the GDPR.
There are 122 cases in which sensitive personal data was leaked, for example email addresses and telephone numbers.
Er zijn 122 gevallen waar gevoelige persoonsgegevens is gelekt, bijvoorbeeld mailadressen en telefoonnummers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de bouwprojecten op Bonaire

An MP asked ministers about planned port and fuel-pier construction on Bonaire that could destroy coral and whether permits, enforcement, financing, cruise tourism and waste management were adequately handled. The government answered that no construction has begun, that existing environmental and maritime procedures apply and can be appealed, and that a feasibility and cost-benefit study and the Bonaire Brandstof Terminals company will follow.
These procedures are public, have objection and appeal possibilities and can go to the administrative court.
Deze procedures zijn openbaar, kennen bezwaar en beroepsmogelijkheden en een gang naar de bestuursrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Gerven over de virtuele verkoop van groene stroom aan Amazon

MPs Beckerman and Van Gerven asked about the virtual sale of green electricity guarantees from Dutch offshore wind to Amazon, and whether this undermines climate goals, public subsidies and transparency. The minister explains that guarantees of origin are an administrative instrument, that Dutch wind power mainly serves Dutch consumers, and that overviews of certificate trade are published by CertiQ, though some data are aggregated for confidentiality.
This overview does provide aggregated volumes, due to commercially confidential information.
Dit overzicht biedt wel geaggregeerde volumes in verband met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de onzin van subsidieslurpende mestfabrieken

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether manure processing plants receiving SDE++ subsidy really produce renewable energy, given gas use, digestate marketing, fraud risk and emissions. The minister answered that subsidies go to renewable energy production, that fraud risks are addressed through enforcement, and declined to remove manure installations from the scheme.
No figures are kept on gas use by manure processors.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden van het aardgasgebruik bij mestverwerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Wilders over rillen in een gasloos huis

PVV MPs Kops and Wilders asked the ministers about tenants in gas-free homes in Nijmegen's Meijhorst who were cold and faced rising energy bills, and whether the energy transition is affordable. Minister Ollongren said the situation is unpleasant, that Portaal is contacting tenants and will visit them, rejected the claim that the energy transition is unaffordable, and disputed the Ecorys projection of rising energy poverty.
I therefore do not get the impression that housing corporation Portaal is trying to shift the cause onto the residents.
Ik heb dan ook niet de indruk dat woningcorporatie Portaal de oorzaak op bewoners probeert af te wentelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Laçin en Van Kent over het vrijkomen van kankerverwekkend chroom-6 bij werkzaamheden aan de Onyxkolencentrale

MPs asked whether chromium-6 released during maintenance at the Onyx coal plant exposed workers, whether independent investigation and compensation are in place, and whether the plant closes on 1 January 2021 and how much subsidy goes to workers. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found no proven exposure but could not exclude it, ordered dust clean-up and tighter controls, said closure timing depends on subsidy conditions, and noted that employer liability and a planned hardship scheme for occupational disease are being developed.
That is not known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over 'onveilige distributiecentra'

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that seven in ten distribution centres violated COVID and safety rules, and about enforcement, sanctions and worker safety. The minister acknowledged the concern, described Inspectorate SZW's inspections, enforcement tools and the temporary shutdown power, but declined to provide a list of individual violations and gave no exact figures for migrant workers infected at work.
I cannot make statements about individual companies or ongoing investigations, nor provide lists.
Over individuele bedrijven of lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen of lijsten aanleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Molen over de Startup in Residence challenge ‘Gezocht: Ontwikkel een tool waarbij het beantwoorden van Kamervragen verbeterd en versneld wordt’

An MP asked whether a Startup in Residence challenge to build a tool speeding up answers to parliamentary questions treats symptoms rather than causes, and whether transparency, staff rotation or information provision are at fault. The government replied that the tool only improves access to existing public documents, that parliament was not consulted on this specific tool, and that it rejects the suggestion that ministry information provision is deficient.
This specific tool has not been discussed with parliament.
Over dit specifieke hulpmiddel is niet gesproken met het parlement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over marktkooplieden in de non-food sector, die nog steeds niet open mogen

An MP asked the Justice, Social Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers why non-food market traders may still not reopen, why they are excluded from click & collect, NOW and TVL support, and whether the Tozo partner-income test and market fees can be relaxed. The minister answered that epidemiological conditions do not yet allow reopening, that the partner-income test will be kept for capacity and equality reasons, and that municipalities decide on market fees without a separate compensation scheme.
The cabinet does not intend to abolish the partner income test in the Tozo.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de partnerinkomenstoets in de Tozo af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de stop van de subsidie energiebesparing eigen huis (SEEH)

An MP asked whether the SEEH energy-saving subsidy for homeowners' associations (VvE's) was closed early, why the advice-cost window closed while budget remained, and whether it would reopen with additional funds. The minister confirmed the temporary closure to free budget for already submitted applications, and committed to reopening the scheme with roughly 31 million euro in total, including about 14 million for new measures.
I informed your House of this in my letter of 1 March 2021 and in the answers to the earlier questions from the SGP faction.
Ik heb dit aan uw Kamer gemeld in mijn brief van 1 maart 2021 en in de antwoorden op de eerdere vragen van de SGP-fractie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over ''afwijzingen door het Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen van verzoeken tot vergoeding van waardedaling bij bewoners die onderdeel waren van de gerechtelijke procedure van

An MP asked whether residents who left the WAG collective lawsuit against NAM and then had their IMG compensation claims rejected could be helped without first filing objections, and why applications by co-owners are assessed only for the applicant's share. The minister explained that IMG could only process claims after withdrawal from court was confirmed, that a small number (about 20) of rejections arose from list mismatches, that IMG has contacted those residents and agreed data-sharing arrangements with WAG, and that objections remain an option though a new application is simplest.
The IMG has made arrangements with Stichting WAG and NAM regarding data exchange in these cases.
Het IMG heeft met Stichting WAG en NAM afspraken gemaakt omtrent de gegevensuitwisseling bij deze gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht 'Stop met zonneparken en leg zonnepanelen op daken'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about expanding rooftop solar instead of solar parks on farmland, citing the zonneladder motion and an advisory report. The minister answered that the zonneladder is a regional weighing framework rather than a strict order, that subsidy rules already favour rooftop systems, and that building rules and municipal powers will be strengthened, with several follow-up analyses promised.
I agree with the National Adviser that it is desirable to strongly invest in rooftop solar, and that is what I am doing.
Ik ben het eens met de Rijksadviseur dat het wenselijk is om stevig in te zetten op zon op dak en dat doe ik ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het artikel ‘Subsidie voor fossiele brandstoffen ongekend groot’

An MP asks the ministers why the government's estimate of 4.5 billion euro in annual fossil fuel subsidies differs from an article's estimate of 17.5 billion, and what it will do about fiscal stimulation of fossil energy use. The minister answers that CBS data cannot be used one-to-one because it requires arbitrary benchmark choices, that the 4.5 billion figure is incomplete but not distorted, and that the government intends to phase out such incentives, with reviews of energy tax and renewable levy pending and decisions left partly to a new cabinet.
In addition, several national processes are currently underway in which the financial incentives relating to fossil fuels are being examined.
Daarnaast lopen er op dit moment meerdere nationale trajecten waarin de financiële prikkels met betrekking tot fossiele brandstoffen worden bekeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over de tijdelijke Bbz-compensatieregeling

An MP asked how many entrepreneurs used the temporary Bbz compensation scheme, why the 2010–2014 cohort was excluded, and whether it could be extended. The minister answered that 1169 people applied, about 2.8 million euro was paid out, the cohort was excluded because the scheme followed a parliamentary motion limited to 2014–2016, and a briefing and an investigation into pre-2014 cases were promised.
1169 people applied for this compensation scheme, which was limited to persons harmed in 2014, 2015 and 2016.
Er hebben 1169 personen een beroep gedaan op deze compensatieregeling die beperkt was tot personen die in de jaren 2014, 2015 en 2016 gedupeerd waren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Moorlag over sociale ondernemingen die niet alle coronasteun ontvangen

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether social enterprises such as De Oude Keuken, which may have an incorrect SBI code, are excluded from COVID support and whether extra aid will be given. The State Secretary replied that TVL support is now open to all sectors regardless of SBI code, that the HVA surcharge applies only to SBI code 56, and that businesses can appeal to RVO.nl, while noting ongoing consultation with Social Enterprise Nederland.
From the fourth quarter of 2020, all sectors can use the TVL (except financial institutions) regardless of the SBI code.
Vanaf het vierde kwartaal 2020 kunnen alle sectoren gebruik maken van de TVL (met uitzondering van de financiële instellingen) ongeacht de SBI-code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg, Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'West-Zeeuws-Vlaamse horeca moet voor Pasen open: 'Als dit nog maanden duurt, gaan bedrijven kapot''

Three CDA MPs asked the minister about the West Zeeland-Flemish hospitality sector's demand to reopen before Easter, the lack of economic perspective in the COVID-19 roadmap, and whether sectors such as hospitality and hairdressing were consulted. The State Secretary answered that the epidemiological situation allows only small steps, that sectors are consulted through regular talks and advisory bodies such as the SER and CPB, and that plans for a phased reopening will be integrated into a periodic revision of the roadmap.
That is why the cabinet has started working with VNO-NCW and MKB-Nederland to formulate plans for a smart reopening of sectors.
Daarom is het kabinet met VNO-NCW en MKB-Nederland aan de slag gegaan om plannen te formuleren voor een slimme heropening van sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over ‘’het gebrek aan voortgang in Groningen’’

MP Nijboer asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about delays in the Groningen earthquake-damage handling, reinforcement operation and the rollout of fibre internet in Siddeburen, and what will be done to restore residents' trust. The Minister acknowledges delays, cites improvements at the IMG damage-handling body and the fibre contractor's revised timeline, and agrees residents must benefit quickly from economic measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de Friese bodem niet meer terugveert na ondergrondse zoutwinning

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that the Frisian soil no longer rebounds after underground salt extraction, asking about permit conditions, subsidence effects, compensation, water management and whether extraction should be reconsidered. The minister answered that the permit caps subsidence at 30 cm above the caverns and 35 cm across the area, that residual rebound is not a permit criterion, that damage claims go to the mining company and the Commissie Mijnbouwschade, and that there is no reason to reconsider extraction.
I do not want residents to be left with damage caused by ground movement from mining.
Ik wil niet dat bewoners blijven zitten met schade ten gevolge van bodembeweging door mijnbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over het bericht 'Schuifdakenfabrikant Inalfa Venray zet zeker 190 mensen op straat'

MPs Amhaouch and Palland (CDA) asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Social Affairs about the planned loss of at least 190 jobs at Inalfa Venray, the regional impact, and industrial policy. The minister answered that no direct government contact with Inalfa occurred before the reorganisation, that the regional labour market can help affected workers, that the R&D subsidy scheme will open by 15 May 2021, and that a regional SWOT analysis is not considered necessary.
To date there has been no direct contact between the central government and Inalfa about the impending reorganisation at the company.
Er is tot op heden geen direct contact geweest tussen de rijksoverheid en Inalfa over de op handen zijnde reorganisatie bij het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Stoffer over het sluiten van de subsidieregeling energiebesparing eigen huis (SEEH)

MPs Bisschop and Stoffer asked why the SEEH subsidy for homeowners' associations (VvE's) was closed early, whether all 2020 applications can be honoured, and how the government will support VvE sustainability. Minister Ollongren answers that EUR 70 million will be made available so all valid 2020 applications are paid and the scheme reopens, while acknowledging that early closure may harm trust and promising an evaluation in 2021.
I make EUR 70 million in budget available on the BZK budget for the SEEH.
Ik stel 70 miljoen euro aan budget op de BZK begroting ter beschikking voor de SEEH.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over mensen die hun woning moeten verlaten respectievelijk kwijtraken als ze hun zorgindicatie verliezen of worden opgenomen in een GGZ-instelling

Two MPs from the ChristenUnie asked the government about people losing their homes when care indications end or when they are admitted to mental health institutions, and about the gaps in housing and support, the reduction of support hours, the household-sharing norm, and municipal responsibilities. The state secretary answered that no central figures exist on homelessness caused by expiring care indications, pointed to municipal responsibility, planned expert support and the Wvggz/Participatiewet frameworks, and said action is being taken through working agreements and a new plan.
At central level there is no insight into the amount of support that municipalities provide under the Wmo 2015.
Op centraal niveau bestaat geen inzicht in de omvang van de begeleiding die gemeenten op basis van de Wmo 2015 verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de TOZO

An MP asks whether municipalities can grant discretionary exceptions (maatwerk) under the TOZO self-employed support scheme and whether the 17 March 2020 Chamber of Commerce registration cut-off should be a hard criterion, including for backdated registrations. The minister answers that municipalities may use the Participatiewet 'zeer dringende redenen' route, that the cut-off is deliberately fixed to limit fraud and administrative problems, and that no change is planned beyond pointing to the earlier answer.
Setting the registration date as a hard criterion for granting the Tozo is consistent with the intended application of the Tozo.
Het stellen van de datum van inschrijving als hard criterium voor toekenning van de Tozo is in overeenstemming met de bedoelde toepassing van de Tozo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het artikel 'If poor countries go unvaccinated, a study says, rich ones will pay'

An SGP MP asked the ministers about a study estimating large global economic losses from unequal COVID-19 vaccine distribution, and about Dutch responsibility and economic impacts. The minister acknowledged the importance of equitable global vaccine access, pointed to Dutch contributions to COVAX and ACT-A, and said exact economic consequences cannot yet be predicted, while committing only to considering such scenarios in future decisions.
In future decisions on the COVID-19 approach, the cabinet considers a wide range of information and possible scenarios.
Het kabinet betrekt bij toekomstige besluiten met betrekking tot de inzet tegen COVID 19 een veelheid aan informatie en mogelijke scenario's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over problemen die ondernemers ervaren bij het lopende steun- en herstelpakket

Three VVD MPs asked the government about business complaints over implementation problems in the COVID support packages (TVL, NOW, starters, TONK), including quarterly calculation, excluded starters, events and retail schemes, and capacity. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of gaps, lists sector consultations and adjustments made, explains why monthly calculation and full starter support were not feasible, and promises further information and wider publicity on the TONK.
At present the cabinet has no insight into the size of this group or exactly which businesses fall under it.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen zicht op de grootte van deze groep en welke bedrijven hier precies onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Ruzie tussen Nederland en Frankrijk bedreigt banen in Roden’

MPs Nijboer and Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports of a dispute with France over Photonis and the threat to jobs in Roden, and what the government would do to protect them and prevent the company falling into the wrong hands. The minister denied a dispute, said the Netherlands is in close contact with France, expressed a preference for a sale by the current owner, and gave general commitments to protect jobs and R&D without concrete new steps.
The cabinet has no indication that an undesirable takeover of the company is currently at issue.
Het kabinet heeft geen indicatie dat een onwenselijke overname van het bedrijf op dit moment aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Wiersma over het bericht 'Sensorfabrikant Photonis inzet van Nederlands-Franse strijd'

Two VVD MPs asked the Economic Affairs and Defence ministers about the Franse government's shift from allowing a sale of Photonis to Teledyne toward a French-only buyer, and the risks to Dutch jobs, innovation and RUG cooperation. The minister answered that the Netherlands will monitor the process closely, weighs Dutch interests in French screening, and outlines the Dutch investment-screening instruments being developed.
I will therefore continue to monitor this process closely.
Ik zal dit proces dan ook nauwlettend blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Gijs van Dijk over opslag van nucleair afval net over de grens

MPs Moorlag and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the government would raise with Germany the concerns of residents near the border about possible nuclear waste storage in salt caverns in Emsland, and how Dutch citizens and authorities can take part in German siting decisions. The state secretary answered that Germany has no concrete plans yet, that Dutch citizens would be informed and have participation rights under the Espoo Convention if a border-near site is considered, and that a Rathenau-led participatory process is underway in the Netherlands.
I consider it important that Dutch citizens also have a say in decision-making on a German final repository if it were to be located near the Dutch border.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat ook Nederlandse burgers inspraak hebben bij besluitvorming over een Duitse eindberging als die in de buurt van de grens met Nederland zou komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Eijs over de pilot Speaksee

MPs from D66 asked whether the positive UWV pilot of the speech-to-text tool SpeakSee could be reimbursed for deaf and hard-of-hearing workers, since it is classed as a hearing aid and falls to health insurers rather than UWV. The minister agreed the tool is valuable, said the Zorginstituut indicated speech-recognition software may fall under the Zorgverzekeringswet, and promised to monitor and discuss access with representatives of people with disabilities.

As part of the one-counter approach from the cabinet response on POC KOT, I will discuss with VWS and representatives of people with disabilities whether they encounter obstacles when applying for these provisions.

Ik zal in het kader van de een loket gedachte uit de kabinetsreactie POC KOT, samen met VWS, met (vertegenwoordigers van) mensen met een beperking bespreken of zij bij het aanvragen van deze voorzieningen tegen belemmeringen aanlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Postma over het bericht "Thuiswerken met peuter of baby? Dat is een illusie''

MPs Palland and Postma asked the minister about parents struggling to combine work, schooling and childcare during the lockdown, and about calls for a temporary corona leave scheme like those in Belgium, Germany, Austria and Norway. The minister says the situation has improved since reopening, relies on employer-employee agreements and collective labour agreements, and says no feasible extra corona leave scheme was found in talks with social partners, promising to inform the House further.
I will inform you further about this in response to the Smeulders/Van Weyenberg motion of 28 January 2021.
Ik zal u hierover nader informeren als reactie op de motie Smeulders / Van Weyenberg van 28 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Renkema over het bericht dat een vrouw 7.000 euro plus een boete moet terugbetalen omdat zij boodschappen kreeg van haar moeder

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Renkema asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a case where a woman on welfare was ordered to repay 7,000 euro plus a fine after receiving groceries from her mother, and about related rules on gifts, recovery and sanctions. The minister acknowledged concerns about hardship and promised general frameworks on gifts and talks with municipalities, but declined to comment on the individual case and gave no figures on frequency or on municipal use of discretion.
No figures are available on that.
Daar zijn geen cijfers over beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over onderzoeken naar het veilig houden van asbestdakensanering

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked about the safety of the asbestos roof removal acceleration, the Arcadis exposure report, the TNO-based certification exemption and the Productenbesluit asbest. The government answered that certification for asbestos roofs is now proposed in the Arboregeling consultation, that the report was delivered on 1 February 2021 after delay, and that a revised Productenbesluit asbest is in preparation for 2022.

It is now known that the amendment to the Arboregeling put to internet consultation by the Minister of SZW proposes to include asbestos roofs among the asbestos applications subject to the certification requirement.

Inmiddels is bekend dat in de wijziging van de Arboregeling zoals door de Minister van SZW in internetconsultatie is gebracht, is voorgesteld de asbestdaken op te nemen bij de asbesttoepassingen waarvoor de certificatieplicht zal gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Leijten over het in één keer ontvangen van 54 aanmaningen van het CJIB

MPs Van Dijk and Leijten asked why a childcare-benefit affair victim received 54 reminder letters from the CJIB at once, and what the government will do to prevent this and stop collection of debts owed by victims. The State Secretary explains the letters were automatically generated per open case, the CJIB has taken measures to prevent bulk dispatch, and public creditors are being asked to pause collection of debts of victims while stating that fines from criminal convictions are excluded.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over beslaglegging op compensatie door de Belastingdienst

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked whether debt-relief trustees can seize compensation paid to childcare-benefit scandal victims after a WSNP debt-rescheduling period ends, and whether a seizure ban will be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledged the undesirable effect, said talks with public and private creditors are ongoing, committed to public creditors waiving claims, and promised certificates clearing victims of past fraud or intent labels.
That is why I am in talks with creditors and other parties to reach a solution that does justice to the various interests.
Daarom ben ik in gesprek met schuldeisers en betrokken partijen om te komen tot een oplossing die recht doet aan de verschillende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ‘het rücksichtslos afsluiten van energie in een seniorenwoning’

An SP MP asked why an energy network operator disconnected a pensioner's flat for six months without arranging a new connection or a settlement, and whether rules should be tightened. The minister answers that the disconnection followed the prescribed policy after repeated warnings and a court ruling, that the recent Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening amendment and a covenant will reduce disconnections, and sees no need for further talks with Stedin.
Disconnecting energy may therefore not simply be done.
Afsluiten van energie mag dan ook niet zomaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "de rol van het Inlichtingenbureau bij de opsporing van bijstandsfraude"

An SP MP asked the government about the role, powers and democratic control of the private Inlichtingenbureau in detecting benefit fraud, including its legal status, complaint routes and data sharing. The minister answers that the bureau is an information intermediary without investigative powers, is accountable via its annual report, audit and the minister as principal, and that a decree amendment will make it jointly responsible for data processing with municipalities.
The IB itself has no investigative powers and is not further involved in enforcing against possible benefit fraud.
Zelf heeft het IB geen opsporingsbevoegdheid en het IB is niet verder betrokken bij de handhaving op mogelijke uitkeringsfraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Palland over de Tozo voor grensondernemers

MPs Van Weyenberg and Palland asked about cross-border entrepreneurs living in Germany or Belgium who run businesses in the Netherlands and are excluded from the Tozo, and whether support could be extended. The minister answered that Tozo and TONK are social assistance not exportable abroad for equality and practical reasons, pointed to other Dutch support schemes, said EU talks are ongoing, and committed to a quarterly monitoring report.
The Tozo is social assistance provided only to persons residing in the Netherlands.
De Tozo betreft immers sociale bijstand die alleen wordt verstrekt aan personen die in Nederland woonachtig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over het oormerken van de ESF+ middelen voor kinderen in armoede

An MP asked whether the Netherlands would support earmarking at least 5% of ESF+ funds for child poverty and why the government does not back this, given the Child Guarantee. The minister answered that the government opposes mandatory earmarking because local, tailored solutions fit child poverty better, pointing to existing national measures and the child budget increase.
The cabinet is not in favour of mandatory earmarking within the ESF+ for combating child poverty.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een verplichte oormerking binnen het ESF+ voor de bestrijding van kinderarmoede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over onterechte en te hoge boetes voor werkgevers

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that the labour inspectorate imposed wrongful and excessive fines on employers, particularly small businesses, and about the legal costs and debt consequences. The minister rejected the premise of disproportionate impact on small firms, defended the inspectorate's case-by-case approach and proportionality rules, and announced a broader review of the system.
I want to answer that question together, in all openness, with employers' and employees' organisations, researchers and stakeholders.
Die vraag wil ik in alle openheid en gezamenlijkheid met werkgevers-, werknemersorganisaties, wetenschappers en stakeholders van een antwoord laten voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de Inspectie SZW onterecht hoge boetes gaf aan werkgevers

An MP asked whether the Labour Inspectorate (Inspectie SZW) wrongly imposed high fines on employers, how often fines are reduced on appeal, and whether there are quotas or cost-recovery pressures behind fine-setting. The minister answered that about 15% of fines paid in 2019 were partly refunded, that such reductions do not automatically mean the original fine was wrong, that no quotas or cost-recovery targets exist, and that a study on understandability of regulations will be conducted in the first half of 2021.
The 15% figure gives an indication of the share of refunds, but for a proper answer to how often an Inspectie SZW fine is reduced at the objection and appeal stages, a multi-year overview is better.

Het percentage van 15% geeft dan ook wel een indicatie van het percentage terugbetalingen, maar voor een goed antwoord op de vraag in hoeveel gevallen een boete van de Inspectie SZW in de volgende stadia van bezwaar en (hoger) beroep wordt verlaagd, is een langjarig overzicht beter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht ‘Arbeidsinspectie gaf werkgevers jarenlang onterechte en te hoge boetes’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that the Labour Inspectorate imposed unjustified and excessive fines, including how often objections succeed, how fines are reduced or withdrawn, and how hardship and fine policy are handled. The Minister answered that about 12% of objections were fully upheld and 18% led to reduced fines, that payment arrangements are routinely granted, and that the policy respects the subsistence minimum while a broader review of the enforcement system is planned.
I also want to answer that question openly and jointly with employers' and employees' organisations, researchers and stakeholders.
Die vraag wil ik ook in alle openheid en gezamenlijkheid met werkgevers-, werknemersorganisaties, wetenschappers en stakeholders van een antwoord laten voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over "BKR registratie bij de start van schuldhulpverlening"

An MP asked whether the Besluit gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening requires BKR registration for debt assistance from the start, and whether this deters people from seeking help and conflicts with the Wgs. The minister answered that registration of all debt assistance is intended to support cooperation with creditors, that it is not meant to deter applicants, and that the rule is mandatory for all municipalities, promising only to monitor implementation and clarify the Wgs.
The intention is not that the college can deviate.
De bedoeling is niet dat het college kan afwijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Peters en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Arbeidsinspectie gaf werkgevers jarenlang onterechte en te hoge boetes'

Three CDA MPs asked the minister about press reports that the labour inspectorate imposed wrongful and excessive fines, and about its appeal practice, matching of fines, and remedies for affected employers. The minister denied systematic misinformation, said appeals are decided case by case, and committed to a review of the graduated approach to minor workplace accidents.
No, there is no automatic or maximal pursuit of appeals. It is always a case-by-case weighing.
Nee, er wordt niet automatisch of zoveel mogelijk doorgeprocedeerd. Het betreft steeds een weging per geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gedeeltelijke sluiting van sociale werkvoorziening DZB in Leiden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the partial closure of Leiden's sheltered employment company DZB due to financial shortfalls, the reorganisation and works council involvement, and a motion on preventing sw-company closures. The State Secretary declined to judge the municipality's decisions, stating responsibility lies with municipalities, noting a 140 million euro COVID compensation for 2020, and that the appreciation of the initiative note would follow separately.
I have no view on the article, because responsibility for how the implementation of the Participation Act is organised is reserved for municipalities.
Ik heb geen oordeel over het artikel, omdat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de wijze waarop de uitvoering van de Participatiewet wordt vormgegeven is voorbehouden aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over kinderopvang voor alleenstaande ouders tijdens de lockdown

MPs Van Meenen and Van Weyenberg asked whether childcare and schools during the lockdown are open only for parents in critical jobs or vulnerable children, whether single parents, including self-employed ones, were considered, and whether they could access emergency care. The minister confirmed the restriction, said single parents were considered but that expanding emergency care would risk overcrowding, and stated that childcare providers and schools decide with parents, with maatwerk possible in exceptional cases.
That is why I do not wish to change the starting points for emergency childcare so that single parents can also rely on it.
Daarom wil ik de uitgangspunten voor de noodopvang niet aanpassen zodat alleenstaande ouders hier ook een beroep op kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over ZZP-ers die nog steeds geweerd worden bij schuldhulpverlening

An MP asked why some municipalities still exclude self-employed people (ZZP'ers) from debt assistance, whether this was reported to parliament, and how they can complain. The minister answers that the amended Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening from 1 January 2021 gives stronger rights, that refusals must be motivated in a decision subject to objection and appeal, and that support measures and campaigns are being used to push municipalities to act.
Access to help can only be refused with a reasoned decision.
Toegang tot hulp kan alleen met een gemotiveerde beschikking worden geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het bericht dat de kledingbank is gesloten tot 19 januari

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary whether clothing banks had been closed nationwide until 19 January, whether they could be treated as welfare services and reopened on humanitarian grounds. The minister confirmed closures as public places under COVID rules, declined to grant an exception, and offered home delivery of clothing for people in acute need instead.
Unfortunately, I cannot grant the permission you requested under the current rules.
Helaas kan ik de door u verzochte toestemming op basis van de huidige regels niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Vrouw met bijstand krijgt boodschappen, 7.000 Euro teruggevorderd'

An MP from D66 asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a report that a welfare recipient received groceries from her parents and had 7,000 euros reclaimed, questioning whether the sanction is proportionate and whether municipalities could show more discretion. The State Secretary declines to comment on the individual case but acknowledges concerns about hardness in the Participatiewet, announces a review of gift rules and reclaim obligations with municipalities, and commits to a signalling team and round tables.
I understand these are strict rules. Rules that matter for public support for the system.
Ik begrijp dat dit strenge regels zijn. Regels die van belang zijn voor het draagvlak voor het stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van Jasper van Dijk over het veel te snel aanmerken van bijstandsgerechtigden als fraudeur

An SP MP asks the state secretary whether a Wijdemeren benefit recipient was wrongly branded a fraudster and ordered to repay 7,000 euros plus a 50 percent fine for gifts of groceries from her mother, and whether the Participatiewet is too harsh and should be reformed. The state secretary declines to discuss the individual case, acknowledges concerns about hardship, promises general frameworks on gifts, a signalling team, round tables and a review of the fraud definition by summer 2021, while maintaining that the inlichtingenplicht must be enforced and that municipalities may waive repayment in urgent cases.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Slootweg en Omtzigt over de terugvordering van bijstand

Three CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a case where a benefit recipient was ordered to repay about 7,000 euro for donated food and the hardship of recovery rules, the discretion of municipalities, and the treatment of food-bank parcels. The State Secretary acknowledged concerns about hardness in the Participatiewet, pointed to municipal discretion and hardship exceptions, announced working groups and a review of harsh rules, but declined to judge individual cases and promised results in the second quarter of 2021.
From my systemic responsibility, it is not appropriate for me to judge individual cases.
Vanuit mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid past het niet dat ik oordeel over individuele casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van den Berge over kinderalimentatie

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about child maintenance: whether income changes can only be adjusted with mutual consent or a court, whether LBIO should review incomes periodically, whether recipients should account for spending, and how child benefit and the child-related budget create inequality. The minister answered that ex-partners should first agree between themselves, that courts remain available, that LBIO should not gain a review power, that periodic accounting is undesirable, and that the Belastingdienst is raising awareness, while rejecting a binding dispute committee.
I therefore see little added value in establishing a dispute committee for maintenance cases, certainly not given the downward trend in the number of court cases.
Ik zie dan ook weinig toegevoegde waarde in het instellen van een geschillencommissie voor alimentatiezaken, zeker niet gezien de dalende trend van het aantal rechtszaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over bezuinigingen op kinderen in armoede

An MP from the PvdA asks the state secretary about reported cuts in municipal child-poverty budgets, including Súdwest-Fryslân's proposed €100,000 reduction, and about the government's response to rising poverty forecasts. The government points to existing national funding, the evaluation of municipal spending, and passes municipal matters to the VNG and municipal councils, without committing to new funds beyond those already announced.
It is not appropriate for the cabinet to request accountability from individual municipalities for how they spend the funds.
Het past het kabinet niet om verantwoording te vragen van individuele gemeenten over de besteding van de middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over menstruatiearmoede in Nederland

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government whether it would provide free menstrual products in public places and follow Scotland's example to tackle period poverty. The state secretary answered that most women do not face cost problems, pointed to general poverty measures and local municipal responsibility, and declined to introduce free provision.
I do not share that view. Circumstances and needs of women differ, but for most women the cost of menstrual products is not a problem.
Die mening deel ik niet. Omstandigheden en behoeften van vrouwen verschillen, maar voor de meeste vrouwen vormen de kosten van menstruatieproducten geen probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Renkema over online ongewenst gedrag op de werkvloer

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs and Employment about online unwanted conduct at work, including whether the shift online is being underreported in statistics, whether new measures are needed, and whether vertrouwenspersonen should be legally mandatory. The state secretary said employers are responsible under the Arbowet, the Inspectie SZW has received no signals of a sharp rise in online misconduct, RI&E coverage is being expanded through a programme, but a legal mandate for confidential counsellors is not deemed necessary, with investment in professionalisation instead.
Based on the foregoing, I see no need to legally mandate a confidential counsellor.
Ik zie op basis van het voorgaande geen noodzaak in het wettelijk verplicht stellen van een vertrouwenspersoon.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok en Renkema over het bericht 'Vier op de tien vrouwen op de arbeidsmarkt benadeeld vanwege zwangerschap of pasgeboren kind: zwangerschapsdiscriminatie nog steeds onverminderd groot p

MPs Özütok and Renkema asked about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report finding that 43% of people active on the labour market who had a child in the past four years experienced pregnancy discrimination, and about the government's response, unions, works councils and the Inspectie SZW. The Staatssecretaris agreed the problem is serious, pointed to the Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie, awareness campaigns, a planned stakeholder meeting, and the upcoming wetsvoorstel Toezicht gelijke kansen bij werving en selectie, while stating that the Inspectie SZW has extra capacity and held over 500 inspections this year.
I will work on providing employers with tools.
Ik zal inzetten op het bieden van handvatten aan werkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de overstap naar de Wajong 2010

An MP asked why the deadline for switching from the old Wajong to Wajong 2010 was set at 30 November 2020, what benefits switching offers, when people were informed, and how the old and new regimes differ, including the obligation to accept suitable work. The State Secretary explained that switching can raise benefits for some working people, that UWV informed beneficiaries and stakeholders in September and October and accepted applications until 30 November, and that the general suitable-work obligation in Wajong 2010 lapses from 1 January 2021 and may become part of re-integration agreements.
UWV, in consultation with me and following the client consultation by LCR, decided to process applications for switching submitted until 30 November 2020.
UWV heeft in overleg met mij, naar aanleiding van de cliëntentoets van LCR besloten om aanvragen voor overstap ingediend tot 30 november 2020 in behandeling te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Gijs van Dijk en Ploumen over het recente onderzoek van het College voor de Rechten van de mens over zwangerschapsdiscriminatie

Two PvdA MPs asked the government how it will respond to a College voor de Rechten van de Mens study finding that 43% of working women who gave birth 2016-2019 experienced pregnancy discrimination, and what enforcement, sanctions and reporting measures it will take. The State Secretary answers that a Labour Market Discrimination Action Plan, a bill giving the Inspectie SZW enforcement powers over recruitment, awareness campaigns and a planned meeting with stakeholders are underway, but gives no figures on fines issued and does not commit to new binding measures.
I consider it very important that women are aware that they can turn to someone if they suspect discrimination and that they can proceed to report it.
Ik acht het van groot belang aan dat vrouwen zich ervan bewust zijn dat zij bij een vermoeden van discriminatie ergens terecht kunnen en dat zij over kunnen gaan tot melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over “vermeende bijstandsfraude”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about alleged welfare fraud, including a broadcast on a man left homeless after a conflict with the social services, how municipalities verify fraud, whether benefit cuts are disproportionate, and whether emails were lost. The State Secretary says municipalities must apply proportionality, the case is for the municipality and courts to judge, he will explore a legal definition of fraud and a prevention team, and he will review the enforcement system.
Supervision of municipalities as part of generic oversight is assigned to the provinces.
Het toezicht op gemeenten als onderdeel van het generiek toezicht is bij de provincies belegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over voedselhulp in Nederland als gevolg van groeiende armoede

MPs Van Dijk and others asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about food aid for people excluded from food banks amid growing poverty, the Red Cross food aid, and structural measures such as abolishing the cost-sharer norm and raising the minimum wage. The government answered that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that a study on the cost-sharer norm has been sent and a review will follow, but that it does not plan to abolish the norm or sharply raise the minimum wage now.
The cabinet does not intend to abolish the cost-sharer norm.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens de kostendelersnorm af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra, Peters, Agnes Mulder, Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de betaalbaarheid van duurzaamheidsinvesteringen en de leningen die hiervoor moeten worden afgesloten

MPs asked the Minister how homeowners lacking funds for sustainability investments can be protected from being forced into loans, following a NIBUD study showing at least two million owners cannot afford them. The minister agreed that people without borrowing capacity should not be compelled to borrow, pointed to the energy-saving mortgage with income-based repayment and debt forgiveness, and promised to ask the Warmtefonds to monitor financial stress among vulnerable groups.
Daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over ‘een flinke groei van het aantal mensen dat een beroep moet gaan doen op voedselbanken’

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about rising demand at food banks, falling food supply from supermarkets, the use of the EUR 4 million corona subsidy, and whether supermarkets' turnover gains could support food banks. The State Secretary acknowledged the supply problem and said the subsidy is held as a safety net, with supermarkets free to decide on support and EU ESF+ funding under discussion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Jasper van Dijk over het aanpassen van de kostendelersnorm om dakloosheid te voorkomen

MPs Peters and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the government will amend the kostendelersnorm (co-tenant rule in the Participation Act) to prevent youth homelessness, citing Divosa's advice and the delayed research results. The State Secretary says the cabinet response and research are sent with the answers, agrees that temporary non-application of the norm for vulnerable young adults is sensible, and points to a broader exploration of alternatives.
Precisely for vulnerable young adults, the municipality can apply tailored measures by temporarily not applying the co-tenant rule, provided the stay is temporary until a permanent solution is found.

Juist voor kwetsbare jongvolwassenen kan de gemeente maatwerk toepassen door de kostendelersnorm tijdelijk niet toe te passen mits het gaat om tijdelijk verblijf tot een permanente oplossing is gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Peters over tekorten bij sociale werkvoorzieningen

MPs Van Dijk (SP) and Peters (CDA) asked the State Secretary about deficits at sheltered workplaces (SW-bedrijven) such as Ergon and Wedeka, whether SW companies are financially failing nationwide, and what measures will prevent closures. The State Secretary declined to comment on individual companies, pointed to municipalities' responsibility and the Thermometer Wsw showing a peak deficit in 2020 expected to improve from 2025, and noted the temporary coronavirus compensation of 140 million euro.
I do not deal with the functioning and operation of individual social development companies.
Ik ga niet over het functioneren en de exploitatie van individuele sociale ontwikkelbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "een angstcultuur bij Sociaal Werkbedrijf Dethon"

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports of a climate of fear at sheltered employment firm Dethon, including transfers of critical staff, deductions of holiday days after sick leave, limited development opportunities, and the need for an ombudsman. The State Secretary answered that implementation is a municipal responsibility, that a voluntary consultative transfer policy applies, that his ministry found no holiday deductions, and that Dethon has an independent complaints committee and access to the Zeeland ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Jasper van Dijk en van Kent over cashen op kosten van de belastingbetaler

SP MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Rechtsbescherming about a case where a business owner allegedly used NOW wage subsidies, let a company go bankrupt, dismissed staff and profited, and whether bailiffs' market structure should be reversed. The minister replied that individual bankruptcies are for the courts and the independent curator and BFT supervisor, that UWV paid wages after the bankruptcy request and will recover via the curator, and that the government will not reverse market competition for bailiffs, though it will correct tariffs and ban price agreements that endanger independence.
It is not for me to judge bankruptcies in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over faillissement in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen vande leden Smeulders en Bromet over het bericht ‘Coronaregels overtreden maar Van Rooi Meat krijgt geen straf: gemeenteraad wil opheldering’

MPs Smeulders and Bromet asked why the safety region did not sanction Van Rooi Meat for exceeding COVID-19 staffing limits, whether the Labour Inspectorate was involved, and whether slaughterhouses are treated leniently. The minister answered that the company received a warning rather than a sanction because it had not reported the actual number of workers, that the Labour Inspectorate made an unannounced visit and found no irregularities in Helmond, and that a national cooperation platform was set up in September 2020.

The chair of the safety region weighed the matter and decided to give the company a warning and impose no sanction for failing to report in advance the actual number of persons present at the inspection.

De voorzitter van de veiligheidsregio heeft een afweging gemaakt en besloten het bedrijf een waarschuwing te geven en geen sanctie op te leggen voor het feit dat er vooraf geen melding is gemaakt van het daadwerkelijk bij de controle aanwezige aantal personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Alkaya over het bericht dat voormalig staatssecretaris Van Ark een compensatie voor de gedupeerden in de CAF-11 zaak blokkeerde in de Ministerraad

SP MPs Kwint and Alkaya asked the state secretary to explain why a compensation plan for CAF-11 childcare-benefit victims was reportedly blocked in cabinet and why earlier documents showed the disproportionate recovery issue was known. The state secretary denies blocking any proposal, says the ministries cooperated, admits the strict enforcement and missed signals were regrettable, and says the parliamentary inquiry has been given the relevant documents.
From the moment the scale of the affair became clear to State Secretary Snel, the cabinet endorsed its commitment to do right by the affected parents.
Vanaf het moment dat de omvang van de affaire bij Staatssecretaris Snel duidelijk begon te worden, heeft het kabinet zijn inzet om de gedupeerde ouders recht te doen onderschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over “verbod op blootstellen jongeren aan coronavirus".

An MP asked whether SARS-CoV-2 falls under biological agent category 3 and whether Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit article 4.105 bars minors from exposure, asking about protections for young delivery and supermarket workers and inspectorate enforcement. The state secretary confirmed category 3 and the minors' prohibition applies to work specifically involving the agent, said general duty of care covers other jobs, and described the Inspectorate's existing powers and a temporary Arbowet change allowing work to be halted.
The Labour Inspectorate supervises this. It does so on a risk-based and programmatic basis.
De Inspectie SZW houdt daar toezicht op. Dit doet zij risicogericht en programmatisch.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Gijs van Dijk over de loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Gijs van Dijk asked the government how it responds to the European Committee of Social Rights finding that the Netherlands falls short on closing the gender pay gap, and what measures are being taken. The state secretary answers that the ECSR found shortcomings on pay transparency and effective measures, that the gap is narrowing only slowly, points to the Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie, the diversity-in-top measures and a forthcoming study on public-sector pay gaps, and says a certification scheme and other transparency measures are still being studied.

The cabinet will come with a position on the private member's bill this autumn, now that the proposal and the response to the Council of State's advice have been submitted to the House of Representatives.
Het kabinet zal dit najaar met een standpunt komen over het initiatiefwetsvoorstel nu het voorstel en de reactie op het advies van de Raad van State is ingediend bij de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van Helvert over het bericht 'emoties lopen hoog op bij huisuitzetting: meerdere politiepatrouilles rukken uit'

MPs Peters and Van Helvert asked about a reported eviction in Geleen over rent arrears, in which several police patrols were deployed, and whether evictions for debt could be prevented. The government confirmed the case, declined to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons, and described measures such as early warning of rent arrears, the amended Municipal Debt Assistance Act from 1 January 2021, and the plan 'Een (t)huis, een toekomst' to prevent evictions.
To protect the privacy of those involved, I cannot go into individual cases.
Om de privacy van de betrokkenen te beschermen, kan ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Leijten over de verplichte dataverstrekking van kinderopvangorganisaties aan de Belastingdienst

MPs Kwint and Leijten (SP) asked why monthly personal data sharing by childcare organisations with the Tax Administration was set by ministerial regulation rather than law, whether privacy impact assessments and consent/opt-out were provided, and whether the practice conflicts with privacy rights. The state secretaries answered that monthly data delivery aims to prevent high childcare benefit recoveries, that a statutory basis exists and is being strengthened via the Awir amendment, and that parents cannot opt out, while several answers (e.g. on the AP advice and PIA) were given but the timing deadline was missed.
From 2021 the monthly delivery of this data will be mandatory.
Vanaf 2021 is het maandelijks leveren van deze gegevens verplicht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijkerken-de Haan over de regeling terugbetaling van de eigen bijdrage kinderopvang in relatie tot Covid-19, na signalen dat de aangekondigde herzieningsmogelijkheid bij substantiële afwijk

An MP asked whether parents could rely on the April 2020 promise of a revision mechanism for substantial deviations from the childcare hours used, and how it was implemented. The state secretary answered that a revision was automatically granted only to parents who newly applied for childcare allowance for a new child by the new reference date, that 0.6% of decisions were objected to, and that hour-count objections were handled through the normal objection procedure.
For children for whom no childcare allowance had been applied for before the reference date of 6 April 2020, there is a revision scheme.
Voor kinderen waar voor de peildatum van 6 april 2020 nog geen kinderopvangtoeslag voor één of meerdere kinderen was aangevraagd, is er een herzieningsregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over bedrijven die handelen in kredietgegevens van personen zonder hen daarover te informeren

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether private credit-scoring firms may trade personal creditworthiness data without informing the individuals concerned, and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority should be urged to investigate. The minister said the GDPR requires transparency toward data subjects, that firms are primarily responsible for compliance, and that the Authority is independent and is already investigating several credit bureaus, so it would not intervene in its priorities.
I wish to emphasise that these companies are primarily responsible for safeguarding personal data.
Ik hecht eraan te benadrukken dat deze bedrijven in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het waarborgen van persoonsgegevens
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over geen airco’s in snikhete vrachtwagencabines

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether it is acceptable that truck drivers must sleep in extremely hot cabins without air conditioning, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the problem but says air conditioning is primarily a matter for employers and employees, points to an energy investment deduction and to ILT enforcement of rest-time rules, and does not commit to new measures.
It is up to the employer to ensure that drivers can rest under the right conditions.
Het is aan de werkgever om ervoor te zorgen dat chauffeurs onder de juiste omstandigheden kunnen rusten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "werken zonder loon"

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about unpaid work by welfare recipients, such as making face masks and participation placements that may displace regular jobs, and how such displacement and unfair competition are prevented and monitored. The State Secretary replies that municipalities have wide discretion, that the legal framework against displacement is clear and adequate, that complaints go to the municipality, the ACM or the courts, and that there is no evidence of fake re-integration trajectories, while declining to comment on a pending Supreme Court case and noting that displacement research is not yet feasible.
I do not consider it appropriate to anticipate the Supreme Court's ruling in the case on which the advocate-general has issued an opinion.
Ik acht het niet passend om vooruit te lopen op de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad in de zaak waarbij de advocaat-generaal een advies heeft geschreven.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Nijkerken-de Haan en Ziengs over het bericht dat het rijbewijs van een gehandicapte chauffeur is ingenomen

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the CBR refused to renew the driving licence of a disabled professional driver who had held one for 31 years, and whether a coulance scheme should exist for such cases. The minister acknowledged the impact, cited the expert assessment and a 2003 CBR policy note requiring two-handed control, rejected a general coulance scheme on road-safety grounds, and said the case was with the CBR without committing to contact it.
A general coulance scheme based on positive past indications is not justified from a road-safety perspective, because past indications do not necessarily say anything about future fitness to drive.

Een algemene coulanceregeling op basis van positieve indicaties uit het verleden is vanuit het oogpunt van de verkeersveiligheid niet verantwoord omdat indicaties uit het verleden niet noodzakelijk iets zeggen over de rijgeschiktheid in de toekomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over "de handelwijze van het UWV inzake terugbetalingen"

An SP MP asks the minister about UWV's handling of reclaiming benefits, including the six-week repayment deadline, gross-versus-net repayment, support for low-income debtors, and accessible help. The minister replies that the statutory six-week term cannot be changed, that gross repayment follows from tax rules and is mitigated by guidance and payment arrangements, and that UWV will consider continuing a proactive contact pilot.
When agreeing repayment arrangements, UWV always takes the debtor's financial position into account.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Kabinet, schep duidelijkheid over de verhuisboete voor bedrijven'

An MP from the VVD asks the government about the proposed conditional final dividend tax settlement (Spoedwet conditionele eindafrekening dividendbelasting) and its effects on the Dutch investment climate, legal soundness, EU and treaty obligations, and SMEs. The government replies that it has serious objections on effectiveness, treaty conflict, free movement of capital, state aid risk and legal uncertainty, and that the Council of State advised against proceeding.
The cabinet has several objections to the bill.
Het kabinet heeft meerdere bezwaren tegen het initiatiefwetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Schuldenbeleid van Belastingdienst onder vuur’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Administration offset childcare and other allowances against debts without applying the minimum-existence protection (beslagvrije voet), possibly pushing people below subsistence. The State Secretary acknowledged the practice should not have been applied, described the meetings with the Ombudsman and advice bodies, and outlined interim fixes and a planned communication strategy, while noting offsetting has been halted since 18 December 2020.

In view of the purpose and intent of the Simplification of the Minimum Protected Amount Act, I now conclude, together with Toeslagen and the Tax Administration, that this method should not have been applied.
Gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet (Wet vBVV) concludeer ik nu met Toeslagen en de Belastingdienst dat deze werkwijze niet had mogen worden toegepast.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Peters, Lodders, Edgar Mulder, Van Weyenberg, Snels, Nijboer, Bruins, Van Raan, Azarkan, Van Haga, Van Otterloo, Leijten, Stoffer en Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat de Bel

MPs from many parties asked whether the Tax Authority fails to apply the protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) when offsetting benefit overpayments against current allowances, and whether this breaches the law. The State Secretary admits that offsets under the standard payment arrangement were made without applying the protected minimum, that this is a mistaken assumption, and promises a repayment operation and a solution, but declines to meet the requested three-week deadline.
I conclude that this approach, given the purpose and intent of the Wet vBVV, offers citizens insufficient protection.
Ik concludeer dat deze werkwijze, gezien het doel en de strekking van de Wet vBVV, onvoldoende bescherming aan burgers biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het Uitvoeringsprogramma Waddengebied en de impactanalyse

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked the ministers about the Wadden Sea implementation programme, the impact analysis, and several related projects and stakeholder involvement. The minister answered that economic sectors are secured in the agenda, the impact analysis will be broader than socio-economic effects, and the programme and impact analysis will be discussed with Parliament before the summer and in the October debate.
On the outcome of that discussion I will inform your House by letter.
Over de uitkomst van de bespreking hiervan zal ik uw Kamer per brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst weer in de fout: veel te veel toeslag voor arbeidsmigranten’

Two VVD MPs asked why the Tax Administration keeps granting the child-related budget with the single-parent supplement to migrant workers whose foreign partners are not registered, despite known errors since 2015. The government admits the verification process is complex, lists partial fixes since 2015 and promises proposals this year, but gives no count of affected migrants and no firm date for a structural solution.
It is not known in how many cases the Tax Administration wrongly assumes there is no partner.
Het is niet bekend in hoeveel gevallen er door de Belastingdienst/Toeslagen onterecht van wordt uitgegaan dat geen sprake is van een toeslagpartner.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Von Martels, De Groot en Dik Faber over het signaal dat de NVWA niet overgaat tot het aanwijzen van verschillende havens als ‘dedicated landing port third countrie

MPs asked why the NVWA has not designated additional Dutch ports, such as Den Helder, as dedicated landing ports for third-country fishing vessels, which hurts shipyards once British vessels lose access after Brexit. The minister explains the EU IUU-regulation limits such designations, reports lost turnover and an intention to allow maintenance-only calls by UK vessels in specified ports, and declines to reconsider the broader landing-port designations.
I have received a confidential overview from the sector of the estimated turnover losses per shipyard.
Ik heb van de sector vertrouwelijk een overzicht gekregen van de geschatte omzetverliezen per werf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht 'Vrees voor Chinese spionage via douanescanners in haven Rotterdam'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reports of Chinese espionage risks from Nuctech X-ray scanners used by Dutch customs at Rotterdam port, airports and distribution centres. The government confirmed the deployment, said risk assessments are case-by-case with an external security audit underway, and stated it would consider proportionate measures without committing to halting use of the scanners.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the Intelligence and Security Services.
Over het kennisniveau van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Regterschot over het onnodig betalen van leges

MPs Lodders and Regterschot asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipalities such as Emmen wrongly kept charging building-permit fees under outdated zoning plans and refused refunds despite the Council of State ruling and the Ombudsman's findings. The minister said she had not received signals of such charges, that enforcing the law is primarily for councils, citizens and courts, and repeated her call for generous ex officio reductions while declining to judge the Emmen case or to ask other municipalities about compliance.
It is primarily for the municipal council, interested parties and the courts to ensure that municipalities comply with the law.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad, belanghebbenden en de rechter om erop toe te zien dat gemeenten de wet naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Pluimveeslachterijen slachten vandaag niet: Geen NVWA-toezichthouders door code rood’

MP Lodders asked the Minister why the NVWA withdrew meat-inspection staff from poultry slaughterhouses during a KNMI code red weather warning, questioning the decision's timing, consistency, consultation with the sector and effects on animals and farmers. The Minister defended the NVWA's decision as protecting staff safety, said the sector was informed and consulted afterwards, rejected responsibility for farmers' costs and promised evaluation of the national plan on animal transport.
On Sunday evening 14 February at around 22.00 the NVWA decided, for the safety of its staff, not to start its services at the slaughterhouses on Monday morning until the KNMI code red was lifted.

De NVWA heeft op zondagavond 14 februari rond 22.00 uur het besluit genomen om in verband met de veiligheid van haar medewerkers de dienstverlening voor de slachthuizen op maandagochtend niet op te starten totdat code rood van het KNMI zou zijn opgeheven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Linda's zoon (13) is over een paar maanden wees: 'Ik wil hem goed achterlaten'
