MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of the Interior about a 13-year-old orphan who may have to sell the family home to pay inheritance tax. The State Secretary answered that the existing rules offer no sufficient relief, that the Tax Authority can grant only limited instalment payment, and that he intends to legislate an interest-free long-term payment arrangement for such hardship cases, to be included in the Fiscale verzamelwet 2023.
I therefore intend to prepare an amendment to laws and regulations so that a general solution can be offered for this and other comparable hardship situations.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om een wijziging van wet- en regelgeving voor te bereiden zodat een algemene oplossing kan worden geboden voor deze en andere vergelijkbare schrijnende situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het Belastingverdrag tussen Nederland en Ierland en het betalen van dubbele belasting door luchtvaartpersoneel

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about double taxation of Dutch airline crew working for an Irish airline, despite the tax treaty assigning taxing rights to the Netherlands as residence state, and whether this can be resolved bilaterally. The State Secretary confirmed Dutch taxing rights, described Irish refund procedures that have improved, a central contact point, and the mutual agreement procedure for persistent cases.
Ireland must withdraw on the basis of these agreements.
Ierland moet op basis van deze afspraken terugtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Subsidieregeling Elektrische Personenauto’s Particulieren’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked about the oversubscribed 2021 EV subsidy for private buyers, budget allocation, lottery use, and whether the subsidy should be cut to stimulate more purchases. The state secretary answered that the 2021 budget was EUR 14.4 million, that the rules were changed in 2020 to stop carrying over applications, and that she sees no reason to lower the per-car subsidy before an interim evaluation.
I will inform your House about the results of the planned interim evaluation.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de geplande tussentijdse evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘Deurwaarders even niet langs bij gedupeerden toeslagen’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that bailiffs continue to pursue debts against childcare-benefit scandal victims despite the moratorium, and whether information sharing with the bailiffs' network works. The State Secretary answers that the moratorium only blocks forced execution, that preparatory steps may continue, that victims will receive codes to show creditors, and that a total solution will be reported in the next progress report.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Banken draaien duimschroeven mkb’er strakker aan in tweede lockdown'

MPs Van der Linde, Lodders and Aukje de Vries (VVD) asked whether banks are becoming less willing to finance SMEs during the second lockdown, what this means for post-crisis credit, and what the government is doing to improve bank lending and use of guarantee schemes. The minister answered that banks report limited additional credit demand, that prudential rules are not seen as blocking lending, that ministries and banks meet regularly and agreed joint action, and that guarantee uptake lags initial forecasts for some schemes while the government promises further steps such as a fiscal review of equity versus debt financing.
No formally adopted minutes are drawn up of the administrative consultation with the banks, which is chaired by EZK.
Van het bestuurlijk overleg met de banken, dat wordt voorgezeten door EZK, worden geen formeel vastgestelde verslagen opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitzending van Radar van 8 februari 2021  ‘Afschaffen levensloopregeling: ‘Overheid verandert halverwege de spelregels’’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the planned end of the levensloopregeling (life-course savings scheme), its transition rules, the impact on participants, communication and tax consequences. The State Secretary answers that the scheme was abolished in 2012 because it barely served its goal, that transitional rules were agreed with parliament, and that participants have several options to move their savings, while stating communication was adequate.
It is not possible for me to address these two individual situations specifically, because the information provided is insufficient to give a correct and complete response to the questions.

Het is voor mij niet mogelijk om specifiek in te gaan op deze twee individuele situaties, omdat de verstrekte informatie onvoldoende is om een juiste en volledige reactie te kunnen geven op de vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over bilaterale Belastingverdragen ter voorkoming van dubbele belasting

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the timing of tax treaty negotiations, the 2020 fiscal treaty policy note, pension and artist/athlete taxation under treaties, and treaties with Poland, Switzerland and France. The State Secretary answered that a letter on negotiation status will follow in April, that negotiations with France are not ongoing, and that Nederland will consider the artist/athlete treatment and possible reintroduction of source taxation, without firm dates.
I expect to send this letter to your House in April.
Ik verwacht deze brief in april aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en van der Linde over het bericht ‘Ook ING stopt met inning coronasteun uit VS’

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister why Dutch banks stopped cashing US COVID stimulus cheques for dual nationals and why the US-Dutch FATCA reciprocity commitment has not been met. The minister said the cheques can be claimed back via a US tax Recovery Rebate Credit, that banks are free to stop offering services such as cheque cashing, and that he keeps raising reciprocity with the US and European partners.
I remain in discussion with the US embassy on this subject.
Ik blijf in gesprek met de Amerikaanse ambassade over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Harbers en Lodders over het bericht 'Toevoegen leefgebieden Natura 2000 grote puinzooi'

Two VVD MPs asked the minister about reports that tiny patches of nature (13 m2) were wrongly classed as nitrogen-sensitive in AERIUS, and about progress on the Geurts/Harbers motion to correct habitat mapping. The minister acknowledged technical errors, said most cases can be resolved in the next AERIUS version with a field check for the rest, and committed to asking provinces to take the new information into account in permit applications meanwhile.
Indeed, it was found last year that small pieces of nitrogen-sensitive nature had been included in AERIUS due to technical errors.
Inderdaad is afgelopen jaar geconstateerd dat er stukjes stikstofgevoelige natuur in AERIUS zijn opgenomen die zijn ontstaan als gevolg van technische fouten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over het bericht 'Besluitvorming genetische gemodificeerde gewassen in impasse door gebrek aan politieke daadkracht'

VVD MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Infrastructure about a dissertation claiming EU GMO authorisation is deadlocked, and about import versus cultivation rules, CRISPR-Cas9, and their motion on biotechnology regulation. The ministers largely agreed EU procedures are slow and costly, said Dutch policy pushes for modernised rules, and pointed to an ongoing European Commission study due by 30 April 2021 without committing to a concrete new step.

The Netherlands is working to put the application and authorisation of new breeding techniques, such as CRISPR-Cas9, on the European agenda, provided species boundaries are not crossed and safety for humans, animals and the environment is guaranteed.

Nederland zet zich in op het Europees agenderen van de toepassing en toelating van nieuwe veredelingstechnieken, zoals CRISPR-Cas9, mits daarbij geen soortengrenzen worden overschreden en veiligheid voor mens, dier en milieu gewaarborgd blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de antwoorden op de vragen naar aanleiding van bericht 'Schonere diesel tanken kan sinds kort ook in Roden'

Two VVD MPs asked why government policy favours zero-emission cars over HVO100 and bioLNG, which they say are costly for businesses, and what the government will do to increase demand. The State Secretary answers that HVO and bioLNG are transition fuels for heavy transport under the renewable energy obligation, that accijns refunds are possible under conditions, and that supply-side measures are being pursued.
I regularly speak with market parties and am always open to talking with parties that switch to renewable fuels.
Ik spreek regelmatig partijen uit de markt en sta altijd open om het gesprek aan te gaan met partijen die overstappen op hernieuwbare brandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het artikel 'Ik wil niet meer alleen maar over de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) praten'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked the ministers why a permit for replacing a damaged manure cellar in Groningen has taken eighteen months, and what can speed up gas-damage procedures. The minister explains that permitting lies with municipalities and the province, that the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen is still reviewing sector responses to its expert advice on manure-cellar damage, and points to the Versterken bill and coordination efforts to speed up procedures.
The permitting process for building a manure basin falls under the authority of the municipality and province.
Het vergunningsproces voor de bouw van een mestbassin valt onder het gezag van gemeente en provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Aukje de Vries over de funderingsproblematiek

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about foundation damage in cities and rural areas, including costs to homeowners, the Fonds Duurzaam Funderingsherstel, the role of KCAF and RVO, and innovation for bacterial decay of wooden piles. The government answered that the problem is poorly quantified and complex, that the loan fund has issued only 34 loans, that KCAF declined cooperation, and that the Rijksprogramma Aanpak Funderingsproblematiek will be developed further in 2021.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten 'Dronter gezin al jaren bedreigd vanwege geografische coördinaten' en 'Hoe boze demonstranten door Google en CIA bij deze onschuldige familie in Dronten terechtkom

An MP asks the Justice and Security minister about reports that a Dronten family has been repeatedly threatened because online maps link their IP address to the geographic centre of the Netherlands, and what the government will do. The minister says police are already acting on criminal threats, commits to facilitating contacts with US bodies and Google at the municipality's request, and points to broader online-harm measures, while noting that linking an IP address to coordinates is not a crime.
The municipality of Dronten has sent me a letter requesting support to restore normality to the situation.
Vanuit de gemeente Dronten heb ik inmiddels per brief het verzoek gekregen om ondersteuning te bieden om de ontstane situatie weer te normaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het melden van telen op zand en/of löss grond door boeren

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the requirement for farmers to report maize cultivation on sandy and loess soils by 15 February, including notification figures, prior maize acreage, administrative burden, flexibility, handhaving, and related questions. The Minister answers that 12,216 notifications covering 115,937 hectares had been received, provides acreage data and a burden estimate of about 249,000 euros, notes that notifications can be amended or withdrawn, and defends the measure as part of the Nitrates Directive action programme.
I am always willing to have the conversation with farmers about their experiences in practice.
Ik ben altijd bereid het gesprek te voeren met boeren over hun ervaringen in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het rapport ‘Basel III Reforms: Updated Impact Study’ van de Europese Bankenautoriteit

Three VVD MPs asked the Finance and Agriculture ministers about the EBA's Basel III updated impact study, including the claimed 21% capital increase for Dutch banks, the effect on agricultural and mortgage lending, and whether the impact is unfairly borne by farm credit. The minister answered that the impact depends on the EU implementation proposal expected in H1 2021, that interministerial talks with banks continue, and that a Commission impact analysis will follow.
Once the Commission presents a legislative proposal, the cabinet will inform the House of its position via the usual BNC fiche procedure.
Zodra de CIE met een wetgevend voorstel komt, zal het kabinet uw Kamer informeren over haar inzet volgens de gebruikelijke weg van een BNC-fiche.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het aflopen van het overgangsrecht voor saldolijfrenten

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the expiry on 31 December 2020 of the transitional regime for saldolijfrentes, including how their value is calculated, the Net Present Value method, and whether the tax burden can be reduced. The State Secretary confirmed that holders must settle the value in box 1 on that date, explained the Net Present Value method and the differences from insurers' surrender values, and refused to change the valuation method, while offering payment arrangements for those unable to pay.
No, I am not willing to do that, because a valuation other than the Net Present Value method does not match the value of the insurance for the insured and therefore does not fit the statutory system.

Nee, hier ben ik niet toe bereid, omdat een andere waardering dan de Netto Contante Waarde-methode niet aansluit bij de waarde van de verzekering voor de verzekerde en daarmee niet past binnen de wettelijke systematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Tielen over het bericht ‘Zzp’ers verbaasd over minieme betalingskorting Belastingdienst’

MPs Lodders and Tielen (VVD) asked why the payment discount on the 2021 provisional income tax assessment was almost nil, since it is tied to the temporarily lowered collection interest rate. Staatssecretaris Vijlbrief answered that the link is set by law, that the Belastingdienst cannot decouple it without a system change not possible before 2023, that the rate returns to 4% from 2022, and that the communication could have explained the reason more clearly in the letter.

It would have been better to state directly in the text, after the sentence 'When paying the total assessment in one go you receive a payment discount of (PM)', why the discount is lower this year than normal.

Het was beter geweest meteen in de tekst, na de zin «Bij betaling in één keer van de totale aanslag krijgt u een betalingskorting van (PM)» aan te geven waarom de betalingskorting dit jaar lager is dan normaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Voorstel: 'Track & Trace' voor de Belastingdienst'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Finance about lost and slow mail at the Tax Authority and proposed a track-and-trace system, including pilots for private and business taxpayers. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, agreed on the need for better handling, said investigation into track-and-trace is ongoing with results to be shared in Q2, and will consider the pilot proposal in planning.

Research is currently underway within the Tax Authority into the further possibilities of a track-and-trace-like system. In the second quarter, the results of the research will be shared with your House.

Momenteel loopt er onderzoek binnen de Belastingdienst naar de verdere mogelijkheden van een systeem als track & trace. In het tweede kwartaal worden de resultaten van het onderzoek met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht «Geef slachtoffers toeslagenaffaire een nieuw en schoon BSN»

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance, following a news report, whether victims of the childcare benefits scandal should receive a new citizen service number (BSN) to start afresh, and whether this would fix data-sharing problems with other agencies. The State Secretary answered that a new BSN would not clear the administrative past or solve the problems, but agreed to investigate the consequences jointly with the State Secretary of Interior, with the priority being to find and remove incorrect data first.
However, I am willing, together with the State Secretary of Interior and Kingdom Relations, to investigate the consequences of changing a BSN.
Ik ben echter bereid, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, te onderzoeken wat de consequenties van het wijzigen van een BSN zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Bisschop, Madlener en Van Haga over het schrappen van artikel 8b uit het Besluit gebruik meststoffen ter uitvoering van het zesde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

MPs from VVD, CDA, SGP, PVV and FvD asked whether the minister would drop article 8b of the manure decree (requiring drempels between potato ridges on clay and loess soils), citing hindrance to integrated cultivation and conflicting research findings. The minister answered that the article cannot be amended after publication, so it will be excluded from entry into force by royal decree, while stating that nutrient runoff measures remain important for the seventh action programme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over de brief 'Agenda voor het Waddengebied 2050' d.d. 11 december 2020

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about the Waddenagenda 2050, including how the VVD/CDA motion on protecting economic sectors (agriculture, potato seed sector, fisheries, harbours, tourism) is reflected, the impact analysis, the signing of the declaration of agreement, consultation outcomes, and the balance between ecology and economy. The ministers answered that the impact analysis will run parallel to the implementation programme, sectors will be involved via the Omgevingsberaad, consultation led to a strengthened landbouw section, and a site visit is desired but not yet scheduled.

As indicated in the letter of 11 December 2020, in line with this motion, a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with drafting the Implementation Programme so that effects on ecology and economy can be weighed in balance.

Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief van 11 december 2020 1 wordt, in lijn met deze motie 2 , parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma Waddengebied 2021–2026 (Uitvoeringsprogramma) gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op ecologie en economie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Mag de bank weigeren om je een bankrekening te geven? Dat gaat AFM onderzoeken’

An MP asked the Finance Minister about press reports that banks may refuse or close accounts of Accidental Americans lacking a US TIN, and whether the AFM's investigation is justified. The minister answered that the AFM has started an exploratory investigation into banks' FATCA-related account practices, that banks should assess individual cases rather than exclude a group, and that he is discussing the issue with the banks and will report by letter.

I have therefore asked DNB, as supervisor of compliance with the Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing Act (Wwft), and the AFM, as supervisor of the rules on the basic payment account, to respond on the closing or freezing of bank accounts.

Ik heb daarom gevraagd aan DNB, als toezichthouder op de naleving van de Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financiering van terrorisme (Wwft), en aan de AFM, als toezichthouder op de naleving van de regels over de basisbetaalrekening, om een reactie over het sluiten dan wel bevriezen van bankrekeningen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de beslissing van de rechtbank Midden-Nederland in de casus van een Accidental American tegen de Volksbank en het bericht 'Annie Brouwer uit Harkema is Amerikaan tegen wil en d

MPs Lodders asked the Finance Minister about a court ruling allowing a bank to close the account of an accidental American, the AFM investigation into banks refusing basic accounts for lack of a TIN, FATCA-IGA privacy and double taxation, and access to basic payment accounts. The minister answered that banks may refuse accounts only on legal grounds, that the FATCA obligation stems from US law and cannot be unilaterally changed, and that banks have promised not to close accounts solely for lack of a US TIN in 2021.
The AFM supervises compliance with the rules on the basic payment account.
De AFM houdt toezicht op de naleving van de regels over de basisbetaalrekening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snoeren, Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht 'Woonbelasting weer omhoog: uitschieters tot +27%!'

VVD MPs asked the government about reported large rises in local property and waste charges for 2021, the effect of abolishing the macro norm and introducing the local-cost benchmark, and possible caps and measures against rising fees. The minister answered that the national picture awaits the COELO atlas, that the benchmark is too recent to evaluate (evaluation planned for 2025), that local councils decide on charges, and that the rise in the import-waste tax is unlikely to raise local waste fees.
It is still too early to determine the effects of introducing the local-cost benchmark, because the benchmark was only introduced in 2020.
Het is nog te vroeg om te kunnen constateren wat de gevolgen van de invoering van de benchmark lokale lasten zijn, omdat de benchmark pas in 2020 is ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de uitvoering van de compensatieregeling eHerkenning

VVD MPs asked why businesses that obtained standard eHerkenning before the special Belastingdienst login became available must downgrade it, possibly at cost, to claim compensation, and about the status of the scheme. The Secretary of State answered that downgrading is free at five of six providers, that 1014 claims had been filed and paid by 25 January 2021 (no split by route possible), and that the Belastingdienst contacted about 540 organisations unable to register in the Trade Register.
RVO cannot see, when logging in with the specific eHerkenning Belastingdienst means, whether this was first a generic eH3 login means.
RVO kan bij het inloggen met het specifieke «eHerkenning Belastingdienst» middel niet zien of dit eerst een generiek te gebruiken eH3 inlogmiddel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de dreiging van Rusland om het belastingverdrag met het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden op te zeggen en de gevolgen voor het Nederlandse mkb

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about Russia's threat to terminate the tax treaty with the Netherlands and the consequences for Dutch SMEs. The State Secretary answered that Russia requested revisions to the agreed partial renegotiation, that no formal termination notice has been received, that termination could take effect at the earliest on 1 January 2022, and that the government aims to reach an agreement.
Should the treaty nevertheless be unilaterally terminated, I will ensure that information about the termination of the tax treaty with Russia becomes available.
Mocht het verdrag toch onverhoopt eenzijdig worden opgezegd, dan zal ik ervoor zorgdragen dat informatie beschikbaar komt over de beëindiging van het belastingverdrag met Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Miljardenvermogen vlucht uit Nederland wegens btw-plicht'

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the end of the VAT exemption for fund management affecting CLO vehicles, the financial and employment consequences, the October 2020 summary proceedings and the Supreme Court rulings of 4 December 2020. The State Secretary answered that the VAT exemption follows EU case law and the Dutch policy decree, estimated the VAT burden at about EUR 3.7 million per year, reported that 81 CLO vehicles have transferred their portfolios to Ireland, and said the transition period was extended to 1 July 2021 while a fresh assessment is made.
I aim to provide clarity to the CLOs as soon as possible, well before the transition period ends on 1 July 2021.
Ik streef ernaar om zo spoedig mogelijk duidelijkheid te geven aan de CLO's, ruim voor ommekomst van de overgangstermijn per 1 juli 2021.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Vries, Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘Onrust bij pachters van buitendijks land achter Waddenzeedijk’ en ‘Rijkscommissie: Waddengebied moet Nationaal Landschapspark worden’

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about unrest among tenant farmers over the Wadden Sea dike plans and a national committee's proposal to make the Wadden region a National Landscape Park, including consultation with stakeholders and the absence of an impact analysis. The minister answered that dike reinforcement is being planned with stakeholders in phases, that the committee's advice is still being discussed with the parties concerned, and that a broad impact analysis will be started in parallel with the Wadden implementation programme.
In parallel with drafting the implementation programme, a broad impact analysis will be started, in line with the Dijkstra and Geurts motion, to weigh the effects on economy and ecology in balance.

Antwoord 14 Parallel aan het opstellen van het Uitvoeringsprogramma zal, in lijn met de motie Dijkstra en Geurts 8 , worden gestart met een brede impactanalyse om zo de effecten op economie en ecologie in balans met elkaar te kunnen afwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht ‘Schonere diesel tanken kan sinds kort ook in Roden’

MPs Ziengs and Lodders (VVD) asked about HVO100 renewable diesel, its CO2 savings, price and taxation, and what policy would promote it. The government answered that HVO is a renewable diesel substitute covered by existing excise rules, that supply is driven by the rising renewable energy obligation, and that a future CO2-chain system (BKE) is planned.
HVO is a high-quality renewable diesel substitute.
HVO is een hoogwaardige hernieuwbare dieselvervanger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Vergoeding lekke mestkelder ‘lachertje’

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about reports that compensation for leaking manure cellars damaged by Groningen earthquakes would be based on economic rather than actual damage, and about timelines and the IMG's approach. The government answered that the IMG will publish its method for manure cellar damage in early 2021, that the expert panel advised repair costs unless they exceed 1.25 times capitalised business damage, and that the IMG's independence limits pre-empting its decision.
It is not appropriate for me to anticipate this, also given the independence of the IMG.
Het past mij niet, ook gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van IMG, hier nu al op vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Lodders en Geurts over het deskundigenverslag deskundigengroep dierziekten HPAI evaluatie van 13 november 2020 ‘eendenbedrijf besmet’

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture about the expert report on avian influenza (HPAI) after a duck farm infection, covering spread, monitoring, ventilation routes, pest control, salmonella checks and export of meat from protection zones. The Minister answered most questions in substance, pointing to ongoing research and biosecurity measures, while declining to commit to raising meat export rules with the European Commission.
I therefore cannot now commit to putting this topic on the European agenda.
Ik kan daarom nu niet toezeggen dat ik dit onderwerp Europees zal agenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht 'Nederlandse sekteleider (58) verdacht van gijzeling en misbruik kinderen'

MPs Lodders and Van Wijngaarden asked about a report on a cult leader suspected of abuse and whether the tax authority can revoke the ANBI charity status of such organisations, including the Orde der Transformanten. The State Secretary answered that the status can be revoked via the existing integrity test or the new VOG requirement from 1 January 2021, that enforcement is risk-based, and that he will inform parliament in early 2021.

Following MP Lodders' question during Question Hour of 13 October about organisations offering homosexuality 'healing' therapies, I asked for a review of whether and what the Tax Authority can do regarding the ANBI status of such organisations and whether a legal amendment is needed.

Naar aanleiding van de vraag van het lid Lodders (VVD) tijdens het Vragenuur van 13 oktober jl. over organisaties die homogenezingstherapieën aanbieden, heb ik verzocht om nader te bezien of en wat de Belastingdienst kan doen met de ANBI-status van dergelijke organisaties en of daarvoor wetswijziging nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Volksbank houdt vol: we moeten rekening 'onbedoelde Amerikaan' afsluiten'

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks may close the accounts of 'accidental Americans' who do not obtain a US TIN or CLN, and whether this is fair and consistent with the basic payment account right. The minister answers that closing such accounts is premature and unnecessary where banks have made sufficient efforts, that talks with the banking association and US authorities are ongoing, and that the lack of a US TIN alone is not a ground to refuse a basic account, though other facts may be.
I therefore cannot go into the substance of that. It is for the court to judge the lawfulness of the Volksbank's conduct.
Ik kan daar daarom niet inhoudelijk op ingaan. Het is immers aan de rechter om te oordelen over de rechtmatigheid van de handelwijze van de Volksbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het handhaven van het EU-verdedigingsbeginsel door de Douane

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about businesses' options when contesting customs duties, the number of objections and their outcomes, the EU defence principle, pending court cases, limitation periods, and handling times for objections, and whether customs can levy duties twice on the same goods. The State Secretary answered that businesses can object and appeal to the court, provided objection and outcome statistics, explained the codified right to be heard, stated that duties are levied only once and that time limits are set by EU law and the General Administrative Law Act, and said customs aims to decide objections promptly without being able to influence appeal timing.
Customs and the affected party have no influence over the timing of the appeal phase.
Op het tijdsverloop in de beroepsfase hebben de Douane en belanghebbende geen invloed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over afwikkeling belastingteruggave nabestaanden

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Tax Authority handles tax refunds to heirs when no bank account is known, including how often it contacts heirs, the F-form for deceased persons, and response deadlines. The State Secretary explained the notification process, reported figures on unclaimed refunds, said a digital F-form is being worked on, and declined to change response periods.
I therefore see no reason to revise the response periods for taxpayers or the Tax Authority.
Ik zie hierom geen aanleiding om de reactietermijnen voor belastingplichtigen of de Belastingdienst te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de btw-aftrek op scholings-/opleidingskosten

Lodders (VVD) asked whether employers can deduct VAT on mandatory training and certification costs, including when the training provider bills the employee under privacy rules. The State Secretary answered that VAT is deductible only if the employer is the contracting party and receives the invoice, so when the employee contracts and is billed directly, the employer cannot deduct it, and the rules apply equally to all.
The VAT Directive 2006 does not allow deduction of VAT on training costs when an employee follows training in their own name and for their own account.
De Btw-richtlijn 2006 staat geen aftrek toe van btw op scholings-/opleidingskosten wanneer een werknemer op eigen naam en voor eigen rekening een opleiding volgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het besluit rond de verlaging van de belasting- en invorderingsrente als onderdeel van de coronamaatregelen

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the end of the temporarily reduced tax interest (4% from 1 October 2020) creates unequal treatment between businesses that requested payment deferral and those that did not, and why the tax interest was not kept at 0.01% until 1 January 2021. The State Secretary answers that the situations are not legally comparable, that tax interest is meant to incentivise timely filing and provisional assessments and is therefore reinstated, and that the end date was foreseeable from March 2020.
Legally, however, the situations are not comparable; in one case there is an established tax assessment paid late, while in the other the assessment has not yet been established.

Fiscaal-juridisch zijn de situaties echter niet vergelijkbaar; in het ene geval is sprake van een vastgestelde belastingaanslag die te laat wordt betaald terwijl in het andere geval sprake is van een nog niet vastgestelde aanslag.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de beantwoording van eerdere Kamervragen over de berichten ‘De Lugt: ‘Neonics-dossier bieten moet terug op tafel’ en ‘Ook Duitse bietentelers eisen derogatie neonics’ en over h

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about France's move to allow temporary derogations for neonicotinoid pesticides and the impact on Dutch sugar beet growers, questioning the level playing field and the lack of consultation with the sector. The minister answers that the French change is still pending in the Senate, that Dutch derogation requests are assessed on agricultural necessity and risks, and that she will consult the sector and pursue transition solutions.
I am of course willing to discuss the economic consequences and possible alternatives to neonicotinoid-containing products with the sector.
Ik ben uiteraard bereid om samen met de sector te spreken over de economische gevolgen en over de mogelijke alternatieven voor neonicotinoïne-houdende middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht "etiket dwarsboomt lage dosering gewasbeschermingsmiddelen"

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that labelling prevents low-dose application of crop protection products, and whether the authorisation body, the Ctgb, and the sector should facilitate low-dose systems and precision techniques. The minister answers that the Ctgb can only authorise what the holder submits, that the holder is responsible for label extensions, and points to the Toekomstvisie gewasbescherming 2030 programme, with no concrete new commitments beyond reviewing options.
According to the Ctgb it is possible to apply a lower dose than the dose in the WG.
Het is volgens het Ctgb wel mogelijk om een lagere dosering toe te passen, dan de dosering in het WG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van der Linde over het experiment van DNB met uitgifte betaalrekeningen

VVD MPs Lodders and Van der Linde asked the Finance Minister about a Dutch bank closing an Accidental American's account under FATCA, where Accidental Americans may lose their bank access, and about the DNB digital euro experiment. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to basic payment account options and the Convenant Basisbankrekening, said the digital euro is separate from this problem, and promised to press the US and EU for talks on FATCA.
I cannot go into individual cases in which accounts have been terminated.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken waarin sprake is van stopzetten van rekeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de toegezegde brief over stalbranden

Lodders (VVD) asks why no agreements on rodent control by farmers have been made, despite the coalition agreement and the fact that rodents may cause about 25% of barn fires, and asks for a letter before 1 April 2020. Minister Schouten answers that integrated pest management is the starting point, that certification and a farmer course for anticoagulant use will be tightened from 2023, that the government sees no direct proof rodents cause fires, and that a letter on barn fires will follow.
With the parliamentary letter on tackling barn fires, your House will be informed about additional measures to further limit the number of barn fires and animal casualties.
Met de Kamerbrief aanpak stalbranden wordt uw Kamer geïnformeerd over aanvullende maatregelen om het aantal stalbranden en dierlijke slachtoffers verder te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht 'Flinke weerstand akkerbouw tegen Waddenagenda'

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked ministers about farmers' and arable growers' opposition to the draft Wadden Agenda 2050, including their involvement, consequences for arable farming, and Natura 2000 links. The minister answers that LTO and nature groups were involved, that the agenda sets no land-use changes, and that talks with the agricultural sector and a Waddenbrief before the 5 November debate will follow.
The Ministries of IenW and LNV will enter into talks with the land and arable farming sector about the sector's position in the Agenda.
Het Ministerie van IenW en van LNV gaan in gesprek gaan met de land- en akkerbouwsector over de positie van de sector in de Agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra  en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Subsidiepot stroomauto’s nu al op’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked whether the EV subsidy budget running out within eight days, the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the limited climate gain and the Court of Audit's criticism of car taxes justify the scheme. The state secretary answered that the costs per avoided tonne fall to about 450 euro by 2025, that the scheme stays within budget and the Klimaatakkoord commitments, and that the carry-over rule for unused budget will be stopped, but gave no definitive per-tonne benchmark.
All calculations that have been carried out have already been sent to you on 3 July 2019.
Alle berekeningen die zijn uitgevoerd, heeft u reeds ontvangen op 3 juli 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het eindigen van de levensloopregeling per 1 januari 2022

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the termination of the levensloopregeling (life-course savings scheme) on 1 January 2022, its effects on savers and their benefits, and how savers are informed. The State Secretary answered that the end date is moved to 1 November 2021 as a fictional enjoyment moment, that savings institutions will act as withholding agents, and that the Tax Authority will communicate about it.
The Tax Authority will again communicate about this through the regular communication channels.
De Belastingdienst zal hierover wederom communiceren via de reguliere communicatiekanalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Nieuwe auto fors duurder door aanpassing bpm’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the Tax Plan 2021 change moving the bpm (car registration tax) taxable event to registration in the vehicle register is meant to level the playing field with parallel imports, and whether it changes VAT treatment. The State Secretary confirmed the aim of ending the tax advantage of parallel imports, stated VAT treatment is unchanged, and agreed to talk with the trade associations BOVAG and RAI to clarify confusion.
Yes. The proposed bill text has caused unintended unrest in the sector, particularly at BOVAG, regarding VAT and bpm.
Ja. Door de voorgestelde wettekst is in de sector en dan met name bij de BOVAG onbedoeld onrust ontstaan ten aanzien van de btw en bpm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘EU-hof: Amerikaanse privacybescherming onvoldoende’

An MP asked whether the EU Court's invalidation of the Privacy Shield (Schrems II) affects personal data transfers to the US, including by Dutch banks under FATCA and by organisations with US-national signatories. The minister answered that transfers now need AVG safeguards such as standard contractual clauses, that the Commission is negotiating a replacement adequacy decision, and that the Data Protection Authority is the route for complaints about unlawful transfers.
The Court based its finding that the Privacy Shield contains insufficient safeguards for EU citizens on the role US investigative and intelligence services can play after a transfer has taken place.

Het Hof heeft zijn oordeel dat het Privacy Shield onvoldoende waarborgen bevat voor EU- burgers, onderbouwd met een verwijzing naar de rol die opsporings- en inlichtingendiensten in de VS kunnen spelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Sloten bij Reusel en Someren vervuild; inspectie bezoekt boeren'

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra asked why reports of suspected manure fraud in Brabant, including high nitrogen and phosphorus in ditches, were not taken seriously, how reports are registered and handled across agencies, and whether farmers should be asked to report anonymously. The minister defends the earlier position that soil samples are not conclusive evidence, describes the reporting channels, case volumes and handling times, and points to the area-based enforcement approach, without committing to an external review or a farmer reporting campaign.
I currently see no reason for an external investigation into how reports of fraud are recorded and processed.
Ik zie momenteel geen aanleiding voor een extern onderzoek naar de wijze van opname en verwerking van signalen van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Kifid: bank mag betaalrekening beëindigen als consument geen US TIN of CLN wil aanvragen' en het bericht 'Wijziging annex II FATCA-verdrag'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a Kifid ruling allowing a bank to close a basic payment account when a US-linked consumer will not supply a US TIN, and about an amendment to Annex II of the FATCA agreement affecting sponsored entities. The minister answered that the Kifid case has specific facts and that banks and the Belastingdienst have provided FATCA information, and that the amendment preserves the status quo for Dutch sponsored entities without extra reporting.
I will ask banks to keep paying attention to clear information provision about FATCA.
Ik zal banken vragen aandacht te blijven houden voor duidelijke informatieverstrekking over FATCA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten: ‘De Lugt: ‘Neonics-dossier bieten moet terug op tafel’ en ‘Ook Duitse bietentelers eisen derogatie neonics’

An MP asks the Agriculture Minister whether the Netherlands should reconsider temporary derogations for neonicotinoid-coated sugar beet seed, citing France's and Germany's moves and level-playing-field concerns. The minister answers that a 2018 derogation request was rejected because safe use could not be shown, that alternative non-neonicotinoid products have been authorised temporarily, and that any new request would be assessed by NVWA and Ctgb.
If such a request were submitted again, I will again have myself advised by the NVWA and the Ctgb.
Wanneer een dergelijk verzoek opnieuw zou worden ingediend, zal ik mij wederom laten adviseren door de NVWA en het Ctgb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden Amerikaanse Nederlanders kunnen Trumpcheque niet verzilveren’

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister about reports that tens of thousands of Dutch-American citizens cannot cash US Trump stimulus cheques in the Netherlands, and whether banks or the US ambassador could resolve it. The minister answered that ING offers cheque cashing until end-2020, that Dutch banks have largely stopped the service for commercial and fraud reasons, and that he has raised the issue with the US embassy.

I have already raised this point with the American embassy in the Netherlands and will ask in a follow-up conversation whether, and if so what, options exist to cash a cheque if this is not possible at a Dutch bank.

Ik heb dit punt reeds onder de aandacht gebracht bij de Amerikaanse ambassade in Nederland en zal in een vervolggesprek vragen of en zo ja welke mogelijkheden er zijn om een cheque te verzilveren als dit bij een Nederlandse bank niet lukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht 'LTO: inbreng sector niet meegenomen in afspoelingsmaatregelen'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the farm sector was excluded from designing measures to prevent runoff from arable fields, and why the measures are so detailed. The minister replied that LTO was consulted, that the draft decree was adjusted after consultation (including adding options and a 3-metre buffer zone), that the scientific reports will be shared, and that the regulatory burden is estimated at about €249,428.
The input from LTO and other organisations and individual farmers has led to adjustments in the draft decree.
De inbreng van LTO en van andere organisaties en individuele landbouwers, heeft geleid tot aanpassingen in het ontwerpbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Brussels plans attack on low tax member states'

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the European Commission was considering using Article 116 TFEU to attack low-tax member states, and whether this threatens national tax competence. The State Secretary answered that the proposal is still at an exploratory stage, that the Netherlands has taken many anti-avoidance measures, and that the Chamber will be informed via a BNC fiche once a concrete proposal is published, but did not address the Commission's inconsistent legal-basis position.
At this moment there is therefore no proposal yet and it is, in my view, too premature to respond to this subject.
Op dit moment ligt er dus nog geen voorstel en is het, naar mijn mening, te prematuur om op dit onderwerp te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over het bericht ‘Brussels ready to clamp down on sweetheart corporate tax deals’

Two MPs from the VVD asked the Minister and State Secretary of Finance about a Financial Times report that Brussels is ready to clamp down on sweetheart corporate tax deals, including whether the Commission will use Article 116 TFEU to remove member-state vetoes on tax. The State Secretary answered that he supports Commission efforts against tax avoidance, that the Article 116 proposal has not yet been published, and that he will uphold parliamentary motions opposing giving up the Dutch veto on tax.
I have no intention other than to respect these motions in my position in the EU.
Ik heb geen ander voornemen dan deze moties bij mijn inzet in de EU te respecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Omtzigt over het rapport van de Algemene Rekenkamer ‘Autobelastingen als instrument’

MPs Lodders, Remco Dijkstra and Omtzigt asked the state secretaries of Finance and Infrastructure about the Court of Audit report on car taxes, questioning the cost per avoided tonne of CO2, the climate gain, the clarity of policy goals and whether the 'hand aan de kraan' monitoring system prevents overstimulation. The government rejected the report's conclusions, arguing the costs are overstated, promising to send the first hand-aan-de-kraan analysis results to Parliament shortly.
The cabinet will send the outcomes to your House in the short term.
Het kabinet zal de uitkomsten op korte termijn uw Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Wijngaarden en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Verdachten zaak sushiketen Sumo krijgen geen straf vanwege inbreuk op hun privacy’

MPs asked the government about a court ruling that suspects in the Sumo sushi case received no sentence because their privacy was violated by a KRO-NCRV documentary filmed with the FIOD and the public prosecutor's cooperation, and about the prosecutor's role in the documentary's content and non-disclosure. The Minister of Justice answered that the prosecution has appealed, that the prosecutor had a media contract allowing review of footage, and that the revised prosecution guidelines of September 2020 aim to prevent similar cases.
As long as the case has not become final, I do not wish to anticipate the possible consequences of (part of) the judgment for other criminal cases of the OM.
Zolang de zaak niet onherroepelijk is geworden wil ik niet vooruitlopen op de mogelijke gevolgen van (een deel van) het vonnis voor andere strafzaken van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht ‘Nederland internationaal onder vuur om drugshandel per post’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Lodders asked about reports that Dutch dealers send about 9,000 drug parcels a month abroad, and about the scale, destinations and controls on outbound postal drug shipments. The Minister answered with seizure figures from 2017 to 2020, stated the 9,000 figure was an extrapolation from a pilot that warrants caution, noted no national statistics on drug parcels intercepted abroad, and said that customs can open parcels without a rechter-commissaris but that reform of the Strafvordering will simplify this and that the government is engaging in international efforts.

After the modernisation of the Code of Criminal Procedure, investigating officers will be empowered to seize postal parcels independently and then open the parcel and inspect its contents, without needing authorisation from the rechter-commissaris.

Na de modernisering van het wetboek van Strafvordering zullen opsporingsambtenaren bevoegd worden om zelfstandig postpakketten in beslag te nemen en om het postpakket vervolgens te openen en kennis te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Omtzigt, van Weyenberg en Bruins over het bericht ‘Storing Belastingdienst: ondernemers krijgen week extra voor btw-aangifte’

MPs asked whether the Tax Authority's portal outage on 31 July 2020 justified a general extension and no fines for late VAT returns and payments. The state secretary confirmed the outage and the extension to 7 August, with fines waived under existing policy and the Covid emergency measures.
That is correct; between 30 July 23:35 and 31 July 14:15 it was not possible to submit VAT returns online because the MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk portal was unavailable.
Dat klopt, tussen 30 juli 23:35 uur en 31 juli 14:15 uur was het niet mogelijk btw-aangiften in te dienen via internet omdat het betreffende portaal MijnBelastingdienst/Zakelijk onbereikbaar was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Experts: liquiditeitscrisis vraagt om soepelere btw-teruggave'

MP Lodders asks the State Secretary of Finance whether the VAT refund period for uncollectable VAT should be shortened from one year to three months to ease SME liquidity, and what steps the cabinet takes on liquidity. The State Secretary answers that a shorter period would add little value, would conflict with the EU VAT Directive and would raise administrative burdens, and that existing COVID-related payment deferrals and support schemes are sufficient, with no further policy options planned.

Unlike the Dutch Association of Tax Advisers (NOB), I believe the limited improvement in liquidity for the entrepreneur receiving a faster refund hardly outweighs the increase in administrative burdens for that same entrepreneur.

Ik meen, anders dan de Nederlandse Orde van Belastingadviseurs (NOB), dat de beperkte vooruitgang in de liquiditeitspositie van de ondernemer die een snellere teruggaaf krijgt niet of nauwelijks opweegt tegen de toename van de administratieve lasten voor diezelfde ondernemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het project 26Lemont, Encrochat en de douane

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance how far official corruption within Customs has been found in the Encrochat police investigation, and asked for a reply before the Customs committee debate. The State Secretary replied that Customs does not investigate corruption signals itself, that such signals are handled by the Rijksrecherche and FIOD under the Public Prosecution Service (Justice ministry), and that the government does not comment on ongoing investigations, while promising to keep reviewing integrity risks with the police and FIOD.
In general, the Cabinet makes no statements about ongoing investigations.
In zijn algemeenheid doet het Kabinet geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over FATCA en de Accidental Americans

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about banks closing or blocking accounts of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality (Accidental Americans) due to FATCA, and about the costs and procedures for renouncing US citizenship. The government answered that banks must follow Dutch rules, that talks with the US and EU partners are ongoing, that complaints can go to Kifid or courts, and that the government will not advise on US law or costs but will keep pressing the US to lower them.
I cannot go into individual cases involving the closure or blocking of accounts or threats thereof.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken waarin sprake is van stopzetten van rekeningen, het blokkeren van rekeningen of dreiging daarmee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over een verschillend btw-tarief op verschillende vormen van educatie

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked why VAT rates differ across forms of education (music, sport, driving lessons) and how other EU states treat them. The Secretary of State explained that VAT rules follow EU directive obligations and CJEU case law, with discretion only over reduced rates, and that driving lessons fall under the standard 21% rate.
The Netherlands has no policy room to unilaterally deviate from applicable European rules as far as mandatory exemptions are concerned.
Nederland heeft geen beleidsruimte eenzijdig van die geldende Europese regelgeving af te wijken voor zover het gaat om verplichte vrijstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Consument merkt niks van lagere btw op e-books'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the reduced VAT on e-books, newspapers and magazines has not lowered consumer prices, and whether the government will act and bring forward the evaluation. The State Secretary answered that the measure primarily aims at a level playing field, that prices are set by market players, that the evaluation will be brought forward to 2022, and that CBS price monitoring will continue.
Because the market for electronic publications is relatively new, the market mechanism may not yet be working optimally.
Doordat de markt voor elektronische publicaties relatief nieuw is, werkt het marktmechanisme mogelijk nog niet optimaal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het artikel “Eindelijk succes voor Almelose luchtwasser van Jan Waayer”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a newspaper report on a biological air scrubber for pig stables that finally succeeded in obtaining RAV listing after years, and about the evaluation, timeline, pending applications and innovation procedures for such techniques. The state secretary answered that innovation is important, that the process took about 4.5 years and was lengthy for reasons withheld as competitive sensitive, that an acceleration taskforce will advise in autumn, and gave counts of pending applications and typical processing times.
Due to the applicant's competitive interests, these reasons cannot be discussed in substance.
Vanwege het concurrentiebelang van de aanvrager kan niet inhoudelijk op deze redenen worden ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘NVWA nalatig na signalen over slachthuizen als 'corona-hotspot’’

MP Lodders asked the minister about reports that the NVWA ignored warnings about meat plants as COVID-19 hotspots, including an internal survey showing vets often could not keep 1.5 metres and the use of interns. The minister confirmed signals and a 135-respondent internal survey, declined to share the survey as not opportune, said masks were provided and inspections followed, and rejected claims that NVWA ignored its own rules.
Given the purpose and nature of the internal survey, I do not consider it appropriate to send it to your House.
Gezien het doel en de aard van de interne enquête vind ik het niet opportuun deze aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Opnieuw betwiste ruiming kippen door salmonella'

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that vaccinated breeder chickens were culled early after a positive Salmonella routine test without re-sampling, questioning whether the procedure is sound given negative confirmatory tests. The minister replies that re-testing is now only allowed in exceptional cases of reasonable doubt under EU rules, that the Commission forced this change, and that the Netherlands will review the testing rules and an evaluation by WUR is underway.
Re-testing will now be omitted and will only be applied in exceptional cases where there is reasonable doubt about the correctness of the first test result.
De hertest blijft vanaf nu achterwege en zal nog slechts in uitzonderlijke gevallen worden toegepast wanneer er gerede twijfel is aan de juistheid van de eerste testuitslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad inzake premieplicht Rijnvarenden

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a Supreme Court ruling that Rhine boatmen employed by a Luxembourg employer are liable for Dutch social insurance premiums and that the Netherlands is not responsible for undoing double premium collection, and about the government's plans to resolve it. The government confirms the ruling, says it is pursuing a solution with Luxembourg, keeps a temporary halt on collection, and states that premium restitution or offsetting cannot be included in the Rhine Boatmen Convention but will be addressed through data exchange and the Rhine Commission.
We continue to work towards a solution for this.
Wij blijven ons inzetten voor een oplossing hiervoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over regelgeving en handhaving van garnalenvisserij in Natura 2000-gebieden

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the minister how the fishing-hour limits for shrimp trawlers in Natura 2000 areas were set, why the permit figures differ from NVWA figures, and how monitoring and enforcement work. The minister explained that the permits were based on 2015 data, were partly corrected after objections, that WMR now monitors fishing hours while enforcement stays with the ministry, and that a new black-box monitoring system is being certified.
From the end of 2019 this monitoring was taken over by WMR.
Vanaf eind 2019 is deze monitoring overgenomen door WMR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Lodders over het artikel ‘Unilever wake-upcall voor het kabinet’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance about the potential departure of head offices such as Unilever's, its effects on the economy and on SMEs, and the investment climate. The minister answered that head offices matter as decision centres, that Unilever's structural simplification leaves Dutch activities unchanged, and that the government will study how to strengthen the investment climate by early 2021 while pointing to earlier tax and labour-cost policy reviews.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht ‘Grote verschillen tussen rechters bij beoordelen van fiscale zaken’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Legal Protection about a report that tax courts differ widely in outcomes, and whether taxpayers' rights are adequately protected, including calls for a taxpayers' charter and further research. The government answered that the Deloitte analysis rests on a very small share of published rulings and does not establish inconsistency, that case-win data are unavailable, that no charter is planned, and that an advisory committee on practical legal protection in tax matters is examining the issue.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over een werkbezoek aan het bedrijf HZPC in Joure en het artikel ‘HZPC verplaatst aardappelonderzoek naar Canada’

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture minister about HZPC moving potato research to Canada and the strict GMO and crop protection rules that may drive such moves. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to an EU review of GMO rules due by April 2021, innovation programmes, and NVWA capacity, while answering most questions on substance.
As agreed in the coalition agreement, the cabinet is working to revise the European GMO regulation.
Zoals in het regeerakkoord is afgesproken, zet het kabinet zich in voor herziening van de Europese ggo-regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen dat logistieke bedrijven wegtrekken uit Nederlandse (zee en lucht) havens vanwege de afhandeling van goederen door de douane

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about signals that logistics firms are leaving Dutch sea and air ports because of customs handling, and about differences in customs controls and scanning between ports. The State Secretary answered at length on customs tasks, risk-based national controls applied uniformly across ports, EU rules, enforcement statistics, helpline performance and e-commerce controls, while acknowledging perceived level-playing-field problems.
Customs enforces in all sea and air ports under a single national risk management model.
De Douane handhaaft in alle (zee- en lucht)havens namelijk volgens één landelijke risicobeheersingsmodel.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Geurts en Lodders over de voortzetting van de activiteiten van Stichting Veldleeuwerik

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the uncertain future of Stichting Veldleeuwerik's farmer study groups and how the sustainability practice network would be continued. The minister replied by referring to attached findings and a kwartiermaker appointment, pledging support for existing groups with BO Akkerbouw while the new practice network is set up.
I attach great importance to supporting the current entrepreneur groups of the former Veldleeuwerik network.
Ik hecht er groot belang aan om de huidige ondernemersgroepen van het voormalige Veldleeuwerik netwerk te steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over de planning van het onderzoek budgetneutrale overstap WLTP

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked why the results of the study on budget-neutral WLTP transition would only be shared in July 2020, who would conduct it, and how independence is guaranteed, following a motion requesting an independent review by early summer. The state secretary answers that the timing was an estimate of the time needed, names Prof. C. Koopmans (SEO, VU) as independent second-opinion reviewer, and sets out the research questions, including macro and top-ten-car budget neutrality, with a request to complete it before 1 June 2020.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans will carry out an independent review, in the form of a second opinion, of the budget-neutral conversion of the bpm table to CO2 emissions under the WLTP test method.
Prof. dr. C. Koopmans zal in de vorm van een second opinion een onafhankelijke toets uitvoeren op de budgettair neutrale omzetting van de bpm-tabel naar de CO 2 -uitstoot volgens de WLTP-testmethode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Te hoge belasting omdat gemeente VvE- reserve meerekent in WOZ bepaling’

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether municipalities wrongly include a homeowners' association (VvE) reserve when valuing apartments for WOZ property tax, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answered that municipalities use uniform methods, that significant VvE reserves are taken into account in sales analysis, that the Waarderingskamer found no shortcomings, and that no further measures are considered necessary.
No problem is experienced with the way municipalities take into account the share in the VvE reserve when determining WOZ values.
Er wordt geen probleem ervaren met de wijze waarop gemeenten rekening houden met het aandeel in de VvE-reserve bij het vaststellen van WOZ-waarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren in Bladel krijgen massaal drugsbrieven: ‘Mijn cliënt zoekt ruimte voor hennepplanten”

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Lodders asked about fake drug-crime letters sent to farmers in Bladel and whether similar letters circulate elsewhere, and about reporting channels and vacant farm buildings. The minister says the letters were part of a municipal awareness campaign, that similar initiatives exist nationwide, and that reporting is possible via police and Meld Misdaad Anoniem, while promising to inform parliament on the broader offensive later.
A clear picture of the precise extent is lacking, but it can be assumed that such practices occur throughout the country.
Een duidelijk en helder beeld over de precieze omvang ontbreekt, maar aangenomen kan worden dat dit soort praktijken in het hele land voorkomen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van den Bosch over de berichten ‘Gemeentelijke belastingen voor huiseigenaren stijgen hard in 2020‘, en ‘Miljoenenstrop voor gemeenten door bedrijfjes die WOZ-waarde aanvechten‘

MPs Lodders and Van den Bosch asked whether local taxes rising in 2020, the cost of no-cure-no-pay WOZ objection firms to municipalities, and the fairness of the local tax system warrant reform. The Minister answered that a reform of local taxes is desirable, that a WODC study on WOZ objection costs is pending, and that the WOZ system is still sound, rejecting the claim that 40% of WOZ values are wrong.
A systemic reform of local taxes seems desirable to me indeed.
Een systeemherziening in de lokale belastingen lijkt mij inderdaad wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked about the poor condition of 164 state-owned farmsteads leased to tenant farmers, the timing of repairs, the Grondkamer rent-review process and a recent ruling, and the strategic status of the farms. The ministers answered that repairs will start once funds are freed in the spring budget process (estimated at about 24 million euro), that 153 farms are strategic, and that the rent norms remain adequate, while declining to draw conclusions for other tenants from the ruling.
Once the funds become available, further repair work will be started as quickly as possible.
Na het beschikbaar komen van de middelen wordt zo snel mogelijk gestart met de verdere herstelwerkzaamheden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over banken die op grond van de FATCA-wetgeving financiële dienstverlening weigeren aan Nederlanders met (ook) de Amerikaanse nationaliteit

Three MPs asked whether banks may block or close accounts of Dutch citizens who also hold US nationality (Accidental Americans) for lacking a US TIN under FATCA, and what the government will do. The Secretary of State answers that closure is not required by FATCA or the IGA, that supervisors DNB and AFM apply case-by-case rules, that no closures had yet occurred, and that the government keeps pressing the US for solutions while declining to restrict data exchange unilaterally.
I am aware of what my predecessor wrote to the House.
Ik ben bekend met hetgeen mijn ambtsvoorganger aan uw Kamer heeft geschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Nijkerken-de Haan en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Limburg vreest verlies duizenden banen door luchtvrachttaks'

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the national aviation tax would cost jobs and traffic at Maastricht Aachen Airport and whether further research and consultation with Limburg had taken place. The government answered that no airport-specific analysis was made, that national effects show a small emissions decline and limited job effects, and that the EU-level alternative remains uncertain.
No specific research was conducted into the position of Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Er is geen specifiek onderzoek gedaan naar de positie van Maastricht Aachen Airport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Lodders over een bericht van het Operationeel Centrum van de politie-eenheid Den Haag

Two VVD MPs asked why the Den Haag police unit tweeted that selling meat from vans during the Offerfeest was legal, and questioned the NVWA oversight, food safety and equal treatment behind it. The minister explained that the NVWA had granted a permanent general permission for transporting uncooled carcasses, that the tweet was meant to inform the public, and that the controls were sample-based, without committing to any new action.
That regulation also allows the competent authority, in this case the NVWA, to grant permission for transporting meat and delivering it to citizens via (mini) vans.
Deze verordening maakt het ook mogelijk dat de bevoegde autoriteit, in dit geval de NVWA, toestemming verleent voor het vervoer van vlees en aflevering aan burgers via (mini)vrachtwagens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Yassini en Lodders over het bericht 'Verkoper van 'tweedehands' e-boeken stopt ermee'

MPs El Yassini and Lodders asked the ministers about a CJEU ruling on resale of second-hand e-books and how it relates to the e-lending convenant for public libraries, plus e-book market size, VAT reduction effects and innovation. The minister answered that the ruling is separate from the convenant, gave market figures, and deferred several questions to forthcoming policy letters or evaluations.
The State Secretary for Finance will inform the House before the summer about the results of this research.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het programma ‘Certificeren op afstand’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about the 'certify remotely' programme for veterinary export certificates, including new deadlines, weekend export limits, frozen products, and the high fee compared with Germany. The minister answers that no new requirements were imposed, that the fee is set by ministerial regulation, and that remote and on-site certification will both be kept for now.
Certifying after the fact is not permitted by law.
Het achteraf certificeren is wettelijk niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Geen gehoor bij Belastingtelefoon’

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone line is unreachable, including waiting times, call-handling figures, the reasons for rising waits, alternative contact channels and planned improvements. The government answered with figures showing about one in twenty callers could not be connected in 2019, explained capacity and staff turnover as causes, and outlined planned measures such as callback options and an external review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de reorganisatie van de Belastingdienst

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the planned split of the Tax Administration, Benefits and Customs, staff concerns, IT modernisation, and the timeline and cost of the reorganisation. The government answered that the split will be done only where useful, that staff will be involved, that a plan of action and an impact assessment will be sent to parliament before the summer, and that culture and leadership will be addressed.
Before the summer we will send parliament a plan of action, as requested by Ms Lodders, in which the voice of employees will also explicitly have a place.
Voor de zomer zullen wij een plan van aanpak aan uw Kamer toesturen, zoals gevraagd door mevrouw Lodders, waarin ook nadrukkelijk het geluid van de medewerkers een plek in krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst heeft geen btw-id voor starters: 'Ik zit weken op zwart zaad'

Two VVD MPs asked why startup sole traders were waiting weeks for VAT identification numbers and what the government would do about backlogs, staffing and the Belastingtelefoon. The State Secretary answered that the two-week target is not being met for some, that backlogs have been cleared, that extra capacity was deployed, and that the new number system was introduced for privacy reasons with a fully new system timing still undetermined.
There is currently no exact date that can be given for when the entirely new system will be built and implemented.
Er is op dit moment nog geen exacte datum aan te geven wanneer het geheel nieuwe systeem gebouwd en geïmplementeerd gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat ANBI’s belastingregels niet naleven

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that charities with ANBI status do not comply with tax rules, including how many are checked, the criteria, and the process for granting or revoking status. The answers describe limited inspection capacity, periodic checks of publication duties with status revocations, and a planned law change on the integrity requirement, but say no full annual control or per-year breakdown is available.
A breakdown per year is not available.
Een overzicht per jaar is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht 'Gehandicapte mag werkbonus nog steeds niet houden, Kamerleden boos'

Two VVD MPs asked why a disabled worker (Wajong recipient) must hand a 12.5-year service bonus to UWV and whether the Wet LB 1964 could be amended for this group, and whether alternatives will be explored. The State Secretary answered that the bonus counts as wage and is offset against the Wajong benefit, that amending the Wet LB 1964 is not the appropriate instrument, and that a harmonised income rule keeps at least 30 percent of extras while UWV lacks reliable data to exempt them fully.
A one-off payment after at least 12.5 years of service is wage within the meaning of the Wet LB 1964 and therefore falls under the income concept.
Een eenmalige verstrekking bij ten minste 12,5 jaar in dienst is loon in de zin van de Wet LB 1964 en valt daarmee onder het inkomensbegrip
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Lodders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de BRP.

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked the government about registration in the Basisregistratie Personen (BRP), including cases where new residents are registered without the main tenant's consent and suffer consequences. Minister Knops answered that he opposes mandatory prior verification and mandatory consent from existing residents, points to municipal responsibility and ongoing work on a BRP change and complaints point, and promises a progress letter in spring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Sienot en Lodders over het bericht dat de prijs van elektriciteit van snelladers wordt verhoogd naar 79 cent/kWH voor passanten

MPs asked whether the government will investigate market power and cartel formation among fast-charger operators after Ionity raised guest charging prices to 79 cent/kWh, and whether a maximum price should be set. The government answered that ACM is independent and has heightened attention for the sector, that the market is open and competitive, and that a maximum price is not currently under consideration.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is an independent regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over de nieuwe Kleine Ondernemersregeling (KOR)

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked the State Secretary for Finance about the low uptake of the new small-business VAT scheme (KOR), the basis for the 200,000 estimate, the lack of VAT on invoices, the EUR 20,000 threshold and the three-year lock-in, and whether the scheme would be adjusted. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is an administrative simplification, that the threshold was chosen for budget neutrality, that uptake will only be assessed in an evaluation in 2021, and that no change is currently planned.

As indicated in the answer to question 6, it can only be determined after the announced evaluation to what extent the number of registered entrepreneurs (positively or negatively) deviates from the expected number and what the possible cause is.

Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 6 kan pas na afloop van de aangekondigde evaluatie vastgesteld worden in hoeverre het aantal aangemelde ondernemers (positief of negatief) afwijkt van het verwachte aantal en wat daar mogelijk de oorzaak van is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het verplichte gebruik van eHerkenning bij de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the Tax Administration makes eHerkenning (level 3, a private authentication means) mandatory for payroll and corporation tax returns from 1 January 2020, questioning its legal basis, communication, EU comparisons, liability, impact assessment and the relation to the Digital Government Act. The state secretary answered that article 2:15 Awb and the AWR/Regeling EBV provide the basis, that the requirement follows from GDPR security duties, and that notice was given by letter and website, while acknowledging the regulation's annex needed correcting and that no formal impact assessment was made.
This will be corrected in the short term by means of a ministerial regulation with retroactive effect to 1 January 2020.
Dit zal op korte termijn door middel van een ministeriële regeling met terugwerkende kracht tot 1 januari 2020 rechtgezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Omvang belastingontwijking multinationals zwaar overschat’

Member Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper report claiming that estimates of profit-shifting by multinationals are greatly overstated, asking for an assessment, the OECD method, Dutch-specific amounts and comparisons across models.
