The State Secretary answered that the estimates remain uncertain and contested, explained the differing data and assumptions of the OECD, European Parliament and Blouin-Robinson studies, cited an unofficial 22 billion euro figure from Lejour, and said no study has calculated losses over ten years and that a separate letter on the Lejour research will follow.
To my knowledge, there are no studies that have calculated how much tax has been avoided over a period of 10 years.
Bij mijn weten zijn er geen studies die voor een periode van 10 jaar hebben berekend hoeveel belasting er ontweken is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de eHerkenning en het artikel ‘MKB en VNO-NCW: gedupeerden nieuw aangiftesysteem compenseren’

MPs Lodders, Middendorp and Aartsen (VVD) asked the Finance, Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about internal resistance at the Tax Administration to eHerkenning, its costs, the fate of about 60,000 businesses lacking a suitable login, and whether small firms can keep filing free. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that concerns were addressed, that about 540 organisations cannot obtain eHerkenning, that proactive deadline extensions and an older portal for VAT remain, and that a further letter on support for small firms would follow.
The Tax Administration proactively grants extensions to employer-liable businesses that are legal entities and last filed via the old business portal.

De Belastingdienst verleent proactief uitstel voor ondernemers die aangifteplichtig zijn voor de loonheffingen, rechtspersoon zijn en hun laatst ingediende aangifte hebben gedaan via het oude ondernemersportaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Den Bosch over het bericht ‘gemeentelijke belastingen voor huiseigenaren stijgen hard in 2020’

Two VVD MPs asked whether rising local property taxes (OZB, waste and water levies) in 2020 undermine purchasing power, why the macro-norm was abolished, and what the new municipal benchmark will achieve. The minister answered that local lasten developments await the COELO atlas, that local councils decide tax increases democratically, and that benchmarking informs local debate, while rejecting new proposals for now.
It is up to the municipalities themselves to determine why the increase is necessary.
Het is aan gemeenten zelf om te bepalen waarom de stijging noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de antwoorden op eerder gestelde vragen inzake de regeling Pelsdierhouderij slopen en ombouwen

MP Lodders asks why, more than six years after the fur farming ban took effect, the subsidy scheme for demolition and conversion of fur farms still does not work adequately, and what the minister will do for affected entrepreneurs. The minister replies that the scheme entered into force in February 2018, that changes will be submitted to parliament and the European Commission, with publication targeted for the second half of 2020, and that the full 36 million euro budget will be pursued without a firm guarantee of retroactive timing.
Assuming this procedure proceeds smoothly, I aim to publish and bring into force the amended decision in the second half of 2020.
Uitgaande van een voorspoedig verloop van deze procedure streef ik er naar het gewijzigde besluit in de tweede helft van 2020 te publiceren en in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over PFAS houdende grond afkomstig van de verwerking van aardappelen, suikerbieten en cichoreiwortels

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked the ministers about PFAS limits threatening processing of potatoes, sugar beet and chicory and the costs for the sector, and about use of manufacturer's declarations and the PFAS taskforce. The minister replied that a temporary national background value and clarified guidance now allow tarra soil to be reused again, that the sector is represented in the taskforce, and that area-specific policy could speed up soil quality maps.
On 1 December 2019 I amended the temporary PFAS policy framework, clarifying the use of tarra soil and setting a temporary national background value.
Op 1 december 2019 heb ik het tijdelijk handelingskader PFAS aangepast waarin het gebruik van tarragrond is verduidelijkt en is een tijdelijke landelijke achtergrondwaarde vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Harbers over het OPS-model

MPs Lodders and Harbers asked the ministers whether the full source code, calculation rules and data of the OPS dispersion model had been made public, and why emission data requested after a September 2019 commitment had not been shared. The minister replied that the source code was published in early November 2019 with the model data in the OPS download, that emission data were partly withheld for business confidentiality and privacy reasons, and that the RIVM released aggregated data to the plaintiffs in a court case on 7 January 2020, with further publication of changes promised.
Not all emission data are publicly available on Emissieregistratie because they contain business-confidential and/or privacy-sensitive (GDPR) information.
Niet alle emissiedata zijn openbaar op Emissieregistratie te vinden aangezien deze bedrijfsvertrouwelijke en/of privacygevoelige (AVG) informatie bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het niet meer kosteloos doen van loonaangifte voor ondernemers door de invoering van eHerkenning

Two VVD MPs asked why employers must now use eHerkenning, which costs roughly 40 to 45 euro, to file payroll returns for free-of-charge tax filing, and whether this conflicts with the goal of reducing administrative burden. The minister replied that the government chose mandatory eHerkenning for sensitive payroll data under the Wet digitale overheid, that costs are shared among users and providers, and that the scheme reduces burden with frequent use, but offered no reconsideration.

That is why, for payroll returns from 1 January 2020, the security level 'substantial' applies and a login means with a corresponding reliability level must therefore be used, in this case eHerkenning level 3.

Daarom geldt ter zake van loonaangiften per 1 januari 2020 beveiligingsniveau «substantieel» en moet dus gebruik worden gemaakt van een inlogmiddel met een overeenkomstig betrouwbaarheidsniveau, in dit geval eHerkenning niveau 3.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voortgang van de aanbestedingsprocedure van de ‘Wijziging van de Muntwet 2002 in verband met de aanbesteding van het produceren van munten en het afschaffen van beleggingsmu

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the tender procedure for coin production and the consequences of the abolition of investment coins, including DNB's role, distribution, and commemorative coins. The government answered that the tender for circulation coins was awarded to KNM, the tender for collector products was withdrawn for lack of interest, a short-term contract with KNM covers 2020, and most questions were answered on substance though tender documents were withheld as confidential.
These documents are secret and not publicly available, because strict security requirements and safeguards apply to the production and distribution of coins.
Deze documenten zijn geheim en niet openbaar opvraagbaar, omdat er bij de productie en distributie van munten strenge veiligheidseisen- en waarborgen van toepassing zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked about the poor condition of state-owned farmhouses leased by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, complaint channels, rent setting, inspections, repair timelines and the policy against selling these farms. Minister Ollongren answered substantively, reporting complaint figures, inspection status, a budget increase and a plan to start interdepartmental talks, while confirming the ban on selling non-strategic farms to tenants only under conditions.
In the context of the spring memorandum 2020, I will start interdepartmental consultation to free up the funds needed to carry out the maintenance work.
Ik zal in het kader van de voorjaarsnota 2020 een interdepartementaal overleg starten om de middelen vrij te maken, die nodig zijn om de onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit te kunnen voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Aanpak belastingontwijking remt buitenlandse investeringen’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the anti-tax-avoidance push is deterring genuine foreign direct investment, and what measures would protect real investment and the investment climate. The State Secretary answered that non-bfi investment rose over ten years with no visible break, that the effect of anti-avoidance measures is hard to isolate, and listed tax-rate cuts, the principal purposes test, and an international coordinated approach as the response.
To be attractive for investment by foreign companies with real economic activity, it is important that the Netherlands has a strong investment climate across the board.
Om aantrekkelijk te zijn voor investeringen van buitenlandse bedrijven met reële economische activiteiten is het van belang dat Nederland een sterk vestigingsklimaat in de breedte heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Wörsdörfer en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Een klik verwijderd van je schuldeisers’

VVD MPs asked the state secretaries about schuldenwijzer.nl, a debt-overview site that currently shows only debts enforced by bailiffs, and why tax authority, municipal and water board debts are not yet included, plus the legal obstacles around citizen service numbers. The government answered that the site helps citizens gain insight, that expansion is in progress led by bailiffs and the Belastingdienst is working on its own portal, and that no concrete legal obstacle has been identified beyond what is still to be signalled by bailiffs.
The Ministry of SZW discusses progress with SNG and KBvG and whether and how government organisations can join.
Het Ministerie van SZW bespreekt met SNG en KBvG de voortgang en ook of en zo ja, hoe overheidsorganisaties kunnen aansluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de evaluaties van 15 CAF projecten (uitgevoerd in 2015), waarom de Kamer meerdere keren gevraagd heeft

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the government had not shared evaluations of 15 CAF projects from 2015 despite repeated parliamentary questions, and when the minister and predecessor knew of them. The State Secretary answered that the evaluations were now attached, that the EDP auditors focused only on CAF 11, that the minister had only recently seen them, and that certain internal deliberation documents would not be shared with parliament.
As I indicated in my letter of 22 November, I consider it of great importance that officials must be able to exchange views freely with me and with each other.
Zoals ik in mijn brief van 22 november jl. heb aangegeven acht ik het van groot belang dat ambtenaren met mij en onderling vrij van gedachten moeten kunnen wisselen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Von Martels, Lodders en Bisschop over het artikel 'Grote onvrede over aanpak pootgoedfraude'

MPs from CDA, VVD and SGP asked the minister about NVWA and NAK handling of seed potato fraud (valse NAK-labels), the enforcement tools of the plant inspection services, and cooperation between the agencies. The minister answered that the NVWA acted within its powers, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that the inspection services' fines powers are limited under current law, and that an evaluation of enforcement instruments is planned by 2021.
I will evaluate the use of the enforcement instruments currently included in this legislation and will also involve the plant inspection services and the sector.
Ik zal de inzet van de nu in deze regelgeving opgenomen handhavingsinstrumenten evalueren en daarbij ook de plantaardige keuringsdiensten en de sector betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over ontploffingsgevaar emissiearme stalvloeren en ruimte voor alternatieve systemen

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked about explosion risk from low-emission stable floors after the Markelo incident, the delayed release of the Omgevingsdienst Twente report, and barriers for innovative systems under the RAV protocol. The government admitted the report was promised but not sent, said a new study on floor safety will be commissioned, and outlined steps to speed up approval procedures.
That was not right, because that had been promised.
Dat was niet goed, want dat was wel beloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over emissiearme stalvloeren

Two VVD MPs asked whether emission-reducing stable floors have been adequately tested for safety after explosions on dairy farms in Lettele and Markelo, and why earlier warnings and the Technical Advisory Pool's role were not considered. The minister acknowledges the earlier answers should have weighed a 2016 fire-academy warning, and announces a joint study with the Minister for Environment and Housing on the safety of emission-reducing floors, with results to Parliament in early 2020.

Given the remaining questions about the safety of emission-reducing floors for livestock farmers and others involved, the Minister for Environment and Housing and I will commission a study into the safety of emission-reducing floors in practical use.

Gezien de vragen die resteren over de veiligheid van emissiearme vloeren bij veehouders en andere betrokkenen zullen de Minister voor Milieu en Wonen en ik een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de veiligheid van emissiearme vloeren bij het gebruik in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht 'Burgemeesters op de bres voor kortebaandraverijen'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the impact of the Wet Kansspelen op afstand and the gambling tax change on short-track harness racing organisations, including possible compensation and whether the sector will survive. The government answered that the wetswijziging will likely lower payouts to the sector, that compensation talks are ongoing with implementation expected 1 January 2021, and that it could not provide a ten-year overview of race numbers.
We do not have the requested overview of developments over the past ten years.
Wij beschikken niet over het gevraagde overzicht van de ontwikkelingen in de afgelopen tien jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de regeling Pelsdierhouderij slopen en ombouwen

An MP asked the minister about the status of the fur farm demolition and conversion subsidy scheme, the one-year implementation deadline, and whether other required procedures are accounted for. The minister reported ten applications, said the one-year deadline cannot be extended because it is part of EU state aid approval, and announced a planned loosening of the deadline and permit requirements.
I intend to considerably extend the implementation period and ensure that fur farmers do not already need to hold all required permits when applying.
Ik ben voornemens de uitvoeringstermijn aanzienlijk te verruimen, en ervoor te zorgen dat pelsdierhouders niet reeds bij de aanvraag hoeven te beschikken over alle benodigde vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp, Ldders en Koerhuis over het inschrijven in de Basisregistratie Persoon (BRP)

MPs Middendorp, Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether residents can register at any address in the BRP without the consent of existing occupants, and about the checks municipalities must perform, in cases where people are registered without the main resident knowing and suffer financial harm. The state secretary answered that registration depends on actual residence rather than consent, that municipalities control registrations under the BRP law and the adres onderzoek circular, that consent-based registration would undermine the BRP, and that the ministry is discussing solutions with municipal and implementing bodies.
Registration in the BRP at an address in the municipality is therefore not dependent on the consent of the resident already registered at that address.
Inschrijving in de BRP op een adres in de gemeente is derhalve niet afhankelijk van de instemming van de reeds op dat adres ingeschreven bewoner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten ‘Belastingproblemen Nederlandse Amerikanen nog niet de wereld uit’ en ‘Snel vraagt banken om meer coulance voor Amerikaanse Nederlanders’

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Dutch-American 'accidental Americans' face banks closing accounts without a US TIN, and about the conditions and costs of renouncing US citizenship and the IRS relief scheme. The State Secretary answered at length, saying banks are premature in closing accounts, that the situation is a US matter, and that he is pressing the US for lower fees and a joint EU approach.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over Fosfaatrechten zelfzuivelaars

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about uncertainty for self-cheesemakers under phosphate rules, including registration numbers, re-decisions on phosphate rights and treatment of new entrants. The minister explains the existing self-cheesemaker scheme remains in force until a planned switch to actual milk production, that re-decisions have been issued, and that monitoring will be expanded in future data collection.
RVO.nl does not keep a register of self-cheesemakers. I therefore cannot provide you with a current overview of self-cheesemakers at this time.
RVO.nl houdt geen register bij van zelfzuivelaars. Ik kan u derhalve op dit moment geen actueel overzicht van zelfzuivelaars overleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht ‘Duizenden veehouders nog in ongewis over fosfaatrechten’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about thousands of livestock farmers still uncertain about phosphate rights, including delays in objection procedures, whether a re-assessment will pause pending objections, and the status of hardship-case applications. The Minister answered that objections are being handled as quickly as possible but carefully, that a re-assessment is expected by autumn 2019, that procedural agreements exist with some farmers, and that seven hardship cases still await data, while mostly referring back to earlier answers without firm dates.
The CBb issued rulings on 16 April 2019 and 25 June 2019 on the definition of dairy cattle in the Meststoffenwet.
Het CBb heeft op 16 april 2019 en 25 juni 2019 uitspraken gedaan over de definitie van melkvee in de Meststoffenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het gebruik van biostimulanten

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the unregulated market for biostimulants, including labelling, toxicity of micro-organisms such as Bacillus and Aspergillus niger, and the lack of inspection. The minister answered that the market is not monitored, the EU fertiliser regulation will bring rules by 2022, most questions were answered in substance, and the NVWA enforces against products making crop-protection claims.
Supervision of what is understood as biostimulants is currently still limited.
Het toezicht op wat onder biostimulanten wordt begrepen is op dit moment nog beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over de Wet modernisering kleineondernemersregeling (KOR)

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about the implementation of the modernised small business scheme (KOR), its turnover threshold of €20,000, and the consequences of a CJEU ruling on margin-scheme dealers. The State Secretary answered that the scheme takes effect on 1 January 2020, outlined the communication campaign, defended the threshold as budget-neutral and comparable within the EU, and said the scheme will be evaluated and the threshold adjusted if warranted.
However, it is necessary that the new article 24 of the Implementing Decree VAT 1968, as it would enter into force on 1 January 2020, be withdrawn.
Wel is het noodzakelijk dat het nieuwe artikel 24 Uitvoeringsbeschikking OB 1968, zoals dat in werking zou treden per 1 januari 2020, wordt ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de zandoverlast op de Markerwaarddijk

VVD MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about repeated closures of the Markerwaarddijk due to sand drifting, the choice to use sand in the dike reinforcement despite the known risk, alternatives considered, economic impact, and how closures will be prevented. The Minister acknowledged the problem, explained the cost, ecological and sustainability reasons for the mixed sand-stone design and the alternatives assessed in the environmental impact report, and said an extra layer of soil is being applied with completion expected in October.
The economic consequences of the road closure for the region are not known to me.
De economische gevolgen van de wegafsluiting voor de regio zijn mij niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over de berichten “Criminelen wassen 1 miljard wit via export tweedehandsauto’s” en “Autobedrijven frauderen voor miljoenen bij export ex-leaseauto’s”

MPs Van der Linde and Lodders asked about press reports of money laundering through export of second-hand and ex-lease cars, asking about the scale of fraud, reporting figures, FIU access to customs data, and enforcement capacity. The Ministers answered that a criminal investigation into four dealers covers roughly 120 million euro in exports and a 21 million euro VAT loss, that no overall figures exist, and that existing cooperation and a new anti-money-laundering plan are being strengthened, while withholding further details due to the ongoing investigation.
Because this criminal investigation is still ongoing, further details cannot be disclosed.
Omdat dit strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog loopt, kunnen verdere details niet worden vermeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over bpm-fraude bij parallelimport

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked the State Secretary of Finance about BPM fraud in imported used cars, including timing of announced measures, import and inspection figures, post-assessments, objections and no-cure-no-pay practices. The government answered that solutions are being worked out with a letter this autumn, gave import volumes, said inspections stayed flat at about 1,000 per half year, and declined to quantify penalties and some objection data for lack of registration or management information.
This autumn, your House will be further informed about this.
Dit najaar wordt uw Kamer hierover verder geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Verkoop personenauto’s zakt flink in eerste halfjaar 2019’

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked about a reported 10% drop in new passenger car sales in the first half of 2019, the rise in BPM revenue despite fewer sales, and whether the BPM tables will be adjusted for the WLTP test procedure. State Secretary Snel answers that sales fluctuations are normal, that BPM revenue rose because cars became heavier and more CO2-intensive, and that the BPM will switch to WLTP-based tables from 1 July 2020 with compensating adjustments.
As described in the answer to question 3, such fluctuations in the number of new car sales are not unusual.
Zoals beschreven in het antwoord op vraag 3 zijn dergelijke fluctuaties in het aantal nieuwverkochte auto's niet ongebruikelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de import van tweedehands elektrische auto’s voor een lagere bijtelling

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether young second-hand electric cars imported to take advantage of a lower company-car tax rate could be curbed, for example by tying the rate to first Dutch registration. The State Secretary answered that the rate depends on first-registration date wherever in the world, that such imports are expected to remain small, and that tying the rate to Dutch registration would breach EU free movement rules.
I see no possibilities to make the company-car tax rate for an imported zero-emission car depend on the moment it is registered on a Dutch license plate.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om bij import van een emissievrije auto het bijtellingspercentage afhankelijk te stellen van het moment dat ze in Nederland op kenteken worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over het artikel “Recalcitrant accountholders in de IGA”

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about a legal article on FATCA's intergovernmental agreement, including how banks must handle US persons without a TIN and whether the IRS can judge banks significantly non-compliant. The State Secretary largely rejected the article's interpretation, said the Netherlands is pressing the US for clarity and a simpler SSN procedure, but admitted US positions remain unclear and no concrete US measures have been announced.
I do not agree with this interpretation of Article 4, second paragraph, of the IGA.
Ik ben het niet eens met deze uitleg van artikel 4, tweede lid, van de IGA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het  bericht ‘De Ketelbrug stond vast, moet  oplossing voor komen’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked about a July 2019 breakdown of the Ketelbrug bridge, its maintenance history, emergency access, and whether shipping would stay blocked. The minister explained the fault was a frequency controller, listed 16 shipping and 7 road disruptions since the 2013 renovation, said emergency services are alerted via the joint control room, and stated the bridge was back on regular operation from 1 August with no backlog maintenance.
From 1 August the bridge is operated again according to the regular operating regime.
Vanaf 1 augustus wordt de brug weer bediend conform regulier bedieningsregime.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Lodders over het bericht dat de Kamerbrief over letselschade foute cijfers bevat

Two MPs (Leijten, SP and Lodders, VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance why figures in a letter on personal injury compensation in the wealth tax were questioned, how injury experts were involved, whether clarity can be given quickly, and whether the debate affects the decision on counting injury compensation as own assets. The State Secretary refers to a reply letter on the motion and does not answer the questions in the text itself.

The written questions from MPs Leijten (SP) and Lodders (VVD), question number 2019Z150123, have been answered by means of the letters 'Response to the motion by MPs Leijten and Lodders on personal injury compensation'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Leijten (SP) en Lodders (VVD), vraagnummer 2019Z150123 , zijn beantwoord middels de brieven «Reactie op de motie van de leden Leijten en Lodders over letselschadevergoedingen» (Kamerstuk 35 026, nrs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Hermans over de monitoring van de afschaffing BPM-teruggaaf voor taxi’s en openbaar vervoer

MPs Lodders and Hermans asked the State Secretary of Finance how the monitoring of the abolition of the BPM refund for taxis and public transport (including accessible transport) is being carried out, and about zero-emission vehicle availability, range, weight-related licence issues, and the absence of greening in the 'Iedereen Onderweg' agenda. The government answered that monitoring of supply is underway, that zero-emission options exist but are more limited for wheelchair taxis, that the rolstoelbusje refund for care institutions remains, and that greening is already covered by a separate convenant.
For the debate on the Tax Plan 2020, the cabinet will return in more detail to the supply of very low-emission and zero-emission vehicles for targeted transport.
Voor de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2020 komt het kabinet uitgebreider terug op het aanbod van zeer zuinige en emissievrije voertuigen voor doelgroepenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Lodders over de heffingskorting van Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Van Weyenberg and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the loss of tax credits (heffingskortingen) for Dutch pensioners abroad since 2019, including the number affected, budget estimates, AOW export rules, and how they were informed. The State Secretary confirmed the change follows from Belastingplan 2018 and 2019, gave estimates of about 350,000 and 130,000 affected persons and a 3 million euro revenue estimate, and described Belastingdienst and SVB communication, while not providing a precise count of AOW recipients affected.
The concrete share of these persons in the numbers is not known.
Het concrete aandeel van deze personen in de aantallen is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Malmström – Finalizing Mercosur deal is ‘priority number one’

MPs Lodders and Van Haga asked about the state of the EU-Mercosur trade negotiations, the urgency of concluding them, whether farm and chemical standards would be weakened, and what concessions on agriculture were on the table. The ministers answered that a political agreement had been reached, that EU standards will not be lowered, that the cabinet will assess the balance once consolidated texts are available, and that they would not disclose other ministers' reactions.
Once the consolidated texts become available, the cabinet can assess the balance of the advantages and disadvantages of the trade agreement for the Netherlands.
Als de geconsolideerde teksten beschikbaar komen, kan het kabinet de balans op te maken van de voor- en nadelen van het handelsakkoord voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over de aanpak van mestfraude

MPs Lodders and Laan-Geselschap asked about the government's approach to manure fraud, including reporting channels, how reports are registered and handled, and cross-border enforcement with Belgium. Minister Schouten answered that no single body collects all reports, that reports via official channels are registered, and that 63 processes-verbaal from 2017 led to mostly convictions and some transactions, while declining to give full regional report counts for the police.
There is no body that collects all reports, including those from all other bodies.
Er is geen instantie die alle meldingen, ook van alle andere instanties, verzamelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over de vermogensrendementsheffing

Two MPs (Lodders, Omtzigt) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Supreme Court ruling that the assumed 4% box 3 return was unrealistic for 2013 and 2014, and what it means for the wealth tax, future reform and pending objections. The State Secretary answered that the ruling leaves the assessments intact, that massive objections for 2013-2016 will be rejected by collective decision, that a real-return system is being studied with spaargeld results promised before Prinsjesdag, and that the questions would be answered within three weeks.
The Supreme Court attaches no consequences to a possible violation at system level in its ruling and leaves the assessments in place.
De Hoge Raad verbindt in het arrest geen gevolgen aan een mogelijke schending op stelselniveau en laat de aanslagen in stand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Fiscaal verdrag drijft Amerikanen in Nederland tot wanhoop’

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the US FATCA tax treaty is driving Americans living in the Netherlands to despair, including missing US TIN/SSN numbers and possible bank account closures. The State Secretary answered that he raised the issue with US authorities, that no extension of the transition period is expected, that significant non-compliance sanctions are a last resort, and that he is coordinating with France and other EU partners.
The size of this group as of 1 June 2019 is not known to me.
De omvang van deze groep op 1 juni 2019 is mij niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Lodders en Rutte Arno over het bericht ‘Bijkleuren van tonijn brengt risico voor de volksgezondheid met zich mee’ en de uitzending van het televisieprogramma Kassa

Two VVD MPs asked whether coloring of yellowfin tuna is banned, how it can be detected, and whether histamine risks are being controlled. The Minister of Medical Care confirmed that tuna coloring is prohibited under EU additive and food safety law, described NVWA inspections and sampling plans, and reported low histamine incident numbers.
The NVWA carries out checks on compliance with additives legislation through inspections.
De NVWA voert controles uit op de naleving van de additievenwetgeving door middel van inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins en Lodders over de doorrekeningen van de subsidie op elektrische auto’s

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins and Lodders asked why PBL's expert reviewers of the Klimaatakkoord analysis could not see the mobility and electricity background documents, why the Revnext calculations were not shared sooner, and how national costs per tonne of CO2 saved differ from the government-perspective costs used by the Algemene Rekenkamer. The state secretary answered that PBL published all background documents after the reviews, that the government will send Revnext calculations and later its own positioning analyses once the Klimaatakkoord is final, and that national costs for electric driving are roughly zero by 2030 while transfers like subsidies are excluded.
It is desirable that background documents become available as soon as possible.
Het is wenselijk dat achtergronddocumenten zo snel mogelijk beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over berichtgeving dat de Belastingtelefoon vanaf 27 mei tot sowieso 3 juni (en misschien wel langer) slecht tot niet bereikbaar was

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone was poorly or not reachable from 27 May into June 2019, including questions on waiting times, dropped calls, outage notices, complaints and a changed business portal. The State Secretary answered that the low-availability days were post-holiday peaks rather than outages, explained the closed-message and call-dropping practices, and provided monthly tables on availability, waiting times, satisfaction and complaints, while stating that outage reporting is targeted at affected users.
Friday 31 May, the day after Ascension, was not a working day for nearly the entire Tax Authority and therefore also not for the Tax Phone.
Vrijdag 31 mei, de dag na Hemelvaart, was geen werkdag voor nagenoeg de hele Belastingdienst en daarmee ook niet voor de Belastingtelefoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Lodders over haar bewering dat gebonden hulp verleden tijd is

MPs Van Haga and Lodders asked the minister about her claim that tied aid is a thing of the past, including notification obligations, transaction-level data on tied aid notifications, and ODA tied/untied breakdowns. The minister confirmed the claim, explained OECD notification rules, withheld transaction-level notification data as confidential under the Arrangement but offered aggregated figures, and stated the government supports untied aid while still promoting Dutch firms where they have a comparative advantage.
However, I offer you non-traceable, aggregated data regarding questions 3d and 3e, which gives an impression of the scale of this trade-related tied aid.
Wel bied ik u met betrekking tot de vragen 3d en 3e niet herleidbare, geaggregeerde data aan, waarmee een beeld ontstaat van de omvang van deze handelsgerelateerde gebonden hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over starre mestprocedure die leidt tot extra kosten

An MP asks the minister about the rigid manure sampling procedure for solid manure, which the MP says imposes extra costs and delays on farmers, and questions whether the rules are simple and efficient. The minister replies that the February 2019 change relaxed the notification deadline from 13:00 to 15:00 and that the independent sampling rules are necessary to combat manure fraud, while refusing to shorten processing times at the cost of sampling quality.

In my considerations I also took into account that the independent sampling organisations must be able to carry out their work carefully and independently, and that the NVWA must be able to exercise adequate supervision.

Ik heb in mijn overwegingen ook meegenomen dat de onafhankelijke monsternemende organisaties hun werk zorgvuldig en op een onafhankelijke wijze moeten kunnen uitvoeren en dat de NVWA in staat moet zijn adequaat toezicht uit te kunnen oefenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over artikel 13a in het ‘Besluit ter voorkoming van dubbele belasting’ (2001) en andere belastingverdragen

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about article 13a of the 2001 double taxation decree, whether it still fits modern international traffic, and whether international truck drivers should be covered, plus the position of Dutch workers facing double taxation. The State Secretary answered that the article follows OECD practice limited to sea and air crew, that truck drivers fall under general allocation rules, that no change is planned, but that the mandate holders will seek a prompt consultation with Norway on long-delayed cases.
I therefore undertake that the mandated handlers of these files will work to hold consultations with their Norwegian colleagues in the short term.
Ik zeg daarom toe dat de gemandateerde behandelaars van deze dossiers zich zullen inzetten om op korte termijn met hun Noorse collega’s een overleg te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Hier heeft Bram geen toekomst’

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the rising number of Dutch farmers emigrating, the reasons behind it, and regulatory burden and cost pressures in farming. The minister replied that CBS figures show at least 100 farmers emigrated in 2010–2015 and 5 in 2016, that the true number is likely higher, and that she is working on farm finances, succession support and regulatory relief while noting that exact causes are hard to establish.
Exact and reliable data on emigrating farmers (families) are not easy to establish.
Exacte en betrouwbare gegevens over emigrerende boeren(gezinnen) zijn niet eenvoudig vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Koerhuis en Lodders over het  bericht ‘Leidse  steuntrekker mag  kamer verhuren aan student om bij te verdienen’

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Leiden plan to let welfare recipients sublet rooms and keep part of the income was lawful, and what the government would do. The government answered that the plan contravened the Participatiewet, that it was a serious shortcoming in lawful implementation, and that Leiden withdrew the pilot after contact with the ministry, so no formal sanction was needed.

Given its scale (both the target group and the monthly amount to be exempted) and its possible spillover effect, implementing the plan would in my view lead to a serious shortcoming in the lawful implementation of the law.

Gelet op de omvang daarvan (zowel qua doelgroep als het vrij te laten maandbedrag) en het mogelijke uitstralingseffect, zou de uitvoering van het plan naar mijn mening leiden tot een ernstige tekortkoming in de rechtmatige uitvoering van de wet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten ‘Honderden producten onterecht verkocht als biologisch’ en ‘5 vragen over fouten met biologische producten’

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that organic products were wrongly sold as organic, questioning SKAL's proportionality stance on violations, consumer information, sanctions, SKAL's tariff increase, its evaluation, NVWA enforcement and retail responsibility. The minister answers that proportionality applies, that SKAL is tightening its sanctions and transparency, that the evaluation remains broadly positive, and that enforcement does not distinguish organic from conventional farming.
I have asked Skal to draw up an action plan for this and to inform me about it.
Ik heb Skal gevraagd hiertoe een plan van aanpak op te stellen en mij hierover te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Lodders over volkscultuur die door de Belastingdienst ongelijk wordt behandeld, als niet cultuur wordt erkend en zodoende geen gebruik kan maken van het gunstige lage btw-tarief

Two VVD MPs asked whether folk culture (parades, carnival associations, shooting guilds) is treated unequally by the Tax Authority, which allegedly does not recognise it as culture and so excludes it from the reduced 9% VAT rate. The State Secretary answers that the VAT rate depends on a closed list in Tabel I of the Wet OB, not on recognition of culture, so there is no unequal treatment and folk culture can qualify where it meets the listed activities.
As the enumeration of these items shows, there is no distinction by type of culture in applying the reduced rate.
Zoals uit de opsomming van deze posten blijkt, bestaat er bij de toepassing van het verlaagde tarief geen onderscheid in het soort cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over de gevolgen van Braziliaans landbouwbeleid voor Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture and trade ministers about the effects of Brazil's farm policy under Bolsonaro, including deforestation, approval of 120 chemicals banned in the EU, residue controls on Brazilian imports, and the Dutch sugar beet seed derogation. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the Netherlands is raising them with Brazil and at EU level, noted that residue monitoring shows no reason for extra controls, and defended the refusal of a neonicotinoid derogation while confirming a temporary alternative pesticide exemption.
The Netherlands is intensifying dialogue with the Brazilian government on agriculture and climate, to convey our concerns on the one hand
Nederland is de dialoog met de Braziliaanse overheid op het gebied van landbouw en klimaat aan het intensiveren, om aan de ene kant onze zorgen over te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht ‘Familie in rouw na drama in stal: dertien koeien komen om in eigen mest na explosie’

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked the minister about a barn explosion in Markelo that killed thirteen cows, whether investigations were ordered, and whether emission-free floors and new stall systems are assessed for safety. The minister answered that no direct ignition cause was found by the fire service and insurer, that an Omgevingsdienst Twente investigation is pending and will be shared, and that safety is part of stall assessment though no evidence shows emission-free floors are unsafe.
The investigation by the Omgevingsdienst Twente is expected to become publicly available. I will send this to you as soon as it is completed.
Het onderzoek van de Omgevingsdienst Twente zal naar verwachting openbaar beschikbaar komen. Dit zal ik u toezenden zodra dit gereed is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht 'Kwart miljoen boetes voor 1 km/u te hard: 'Dit riekt naar spekken staatskas'

VVD MPs asked the government whether fining drivers for speeding just 1 km/h over is justified, given that administration costs (9 euro) nearly equal the fine, and raised questions about the 130 km/h lower tolerance, foreign offenders and camera-based enforcement. The Justice Minister defended enforcement of small speeding offences for road safety, explained the cost breakdown and the abolition of the lower tolerance on 130 km/h roads, and reported on cross-border enforcement and the start of camera use by the tax authority.
Traffic enforcement exists to promote compliance with traffic rules and thereby safeguard road safety.
Verkeershandhaving is er om de naleving van de verkeersregels te bevorderen en daarmee de verkeersveiligheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Koerhuis over het bericht ‘Verplicht sparen voor onderhoud appartement’

MPs Lodders and Koerhuis asked whether VvE mandatory maintenance savings held in reserve funds should be taxed in box 3 and whether this creates unequal treatment and double taxation. The minister answered that the reserve is a taxable property right under Supreme Court case law, that there is no unequal treatment, and that no additional exemption or new measures are planned beyond reviewing the eigenwoningrente ruling.
The cabinet sees no injustice in this.
Het kabinet ziet hier geen onrechtvaardigheid in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Europa pakt Oekraïense kippenvleesexport aan’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that the EU was tackling Ukrainian chicken meat exports, including how a quota increase from 20,000 to 70,000 tonnes fits with the removal of duties on chicken parts and whether a provisional application of the Association Agreement amendment should proceed before European Parliament consent. The minister explained that Ukrainian exporters exploited an unforeseen tariff loophole, that renegotiation is underway and requires Council and European Parliament approval, and that the government will assess the Commission's proposal and raise concerns about the quota and SPS/animal welfare implementation.
In anticipation, the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality sent a letter on 25 April 2019 to Commissioner Hogan expressing concerns about the provisional outcome of the negotiations.

Vooruitlopend hierop heeft de Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit op 25 april 2019 een brief aan Commissaris Hogan gestuurd waarin zorgen worden geuit over de voorlopige uitkomst van de onderhandelingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat de bezwaarschriften box 3 inkomstenbelasting 2018 wordt aangewezen als massaal bezwaar

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the mass objection procedure for box 3 wealth tax 2018, including objection numbers since 2013, the rule requiring individual timely objections, and whether taxpayers can still raise individual circumstances after the collective legal question is decided. The State Secretary gave numbered answers: most objections were admissible, the timeliness requirement aims at equal treatment, communication efforts were made, and individual circumstances can generally not be deferred under the Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht.

Do you consider the change to the mass objection procedures, whereby taxpayers must now object individually and on time to their income tax assessment, a restriction of the rights of individual taxpayers?

Vindt u de wetswijziging in de massale bezwaarprocedures, waardoor belastingplichtigen nu wel individueel en tijdig bezwaar moeten maken tegen hun aanslag inkomstenbelasting, een inperking van de rechten van individuele belastingplichtigen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over standpuntbepaling in het Europees Parlement over een hoger toegestaan restgehalte van neonicotinoïden

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Commission's proposal to raise maximum residue limits for several pesticides, including clothianidin, and about Dutch support, the fate of Cruiser SB exemption, and residue controls. The minister answered that the Netherlands supported the proposal based on EFSA safety assessments, explained that bee protection drove the neonicotinoid restrictions, declined to give a country-specific view, and pointed to EFSA reports for residue control data.
I cannot make statements about the situations and considerations of non-EU countries.
Over de situaties en overwegingen van niet-EU landen kan ik geen uitspaken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst eist tienduizenden euro’s van matrozen’

The MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance how the Tax Authority checks whether foreign-employer Rhine boatmen work mainly in the Netherlands, whether Dutch-resident crew were informed of the 2010 rule change, and why they must now pay social premiums twice. The government answers that Dutch social insurance applied to these boatmen since 2010, that individual letters were sent on request, that it regrets the hardship, and that it will raise the matter with Luxembourg and the SVB's regularisation procedure may offer relief in exceptional cases.
It is regrettable that the employers of Rhine boatmen nevertheless continued withholding premiums in Luxembourg.
Het is te betreuren dat de werkgevers van rijnvarenden desondanks inhouding van premies in Luxemburg hebben voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent, Van den Bosch en Lodders over de afgelopen provinciale statenverkiezingen

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Interior Affairs who pays for recounts of votes in provincial elections, whether municipalities are funded for this, and whether electronic vote counting could reduce recount costs and frequency. The minister answered that municipalities organise elections and recounts are part of that task funded via the municipal fund, and that electronic counting would require a new ballot paper being tested first, without clearly reducing recount risk in the Flevoland case.
Carrying out any recount (and therefore also its funding) is part of organising the election.
Het uitvoeren van een eventuele hertelling (en dus ook de bekostiging daarvan) is onderdeel van de organisatie van de verkiezing.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van der Linde en Koerhuis over de brief van de Ombudsman aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het opnieuw aandacht vragen voor de korte aanvraagtermi

VVD MPs asked why the Dutch Ombudsman's concerns about low awareness of the 'special situations' rent/benefit scheme and its six-week application deadline were not addressed, and what the government would change. The State Secretary answered that the Belastingdienst had expanded website information and would raise awareness via intermediaries, that the six-week term is set in regulation and sufficient in practice, and that changes await an IBO review due end 2019, while declining a coulance scheme.
From an implementation perspective, the six-week term is sufficient.
Vanuit de uitvoering gezien is de zeswekentermijn voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de tariefsverhoging van 35% door Skal Biocontrole

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture about a 35% fee increase by the private inspection body Skal Biocontrole, its oversight, staffing and whether more certifiers should be accredited. The Minister confirms she approved the increase as necessary for growth in the sector, calls it likely one-off, says she is negotiating a moderate fee policy with Skal, and defends the current single-certifier system.
I did not, however, want to withhold my approval of the level of this part of the fees.
Ik heb mijn goedkeuring aan de hoogte van dit onderdeel van de tarieven echter niet willen onthouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over de rapportage gezamenlijk meetnet gewasbeschermingsmiddelen in het gebied van het Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta

Two VVD MPs asked the government about pesticide exceedances at Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta, including permethrin and imidacloprid in consumer products, and about the overall pesticide policy approach. The minister answered that consumer use is hard to link directly to exceedances, that policy addresses both professional and non-professional use, and that the government will send further data such as the RIVM sales analysis before the summer recess.
Sales figures for biocide products for consumers are not available at the Ministry of IenW.
De verkoopcijfers van biocideproducten voor consumenten zijn niet voorhanden bij het Ministerie van IenW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Lodders over het bericht dat journalisten aangifte moeten doen

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether journalists threatened in Flevoland can easily file criminal complaints, and whether police could refuse to record threats as too hard to prove. The minister condemned threats against journalists, said a complaint must always be possible, outlined an action plan with police and prosecutors, and noted a new reporting point and tougher sentencing guideline.
A journalist, or anyone else, who wishes to file a complaint about a criminal offence must have the opportunity to do so in all cases.
Een journalist, of ieder ander, die aangifte wil doen van een strafbaar feit, moet daar in alle gevallen de mogelijkheid toe hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Omtzigt over het verkopen van bespaarde CO2-rechten door autofabrikant Tesla aan Fiat-Chrysler

MPs Lodders, Ziengs and Omtzigt asked whether the EU-permitted pooling of CO2 emission credits between Tesla and Fiat-Chrysler, which may help Fiat-Chrysler avoid EU fines, is acceptable and whether it will persist under the 95 g/km rules, and how much the national EV stimulus would actually reduce EU-wide emissions given possible waterbed effects. The State Secretary answered that pooling has been allowed since 2007, that the pool average must still meet the EU norm, that the government prefers each manufacturer to meet the norm alone, and that the national EV measures yield about 2.4 Mton additional reduction, with the waterbed effect considered small given Netherlands' roughly 3% share of the EU fleet.
The cabinet is not aware of the exact amount involved between certain manufacturers in this arrangement.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van het exacte bedrag dat tussen bepaalde fabrikanten hiermee is gemoeid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Vaststelling WOZ door gemeenten rammelt’

MPs Lodders and Van den Bosch asked about a report that 17 municipalities scored insufficiently on WOZ property valuation, and about oversight, sanctions, and the Waarderingskamer's role. The State Secretary replied that low-scoring municipalities are placed under intensified supervision with agreed improvement deadlines, that the Waarderingskamer approved publication of WOZ values for all municipalities, and that the government sees the supervisory framework as adequate.
Municipalities that score insufficiently are placed under intensified supervision and must achieve agreed improvements within a set period.
Gemeenten die een onvoldoende scoren worden onder verscherpt toezicht geplaatst en dienen binnen een bepaalde termijn afgesproken verbeteringen te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Ziengs en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Planbureau rommelt’

VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the PBL environmental agency's published claims about meat, climate and nitrogen emissions were accurate, and whether policy had been based on flawed PBL data. The government answered that PBL's independence and quality are safeguarded, that the 25-40% reduction concerns agriculture-related emissions only, and that it knows of no cases where policy was based on incorrect PBL data.
In my view, the above sufficiently safeguards independence and quality now and in the future.
Het bovenstaande waarborgt in mijn ogen nu en in de toekomst voldoende de onafhankelijkheid en kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het loket agroloket@minez.nl

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Agriculture about the Agroloket, a channel for farmers and businesses to report unnecessary regulatory burdens, including its visibility, the handling of reports and the lack of overview of cases. The minister answered that the loket has received few reports, that case handling times vary, and that the website and reporting overview were changed, but did not provide a full overview of reports and their outcomes.
With the current set-up of this portal it is not possible to include an overview of the submissions.
Bij de huidige opzet van dit loket is het niet mogelijk om een overzicht van de inzendingen op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het bericht ‘Mestoverschot berekend met verouderde cijfers’

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked whether Dutch manure policy relies on outdated excretion standards that disadvantage dairy farmers, and why they have not been updated. The minister answered that the forfaits were deliberately not revised for now to avoid exceeding the sectoral phosphate and nitrogen ceilings, with a CDM advisory opinion awaited before a decision for 1 January 2020.
As also reported earlier in the General Consultation of 13 December, I have therefore chosen not to revise the forfaits for the time being.
Zoals ook eerder gemeld in het Algemeen Overleg van 13 december jl., heb ik er daarom voor gekozen de forfaits vooralsnog niet te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Koeiengriep vastgesteld in Duitse grensstreek'

MP Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture about a reported IBR (bovine herpes, 'cow flu') outbreak on three German farms near the Dutch border and whether Dutch farms, vets and municipalities were warned. The minister answered that Germany is officially IBR-free, the risk of spread is very small, IBR is not yet notifiable in the Netherlands so the government has no communication role, and an AMvB is being prepared.
There has therefore been no communication from the government about the IBR outbreaks in Germany.
Er is vanuit de overheid dan ook geen communicatie geweest over de IBR-uitbraken in Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'EBRD overweegt opnieuw miljoenenlening MHP'

Two VVD MPs asked whether the EBRD's proposed EUR 100 million loan to Ukrainian poultry producer MHP for acquiring a Slovenian poultry integrator raises concerns about unfair competition, state aid and lower production standards, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that the loan is not state aid, that EBRD rules require additionality, that the Netherlands abstained and objected to earlier MHP loans on environmental and animal welfare grounds, and that the EU is seeking to curb duty-free poultry imports from Ukraine through the Association Agreement.
Because it concerns an acquisition, the EBRD is bound by rules on handling market-sensitive information.
Omdat het een overname betreft is de EBRD gebonden aan regels ten aanzien van de omgang met marktgevoelige informatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het bericht ‘Reactie PBL op gebruik NEV-cijfers en modellen’

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether ministries and the PBL can inspect and run the private Carbontax model, whether it has been externally validated, and what the government has spent on it. The government answered that ministries and PBL have only general knowledge of the model, that it is owned by Revnext and cannot be made public, that it is the only suitable model for the analysis, and it offered a technical briefing while listing the commissioned studies and costs.
The CARbontax model is not owned by the state but is intellectual property of Revnext, therefore it is not for the state to make it public.
Het CARbontax-model is geen eigendom van het Rijk maar is intellectueel eigendom van Revnext, daarom is het niet aan het Rijk om het openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over uitstaande belastingschuld

Two MPs (Omtzigt, Lodders) asked how much tax debt in arrears the Belastingdienst held from 2016 onward, split by collection segment, and asked for answers before a debate. The State Secretary provided the arrears figures, explained that growth partly reflects dynamic monitoring of hard-to-collect claims and a lower write-off rate, and noted that the figures differ from earlier reports due to a new information system.
I have answered these questions as far as possible in my letter of 20 February.
Ik heb deze vragen voor zover mogelijk beantwoord in mijn brief van 20 februari jongstleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Van Weyenberg en Slootweg over de uitwerking FATCA voor Nederlandse burgers en signalen dat bankrekeningen geblokkeerd gaan worden

MPs from VVD, D66 and CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance about FATCA's effects on Dutch citizens with US ties, including banks threatening to block accounts without a US TIN/SSN. The State Secretary answered that banks may refuse or end services but must still offer basic payment accounts, that the number of affected people cannot be confirmed, and that the government is engaging US authorities on the SSN procedure and extending the transitional arrangement.
I assume the "white list" refers to banks that qualify as Participating FIs under FATCA.
Ik ga ervan uit dat met de «witte lijst» de banken worden bedoeld die kwalificeren als deelnemende bank (Participating FI) op grond van FATCA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over het bericht ‘Klokkenluiders kunnen bij misstanden aanbestedingen nergens terecht’

Two VVD MPs asked whether whistleblowers can report misconduct in public procurement, since the competition authority ACM can only act against firms under the cartel ban and not against government bodies or state companies. The state secretary answered that ACM can act against state companies acting as undertakings, that internal checks, the Huis voor Klokkenluiders and the FIOD/OM are the available routes, that no change to the rules is needed, and that research on legal protection in procurement is ongoing with results to parliament before summer.
I am of the view that it is not necessary to expand the current possibilities.
Ik ben van mening dat het niet nodig is om de huidige mogelijkheden uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Weyenberg over de advertentie in Arts en Auto: ‘Schenking eigen woning’

MPs Lodders and Van Weyenberg asked the State Secretary of Finance about a newspaper advertisement promoting 'cross gifts' that let parents give a second tax-free gift to their children via reciprocal arrangements, and whether this is legitimate and how it is enforced. The State Secretary answered that such cross gifts are unwanted and contrary to the letter and spirit of the Successiewet, that the Tax Authority will treat them as gifts from the parent and enforce against misuse, and that no amendment is planned.

I consider the use of cross gifts to obtain the increased gift tax exemption for the owner-occupied home a second time undesirable, and applying the exemption in such a case contrary to the letter and spirit of the Successiewet 1956.

Ik acht het gebruik van kruislingse schenkingen ten einde de verhoogde vrijstelling schenkbelasting voor de eigen woning voor een tweede maal te verkrijgen ongewenst en de toepassing van de vrijstelling in een dergelijk geval in strijd met de letter en geest van de Successiewet 1956.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Von Martels over de problematische situatie in de suikerbietenteelt na het wegvallen van het gebruik van neonicotinoïden

Two MPs asked the minister about the problems facing sugar beet cultivation after the EU restrictions on neonicotinoids, including delays in consultation, the handling of the Cruiser SB exemption request, and the environmental impact of alternatives. The minister answered that the restrictions were supported for bee risks, that a temporary exemption was judged unworkable and undesirable, and that long-term issues will be addressed in a crop protection vision.
I have informed your House as soon as possible about my decision.
Ik heb uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd over mijn beslissing.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Omtzigt, Lodders, Bisschop en Van Rooijen over een keurpunt voor levend vee voor de Brexit en de extra capaciteit bij de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs asked whether the minister had led a public-private effort to set up live-animal inspection posts at Dutch seaports before a no-deal Brexit, and about NVWA staffing and preparedness. The minister replied that applications were sent to the European Commission before the 15 February deadline, that exact locations are confidential, that the NVWA has hired 100 of 143 needed staff, and that service levels may have to be adjusted for about a year.
I cannot go into the precise numbers and locations because of the confidentiality of this information.
Op de precieze aantallen en locaties kan ik niet in gaan in verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het afwijzen van de stof pymetrozine door de Europese Commissie

An MP asks why the Netherlands supported the EU non-renewal of the pesticide pymetrozine, whether sector consultation took place, and how IPM systems and parliamentary information will be handled. The minister answers that the Netherlands backed the Commission proposal on the basis of risk assessment (groundwater metabolites, hormone-disrupting properties), that agricultural need is not a criterion, and that the Chamber will now be informed before each SCoPAFF meeting.

To avoid uncertainty about when the Chamber is or is not informed about substances, I have chosen to inform the Chamber before every SCoPAFF meeting about all intended Dutch positions on items where decisions will be taken.

Om onduidelijkheid te voorkomen over wanneer uw Kamer wel of niet over stoffen wordt geïnformeerd, heb ik ervoor gekozen om uw Kamer voorafgaand aan elke SCoPAFF-vergadering te informeren over alle voorgenomen Nederlandse standpunten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de overschrijdingen van begroting voor de kosten van elektrische voertuigen

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether the 141 million euro estimate for the EV bijtelling discount in Miljoenennota 2019 and the Startnota benchmark rule were breached, and what the substantial endogenous development rule implies. The Staatssecretaris acknowledges EV sales exceeded expectations, puts the 2018 cost near 200 million (about 40% above the estimate), states the 2017 benchmark is 86 million, says no specific trigger moment is fixed, and commits only to monitoring and a new estimate in Miljoenennota 2020.
For now the cabinet sees no need to adjust further in the short term, but considers it important to keep a close watch to detect signals of overstimulation in time.
Het kabinet ziet vooralsnog geen noodzaak om op korte termijn verder bij te sturen, maar acht het wel van belang om een vinger aan de pols te houden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Laan-Geselschap over het bericht: “Konijnenfokkers bedreigd: Ik ben bang voor een kogel door mijn raam”

MPs Lodders and Laan-Geselschap asked about threats against rabbit farmers, inspection and offence figures, and police and government protection measures. The minister condemns all threats, reports that 15 of 45 inspections found violations (none classed as serious), and says the police do not register victims by occupation, so no figures on reports or convictions are available.
The police do not register victims by their profession and therefore have no figures available on this.
De politie registreert niet specifiek op het beroep van slachtoffers en heeft hierover dan ook geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Douane laat controles risicovluchten schieten door hoge werkdruk'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that customs at Schiphol skip checks on risk flights due to high workload, and about staffing shortages, a union workload survey, ICT problems, sick leave and Brexit recruitment. The State Secretary largely confirmed high workload and understaffing at Schiphol, explained that risk-based choices sometimes mean planned checks are skipped, stated that the 100% control regime on flights from designated origins continues in 2019, and gave staffing, recruitment and sick-leave figures.
It has been agreed with JenV that the 100% control regime for drug enforcement on the flights designated by JenV will also be carried out in 2019.
Met JenV is afgesproken dat het 100%-controleregime in het kader van de drugsbestrijding op de door JenV aangewezen vluchten, ook in 2019 uitgevoerd zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Lodders over de stijging van de woonlasten

Two VVD MPs asked whether rising local housing costs (lokale lasten) in many municipalities, including large increases in Amsterdam, are acceptable and whether the government will act or discuss this with municipalities. The Minister answered that municipalities set local taxes democratically, that a national macronorm only limits total ozb revenues, that the Wet HOF does not restrict local tax increases, and that no further measures or talks with municipalities are planned.
For a picture of the other municipalities, one will have to wait for the 2019 edition of the COELO atlas of local taxes to appear.
Voor een beeld van de andere gemeenten zal gewacht moeten worden op het verschijnen van de 2019 editie van de COELO atlas van de lokale lasten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Van den Bosch en Lodders over het bericht 'Bestuurslid luidt noodklok: 'Waterschap Rivierenland heeft straks een half miljard schuld'

MPs of the VVD asked the government about a report that water board Rivierenland faces a debt of half a billion euros, asking how financial positions of water boards are monitored, whether rising dike-reinforcement costs and interest rates threaten investment plans, and whether water boards keep to their core tasks. The Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management answered that each water board is responsible for its own finances under oversight by its general board and the provinces (including the Wet FIDO interest-risk norm), that the cost trends are not yet a established trend and are being monitored, that dike safety planning is not in jeopardy, and that water boards' core tasks are legally limited with provinces supervising them.
Each water board is itself responsible for its own financial position.
Ieder waterschap is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de eigen financiële positie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het rendement in box 3

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's position in Box 3 litigation that AEX main shares and real estate are stable low-risk investments, the AFM's risk classification, a return-based Box 3 system, and EU comparisons of savings taxation. The State Secretary defended the Tax Authority's argument as conditional, said no AFM fund fits the low-risk description, admitted the promised spring 2018 letter on actual-return taxation is delayed, and provided OECD-based comparative tables, answering each question separately but late.
A system of wealth return tax based on actual return has far-reaching consequences for, among other things, citizens' administrative burden, the risk of tax avoidance and feasibility.

Een stelsel van vermogensrendementsheffing op basis van werkelijk rendement heeft verregaande consequenties voor onder andere de administratieve lasten van burgers, risico's op belastingontwijking en de uitvoerbaarheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over het model CARbonTAX dat gebruikt is om de verkopen van elektrische auto’s te voorspellen en welke er in 2018 meer dan 100% naast zat bij de schatting van de verkoop

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the CARbonTAX model underpredicted electric car sales in 2018 by more than 100%, and whether the model is validated and still used. The State Secretary answered that the model was built for Autobrief II, that EV sales were underestimated due to market dynamics and the early scrapping of the PHEV bijtelling discount, that the model is not public, and that its parameters were recently revalidated by PBL and TNO.
Because the Carbontax model is not public, it is not possible to send the model to your House.
Omdat het Carbontax-model niet openbaar is, is het niet mogelijk om het model aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichten ‘Paardenstallen getroffen door uitbraak zeer besmettelijk griepvirus influenza’ en ‘Openheid van zaken over influenza uitbraak in Limburg’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about reports of an influenza outbreak among horses in Limburg, including vaccination rates, communication and differences between Dutch and international vaccination schemes. The minister answered that influenza in horses is not notifiable, so no complete picture exists, that stakeholders communicate actively, and that vaccination remains voluntary except where sport or breeding organisations require it.
A very precise picture of the occurrence of influenza in horses does not exist, since it is not a notifiable disease and there is no monitoring programme.
Een heel nauwkeurig beeld over het voorkomen van influenza bij paarden is er niet aangezien het geen aangifteplichtige ziekte is en er geen monitoringsprogramma is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Gaat de Belastingdienst te ver in data-speurtocht?'

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Authority goes too far in data-gathering, including data security, privacy limits, use of Museumkaart user data, and the cost-effectiveness of the extra funding against hidden wealth. The State Secretary answers all eight questions, stating that no system can guarantee full data security, that privacy intrusions are allowed by law and assessed case by case, and that results from the hidden-wealth programme cannot be fully quantified.

When choosing to request information from new information sources, the Tax Authority weighs the interests of the Tax Authority or inspector against those of the taxpayer, applying privacy-law criteria such as purpose limitation, necessity, proportionality and subsidiarity.

De Belastingdienst hanteert bij het maken van de keuze tot het opvragen van informatie bij nieuwe informatiebronnen, een afweging tussen de belangen van de Belastingdienst c.q. de inspecteur en de belangen van de belastingplichtige, de criteria die volgen uit het privacyrecht, zoals doelbinding, noodzaak en de beginselen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de aanpassing van de Uitvoeringsregeling en het Uitvoeringsbesluit Meststoffenwet

An MP asked the minister about the January 2019 amendments to the fertiliser implementing regulations, their consistency with circular agriculture and CO2 goals, and the treatment of liquid plant-based digestate versus compost. The minister answered that the changes implement the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme, that compost must now be non-pumpable, and that plant-based digestate will be reviewed in the upcoming EU fertiliser regulation framework.
I want to examine whether the new framework of the EU Fertiliser Regulation also offers possibilities for the Fertiliser Act.
Ik wil bezien of het nieuwe kader van de Meststoffenverordening ook mogelijkheden biedt voor de Meststoffenwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Weverling over de voorbereiding op de brexit door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

MPs Lodders and Weverling asked the minister about the NVWA's Brexit preparations, including external reviews, inspection locations, staffing, IT readiness and coordination with other inspection bodies. The minister answered that preparations are on schedule, with a worst-case plan requiring 143 FTE, ongoing recruitment and training, and some locations and IT readiness still being addressed.
The NVWA saw no reason to commission such an external study.
De NVWA zag geen aanleiding om een dergelijk extern onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over problemen bij de aanmelding voor derogatie

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about technical problems with registering for the 2019 derogation, whether affected businesses could still register after 31 January, and why fees could not be paid by automatic direct debit. The minister said the software problems were resolved, that the deadline stays at 31 January except that late applicants who show they were blocked will still be processed, and that payment by iDEAL or invoice was chosen over direct debit for security reasons.
If an entrepreneur can nevertheless demonstrate that he could not gain access and was therefore not helped in time, RVO.nl will also process his notification after 31 January.
Mocht een ondernemer desondanks kunnen aantonen dat hij geen toegang kon krijgen waardoor hij niet tijdig is geholpen, zal RVO.nl zijn melding ook na 31 januari in behandeling nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de aangifte omzetbelasting (btw)

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about VAT return deadlines, payment and refund timelines, penalties for late payment by taxpayers and by the tax authority, correction returns, audit timelines, and interest on late refunds. The State Secretary answered in detail on statutory deadlines (typically eight weeks for refund decisions), penalties, and interest rules, but declined to provide statistics on late refunds or complaints and did not address the specific case substantively.
Figures on how often the Tax Authority repays late are not available.
Cijfers over hoe vaak de Belastingdienst te laat terugbetaalt zijn niet beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de merkwaardige bewering van de Belastingdienst bij de Hoge Raad dat hoofdfondsen en onroerende zaken een stabiele beleggingsvorm vormen met weinig risico’s

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the tax authority told the Supreme Court that main-share funds and real estate are stable, low-risk investments, and whether that matches AFM supervision and government policy. The State Secretary answered that the remark was incidental, that the 4% return test does not depend on the risk level of assets, that the AFM does not treat such investments as risk-free, and that a real-return box 3 system is being examined alongside other tax reform work.
It is now up to the Advocate-General to give her opinion in a conclusion on the question put before the Supreme Court.
Het is nu aan de Advocaat-Generaal om in een conclusie haar mening te geven over de kwestie die aan de Hoge Raad is voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de verplichte rijenbemesting vanaf 2021 en de aangepaste teeltmaatregelen voor 2019 die voortvloeien uit het zesde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

An MP asked the minister whether revised cultivation measures for maize on sandy and loess soils under the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme had been adequately communicated to farmers, given a survey where 40% of growers were unaware. The minister replied that communication runs via RVO.nl, sector consultation and internet consultation, that the list of catch and follow-on crops will be published before year-end, and that further communication will be intensified.
RVO.nl has received few questions about this.
RVO.nl heeft hierover weinig vragen ontvangen.
