Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked how innovators outside livestock farming can get new ammonia-reducing stall systems onto the Rav list, and about procedures, cooperation with other countries, TAP composition and the motion on testing barriers. The government explained quick scans, a maximum 20-week assessment, VERA cooperation, and that it is mapping barriers and will inform the Chamber early next year.
I will inform the Chamber early next year about the steps I will take to remove these barriers as much as possible.
Ik zal de Kamer begin volgend jaar informeren over de stappen die ik zal zetten om deze belemmeringen zo veel mogelijk weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Nieuwe belasting op attracties voor dagjesmensen’

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about Amsterdam's plan for a new levy on attractions aimed at day-trippers, and the limits central government sets on municipal tax autonomy. Minister Ollongren answered that municipalities can set tourist and recreation levies autonomously within legal limits, that the effects on businesses and subsidised institutions are not yet known, and that the Amsterdam alderman will first consult residents.
At this stage there is insufficient knowledge of the measure Amsterdam wishes to introduce to say anything about its potential effects on entrepreneurs or their turnover.
In dit stadium is onvoldoende bekend over de door de gemeente Amsterdam gewenste maatregel om iets te kunnen zeggen over de potentiële effecten ervan op ondernemers of hun omzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Arno Rutte over een levensgevaarlijk chloormiddel dat nog steeds te koop is

MPs Lodders and Rutte asked why the NVWA did not intervene against MMS chlorine products between 2010 and 2016, why warnings from the US and Canada were not reflected, and about the pace of the risk assessment, enforcement and inspection. Minister Bruins answered that enforcement was risk-prioritised and carried out under successive laws, explained the timeline of the risk assessment and inspections, and declined to commit to half-yearly reporting on inspection trajectories.
I am therefore not in favour of informing your House about this every half year.
Ik ben er daarom geen voorstander van om uw Kamer halfjaarlijks hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Weer ongeluk met gevaarlijk Multiplay-springkussen’

An MP from the VVD asks the Ministers of Medical Care and of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a reported accident with a Multiplay bouncy castle and about NVWA oversight of suppliers, certification bodies (AKI) and sales information. The minister answers that the NVWA sent letters to suppliers, inspected and tested certificates, withdrew the Piraat model, reviewed AKI audits and is handling further incidents, while declining some data requests and saying no additional warning labels are needed.
I cannot provide your House with the data you requested.
De door u gevraagde gegevens kan ik uw Kamer niet leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Beveiliging data fiscus ondermaats’

MPs Lodders and Middendorp asked about press reports that the tax authority cannot technically secure personal data, and about logging, data location, staff training and AVG compliance. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the limitation concerns only logging of data use once extracted to staff workstations in one department, that measures have been taken, and that an Analytical Data Perimeter will be introduced in 2019.
Actions with data in the central data environment of DF&A are logged and monitored.
Handelingen met gegevens in de centrale dataomgeving van DF&A worden wel gelogd en gemonitord.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan, Tielen en Lodders over het bericht ‘Onterecht geld opstrijken; Ouders kunnen zich inschrijven voor studie en, zonder ooit op te dagen, kinderopvangtoeslag ontvangen. Wat

MPs from the VVD asked whether a student enrolment certificate alone is enough to receive childcare allowance, how many households receive it for study, and how enrolment is checked. The government answered that enrolment is one eligibility condition checked by the Tax Authority against Dutch education-agency data, that a certificate alone is not sufficient, and that the check is effective.
A certificate of enrolment alone is therefore not sufficient.
Een bewijs van inschrijving alleen is dus niet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over zorgen uit het land over de subsidieregeling voor pelsdierhouderijen

An MP asks the minister about the status and design of the subsidy scheme for demolishing and converting fur farms, including the start date, budget use, transition period, locational limits and pension support. The minister answers that five applications have been filed, the scheme took effect on 28 February 2018 with tax provisions backdated for EU state-aid reasons, and that the budget of 36 million euro is fully available for the flanking policy, with further consultation with the sector promised for spring 2019.
I will inform your House in spring 2019 about these and other results of the consultation with the sector.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het voorjaar 2019 over deze en overige resultaten van het gevoerde overleg met de sector informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Lodders over het bericht 'Tientallen gemeenten hebben geen goed beeld van WOZ-waarde huizen'

MPs Van den Bosch and Lodders (VVD) asked about news reports that dozens of municipalities have poor WOZ property valuations, including causes, overvaluation corrections, tax consequences, the meaning of Waarderingskamer star ratings, and whether sanctions will follow. Minister Ollongren answered that 95 municipalities received a negative rating at some point, mostly due to data registration and backlog problems, that the regulator decides on sanctions, and that she sees no reason for extra measures now.
The precise number of cases is not known to me or to the Waarderingskamer.
Het precieze aantal gevallen is mij of de Waarderingskamer niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Lodders over de wachttijden voor ondernemers om zich in te schrijven in het handelsregister van de Kamer van Koophandel

Two MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretaries about waiting times of about three weeks for entrepreneurs to register at the Chamber of Commerce, including regional differences, the causes and VAT number delays. The government answered with regional waiting times of 4 to 14 days, measures taken to reduce them, and an explanation of VAT number timing, while stating it does not yet meet its 7-day target everywhere.
The KvK does not meet the target of a maximum waiting time of seven calendar days in all regions.
De KvK voldoet niet in alle regio’s aan de doelstelling van een maximale wachttijd van zeven kalenderdagen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het feit dat zonnepanelen meegenomen worden in de onroerendezaakbelasting

MPs Lodders and Yesilgöz-Zegerius asked whether solar panels, which owners could remove when moving, count toward the WOZ value and property tax, how many owners pay more, and how this fits the government's sustainability goals. The State Secretary confirmed that panels are generally included as fixed parts of the property, estimated the added tax at roughly 5 to 10 euro per year, and said the tax system will be reviewed through the Climate Agreement and the interbestuurlijk programma before a final position is taken.
There is no overview available of how municipalities handle the valuation of solar panels and whether or not they use the exception provision in the Municipalities Act.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van hoe gemeenten omgaan met de waardering van zonnepanelen en of zij al dan niet gebruik maken van de uitzonderingsbepaling in de Gemeentewet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Fiscus blijft falen'

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked about Belastingtelefoon (tax helpline) call-answering failures, unit call numbers, staffing and whether a Q&A or email channel could help. The State Secretary gave detailed monthly figures showing 6-19% of callers not reached within five working days, said callers are not dropped from queues, and outlined 210 FTE extra capacity, but did not give a firm date for restored accessibility and declined email questions for security reasons.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Nijkerken-de Haan over berichten uit het land dat belastinginspecteurs amateurmuziekverenigingen en verbonden steunverenigingen aan een belastinginspectie onderwerpen

MPs Lodders and Nijkerken-de Haan asked whether the tax authority has imposed VAT assessments, some retroactive, on supporter associations of amateur music societies, and on what legal basis. The State Secretary confirmed VAT assessments against two supporter associations and seven support foundations, explained the withdrawn VAT approvals for fundraising bodies and the general VAT exemption limits, and stated that the VAT liability follows from law and cannot be waived, though payment arrangements are possible.
The possible VAT liability, however, follows from the law. It cannot be deviated from.
De eventuele verschuldigdheid van btw vloeit echter voort uit de wet. Daar kan niet van worden afgeweken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht 'Trekkerrijbewijs zorgt voor uitsluiten buitenlandse stagiaires'

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about the T-licence rule that reportedly excludes foreign interns from driving agricultural tractors on public roads. The minister confirmed the rule, explained the grandfathering for licences issued before 1 July 2015, and said interns can still operate tractors on private land and the rule is non-discriminatory and justified by road safety.
The requirement is non-discriminatory and applies to everyone, regardless of nationality.
De eis is non-discriminatoir en geldt voor iedereen, ongeacht nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over twee zwaargewonden kinderen na val onveilig speeltoestel

An MP asked the Ministers of Agriculture and of Medical Care about dangerous Multiplay bouncy castles after two children were seriously injured, including whether the NVWA should have acted sooner and why certificates were not checked. The minister acknowledged a non-valid certificate led to one model being taken out of use, stated the NVWA inspects only a small share of locations, and promised further steps on the procedure for placing bouncy castles on the market.
The NVWA has no information that shows whether the correct certificates and logbooks are present for all play equipment.
De NVWA heeft geen informatie waarbij inzichtelijk gemaakt kan worden of bij alle speeltoestellen de correcte certificaten en logboeken aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘ministerie dendert door met vliegtaks’

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers why the ministry is pushing ahead with an aviation tax, how it fits the three-track policy, and how the EU, sector and other countries are involved. The government answers that it is pursuing all three tracks in parallel, that a national aviation tax may be introduced from 2021 if the European and emissions/noise routes yield too little, and that consultation, bilateral contacts and a Brussels coordination effort are underway.
The cabinet will make a choice this autumn on which variant can be worked out in national legislation
Het kabinet maakt dit najaar een keuze welke variant in nationale wetgeving kan worden uitgewerkt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Weverling over de uitzending ‘De bijenredders’

MPs Lodders and Weverling asked the minister about a Brandpunt+ broadcast on varroa mite control and a project to introduce varroa-resistant bees, and whether the National Bee Strategy and Bee Health Action Programme address it. The minister answered that the varroa mite is an important cause of winter bee mortality, welcomed the Arista Bee Research initiative, said it has joined the National Bee Strategy, and described existing knowledge-development and monitoring measures.
I will continue the policy aimed at reducing bee mortality among honeybees, developing more resilient (varroa-resistant) honeybees and optimising beekeeping practice.

Ik zal het beleid gericht op het verminderen van bijensterfte onder honingbijen, het ontwikkelen van meer weerbare (varroa-resistente) honingbijen en het optimaliseren van de imkerpraktijk voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'bescherm de rechten van belastingbetalers beter'

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary of Finance about claims that high tax interest deters taxpayers from objecting, about the reciprocity and fairness of the tax interest and collection interest rules, and about a taxpayers' charter proposed by the tax advisers' association. The State Secretary answers that no such cases are known, that the rules are grounded in the principle of default and budget constraints, and that a charter adds no value beyond existing legislation, though clearer guidance may be published on the Tax Administration website.
A charter does not go through this legislative process, has an unclear status and creates expectations among taxpayers that are not necessarily justified.
Een handvest doorloopt immers niet dit wetgevingsproces, heeft een onduidelijke status en schept verwachtingen richting belastingplichtigen die niet noodzakelijkerwijs terecht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Hermans over het bericht dat ouderen zich niet bewust zijn van toeslagen

VVD MPs Lodders and Hermans asked the government about reports that many elderly people do not claim the healthcare and rent allowances they are entitled to, and what steps will be taken. The government acknowledges non-take-up, says it cannot confirm the healthcare-allowance figures, and defers concrete measures to an IBO review of the allowance system due in spring and autumn 2019.
The cabinet will, as mentioned above, start an IBO study into the allowance system.
Het kabinet zal, zoals hierboven reeds vermeld, een IBO onderzoek starten naar het toeslagenstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over het verbod op het gebruik van de sleepvoet

MPs Lodders and Geurts asked the Minister of Agriculture why the planned ban on slurry-shoe (sleepvoet) manure application on grassland on clay and peat soils was not reconsidered, and about alternatives, their effects, verification and responsibility. The Minister maintained the ban from 1 January 2019 as agreed under the PAS nitrogen programme, described approved alternatives, and set out the verification and responsibility arrangements.
For these alternatives, my ministry is now working on elaborating the regulations so that they can be applied in 2019.
Voor deze alternatieven werkt mijn ministerie nu aan de uitwerking van de regelgeving zodat deze kunnen worden toegepast in 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren vrezen wilde zwijnen na besmetting’

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about African swine fever risks from wild boar, including whether the national government should take over management from the provinces, testing of hunted wild boar, transport and waste controls, and vaccines. The minister answered that consultation with provinces and stakeholders is ongoing, that provinces remain legally responsible for wild boar population management, that the national government can only intervene through substitution in case of neglect, and that existing monitoring and biosecurity measures are considered sufficient for now.
Given this decentralisation of powers, the national government can only intervene in case of neglect of duty by a provincial administration through substitution.
Het Rijk kan, gegeven deze decentralisatie van bevoegdheden, alleen ingrijpen als sprake is van taakverwaarlozing door het bestuur van een provincie door middel van in de plaatstreding
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘EU blijft streng op nieuwe veredelingstechnieken’ en ‘Europees Hof remt kwekers vanwege genetische modificatie’

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the minister how the EU Court ruling on new plant breeding techniques such as CRISPR-Cas9 (subject to GMO rules) affects policy, import controls, and the coalition goal of promoting these techniques in Europe. The minister answered that the ruling keeps such products under GMO authorisation, that detection is difficult, and that the government will address the policy consequences in a separate letter to parliament.
We will shortly inform the House by letter about the Dutch position on applying new plant breeding techniques and the policy consequences of the European Court of Justice ruling.

Wij zullen uw Kamer spoedig per brief informeren over de Nederlandse inzet voor de toepassing van nieuwe plantenveredelingstechnieken en de beleidsconsequenties van de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Het is een puinhoop bij RVO.nl’

An MP asked the minister about reported delays and errors in the transfer of phosphate rights at RVO.nl, including processing times, complaints and objections. The minister answered that processing times now fall within the 8-week legal limit from March onward, that transfers of cattle farmers' rights are held pending reassessment of their decisions, and gave complaint and objection figures.
That is why I have decided to suspend the registration of notifications from cattle farmers.
Daarom heb ik besloten de registratie van kennisgevingen van vleesveehouders aan te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht ‘Levensgevaarlijk chloormiddel nog steeds te koop als ‘medicijn’’

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked why the NVWA took years to act against Miracle Mineral Solution, a chlorine-based product sold as a medicine, despite early warnings and health reports. The minister explained the NVWA needed an independent risk assessment, enforcement began in 2018 after the March report, and it had issued warnings and fines in earlier years.
The bureau can ask the Front Office Food and Product Safety of the RIVM and RIKILT to carry out a risk assessment.
Bureau kan het Front Office Voedsel- en Productveiligheid van het RIVM en het RIKILT vragen een risicobeoordeling uit te voeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de berichten ‘Twaalf schapen afgeslacht in Overijssels weiland: was het een wolf?’, ‘Dit wil je niet nog een keer meemaken’ en ‘Wolf maakt mogelijk slachtoffers b

VVD MPs asked the minister about wolf attacks on sheep, whether farmers can be better protected, compensation and whether lethal control should be possible. The minister answered that wolves are a protected species, that livestock protection is the owners' responsibility, that provinces handle damage compensation and that the operational wolf plan is being revised, with a commitment to consult stakeholders.
It seems desirable to me that foreign examples, such as those in Germany, are taken into account in this revision.
Het lijkt mij wenselijk dat buitenlandse voorbeelden, zoals die in Duitsland, bij deze aanpassing worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders inzake overlijden na fatale val van speeltoestel

An MP asked the minister about the death of a child after a fatal fall from an indoor play device, the NVWA's failed inspections of the play hall since 2013, and its enforcement and follow-up. The minister acknowledged that the NVWA did not act adequately after the 2013 inspection, that its enforcement tools were not used timely, and described tightened intervention policy and monitoring measures.
The NVWA should have found during its 2013 inspection that there was an unsafe situation.
De NVWA had tijdens haar inspectie in 2013 behoren te constateren dat er sprake was van een onveilige situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Lodders over de voornemens omtrent landonteigening in Zuid-Afrika

Two VVD MPs asked the Foreign Minister about South African plans for land expropriation without compensation, farm attacks, Dutch and European business caution, the ICC withdrawal and asylum applications by South Africans. The minister answered that the government is monitoring developments, expects the parliamentary inquiry report and the post-2019 ICC decision, and will raise concerns at the EU-South Africa summit.
Once this report is published, the government will study the outcomes and share them with the House.
Het kabinet zal, zodra dit verslag is uitgebracht, de uitkomsten bestuderen en met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Belastingtelefoon slecht bereikbaar’

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone (BelastingTelefoon) was hard to reach, including ombudsman complaints, rejected calls, staffing cuts and forecasting. The State Secretary admits reachability is worse than he would like, reports 141 complaints and 1 June-31 July, cites added capacity and recruitment, and explains the call-planning model and the still-incomplete digital status portal.
Yes, reachability is worse than normal and worse than I would like.
Ja, de bereikbaarheid is slechter dan normaal en slechter dan ik zou willen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Geen reactie op uitstelverzoek door storing bij fiscus’

MPs Lodders and Omtzigt asked about a technical fault at the Tax Authority that left extension-request replies unsent from April to July 2018, and about redirecting callers to the BelastingTelefoon and waiting times for advisers. The Secretary of State confirmed the fault, gave the number of affected requests (29,203, of which 380 rejections), said the wait times were short and that the claim that a quarter of advisers dropped off was wrong due to incorrect open data.
A solution to this problem was implemented in the ICT environment on 20 July.
Voor dit probleem is op 20 juli een oplossing gerealiseerd in de ICT-omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Lodders over de belastingtelefoon en alternatieve manieren van communiceren met de Belastingdienst

MPs Omtzigt and Lodders asked why the Tax Administration stopped publishing belastingtelefoon performance figures in its half-yearly reports, asked for call-waiting, staffing and sick-leave data, and asked about electronic communication and procedures for written questions and rulings. The State Secretary answered that the indicators were replaced by client-satisfaction and technical-accessibility measures, gave the requested data and queue-management details, said formal electronic communication is not yet open, and committed to restoring accessibility to early-2017 levels by early 2019.
The accessibility indicator, for example, only provides insight into the accessibility of telephone service, whereas the Tax Administration provides services through multiple channels.
De bereikbaarheidsindicator biedt bijvoorbeeld enkel inzicht in de bereikbaarheid van de telefonische dienstverlening, terwijl de Belastingdienst via meerdere kanalen diensten verleent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitzonderlijke droogte en de gevolgen voor de landbouw

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the exceptional drought justifies relaxing rules on manure spreading, grassland ploughing, greening measures and fallow grazing, and requests quicker decisions. The Minister confirms the situation is exceptional, says requests will be considered welcomingly and with priority, commits to advice from the CDM and a request to the European Commission on greening exemptions, and says decisions will be communicated as soon as possible.
I am committed to providing entrepreneurs with clarity as quickly as possible on decisions that are sufficiently substantiated.
Ik zet mij ervoor in om zo snel mogelijk duidelijkheid te geven aan ondernemers met besluiten die voldoende onderbouwd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de aanhoudende droogte in Nederland

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about farmers being obliged to sow cover crops during the drought, whether this is fair given the costs and failing crops, and whether a derogation will be granted quickly. The minister answers that a formal derogation request has been submitted to the European Commission, that a decision cannot come before Commission approval, and that she will push for speed while supplying the information requested.
I have consulted with the European Commission on this and submitted a formal derogation request aimed at easing the greening conditions for sowing catch crops.
Ik heb daarover overlegd met de Europese Commissie en een formeel derogatieverzoek ingediend met het oog op een versoepeling van de vergroeningsvoorwaarden voor het inzaaien van vanggewassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Belastingtelefoon slecht bereikbaar’

Two MPs (Lodders, Omtzigt) asked the State Secretary of Finance why the Tax Helpline was poorly reachable, whether quality indicators were valid, and what steps would fix it. The State Secretary attributed the problems to tight capacity planning, staff absence, a supplier change and a shrinking labour market, cited reachability figures, and announced extra staff and new quality controls from November 2018.
I agree with you that the reachability of the Tax Helpline must return to the level of the first half of 2017, and that the answers given must be of sufficient quality.

Ik ben met u van mening dat de bereikbaarheid van de Belastingtelefoon weer terug moet bewegen naar het niveau van de eerste helft 2017 en dat daarbij de gegeven antwoorden van een voldoende kwaliteit moeten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over agrarische panden

Two VVD MPs asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf (Dutch state property agency) let maintenance of its leased farm buildings lapse, why it does not sell them, and which conditions apply. The State Secretary answered that the agency manages 164 farms, has an inspection and maintenance plan for 2018 after a 2017 letter to tenants, and maintains a policy of not selling farm buildings, while knowing of no operational hindrance from the maintenance backlog.

Because there is a backlog in maintenance of agricultural buildings, the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf notified all tenants of agricultural buildings by letter on 14 September 2017 that they could report faults and problems to a national fault line.

Omdat er een achterstand is in het onderhoud van agrarische gebouwen heeft het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf op 14 september 2017 alle pachters van agrarische gebouwen per brief gemeld dat zij melding kunnen maken van storingen en problemen op een landelijk storingsnummer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Rechtsbescherming belastingbetalers verdient verbetering'

The MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about a Financieel Dagblad report claiming taxpayer rights need improvement, and whether Dutch taxpayers have a charter of rights. The State Secretary answered that Dutch taxpayer rights are well protected by national and international law and the appeal system, that the IBFD report does not cover the Netherlands, and that a charter is unnecessary given existing legal protections.
In the Netherlands considerable attention has been paid to carefully shaping the legal relationship between tax inspectors and collectors on one side and taxpayers on the other.
In Nederland is veel aandacht besteed aan een zorgvuldige vormgeving van de juridische relatie tussen belastinginspecteur en ontvanger aan de ene kant en belastingplichtigen aan de andere kant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Nijboer, Snels, Van Weyenberg, Omtzigt, Lodders en Leijten over een nieuw datalek bij Mossack Fonseca

MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a new Mossack Fonseca data leak, how the Tax Authority will use the data, the yield and cost of Panama Papers work, the promised business case on strengthening its information position, and staffing outflow. The State Secretary confirmed awareness, said analysis will start once the data is public, and stated that costs and yields cannot be separately tracked or directly linked, promising a broader assessment and information to parliament on Prinsjesdag 2018.

I will inform the House on Prinsjesdag 2018 to what extent additional investment in strengthening the Tax Authority's information position and enforcement capacity could benefit tax revenues and its enforcement strategy.

Ik informeer uw Kamer op Prinsjesdag 2018 in hoeverre een extra investering op het terrein van de versterking van de informatiepositie en de opsporingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst de belastingopbrengsten en ook de handhavingstrategie van de Belastingdienst ten goede kan komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de internetconsultatie Regeling tot wijziging van de Regeling ammoniak en veehouderij (Rav) en de Regeling geurhinder en veehouderij (Rgv)

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and minister about the internet consultation on amending the ammonia and odour regulations for livestock farming, questioning the WUR study underlying the change, its financial effects, and whether consultation should have waited for pending questions and parliamentary debate. The government answered that combi-scrubbers perform worse than assumed, that the study is statistically robust, that expansion possibilities will be restricted for affected farms, and that no cost-benefit analysis is available; it deferred some questions to a separate reply.
A cost-benefit analysis is not available.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over de Evaluatie geurverwijdering door luchtwassystemen bij stallen

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked about differences in air-scrubber performance and standards between the Netherlands and Germany, and about the planned adjustment of odour-reduction percentages for combi-scrubbers following a WUR evaluation. The government answered that no EU or Dutch standards exist for scrubbers, that Dutch and German lab measurements differ due to methodology, that combi-scrubbers underperform relative to permit assumptions, and that it will adjust emission factors, while noting the impact on farmers is limited for existing farms.
The study shows that combi-scrubber systems in practice do not deliver the emission reduction assumed in permits.
Het onderzoek toont aan dat de combi-luchtwassystemen in de praktijk niet de emissiereductie geven waar in vergunningen mee wordt gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Expat Americans given one-year reprieve on US repatriation tax’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about a one-year deferral of the US 'toll tax' on repatriated foreign earnings for Accidental Americans and whether it applies to Dutch residents. The State Secretary confirmed the deferral also covers US citizens living in the Netherlands, said the Dutch embassy is lobbying Congress for full abolition, and promised to keep the House informed.
Yes, this deferral also applies to US nationals living in the Netherlands.
Ja, dit uitstel is ook van toepassing op in Nederland wonende Amerikaanse onderdanen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg en Lodders over rulings over de dividendbelasting

MPs Omtzigt, Bruins, Van Weyenberg and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the full dividend-tax ruling policy of the past fifteen years, whether companies can pay dividends to zero-dividend-tax jurisdictions, how many dividend-tax rulings exist, whether they comply with law, and whether the commission examined pre-2015 rulings. The State Secretary answered that no separate ruling policy exists beyond the Verzamelbesluit, that counts of rulings were not systematically kept, that rulings are checked on procedure, and that the independent commission examined a random sample of 2017 APA/ATR rulings including some dividend-tax ones.
The number of cases in which advance certainty was given on the application of the Dividend Tax Act 1965 has not been systematically recorded over the past 15 years.
Het aantal gevallen waarin zekerheid vooraf is gegeven over de toepassing van de Wet op de dividendbelasting 1965 is niet systematisch bijgehouden in de afgelopen 15 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'LNV overrompelt schapenboeren: zeedijk telt maar half voor Mestwet'

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the minister about reports that a manure-policy change caught sheep farmers off guard, whether enforcement and reporting of manure fraud work properly, and how many fraud reports came in. The minister denied any tightening of the manure law, explained the court rulings on sea dikes and a suspended policy rule, and reported about 30 suspected manure-fraud signals in the past 12 months.
Following these rulings, after consultation with LTO, Wetterskip Fryslân and the Union of Water Boards, a policy rule was drawn up.
Naar aanleiding van deze uitspraken is, na overleg met LTO, Wetterskip Fryslân en Unie van Waterschappen, een beleidsregel opgesteld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over het bericht ‘RVB wil dat onjuiste pachtnota's betaald worden’

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked why the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf sent tenants invoices and reminders for April 2018 based on outdated rent percentages, and what would be done about payment pressure and liquidity risk. The Staatssecretaris admitted a process step was wrongly skipped, apologised, committed to no automatic follow-up calls and to stopping collection with interest refunds.

When sending the invoices for rent for the period 1 October 2017 to 30 April 2018, it was not possible to implement in time in the administrative systems the rent price adjustments applying from 1 July 2017.

Bij het verzenden van de facturen voor de pacht over de periode 1 oktober 2017 t/m 30 april 2018 is het niet gelukt om de aanpassingen van de pachtprijzen die gelden vanaf 1 juli 2017 tijdig in de administratieve systemen door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Lodders over het bericht 'Nieuwe pachtrekeningen door softwarefout'

MPs Middendorp and Lodders asked the State Secretary about reports that Rijksvastgoedbedrijf farm rent invoices failed to apply July 2017 rent adjustments due to a process step being skipped (not a software bug), why this surfaced late, poor reachability and itemised invoicing. The government admitted the error, apologised, promised corrections and contact channels, and said a letter on rent policy would follow.
All tenants have now received a letter about the rent adjustment that was not implemented, apologising for how matters unfolded.
Inmiddels hebben alle pachters een brief ontvangen over de niet doorgevoerde pachtprijsherziening, waarin excuses worden aangeboden over de gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de fiscale behandeling van de financiering van startups

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax treatment of startup financing, including liquidity problems, survival rates, and whether employee stock options should be taxed more favourably. The government answered that it sees no reason yet to widen the rules, pointing to ongoing evaluation of the reduced reasonable-wage rule and the stock option rule, due by the end of this cabinet period.
However, the cabinet does not want to anticipate these evaluations and currently sees no reason to widen the tax rules for startups and scale-ups.
Het kabinet wil echter niet vooruitlopen op deze evaluaties en ziet nu geen aanleiding om de fiscale regelgeving voor start-ups en scale-ups te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over het bericht ‘NVWA bevestigt besmetting bruinrot in snijroos’

VVD MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture about Ralstonia (brown rot) infections in cut roses, compensation for affected growers, a 2018 College van Beroep ruling denying compensation under the Plantenziektenwet, use of EU regulation 702/2014, and the unknown source of the outbreak. The minister said no compensation negotiations have taken place, the Netherlands chose not to pay compensation under EU rules judging the losses a normal business risk, and the source remains unidentified despite NVWA investigation.

I want to support the sector by jointly examining, together with the sector, what room exists within cabinet policy and European and national laws and regulations to achieve risk coverage by the sector itself.

Ik wil de sector ondersteunen door samen met de sector te onderzoeken welke ruimte er binnen het kabinetsbeleid en Europese en nationale wet- en regelgeving gevonden kan worden om tot realisatie van een risicoafdekking door de sector zelf te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Grenswerkers klem tussen Nederlandse en Duitse belastingdienst’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Interior about reports that cross-border workers are caught between Dutch and German tax authorities, including rising problem cases, information provision, DGA salary double taxation, and capacity. The government denies a clear rise in problems, says information provision is adequate and monitored, sees no need for new Germany-specific agreements or additional measures now, and commits only to continued monitoring.
However, there are no figures available on all cases where problems arise from differing interpretation of those tax rules in relation to Germany.
Er zijn echter geen cijfers beschikbaar van alle gevallen waar zich problemen voordoen door verschillende interpretatie van die (belasting)regels in relatie tot Duitsland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de berichten ‘Situatie buitendijkse haven is onvoorstelbaar’ en ‘Komst buitendijkse haven nog niet zeker’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that the Maritime Service Harbour in Northern Flevoland is stalled because the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the province cannot agree on erfpacht terms, leaving banks unwilling to finance entrepreneurs. The Minister acknowledges the disagreement, says the Rijk is willing to talk further with the province, and suggests granting rights directly to entrepreneurs as a possible fix.
On the Rijk's side we are happy to enter further consultation with the province to achieve swift realisation of the Maritime Service Harbour.
Van Rijkszijde treden wij graag verder in overleg met de provincie om tot een snelle realisatie van de Maritieme Servicehaven te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Remco Dijkstra en Van den Bosch over het bericht ‘Eindhoven wil eigen vliegtaks invoeren’

MPs of the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about Eindhoven's motion to introduce a local aviation tax, including its legality, effects on competitiveness and whether other municipalities might follow. The Minister of the Interior answered that the decision rests with the municipal council, that such a tax would be tested by courts if challenged, and that the government prefers a national or European aviation levy instead.
It is up to the democratically elected representative body of the municipality, the municipal council, to decide on the introduction and levying of a tax.
Het is aan het democratisch vertegenwoordigende orgaan van de gemeente, de gemeenteraad, om de beslissing te nemen over de invoering en heffing van een belasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Afkoop pensioen dure grap voor ondernemer in het buitenland’

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that entrepreneurs living abroad face very high tax burdens when buying out their own-account pension, asking how many are affected, which countries apply such burdens, and whether the Tax Authority and treaties can resolve it. The State Secretary answered that no cases of a 90% burden are known, that foreign tax treatment cannot be generalised, that Dutch treaties mostly give the source state taxing rights, and that affected entrepreneurs should seek information from foreign authorities or advisers.
I am not aware of any cases in which directors-major shareholders faced a 90% tax burden when buying out their own-account pension.
Mij zijn geen gevallen bekend waarbij dga’s zijn geconfronteerd met een belastingdruk van 90% bij afkoop van hun pensioen in eigen beheer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over fosfaatrechten

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture whether phosphate rights, traded since before their 2018 introduction, create an unregulated market open to fraud, speculation and price manipulation, and asks for transparency and monitoring. The Minister replies that the trade is private-law, restricted to farming enterprises and registered with RVO.nl, that no market regulation is planned for now, and that the market will be monitored with annual reports to parliament.
I will report to your House on this annually.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover jaarlijks rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Wörsdörfer over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers

VVD MPs Lodders and Wörsdörfer asked whether self-employed people working from home must publish their home address in the Chamber of Commerce register, how they are protected against identity fraud, and whether the VAT number containing the BSN can be avoided. The government answered that the register publicly shows home and business addresses for sole traders for traceability and legal certainty, that home addresses can be shielded on request, and that it is investigating options for VAT numbers without the BSN.
I have no indications that the public disclosure of this information in the trade register creates an increased risk of identity fraud.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de openbaarheid van deze gegevens in het handelsregister een vergroot risico op identiteitsfraude oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over functioneren van de Belastingdienst

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Finance about delays at the Tax Administration: backlogs in issuing VAT numbers, late publication of the payroll tax handbook and the tax relief tool, and delayed inheritance and gift tax assessments. The State Secretary acknowledged the delays, attributed them to capacity shortages and technical problems, promised a return to five-day processing by mid-May, and said affected taxpayers were informed by letter and no late-payment interest would be charged.
I do not find this desirable. That is why the priority in handling this category has now been raised.
Dit vind ik niet wenselijk. Daarom is de prioriteit in afhandeling van deze categorie inmiddels verhoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘verandering fiscale regels dochterbedrijf gaat jaren kosten’

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of the CJEU ruling on the Dutch fiscal unity regime, the number of affected firms, expected costs for SMEs and large companies, timing and content of emergency legislation and a future group regime. The State Secretary answered that about 300,000 entities use the regime, that burdens are expected to be temporary, announced a transitional measure for interest deduction limits up to EUR 100,000 per year and a future group regime to be presented before the end of the cabinet term.
The size of the higher burdens for companies that domestically use fiscal unity benefits depends on the budgetary yield of the bill with the emergency repair measures.

De omvang van de hogere lasten voor bedrijven die binnenlands gebruikmaken van voordelen van de fiscale eenheid hangt samen met de budgettaire opbrengst van het wetsvoorstel met de spoedreparatiemaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Supermarkten zetten telers onder druk met nieuw keurmerk groente en fruit'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about supermarkets' new produce quality mark that does not oblige retailers to pay growers extra, and how this fits the coalition agreement's commitment that the ACM will ensure growers receive higher prices for above-legal standards. The minister said the ACM currently lacks powers over producer-buyer contracts, that options to reward growers are being mapped, and that she will report before summer and talk with retailers.
On the detailed implementation of this, I will inform you together with the State Secretary of EZK before the summer, and will also include the quality marks.
Over de nadere invulling daarvan zal ik u samen met de Staatssecretaris van EZK voor de zomer informeren en zal daarbij ook de keurmerken meenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Omtzigt en Lodders over het btw-nummer van zzp’ers dat het burgerservicenummer bevat

MPs Van der Molen, Omtzigt and Lodders asked whether the VAT number of sole traders contains the citizen service number (BSN) and whether this is lawful under privacy rules, and asked the government to stop including the BSN in new VAT numbers. The State Secretary of Finance answered that the BSN is part of the VAT number for natural persons for historical and EU-specification reasons, that a legal basis exists under the Wabb and Wet op de omzetbelasting, and that he is open to a different VAT number format, with information to the House before summer 2018 but declined to report on the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
I cannot make any statement about the status of the Data Protection Authority's investigation.
Over de stand van zaken van het onderzoek van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Alarm om haast vliegtaks'

MPs Lodders and Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked why the ministry is already preparing an aviation tax, given the coalition agreement's European-route-first approach, and questioned its timing, effects and lessons from the 2008 tax. The State Secretary replied that parallel work on three tracks (European, emissions/noise levy, per-ticket charge) is needed to meet the 2021 budget target, with a letter to parliament before summer and an internet consultation, while answering most sub-questions on process and effects in general terms.
In my fiscal policy agenda I announced that I would send parliament a letter on the three tracks under investigation before summer.
In mijn fiscale beleidsagenda heb ik aangekondigd nog voor de zomer een brief over de drie te onderzoeken sporen naar de Tweede Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'GBNED: Belastingdienst lijkt aan koppelverkoop te doen'

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Tax Authority's pilot with certified online bookkeeping software for self-employed workers amounts to tied selling, and questioned the selection criteria, error rates and the Tax Authority's role. The State Secretary denied any tied selling, explained the Zeker-OnLine certification process, said the pilot aims to reduce errors and fines, and promised to report on the pilot's results from the 22nd half-year report.
There is therefore no question of tied selling.
Van koppelverkoop is dan ook geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Lodders over de aanvraag voor de status van referentielaboratorium voor Nederlandse instellingen

MPs Weverling and Lodders asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Netherlands applying to host an EU reference laboratory for plant pest and disease identification, and what would happen if no Dutch institution were designated. The minister replied that the NVWA's NRC-fytosanitair is suitable, that hosting a reference laboratory would strengthen Dutch influence, that funding options are being examined, and that she intends to build support at EU level.
At present I am examining, in good faith, the possibilities for responding to this.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik welwillend de mogelijkheden om hierop te reageren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘EU nagelt Nederland aan de schandpaal vanwege 'agressieve belastingplanning'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about EU Commissioner Moscovici's remarks that seven countries, including the Netherlands, enable aggressive tax planning, asking whether the Netherlands would be blacklisted and how the government would respond. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands meets all EU standards for the non-cooperative jurisdictions list, outlined the anti-tax-avoidance measures announced in the 23 February letter, and declined to comment on the Commissioner's intentions or on SGP enforcement beyond general statements.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Lodders over pensioenopbouw van zwangere huisartsen

Two VVD MPs asked why self-employed doctors lose pension accrual in occupational pension schemes during pregnancy and whether this will be fixed. The state secretary explained the causes (lower income and a fiscal part-time factor, visible three years later), noted that self-employed people can compensate via the third pillar, and committed to removing fiscal barriers in the end-of-year decree 2018.

I intend to arrange that there are no fiscal obstacles preventing these self-employed professionals from accruing pension within their own occupational or sector pension scheme on the same income as before the pregnancy.

ben ik voornemens te gaan regelen dat er geen fiscale belemmeringen zijn om deze zelfstandige beroepsbeoefenaren binnen de eigen beroeps- of bedrijfstakpensioenregeling over hetzelfde inkomen pensioen te laten opbouwen als vóór de zwangerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de waterschapslasten

An MP asked the government about rising water board (waterschap) charges, the cost drivers, differences between water boards, and whether the rising costs can be limited. The Minister answered that the increases stem mainly from investment needs, that the 2011 Bestuursakkoord Water sets efficiency targets and is progressing, and that water board charges are cost-covering and set by democratically elected boards, with a tax-system review pending.
Progress is reported annually in the State of Our Water, which is presented to the House in May.
Jaarlijks wordt over de voortgang gerapporteerd in de Staat van ons Water, die in mei aan de Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over moeilijk inbare belastingvorderingen en het afboeken van belastingvorderingen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about hard-to-collect tax claims, their write-off amounts across tax types, causes, collection steps, write-off rules and recovery costs. The answer gave outstanding claim figures, a breakdown by tax type, write-off trends (about 180,000 claims written off in 2017 versus about 660,000 in 2013), the collection process and the rule that claims are written off only after all recovery options are exhausted.
How much the collection costs for the various taxes amount to is not known.
Hoeveel de kosten van de invordering bij de verschillende belastingen belopen is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht dat de Belasting van Personenauto's en Motorrijwielen (BPM)-opbrengst fors hoger is

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked whether the 27.4% rise in BPM car tax revenue for 2017 is real, what causes it, when the tariffs will be switched to WLTP-based tables, and how to prevent or compensate overpayment. The Secretary of State says final 2017 figures come in May 2018, attributes the rise mainly to economic growth and consumer preferences for larger cars rather than WLTP (only 128 WLTP cars sold), commits to a budget-neutral switch as soon as possible but not before analysis after summer 2018, and declines to investigate individual overpayment.
I am working to ensure that the BPM revenue (at macro level) does not rise as a result of the WLTP.
Ik zet mij in om de BPM-opbrengst (op macroniveau) niet te laten stijgen als gevolg van de WLTP.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Lodders over de Colombiaanse antidumpingprocedure tegen de Nederlandse aardappelsector

Two MPs asked whether Colombia's anti-dumping investigation into frozen potato products from Dutch, German and Belgian producers was procedurally and substantively sound, and whether the Netherlands would push the European Commission to take it to the WTO. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concerns about the procedure and has lobbied Colombia and the Commission, but that a WTO case can only be brought by the Commission once definitive measures exist, with a decision expected in March 2018.
On the basis of the facts now available, the Netherlands already urged the European Commission at the trade policy committee of 16 February 2018 to seriously consider this step.
Nederland heeft er op basis van de nu voorliggende feiten in het handelspolitiek comité van 16 februari 2018 reeds bij de Europese Commissie op aangedrongen deze stap serieus te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Ondernemers in Nederland met Amerikaans paspoort dupe van belastinghervorming Trump’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance whether US tax reform, including a one-off 'toll tax', unfairly double-taxes Dutch residents with US citizenship and how the government will respond. The State Secretary confirmed the US taxes citizens worldwide, said the tax treaty offers little relief, and described diplomatic steps and possible coordinated EU action without committing to a concrete remedy.
The cabinet intends to also bring the position of US nationals living in Europe into the broader European discussion on the US tax reform.
Het kabinet is voornemens om de positie van in Europa wonende Amerikaanse onderdanen ook te betrekken in de bredere Europese discussie over de Amerikaanse belastinghervorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de consequenties van de hogere belastingheffing voor gepensioneerden in België

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Dutch tax authority's end of the wage-tax exemption for Dutch pensioners living in Belgium, the number affected, how they were informed, and whether double taxation or a transitional rule can be prevented. The State Secretary answered that about 1,300 people were notified, that a bilateral agreement with Belgium was signed on 5 March 2018 that removes double taxation and double non-taxation, and that the Tax Authority can undo double taxation quickly once Belgian information arrives.
Therefore I immediately entered into consultation with Belgium, and this led to a quick positive outcome.
Daarom ben ik direct in overleg getreden met België en dat heeft tot een snelle positieve uitkomst geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over het bericht “Willekeur bij publicatie voedselveiligheidswaarschuwingen”

MPs Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked the ministers why food safety warnings were published late or not at all by the NVWA, and how consumers could find them in one place. The minister replied that companies must issue public warnings themselves, that the NVWA can only require companies to publish, not to report to it, and that the NVWA will tighten its internal procedures and urge companies to notify faster.
In the TV broadcast the NVWA promised it would tighten its internal procedures so that public warnings are published faster.
In de Tv-uitzending heeft de NVWA toegezegd dat ze haar interne werkwijze gaat aanscherpen zodat publiekswaarschuwingen sneller worden gepubliceerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de stijging van de lokale lasten en het COELO-rapport

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the macronorm for property tax (OZB), its history since 2008, overshoots, the role of COELO, the VNG and the Tax Administration, and the 2014 evaluation. The minister answered that municipalities decide democratically on OZB, that overshoots are offset in later years, that COELO collects only aggregate data, and that the norm will be reconsidered only when the local tax base is revised.

Based on the currently available data, aimed at applying the macronorm to the total revenues of all municipalities together, COELO does not have the data to determine the OZB revenue of individual municipalities.

Op basis van de huidige beschikbare gegevens, met als doel de toepassing van de macronorm op de totale opbrengsten van alle gemeenten tezamen, beschikt het COELO niet over de gegevens om de ozb-opbrengst van individuele gemeenten vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Amsterdam over de forfaitaire heffing in de vermogensrendementsheffing

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance how the government would respond to a Amsterdam Court of Appeal ruling that the forfaitaire box 3 wealth tax may breach fair balance, and whether reform was sufficient and a move to actual returns planned. The State Secretary answered that the ruling leaves the assessment intact, that the 2017 reforms and higher exemption are considered sufficient for now, and that a cabinet position on actual-return taxation will be sent to parliament in spring.
The Amsterdam Court of Appeal, however, attached no (legal) consequences to this, and the constitutional position of the judge means the legislature must be given some time to address this situation.

Het hof Amsterdam heeft hier echter geen (juridische) consequenties aan verbonden en de rechtsstatelijke positie van de rechter houdt in dat de wetgever enige tijd moet worden gegund om in deze situatie te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laan-Geselschap en Lodders over het bericht ‘Kans op onnodig betalen van leges steeds groter’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities may charge permit fees under outdated, unextended zoning plans, which the Wro prohibits after ten years, and how overcharged businesses can be compensated. The Minister says such fees are unlawful and disapproves of them, but places the duty to ensure valid grounds and to remedy overcharging mainly on municipalities and provinces, without estimating the scale.
Article 3.1, fourth paragraph of the Wro clearly provides that it is not permitted to collect leges when the zoning plan is more than ten years old.
In artikel 3.1, vierde lid van de Wro is duidelijk bepaald dat het niet is toegestaan om leges in te vorderen wanneer het bestemmingsplan meer dan tien jaar oud is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over het bericht ‘Nieuwe auto’s duizenden euro’s duurder’

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the switch to WLTP testing will raise car registration tax (BPM) and prices, and about greener fleet policy. The State Secretary answered that CO2mpas recalculates WLTP emissions to NEDC values to keep current tables, that the impact cannot yet be judged, and that monitoring with RDW, TNO and industry will be extended, promising to keep the House informed; on fleet renewal the government relies on tax incentives for zero-emission cars rather than targeted fleet renewal.
I hereby undertake to keep your House informed of progress in this complex process.
Ik zeg bij deze toe uw Kamer op de hoogte te houden over de voortgang in dit complexe proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de stijging van de lokale lasten en het COELO-rapport

An MP from the VVD asked the government about rising local taxes, including a 9.4% OZB increase in Eindhoven, the COELO report, and why the macronorm was exceeded and the agreed compensation never applied. The minister answered that municipal councils decide on OZB rates, that the macronorm was exceeded in 2012-2016 with overruns carried over to the following year, and that individual municipality data on macronorm breaches is not available.
The annual COELO research does not provide data on the number of municipalities that individually exceeded the macronorm.
Uit het jaarlijkse onderzoek van het COELO zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het aantal gemeenten dat op individuele basis de macronorm heeft overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Veldman over het bericht ‘Nieuw innovatiebox-besluit stelt teleur’

MPs Lodders and Veldman asked the State Secretary of Finance about a critical press report on the new innovation box (innovatiebox) decision, including whether the scheme is accessible to entrepreneurs and which open questions remain. The State Secretary answered that entrepreneurs' experiences are largely positive, pointed to the evaluation, the flat-rate option, helpdesks and policy decisions, and acknowledged that some aspects such as aggregation level and IP access criteria are still being clarified, with a supplementary policy decision expected this year.
I therefore expect to supplement the policy decision on the new innovation box this year.
Ik verwacht het beleidsbesluit over de nieuwe innovatiebox dan ook dit jaar nog aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Duitsland vreest oprukkende zwijnenpest'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about spread of African swine fever toward Germany and the Netherlands, including hygiene measures, controls and wild boar risk. The minister answered that spread is mainly linked to human activity, that EU and national measures (transport rules, disinfection, hunter and sector communication, monitoring) are in place, and that no change of strategy is needed for now.
I support the European Commission's initiatives for the approach, but I also acknowledge the problems with combating it in wild boar.
Ik steun de initiatieven van de Europese Commissie voor de aanpak, maar ik onderken ook de problemen met de bestrijding ervan in de wilde zwijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Gijs van Dijk over de "carve out van gepensioneerden".

MPs Lodders and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pension funds considering a carve-out for pensioners are blocked by the Pensioenwet, and whether the law should be changed now. The minister answered that no funds are known to be seriously considering a carve-out, that it could bring advantages but also risks such as broken solidarity, and that its fate should be decided together with the wider pension reform, so the legal barriers are not lifted immediately.

Distinguishing between the pension assets and the investment policy of the active and deferred participants and of the pensioner group is an interesting route that is also being examined in the context of renewing the pension system.

Het onderscheid maken tussen het pensioenvermogen en het beleggingsbeleid van de groep actieve en gewezen deelnemers en van de groep gepensioneerden is een interessante route die ook in het kader van vernieuwing van het pensioenstelsel wordt bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “Stoot Nederlandse melkkoe meeste of minste methaan uit binnen Europa”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether differing EU member-state methods for estimating dairy cow methane emissions create an uneven playing field and whether Dutch methods should be harmonised. The minister answered that the IPCC-based, differentiated methods are mandatory and effective, that the earlier high figures were outdated and recalculated, and that no further harmonisation steps are needed.
I do not consider additional steps necessary, because the differences in calculation method are in line with international agreements and depend on the size of the source.
Ik acht aanvullende stappen niet nodig, want de verschillen in berekeningsmethode zijn overeenkomstig internationale afspraken en afhankelijk van de omvang van de bron.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Becker over het bericht ‘Oekraïne wil tafeleieren naar Europa brengen’

MPs Lodders and Becker asked whether Ukrainian table eggs will soon be exported to the EU and whether they meet EU animal welfare and food safety standards. The minister answered that an EU-approved exporter exists, that Ukraine is phasing in EU standards by 2021 under the association agreement, and that EU egg import quotas leave the Dutch and EU producers largely unaffected.
The cabinet will continue to keep itself informed of progress.
Het kabinet zal zich blijvend op de hoogte laten stellen van de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, De Groot, Geurts en Lodders over gegevensverstrekking aan Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw voor het programma Onderzoek en Innovatie

MPs asked whether the minister should give the agricultural sector body BO Akkerbouw the names, addresses and acreage data of non-member farms, given data-protection limits and administrative burden, for a mandatory research levy. The minister declined direct transfer of the data, offering instead KvK data transfers and an opt-in consent route via RVO.nl, arguing this is proportionate and workable under the Wbp.
This means that providing the acreage data, without the farms having given consent, does not meet the requirements of proportionality and subsidiarity.
Dit maakt dat het verstrekken van de areaalgegevens, zonder dat de akkerbouwbedrijven daar toestemming voor gegeven hebben, niet voldoet aan de eisen van proportionaliteit en subsidiariteit
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Lodders over de zeehondentochten op de Wadden

MPs Aukje de Vries and Lodders asked about proposed closures of sandbanks in the Wadden Sea to seal tour operators, the basis for those proposals, stakeholder consultation and enforcement. The minister replied that the proposals are preliminary, follow a set consultation procedure with a decision planned for spring 2018, and that closures are based on monitoring and enforced, while seal populations are stable.
The closed area is also not enlarged under the current proposals in the starting document, but rather reduced.
Het gesloten gebied wordt ook met de huidige voorstellen in het startdocument niet vergroot, maar juist verkleind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht 'Jagersvereniging waarschuwt leden: totaalverbod op het gebruik van lokmiddelen bij landelijke vrijstelling'

MP Lodders asks why the Wet Natuurbescherming regulation no longer allows lure decoys and lure sounds for hunting species under the national exemption, and what the consequences are for hunters, agriculture and protected species. The state secretary says the omission was not intended, that the regulation will be amended as soon as possible, and that a provincial exemption can be requested in the meantime.
This amendment will be realised at the earliest possible opportunity.
Deze wijziging zal op de kortst mogelijke termijn worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over “Ernstige zorgen over de exportpositie van de Nederlandse paardensector”

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of export problems for the Dutch horse sector after EIA cases in Netherlands and Germany, including whether Germany has more favourable certificates and what action will be taken. The State Secretary confirmed the EIA cases and export restrictions in several countries, denied that Germany has more favourable certificates (noting only minor differences from negotiations), and said the government will seek the most favourable export conditions bilaterally and via the European Commission, in consultation with the sector.
Equal export conditions (level playing field) are achieved because the European Commission agrees veterinary export conditions with third countries on behalf of the member states.
Gelijke exportvoorwaarden (level playing field) worden bereikt doordat de Europese Commissie namens de lidstaten met derde landen veterinaire exportvoorwaarden overeenkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber en De Groot over fipronil in eieren

MPs Lodders, Geurts, Dik-Faber and De Groot asked the ministers about the fipronil egg crisis, including a toxicologist's claim that the Dutch limit is too strict, the RASFF notification process, when the Netherlands knew of contamination, and differing risk approaches across member states. The government defended the EU residue limit, explained the RASFF process and the ARfD and ADI tests used, admitted a date error, and said it would examine the differences in approach.
For the answer to this question I refer you to our letter of 10 August.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik u naar onze brief van 10 augustus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het mesttransport naar Duitsland

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary about German restrictions on Dutch manure transport and whether the Netherlands had escalated the matter to the European Commission. The government replied that it shared its interpretation of EU rules with Lower Saxony, the Commission confirmed the Dutch view, and the new German manure policy is seen as consistent with the Nitrates Directive.
Recently I received the European Commission's position, which confirms the Dutch view.
Recentelijk heb ik het standpunt van de Europese Commissie ontvangen, waarin zij de zienswijze van Nederland bevestigt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen en het uitblijven van een reactie op het verzoek van de Kamer van 13 april 2017 over de uitspraak van het College van Beroep over de Positieflijst zoogdieren 2015

MP Lodders asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how the government will respond to the Court of Appeal's ruling that the 2015 mammal positive list methodology was flawed, why a new assessment of about 300 species was done before the ruling, and whether the list should be withdrawn. The state secretary answered that the ruling restores the previous status of muntjacs and mazama with immediate effect, that the re-assessment was done because the full inventory was only completed in 2016 and no ruling was expected, and referred to earlier letters for the other questions.
The amendment of the regulations has been initiated.
De aanpassing van de regelgeving is in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie van 19 april 2016, Dansk Industri/Karsten Eigil Rasmussen

Two MPs asked the state secretaries whether the 2013 and 2016 European Court of Justice rulings (Experian, Dansk Industri/Rasmussen) show that the age exception in the Dutch equal treatment law and the Staffelbesluit age-based premium scales are incompatible with EU law, and what consequences this has for pension schemes. The government acknowledged the age exception in the Wgbl is likely not a correct implementation of the directive and promised to examine amendments, but maintained that the Staffelbesluit itself can be objectively justified and needs no withdrawal.

From both rulings of the European Court of Justice it can be inferred that the exception to the prohibition of age discrimination laid down in Article 8(3) of the Dutch Equal Treatment on Grounds of Age in Employment Act (Wgbl) is, on closer examination, not a correct implementation of the above Directive.

Uit de beide uitspraken van het Europese Hof van Justitie kan worden afgeleid dat de uitzondering op het verbod van leeftijdonderscheid, die is vastgelegd in artikel 8, derde lid, van de Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van leeftijd bij de arbeid (Wgbl), bij nader inzien geen juiste implementatie van de bovengenoemde Richtlijn is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht 'Onzichtbare regeldruk van honderden miljoenen euro’s teistert bedrijfsleven'

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that policy rules (beleidsregels) by implementing bodies create hidden regulatory burden for business, and whether these burdens are quantified and reduced. The minister answered that policy rules are formally not legislation and cannot add obligations, that the cited cases largely reflect existing law, inspection instructions or business-own costs, and that knotty cases will be addressed through the existing maatwerk approach without coordinating or quantifying policy rules further.
Policy rules are formally not legislation, so they cannot contain additional obligations for citizens, businesses and institutions beyond those already following from the legislation they elaborate.

Beleidsregels zijn formeel geen wetgeving. Ze kunnen dan ook geen aanvullende verplichtingen voor burgers, bedrijven en instellingen bevatten ten opzichte van de verplichtingen die al volgen uit de wetgeving ter uitwerking waarvan de beleidsregels zijn opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over RVO naar aanleiding van vele klachten van ondernemers

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about many complaints from entrepreneurs over RVO's registration of livestock units (GVE's) for the phosphate reduction plan, including causes of discrepancies, timing of fines, and pending files. The State Secretary answered that RVO received seven formal and 18 phone complaints, that about 5,500 files may lead to adjustments, that most farms should receive their fine letters by end of June, and that the regulation was amended on 28 April 2017.
The expectation is that by the end of June all companies will have received their letter about the fine.
De verwachting is dat eind juni alle bedrijven hun brief over de geldsom hebben ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen omtrent het stalsysteem 'koeientuin'

An MP asked the State Secretary about the 'koeientuin' cow-barn system, which has no straw bedding and therefore conflicts with EU organic rules, and whether innovative stall concepts can be blocked by existing rules. The government answered that it requested an individual exemption from the EU, which the Commission refused, and that a possible solution may come from pending revisions of the organic regulation.
The Netherlands requested the European Commission for an individual exemption from the mandatory presence of bedding.
Nederland heeft aan de Europese Commissie verzocht om een individuele ontheffing van de verplichte aanwezigheid van strooisel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel 'Pensioenfederatie: 'Nettopensioen is vaak loos product'

Lodders (VVD) asks whether the rules for buying net pension in pension funds, which may cause participants to lose a quarter or more of their savings, should be revised, and whether fiscal hygiene is adequately guaranteed. Klijnsma answers that the rules stem from a 2014 decree, that fiscal hygiene is guaranteed under current rules, and that she is consulting with the Stichting van de Arbeid and Finance on possible changes, with conclusions to be shared as soon as possible.
I aim to share my conclusions with your House as quickly as possible once the consultation with the Stichting van de Arbeid has concluded.
Ik streef ernaar om – na afloop van het overleg met de Stichting van de Arbeid – zo snel mogelijk mijn conclusies met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ten Broeke over dreigende antidumpingmaatregelen van Brazilië

MPs Lodders and Ten Broeke asked about Brazil's threatened anti-dumping duties on Dutch chips exports, including whether the Brazilian authorities used improper arguments, whether the measures comply with WTO rules, and what steps the government has taken. The minister answered that the Commission considers the measures insufficiently substantiated, that the Netherlands has lobbied repeatedly through its embassy and the Commission, and that the Commission can challenge the measures at the WTO.
The cabinet shares the European Commission's view that the measures are insufficiently substantiated and motivated.
Het kabinet deelt de lezing van de Europese Commissie dat de maatregelen onvoldoende zijn onderbouwd en gemotiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van ‘t Wout over uitbreiding van de werkingssfeer van een cao en/of de uitbreiding van de verplichtstellingsbeschikking van een bedrijfstakpensioenfonds

MPs Lodders and Van 't Wout asked how often and why the scope of collective agreements and pension fund compulsory membership decisions is changed, who decides, and whether 'clarifications' or 'editorial changes' disguise expansions. The ministers answered that scope is set by social partners, that Minister decides on extensions with representativeness rules and objections procedures, and gave counts of 2015-2016 scope-change decisions, while declining to investigate misuse of editorial changes.
Defining and adapting the scope of collective agreements and compulsory schemes is a responsibility of the social partners.
Het definiëren en aanpassen van werkingssferen van cao's en verplichtstellingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte, Lodders en Aukje de Vries over de problemen van agrarische ondernemers in de Oudebildtdijk

MPs Rutte, Lodders and Aukje de Vries asked whether designating the Oude and Nieuwe Bildtdijken as a protected village landscape (beschermd dorpsgezicht), including about 2,500 hectares of farmland, would restrict farmers' operations, and whether the farmland should be excluded. Minister Bussemaker replied that the designation is based on cultural-historical values, does not aim to block farming, leaves the existing zoning plan in force, and that she sees no reason to reconsider or exclude farmland, while offering a protocol with the municipality and province and awaiting a pending Council of State appeal.

I have already indicated to the municipality of Het Bildt and the province of Fryslân that I am willing to draw up, together with them and the agricultural sector, a protocol on agricultural business operations in relation to the status of the protected village landscape.

Ik heb de gemeente Het Bildt en de provincie Fryslân al aangegeven bereid te zijn om samen met hen en de agrarische sector een protocol op te stellen over de agrarische bedrijfsvoering in relatie tot de status van het beschermd dorpsgezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over het bericht “ Duitse minister: nepvlees mag geen schnitzel heten”

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked whether vegetarian products may use meat-related names such as 'schnitzel' and whether the Netherlands would follow a German proposed ban. The minister answered that such names are not per se misleading if labelling is clear, that the NVWA enforces against consumer deception including online, and that no national ban is planned because consumers have not reported problems.
