When meatless products use terms that are (also) customary for meat-containing products, this is not by definition unclear and misleading, provided the labelling is clear about the absence of meat and the use of other ingredients.

Als voor vleesloze producten termen worden gebruikt die (ook) voor vleeshoudende producten gebruikelijk zijn, is dit niet per definitie onduidelijk en misleidend, als de aanduidingen helder zijn over de afwezigheid van vlees en over het gebruik van andere grondstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over stalkeuring

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the limited availability of livestock stall inspections for export, which species qualify, the status of talks with the pig sector, and when they will be reintroduced for pigs. The State Secretary answered that stall inspection is open only to individually identified animals, that pigs are largely not yet individually marked, and that it will return sector by sector once reliable identification systems are in place, without committing to a firm date.
As soon as a sector, or part of a sector, has a watertight system of individual identification, it can again make use of stall inspection.
Zodra er in een sector, of een deel van een sector, een sluitend systeem van individuele identificatie is, kan men weer gebruik gaan maken van stalkeuring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het akkerbouwonderzoek

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked why the Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) took months to respond to the Brancheorganisatie Akkerbouw's request for data needed for an agricultural research levy, and whether this delay endangers EUR 1.2 million in projects. The minister confirmed the request was filed in July, cited data protection (Wbp) constraints, and said the BO may obtain KvK numbers of non-member market participants so it can ask them to authorise RVO to share acreage data.
I have decided, within the scope permitted by the Wbp, to enable the Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw to obtain from RVO the Chamber of Commerce numbers of non-member market participants.

Ik heb besloten – binnen de ruimte die de Wbp biedt – het de Brancheorganisatie (BO) Akkerbouw mogelijk te maken de Kamer van Koophandel-nummers (KvK-nummers) van de niet bij haar aangesloten marktdeelnemers van RVO te verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen omtrent exportcertificering van paardensperma

An MP asked the state secretary why only one laboratory is designated for export health testing of horse semen, and whether this limits competition and whether EU-equivalent labs abroad can be recognised. The state secretary answered that private labs and foreign labs can apply for recognition or equivalence, that the rules were loosened from 1 January 2017, and declined to provide a cost overview because tariffs are the labs' responsibility.
Setting the level of tariffs is a responsibility of the laboratories.
Het bepalen van de hoogte van tarieven is een verantwoordelijkheid van de laboratoria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht "Sinaasappels mogelijk dubbel zo duur door Europese regels"

The state secretary of Economic Affairs was asked by MP Lodders (VVD) about EU proposals to tighten import rules on citrus from countries such as South Africa to guard against the African citrus fruit moth and Citrus Black Spot, which MPs considered disproportionate and protectionist. The answer states the minister opposes prescribing a specific cold treatment, wants proportionate risk-based measures and alternatives, will ask the Commission to allow alternatives, and will not oppose the measure at the Council this January.
However, I will ask the European Commission to also allow alternative measures to prevent the introduction of the African citrus fruit moth.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie echter wel verzoeken ook alternatieve maatregelen ter voorkoming van de insleep van de Afrikaanse fruitmot toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen over het programma "Certificering op Afstand"

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the NVWA's 'Certificering op Afstand' programme, including how remote certificate fees are set, why they can exceed on-site vet visits for multiple certificates, and whether this fits NVWA efficiency goals. The State Secretary answered that remote certification costs EUR 62.59 versus at least EUR 195.74 for an on-site visit, acknowledged higher costs for more than three certificates, and said the NVWA is examining whether remote fees can be capped at on-site costs.
The NVWA is currently examining whether it can be arranged that the costs of remote certification can never exceed those of an on-site inspection.
De NVWA bekijkt momenteel of kan worden geregeld dat de kosten van certificering op afstand nooit hoger kunnen uitvallen dan een controle op de locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over vogelgriep vastgesteld in Kamperveen

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about bird flu outbreaks, the duration of the housing obligation for free-range poultry, and whether free-range egg status should be preserved after twelve weeks of confinement. The state secretary confirmed continued high risk through spring 2017, said the status of free-range eggs would lapse after twelve weeks, and undertook to lobby the European Commission to allow an extension without loss of that status.
That is why I will urge the European Commission that the Netherlands can extend the housing obligation due to bird flu risks, without companies losing their free-range egg trading status.

Daarom zal ik er bij de Europese Commissie voor pleiten dat Nederland de ophokplicht kan verlengen in verband met de risico's voor vogelgriep, zonder dat bedrijven hun handelsstatus wat betreft vrije uitloopeieren verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over “de Luxemburg-route”

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary about the Luxembourg pension route for cross-border pension schemes, the European pension vehicle there, and whether Dutch rules should be broadened to attract foreign schemes. The government answered that only a few Dutch schemes (under 50 participants) operate in Luxembourg, that participation is a social-partner choice protected by works council consent and dual supervisor approval, and that it does not consider changing Dutch prudential rules desirable, while it will study adjustments to the general pension fund for foreign schemes.
The cabinet indicated in its response to the study that it will further examine whether adjustments are needed to realise the potential of the general pension fund for foreign schemes.

Het kabinet heeft in haar kabinetsreactie bij het onderzoek aangegeven dat zij nader zal bestuderen of er aanpassingen nodig zijn om deze potentie van het algemeen pensioenfonds voor buitenlandse regelingen tot wasdom te laten komen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Vermeij over het bericht ‘Aantal pensioenfondsen zakt onder driehonderd’

MPs Lodders and Vermeij asked the State Secretary about the reported drop of Dutch pension funds below 300, the causes of consolidation (especially among industry-wide funds) and what will be done to help industry funds merge. The State Secretary explained the long-term consolidation driven by social developments and efficiency concerns, and said a concept bill on merging mandatory industry funds with temporary segregated assets would be sent to parliament.
The cabinet endorses the importance of scale enlargement aimed at reducing administration costs for small and medium-sized pension funds
Het kabinet onderschrijft het belang van schaalvergroting met als doel het verlagen van de uitvoeringskosten voor kleine en middelgrote pensioenfondsen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht "Veehouderij kan niet zonder begrenzing"

An MP asked the state secretary whether a farewell interview by the director-general for Agro and Nature, suggesting environmental rules should not be applied too strictly, undermines farmers' trust and signals a shift in the Dutch negotiating position on derogation from the Nitrates Directive. The state secretary rejected that reading, said the director-general argued for keeping within the limits, and referred to contacts with the European Commission and promised quarterly updates to parliament.

In that debate I informed your House about the contacts at official and political level and promised to keep you informed every quarter about the progress of talks on the sixth Nitrates Directive action programme.

Daarin heb ik uw Kamer geïnformeerd over de contacten op ambtelijk en politiek niveau en toegezegd u elk kwartaal te zullen informeren over de voortgang van gesprekken over het 6 e actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘Impact fijnstof zwaar overdreven’

An MP asked the government to react to a newspaper article claiming air pollution has only a small effect on regional health differences, and whether livestock density correlates with chronic illness. The state secretary rejected the article's methodology as unsound, pointed to the VGO study and the planned air-quality measures, and promised to inform parliament about any measures.
Your House will be informed about the measures to be taken.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over de te nemen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht ‘NVWA kapittelt afslag Urk vanwege condens’

VVD MPs Lodders and Visser asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs, and the answer came from Minister Schippers, about the NVWA closing three cold cells at Visveiling Urk and imposing a penalty order over condensation, which they argued is a natural phenomenon with no bacteriological danger. The government answered that condensation is a food-safety hygiene requirement that Visveiling Urk has failed to fix despite years of warnings, and it declined to intervene in the dispute between the NVWA and the company.
No, I am not willing to get involved in this discussion between the NVWA and Visveiling Urk bv.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid mij te mengen in deze discussie tussen de NVWA en Visveiling Urk bv.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over dat de kostencijfers van DNB niet altijd goed vergelijkbaar zijn

An MP asked whether pension fund cost figures published by DNB are comparable and whether reporting guidelines cause confusion. The state secretary said reporting is largely comparable, DNB publishes unadjusted fund data, and the AFM supervises compliance, without committing to new action.
In my view, the reporting guidelines of the Pensioenfederatie need not lead to unclarity.
Naar mijn mening hoeven de rapportagerichtlijnen van de Pensioenfederatie niet tot onduidelijkheid te leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat Pensioen 1-2-3 niet leidt tot meer duidelijkheid

Dutch MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a Netspar study finding that the new Pensioen 1-2-3 communication model does not yet make pension information easier to find, and about pension awareness, harmonisation of information channels and the key elements participants should see. The State Secretary acknowledged room for improvement, noted the obligation is new, pointed to existing tools and activities, reported awareness data without attributing effects to Pensioen 1-2-3, and said the sector will evaluate the instrument after two years.
I am willing to keep a close eye on progress and to engage in discussion with the pension providers.
Ik ben bereid om een vinger aan de pols te houden over de voortgang en in gesprek te gaan met de pensioenuitvoerders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Dijkgraaf en Geurts over het persbericht ‘Innovatieve schimmel alternatief voor landbouwgif’

Three MPs asked why the Ministry of Economic Affairs press release on a fungus-based alternative used the term 'landbouwgif' rather than the statutory 'gewasbeschermingsmiddelen', and whether this framing harms agriculture. The Secretary of State acknowledged the term was chosen for a general audience, said the pilots for low-risk alternatives are still in the start-up phase, and stressed the importance of an adequate effective pesticide package.
The word landbouwgif was used as a synonym for the high-risk plant protection products.
Het woord landbouwgif is als synoniem gebruikt voor de risicovolle gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘Eiopa wil betere en meer vergelijkbare informatie voor deelnemers'

Conservative MP Lodders asked the State Secretary whether EU pensions supervisor EIOPA's plans to develop rules on participant information and governance for pension funds go too far, and what the government will do to stop them. The State Secretary answered that the government opposes detailed EU harmonisation, notes that EIOPA can only issue non-binding advice, and sees no need for concrete steps at present.
EIOPA can therefore issue advice, but cannot impose rules on member states.
EIOPA kan daarom wel advies uit brengen, maar geen regels opleggen aan lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Geurts en Lodders over het bericht dat fabrikanten woest zijn over eenzijdige aanpassing van emissies innovatieve stalvloeren

MPs Dijkgraaf, Geurts and Lodders asked why the government adjusted emission measurements for innovative low-emission stable floors, whether Wageningen University's overlapping roles are independent, why the Aeromix system received no provisional emission factor, and about the professionalisation of the advisory committee TacRav. The State Secretary answered that a expert panel is reviewing the measurements, a third party will advise by November, definitive factors are expected early 2017, and the TacRav professionalisation will be audited.
I want to have the advice at my disposal in November, so that after consultation with those involved I can definitively set the emission factors in early 2017.
Het advies wil ik in november tot mijn beschikking hebben, zodat ik na overleg met betrokkenen begin 2017 de emissiefactoren definitief kan vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over rattenoverlast

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked the government about rising rat infestations, the increase in Weil's disease cases, the effectiveness of Integrated Pest Management and rodenticide use, and whether doctors are informed. The government answered that monitoring is still too short for firm trends, that Integrated Pest Management is essential, that cases rose but not tenfold, and that it will evaluate the policy with results expected in 2021.
The number of patients has not increased tenfold in the past year.
Het aantal patiënten is het afgelopen jaar niet verachtvoudigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders over het onderhoud van sloten door waterschappen

MPs Visser and Lodders asked the minister whether they share farmers' concerns about Vechtstromen water board reducing ditch maintenance and abolishing inspections, and how this fits the motion on flood prevention and the Water Framework Directive. The minister says the board is following a careful procedure with public consultation and appeal, that maintenance responsibility for the smallest waters shifts to owners, and that water-quality and flood risks are not expected to rise.
Furthermore, it applies a careful procedure in which public participation and appeal are possible.
Voorts hanteert ze daarbij, een zorgvuldige procedure waarbij inspraak en beroep mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Bosma en Lodders over het inzichtelijk maken van marktbelemmeringen voor de export van agri-producten

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the value of the Dutch onion sector, the number of trade missions involving agri-food and horticulture, the effect of the Russian import ban, and how export markets will be expanded. The State Secretary answered that the Dutch onion sector holds a strong world market position, that agri-food was represented on most economic missions in 2015 and 2016, and referred to earlier letters for the broader export strategy without listing concrete new commitments.

At 14 of the 21 economic missions organised by the Netherlands Enterprise Agency in 2015, the Agri & Food and/or Horticulture & Propagation Materials top sectors were represented; in 2016 this was the case at 13 of the 18 economic missions.

Bij 14 van de 21 economische missies die door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland zijn georganiseerd in 2015, waren de topsectoren Agri & Food en/of Tuinbouw & Uitgangsmaterialen vertegenwoordigd, in 2016 bij 13 van de 18 economische missies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over signalen omtrent de  fytosanitaire keuringen door de  NVWA

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the NVWA's cancellation of phytosanitary inspections a day in advance, the costs passed to importers, the 50% inspection rate versus the EU 15% minimum, and whether Germany's approach causes trade diversion. The State Secretary answered that cancellations are possible for priorities such as calamities while the 15% annual EU minimum is met, that costs are recovered via a levy spread across all consignments, that the 50% rate for certain stone codes reflects higher pest risk, and that no evidence of trade diversion was found.
The NVWA informs the businessman concerned as soon as possible if the inspection has to be cancelled.
De NVWA bericht zo snel mogelijk de betrokken ondernemer als de inspectie geannuleerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel 'Veehouderij kan niet zonder begrenzing’

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary whether the government supports a phosphate rights system and comments in an interview suggesting relaxing the Nitrates Directive, and whether contacts with the European Commission undermine farmers' trust. The State Secretary said the phosphate ceiling is a condition of the derogation, that the government will argue in Brussels for dropping an absolute production limit if manure processing secures the surplus, and declined to disclose details of talks with the Commission.
Partly in the interest of the results to be achieved, it is not desirable or customary to make detailed information about the talks public.
Het is, mede in het belang van de te bereiken resultaten, niet wenselijk of gebruikelijk om gedetailleerde informatie over de gesprekken openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘FrieslandCampina wil collectieve subsidie voor mestvergisters’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether farmers can apply for SDE+ subsidy collectively for manure digesters, whether extra conditions apply, and whether non-participating farmers can still apply. The minister replied that a collective application is possible in principle, that a separate scheme for monomanure digestion is planned pending EU state-aid approval, and that individual farmers can apply under the regular SDE+.
Within the regular SDE+ it is necessary to submit an application stating the specific location and/or permits.
Binnen de reguliere SDE+ is het noodzakelijk om een aanvraag in te dienen met opgave van de specifieke locatie en/of vergunningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de tuinwallen op Texel

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the Texel garden walls, which have ecological and cultural value, are not eligible as greening elements under EU agricultural policy, and whether measures could be taken. The State Secretary answered that the walls are not on the EU list of eligible landscape elements, so no notification to the Commission is possible for 2017, and that the walls could be raised in future CAP discussions.
I see no possibilities to make garden walls part of the greening measures in the short term because they are not included in the Commission's proposal.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om tuinwallen op korte termijn onderdeel te laten zijn van de vergroeningsmaatregelen omdat ze niet opgenomen zijn in het voorstel van de Commissie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders, Graus, Dik-Faber, Dijkgraaf,  Van Klaveren en Houwers over het bericht van Cumela om voor 24 augustus 2016 duidelijkheid te geven over het verzoek van Cumela voor uitstel

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to clarify before 24 August 2016 whether he would postpone the manure spreading ban, as requested by the trade association Cumela. The State Secretary answered that he had asked the Technical Committee Soil for advice on a possible exemption under the Soil Protection Act, expected to decide within the week and communicate it promptly.
I expect this advice to be received shortly and will then decide on an exemption.
Ik verwacht dit advies op korte termijn te ontvangen en zal daarna besluiten over een vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over diverse toezeggingen met betrekking tot gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP asked the state secretary about the Council of State's critical advice on the proposed ban on pesticide use by non-professionals, the preference order for non-chemical alternatives, environmental effects, packaging, enforcement budget and the risk of unauthorised substances. The government answered that the advice was published in April 2016, that the preference order will be promoted through a voluntary Green Deal with retailers with monitoring but no NVWA inspection, and that a modest additional budget of about two million euro was allocated to the NVWA for enforcement through 2017.
The advice of the Council of State has, as usual, been published together with the Nader Rapport in the Staatscourant.
Het advies van de Raad van State is, zoals gebruikelijk, met het Nader Rapport gepubliceerd in de Staatscourant
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Illegale inzet koper in biologische aardappel’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether illegal use of copper oxychloride by organic potato growers against Phytophthora, and the failure of inspection body Skal to enforce it, was acceptable and whether controls would be tightened. The government answered that such use violates the law since copper oxychloride products were banned in the Netherlands in 2000, that enforcement falls to the NVWA which applies the same inspection regime to organic and conventional farming, and that it considers the practice unacceptable and is funding resistant potato breeding.
This means that potato growers who use copper oxychloride products against Phytophthora are violating the law.
Dit betekent dat aardappeltelers die middelen met koperoxychloride gebruiken ter bestrijding van Phytophthora de wet overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen, De Boer en Lodders over het artikel ‘Burgemeester Almere heeft geen tijd’

VVD MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a report that bus stone-throwing in Almere's Kruidenwijk continued and that no one had been arrested, and what role the mayor should play. The minister said about ten incidents are under investigation, some arrests have been made, the government is working on an integrated public transport safety approach with the municipality and operator, and recovery of damages through criminal proceedings is possible but no concrete statements can yet be made.
As the investigation into these various incidents is still ongoing, I cannot currently provide further substantive information on this.
Nu het onderzoek naar deze diverse incidenten nog loopt, kan ik hier op dit moment geen verdere inhoudelijke mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders over het bericht "Onkruidverdelger glyfosaat niet kankerverwekkend" en het persbericht van FAO/WHO

An MP asked the state secretaries about reports that glyphosate is not carcinogenic and the consequences for the ban on its use on paved surfaces and for municipal weed control. The government answered that the ban on professional use on paved surfaces stands independently of glyphosate's classification, that ECHA has not yet ruled, and that the approval extension is still pending at EU level.

The ban, announced several years ago to protect the aquatic environment, applies to all plant protection products and is entirely separate from recent developments concerning the active substance glyphosate.

Dit verbod, dat al enige jaren geleden is aangekondigd ter bescherming van het aquatisch milieu, geldt voor alle gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en staat geheel los van de recente ontwikkelingen rondom de werkzame stof glyfosaat.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht “Alterra ziet minder imidacloprid in water” en het ter notificatie voorgelegde ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden

An MP asked the State Secretary about Alterra findings that imidacloprid concentrations in surface water fell in 2015-2016, whether this breaks the trend, and about the notified draft ban on imidacloprid in greenhouse horticulture areas, including why notification was not mentioned earlier and on what EU basis the areas were designated. The State Secretary largely referred to a separate letter and parallel answers, committed to sending the Ctgb advice-based letter, and did not reverse the ban.
I asked the Ctgb to draw up advice on imidacloprid based on the follow-up analysis of the Leiden Centre for Environmental Sciences.
Ik heb het College voor de toelating van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden (Ctgb) gevraagd een advies op te stellen over imidacloprid
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat een akkerrand is afgekeurd door de RVO omdat deze twee meter te breed is

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the RVO rejecting a field margin for being two metres too wide, questioning the bureaucratic approach and the ecological rationale. The State Secretary answered that the European rule is strict, that he has asked the European Commission to change it, and that until then Dutch authorities must reject field margin parts wider than 20 metres.
As long as that has not happened, the Netherlands is bound to reject (parts of) field margins wider than 20 metres.
Zolang dat niet is gebeurd, is Nederland eraan gehouden (de delen van) akkerranden breder dan 20 meter af te keuren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht “grutto of kraai, voor wie moet je kiezen?”

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports on predation of meadow bird nests by foxes, crows and other predators, including whether predation is rising and whether predator control is needed for meadow bird conservation. The government answered that predation is monitored nationally without a clear rising trend, that predator control is one factor within a broader habitat approach, and that legal options exist under the new nature conservation law, with no commitment to new action.
As can be seen, no rising trend can be discerned in the figures, although predation has increased over the past few years after several years of low predation.
Zoals te zien is er geen stijgende trend te ontdekken in de cijfers, al is predatie de afgelopen paar jaar na enkele jaren met weinig predatie wel toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over koeherkenning

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the planned ban on cold-branding cows, which dairy farmers use for identification in milking parlours and pastures, and whether the ban will be suspended and why the NVWA's concerns were not shared. The State Secretary confirms awareness of the sector's objections, refers to the draft decree for the substance, states the NVWA's concerns were not formally raised as far as known, and says cold-branding remains allowed until the ban takes effect.
I refer you for the answer to the explanatory memorandum accompanying the draft amendment decree to the Animal Keepers and Veterinary Decree, which was submitted to your House on 1 June.
Ik verwijs u voor het antwoord naar de nota van toelichting bij het ontwerpbesluit wijziging Besluit houders van dieren en Besluit diergeneeskundigen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht “Pensioenfondsen verhuizen naar België”

An MP (Lodders, VVD) asked the state secretary about Dutch employers moving pension schemes to Belgian or other EU funds to cut costs, including whether Belgium indexes more easily, how many firms have moved, and whether the Netherlands is lagging on cross-border pension rules. The government answered that Dutch labour law and supervisory checks (DNB, AFM) still apply, that several firms have moved about 550 million euro, and that it will reassess cross-border rules after an EIOPA advice.
First, Dutch social and labour law remains applicable to this scheme, so safeguards such as the ban on cash-out and the right to value transfer remain in force.
Ten eerste blijft het Nederlandse sociaal en arbeidsrecht van toepassing op deze regeling, waardoor waarborgen als het verbod op afkoop en het recht op waardeoverdracht van toepassing blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Lodders en Veldman over de berichtgeving over de Nijkerkerbrug

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the one-year delay in renovating the Nijkerkerbrug, why the experimental tender approach was kept despite an agreement to revert to the classic method, the safety and economic consequences, and whether the renovation will be sped up. The Minister attributes the delay to technical and procedural risks and the new market-oriented tender approach, says the temporary safety and weight-limit measures are in place, and promises to explore partial recovery of the delay when the contract is awarded in spring 2017.
I have chosen to put the Nijkerkerbrug on the market in a different way, in a form suited to the recently presented Market Vision.
Ik heb ervoor gekozen om de Nijkerkerbrug op een andere manier op de markt te zetten, in een vorm passend bij de onlangs gepresenteerde Marktvisie.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders over de berichten ‘Wijziging NVWA-tarieven per 1 mei 2016’ en ‘NVWA zet nertsenhouders en hun gezinnen mes op de keel’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the May 2016 increase in NVWA inspection fees, whether it anticipates the pending review of the agency, and whether daily inspections of mink farms without findings are proportionate. The State Secretary answered that the fee increase follows existing cost-recovery policy independent of the review, that the review results were sent to Parliament that day, and that the inspections are based on several laws with enforcement findings still under analysis.
The results of this have been sent to your House today.
Over de uitkomsten hiervan is uw Kamer vandaag geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Lodders inzake de doorstroom van voortgezet speciaal onderwijs naar regulier voortgezet onderwijs

MPs Straus and Lodders asked the state secretary about a havo pupil whose examination results from special secondary education could not be carried over to regular secondary education, and how pupils transfer and are informed. The state secretary answered that results can be transferred if the receiving school has an exemption, that transfer need not cause delay, and that the specific case was resolved by granting such an exemption.
This has already happened. There was contact between the school and the Ministry of OCW to discuss this specific case.
Dit is reeds gebeurd. Er is contact geweest tussen de school en het Ministerie van OCW om deze specifieke casus te bespreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Bosma naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Strijd tegen kiloknaller gaat nieuwe ronde in’

MPs Lodders and Bosma asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal welfare group Wakker Dier changing its definition of 'kiloknaller' (cheap-meat promotions), which produced a 40 percent rise in such promotions in 2015. The State Secretary said Wakker Dier may adapt its definition but must communicate the change clearly to avoid misleading consumers, and that the public debate concerns the desirability of such promotions rather than the definition used.
It is not desirable that Wakker Dier misleads consumers.
Het is echter niet gewenst dat Wakker Dier consumenten op het verkeerde been zet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het aanmerken van een paardenmarkt als erkende verzamelplaats

An MP asked whether a horse market can be designated an approved assembly point under EU law, and on what conditions. The State Secretary answered that EU Directive 2009/156 allows only direct transport or transport via an approved assembly centre, sets requirements referenced from Directive 64/432, and that no approved horse assembly centres currently exist in the Netherlands while national rules are being developed in consultation with the sector.
At present, under European regulations, there are no approved horse assembly centres in the Netherlands.
Op dit moment zijn er op grond van Europese regelgeving geen erkende paardenverzamelcentra in Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders over het persbericht van de Europese Commissie van 14 maart, de toespraak van Commissaris Hogan tijdens de Landbouw- en Visserijraad van 14 maart jl. en het verslag van deze raad

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the European Commission's new agricultural market measures for dairy and pig farmers, the state aid increase, and the effect on the level playing field. The government answered that the Dutch presidency pushed for market-oriented measures, that the state aid rules are strict and require Commission approval, and that it sees no unfair distortion from the package.
There is no question of an additional support package of 500 million euros.
Er is geen sprake van een aanvullend steunpakket ter grootte van 500 miljoen euro.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Jonge Landbouwersregeling pakt totaal verkeerd uit’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs for a response to a press report that the Young Farmers scheme (EU CAP support) is going to family partnerships rather than individual young farmers, and where the subsidy ends up and how it reaches the right target group. The State Secretary says the EU definition allows partnerships, that the Netherlands voted against that clause, that changing it requires CAP reform, and that the provinces now run the scheme and can adjust it at the next opening.
Adjusting the definition will therefore only be possible with a revision of the CAP.
Aanpassing van de definitie zal derhalve pas mogelijk zijn bij een herziening van het GLB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘NVV, NVP en NMV stappen uit overleg PAS met ministerie van Economische Zaken’

MP Lodders asks why the agricultural unions NVV, NVP and NMV walked out of PAS talks with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and why a reserve package of generic measures was kept from the sector until late 2015 and not in the 2015 covenant. The State Secretary says the unions broke off the process before the planned spring 2016 administrative meeting, that the reserve package was only developed after the covenant, and that the covenant commitments on emissions and deposition space will be honoured, with a PAS progress report promised for April 2016.
I intend to inform the House in April of this year about the progress of the PAS.
Ik ben voornemens de Kamer in april van dit jaar te informeren over de voortgang van de PAS.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Veel fouten bij uitgaven EU-subsidies voor platteland’, de ‘Verdeling nationale envelop Europese middelen melkvee- en varkenshouderij.’ en de EU-trendrapportage va

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that most EU rural-development spending errors occur in rural and regional funds (estimated error rate 6.2%, against a 2% target), about the Court of Audit's EU trend report, and about how the national dairy and pig envelope is justified to the Commission. The State Secretary answered that the error rate is slightly declining, that error rates do not necessarily mean unlawful spending, that the Netherlands will push for the trend to continue, and that effectiveness and efficiency accountability is being developed under the Commission's Budget for Results agenda.
I will ask for attention to continuing the trend and further reducing the error rate in the Rural Development Committee.
Ik zal aandacht vragen voor het doorzetten van de trend en verdere verlaging van het foutenpercentage in het kader van het Plattelandscomité.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat gebruikt onkruidmiddel dat slecht is voor water’

MPs Lodders and Visser asked why Rijkswaterstaat may use glyphosate-based weedkiller (Roundup) on tree stumps in hydraulic structures when the planned pesticide ban would apply to everyone else, and what alternatives were considered. The minister answered that glyphosate remains legally permitted, that a planned exception for situations without feasible alternatives will be written into a ministerial regulation, and that the same rules will apply to all parties including Rijkswaterstaat.
Rijkswaterstaat uses plant protection products for stumps in hydraulic structures only when no feasible alternatives exist.
Rijkswaterstaat gebruikt alleen gewasbeschermingsmiddelen voor stobben in waterbouwkundige constructies als er geen uitvoerbare alternatieven zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het oneigenlijk gebruik van de pensioenknip

An MP asked the State Secretary about pension insurers that only offer the pension lump-sum option (pensioenknip) to their own members, and whether insurers should be pressed to accept outsiders and present balanced information. The State Secretary said insurers are not obliged to issue offers to outside members due to contractual freedom, but committed to raise the matter with the Verbond van Verzekeraars and to keep monitoring information provision.
I will raise this point again with the Verbond van Verzekeraars to encourage insurers to treat requests for the pension lump-sum option in a benevolent manner.
Ik zal dit punt nogmaals bespreken met het Verbond van Verzekeraars om te bevorderen dat verzekeraars welwillend omgaan met verzoeken voor de pensioenknip.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over elektronische monitoring van ammoniak

MP Lodders (VVD) asked why the government will not grant pig farmers a few months' delay in mandatory electronic monitoring of ammonia scrubbers, given their financial distress and sector revitalisation effort, and whether the Minister would stop new measures. The State Secretary refused the delay, saying it would reward non-compliance with long-known rules, while pointing to the sector's structural problems, a 30 million euro EU support envelope and ongoing dialogue on reducing regulatory burden without compromising environmental standards.

Even though the request would be broadly supported, it is a wrong signal to reward, a few weeks before the end of the transition period, those who did not prepare for new regulations that have been known for a long time.

Ondanks dat het verzoek breed gedragen zou zijn, is het een verkeerd signaal om enkele weken voor het einde van de overgangstermijn degenen te belonen zich niet hebben voorbereid op nieuwe regelgeving die al geruime tijd bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders over het bericht ‘Uitleg over de discardban’

MPs Visser and Lodders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about fishing-sector uncertainty over the landing obligation (discard ban) from 1 January 2016 and about NVWA statements that it would not disclose enforcement strategy in advance. The State Secretary replied that a step-by-step plan and information sessions provide clarity, that the NVWA's enforcement details are not disclosed in advance as usual, and that the NVWA engages constructively with the sector.
It is not customary to provide information about this in advance.
Het is niet gebruikelijk dat hierover vooraf informatie wordt verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over concurrentieverstoring door subsidieregelingen

Two VVD MPs asked whether the subsidy to LTO for the 'beveilig mijn boerenbedrijf' project led to only one supplier being chosen per product, and whether subsidy rules should require multiple suppliers. The minister confirmed LTO selected the suppliers itself and said the government sees no need for supplier-selection rules in specific subsidy schemes beyond existing competition law.
The cabinet sees no reason to set rules in specific subsidy schemes in this area, beyond the applicable competition laws and regulations.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om, naast de geldende wet- en regelgeving ter bevordering van concurrentie, op dat terrein ook regels te stellen in specifieke subsidieregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitspraken van het Europees Hof dat reistijd gezien moet worden als werktijd

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how the European Court ruling that travel time to and from a job counts as working time affects the NVWA food safety authority, its tariffs, inspection numbers and efficiency. The State Secretary answered that the ruling has no direct effect on the NVWA, its tariffs or its inspection volume, that the consequences will be considered in negotiations with unions, and that efficiency measures such as team reductions and regionalisation are ongoing.
The ruling in question as such has no significance for the NVWA.
De onderhavige uitspraak als zodanig heeft geen betekenis voor de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht “Foute melding claimt ruimte”

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that about 70 percent of PAS notifications in Overijssel were incorrect, incomplete or unjustified, and about the reasons, national scope, and consequences. The government attributes the errors mainly to initiators' unfamiliarity with PAS rules, says incorrect entries will be removed and corrected notifications submitted, and says controls will continue.
Responsibility for the correctness and completeness of the notification lies primarily with the submitter.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de juistheid en volledigheid van de melding ligt primair bij de indiener.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over een nieuwe Europese richtlijn over antibioticagebruik

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked whether the new EU antibiotic guidelines for animal husbandry fall short of Dutch rules and how the Netherlands will push for stronger EU action during its presidency. The State Secretary replied that the guidelines are non-binding, draw on Dutch experience, and that the Netherlands will advocate stricter EU rules and raise the issue at a February ministerial conference.
I agree with you that the approach to antibiotic resistance must be addressed at European level.
Ik deel met u dat de aanpak van antibioticaresistentie op Europees niveau moet worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan een pluimveeslachterij op 19 oktober 2015

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked why the NVWA refused the poultry sector's request to keep slaughterhouses running on 26 and 27 December, and why it handled the request slowly and charged waiting costs to the company. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA allowed a one-time exception for 26 December with conditions, that the sector was informed, and that the claim procedure for NVWA-caused losses exists.
The NVWA will allow poultry slaughterhouses, on a one-time basis, to submit applications for inspections on Saturday 26 December (Second Christmas Day).
De NVWA zal eenmalig voor pluimveeslachterijen toestaan om aanvragen voor keuringen op zaterdag 26 december (Tweede Kerstdag) in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over de berichtgeving ‘Dinkelland tegen besluit EZ over Natura 2000’ en ‘Geen naaldbossen in Twente’

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports that Dinkelland opposed an EZ Natura 2000 measure, including planting coniferous forest in a buffer zone after an interim AERIUS update. The State Secretary acknowledged local unrest, said the measure was revised after consultation to drop the conifer planting and reduce its scope, and defended the AERIUS update as necessary for the PAS's legal soundness.
After the public inspection period (TIL), the measure was reassessed, partly in light of questions about its usefulness and necessity.
Na de ter inzage legging (TIL) is de maatregel, mede in het licht van de vragen over nut en noodzaak, opnieuw beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van ’t Wout over het bericht “France offers new farm aid as 1,500 tractors hit Paris streets”

MPs Lodders and Van 't Wout asked about reports that the French government would freeze implementation of new, mainly environmental, rules for livestock farming, and whether this distorts the EU level playing field. The government answered that the French moratorium until 1 February 2016 only checks for national rules stricter than EU requirements, that EU implementation is not frozen, and that the Netherlands has pressed for European rather than national action.
A specification of possibly stricter national measures cannot be given at this stage, as the French government's review has not yet been completed.
Een specificering van mogelijk stringentere nationale maatregelen is in dit stadium is niet te geven, daar de toetsing door de Franse overheid nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Diervriendelijke subsidiepotjes’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how EU agricultural subsidy funds of 29.94 million euro support market position, cost control, competitiveness and exports, and whether they fund environmental measures or weidevogel conservation without evidence. The State Secretary answers that the funds support dairy and pig sector sustainability, manure processing and competitiveness, that no funds go to stable environmental measures, and that weidevogel spending is justified by scientific studies and practical experience, with details to follow in a letter to parliament.
I have informed you about this in my letter to the House of Representatives of 24 September.
Ik heb u hierover geïnformeerd in mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 24 september jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders en Dijkgraaf over het openbaar maken van meetdata ammoniak door Wageningen Universiteit

MPs Geurts, Lodders and Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary whether Wageningen University should publish its ammonia measurement data and calculation methods behind manure emission factors, citing an international review's call for free data availability. The state secretary said the research was published and reviewed, that Wageningen UR is willing to share underlying data and show calculations to critics, and that older data from the 1990s no longer exists under the five-year retention rule, and declined to request further disclosure.

Since 1 January 2005 it has been customary to retain research data for 5 years, in accordance with the rules of the Dutch Code of Conduct for Research Integrity of the Association of Universities (VSNU).

Het is sinds 1 januari 2005 gebruikelijk om onderzoeksgegevens 5 jaar te bewaren, conform de hiervoor geldende regels vanuit de Nederlandse Gedragscode Wetenschapsbeoefening van de Vereniging van Universiteiten (VSNU).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over pensioenopbouw van medisch specialisten

An MP asked whether the pension cap in the Witteveen Act treats full-time doctors working over 40 hours unfairly compared with those working 36 or 38 hours, and why no exception was made. The State Secretary answered that there is no statutory full-time threshold, that the cap is pro-rated for part-time work to prevent splitting contracts, and that changing the law is not desirable.
I therefore do not consider an amendment of the law desirable.
Een aanpassing van de wet acht ik daarom niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de evaluatie vogelgriep 2014

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the delayed evaluation of the 2014 avian influenza outbreak response, the urgency before the migration season, and whether recent foreign outbreaks and EU-level standards would be addressed. The State Secretary answered that the report is delayed and will be sent to parliament with a policy response this month, while referring to expert advice and the Beleidsdraaiboek and stating EU rules set the minimum measures.
The report will be completed this month. I will send it to your House, with my policy response, after completion.
Het rapport wordt deze maand afgerond. Ik zal uw Kamer het rapport, voorzien van mijn beleidsreactie, na afronding toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voortgang van het Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS)

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Programme Aanpak Stikstof (PAS), including a three-month deadline for reporting herd expansions, its effect on farmers, administrative burden, a consultation meeting and a helpdesk. The State Secretary defends the three-month notification window to prevent speculative reporting, says the PAS takes farmers' interests into account, claims it reduces administrative burden, and points to a helpdesk for general questions.
A time limit has been prescribed to prevent activities being reported that are never realised.
Er is een termijn voorgeschreven om te voorkomen dat activiteiten worden gemeld, die nooit worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voortgang van het Programma Aanpak Stikstof

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the mandatory AERIUS Calculator was offline, whether permits could be issued from 1 July, what the economic harm and remedies would be, and how this fits with growth ambitions. The State Secretary said the calculator was unavailable 9-30 June for adjustments, will be available from 1 July, that development space is limited to protect Natura 2000 habitats, and that a stakeholder meeting was held on 29 June.
The AERIUS Calculator was not available from 9 to 30 June.
AERIUS Calculator was van 9 t/m 30 juni niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Lodders inzake schade door waterplanten

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about waterplant obstructions on the Zuidelijke Randmeren, including a rescue boat hampered during a storm, and whether incidents are tracked and what maintenance responsibilities apply. The Minister confirmed the incidents, reported 9 waterplant-related incidents nationally in 2012-2014 (2 significant), said safety comes first and fairway maintenance is Rijkswaterstaat's responsibility while other maintenance lies with third parties, and committed to monitoring developments without further inquiry.
Given the low number of significant accidents and the fact that shipping routes are regularly available, I see no reason to make further inquiries.
Gezien het lage aantal significante ongevallen en het feit dat de scheepvaartroutes regulier beschikbaar zijn zie ik geen aanleiding hier verdere navraag te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser naar aanleiding van de acties van de Franse boeren

VVD MPs Lodders and Visser asked ministers about French farmers' blockades that disrupted Dutch transport, the lack of French police action, damages, state aid and whether Dutch inspections could allow derogations from driving-time rules. The government condemned the actions, protested to France and the Commission, said damages are a civil matter, and said it would raise the issue at the 7 September Agriculture Council.
We condemn these actions. Like the Spanish government, the Netherlands has also protested.
Wij keuren deze acties af. Net als de Spaanse regering heeft ook Nederland geprotesteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over de subsidieregeling beveiliging agrarische bedrijven

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked whether a subsidy scheme for securing agricultural businesses favours a single supplier, distorting competition and consumer choice. The minister answered that a one-off subsidy went to the LTO Nederland farmers' organisation, which selected six products and suppliers based on a member survey, and that farmers remain free to choose other products.
A one-off subsidy was granted to the Land- en Tuinbouworganisatie (LTO Nederland) for a project aimed at raising awareness of the risk of falling victim to crime among agricultural entrepreneurs.

Er is een eenmalige subsidie toegekend aan de Land- en Tuinbouworganisatie (LTO Nederland) voor een project dat is gericht op de bewustwording van risico's op slachtofferschap van criminaliteit bij agrarische ondernemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de natuurontwikkeling op Texel, zoals het Gebied Dorpzicht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about nature development on Texel (Dorpzicht), the conversion of permanent grassland for nature, and whether natural managers are subject to the same grassland-retention rules as farmers. The State Secretary confirmed the situation, said permanent grassland can still count after conversion, and said nature managers receiving first-pillar CAP support are bound by the same rules, while exact hectare figures are still being compiled by RVO.
As soon as the outcomes are known, I will inform the House about this.
Zodra de uitkomsten hiervan bekend zijn, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht «Meitelling door ruim de helft nog niet ingediend» en de brief van de Nederlandse Melkveehouders Vakbond (NMV)

An MP asked about reports that over half of farmers had not yet submitted the 2015 Gecombineerde Opgave, and about the NMV's concerns over RVO's information provision and accessibility. The Secretary of State said the deadline was extended, RVO maintains contact with the sector, extra call-centre capacity was added, and she rejects a direct link between the submission backlog and RVO's accessibility.
RVO has in the meantime made contact with the NMV so that they could further explain their concerns.
RVO heeft inmiddels contact gelegd met de NMV zodat zij hun zorgen verder hebben kunnen toelichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Teeven over de berichten “Welzijn scharrelvarken niet beter dan gangbaar” en “Welzijn straalt uit naar buren”

MPs Lodders and Teeven (VVD) asked whether animal welfare standards in the EU and in Denmark and Germany are raising Dutch pig farming costs and weakening competitiveness, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that Dutch production costs are only modestly above EU peers, mostly due to environmental rules, and that the government will push for EU-level welfare standards and innovation without unilateral tightening.
I am in favour of tightening animal welfare requirements at European level because of the consequences for the competitiveness and future prospects of the Dutch pig sector.
Ik ben voorstander van het aanscherpen van dierwelzijnseisen op Europees niveau vanwege de gevolgen voor de concurrentiepositie en het toekomstperspectief van de Nederlandse varkenssector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichtgeving “Suzuki-fruitvlieg hele winter op grote schaal actief gebleven” en “Suzuki-fruitvlieg”

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that the Suzuki fruit fly survived winter and threatens the harvest, including requests for emergency exemptions for pesticides such as Tracer for cherry growers. The State Secretary answered that exemptions for Exirel and Tracer on cherries have been granted or decided and that the government will pursue a long-term EU-level solution.
I support a joint European approach, which I also advocated in the Agriculture and Fisheries Council, in which the sector is also actively involved.
Ik steun een gezamenlijke Europese aanpak, waar ik ook voor heb gepleit in de Landbouw en Visserijraad, waarbij ook de sector actief is betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht “Ministeries zijn het nog niet eens over alle details in Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof”

MPs Lodders and Visser asked whether ministries disagree on details of the Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof and whether new recalculations are needed, with consequences for timing and consultation. The State Secretary answers that the Rijk and 12 provinces reached agreement on finalising the programme, with entry into force on 1 July 2015 and a partial amendment by 15 December 2015 after an AERIUS Monitor update, subject to public consultation.
The Rijk and the 12 provinces have reached agreement on the finalisation and entry into force of the programme aanpak stikstof.
Het Rijk en de 12 provincies hebben overeenstemming bereikt over de afronding en inwerkingtreding van het programma aanpak stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht dat het beheer en de uitvoering van pensioenvermogens steeds vaker in het buitenland plaatsvinden

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that pension management and administration increasingly takes place abroad, including questions on salary rules, companies moving pension administration to Belgium, and cross-border PPI activity. The State Secretary answered that existing pension remuneration rules apply regardless of location, that Dutch supervisors (DNB, AFM) and employee councils retain oversight of cross-border transfers, and that the PPI's cross-border scope will be evaluated again in three years.
In the aforementioned answer to parliamentary questions from MP Vermeij I addressed the safeguards in place for this.
Bij de hiervoor genoemde beantwoording van Kamervragen van het lid Vermeij ben ik ingegaan op de waarborgen die hiervoor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voorkeursbehandeling van jongeren, vrouwen en allochtonen in pensioenfondsbesturen

An MP asked the state secretary whether solidarity and union representativeness justify preferential treatment of young people, women and ethnic minorities on pension fund boards. The state secretary answered that diversity should reflect the membership base while expertise comes first, and that union involvement follows from collective bargaining rather than representativeness.
Not all forms of solidarity need to be reflected in pension scheme board composition.
Niet alle vormen van solidariteit hoeven bij pensioenregelingen tot uiting te komen in de bestuurssamenstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het gebruik van mineralenconcentraat (verkregen uit mestverwerking) als kunstmestvervanger binnen de EU

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether manure-derived mineral concentrate should be allowed as a fertiliser substitute outside the Nitrates Directive manure standard, what steps had been taken with the European Commission, and whether the Commission's refusal frustrates Dutch innovation. The State Secretary replied that the Nitrates Directive currently only permits use within the 170 kg nitrogen per hectare standard, that she is pursuing three tracks (EU fertiliser framework changes, circular economy discussions, and expanding the pilot toward derogation), and that the pilot entered a new phase on 1 January 2015.
I am currently concentrating on the three tracks already named in the answer to questions 1 and 2.
Ik concentreer mij op dit moment op de in het antwoord op vraag 1 en 2 al benoemde drie sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over vleesaanbiedingen onder de € 4,12 per kilo zonder dierenwelzijnskeurmerk

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why policy on cheap meat offers below 4.12 euro per kilo without an animal welfare label relies on unverified Wakker Dier figures, and how a 'reasonable price' is defined. The State Secretary largely referred to earlier answers, said policy is not based on Wakker Dier data, that price is set by market supply and demand, and pointed to existing price monitoring reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries en Ziengs over regeldrift

MPs asked whether the government finds it acceptable that insurers demand extensive documents from employers before advising on pension schemes, given the aim to cut administrative burden. The minister says the Wft uses open norms, the AFM guidelines are not a checklist, the burden is hard to estimate and is not tracked, and the Actal study on financial-sector regulation will examine similar cases.
Because there are various ways to gather information from the client, the administrative burden arising from this cannot be reliably estimated.
Vanwege de verschillende mogelijkheden om informatie bij de klant in te winnen zijn de administratieve lasten die hieruit voortkomen niet goed in te schatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman, Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over de beoordeling van luchtkwaliteit bij plattelandswoningen

MPs Veldman, Lodders and Dijkstra asked the minister why air quality (fine dust) must be assessed for former farm dwellings occupied by third parties, unlike active farm housing, and whether exemptions or flexibility are possible. The minister explains that EU air quality rules apply except at workplaces, that the Council of State ruling requires assessment for former farm homes, and promises to explore flexibility, including a provision in the future Environment Quality Decree under the Omgevingswet.
However, I will examine whether there are other possibilities to achieve nuance and flexibility.
Wel zal ik nagaan of er anderszins mogelijkheden zijn om te komen tot nuancering en flexibilisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voorkeursbehandeling van jongeren, vrouwen en allochtonen in pensioenfondsbesturen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether the FNV's plan to give priority to young people, women and immigrants in appointments to pension fund boards is acceptable, and questions the representativeness of unions on such boards. The State Secretary answers that preferential treatment by reserved seats is not allowed under equal treatment rules, that expertise and diversity can coexist, and that union board seats follow statutory arrangements for balancing the interests of all participants.
That means no board seats may be reserved for young people, women or immigrants.
Dat betekent dat er geen bestuurszetels gereserveerd mogen worden voor jongeren, vrouwen of allochtonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het afgeven van exportcertificaten door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) op zaterdag

An MP asked whether the NVWA's refusal to issue export certificates on Saturdays hurts Topigs Norsvin's competitiveness and asked for weekend certification. The state secretary replied that the NVWA already offers Saturday certification on request, subject to additional conditions for out-of-hours requests.
The NVWA does, in line with its planning framework, indeed offer the possibility of export certification on Saturday for companies that wish it.
Antwoord 3 De NVWA biedt, conform haar planningskader 1 , wel degelijk de mogelijkheid tot exportcertificering op zaterdag voor bedrijven die dat wensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over steun voor de varkenssector

An MP asks why the Netherlands abstained on the Commission's private storage scheme for pork, whether it will oppose the measure, and about its costs, market effects and seasonal fit. The Secretary of State says the Netherlands supported private storage given low prices but abstained because the Commission refused early release, that the scheme is funded from the EU agricultural guarantee fund, and that the Netherlands is willing to support it while preferring a different design.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over “vleesaanbiedingen onder € 4,12 per kilo zonder dierenwelzijnskeurmerk”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs why she based her stance against meat offers below 4.12 euro per kilo without an animal welfare label on Wakker Dier's unverified figures, and asked for supporting data and comments on the sector. The state secretary answered that such offers are undesirable as a signal and for welfare and food safety reasons, that the ministry does not verify the Wakker Dier figures and conducts no own supermarket research, and that discounting near expiry is acceptable as it prevents food waste.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs does not conduct its own research into offers in supermarkets.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken voert geen eigen onderzoek uit naar aanbiedingen in supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van de Aukje de Vries en Lodders over bankfinanciering in relatie tot muizenschade in Fryslân

MPs asked whether Deutsche Bank takes a stricter line than Rabobank toward farmers suffering vole damage in Fryslân, and whether the minister would raise this with Deutsche Bank and survey other banks' financing problems. The government answered that Deutsche Bank's affected client base is too small to show a specific policy, that complaints unrelated to its strategic reorientation must be filed by clients themselves, and that the State Secretary is consulting banks and regions and examining a guarantee scheme for residual hardship cases.

As I indicated in my letter of 29 January and as agreed with your House, I will continue to bring complaints that are the direct result of Deutsche Bank Nederland's strategic reorientation directly to the attention of its Management Board.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 29 januari jl. heb aangegeven en ook met uw Kamer heb afgesproken, zal ik klachten die het directe gevolg zijn van de strategische heroriëntatie van Deutsche Bank Nederland rechtstreeks onder de aandacht blijven brengen van de Raad van Bestuur van Deutsche Bank Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de premiepercentages bij een pensioenrichtleeftijd lager dan 67 jaar

An MP asks whether pension schemes with an entry date on the first of the month the member turns 67 must be recalculated under the Witteveen framework and at what cost. The state secretaries confirm recalculation is required where the full fiscal room is used, but grant a temporary two-year exemption from actuarial recalculation for these schemes to ease administrative burden.
It is not known how many pension schemes this issue affects.
Het is niet bekend bij hoeveel pensioenregelingen deze problematiek speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Storing op mijnRVO.nl’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an outage on the RVO.nl portal that prevented dairy farmers from viewing their phosphate reference values before the 1 February 2015 deadline, and whether the deadline would be extended. The State Secretary confirmed the technical outage lasted from 14 to 15 January, described smaller ongoing glitches, and extended the phosphate reference objection period by two weeks to 13 February 2015.
To accommodate the entrepreneurs, I have decided to extend the response period for the phosphate reference value by two weeks, until Friday 13 February 2015.
Om de ondernemers tegemoet te komen heb ik besloten om de reactietermijn voor de fosfaatreferentiewaarde met twee weken te verlengen tot en met vrijdag 13 februari 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Geurts en De Rouwe over de toename, omvang en gevolgen van muizenschade in Friesland

MPs asked the state secretary about the growth and damage of mouse plagues in Friesland, the ban on ploughing grassland, the risk to dykes, and possible derogations from the Nitrates Directive action programme. The state secretary referred to earlier letters on most questions, said the ploughing ban rests on both environmental and agronomic considerations, and noted that nitrate levels in the affected area are well below the norm.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to my letter of 27 January 2015
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar mijn brief van 27 januari 2015
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het goed samengaan van natuur en veehouderij

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a Wageningen/Dienst Landelijk Gebied study finding no negative link between farming and nature in Noordoost-Twente applies more widely, and what the government has done with it. The State Secretary answered that the study does not address ammonia deposition, that the findings are not representative of rural Netherlands in general, and that no follow-up study is planned.
I do not consider a follow-up study useful, because the research design is not suitable to support the conclusions drawn.
Een vervolgonderzoek acht ik niet zinvol, omdat de onderzoeksopzet niet geschikt is om de getrokken conclusies mee te onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de extra kosten door ammoniakbeleid

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the state secretary about the extra costs of proposed ammonia rules for livestock farms, the effect on consumer prices, the sector's ability to bear the burden, and the comparison with EU Member States under the NEC directive. The state secretary answered that per-farm costs are hard to average since rules apply only to new or substantially expanded barns (at most 3% annual extra cost), cannot estimate consumer price effects, notes Dutch reduction targets are lower than the EU average, and says the position on the Commission proposal will follow later this year.
No, I cannot indicate how much more consumers will on average pay and to what extent comparable extra costs were passed on to consumers in the past.
Nee, ik kan niet aangeven hoeveel meer geld de consument gemiddeld gaat betalen en in hoeverre vergelijkbare extra kosten in het verleden zijn doorberekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de overlast veroorzaakt door ratten

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about rising rat nuisance, the effects of the 2014 ban on outdoor use of rodenticides, the status of the European pest management standard, and prevention plans. The government answered that rat reports rose from 2012 and the ban was partly reversed under conditions requiring Integrated Pest Management certification, with a transition period to 2017.
I will make an effort to ensure that this process is organised efficiently and cost-effectively.
Ik zal me inspannen om te zorgen dat dit proces efficiënt en kosteneffectief ingericht wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over een nieuw vogelpesttype in Duitsland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the H5N8 bird flu outbreak in Germany, its effects on Dutch poultry, steps taken since last year, research on free-range risk, industry involvement, and oversight after the abolition of the product boards. The answers describe culling and a protection zone, a mandatory second cleaning of returning trucks, a CVI risk study to be sent to parliament early next year, and state takeover of public tasks while cleaning remains an industry responsibility.
I will inform your House early next year about the results.
Ik zal uw Kamer begin volgend jaar informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over de relatie tussen ammoniakuitstoot en emissiearme bemesting

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked whether measurement data cast doubt on the link between low-emission manure application and ammonia emissions, and whether the NEMA emission model was sound. The State Secretary answered that the scientific basis of ammonia policy was reviewed internationally without doubts, that the CDM was asked for a quick scan of the significant trend difference, and that Dutch ammonia measures are a national choice within EU ceilings.
Thereupon I asked the Expert Committee on the Fertilisers Act (CDM) to prepare a quick scan to explain the difference between the trends.
Daarop heb ik de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet (CDM) gevraagd een quick scan op te stellen om het verschil tussen de trends te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en De Liefde over de opkomst van de suzuki-fruitvlieg

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the spread of the suzuki fruit fly, its damage to Dutch growers, control options such as parasitic nematodes, and the authorisation of the pesticide Tracer. The State Secretary answered that the sector is responsible for pest control, that the damage is estimated at 2 to 20 percent of unsaleable fruit without exact measurement, that small-scale trials of nematodes are underway, and that Tracer was authorised for some crops but refused for cherries.
The sector is itself responsible for combating diseases and pests in crops and also accepts this responsibility.
De sector is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de bestrijding van ziekten en plagen in gewassen en neemt deze verantwoordelijkheid ook op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over muizenschade bij boeren

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked whether farmers suffering vole damage not compensated by the Faunafonds can be helped, including a derogation from the grassland-ploughing ban and an adjusted nitrates calamity scheme. The state secretary refused a derogation, said grassland may be ploughed from 1 February 2015, and stated the planned calamity scheme does not cover vole damage and that no further policy is foreseen.
I have informed the province of Friesland that I do not intend to grant an exemption from the ban on ploughing grassland.
Ik heb de provincie Friesland er van op de hoogte gebracht dat ik niet voornemens ben een ontheffing op het verbod op het scheuren van grasland te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de toelating van eieren van Avangardco op de Europese interne markt

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the EU approval of Avangardco egg products, the welfare conditions of its laying hens, and whether the Netherlands will act in the Council and on a sector masterplan. The State Secretary says EU approval was procedurally sound, opposed duty-free Ukrainian egg imports at the committee vote, asked the Commission to press Ukraine on welfare reform, and declines to draw up a sector masterplan.
I have no information about the precise production conditions at Avangardco.
Over de precieze productieomstandigheden van Avangardco heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over provinciale besluitvorming met betrekking tot stikstofdepositie

An MP asks the State Secretary about Drenthe withdrawing its Beleidskader Stikstof 2.0, the number of firms stuck by nitrogen policy, how other provinces handle permits while the PAS is unavailable, and the transitional rule in the PAS amendment. The State Secretary confirms the withdrawal on Raad van State rulings, says the exact number of stuck firms is unknown, notes the Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 governs permits, and promises to inform the Chamber soon about PAS progress.
The exact number of firms per province in a deadlock due to the nitrogen policy is not known to me.
Het exacte aantal bedrijven per provincie, dat in een impasse verkeert ten gevolge van het gevoerde ammoniakbeleid, is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Dijkgraaf over het bericht ‘Alleen ruimen bij risico voor volksgezondheid’

MPs Lodders (VVD) and Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the NVWA failed to inform veterinarians directly about the furazolidon contamination incident and how farmers and industry bodies were informed, and whether the substance is freely available. The State Secretary replied that SMS alerts, the NVWA website, a beschikking to affected farmers and three information meetings with industry bodies were used, and that furazolidon is not available everywhere.
These remarks are taken into account by the NVWA in the evaluation of this furazolidon incident.
Deze opmerkingen worden door de NVWA meegenomen bij de evaluatie van dit incident met furazolidon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over de aanwijzing Binnenveld in Veenendaal als Natura 2000-gebied

MPs Heerema and Lodders asked the State Secretary about the designation of Binnenveld in Veenendaal as a Natura 2000 area, including the municipality's appeal, the feasibility of the management plan and its economic consequences for farmers. The State Secretary answered that the designation stands, the management plan is delegated to the provinces and water board and expected in September, and that the economic consequences will be assessed within that plan.
The designation decision only concerns the boundary of the area and the setting of the conservation objectives.
Het aanwijzingsbesluit betreft alleen de begrenzing van het gebied en de vaststelling van de instandhoudingsdoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht «Inloggen op mijn.rvo.nl verandert»

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about changes to the login method for mijn.rvo.nl, including late notice to entrepreneurs, the readiness of the new system, the transition period, the costs of eHerkenning certificates, and the consequences for those who cannot switch in time. The minister answered that eHerkenning has been in use for years, that the transition runs over six months with the old credentials phased out, that RVO does not charge subscription fees, and that the government has a responsibility to avoid unequal conditions with the private sector.
The start date of 1 July will therefore not be postponed.
De ingangsdatum van 1 juli wordt dus niet opgeschort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Stikstofdepositie op natuur veel lager dan verondersteld’

An MP asks the State Secretary whether RIVM measurements of nitrogen deposition on nature are much lower than modelled, whether the 70 percent model uncertainty undermines ammonia policy, and whether policy should rely on measurements instead. The government answers that models are needed for nationwide and forward-looking coverage, that measurements validate the models, that ammonia concentrations fell about 20 percent since the 1990s but no longer decline, and that a CDM-led investigation into the trend discrepancy has been commissioned with results promised soon.

Following RIVM signals that the trend in calculated ammonia emissions is not supported by the measurements, we recently commissioned the Expert Committee on Manure Policy (CDM) to conduct further research with RIVM.

Naar aanleiding van signalen van het RIVM dat de trend in de berekende ammoniakemissies niet ondersteund wordt door de metingen, hebben wij onlangs de Commissie Deskundigen Mestbeleid (CDM) de opdracht gegeven samen met het RIVM nader onderzoek te doen
