Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Lodders en Geurts over het rapport van Watermaatschappij Limburg over mogelijke overschatting van nitraatgehaltes in lössgrond

Three MPs asked the State Secretary about a Watermaatschappij Limburg report suggesting nitrate levels in loess soil may be overestimated by about 30% compared with RIVM's method, and whether this affects loess-soil use standards and EU reporting. The State Secretary answered that the report rests on a very small dataset, that the nationwide monitoring network (LMM) and model calculations still show concentrations above the 50 mg/l target, that WML and RIVM will discuss the methodology, and that a pilot with equivalent measures in loess areas is viewed positively.
RIVM and WML will soon enter into discussion about the methodology of nitrate measurements.
RIVM en WML gaan op korte termijn in gesprek over de methodiek van nitraatmetingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht dat de vrijstelling van de pensioenpremie voor gelegenheidswerkers onder druk staat

MPs Lodders and Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga asked whether the pension premium exemption for short-term agricultural casual workers conflicts with equal treatment law, and what it costs employers if the exemption ends. The Secretary of State says the courts will decide, that social partners have reached a principle agreement subject to legal review, and that the ministry's role is limited to amending the compulsory affiliation scheme.
Whether the pension premium exemption for casual workers is or is not contrary to the law is ultimately a matter for the courts.
Of de vrijstelling van pensioenpremie bij gelegenheidswerkers al dan niet in strijd met de wet is, is uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over ‘Varkensexport lijdt onder capaciteitsprobleem NVWA’

MP Lodders (VVD) asked whether the NVWA lacks vets to carry out all requested pig export inspections at farms, with consequences for animal welfare, health and exports, and what the cost is for businesses. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the stricter inspection regime causes temporary vet shortages on peak days, with 51 inspections postponed in one period, that welfare is not affected, and that twenty extra vets are being trained to solve the capacity problem by the second half of 2014.
It is expected that the twenty veterinarians will have completed the full training programme and be operational in the second half of 2014, at which point the capacity problem will be resolved.

Naar verwachting zullen de twintig dierenartsen in de tweede helft van 2014 het volledige opleidingstraject afgerond hebben en operationeel zijn, waarmee het capaciteitsprobleem dan zal zijn opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht «Boeren en waterschappen koppelen grondgebruik aan waterbeheer»

MPs Lodders and Visser asked about reports that farmers and water boards are launching 30 new area projects under the Deltaplan Agrarisch Waterbeheer, and whether this creates overlapping regulation with the Nitrates Directive and crop protection rules. The State Secretary answered that LTO leads the initiative with water boards, that the government plays a supporting role, and that equivalent measures could give farmers exemptions from generic use norms from 2015, without adding new binding regulation.
I do not foresee that this will lead to an accumulation of regulation.
Ik voorzie niet dat dit leidt tot een stapeling van regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Dijksma zegt nee tegen Basamid’

An MP asks why the State Secretary for Economic Affairs refused to sign the exemption request for the pesticide Basamid, and about its impact on Dutch growers and exports. The government answers that the Ctgb advised against the exemption due to formaldehyde risks to users and bystanders, that the state secretary weighted human health above agricultural interest, and that economic effects cannot be precisely quantified.
In my assessment I gave more weight to the seriousness of the risk to humans than to the agricultural interest.
In mijn afweging heb ik de ernst van het risico voor de mens zwaarder laten wegen dan het landbouwkundige belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders, Visser en De Liefde over het einde aan de betutteling van het milieubeleid

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government's Duurzaam Doen website and planned environmental measures amount to an end to paternalism in environmental policy, and about its cost, related initiatives, and the basis for recommending meat reduction. The minister answered that the site offers practical guidance rather than mandates, cost about 49,909 euros, that similar initiatives exist, and that reducing meat consumption benefits health and sustainability per official reports.
The cabinet wants to make use of the energy and ambitions that many parties and residents in our country have in the area of environment and sustainability.
Het kabinet wil gebruik maken van de energie en ambities die veel partijen en bewoners in ons land hebben op het gebied van milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders naar aanleiding van het Volkskrant artikel getiteld “Wolf krijgt ‘verblijfsvergunning”

MPs Heerema and Lodders asked why the wolf should receive legal protection and what effect wolf damage claims would have on the Faunafonds, which may lack funds for goose damage. The State Secretary answered that provinces requested clarity on the wolf's status so they can use their management powers, that the Faunafonds is provincially responsibility and expected only relatively small wolf damage costs, and that the fund has no ceiling on compensation.
It is up to the provinces to give a judgement on that.
Het is aan de provincies daarover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren Dinkelland halen gelijk bij Raad van State

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Council of State ruling that the Dinkelland Natura 2000 designation, including an agricultural enclave, was insufficiently motivated and that the boundary should not expand the area. The government answered that it will supplement the motivation as the court requested, denies that compensation for De Vetpot was required, and maintains the enclave is necessary for conservation goals without changing the management plan.
I will, in line with the interim judgment of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State, still motivate the decision adequately.
Ik zal conform het tussenvonnis van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State het besluit alsnog toereikend motiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘LTO wil snelle oplossing stuifbestrijding’

MP Lodders asks why no permanent solution for dust control (stuifbestrijding) has yet been reached despite a commitment last summer, and whether the delay tied to the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme requires a faster national fix for arable farmers, and asks about the economic damage including a claimed 2 million euro loss for sugar beet. The State Secretary replies that the fifth programme proposes a structural exemption for cattle slurry on arable land in the peat-colony areas and Texel from 2015, that a transitional arrangement for 2014 has been published and is in force, and that she knows of no damage incurred before the transitional arrangement took effect.
In anticipation of this structural arrangement, I have put in place a transitional arrangement for this year.
Vooruitlopend op deze structurele voorziening heb ik voor dit jaar een overgangsregeling getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Noorden verwacht dassenexplosie’

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a report predicting a sharp badger population increase in the north, with uncompensated damage and financing concerns. The government said badger management and damage financing are provincial responsibilities, rejected the comparison with goose problems, and reported an approved relocation of a badger family in Cuijk.
The province is responsible for management and damage control.
De provincie gaat over beheer en schadebestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over terugroepactie sleurt vleesbedrijven mee

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the NVWA's recall of Van Hattem Vlees meat threatens dozens of other small and medium meat companies and whether the NVWA considered that. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA was obliged under EU law to recall untraceable meat, that businesses bear responsibility for traceability, and that food safety comes first.
The NVWA was therefore obliged under European legislation to declare the meat unfit for human consumption and to order the company to remove it from the market as a precaution.

De NVWA was daarom op grond van Europese wetgeving genoodzaakt het vlees als niet geschikt voor humane consumptie aan te merken en het bedrijf te sommeren om dit uit voorzorg van de markt te laten halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht Recall Van Hattem kan beperkter

MP Lodders asked why the NVWA apparently moved from demanding a full recall of Van Hattem meat to a more nuanced stance, and what this means for 55 meat businesses. The State Secretary replied that the NVWA's position has not changed: companies that can prove full traceability and legal compliance need not recall meat, with the burden of proof on the business, and that the consequences vary per firm.
Moreover, there is no question of a changed position of the NVWA.
Ook is er geen sprake van een veranderde opstelling van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Neppérus over het bericht dat varkenshouders teleurgesteld zijn in EZ

Two VVD MPs asked why the loose-housing sow stall with feeding stalls was excluded from the Maatlat duurzame veehouderij, thereby losing access to MIA and Vamil tax schemes, and whether the ministry should be making such system choices. The state secretary answered that the exclusion reflects that this system is now the legal minimum for group housing of sows, that the scheme is meant to reward above-standard innovators, and that varkenshouders can still qualify through other housing types, so no change is planned.
It is an entrepreneur's decision which housing system is chosen.
Het is een ondernemersbeslissing welk huisvestingssysteem wordt gekozen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over waardeoverdracht

An MP from the VVD asks the state secretary for Social Affairs about the situations in which pension value transfer is possible, its size and main problems, and the pros and cons of different systems. The state secretary lists the legal situations, cites about 115,000 transfers a year worth EUR 1.7 billion, and says she is still studying options without committing to a specific outcome.
I will answer the questions for the General Consultation on Pension Matters, which has been moved to 20 March.
Ik beantwoord de vragen voor het Algemeen Overleg Pensioenonderwerpen, dat is verplaatst naar 20 maart a.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht "DDB wil meer informatie ZuivelNL"

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that the Dutch Dairy Board wants more information on the new dairy chain body ZuivelNL, including a levy of EUR 0.05 per 100 kg milk, and whether interbranch organisations may take over productschap tasks and use general binding declarations. The minister answered that the LTO-NZO cooperation is not yet a recognised interbranch organisation under the CAP, that the levy is a voluntary private contribution rather than a statutory levy, that public tasks remain with the ministry and no general binding declaration applies, and that a framework regulation will be published in the second quarter of 2014.
A private organisation is free to ask its voluntarily affiliated participants for a financial contribution, whether or not it is an interbranch organisation within the meaning of the CAP.
Het staat een private organisatie, of dit nu een brancheorganisatie in de zin van het GLB is of niet, vrij om een financiële bijdrage te vragen aan de (vrijwillig) aangesloten deelnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘extra ammoniakeisen dreigen vanuit Brussel’

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked about reports that the European Commission would propose tighter ammonia and fine-particle emission ceilings, and what this means for intensive livestock farming in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State answered that the proposed ceilings can likely be met under existing policy, that no direct effect on intensive livestock farming is expected, and that further Dutch stable and manure rules are being prepared but will not be suspended.
I do not want to suspend these measures because that would cause problems with implementing the PAS and with meeting the agreements already made under the European air quality directive.

Ik wil deze maatregelen niet opschorten omdat er dan problemen ontstaan met de implementatie van de PAS en ten aanzien van het voldoen aan de reeds gemaakt afspraken in het kader van de Europese luchtkwaliteitsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht LTO en NVV boos over tariefverhoging Rendac

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that farm and pig-farmer organisations object to a Rendac tariff increase for animal carcass processing, including whether Rendac holds a monopoly and whether the market should be opened. The State Secretary largely refers to a letter on carcass tariffs and a LEI study, denying that the sale of the parent company caused the increase and that the ministry opposes a free market for health reasons.
I refer you to my letter on carcass tariffs of 5 February 2014 and the LEI study carried out, which is attached as an annex.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn brief over kadavertarieven van 5 februari 2014 en het door het LEI uitgevoerde onderzoek welke als bijlage is bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Lodders over het uitrijden van drijfmest op grasland

MPs Dijkgraaf and Lodders asked why manure spreading on grassland is allowed only from 15 February while arable land may be fertilised from 1 February, and whether earlier grassland application would benefit the environment and grass growth. The State Secretary defended the later grassland date on water-quality and leaching grounds, noting the uncertain agronomic benefit, and declined to bring the date forward.
Given the uncertain agronomic benefit attached to this, I therefore consider bringing forward the spreading period on grassland not justified.
Mede gezien het onzekere landbouwkundige voordeel dat daaraan is verbonden, acht ik daarom een vervroeging van de uitrijperiode op grasland niet verantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over uitbreiding van vergunningsplicht bij natuur

VVD MPs Rudmer Heerema and Lodders asked whether the State Secretary would accept proposals by nature, landscape and animal welfare organisations to extend permit requirements to nature areas of national importance, to restrict netting-off (saldering) under the PAS, and to abolish the list of huntable species. The State Secretary replied that the organisations' vision document was noted, that the Nature Conservation Bill is before parliament, and that an amendment note will be submitted in spring to stress the link between economy and ecology.
I have taken note of the vision document "A new Nature Conservation Act" from the nature, landscape and animal welfare organisations.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van het visiedocument «Een nieuwe wet natuurbescherming» van de natuur-, landschaps- en dierenwelzijnsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over problemen met zeugen in groepen

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of high abortion rates in group-housed sows, whether the four-day group-housing rule should be scrapped, and whether enforcement should be suspended pending a lawsuit and studies. The State Secretary answers that causes are multifactorial and unknown, keeps the rule, offers guidance to problem farms, and refuses to suspend enforcement.
There are no grounds for this, neither of a policy nor of a legal nature.
Er zijn hiervoor geen redenen, noch van beleidsmatige noch van juridische aard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het uitbreiden in oppervlakte van bestaande Natura 2000-gebieden

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs who is responsible for enlarging Natura 2000 areas such as Engbertsdijkvenen, Willinks Weust and Lopikerwaard, on what legal basis, and what the local economic effects are. The State Secretary answered that the Minister of Economic Affairs decides on designation under the Nature Conservation Act with public participation, that boundaries change only on ecological criteria, and that economic effects cannot be considered at the designation stage but may be in management plans.
The competence to adopt the designation decisions lies with the minister responsible for Economic Affairs.
De bevoegdheid van het vaststellen van de aanwijzingsbesluiten ligt bij de bewindspersoon van Economische Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht Drenthe schort verlenen vergunning op

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Drenthe provincial executive's decision to suspend livestock permits near Natura 2000 areas until 1 February 2014, and whether the Groenmanifest framework was working. The State Secretary defended the suspension as prudent to check ecological and economic interests remain in balance, said the framework had enabled many permits, and pointed to the PAS as the longer-term solution.
I consider it sensible of the Drenthe Provincial Executive to temporarily suspend permit issuance in order to investigate whether nature and economic interests are still in balance.
Ik vind het verstandig van Gedeputeerde Staten van Drenthe dat ze de vergunningverlening tijdelijk opschort om te onderzoeken of de natuurbelangen en economische belangen nog in evenwicht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over vergunning blijft struikelblok mestverwerking

Two MPs asked whether the failure of permit granting for manure processing plants should affect the manure rights system and whether the government would evaluate or abolish it. The State Secretary said a national working group on speeding permits with the provinces and municipalities has been set up, a complaints point opened, and she will not abolish manure rights but will evaluate the Meststoffenwet annually.
I intend to evaluate the Meststoffenwet annually after its introduction on the objectives achieved.
Ik heb het voornemen om de meststoffenwet na invoering jaarlijks te evalueren op de behaalde doelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het verzoek om extra stikstof in spruiten

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether LTO's request for an extra nitrogen dose for Brussels sprouts growers after heavy rainfall is being considered, and whether a 60 mm rainfall threshold applied in past such requests. The State Secretary answered that the request will be included in talks with the European Commission on the fifth Nitrates action programme, that no minimum rainfall threshold has ever been set, and that a proposed calamity scheme would make such requests unnecessary.
LTO has requested that an extra dose be permitted; no amount was specified.
LTO heeft gevraagd om een extra gift toe te staan; een hoeveelheid is niet genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Bosman, De Liefde en Rudmer Heerema over nationale koppen ten aanzien van Europese regelgeving op het gebied van landbouw, natuur en visserij

MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs for an overview of stricter-than-EU national rules (nationale koppen) affecting farmers, growers and fishers, including their regulatory-burden effects and planned reductions under the coalition agreement. The government answered that the overview was sent in September 2013 and a sector-specific regulatory-burden approach for agro and food is underway, with a table of measures and their burden effects, and no full list of nationale koppen per directive was given beyond the inventory of current rules.
Progress on the ambition to reduce regulatory burden by 2.5 billion euro by 2017 is reported to the House twice a year.
Over de voortgang ten aanzien van de ambitie om de regeldruk per 2017 met 2,5 miljard euro te verminderen wordt uw Kamer twee maal per jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de mogelijkheid om hagelkanonnen in te zetten om de oogst te beschermen

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked whether anti-hail cannons may be used by fruit growers and whether municipalities should decide, and how enforcement by fines should be handled. The state secretary said the balancing of crop protection against noise nuisance is a local decision for municipalities, that no national rule or exception is appropriate, and that enforcement is up to the municipality.
The balancing of interests for the use of the anti-hail cannon must take place at the local level.
De belangenafweging voor het gebruik van het antihagelkanon dient op lokaal niveau plaats te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de zware gevolgen voor agrarische ondernemers door de nieuwe stikstof- en nitraatnormen

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the severe effects of tighter nitrogen and nitrate manure standards on farmers, including yield losses, soil fertility and competitiveness. The State Secretary replies that the measures are targeted, that yield losses of 10 to 50 percent are not expected (WUR calculates a maximum of 6 to 7 percent), that some norms will be raised, and that an equivalence route will allow farmers to request exemptions from 2015.

I offer initiatives that can demonstrate, through scientific underpinning and adequate safeguards, that other measures achieve an equivalent environmental result the opportunity, from 2015, to apply for an exemption from the generic use standards.

Ik bied initiatieven die door wetenschappelijke onderbouwing en adequate borging kunnen aantonen en garanderen dat zij met andere maatregelen tot een equivalent milieuresultaat komen, vanaf 2015 de gelegenheid om ontheffing aan te vragen van de generieke gebruiksnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over vernieling van proefvelden met aardappelen in Valthermond en de gemeente Eemsmond

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and justice minister about vandalised potato trial fields of Wageningen University in Valthermond and Eemsmond, including effects on blight-resistance research, prevention, penalties and recovery of damage, and group involvement and prosecution statistics. The government condemned the vandalism, said the research has not been significantly delayed, described cameras and resilience measures, outlined the maximum penalty and civil recovery routes, and stated that perpetrators have not been identified and protest groups are not registered.
Despite police efforts on this case, because the vandals acted extremely covertly, it has so far not been possible to trace those responsible for these incidents.
Ondanks de inzet van de politie op dit dossier is het vanwege het uiterst heimelijke optreden door de vernielers vooralsnog niet gelukt in verband met deze gevallen verantwoordelijken op te sporen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en de Liefde over een schadelijk buitenlands fruitvliegje dat de Nederlandse fruitoogst bedreigt

MPs Lodders and De Liefde asked why the government was slow to grant an exemption for a biological pesticide against the harmful spotted-wing drosophila fruit fly and what it will do to act faster. The state secretary answered that the fly is spreading in the Netherlands, that the exemption for Tracer was requested in March and has now been granted for the affected crops, and did not commit to further specific reforms.
The agent has now been exempted for the mentioned crops.
Het middel is inmiddels vrijgesteld voor de genoemde gewassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over de Nederlandse inzet inzake het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

Dutch MPs from VVD, CDA and SGP asked the state secretaries about the Dutch negotiating position on the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme, including the 50 mg nitrate standard, phosphate norms, the derogation and the lack of sector support. The government answered that the 50 mg standard is a binding target Netherlands committed to, that equivalent measures are being developed with LTO, and that it will press the Commission on monitoring results and the derogation.

I am in consultation with LTO on a number of these measures, with a view to having the required justification and assurance in place before the nitrogen use standards for leaching-sensitive crops in the southern sand and loess region are lowered on 1 January 2015.

Ik ben met LTO in overleg over een aantal van deze maatregelen met het oog op het beschikbaar hebben van de vereiste onderbouwing en borging voordat op 1 januari 2015 de stikstofgebruiksnormen voor uitspoelingsgevoelige gewassen in het zuidelijke zand- en lössgebied worden verlaagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Verdienen aan eieren zit er voorlopig niet in’

An MP asked the state secretary about egg farmers in financial distress after the battery-cage ban, unequal enforcement and imports from third countries, and whether the Ingrepenbesluit should be brought forward. The state secretary attributed the problems to a temporary market disruption, refused to delay the ban, proposed bringing forward the beak-trimming ban to 2018, and said she would push for an EU-wide ban on procedures.
My aim is to achieve animal-friendly and economically sound poultry farming with, in principle, as few or no procedures as possible.
Mijn doel is om te komen tot een diervriendelijke en economisch verantwoorde pluimveehouderij met in beginsel zo min mogelijk of geen ingrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders, De Liefde en Ten Broeke over het importverbod van Rusland op pootaardappelen en plantmateriaal

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and the foreign trade minister about Russia's import ban on Dutch seed potatoes and plant material, asking about EU and Dutch action, WTO compliance, and how to prevent such unilateral bans. The government answered that it keeps pressing the European Commission for quick follow-up talks with Russia, supports a derogation and traceability measures, and sees no WTO challenge yet, while acknowledging the ban harms Dutch growers.
I will keep urging the European Commission for swift follow-up steps given the major trade interests of Dutch business.
Ik zal bij de Europese Commissie blijven aandringen op spoedige vervolgstappen gezien de grote handelsbelangen van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitrijdperiode van mest

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs whether the manure spreading periods for grassland and arable land should be extended because the cold spring prevented farmers from spreading in time. The state secretary said an extension was not needed for grassland per the technical advisory committee, but she intends to extend the arable-land spreading period by two weeks to 15 September for farmers who grow cover crops.

Therefore I intend to extend the spreading period for liquid manure on arable land by two weeks until and including 15 September, on condition that the farmers concerned grow a cover crop by that last date.

Daarom ben ik voornemens de uitrijdperiode voor drijfmest op bouwland met twee weken te verlengen tot en met 15 september, onder voorwaarde dat de betreffende ondernemers uiterlijk op die laatste datum een groenbemester telen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over grondwaterzuiveringsinstallaties bij boeren

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked whether strict Activiteitenbesluit rules and rare discharge exemptions leave farmers with groundwater treatment installations no option but costly chemical waste disposal of brine, and whether the rules should be loosened. The state secretary replied that the rules are not stricter than the former Lozingenbesluit, that transitional rules and case-by-case maatwerkvoorschriften offer flexibility, and that no amendment is needed.
The decree gives the competent authority ample opportunities, within the appropriate frameworks, to broaden discharge possibilities case by case through a maatwerkvoorschrift.
Het besluit biedt het bevoegd gezag ruime mogelijkheden om binnen de geëigende kaders bij maatwerkvoorschrift de lozingsmogelijkheden per individueel geval te verruimen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders over de bouwstop veehouderij in Brabant

Parliamentarian Lodders (VVD) asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about a temporary building stop for livestock farms in Brabant, the province's ambition for a careful-livestock standard, conflicting provincial decisions on reconstruction policy, and how to restore entrepreneurs' prospects. The state secretary answered that no general building stop exists (only a one-year extension for goat and sheep farms), that the national government supports the Van Doorn approach, that it does not see provincial ambitions hindering manure processing, and that reconstruction policy is now a provincial task.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het aan banden leggen van teelt pootgoed

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs why the European Commission proposed a stricter crop-rotation rule (1-in-4) for seed potatoes, whether it was justified, and whether the Netherlands would oppose it at the Agriculture Council. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands had strongly opposed the unjustified proposal, and the Commission has since said the rule would apply only to specific regions, which excludes the Netherlands, so the main concerns are addressed, with a promise to ensure the final proposals reflect this.
Naturally, I will ensure that in the final proposals this commitment is actually implemented.
Vanzelfsprekend zal ik er op toezien dat in de definitieve voorstellen deze toezegging daadwerkelijk wordt ingevuld.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Verheijen over de voorschriften met betrekking tot de presentatie van olijfolie in horeca gelegenheden

Two VVD MPs asked why the European Commission planned to ban refillable olive oil bottles in restaurants, on what powers, and whether it breached subsidiarity and burdened hospitality businesses. State secretary Dijksma answered that the Netherlands opposed the measure, voted against it, welcomed its withdrawal, and will send the Commission a list of EU rules causing unnecessary burden.
For these reasons, the Netherlands voted against the measure.
Nederland heeft om deze redenen tegen de maatregel gestemd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Straus over het huiswerkblad van Maandtaak

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Maandtaak primary-school homework sheet on modern farming (on the farm, chicken, calf, pig) gives a one-sided picture, who is responsible for the content, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that the content of educational materials is not for the government to assess, that schools choose their own methods and sources, and that the government does not steer method choice, so no action is committed.
It is not for the (national) government to assess the content of educational materials.
Het is niet aan de (rijks) overheid om de inhoud van educatieve materialen te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen De Liefde en Lodders over het bericht ‘Jumbo verstuurt 3-procentsbrief aan leveranciers huismerk’

MPs De Liefde and Lodders asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that Daymon unilaterally imposed a 3% discount on Jumbo's private-label suppliers and how this relates to the unfair trading practices code and related motions. The minister said commercial negotiations are a matter between firms, that the government facilitates a self-regulatory code with dispute resolution, that legislation would only be considered if self-regulation fails, and that the motions will be addressed by letters before summer.
The government should in principle interfere as little as possible in this.
De overheid hoort zich daarmee in beginsel zo min mogelijk te bemoeien.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Ten Broeke over bontproductie in China

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about fur farming conditions in China, how Dutch fur farming standards compare, global demand for fur, the revenue lost from the Dutch fur farm ban, and whether production will shift to countries with weaker animal welfare. The state secretary answered that data on Chinese fur farming is scarce, outlined regulatory differences, cited industry figures on rising fur turnover, estimated the Dutch fur sector's turnover above 300 million euro without quantifying lost state revenue, and said production may shift to countries like Denmark, Poland, Romania or Belarus and China, though the extent is unknown.
To what extent the Dutch state is losing revenue cannot be said on this basis, as it depends on various factors.
In hoeverre de Nederlandse staat inkomsten mis loopt is op basis hiervan niet te zeggen, dit is afhankelijk van diverse factoren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Boer en Lodders over aanzienlijke prijsstijgingen in het openbaar vervoer, naar aanleiding van prijsstijgingen op het Hanzelijn-traject

Two VVD MPs asked why train fares on the Hanzelijn route are 15-25% higher than on parallel routes, and whether fares were agreed to be based on distance. The state secretary explained NS's tariff-unit system that equalises fares across parallel routes, denied any agreement to base fares on kilometres, declined to change the tariffs, and said regional fares are the responsibility of decentralised authorities.
It is not correct that it was agreed that the fare would be based on the number of kilometres.
Het klopt niet dat was afgesproken dat de ritprijs zou worden gebaseerd op het aantal kilometers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over zonder gewasbeschermingsplan drie procent minder subsidie

An MP asked whether farmers lacking a crop protection plan should really lose three percent of income support, and whether the NVWA should drop these checks while a replacement is being developed with the sector. The state secretary refused to reverse the decision, saying the absence of a plan can no longer be remedied under EU cross-compliance rules, while a sector-agreed alternative is being explored.
I do not share your views in questions 2 and 3.
Ik deel uw opvattingen onder 2 en 3 niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders over ‘Imker: neonicotinoïde is niet het probleem’

An MP asked the state secretary whether neonicotinoids used per instructions cause no bee problems, and about a German lab test and the varroa mite. The state secretary said the authorisations were based on the then-applicable framework, that EFSA's new assessment identified acute risks and data gaps, and that EU-level action is being pursued, while noting varroa is one factor and EFSA does not study causes of bee mortality.
That is why I have proposed to the European Commission that action be taken at Community level.
Daarom heb ik de Europese Commissie voorgesteld om op communautair niveau actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en De Liefde over het terugvorderen van toegezegde middelen bij de voedingstuinbouwsector

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reclaiming GMO fruit and vegetable subsidies from the horticulture sector, including the environmental measure, and the resulting penalties and effects on accountant opinions. The State Secretary answered that the EU rules require the subsidies to be recovered, that no fine is imposed for not carrying out the programme, and that she sees no room to waive recovery.
European law therefore gives me no room in this situation to waive recovery.
Het Europees recht biedt mij dan ook in deze situatie geen ruimte om af te zien van terugvordering.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Geurts en Lodders inzake introductiemoment groepshuisvesting drachtige zeugen

MPs Geurts and Lodders asked the minister why the 4-day group housing requirement for pregnant sows is kept, whether it harms animal welfare, the environment and farmers' competitiveness, and whether it should be relaxed. The minister answered that research and agreements with sector parties justify keeping the requirement, that farmers with management problems will be supported through a good-practice guide, and that no relaxation is planned.
I therefore see no other reason than to maintain the introduction of pregnant sows into the group four days after mating and to accelerate the drafting of a guide of good practices.
Ik zie dan ook geen andere reden dan vast te houden aan de introductie van drachtige zeugen na vier dagen na dekken in de groep en het versneld opstellen van een gids van goede praktijken
Antwoord vragen Lodders en De Boer over de aanslag bij het melden van wildschade

Two VVD MPs asked why farmers must first pay a 300-euro treatment fee before claiming game damage compensation from the Faunafonds, whether it is one-off, whether it is refunded if rejected, and whether the measure should be reversed. The state secretary replied that provinces are now responsible for financing the Faunafonds and lowering administration costs, that the treatment fee is being discussed in the Ganzen consultation, and that no conclusion has been reached so the government awaits the provinces' proposals.
I am awaiting the definitive proposals from the provinces.
Ik wacht de definitieve voorstellen van de provincies af.
Antwoord vragen Lodders over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris niet ambitieus is voor jonge ondernemers

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether he was unambitious on young farmers' succession and why he would not place the support measure in the First Pillar of the CAP. The state secretary denied lack of ambition, said he backed extra support for young farmers, accepted First Pillar support as one option, and argued that targeted Second Pillar investment is more effective.
During the Council I in fact strongly advocated extra support for young farmers.
Tijdens de Raad heb ik mij juist sterk gemaakt voor extra ondersteuning voor jonge boeren.
Antwoord vragen lid Lodders over het bericht dat bijna 20% van de pensioenpremie opgaat aan kosten

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary whether nearly 20% of pension premiums go to costs, whether pension funds' costs can be compared, what incentives keep them low, and whether the pension dashboard could show costs. The state secretary declined further transparency steps, argued cost comparisons are not meaningful, pointed to social partners as cost incentives, and said individual participants cannot easily judge costs.
As I indicated in answer to question 9 from MP Vermeij and in answer to question 4 from MP Omtzigt, I see no reason to take further steps.

2 Antwoord 3 Zoals ik in antwoord op vraag 9 van het lid Vermeij ( 2012Z166447 ) en in antwoord op vraag 4 van het lid Omtzigt ( 2012Z16648 ) heb aangegeven zie ik geen aanleiding tot het nemen van verdere stappen.
Antwoord vragen Lodders over “Het bericht Bleker en Ciolos zijn het eens over vergroening Europees Landbouwbeleid”

An MP asked the state secretary whether he agreed with the Commissioner's plan to make CAP direct payments conditional on greening measures, and what alternative measures he would take. The state secretary said he opposes fully decoupling the greening premium, prefers alternatives via agri-environment schemes and farm certification, and referred several questions to earlier written reports.
I am not in favour of farmers setting the goals themselves, but I do want them to have more freedom in deciding which measures they use to reach these goals.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van dat boeren zelf de doelen bepalen, maar wel dat zij meer vrijheid krijgen bij het bepalen met welke maatregelen zij deze doelen willen bereiken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Houwers inzake een verbod op chemische onkruidbestrijdingsmethoden

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether the IVAM LCA quickscan showing no environmental gain from banning chemical weed control on paved surfaces is accepted, whether environmental standards should apply to non-chemical methods, and whether the government will revisit the Grashoff motion on glyphosate for non-commercial use. The government acknowledged the study's mixed findings, announced an independent inventory to resolve confusion, saw no current need for standards on non-chemical methods, and pointed to the Dutch sustainable crop protection action plan for implementing the motion.
Therefore an independent inventory will be carried out to remove this lack of clarity.
Daarom zal een onafhankelijke inventarisatie uitgevoerd worden, om deze onduidelijkheid weg te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Snijder-Hazelhoff over het bericht "Brabantse boer klem door vele procedures"

Two VVD MPs asked whether lengthy permit procedures will prevent Brabant pig farmers from meeting animal welfare and manure processing rules, and whether postponement would be granted. The state secretary rejected postponement of the 1 January 2013 EU welfare deadline and said manure processing targets were set with available capacity in mind, while promising to press provinces and municipalities to speed permits and to report on further measures.
I therefore see no reason for postponement.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor uitstel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders met betrekking op de begrenzing van het Natura 2000-gebied Westerschelde

An MP asks whether the Westerschelde Natura 2000 boundary near Rammekensschor was moved despite industrial zoning and lost nature values, and about economic consequences and the WCT container terminal. The minister answers that a Council of State ruling required a better-reasoned boundary, the sand depot stays outside the area, and the change has no added economic or WCT impact.
In doing so, the Council of State ruled in favour of Vogelbescherming that the boundary at Rammekensschor was insufficiently reasoned and instructed me to take a new decision on this point.

Hierbij heeft de Raad van State de Vogelbescherming in het gelijk gesteld dat de begrenzing bij Rammekensschor onvoldoende is gemotiveerd en heeft mij opgedragen een nieuw besluit te nemen op dit punt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders over natuurherstel Westerschelde

An MP from the VVD asked the state secretary about the European Commission's objection to the Province of Zeeland's measures for nature restoration in the Westerschelde, including whether four polders should be flooded in future. The state secretary answered only by referring to a letter sent by the Minister of Foreign Affairs to the Commission and a copy sent to parliament, without addressing the substance of the questions.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders met betrekking tot te hoge eisen aan Natura 2000 in Overijssel

An MP asked the state secretary whether the differences between Natura 2000 conservation targets in the designation decrees and the Standard Data Forms in Overijssel are unacceptable, and whether complementary targets should be removed before designation. The state secretary answered that complementary targets were being removed from final designation decrees, that remaining differences arise from newer knowledge and will be resolved when the standard forms are updated, and that the IQuatro report uses an overly broad definition of complementary targets.
When Natura 2000 areas are definitively designated, complementary targets, as named in the Natura 2000 Targets Document, are removed.
Bij het definitief aanwijzen van Natura 2000-gebieden worden complementaire doelen, zoals benoemd in het Doelendocument Natura 2000, geschrapt
Antwoord vragen van de leden Neppérus en Lodders over de vermindering van pensioenaanspraken van particuliere pensioen bv’s

MPs Neppérus and Lodders asked why directors-major shareholders of private pension BVs cannot reduce pension entitlements as pension funds can, and whether the Adviescommissie's advice to widen the tax rule was considered. The state secretary answered that the rules cannot be widened without disproportionate costs and that a limited one-off reduction at pension start will be proposed in the Belastingplan 2013.

I intend to include in the Belastingplan 2013 a proposal under which, in certain cases and under strict conditions, a one-off reduction of pension entitlements built up in own management can take place at the pension start date.

Ik ben voornemens in het Belastingplan 2013 een voorstel op te nemen op grond waarvan in bepaalde gevallen en onder strikte voorwaarden op pensioeningangsdatum (eenmalig) een vermindering van in eigen beheer opgebouwde pensioenaanspraken kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Irrgang over de mogelijkheid om banksparen ook mogelijk te maken voor het aankopen van het pensioen

MPs Lodders (VVD) and Irrgang (SP) asked whether a mandatory insurance product covering longevity risk could make bank savings usable for buying a pension annuity. Minister Kamp replied that financial effects of non-existent products cannot be calculated and that splitting the product between a bank and an insurer would be complex and error-prone, referring to earlier answers.

Furthermore, I indicated in answer to question 6 of the earlier questions on this subject that I consider splitting the pension product into a savings part held at a bank and an insurance part held at an insurer to be a complicated structure in terms of costs and administration.

Verder heb ik in antwoord op vraag 6 van de eerder gestelde vragen over dit onderwerp aangegeven dat ik het splitsen van het pensioenproduct in een spaardeel dat ondergebracht wordt bij een bank en een verzekeringsdeel dat ondergebracht wordt bij een verzekeraar kostentechnisch en administratief een ingewikkelde constructie vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de mogelijkheid om banksparen ook mogelijk te maken voor het aankopen van het pensioen

An MP asked the government whether banksparen (bank savings) could be used to purchase pension payouts, raising competition and cost questions. The minister said the financial consequences cannot be quantified because banks and insurers differ, and that bank savings cannot cover longevity risk, so the market should first show whether a split product is feasible before legal barriers are discussed.
Antwoord vragen van het lid  Lodders over “het oneigenlijk gebruik van de pensioenknip”

Lodders (VVD) asked the minister of Social Affairs about reports that pension insurers refuse to apply the 'pensioenknip' (pension split option), its low uptake, and low interest rates and refusals to allow shopping after the first period. The minister answered that awareness is assumed, limited uptake reflects risk aversion, a few AFM complaints arise from technical rules, and insurers are legally bound to cooperate, with courts as the remedy.
If a pension provider refuses this cooperation, the person concerned can hold the provider to account and, if that does not lead to cooperation, go to court.
Als een pensioenuitvoerder deze medewerking weigert, kan betrokkene de uitvoerder daarop aanspreken en als dat niet tot medewerking leidt naar de rechter stappen.
Antwoord vragen Lodders over het bericht dat door de lage rente werknemers te maken kunnen krijgen met grote kortingen van hun pensioen

Lodders (VVD) asked the ministers whether low interest rates cause large pension cuts for workers with defined-contribution schemes, and whether the pension 'knip' or its extension could help. Minister Kamp answered that payouts depend on market rates at purchase, that about 626,000 participants hold such schemes with only tens of thousands likely affected per year, and that he sees no need to extend the temporary knip now but will review it in 2013.
I am willing to review in the course of 2013 whether the transitional period bridged by the temporary scheme requires extension
Ik ben bereid om in de loop van 2013 te bezien of de overgangsperiode die met de tijdelijke regeling wordt overbrugd, verlenging behoeft

Vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf (SGP), Lodders (VVD) en Koppejan (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de weegfactor van natuurproject Waterdunen (ingezonden 14 november 2011).

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether he would accept Zeeland's proposal to raise the weighting of the Waterdunen nature project toward the Natura 2000 Westerschelde management target from 30% to at least 50%. The state secretary answered that he is open to proposals within the Birds and Habitats Directives but that the Zeeland study did not lead to a request to change the agreed package, and he declined to commit to the higher weighting.
I am open to proposals to seek room for manoeuvre within the framework of the Birds and Habitats Directives.
Ik sta open voor voorstellen om rek en ruimte te zoeken binnen de kaders van de Vogel- en Habitatrichtlijn.

Vragen van de leden Lodders (VVD) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de impasse rond de natuurontwikkeling in het Binnenveld (ingezonden 17 oktober 2011).

MPs Lodders and Dijkgraaf asked about the impasse over nature development in the Binnenveld Natura 2000 area, a municipal land-swap offer from Rhenen, and whether a water-level rise on the Grift is needed and affordable. The state secretary said an independent expert commission found a water-level rise necessary for Natura 2000 goals, that measures are technically feasible with lower costs, and that the offer can be considered only if Natura 2000 goals are not jeopardised.
I contributed to this by asking an independent commission of experts to map out feasible measures that lead to achieving the Natura 2000 goals.
Ik heb daaraan bijgedragen door een onafhankelijke commissie van deskundigen te vragen uitvoerbare maatregelen in beeld te brengen die leiden tot het realiseren van de Natura 2000-doelen.
Vragen van het lid Lodders (VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over een tekort aan verpleeghuisartsen (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the health minister about the shortage of geriatric physicians (specialists in elderly care), its causes and possible government roles. The minister confirmed the training figures, attributed the shortage to low awareness and image problems, and pointed to existing funding and alternative staffing measures, with ongoing talks with the field.
VWS is currently in talks with stakeholders on a broad approach to further promote (lateral) entry into the training and supports initiatives for alternative solutions through task reallocation.

VWS is op dit moment in gesprek met veldpartijen voor een brede aanpak om de (zij)instroom in de opleiding verder te bevorderen en ondersteunt initiatieven voor alternatieve oplossingen via taakherschikking.

Vragen van de leden Lodders (VVD) en Koopmans (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de uitspraak van Raad van State inzake Natura 2000-gebied Elperstroom (ingezonden 23 augustus

MPs Lodders and Koopmans asked the state secretary to respond to a Council of State ruling that the 220-hectare extension of the Elperstroom Natura 2000 area was insufficiently justified, and asked whether the extension was necessary. The state secretary said the extension was based on ecological and hydrological grounds, that the Council of State upheld the designation on all other points, and that the decision will be re-motivated within three months.
The Division has instructed me to re-motivate the designation decision for the Elperstroom area adequately within three months.
De Afdeling heeft mij opgedragen om binnen drie maanden het besluit tot aanwijzing van het Elperstroomgebied alsnog toereikend te motiveren.
Vragen van de leden Lodders (VVD) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de nationale koppen op Natura 2000 (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

MPs Lodders and Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary about the IQuatro report on national add-ons (koppen) to Natura 2000, including the proposed deletion of habitat targets, inclusion of the Leenheerenpolder, changes to habitat types in Stelkampsveld, and availability of ecological justifications. The state secretary promised an evaluation covering IQuatro themes, justified the habitat additions with updated data, and referred to publicly available selection documents.
The evaluation will indicate which national add-ons were identified in the implementation of Natura 2000.
In de evaluatie zal worden aangegeven welke nationale koppen zijn geïdentificeerd bij de implementatie van Natura 2000.
Vragen van de leden Mulder en Lodders (beiden VVD) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de vaatchirurg die spoor van calamiteiten achterlaat (ingezonden 4 april 2011).

VVD MPs asked the health minister why an IGZ investigation into a vascular surgeon has lasted 3.5 years, whether he could practise in the Netherlands meanwhile, and why hospitals and the inspectorate failed to flag his problems earlier. The minister acknowledged delays and ex-inspector errors, said there was no patient risk since the surgeon no longer works in the Netherlands, and promised to conclude the investigation by mid-May and to address reference-checking in a forthcoming letter on disciplinary law.
That the investigation took longer than planned is careless toward both the doctor involved and the people who complained about him.
Dat het onderzoek meer tijd in beslag heeft genomen dan voorzien, is onzorgvuldig naar zowel de betrokken arts als naar de personen die over de arts hebben geklaagd.

Vragen van de leden Lodders en Aptroot (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de aansluiting van de Westerbaan in gemeente Katwi

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether the government would adjust the Natura 2000 boundary at Meijendel & Berkheide to allow the Westerbaan road link in Katwijk, citing traffic problems and a prior ministerial commitment. The state secretary answered that he is prepared to adjust the boundary if the province and municipality submit an ecologically sound proposal, and that the commitment will be formalised with the definitive designation decision, expected around summer.
I am prepared to adjust the boundary of the Natura 2000 area Meijendel & Berkheide in a way that makes the realisation of the ring road possible.
Ik ben bereid de begrenzing van het Natura 2000-gebied Meijendel & Berkheide aan te passen op een wijze die de realisatie van de rondweg mogelijk maakt.

Vragen van de leden Snijder-Hazelhoff en Lodders (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de eventuele verkoop van het Malieveld en het Haagse Bos (ingezonden 4 november 2010

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation about reports that Staatsbosbeheer would sell the Malieveld and Haagse Bos, and whether it should sell land without a strict nature function. The state secretary denied that the sale is wasteful, said the state would share in any increase in value if the nature function changes, and committed to a land policy note on selling land not needed for national goals.
At the nature legislative consultation with your House on 8 November 2010 I indicated I would elaborate my plans in a land policy note, which I will send to your House.
Tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg natuur met uw Kamer van 8 november 2010 heb ik aangegeven mijn plannen uit te werken in een grondnota, die ik uw Kamer doe toekomen.
Vragen van het lid Lodders (VVD) aan de minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de dassencompensatieproblematiek in de gemeente Cuijk (ingezonden 30 september 2010).

An MP asked the minister why a permit for a recreation park in Cuijk was withheld over a badger habitat compensation shortfall of 3.8 km of hedgerows, and whether the costs of delay were acceptable. The state secretary replied that the municipality is responsible for implementing its own badger plan, that about 10 percent of compensation remains outstanding so no exemption can yet be granted, and that a new permit request will be considered once the habitat is completed.
The municipality of Cuijk drew up its own badger management plan and is itself responsible for fully implementing it.
De gemeente Cuijk heeft zelf een dassenbeheerplan opgesteld en is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de volledige uitvoering hiervan.

Vragen van de leden van Nieuwenhuizen en Lodders (beiden VVD) aan de ministers van Verkeer en Waterstaat en van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de hinder die luchthaven Schiphol ondervindt van ganzen (ingezonde

MPs Nieuwenhuizen and Lodders asked whether bird strikes with geese at Schiphol had doubled, how Noord-Holland manages goose control, and whether the province should be pressed to tighten policy. The minister answered that only six goose strikes occurred in five years, that preventive measures are necessary and under review, and that any tightening would be discussed in the national bird-strike steering group.
Yes, I share that concern. The preventive measures being taken are all necessary.
Ja, ik deel die zorg. De preventieve maatregelen die genomen worden zijn alle nodig.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Nispen en Temmink ter vervanging van nr. 8 over zware voorhang

Requires that draft general administrative orders under the law be submitted to both chambers with a four-week period in which a fifth of members can demand the matter be regulated by statute instead.
This amendment therefore provides that the general administrative orders to be established under this law must be submitted to the House through a heavy pre-consultation procedure.
Dit amendement regelt daarom dat de op grond van deze wet vast te stellen algemene maatregelen van bestuur via een zware voorhangprocedure moet worden voorgelegd aan de Kamer.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden van Nispen en Temmink ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het laten vervallen van de bevoegdheid voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens
Removes the NCTV's own power to process personal data from publicly accessible online sources, leaving that analysis to intelligence and security services under safeguards.
The submitters therefore intend with this amendment to remove the power to process personal data.
Indieners beogen daarom met dit amendement de bevoegdheid voor het verwerken van persoonsgegevens te laten vervallen.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Nispen en Temmink ter vervanging van nr. 9 over verkorting van de bewaartermijn van gegevens
Shortens the retention period for personal data held for the NCTV from five years to one year and the extension period from five years to six months, with remaining data destroyed earlier.
The submitters believe that storing sensitive personal data may not last longer than strictly necessary.
Indieners zijn van mening dat het opslaan van gevoelige persoonsgegevens niet langer mag zijn dan strikt noodzakelijk is.
Motie van het lid Temmink over de weerbaarheidsscan alleen uitvoeren als deze ook bruikbaar is voor bewindspersonen en topbestuurders

Asks the government to carry out the resilience scan of politicians' and executives' networks only if it is truly usable for ministers and top officials, preferably scientifically validated by its original developers.
requests the government to carry out the resilience scan only if it is actually usable for these target groups
verzoekt de regering de weerbaarheidsscan alleen uit te voeren als deze daadwerkelijk bruikbaar is voor deze doelgroepen
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Temmink en Van Esch ter vervanging van nr. 14 over wel toetsing vooraf door de Toetsingscommissie Inzet Bevoegdheden
Restores mandatory prior review by the TIB of large-scale data collection and of technical risks in hacking-power requests, instead of shifting these checks to CTIVD supervision afterwards.
to let the mandatory prior review by the TIB continue to exist
de verplichte toets vooraf door de TIB te laten bestaan
Motie van het lid Hammelburg c.s. over na inwerkingtreding van de tijdelijke wet een uitvoeringstoets uitvoeren die ziet op de balans tussen passende waarborgen en effectieve taakuitvoering
Motion asking the cabinet to carry out an implementation review one year after the temporary intelligence law takes effect, on balancing safeguards with effective operations.
requests the cabinet to carry out an implementation review one year after the temporary law takes effect, focused on the balance between adequate safeguards and effective performance of duties
verzoekt het kabinet één jaar na inwerkingtreding van de tijdelijke wet een invoeringstoets uit te voeren die ziet op de balans tussen passende waarborgen en effectieve taakuitvoering
Amendement van de leden Temmink en Van Esch over wel toetsing vooraf door de Toetsingscommissie Inzet Bevoegdheden
Deletes the bill's removal of mandatory prior review by the Investigatory Powers Commission (TIB) for large-scale data collection, keeping that ex ante check on intelligence services.
With the removal of the prior review by the Investigatory Powers Commission (TIB) for large-scale data collection, the level of oversight is undermined.
Met het wegvallen van de toetsing vooraf door de Toetsingscommissie Inzet Bevoegdheden (TIB) bij grootschalige dataverzameling wordt er wel afbreuk gedaan aan het niveau van toezicht.
Amendement van de leden Temmink en Van Esch over het aanhouden van het gerichtheidsvereiste
Deletes the provision that disapplies the gerichtheidsvereiste for snapshot cable reconnaissance, restoring the targeting requirement on intelligence data collection.
The bill proposes that for cable reconnaissance (the so-called snapshot power) the targeting requirement be declared inapplicable.
In het voorliggende wetsvoorstel wordt voorgesteld dat bij verkenning op de kabel (de zogenaamde snapshotbevoegdheid) het gerichtheidsvereiste buiten toepassing wordt verklaard.
Amendement van de leden Temmink en Van Esch over geen bulkdatasets delen met buitenlandse diensten
Prohibits the intelligence services from passing data obtained under the new bulk-data powers to foreign intelligence services.
Data acquired through use of the power in the first paragraph are not provided to the intelligence and security services of other countries.
De ingevolge de toepassing van de bevoegdheid, bedoeld in het eerste lid, verworven gegevens worden niet verstrekt aan de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten van andere landen.
Motie van de leden Temmink en Inge van Dijk over toekomstige boeteopbrengsten voor het Huis voor Klokkenluiders ten goede laten komen aan het fonds voor klokkenluiders
Asks the government to propose that future fine revenue from sanctions of the House for Whistleblowers goes to the whistleblowers fund.
requests the government to propose that future fine revenues from sanction powers of the House for Whistleblowers benefit the whistleblowers fund
verzoekt de regering met een voorstel te komen zodat toekomstige boeteopbrengsten vanuit sanctiemogelijkheden voor het Huis voor Klokkenluiders ten goede komen aan het fonds voor klokkenluiders
Motie van de leden Temmink en Inge van Dijk over een plan om het fonds voor klokkenluiders op termijn onafhankelijk te maken
Asks the government to present a plan to make the whistleblower fund independent in the long term, rather than running it through the Interior Ministry budget.
an independent fund is preferable in the long term to guarantee independence
een onafhankelijk fonds op lange termijn de voorkeur verdient om de onafhankelijkheid te garanderen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Temmink over de lobby-activiteiten van oud-bewindspersonen bij de IND

MPs Marijnissen and Temmink asked about IND lobbying meetings with former ministers Verdonk and Teeven on Indonesian nurse visas, whether procedures changed, the ministry's whistleblower cases, ministers' agenda transparency, and a lobby register. The government answered that the IND's decision was based on rules and not affected by the meetings, that no procedures were changed, and that agenda publication will be improved while a lobby register is deferred pending research.
The cabinet recognises the importance of transparent representation of interests.
Het kabinet onderkent het belang van transparante belangenvertegenwoordiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Temmink en Van Nispen over het feit dat het niet noodgevallen nummer van de Brandweer in handen is van een commerciële partij

MPs Temmink and Van Nispen asked why the non-emergency fire brigade number 0900-0904 is operated by a commercial party, why callers pay per-minute fees, and why it is not free like the Marechaussee number. The minister answered that KPN is not the owner but a platform provider, the number is managed by the Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking, service fees partly cover costs without profit, and cost estimates for free numbers were not provided.
The number 0900-0904 is not in the hands of a commercial party, but is managed by the Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking (LMS).
Het nummer 0900-0904 is niet in handen van een commerciële partij, maar in beheer bij de Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking (LMS).
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Sneller, Michon-Derkzen, Kuik, Mutluer en Temmink over agressie en geweld tegen beroepsgroepen met een publieke functie

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA, GroenLinks-PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reporting, prosecution, sentencing and prevention of aggression and violence against public-service workers. The minister answers that reporting should be made mandatory in practice through employer norms, that no reliable national picture exists, and that existing protocols, WODC research and Weerbaar Bestuur initiatives are being used, while leaving primary employer responsibility with organisations.
A reliable national picture of aggression and violence against officials with a public task is lacking.
Een betrouwbaar landelijk beeld van agressie en geweld tegen functionarissen met een publieke taak ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Temmink over ‘de financiering van politieke partijen’

Opposition MPs Marijnissen and Temmink asked the Interior Minister about political party donations from BVs, whose ultimate beneficial owners were not disclosed, and whether the EUR 100,000 donation cap and transparency rules are being circumvented. The minister answered that beneficial-owner registration applies only from 2024, that the cap is checked via accountant certification and fines, and that the rules are normative and left to parties to apply, while promising to enforce registration from 2024.

Because the obligation to also record the address details of the ultimate beneficial owner(s) for a donation from a legal entity only applies from subsidy year 2024, those details did not yet have to be provided or made public in subsidy year 2023.

Omdat de verplichting om bij een bijdrage van een rechtspersoon ook de adresgegevens van de uiteindelijk belanghebbende(n) te registreren pas van toepassing is vanaf het subsidiejaar 2024 – zie het antwoord op vraag 1 – hoefden die gegevens in het subsidiejaar 2023 nog niet te worden verstrekt noch openbaar te worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over het advies van het Adviescollege Openbaarheid en Informatiehuishouding (ACOI) over de Wet open overheid (Woo)

Temmink (SP) asked the government how it will respond to the ACOI report showing journalists distrust the handling of Woo freedom-of-information requests, and whether a culture of obstruction exists in ministries. The state secretary acknowledged late handling and the need for improvement, promised a government response to the Woo implementation test in the first half of 2024, and denied recognizing a pattern of acting outside Woo rules but accepted that obstruction concerns warrant attention.
I am asking the government commissioner for information management and the ACOI to reflect on the Woo implementation test and issue advice in response.
Ik vraag de regeringscommissaris Informatiehuishouding en het ACOI te reflecteren op de Woo-invoeringstoets en een advies uit te brengen naar aanleiding hiervan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over deafhandeling van het toeslagenschandaal

MP Temmink (SP) asked the State Secretary of Finance about the handling of the childcare benefits scandal, including implementation of two adopted motions, the 31 December 2023 registration deadline, DUO debts of children, compensation practices, and municipal support tasks. The State Secretary answered that letters on the motions were sent alongside the answers, gave figures on ex-gratia and integral assessment participation, explained the municipal support framework, and said compensation is fully paid for wrongly reclaimed amounts while the 30% amount for strict-liability/intent qualifications is a compensation for indirect harm rather than mitigation.
At the same time as answering these questions, a letter was sent to your House addressing this.
Tegelijkertijd met de beantwoording van deze vragen is een brief aan uw Kamer verstuurd waarin hierop wordt ingegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over het artikel ‘Het CBR weet al jaren van fraude bij theorie-examens. Het doet bijna niks tegen “turbo-opleiders”, wel tegen klokkenluiders.’

An SP MP asked the ministers about CBR knowledge of exam fraud by 'turbo' driving schools, the CBR's response to whistleblower evidence, and whether whistleblowers were prosecuted. The minister answered that CBR has taken many anti-fraud measures, filed a complaint and report against an individual, denied prosecuting whistleblowers under the Whistleblower Act, and said consultations on further measures are ongoing.
It is incorrect that the CBR would have taken the persons who supplied the evidence to court.
Het is onjuist dat het CBR de personen die het bewijs aanleverden voor de rechter zou hebben gedaagd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz, Temmink, Van Raan en Van Baarle over het bericht 'Tien camera’s per vierkante kilometer in database politie: ‘Onbespied over straat kan bijna niet meer’' en de uitzending

MPs from D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that private cameras registered with the police (Camera in Beeld) are growing, whether footage from unregistered private cameras, doorbell cameras and cameras pointed at public roads is lawful and usable, and whether this amounts to a nationwide surveillance network. The Minister answered that police may demand footage under article 126nda Sv for offences carrying four years or more, that misaligned cameras are a concern, that a nationwide network is undesirable, and that courts decide whether unlawfully obtained footage is admissible.
I therefore consider it important that camera owners continue to be reminded that they must adjust their cameras in line with the rules of the General Data Protection Regulation.
Ik acht het derhalve van belang dat camera-eigenaren er blijvend op worden gewezen dat zij hun camera moeten afstellen volgens de regels van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over het Risicotaxatie Instrument Geweld (RTI-G)

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether police used the RTI-G risk algorithm to profile citizens for future violence, including whether it scored people by Antillean, Moroccan or Somali background, whether a privacy impact assessment exists, and whether flagged people were searched or stopped. The minister confirmed use, said the tool was never used alone and always involved human interpretation, that ethnicity was removed in 2017, and that police have since stopped using RTI-G because its necessity and quality could not be substantiated.
Because the usefulness, necessity and quality of this could not be sufficiently substantiated, the police stopped using RTI-G.
Omdat nut, noodzaak en kwaliteit hiervan onvoldoende te onderbouwen zijn, heeft de politie het gebruik van RTI-G gestopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Inge van Dijk, Temmink, Van der Plas en Dekker-Abdulaziz over de RAM database bij de Belastingdienst

Five MPs asked the government about the RAM database at the Belastingdienst, including whether privacy impact assessments were done, whether parliament was misinformed, and why an external investigation is needed. The State Secretary answered that an external investigation and an investigation by the Dutch Data Protection Authority are pending, so definitive answers and the legality question cannot yet be given, and that memos and documents will be sent later.
I wish to emphasise that definitive answers can only be given after the external investigation and the investigation by the AP.
Ik wil daarbij benadrukken dat pas na het externe onderzoek en het onderzoek door de AP definitieve antwoorden gegeven kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over meldingen van gedupeerden in het toeslagenschandaal

MP Temmink asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that some municipalities ask children of victims of the childcare benefits scandal to account for their compensation money, refuse broad support to parents who do not enter debt assistance, and reject applications for co-residing persons. The State Secretary answers that no such accountability is required, that broad support has no preconditions though advice to seek debt help may be given, that municipalities bear responsibility for case-by-case design and SPUK accountability, and that the VNG offers support to municipalities.
There is no obligation for victimised parents or children to account to municipalities for how they spent compensation money as a condition for access to broad support.
Er is geen verplichting voor gedupeerde ouders of kinderen om verantwoording aan gemeenten af te leggen over besteding van compensatiegeld als voorwaarde voor de toegang tot brede ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Temmink over waarschuwingsbrieven van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de onwenselijkheid van omdraaiing van de bewijslast in het strafrecht

MPs Sneller and Temmink asked about 176 warning letters sent by the Public Prosecution Service to people allegedly present at the November 2022 Schiphol climate protest, identified partly via facial recognition, and whether the subsequent interviews reversed the burden of proof. The minister answered that the letters have no formal legal status, that some identifications were wrong and apologies were sent, that people were treated as 'betrokkenen' rather than suspects, and that data of wrongly identified persons will be deleted while further investigation and evaluation are ongoing.
The warning letter has no formal legal status and therefore does not lead to registration in the criminal records.
De waarschuwingsbrief heeft geen formele juridische status en leidt dus ook niet tot vermelding op de justitiële documentatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Temmink over het bericht dat de gemeente Den Haag, in navolging van de gemeente Deventer, cameradrones toepast bij het inspecteren van dakkapellen en uitbouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Temmink asked about municipalities using camera drones to inspect dakkapellen and extensions, raising privacy, DPIA, aviation permit, retention, anonymisation and legality concerns. The Minister answered that municipalities are responsible for privacy compliance, that Deventer and Den Haag have taken steps (DPIA, notices, blurring, limited retention), and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and courts will judge lawfulness.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for compliance with privacy legislation.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Temmink en Van Nispen over de lobbyactiviteiten van de fabrikant van de taser

MPs Temmink and Van Nispen asked whether police officers were invited to a Axon (taser maker) roadshow with gifts and meals, how new police equipment is procured, and whether the term 'excited delirium' is scientifically grounded. The Minister says the roadshow page was removed, no police invitations were found, procurement is demand-led under police purchasing policy, and it is not for the Minister to research the medical diagnosis.
As far as can be checked, it has not appeared that police officers were invited to this roadshow.
Voor zover dat nagegaan kan worden is niet gebleken dat voor deze roadshow politiefunctionarissen zouden zijn uitgenodigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over de aankomende alternatieve behandeling van werkelijke schade in het toeslagenschandaal

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the forthcoming alternative route for actual damages in the childcare benefits scandal, including whether forfait amounts risk undercompensation, the Council of State's warnings on outsourcing, and the role of external parties. The State Secretary answered that a pilot starts this autumn with results due in a progress report, that forfait amounts are validated by experts with the option of individual assessment by the CWS, and that outsourcing has proven workable.
This autumn a pilot for this route will be started.
Dit najaar wordt gestart met een proef voor deze route.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Temmink over opnieuw een rechtszaak van een gedupeerde vanwege uitblijvende beslissing van de herstelorganisatie UHT van de Belastingdienst

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Finance why the Belastingdienst's childcare benefits restoration body (UHT) only engaged with a parent after a lawsuit was filed, why the state's lawyer was used, and what the restoration costs are including mediation, penalty payments and legal fees. The government answers that it does not comment on pending lawsuits, says parents' lawsuits are regrettable, gives partial cost figures (penalty payments over 25 million euros, mediation about 38.5 million euros over three years, legal representation about 300,000 euros) and states that not all costs can be separated out.
Before answering this question and the following ones, it is noted that the policy is not to comment on individual pending lawsuits.
