Voorafgaand aan de beantwoording van deze vraag en de volgende vragen wordt opgemerkt dat het beleid is om niet in te gaan op individuele lopende rechtszaken.

Motie van het lid Tseggai c.s. over onderzoek naar de vervolging van klanten die tegen betaling seks hebben met een minderjarige
Motion asking the government to investigate how prosecution of clients who pay for sex with minors works in practice and how it can be strengthened.

Motie van het lid Ceder c.s. over een wettelijke verplichting voor aanbieders van seksadvertenties om de leeftijd van geadverteerde personen te verifiëren

Asks the government to rapidly scale up the national service year to at least 4,000 participants per year, add a survey to the conscription letter, and report by Q3 2024.
requests the government to rapidly and substantially scale up the service year, on the Swedish model, to at least 4,000 participants per year;
verzoekt de regering om het dienjaar, naar Zweeds model, zo snel mogelijk fors op te schalen naar ten minste 4.000 deelnemers per jaar;
Motie van de leden Boswijk en Diederik van Dijk over de Kamer uiterlijk 1 juli informeren over de behoeftestelling voor de oprichting van een tankbataljon
Asks the government to inform the House by 1 July, via an A-letter, about the requirements statement for setting up a tank battalion.
requests the government to inform the House by 1 July about the requirements statement for setting up a tank battalion, by means of an A-letter
verzoekt de regering de Kamer uiterlijk 1 juli te informeren over de behoeftestelling voor de oprichting van een tankbataljon, door middel van een A-brief
Motie van het lid Van den Hil c.s. over het verbeteren van de bekendheid en de samenhang van bestaande verlof- en ondersteuningsregelingen
Asks the minister to improve awareness and coordination of existing leave and support schemes for informal carers.

requests the Minister, together with the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, employers, employees and municipalities, to improve the awareness and coherence of existing leave and support schemes.

verzoekt de Minister om samen met de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, werkgevers, werknemers en gemeenten de bekendheid en samenhang van bestaande verlof- en ondersteuningsregelingen te verbeteren

Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk over een advies van de Gezondheidsraad over in hoeverre de huidige benadering van genderbevestigende behandelingen bij minderjarigen recht doet aan het geldende gez
Asks the government to request advice from the Health Council on whether current gender-affirming treatment for minors complies with the health-law framework.
requests the government to seek advice from the Health Council on the extent to which the current approach to gender-affirming treatment for minors respects the applicable health-law framework

verzoekt de regering om advies te vragen aan de Gezondheidsraad in hoeverre de huidige benadering van genderbevestigende behandelingen bij minderjarigen recht doet aan het geldende gezondheidsrechtelijke kader
Motie van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Bikker over redenen voor een abortus of een abortusverzoek registreren en deze informatie jaarlijks geaggregeerd en geanonimiseerd openbaar maken
Asks the government to register reasons for abortion requests and publish aggregated, anonymised data annually via the inspectorate's reports.
requests the government to ensure that reasons for an abortion request are registered and this information is published annually in aggregated and anonymised form
verzoekt de regering om te bewerkstelligen dat redenen voor een abortus(verzoek) worden geregistreerd en deze informatie jaarlijks geaggregeerd en geanonimiseerd openbaar wordt gemaakt
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over stoppen met het eisen van een mantelzorgverklaring
Asks the government to talk with municipalities to stop requiring caregiver declarations (mantelzorgverklaring) and trust informal carers instead.
requests the government to talk with municipalities to stop demanding a caregiver declaration
verzoekt de regering om het gesprek te voeren met gemeenten om te stoppen met het eisen van een mantelzorgverklaring
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de absolute en relatieve stijging van het aantal euthanasiegevallen
Motion asks the government to commission independent research into causes of the rising number of euthanasia cases and inform the House by mid-2024.
requests the government to commission independent scientific research into the causes of the absolute and relative rise in euthanasia cases
verzoekt de regering opdracht te geven voor onafhankelijk wetenschappelijk onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de absolute en relatieve stijging van het aantal euthanasiegevallen
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 37 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euro within the health budget from unallocated funds to post-COVID specialist outpatient clinics as a two-year pilot.
This amendment raises the commitment amount in article 2 (Curative Care) by 27 million euro
Dit amendement verhoogt het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 2 (Curatieve Zorg) met € 27 miljoen
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Increases the health budget for curative care by 27 million euro, funded from undistributed reserves, to set up post-COVID outpatient clinics.
This amendment increases the commitment amount in article 2 (Curative Care) by 27 million euro
Dit amendement verhoogt het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 2 (Curatieve Zorg) met € 27 miljoen
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over mogelijkheden verkennen om antisemitisme als weigerings- of intrekkingsgrond zwaarder mee te wegen
Asks the government to explore giving antisemitism greater weight as a ground for refusing or revoking asylum, residence, integration and naturalisation, following Germany's example.
requests the government to explore various options for how antisemitism can be given greater weight as a ground for refusal or revocation
verzoekt de regering om verschillende mogelijkheden te verkennen hoe antisemitisme als weigerings- of intrekkingsgrond zwaarder kan worden meegewogen
Amendement van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het invoegen van een evaluatiebepaling
Adds a clause requiring the minister to report to parliament within five years on the effectiveness and effects of the law on refusal grounds for criminal foreigners.
Within five years of this law entering into force, the Minister sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice
Onze Minister zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over een landelijke campagne om drugsgebruikers te confronteren met de gevolgen van drugsgebruik voor de samenleving
Asks the government to launch a national campaign confronting drug users with the societal consequences of drug use, modelled on Rotterdam's campaign.
requests the government, following Rotterdam's example, to start a national campaign
verzoekt de regering naar Rotterdams voorbeeld een landelijke campagne te starten
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over een actieplan om het verkeerd gebruik van hallucinerende geneesmiddelen tegen te gaan
Asks the government to produce an action plan against misuse of hallucinogenic medicines without making their legitimate use impossible, and to inform the House before summer 2024.
requests the government to come up with an action plan to counter the misuse of hallucinogenic medicines
verzoekt de regering met een actieplan te komen om het verkeerd gebruik van hallucinerende geneesmiddelen tegen te gaan
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over de nieuwe indicatieve stoffentest introduceren bij alle eenheden en het Post Interventieteam
Asks the government to introduce the new indicative substance test at all police units and the Post Intervention Team to increase interventions and seizures.
requests the government to introduce the new indicative substance test at all units and the Post Intervention Team
verzoekt de regering de nieuwe indicatieve stoffentest bij alle eenheden en het Post Interventieteam te introduceren
Motie van het lid Krul c.s. over onderzoeken op welke manier designerdrugs aanbiedende sites uit de lucht gehaald kunnen worden
Asks the government to map online designer drug shops and investigate how to take their sites offline quickly and dismantle the criminal network behind them.
requests the government to investigate how these sites can be taken offline as quickly as possible
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken op welke manier deze sites zo snel mogelijk uit de lucht kunnen worden gehaald
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het ontbreken van verdoving bij late zwangerschapsafbreking

An SGP MP asked the state secretary about the absence of standard fetal anaesthesia in late-term abortions after 24 weeks, the lack of a medical guideline, and comparisons with fetal surgery and early abortion. The state secretary answered that professional norms govern the procedure, that a revised quality standard in draft requires sedation and analgesia for the fetus, that fetal pain science is complex, and that no change to late-abortion policy is planned.
I see no reason to change the policy on late-term abortion.
Ik zie geen reden om het beleid ten aanzien van late zwangerschapsafbreking te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul  en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Coöperatie Laatste Wil komt met nieuwe  levenseindemethode'

MPs Bikker, Krul and Diederik van Dijk asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about the Coöperatie Laatste Wil's new assisted-dying method, its risks for vulnerable people, and possible legal action. The government called the dissemination of suicide methods undesirable, said it is checking whether the activities are criminal under article 294 Sr, declined to confirm any ongoing investigations, and said the prosecutor would act if criminal limits are crossed while the minister sees no reason to use a special instruction power.
In general, the Minister of Justice and Security can neither confirm nor deny whether criminal investigations are ongoing against certain natural or legal persons.
In zijn algemeenheid geldt dat de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan bevestigen noch ontkennen of tegen bepaalde natuurlijke of rechtspersonen strafrechtelijke onderzoeken lopen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Nederland bezit grootste hoeveelheid kinderporno in Europa

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about a report that the Netherlands hosts the largest share of child sexual abuse material in Europe, and about the legal duties, enforcement capacity, cooperation and reporting relevant to it. The minister answered that the existing framework (DSA, the ATKM's administrative powers, a 24-hour removal norm with about 59% compliance, and EU proposals still under negotiation) is robust, while acknowledging the problem and pointing to police investment and ongoing work on 'bad hosters'.
The cabinet finds it very worrying that large amounts of child sexual abuse imagery are still hosted in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet vindt het zeer zorgwekkend dat in Nederland nog altijd veel beeldmateriaal van seksueel kindermisbruik wordt gehost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over geweld en intimidatie jegens christelijke asielzoekers in azc in Goes

An SGP MP asks the Minister for Asylum and Migration how the government responds to reports of intimidation and violence against Christian asylum seekers at the Goes reception centre, what measures are taken, how victims can be encouraged to report, whether a convenant like the LGBTI one is possible, and whether asylum applications can be refused for intimidation. The Minister says such discrimination is unacceptable, that COA handles incidents seriously and imposes sanctions, that victims are encouraged to report, that COA does not separate residents by religion, and that refusal criteria follow the qualification directive so the review will not cover that.
COA does not recognise structural, organised incidents against Christian asylum seekers at the Goes location.
Het COA herkent op de locatie in Goes geen structurele, georganiseerde incidenten jegens christelijke asielzoekers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Forse schade aan Paleis op de Dam door bekladding met rode verf: “Fuck Israël”’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about red paint vandalism on the Royal Palace on Dam Square reading 'Fuck Israël', including whether it constitutes hate speech, the damage and costs, suspects, and NCTV threat analysis. The minister condemned the vandalism, declined to comment on individual case investigations, outlined camera surveillance and compensation options, and said the NCTV will report on relevant developments in its threat assessments.
As Minister of Justice and Security I cannot go into the substance of individual cases.
Ik kan als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid niet inhoudelijk ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht “Syrische christen onder druk in azc”

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports of discrimination and intimidation against Syrian Christian asylum seekers in reception centres, and what measures would be taken, including whether perpetrators could lose asylum status and how to make the Gave reporting point more accessible. The minister answered that COA monitors the situation and has house rules, sanctions and intensive supervision, that victims decide on reporting to police, that asylum refusal for serious convictions is already possible, and that the situation in Syria is monitored without currently warranting a change in risk profile.
To date, this monitoring does not show that Christian asylum seekers are being discriminated against.
Tot op heden blijkt uit deze monitoring niet dat christelijke asielzoekers gediscrimineerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘SchoolTV onder vuur over Gaza: ’Hamas is een politieke partij, ze hebben ook mensen die vechten’

MPs Stoffer and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether SchoolTV's lesson material on Hamas and the Israel-Palestine conflict is independent, reliable and neutral, and what oversight and complaint routes exist. The Minister declined to assess the content of teaching materials or of public broadcasting, citing freedom of education and press freedom, and pointed to the Mediawet, the Commissariaat voor de Media and the Ombudsman for the public broadcasters as existing accountability channels, while refusing to commission further review or quality frameworks.
In general I consider it important that schools use proven effective methods.
Ik vind het in algemene zin belangrijk dat scholen gebruik maken van bewezen effectieve methoden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de AI-explosie van kinderporno

An SGP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the reported surge in child sexual abuse material linked to AI and encrypted apps, covering escalation risks, enforcement capacity, EU cooperation, prosecution rates, company responsibility and public awareness campaigns. The minister answers that enforcement capacity has been expanded but remains insufficient, outlines prevention and cooperation efforts, and declines to launch public campaigns on fake imagery due to backfire risks.
It is not recorded per report what the underlying reason is for prosecuting or not, so it is difficult to give exact figures on the actual imposition of sentences.

Er wordt niet bijgehouden per melding wat de achterliggende reden is om wel of niet tot vervolging over te gaan en daarom is het lastig om exacte cijfers te geven over het concreet opleggen van straffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Diederik van Dijk over het onderhandelaarsresultaat voor de nieuwe politie-cao

SGP MPs Flach and Van Dijk asked whether the new police collective agreement, which makes three Christian holidays exchangeable for individual leave, undermines commonly recognised public holidays and why parliament was not consulted. The government answered that the holidays remain in the Algemene termijnenwet, that collective bargaining is an employer-union matter, and that the Barp amendment will be prepared via the ministerial process with later publication, but it did not commit to advance parliamentary involvement.
Your House will receive the answers to these questions well before this publication.
Uw Kamer ontvangt ruim voor deze publicatie de beantwoording op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Six Dijkstra over de nieuwe cijfers van het Landelijk Alcohol en Drugs Informatie Systeem (LADIS)

MPs asked the government about the rising number of people seeking treatment for gambling addiction (many young, mostly online), the lack of a ban on online gambling advertising, the minimum gambling age, drug addiction trends including cannabis and new substances, and the cost of cannabis-related addiction care. The minister acknowledged the trends as worrying, pointed to planned gambling law revision with consultation in 2026 and a planned raise of the minimum age to 21, and listed prevention measures while declining to ban gambling outright and giving no cost breakdown for cannabis treatment.
The aim is to put the relevant bill out for consultation in 2026.
Het streven is om het betreffende wetsvoorstel in 2026 in consultatie te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Van der Burg en Diederik van Dijk over de uitvoering van de motie-Sjoerdsma c.s. ten aanzien van erkenning en schadevergoeding voor Indische slachtoffers van Nederlandse

Four MPs asked the Foreign Minister why the promised local disclosure of the NIMH victims list and claims handling for Indonesian victims of Dutch abuses has not yet happened two years after the Sjoerdsma motion. The minister answers that privacy assessments under the GDPR are slow, that a foundation has been funded to promote the scheme locally, and that the list is expected to be shared this autumn.
It is expected that the data overview can be shared with the Indonesian foundation this autumn.
Naar verwachting kan het gegevensoverzicht dit najaar worden gedeeld met de Indonesische stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Diederik van Dijk over ‘De geëscaleerde demonstratie bij een bijeenkomst van Christenen voor Israël’

MPs Bikker and Van Dijk asked how the government views an escalated pro-Palestinian demonstration at a Christenen voor Israël gathering in Barneveld, including intimidation of attendees, the role of the mayor and police, and whether freedom of assembly is safeguarded. The government answered that the gathering went ahead, that intimidation is unacceptable, and that the mayor is responsible for facilitating and intervening, while referring to a WODC study on how demonstration rights relate to other fundamental rights due in summer 2025 and a government response in autumn.
It is the responsibility of local authorities, in particular the mayor, to facilitate demonstrations as much as possible and to intervene where necessary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal gezag, in het bijzonder de burgemeester, om demonstraties zoveel mogelijk te faciliteren en waar nodig in te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het toezicht en vergunningverlening onder de Wet Wapens en Munitie

An MP asked the Justice Minister about oversight and licensing under the Weapons and Ammunition Act, including regional differences in licences for air-pistol and airsoft rental, the proposed reform for airsoft providers, the status and oversight of airsoft associations, and the validity period of hunting licences. The minister answered that licences are issued locally with possible interpretation differences that will be levelled, that airsoft associations are checked on board reliability and fraud reports, and that the topics will be addressed in the planned modernisation of the Act without firm commitments on timing.
Once these differences are noticed, efforts will be made to level them out.
Zodra deze verschillen opgemerkt worden, zal ingezet worden op het nivelleren hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht ‘Hoe wij bij een CvI-lezing werden belaagd en geïntimideerd door demonstranten’

MPs Van Dijk and Flach asked the government about reports of intimidation of attendees at a lecture by a Dutch organisation, and whether protest rights permit criminal conduct without enforcement. The Minister condemned the intimidation, said demonstration rights do not cover criminal acts, and pointed to local authority and prosecutors for enforcement while a WODC study on conflicting fundamental rights is pending, with no commitment to amend the Public Demonstrations Act yet.
I am not anticipating changes to legislation ahead of the results of the WODC study.
Ik loop niet vooruit op het wijzigen van wetgeving voorafgaand aan de resultaten van het WODC-onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach en Diederik van Dijk over de uit de hand gelopen bijeenkomst op 22 april in Lelystad

MPs Bikker, Eerdmans, Flach and Van Dijk asked whether a counter-demonstration at a Christians for Israel lecture in Lelystad, which forced attendees to stay inside for about three quarters of an hour, was announced or permitted, what support municipalities get, and how safety will be guaranteed. The minister answers that the municipality was informed only shortly before, that the mayor is responsible for facilitating demonstrations, and that a research study on the legal framework is expected at the end of summer.
In the Netherlands the mayor is responsible for facilitating the right to demonstrate.
In Nederland is de burgemeester verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van het demonstratierecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk, Eerdmans, Van der Burg en Ceder over de brief van omstreden VN-rapporteur Albanese aan Christenen voor Israël

MPs from SGP, JA21, VVD and ChristenUnie asked the Foreign Minister about a letter from UN Special Rapporteur Albanese to Christians for Israel, its mandate limits, and threats of criminal consequences. The minister answered that communicating with non-state actors falls within the mandate, that the government disagrees with her content, that vandalism and intimidation are condemned, and that the mandate is adequately defined and the letter was confidential practice.
The letter itself has not been made public.
De brief zelf is niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over christenvervolging in Indonesië

An SGP MP asks the Foreign Minister about attacks on Christians in Indonesia, permit requirements for worship, and what the government will do about administrative discrimination and social intolerance. The minister acknowledges the problems, says gatherings should be possible without permits, and points to dialogue programmes such as JISRA and embassy projects, without committing to a specific new step.
The Netherlands will continue to stress this principle in dialogue with the Indonesian authorities.
Nederland zal dit uitgangspunt blijven onderstrepen in de dialoog met de Indonesische autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de advertentie van ambtenaren van het ministerie van Asiel en Migratie

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how she views an advertisement in Trouw by ministry civil servants distancing themselves from the minister, whether it conflicts with civil servants' loyalty duties under the Ambtenarenwet, and what steps she will take. The minister answered that civil servants must respect the Ambtenarenwet and Gedragscode Integriteit Rijk, that the ad's message is in line with cabinet policy, and declined to take further action or raise the issue in cabinet.
Civil servants must abide by the Ambtenarenwet.
Ambtenaren dienen zich te houden aan de Ambtenarenwet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Diederik van Dijk en Van Nispen over de berichten 'Gokgedupeerden’ willen hun geld terug van onlinecasino’s: maken ze een kans, ze drukten toch zelf op het knopje?' en 'Gokbedrijv

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether gambling operator Unibet, which operated illegally before licensing, should keep its Dutch licence while it withholds transaction data from players suing to recover losses, and whether the regulator should act. The State Secretary answered that licence decisions rest with the independent Kansspelautoriteit, that the Ksa will weigh conduct in future licence assessments, that the matter of data access is for the courts, and that the Netherlands supports the European Commission's infringement procedure against Malta over Bill 55.
It is not for me to decide on suspending or revoking a licence.
Het is niet aan mij is om te besluiten over het schorsen of intrekken van een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het beoordelen en terugsturen van christelijke vluchtelingen

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how returning Christian refugees to Nigeria, given severe Christian persecution there, is assessed, how IND staff gain and verify country information, and whether IND expertise on conversion claims should be strengthened with external experts. The Minister answered that Christians are not treated as a risk group, each case is individually assessed against current country information, IND staff are trained and consult conversion coordinators, and sees no concrete need to further strengthen expertise.
In current policy, Christians are not designated as a group or profile facing an elevated risk.
In het huidige beleid worden christenen niet als groep of profiel aangemerkt waarvoor een verhoogd risico geldt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de mogelijke consequenties van strafbaarstelling illegaliteit

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether the Raad van State should be asked for urgent advice on whether humanitarian aid could fall under the criminalisation of illegal stay in article 108a, and whether that article should not enter into force until parliament has deliberated. The minister agreed to ask the Raad van State for advice after the bill's adoption and to deliberate with parliament before the article takes effect, while noting he cannot pre-empt how prosecutors and courts will interpret it.

As soon as the bill is adopted by the House of Representatives, I will ask the Raad van State to advise on whether there is a considerable chance that individual acts of humanity or humanitarian aid also fall under this article.

Ik zal zodra het wetsvoorstel in de Tweede Kamer is aangenomen de Raad van State vragen te adviseren over de vraag of een aanmerkelijke kans bestaat dat ook individuele gedragingen uit menselijkheid of humanitaire hulp onder dit artikel vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Diederik van Dijk over het UN Watch onderzoek naar omstreden VN-rapporteur Francesca Albanese

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about UN Watch allegations that UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese had improper sponsored travel and that complaints were buried. The minister replied that the UN coordination committee found no breach of the code of conduct, that the internal complaint procedure appears adequate, and that the government shares concern about some of her remarks while respecting UN procedures.
Complaints about the conduct of UN Special Rapporteurs are always handled confidentially.
Klachten over het handelen van VN Speciaal Rapporteurs worden altijd vertrouwelijk behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het stopzetten van grootschalige voedselhulp in Ethiopië

Two SGP MPs asked the government about the WFP halting food aid to 650,000 malnourished women and children in Ethiopia due to funding shortfalls, its consequences, risks to peace in Tigray, the funding gap, and Dutch and EU options to help. Minister Klever answered that 3.6 million people risk losing aid, that Dutch contributions (EUR 60 million to WFP, EUR 9 million to the Ethiopia humanitarian fund) cannot offset large US aid cuts, and that the government is raising the issue within the EU and other donor fora.
The Netherlands has managed to keep the humanitarian aid budget at its level, but it is impossible for the Netherlands to compensate for large global reductions in life-saving aid.
Nederland heeft het budget voor humanitaire hulp op peil weten te houden, maar het is voor Nederland onmogelijk om forse wereldwijde reducties in levensreddende hulp te compenseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Stoffer en Flach over het bericht Cryptomijnen in een land onder hoogspanning

MPs Van Dijk, Stoffer and Flach asked the ministers whether Dutch and EU rules apply to Dutch firms mining crypto in Ethiopia, and about its benefits, its effect on the local population's electricity, and the government's moral view. The minister answered that OECD and UN business standards apply, that crypto mining brings foreign currency but little direct benefit to the population, and that no additional legislation is needed.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to apply the OECD Guidelines on responsible business conduct and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen en de UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights toepassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Paulusma, Bikker en Krul over het beëindigen van de VWS-subsidie aan het IKNL Trialbureau

MPs asked why the minister is ending the VWS subsidy for the IKNL trial bureau, its amount, timing, alternatives and impact. The minister confirmed the subsidy for trial activities ends on 1 January 2026 on state aid grounds, stated the 2025 amount, and declined substantive answers on alternatives and timing because an objection by IKNL is pending.
Because of this ongoing objection procedure, I cannot make any further substantive statements.
Vanwege deze lopende bezwaarprocedure kan ik daarom verder geen inhoudelijke uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over ‘haatpredikers op de TU Eindhoven’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about planned talks at TU Eindhoven by speakers alleged to praise Hamas and support IS, and about powers to bar extremist speakers. The minister said the university had banned the lecture, that extremist speakers are a matter for event organisers and local mayors, and that the national security measures cannot be applied to non-foreign speakers.
Where it concerns extremist speakers, it is primarily up to the organisers of an event to ensure they are not given a platform.
Daar waar het gaat om extremistische sprekers is het in eerste instantie aan organisatoren van een evenement om te zorgen dat zij geen podium worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Rajkowski, Diederik van Dijk en Boomsma over het bericht ‘Onlogische, lange en onnodige ritten: misbruik taxivervoer asielzoekers blootgelegd’

Three MPs asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports of misuse of taxi transport for asylum seekers, including a rejected Woo request, the costs and number of medically indicated taxi rides, verification of medical appointments, suspected 'ghost rides' and whether the rules should be tightened. The minister answered in detail on numbers, indication criteria and controls, stated that further investigation is underway, and announced stricter rules for non-medical taxi rides from 1 June.
COA refused the document on the ground that it contains competitive and commercially sensitive information provided to COA in confidence.
Het COA heeft het betreffende document geweigerd op de grond dat het concurrentie- en bedrijfsgevoelige informatie bevat die vertrouwelijk aan het COA ter beschikking zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie en het ministerie van SZW en VWS iftars organiseren

Two SGP MPs asked whether police and ministries hold iftar gatherings during Ramadan, questioning their neutrality given a reported in-uniform prayer, their costs, and why Islamic holidays dominate. The government answered that police and ministries organise gatherings for diversity and inclusion, that costs are absorbed in existing budgets, that in-uniform prayer is undesirable while attending iftars is acceptable, and that no nationwide policy governs which days are marked.
A call to prayer in uniform does not seem to me to fit with a police force that projects neutrality.
Een oproep tot gebed in uniform vind ik niet passen bij een politie die neutraliteit uitstraalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over beperkte oefenmogelijkheden voor de luchtmacht

An MP from the SGP asked the State Secretary for Defence about the very limited flying and training opportunities for the Air Force after Ramstein Flag, including whether the Besluit militaire luchthavens and noise rules should be evaluated, and how the National Programme for Defence Space (NPRD) addresses this. The State Secretary acknowledged the constraints, said a revision of the Bml replacing the noise metric is being prepared with a letter due in Q3 2025, and described planned expansion of sorties and the NPRD decision timeline, while noting noise-space flexibility and inventorying further bottlenecks.
I will inform the House about this in the third quarter of this year.
Hierover informeer ik uw Kamer in het derde kwartaal van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de mogelijke herbenoeming van de VN Speciaal Gezant mevrouw Albanese

Two MPs from SGP and PVV-aligned Stoffer ask the foreign minister about the possible reappointment of UN Special Rapporteur Albanese, her social media statements, and Dutch involvement in appointments. The minister answers that such rapporteurs act in personal capacity, that Dutch objections were raised with her, that the cabinet does not support her reappointment, and that the decision rests with the UN Human Rights Council.
The cabinet does not support her possible reappointment.
Het kabinet steunt haar eventuele herbenoeming niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Bikker, Krul en Van der Plas over abortus vanwege geslacht

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie, CDA and BBB asked whether sex-based abortion after prenatal sex disappointment is discriminatory, whether it conflicts with the Embryowet ban on sex selection, and whether verification or regulation of pre-technical sex-determination ultrasounds is possible. The state secretary answered that such abortions are rare and multi-motivated, that a study of reasons would be unreliable and undesirable, and that private ultrasounds fall outside state regulation and cannot be influenced by law.
I have made inquiries with the professional groups of midwives (KNOV), sonographers (BEN) and abortion doctors (NGvA) on this.
Ik heb hierop navraag gedaan bij de beroepsgroepen van verloskundigen (KNOV), echoscopisten (BEN) en abortusartsen (NGvA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Dijk en Slagt-Tichelman over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars vinden thuis sterven vaak te duur’

MPs from four parties asked the state secretary for health about reports that insurers refuse to pay for home-based terminal palliative care because of budget caps, and about causes, insurer practices, and remedies. The state secretary disputes the specific case, says insurers report no such refusals, and points to agreements in the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord and the palliative care programme as the way forward.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Bikker over informatie van FIOM over abortus

Two MPs (SGP and ChristenUnie) question the state secretary about FIOM's web page on abortion, asking whether its petri-dish photos and its claims on fetal pain are misleading and whether the subsidy-funded content is neutral. The state secretary defends the photos as accurate, says FIOM and the NGvA may clarify the accompanying text, and states that fetal pain is a matter for clinicians rather than legislation.
Fiom and the NGvA are considering whether this can be further clarified in the accompanying text on the website.
Fiom en het NGvA bekijken of dit verder kan worden verduidelijkt in de begeleidende tekst op de website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Ambulance met spoed steeds langer onderweg: 'In ons dorp bijna nooit op tijd''

MPs Eerdmans and Diederik van Dijk asked the minister about large regional differences in ambulance response times and rising overruns of the 15-minute norm. The minister defended the current regional norm, pointed to a new urgency classification and care coordination, and promised annual transparency on response times at municipal level from 2026, while the 2024 figures are not yet available.
That is why I have formally asked Ambulancezorg Nederland to provide annual transparency on ambulance response times at municipal level from 2026 (reporting year 2025).

Daarom heb ik Ambulancezorg Nederland formeel verzocht om vanaf 2026 (dat wil zeggen rapportagejaar 2025) jaarlijks transparantie te verschaffen over de responstijden van de ambulance op gemeenteniveau
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Agent kan voortaan ook eed zweren op Allah of andere god’

An MP asks why the police oath was modernised to allow religious formulas (such as invoking Allah) without prior parliamentary consultation, questioning consistency with other public employers and the BZK minister's earlier statements on religion. The minister replies that the change is a labour-terms matter agreed with police unions within mandate, that BZK is not responsible for police, and describes the rationale, the Defence-inspired wording, and a work instruction for religious formulas.
The change to the oath and pledge is a change in terms of employment between the police employer and the police unions within the cabinet's mandate.
De wijziging van de eed en belofte betreft een rechtspositionele wijziging tussen werkgever van politie en de politievakbonden binnen mandaat van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het personeelstekort in de kraamzorg

An MP asked the health minister about staff shortages in maternity care, gaps in the number of care hours, insurer duties, the own-contribution barrier, tariffs, funding, wages and training. The minister answered that the sector and insurers are responsible, that exact figures are not known, and pointed to a convenant, a vision, an agenda and existing funding and tariff mechanisms.
Exact figures are not known to me, even after inquiries with the NZa and IGJ.
Exacte aantallen zijn bij mij, ook na navraag bij de NZa en IGJ, niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Diederik van Dijk, Van den Hil, Krul, Ceder, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Slagt-Tichelman, Kostić en Eerdmans over een solide toekomstplan voor Kamp Westerbork naar aanleiding van 80 jaar

MPs asked the government to respond to Kamp Westerbork memorial's financial shortfalls, deferred maintenance and the need for a sustainable future plan, and to say what it will do about the memorial's proposed plan and the Moluccan history. The state secretary answers that a solid future plan will be developed with the memorial centres, one-off 2025 funds have been reserved, the memorial's financing plan is under study, and an OHW letter on progress is expected around summer 2025.
I am studying this plan and looking at what role the central government can play in it.
Ik ben dit plan aan het bestuderen en bekijken welke rol de Rijksoverheid daarin kan spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Eén man, 25 baby’s:‘schijnkinderen’zijn een nieuwe manier om verblijfspapieren te krijgen’

An SGP MP asked the Asylum and Migration minister about reports of 'sham fatherhood' recognitions used to obtain residence permits, including what action is taken and whether recognition should be criminalised. The minister called the signals serious, outlined existing legal tools (refusal by civil registrars, court annulment, prosecution), and said a new approach is being developed, while declining to share a confidential IND report.

That is why an approach to the problem of sham recognitions in Chavez residence applications is currently being developed together with the IND, the Public Prosecution Service, the Dutch Association for Civil Affairs and the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security.

Daarom wordt er op dit moment, in samenwerking met de IND, het Openbaar Ministerie (OM), de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Burgerzaken en de Ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid gewerkt aan een aanpak voor de problematiek rondom schijnerkenningen bij Chavez-verblijfsaanvragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Bikker over het bericht ‘Deze zes mensen zien het vuilste van wat op internet rondgaat’ en ‘Politie waarschuwt honderdvijftig bezitters van kinderporno

MPs Van Dijk, Krul and Bikker asked why Dutch hosting providers are slow to remove child sexual abuse material, why police only warn downloaders rather than arrest them, and what legal tools exist. The minister acknowledges that only about 26% of Offlimits reports were handled within 24 hours in 2023, points to the new ATKM powers since July 2024, and explains that police prioritise producers and networks, using warning campaigns for downloaders.
In 74% of cases no or insufficient follow-up was given to a report, and the child pornography material remained visible for at least 24 hours.
In 74% van de gevallen werd geen of onvoldoende opvolging gegeven aan een melding en blijft het kinderpornografisch materiaal op zijn minst langer dan 24 uur zichtbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Wal, Diederik van Dijk en Mohandis over de digitale openbaarmaking van het Centraal Archief Bijzondere Rechtspleging

MPs from D66, VVD, SGP and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science when and how the Central Archive of Special Jurisdiction (CABR) can be searched online by name of war victims and suspected collaborators, and why only names but not the underlying dossiers were published. The Minister answers that a temporary searchable facility at the National Archives is being prepared, a bill creating a legal basis for balancing privacy against access will go to consultation by end of March, and that the name index must be public as the only way to request dossiers, despite Data Protection Authority concerns.

I intend to put a draft bill out for consultation before the end of March that will create the legal basis, missed by the Data Protection Authority, for access to archives containing ordinary, special and criminal personal data.

Ik wil vóór eind maart een conceptwetsvoorstel in consultatie brengen die de door de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens (AP) gemiste grondslag zal creëren voor toegang tot archieven met gewone, bijzondere en strafrechtelijke persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Kind met achternaam van beide ouders kan, maar niet iedereen geeft toestemming’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the courts should be able to grant substitute consent when parents disagree on a child's surname under the new combined surname law, and whether the transitional rules should be changed. The State Secretary answered that he opposes allowing courts to decide such disputes, and that the transitional arrangement was a deliberate choice limited to children born from 2016 and under about eight years old, so no change is planned.
Like my predecessor, I am for now not in favour of such a possibility.
Net als mijn voorganger ben ik vooralsnog geen voorstander van een dergelijke mogelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de effectiviteit van medische genderbehandelingen bij kinderen

An SGP MP asked the government about the effectiveness of gender-affirming medical treatment for minors, citing an Amsterdam academic article questioning how such effectiveness should be judged, and asked how this fits with passende zorg criteria and the Zorgverzekeringswet. Minister Agema answered that treatment follows careful psychological evaluation and monitoring, that the Gezondheidsraad is advising on the matter, that coverage follows the 'stand van de wetenschap en praktijk' criterion, and that Zorginstituut work on the scope of transgender care is ongoing without a fixed end date.
It is legally stipulated that all insured care under the Health Insurance Act must meet the criterion of 'the state of science and practice'.
Het is wettelijk bepaald dat alle te verzekeren zorg in de Zorgverzekeringswet dient te voldoen aan het criterium « de stand van de wetenschap en praktijk ».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Boomsma en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht 'Asielzoekers met bekeringsverhaal krijgen minder vaak een verblijfsvergunning, zien advocaten'

MPs Ceder, Boomsma and Diederik van Dijk asked whether asylum claims based on conversion are now assessed more strictly after a 1 July 2024 change in the credibility framework, and how IND staff are trained and supported on Christianity and conversion. The minister denies that conversion claims are assessed more strictly, says documents now play a more prominent role, and refuses to provide statistics on conversion-based grant and refusal rates, citing lack of aggregated data.
The IND does not have this information because it does not record at an aggregated level what the asylum motive is for cases that are granted or refused.
De IND beschikt niet over deze informatie omdat niet op geaggregeerd niveau wordt bijgehouden wat het asielmotief is van zaken die worden ingewilligd en afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Bikker over het bericht dat de Campagne van Platform Zorg voor Leven geweerd is vanwege “te veel negatief commentaar”

MPs Van Dijk and Bikker asked whether the government considers it acceptable that schools and education bodies refused an anti-abortion campaign from Platform Zorg voor Leven that was not in conflict with advertising rules, and how students are informed about alternatives to abortion. The State Secretary said schools decide their own advertising and curricula under constitutional autonomy, pointed to existing sexual education, counselling and information services, and did not commit to any new action.
Schools and educational institutions themselves determine how they shape their education.
Scholen en onderwijsinstellingen bepalen zelf hoe zij hun onderwijs vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Verbazing over ‘nep-beveiligers’ tijdens pro-Palestina demonstratie’

Two SGP MPs asked whether a pro-Palestine demonstration in Leiden, where persons acting as self-appointed security (Protest Alliance Watch) allegedly enforced their own rules on station travellers, violated the ban on private armed-style organisations and whether NS station staff were adequately trained. The minister answered that the right to demonstrate applies within the law, that local authorities and police, not the minister, judge such conduct, that police did not observe forced removals, that NS conductors (boa's) have limited powers and no specific training is needed, and that a joint escalation framework is being drafted in response to a motion.
The judgment on whether specific concrete conduct constitutes a criminal offence is reserved for the Public Prosecution Service and ultimately the court.
Het oordeel of bepaald concreet handelen valt onder een strafrechtelijk delict is voorbehouden aan het Openbaar Ministerie en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘‘Duitse aanklager: Hamas heeft een wapendepot in Denemarken om klaar te zijn voor mogelijke aanslagen’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister about a German report on Hamas weapons depots in Europe, possible Dutch links, screening of Hamas-linked organisations, and why Samidoun was not placed on the national terrorism sanctions list. The minister declined to comment on the individual case due to an ongoing German investigation, described existing screening and sanctions tools, and stated that the Public Prosecution Service is independent and had no grounds to open an investigation into Samidoun.
In the interest of this ongoing investigation, I cannot make statements about this individual case.
In het belang van dit lopende onderzoek, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Te koop in Nederland: 7 Oktober, de game’

An MP asked the government about a game recreating the 7 October 2023 Hamas attack being sold in the Netherlands, and whether it should be banned. The minister condemned the game, said it was removed from Steam in EU member states after a French removal order, and promised to bring a law criminalising glorification of terrorism to consultation in spring 2025.
That is why the cabinet is also preparing legislation to make the glorification of terrorism a criminal offence with a high maximum sentence.
Daarom bereidt het kabinet ook wetgeving voor om het verheerlijken van terrorisme strafbaar te stellen met een hoog strafmaximum.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Hamas’s extensive network in Europe exposed in a new series of reports’

An MP from the SGP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers how to respond to reports that Hamas-linked actors operate in Europe, including whether they should be placed on the national and EU terrorism sanctions lists and how disinformation and Hamas-linked networks should be monitored. Minister Van Weel answered that the matter was passed to competent authorities, explained the legal criteria for listing and the limits on acting, and said the government will pursue further EU measures and criminalise glorification of terrorism.
In the interest of how the intelligence services operate, no statements are made about this in public.
In het belang van de werkwijze van de inlichtingendiensten worden hierover in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het verdwijnen van de restitutiepolis

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health whether the disappearance of restitution health insurance policies in 2025 threatens access to care, including the freedom of doctor choice under the Zvw, and whether the Minister would monitor the effects on mental health care waiting lists. The Minister acknowledged the disappearance, stated that insurers' duty of care and NZa supervision remain, that the Minister has no legal instrument to force insurers to offer restitution policies, and that monitoring and broader ggz measures will follow in a forthcoming accord.
I have no legal instruments to oblige health insurers to offer restitution policies.
Ik heb geen juridische instrumenten om zorgverzekeraars te verplichten om restitutiepolissen aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het snelgroeiende geweld tegen christenen in India

SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the rising violence against Christians in India, its causes, the role of anti-conversion laws, disinformation, caste, and EU action. The minister condemned violence against religious minorities, said Nederland raises freedom of religion in bilateral, EU and UN dialogues including the upcoming EU-India human rights dialogue, but said causes are not clear-cut and gave general answers on several questions.
The Netherlands will continue to do so, including by pushing for this topic to be raised at the next EU-India Human Rights Dialogue.
Nederland zal dit blijven doen, onder meer door in te zetten op agendering van dit onderwerp in de eerstvolgende EU-India Mensenrechtendialoog
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Boomsma, Tseggai en Diederik van Dijk over de aanpak van klanten die betaalde seks hebben met minderjarige slachtoffers van seksuele uitbuiting

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about police and prosecution capacity for pursuing clients who buy sex from minors, after the OM Limburg reportedly declined to target them, and about sentencing, online age verification on sex-advertisement sites, and effective enforcement. The Minister denied any national policy of not pursuing clients, cited the higher statutory maxima and capacity investments, and committed to talks with police, the OM and advertising platforms, plus a policy response to the CKM report before the Christmas recess.
There is no decision that no capacity will be deployed in any case for the investigation of customers of human trafficking.
Er is geen besluit dat er sowieso geen capaciteit wordt ingezet voor de opsporing van klanten van mensenhandel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans, Rikkers-Oosterkamp en Diederik van Dijk over slechte aanrijtijden in kernen van Nunspeet en het artikel dat een vrouw overleed die na een aanrijding drie kwartier moest wachten o

MPs Eerdmans, Rikkers-Oosterkamp and Diederik van Dijk asked about poor ambulance response times in villages around Nunspeet and a reported death after a woman waited three quarters of an hour for an ambulance. The minister expressed sympathy, defended the regional 15-minute norm, pointed to the new urgency triage and a pending dialogue with AZN on local transparency, but declined to publish local figures or accept location-specific accountability.
Monitoring or accounting at local level does not fit with that.
Monitoren of verantwoorden op lokaal niveau sluit daar niet op aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de Jaarrapportage van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd over de Wet afbreking Zwangerschap 2023

An SGP MP asked the state secretary for health about budgets, realised spending and forecast abortion numbers for subsidised abortion clinics in 2021-2025, and whether the IGJ should publish first-half 2024 figures. The state secretary gave the budget figures, said the ministry makes no abortion forecasts (clinics estimate their own activity), declined to draw conclusions about 2024-2025 or post-2025 trends, and refused to request early publication of 2024 data, citing the need for careful processing.
The Ministry of VWS does not make estimates or calculations of abortion rates.
Het Ministerie van VWS maakt geen ramingen of berekeningen van abortuscijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht dat er voor het eerst iemand stierf in een zelfdodingsmachine

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether a suicide capsule reportedly built in the Netherlands and used in Switzerland is lawful, whether its builder needs a patent or permit, whether it can be exported, and whether the government will act against its designer. The minister said the Swiss criminal investigation is ongoing and that the prosecutor (OM) decides on prosecution independently, declining to consult the OM, while stating that export and patenting face no obstacle and that suicide prevention policy continues.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to make this assessment independently and without political interference.
Het is aan het OM om deze beoordeling eigenstandig en zonder politieke inmenging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over het bericht ‘Omstreden Samidoun-kopstuk Mohammed Khatib komt naar Radboud Universiteit Nijmegen: ’Extremistische haatprediker’

Two MPs from the SGP asked whether the government will act against the planned lecture by Samidoun figure Mohammed Khatib at Radboud University, including through a national terror listing, a travel ban, or a ban on Samidoun. The ministers answered that entry has been refused and the university cancelled the lecture, that they will not intervene in academic debate, that Khatib has been flagged in E&S but the Twbmt cannot bar him from the country, and that they will talk with Germany and the Public Prosecution Service about Samidoun and support an EU listing.
With regard to the organisation Samidoun, other countries have established links with terrorist organisations.
Ten aanzien van de organisatie Samidoun geldt dat andere landen banden met terroristische organisaties hebben vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘VWS negeert advies Raad van State bij regie over opleidingsplekken'

An MP from the SGP asked the Minister of Health why she adopted a decree capping training-place subsidies despite the Council of State's doubts about its legal basis, and whether she would introduce a repair law. The minister answers that the government re-examined the legal basis, concluded the power exists, sees no need for a statutory change, and will await a mid-2025 evaluation before deciding on amendments.

The government re-examined whether the chosen legal basis is sufficient in light of the advice and concluded that there is a power to set, by AMvB, conditions, requirements and restrictions for the NZa when granting availability contributions.

De regering heeft naar aanleiding van het advies opnieuw onderzocht of de gekozen grondslag volstaat. Zij heeft geconcludeerd dat er een bevoegdheid is om bij AMvB voorwaarden, voorschriften en beperkingen voor de NZa te stellen bij de toekenning van beschikbaarheidbijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het OM kan criminaliteit in de zorg niet meer aan: ‘Er wordt jaarlijks voor 10 miljard gefraudeerd’

Diederik van Dijk (SGP) asked the ministers of Health and Justice about reports that organised crime and fraud in healthcare cost around 10 billion euros a year and that prosecutors cannot cope, asking about cooperation, data sharing, inspection, fraud law and prioritisation. The minister answers that the Wbsrz (in force 1 January 2025) and a warning register will improve data sharing, that prosecution is already prioritised, and that she will not weaken the intent requirement or reverse the burden of proof but will review regulation with partners.
I am willing to enter into discussion with health insurers about how they check and reimburse claims for care provided in foreign clinics, and to inform your House about this in spring 2025.

Ik ben bereid het gesprek met zorgverzekeraars aan te gaan over de vraag op welke manier zij declaraties voor zorg – die geleverd is in buitenlandse klinieken – controleren en vergoeden, en uw Kamer daarover in het voorjaar van 2025 te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over groeiend aantal boeren dat wordt benaderd door onder meer drugscriminelen

Two MPs asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about a reported rise in farmers approached by drug criminals offering use of barns, and what is being done. The minister acknowledged the problem, said the data does not show a rising trend, and described existing measures (advisors, Veilig Buitengebied, reporting lines) while declining to give police-level detail on how cases are handled.
This specific theme is also not registered as a separate category by the police.
Dit specifieke thema wordt ook niet als aparte categorie geregistreerd door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Fins onderzoek: Spijt bij geslachtsverandering neemt toe’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Health about a Finnish study reporting rising regret after gender-affirming hormone treatment, and whether it would inform the Dutch transgender care quality standard and how many Dutch patients stop treatment. The minister answered that the Finnish findings will be considered in the ongoing standard update, that Dutch data on regret is limited, and that the Gezondheidsraad has been asked to review long-term effects.
I consider it important that the results of this study are taken into account in the revision of the Somatic Transgender Care Quality Standard.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de resultaten van dit onderzoek meegenomen worden bij de herziening van de Kwaliteitsstandaard Transgenderzorg Somatisch
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de aankondiging van Holland Casino om over te gaan tot ‘agressieve gokcampagnes’ om meer gokkers te werven

An MP asked the government whether Holland Casino's announcement of aggressive gambling campaigns to attract more gamblers, despite its state ownership and the advertising ban, was acceptable and what it would do about it. The state secretary replied that Holland Casino has no plans to significantly increase marketing spend, that aggressive campaigns are unacceptable to it, and that as shareholder the state expects compliance with rules and an exemplary role.
It is therefore not the intention of Holland Casino, and never has been, to attract more customers through aggressive marketing campaigns.
Het is dus niet de bedoeling van Holland Casino, en ook nooit geweest, om met agressieve marketingcampagnes meer klanten te werven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk en Tuinman over het bericht dat de Europese coördinator van het in Duitsland verboden Samidoun, genaamd Mohammed Khatib, op 10 juni 2024 komt spreken op de Radb

MPs Eerdmans, Diederik van Dijk and Tuinman asked whether the government would engage Germany on Samidoun's Radboud University talk, bar the speaker from entry, ban the organisation, and push for EU terrorist listing. The minister answered that the government will talk with Germany, that the universities bear responsibility for event conditions, that the entry ban law does not allow refusing entry, and that listing is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and the Foreign Ministry, with the motion being investigated.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to consider whether there are grounds to ban an organisation, not for the cabinet.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bezien of er redenen zijn waarom een organisatie verboden moet worden, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘De kapper pochte in de salon dat hij de IND had bedonderd met een schijnhuwelijk, maar de immigratiedienst trof geen maatregelen’

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that the IND was given information about a suspected sham marriage but took no action, and how fraud signals are reported and investigated. The State Secretary said the IND investigated an integrity report internally and via the Integriteitscommissie, that new information led to a follow-up investigation, and that an independent investigation has been commissioned, though he would not anticipate its findings.
An independent investigation is being carried out under the commissioning of the acting Secretary-General of the Ministry of Justice and Security.
Er wordt een onafhankelijk onderzoek uitgevoerd onder opdrachtgeverschap van de waarnemend secretaris-generaal van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de vervolging en benarde positie van christenen in Pakistan

MPs Diederik van Dijk and Stoffer asked the Foreign Minister about violence against Christians in Pakistan after blasphemy-linked mob attacks in Sargodha, and about police protection, compensation, support for civil society and contacts with religious leaders and courts. The minister answered that the government is concerned, has raised the issue with Pakistani authorities, describes the trends in blasphemy prosecutions, and outlines Dutch and EU engagement, including monitoring some trials and possible travel by the EU envoy.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about these acts of violence in Sargodha, Pakistan, arising from blasphemy accusations.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstige zorgen over deze gewelddadigheden in Sargodha, Pakistan, als gevolg van beschuldigingen van blasfemie.
Antwoord op de leden Diederik van Dijk en Stoffer over de reeks (Islamitische) aanvallen op Koptische Christenen in Egypte

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about attacks on Coptic Christians in Egypt, including Al Minya, and what the Dutch government and EU are doing about religious freedom and impunity. The minister answered that the government shares concern, the embassy is monitoring, Egyptian authorities have responded, and religious freedom is a diplomatic priority raised at various levels, with the Special Envoy for Religion and Belief engaging the Egyptian ambassador.
I do not have independent information about the alleged perpetrators and therefore cannot judge them.
Ik beschik niet over eigenstandige informatie over de vermeende daders, en kan daar dan ook geen oordeel over geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and BBB asked the government how it will protect vulnerable people from suicide powder Middel X, given a study finding at least 172 deaths and 70% with a psychiatric history, and why the substance is not banned. The minister says access is limited via an industry code, that a ban is legally complicated and of limited effect, and that additional forensic powers and follow-up research are planned.
A change to the Burial and Cremation Act is currently being prepared, giving forensic physicians more powers to conduct further investigation.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een wijziging van de Wet op de lijkbezorging (Wlb), waarbij de forensisch arts meer bevoegdheden krijgt om nader onderzoek te doen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Boon over de berichten 'Staatssecretaris: begrip voor uitstel concerten Israëlische groep' en 'Driehoek wist niets van het besluit over afgelastin

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary for culture how the government will ensure artists can perform safely regardless of origin, and why she showed understanding for Het Concertgebouw cancelling Jerusalem Quartet concerts without consulting the local security triangle. The answers say the cancellation was a security-based decision by the venue, that the state secretary understood it as an exception, that a general guidance document is being prepared with the sector, and that a concert date is being sought.
However, Het Concertgebouw itself made the decision to cancel this concert before advice had been given by the security triangle.
Het Concertgebouw heeft echter zelf de beslissing genomen om dit concert af te gelasten voordat er een advies vanuit de driehoek was gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk en Flach over het bericht 'Halsema wilde Extinction Rebellion bij blokkade A10 'zoveel mogelijk tegemoet komen''

MPs Diederik van Dijk and Flach asked whether the Amsterdam mayor's tolerance of a banned Extinction Rebellion motorway blockade on the A10, and the prosecution policy of not pursuing single Wom offences, weakens enforcement of the law. The ministers answered that the mayor has primary responsibility for demonstration rules, that the public prosecutor decides on prosecution case by case, that six demonstrators received 200 euro penalties, and that the ministry will address the legal framework in a letter on the right to demonstrate.
We take this responsibility seriously and have therefore reported to your House extensively on it in the letter on the right to demonstrate that you recently received.
Wij nemen deze verantwoordelijkheid serieus en hebben uw Kamer hier dan ook uitgebreid over bericht in de Kamerbrief over het demonstratierecht die u onlangs heeft ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Politie pakt waker op bij abortuskliniek’

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether a single-person protest outside an abortion clinic, which led to a six-hour detention, was lawful and protected by freedom of expression, and what municipalities are told about such protests. The minister answered that the police act under local authority, that single-person protests fall under Article 7 of the Constitution rather than the Wom, that content cannot justify a ban though municipalities may set form rules, and that only courts can judge the lawfulness of local restrictions.
It is not for me or the Minister of Justice and Security to intervene in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij of aan de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om te treden in individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Krul, Diederik van Dijk en Jansen over het bericht 'Coffeeshops Tilburg en Breda mogen meer legale cannabisvoorraad in huis hebben: ‘genoeg voor een week’'

Four MPs asked whether the government had decided to raise the legal cannabis stock limit for coffeeshops in Tilburg and Breda beyond one week's supply, and why parliament learned of it only through the media. The minister replied that the 500-gram local limit was dropped after burgemeesters found it unworkable, that the change was previously announced in parliament, and that police and prosecutors raised no objections though they suggested a fixed weight.
Question 3: Why must the House learn from the media that the government is dropping a uniform norm altogether
Vraag 3 Waarom moet de Kamer in de media vernemen dat de regering een uniforme norm in het geheel loslaat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Diederik van Dijk en Dijk over de interactieve tablettour van het Nationaal Holocaustmuseum voor groepen leerlingen uit het voortgezet onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the government recognises the value of school visits to the Holocaust Museum, whether it will push all secondary pupils to visit, and whether free museum admission for all Dutch citizens will be explored. The government agrees Holocaust education matters, says schools must take the initiative, points to existing school funding and a forthcoming national Holocaust education plan, and leaves museum pricing to the museum itself.
However, it is up to schools themselves to take the initiative here and to look at which activity fits the school and target group.
Het is echter aan scholen zelf om hier initiatief toe te nemen en te kijken welke activiteit past bij de school en doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Verzorgingshuis laat stervende patiënt (87) niet meer eten, verpleger kan het niet verkroppen en gaat in de fout’

An SGP MP asked ministers about a reported case in which a nursing home stopped feeding a dying 87-year-old patient, a nurse broke with protocol, and whether refusal of feeding is legally protected. The ministers answered that the OM and IGJ investigations are pending, the patient's right to voluntarily stop eating and drinking is grounded in self-determination, conscientious objections are governed by professional codes, and the assessment of sanctions is for competent bodies.
Pending the ruling of the Supreme Court, the OM's investigation is at a standstill.
In afwachting van de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad ligt het onderzoek van het OM stil.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het online verstrekken van abortuspillen

MP Diederik van Dijk (SGP) asked about the status of a bill replacing the temporary policy rule on prescribing medicines online, whether abortion clinics use it to provide abortion pills remotely, how the Health Inspectorate (IGJ) supervises and enforces online abortion pill provision, and how foreign online providers such as Women on Web relate to Dutch law. The minister answered that a Medicines Act amendment is in preparation, that one clinic uses digital consults under the policy rule, that the IGJ supervises and enforces under the Wafz and Criminal Code, and that enforcement against foreign providers depends on the circumstances.
Following this question I have made an inquiry among the managers of abortion clinics.
Naar aanleiding van deze vraag heb ik een uitvraag gedaan bij bestuurders van abortusklinieken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Diederik van Dijk over patiënten die het Amsterdam UMC aansprakelijk stellen voor schade na gezichtsoperaties

MPs Van der Plas and Van Dijk asked the minister about patients holding Amsterdam UMC liable for harm after facial surgeries, including allegations of pressure, incomplete risk information and whether the IGJ should investigate. The minister answered all 13 questions in substance, saying the IGJ sees no reason to investigate, that the care is medically indicated and individually decided, and that the quality standard is being evaluated.
From my position I cannot go into individual files that are before the court.
Ik kan vanuit mijn positie niet ingaan op individuele dossiers die zich onder de rechter bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Samidoun-kopstuk naar Amsterdam: club riep op ’Europa te verslaan met kalasjnikovs, raketten en kogels’’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a PFLP-linked Samidoun speaker, reportedly calling to defeat Europe with weapons, could be barred from entry or from operating in Amsterdam, and whether the Samidoun organisation could be banned. The government answered that the IND found insufficient grounds to exclude him under current criteria, that local authorities saw no basis for a area ban, and that a Dutch ban would be a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, not the cabinet.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service, not the cabinet, to decide whether there is cause in this case to make such a request.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie, niet aan het kabinet, om zich uit te spreken over de vraag of er in casu aanleiding bestaat om een dergelijk verzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Milieuorganisatie stapt naar de rechter om renovatie Binnenhof te stoppen’

MPs Flach and Van Dijk asked about an environmental group's court appeal to halt the Binnenhof renovation over nitrogen permits, its standing as a cooperative, and possible delays. The minister answered that the appeal is pending before the court, that a nature permit was granted in January 2024, that delay effects will be reported in the next progress report, and that the court decides on standing.
I cannot go into the substance of this appeal procedure or the arguments to be made, because this case is before the court.
Op de inhoud van deze beroepsprocedure en de te voeren argumenten kan ik nu niet ingaan, omdat deze zaak voorligt bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Diederik van Dijk over de reeks (Islamitische) aanvallen op Christenen in Nigeria rond kerst

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister how to interpret the deadly late-December 2023 attacks on Christian villages in Nigeria's Plateau state, what Nigerian authorities and the Netherlands are doing about religious violence and foreign financing, and what the Dutch and EU freedom-of-religion envoys are doing. The minister answered that the violence is a broader resource conflict not aimed solely at one group, that Nigerian security capacity is insufficient, that the Netherlands raises concerns bilaterally and in UN review, and that its envoys raise Nigeria in FoRB fora.
Nigerian citizens of Christian or Muslim faith have for years been victims of interreligious and intra-religious violence.
Nigeriaanse burgers met een Christelijke of Moslim geloofsovertuiging zijn al jaren slachtoffers van interreligieus en intra-religieus geweld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over de grote zorgen van het internationale artsencollectief (SEGM) over genderrichtlijn WHO

An SGP MP asked the Health Minister about concerns from the SEGM physicians' collective over the WHO guideline on trans and gender-diverse health, including the consultation timing and expert selection. The minister rejected the concerns, explained the WHO procedure, noted the consultation was extended to 2 February 2024, and said the guideline does not cover minors while Dutch care standards are under evaluation.
I do not share the concerns of the Society for Evidence Based Gender Medicine (SEGM) regarding the development of the WHO Guidelines on the health of trans and gender-diverse people.

Ik deel de zorgen niet van de Society for Evidence Based Gender Medicine (SEGM) met betrekking tot de ontwikkeling van de Richtlijnen voor de gezondheid van trans- en genderdiverse personen door de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie (WHO).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Tuinman en Diederik van Dijk over de mogelijke oprichting van een eigen tankbataljon

MPs Boswijk, Tuinman and Diederik van Dijk asked the government about reviving a national tank battalion, its cost, its links with Germany and the timing of a Leopard 2A8 procurement decision. The government says a tank battalion is not funded and that the decision on it is left to the next cabinet, while giving substantive answers on cost structure, the German cooperation and technology, and withholding only the commercially confidential cost breakdown, which it supplies in a confidential annex.
This cost specification contains commercially confidential elements.
Deze kostenspecificatie bevat commercieel vertrouwelijke elementen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder en Bontenbal over het bericht 'Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’'

MPs asked whether the government will prevent extremist preacher Mohamed Hoblos from spreading his message online after being denied physical entry to a Utrecht event, and why the venue and mayor could not stop it. The government answered that an online approach is being developed, that terrorist content can be removed, and that under existing law a mayor can only ban a speaker in concrete and serious threat cases, while the organiser and Jaarbeurs assured the speaker would not speak.

Through various pillars, such as dialogue with the internet sector, the local approach and an ambitious international effort, the Minister of Justice and Security is making every possible effort in this regard, nationally and internationally.

Via diverse pijlers, zoals een dialoog met de internetsector, de lokale aanpak en een ambitieuze internationale inzet spant de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid zich hier, nationaal en internationaal, zo maximaal mogelijk voor in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Helder, Michon-Derkzen, Bontenbal over het bericht ‘Australische haatprediker ongemoeid naar Utrecht: terreurdaden Hamas ’een opsteker’’
