MPs asked the Justice Minister whether an Australian extremist preacher planning to speak in Utrecht could be barred from entry, and what would stop him operating elsewhere in the Netherlands. The government answered that it acts against speakers who incite hatred or violence, that the preacher is flagged in the Schengen SIS system for refusal of entry, and that the municipality and services cooperated to prevent him getting a platform.
This refusal of entry applies, in line with the Schengen Borders Code, to all other Schengen member states as well.
Deze toegangsweigering geldt, in lijn met de Schengengrenscode, ook voor alle andere Schengen lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Duitse regeringspartij: Antisemieten mogen geen Duitser worden’

An SGP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Netherlands should adopt a German proposal to bar antisemitic migrants from naturalisation and revoke citizenship for antisemitic offences. The State Secretary answered that existing rules already allow refusal of naturalisation and revocation on public-order grounds, that revocation grounds are limited by law, and saw no reason to contact Germany or explore a similar proposal further.
I see no reason to do so.

Amendement van het lid Van Kent ter vervanging van nr. 8 over adviesrecht van de ondernemingsraad inzake de beloning van bestuurders

Amendement van het lid Van Kent ter vervanging nr. 7 over instemmingsrecht van de ondernemingsraad op de ontwikkeling van de beloning van bestuurders

an arrangement on the level and content of the terms of employment of the board that represents the legal entity
een regeling of afspraak op het gebied van de hoogte en inhoud van de arbeidsvoorwaarden van het bestuur dat de rechtspersoon vertegenwoordigt

Motie van het lid Özdil c.s. over het minimumtarief voor zzp'ers
Asks the government to set the minimum rate for self-employed workers high enough to allow them to afford pension and disability insurance.
this rate is high enough to also be able to take out a pension and disability insurance
dit tarief hoog genoeg is om ook een pensioen- en arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering af te kunnen sluiten
Motie van het lid Van Kent c.s. over 1 miljard om eerder stoppen met werken mogelijk te maken
Asks the government to provide 1 billion euros for earlier retirement in sectors, funded by raising the wealth yield tax for large assets.
requests the government to make 1 billion available to sectors to enable earlier retirement
verzoekt de regering om, 1 miljard beschikbaar te stellen aan sectoren om eerder stoppen met werken mogelijk te maken
Motie van de leden Van Kent en Van Rooijen over de manier van verdeling van de pensioenpremie
Asks the government, if it abolishes the young-old split of the pension premium, not to charge the cost to workers and pensioners.

verzoekt de regering om, indien zij besluit om de manier van verdeling van de pensioenpremie tussen jong en oud af te schaffen, de rekening hiervan niet bij werknemers en gepensioneerden te leggen
Motie van het lid Gijs van Dijk c.s. over uitwerken van scenario's voor eerder stoppen met werken
Asks the government, together with social partners, to develop scenarios enabling earlier retirement for groups in heavy occupations who cannot work until the raised AOW age.
requests the government, in consultation with the social partners, to develop a number of scenarios to make earlier retirement possible
verzoekt de regering, in overleg met de sociale partners een aantal scenario's uit te werken om eerder stoppen met werk mogelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Pieter Heerma c.s. over de situatie op de markt voor maaltijdbezorging
Asks the cabinet to take a position on the meal delivery market and talk with its players, and to explore stronger enforcement against evident bad faith.
requests the cabinet to state its position on the situation in the meal delivery market and to enter into talks with the players in this market;
verzoekt het kabinet, zich uit te spreken over de situatie op de markt voor maaltijdbezorging en met de spelers op deze markt in gesprek te gaan;
Motie van het lid Gijs van Dijk c.s. over de fietskoeriers van Deliveroo
Asks the government to have the Tax Authority immediately enforce against bogus self-employment of Deliveroo bike couriers.
requests the government to have the Tax Authority enforce immediately against the bogus self-employment of Deliveroo's bike couriers
verzoekt de regering, de Belastingdienst direct te laten handhaven op de schijnzelfstandigheid van de fietskoeriers van Deliveroo
Motie van het lid Özdil c.s. over een AOW-regeling voor werknemers in zware sectoren
Asks the government to propose within six months, with social partners, a scheme for workers in heavy sectors by scrapping the early-retirement penalty levy.
requests the government, within six months and in consultation with social partners, to make a proposal for a scheme for workers in heavy sectors
verzoekt de regering, binnen zes maanden in overleg met sociale partners een voorstel te doen voor een regeling voor werknemers in zware sectoren
Motie van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk over de maximale proeftijd bij meerjaarscontracten en jaarcontracten
Asks the government to keep maximum probation periods at two months for multi-year contracts and one month for annual contracts.
calls on the government to leave the maximum probation period unchanged at two months for multi-year contracts and one month for annual contracts
roept de regering op, om de maximale proeftijd ongewijzigd te laten op twee maanden bij meerjaarscontracten en één maand bij jaarcontracten
Amendement van het lid Van Kent over versnelde uitbreiding van de capaciteit van de Inspectie SZW
Amendment shifts 12 million euro in 2018 from subsidy schemes to the Inspectie SZW budget to speed up its capacity expansion, with structural funding from 2020.
With this amendment the submitter wants to ensure that the capacity of the Inspectorate is expanded faster.
Met dit amendement wil de indiener regelen dat de capaciteit van de Inspectie versneld wordt uitgebreid.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Kent ter vervanging van nr. 14 over het in zijn geheel verbieden van stukloon

Amendement van het lid Van Kent over het in zijn geheel verbieden van stukloon
Proposes banning piece-rate pay entirely in the Civil Code so that all workers are paid by hours worked.
Therefore this amendment provides that piece-rate pay is entirely prohibited.

Amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 7 over een personele uitbreiding bij de Inspectie SZW
Increases the departmental budget by 40 million euro to add about 400 staff to the Labour Inspectorate (Inspectie SZW).
In article 96 departmental operating expenditure the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 40,000 thousand euro.
In artikel 96 Apparaatsuitgaven kerndepartement worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 40.000 (x € 1.000).
Amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk c.s. over een personele uitbreiding bij de Inspectie SZW
Adds 40 million euro to core department overhead to hire 400 additional staff at the Inspectie SZW labour inspectorate.
This amendment provides that 400 people will be added to the Inspectie SZW.
Dit amendement regelt dat er 400 mensen bij komen bij de Inspectie SZW.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk ter vervanging van nr. 11 over de mogelijkheid voor spijtoptanten tot aanpassing van de hoog-laag constructie
Re-introduces for pension recipients who started before 2016 the option to vary the high-low pension construction up to age 65 5/12.
Therefore the arrangement for this group of people is reintroduced.
Daarom wordt de regeling voor deze groep mensen opnieuw geïntroduceerd.
Amendement van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk over een aanpassingsmogelijkheid voor de pensioenuitkering bij een dreigend AOW-gat
Amendment allowing pensioners to adjust the variation of their pension payout when the state pension age is raised after pension start, to avoid an AOW gap.
This amendment makes it possible for pensioners to adjust their pension payout in future as well.
Dit amendement maakt het mogelijk dat gepensioneerden ook in de toekomst de mogelijkheid krijgen om hun pensioenuitkering aan te passen
Motie van het lid Van Kent over verruimen van de overbruggingsregeling
Asks the government to come forward before the summer recess with proposals to widen the bridging scheme so more people can use it.
requests the government to come with proposals before the summer recess to widen the bridging scheme
verzoekt de regering om, nog voor het zomerreces met voorstellen te komen om de overbruggingsregeling te verruimen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Dijk over het bericht 'Vacatures voor renovatie Binnenhof duiden op schijnzelfstandigheid'

MPs Van Kent and Dijk (SP) asked the government about reports that Binnenhof renovation vacancies point to bogus self-employment, asking about enforcement, contracting, possible tax offences and worker safety. The minister replies that the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf does not recognise the reports, that no cases are known, that contractors are bound by contract to follow the law, and that enforcement and the phase-out of bogus self-employment within the state are being pursued.
You will be informed shortly by the Minister of BZK about progress in phasing out the number of (potential) bogus self-employed within central government.
Over de voortgang van het afbouwen van het aantal (potentieel) schijnzelfstandigen bij de Rijksoverheid wordt u op korte termijn geïnformeerd door de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Lauwersmeer vervuild door slib uit Reitdiep, ecologen bezorgd’

The MP Van Kent asks whether sludge dumped into the Lauwersmeer Natura 2000 area is polluted, whether the province's plans comply with Natura 2000 rules, and what steps will prevent further pollution. The Minister answers that the province of Groningen and the water board Noorderzijlvest are the competent authorities, that Rijkswaterstaat only assesses effects on the waterway, and that the Minister will not intervene in individual provincial decisions.
It is not for the Minister of I&W to review individual decisions of the provincial executive, unless there is an explicit statutory obligation to do so.
Het is niet aan de Minister van IenW om individuele besluiten van gedeputeerde staten te toetsen, tenzij daartoe een expliciete wettelijke verplichting bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de vervolging van Eternit door het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asks the government about the criminal prosecution of Eternit for manslaughter, the performance of the government-funded Instituut Asbestslachtoffers (IAS) and whether a statutory asbestos fund is needed, and whether the 2016 asbestos ban bill will be re-submitted. The state secretary declines to comment on the prosecution (a matter for the court), rejects the claim that the IAS is failing, and says no new asbestos ban bill is planned given existing EU REACH rules and a voluntary roof-removal strategy.
It is for the court to judge in this case.
Het is aan de rechter om in deze zaak te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de PFAS-vervuiling door het bedrijf Custom Powders in Helmond

An MP asked how the government will respond to PFAS contamination by Custom Powders in Helmond, including unpermitted PFOA discharges, worker exposure, and whether Chemours should be held liable. The minister answered that municipal authority and courts determine liability, that employers are primarily responsible for worker safety, and that a separate exploration of a national PFAS ban will be sent.
Ultimately it is up to the court to determine whether there is legal liability and whether compensation must be awarded.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de rechter om vast te stellen of er sprake is van juridische aansprakelijkheid en of er schadevergoeding moet worden toegekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van Nispen over de berichten dat KaFra Housing winst maakt op de huisvesting voor asielzoekers

Two SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that KaFra Housing, a commercial provider, houses asylum seekers in former worker accommodation and profits from public funds, and whether the state should investigate such arrangements. The minister replied that COA renting commercial locations is not unusual, that emergency shelter is costlier and is being phased out, that the locations meet quality standards, and that no further investigation is deemed necessary.
I do not recognise the picture painted that asylum seekers are being housed in poor living conditions at these locations.
Ik herken niet het beeld dat geschetst wordt dat er asielzoekers met slechte woonomstandigheden op deze locaties worden opgevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Patijn en Van Kent over de afgesloten cao IKEA met de bedrijfsbond WIM

MPs Patijn and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the IKEA collective agreement with the company union WIM, including strikes by FNV members, a narrow 50.3% vote, and whether the union is independent of the employer and compliant with ILO Convention 98. The minister declined to judge the specific case, stated that the Netherlands is reviewing the independence of unions as part of a broader exploration of the cao system, and said no grounds exist to declare the agreement invalid if legal requirements are met.
I have therefore entered into discussions with social partners and other stakeholders and am including this point in the further elaboration of the exploration.
Daarom ben ik hierover met sociale partners en andere stakeholders in gesprek gegaan en neem ik dit punt mee met de verdere uitwerking van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de NS-ticketautomaat op de veerhaven van ’t Horntje

An SP MP asked the minister whether NS may remove the ticket machine at the 't Horntje ferry port on Texel, citing ageing residents and tight transfers. The minister answers that NS is operationally responsible, usage is very low, one machine per station remains (Den Helder), and NS is consulting the Texel municipality on possibly keeping the machine temporarily.
The consideration regarding the ticket vending machines is an operational responsibility of NS.
De afweging met betrekking tot de kaartverkoopautomaten is een operationele verantwoordelijkheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent, Koekkoek en Kostić over de berichten dat milieutoezichthouders strengere regels wilden voor staalslakken

MPs asked the State Secretary about reports that environmental inspectors (ILT) wanted stricter rules for steel slag, why the ILT advice was not shared with parliament, and whether slag use as a building material is safe. The State Secretary answered that the ILT advice was tied to a permit application never filed, that a notification duty will replace the planned information duty (expected early 2026), and that use of LD slag as sand substitute in layers thicker than half a metre is being investigated, while ruling out generic classification of slag as waste.
The advice did not acquire formal status because no permit application was submitted.
Het advies heeft geen formele status gekregen vanwege het ontbreken van een aanvraag voor een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de handhaving van het verbod op varend ontgassen

Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how enforcement of the ban on gassing off at sea is organised, including staffing, equipment, violations, and the availability of degassing installations. Minister Madlener replied that the ILT enforces risk-based using e-noses and drones, has recruited inspectors, recorded four violations resulting in penalty payments, and that capacity is considered sufficient.
The Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT) enforces the applicable ban.
De Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT) handhaaft op het geldende verbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Dijk over “het bericht 'Noodfonds Energie slecht bereikbaar voor huishoudens'”

SP MPs Van Kent and Dijk asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that the Temporary Energy Emergency Fund was hard to reach, with queues and overloaded systems, and whether applicants in need could be excluded. The State Secretary acknowledged the problems and regretted that eligible households were turned away, but said the fund was closed due to its limited budget, that the Rijk will not add money, and that a future public energy fund will be developed under the Social Climate Fund.
I deeply regret when residents have called upon it in vain, or were too late, while they do belong to the target group.
Ik betreur ten zeerste als bewoners tevergeefs een beroep hebben gedaan, of te laat waren, terwijl zij wel tot de doelgroep behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over het bericht dat bij voormalige bewoners van Rijnwijk verschillende vormen van kanker vaker dan gemiddeld voorkomen

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the state secretary for health about reports of higher-than-average cancer rates among former residents of Rijnwijk in Arnhem, near a heavily polluting former industrial site, and why soil and health effects were not investigated earlier. The state secretary said the municipality of Arnhem and the GGD will first run an exploratory study, that earlier soil investigations found no health risk, and that a separate national study is not considered appropriate.
I think it is good that the municipality of Arnhem has the GGD explore what is going on.
Ik denk dat het goed is dat de gemeente Arnhem de GGD laat verkennen wat er aan de hand is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de geregistreerde huisvestingslocaties voor arbeidsmigranten van Stichting Normering Flexwonen

An SP MP asked the minister about housing for migrant workers in regular homes, the number of SNF-certified accommodations, and whether councils should see the private SNF register. The minister reported that 79% of SNF-registered locations and 59% of beds are regular homes, declined to make the register public to councils, but encouraged data-sharing agreements and use of the Wgv licensing tools.
I therefore encourage municipalities to make such agreements with SNF and will myself discuss further with SNF what role I can play in promoting such agreements.
Ik moedig gemeenten dan ook aan om dergelijke afspraken met SNF te maken en zal zelf ook met SNF verder bespreken welke rol ik kan spelen om dergelijke afspraken te bevorderen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over “de aanhoudende problemen van gedupeerde Groningers met het kwijtraken van toeslagen of kwijtschelding en extra belastingheffingen als gevolg van de schadevergoe

MPs Beckerman and Van Kent asked why Groningen residents still lose benefits, allowances or remission and face extra tax after receiving damage compensation, and what steps will be taken. The government answers that fiscal consequences should be avoided, that IMG and NCG can compensate where unavoidable, that several measures and ongoing talks are underway, and that communication and some rules (e.g. Participatiewet exemptions) are being improved, while declining to answer in time for the debate.
As already indicated in the letter of 28 October 2024, we have also taken a number of measures to prevent fiscal consequences as much as possible.
Zoals al in de brief van 28 oktober 2024 aangegeven, 3 hebben wij hiernaast nog een aantal maatregelen getroffen om fiscale gevolgen zo veel mogelijk te voorkomen, waaronder:
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over het bericht ‘Bij Transavia overwintert personeel op kosten van het UWV"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs how long the government and UWV have known about Transavia's seasonal on-call-style contracts that let staff claim unemployment benefits in winter, why nothing was done sooner, and whether the planned Meer zekerheid flexwerkers bill will prevent similar practices. The minister answered that UWV flagged the issue in 2021 as a complex overlap between labour and social security law, that the bill (bandbreedtecontract with a 130% maximum) would close the gap, that a new WW test would require legislation and be no faster, and that current law does not yet prohibit the practice.
I expect employers to comply with applicable laws and regulations and will hold companies to account if they do not.
Ik verwacht van werkgevers dat zij zich aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving houden en zal bedrijven erop aanspreken als dat niet zo is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de verkenning minimumjeugdloon

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the review of the statutory youth minimum wage, its age-based rates, equal pay and the effects on youth education and work, including vocational (bbl) students. The minister answered that the cabinet sees grounds for substantive reconsideration with a reservation in the Voorjaarsnota 2025, that the full policy assessment will follow in the cabinet response before the summer recess, and that the questions on rates, equal pay and bbl wages will be addressed there, while noting evidence on work effects and dropout and referring the bbl staffel to the Minister of OCW.
Before the summer recess I expect to send the cabinet response to your House.
Voor het zomerreces verwacht ik de kabinetsreactie aan uw Kamer te zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht “Risico’s met bouwmateriaal vol gevaarlijke stoffen al jaren bekend, Rekenkamer kritisch”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary why warnings from the Court of Audit, the ILT and the Arnhem environmental service about risks of misapplied immobilisate (secondary building material with hazardous substances) were not heeded, and what steps would prevent pollution at a Zevenaar site and recover clean-up costs. The State Secretary answered that the concerns are taken seriously, citing planned mandatory washing of bottom ash, an information duty since 2024, a review of the quality guideline, and ILT enforcement, while stating that enforcement and cost recovery are for the local authority and polluter-pays case-by-case assessment.
I recognise the signals from the Court of Audit, ILT and ODRA and take them seriously.
Ik herken de signalen van de Algemene Rekenkamer, ILT en ODRA en neem deze serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Kent en Beckerman over stagiairs van Transavia die in 2023 als personeel werden ingezet

An SP MP asks ministers how interns placed as employees at Transavia, who can only recover wages through the civil courts, are helped by school complaint procedures, SBB and the Inspectorate, and whether a complaints point or lower court threshold is needed. The minister answers that schools, SBB and the Inspectorate have no power to enforce wages, that legal aid and the regelrechter experiment exist, that the Arbeidsinspectie fined Transavia and later accepted its adjusted internship practice, and that additional measures are premature.

Educational institutions, SBB and the Inspectorate of Education have no legal authority to enforce wage payments or settle wage disputes, because this falls under civil employment law and not their tasks.

Onderwijsinstellingen, de SBB en de Inspectie van het Onderwijs hebben geen juridische bevoegdheid om loonbetalingen af te dwingen of geschillen over loon te beslechten, omdat dit valt onder het (civiele) arbeidsrecht en niet onder hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Klikken over uitkeringsfraude? Dat kan in steeds meer gemeenten, maar ook kritiek neemt toe'

MPs Van Kent and Van Nispen (SP) asked whether municipal anonymous fraud hotlines for welfare benefits should be curbed, given reports of harm to citizens and social trust. The State Secretary defended municipal discretion over hotlines, said they yield useful signals and that investigations include hearing rights, and rejected a ban while answering several questions only in general terms.
So I will not introduce a ban on the hotlines.
Ik ga dus geen verbod invoeren op de meldpunten.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Bij Transavia overwintert personeel op kosten van het UWV'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Transavia's 46-6 zero-hours contract that leaves cabin crew without pay for six weeks a year and shifts the cost to unemployment benefits (WW) and the UWV, and whether the UWV and government would control or stop this. The minister called the constructions undesirable, said they are currently legal, pointed to the Meer zekerheid flexwerkers bill that would largely ban zero-hours contracts, and declined to direct Transavia as shareholder or to examine other sectors.
The cao for Transavia cabin crew shows that Transavia uses permanent employment contracts with a variable working time.
Uit de cao Cabinepersoneel van Transavia blijkt dat Transavia gebruik maakt van arbeidsovereenkomsten voor onbepaalde tijd met een daarbij wisselende arbeidsomvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over belastingconstructies bij OV-bedrijf Qbuzz

An SP MP asked the government about Qbuzz's interest payments to its Italian state-railway parent, tax avoidance, foreign ownership of regional bus operators and whether Dutch-owned bus operators are preferred. The government declined to discuss individual tax files citing confidentiality, restated the arm's-length principle and existing earnings-stripping rules, and said foreign ownership is not decisive in concession awards.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation of article 67 of the General Tax Act, individual tax files cannot be discussed.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Bamenga, Van Kent en Kostić over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how citizens, animals and the environment are protected against LD steel slag, which RIVM classifies as hazardous, and how regulation, enforcement and interbestuurlijk toezicht will be strengthened. The State Secretary answered that duty-of-care rules and enforcement apply, that several steps (information duty, updated circular, regulatory review) are underway, and that the risks are recognised, while stating that municipalities and provinces carry enforcement responsibility.
That is why steps have been taken and I am currently working, as part of the review of soil regulation, on
Daarom zijn er stappen ondernomen en ben ik op dit moment in het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving aan de slag met
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Oezbeekse trucker staakt bij truckstop in Venlo: “ik vrees voor m’n leven”’

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Infrastructure and Social Affairs how they will protect a striking Uzbek truck driver from employer coercion, ensure full wages, safeguard his residence permit, and act against the Lithuanian firm Baltic Transline and sector-wide abuse. The minister replied that the Labour Inspectorate has investigated and is still examining the case, that cabotage rules were not breached on the cited route, that an implementation study is under way with results expected end 2025, and that EU-level research on third-country drivers is ongoing.
I cannot make any statements about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het vrijkomen van tetrafluorethyleen door een leidingbreuk bij Chemours

An SP MP asked the state secretary about a release of about 45 kg of tetrafluoroethylene gas at Chemours Dordrecht, its cause, health and environmental effects, worker health, prevention, criminal consequences and cleanup costs. The answers attribute the release to a ruptured safety disc at normal process conditions, judge risk to residents unlikely, say no worker was affected, and point to the provincial competent authority and DCMR for enforcement and cause analysis.
The breaking of a rupture disc must be seen as the direct cause of the incident. This does not yet provide insight into the underlying causes of the unusual occurrence.
Het doorbreken van een breekplaat moet gezien worden als de directe oorzaak van het incident. Hiermee is er nog geen inzicht in de onderliggende oorzaken van het ongewone voorval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de uitzending ‘Werkt een online cursus tot BHV’er?’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a broadcast reporting that workers can become company first-aiders (BHV'ers) through a 75-minute online course without practical training, and whether the law should require practice drills and annual repetition. The minister answered that employers are responsible under the Working Conditions Act, that sectors should agree specific training via arbocatalogues, that no law change is needed, and that the Labour Inspectorate enforces where violations are found.
It is therefore up to the sectors themselves to make further agreements on specific training and equipment that match practice.
Het is daarom aan de sectoren zelf om nadere afspraken over specifieke opleiding en uitrusting te maken die aansluiten bij de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over het nieuws dat arbeidsmigranten worden uitgebuit door werkgevers die de noodopvang voor asielzoekers verzorgen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked about reports that migrant workers were exploited by private firms running emergency asylum accommodation on cruise ships, including unpaid long shifts and dismissal without housing, and about tax avoidance and why asylum seekers do not do the work. The minister called the conditions unacceptable and said investigation is needed, that emergency sites require specialist staff and fast setup, that COA checks contractors via Bibob and CSR rules, and that COA is reviewing contracts and activating residents more, while not committing to contract-wide sanctions.
It is my ambition to limit this expensive and suboptimal form of accommodation to a minimum as quickly as possible.
Het is mijn ambitie om deze dure en suboptimale vorm van opvang zo snel mogelijk tot een minimum te beperken.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Kostić, Wingelaar, Koekkoek, Gabriëls, Bamenga en Van Kent over het RTL Nieuws onderzoek 'Meer ziekmakende stoffen in de lucht bij 125 bedrijven door heel Nederland’

Six MPs asked the state secretary about an RTL Nieuws investigation showing rising emissions of hazardous substances (including PAK) at many industrial firms, and about the effectiveness of the ZZS minimisation duty, reporting errors at Tata Steel and the role of competent authorities. The state secretary answered that enforcement and assessment of emissions data is primarily the responsibility of competent authorities such as the provinces and environmental services, pointed to the Impulsprogramma Chemische Stoffen and the Actieagenda, promised to consult competent authorities and to ask RIVM and the Expertgroep for a reassessment, and declined to act on several requests because they fall under other bodies.
The competent authority may use all means available to it, including filing a criminal complaint; I do not interfere further in this.
Het bevoegde gezag kan gebruik maken van alle middelen die hen ter beschikking staan, waaronder het doen van aangifte, ik meng mij hier verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de gevolgen van asbestbranden

MPs Van Kent asked whether, after the government's earlier answer on asbestos fires, no party is now obliged to clear asbestos debris outside built plots, and whether a statutory duty is needed. The Secretary of State corrected his earlier answer, says the owner of the burned building must clear debris on neighbouring land (including undeveloped land), explains the Civil Code and environmental law basis, and concludes no new legislation is needed.
That answer relied too heavily on case law about responsibility for clearing drug waste.
In dat antwoord is te veel uitgegaan van de jurisprudentie over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het opruimen van drugsafval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over ongerechtvaardigde ontslagen op staande voet van arbeidsmigranten in de vleessector

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs for details on staffing agencies in the meat sector with high shares of dismissals on the spot, including their names, sizes, locations and owners. The minister refused to name the agencies or give the requested details citing GDPR and confidentiality rules, while acknowledging the misuse concern and saying the agencies' inspection bodies lack the legal mandate to act and that further steps are being considered.
The UWV may not share this data on the basis of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and several confidentiality provisions.
Het UWV mag deze gegevens op basis van de Algemene verordening gegevensbescherming (AVG) en meerdere geheimhoudingsbepalingen niet delen.
Antwoord op van de leden Kostić, Van Kent, Gabriëls en Bamenga over het beschermen van burgers, dieren en milieu tegen staalslakken

MPs asked whether LD steel slag is a waste or a by-product usable as building material, citing a critical report from Stichting Natuurlijk Schoon Eerbeek, and asked about contamination risks, enforcement, financial incentives and possible suspension of use. The Minister rejected the report's conclusions, stated that the 2017 legal opinion is not a generic ruling, said use is permissible within regulatory frameworks, and announced a planned nationwide information obligation and review of soil regulation, while declining to suspend use or detail Tata Steel agreements.
As part of the review of soil regulation, I will examine to what extent it is desirable to tighten the regulations further.
In het kader van de herijking van de bodemregelgeving zal ik bezien in hoeverre het wenselijk is de regelgeving nog verder aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Beckerman over stagiairs van Transavia die in 2023 als personeel werden ingezet

MPs Van Kent and Beckerman asked about Transavia trainees deployed as regular staff in 2023 and what the government would do about it. The minister says trainees must not replace regular workers, that the Labour Inspectorate fined the airline and withdrew its preventive shutdown warning after adequate changes, and points to complaint routes but declines to rule on individual cases.
However, it is not for the cabinet to make statements about this in individual cases.
Het is echter niet aan het kabinet om hier in individuele gevallen uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "de boodschappenproblematiek die niet wordt opgelost met de Participatiewet in balans”

The SP MP Van Kent asked the State Secretary why the draft Participatiewet in balans amendment on gifts in kind was changed without being highlighted, and how gifts of groceries affect benefits and reporting duties. The State Secretary confirmed the change was dropped after consultation due to unclear rules, explained that in-kind gifts still require individual assessment and reporting, and committed to a further round of talks with municipalities.
The omission of this change from the bill submitted to your House was explained further on page 142 of the explanatory memorandum.
Het niet opnemen van deze wijziging in het voorstel dat bij uw Kamer is ingediend, is wel nader toegelicht op pagina 142 van de memorie van toelichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van der Werf over gaten in de beveiliging van defensiecomplexen

MPs Van Kent and Van der Werf asked about security gaps at defence sites, including turnstiles that allowed intruders to slip onto bases, and what has been done about them. The State Secretary answered that emergency measures were in place before the broadcast, a permanent fix by the supplier would be complete by year end, and that the most sensitive assets are protected by stricter tiers, while withholding details of those measures as highly classified.
The supplier of the turnstiles was also immediately instructed to develop a lasting solution so that intrusion in this way is no longer possible.
Ook is direct aan de leverancier van de tourniquets opdracht gegeven een duurzame oplossing te ontwikkelen zodat insluipen op deze manier niet meer mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over ongerechtvaardigde ontslagen op staande voet van arbeidsmigranten in de vleessector

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about unjustified summary dismissals of migrant workers in the meat sector, including sector-level data and the number of agencies with high rates. The minister answered with administrative data showing elevated summary dismissals among agency workers and non-Dutch nationals, and described sector talks and the forthcoming Wtta licensing law and a review of possible agency-work bans.
In addition, the Act on admission of temporary agency labour (Wtta) is being introduced, with which malicious organisations in the temporary employment market can be tackled.
Daarnaast wordt de Wet toelating terbeschikkingstelling van arbeidskrachten (Wtta) geïntroduceerd waarmee malafide organisaties in de uitzendmarkt kunnen worden aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over de uitspraak dat Oekraïne Nederlandse F-16’s in mag zetten in Rusland

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Ukraine may use Dutch F-16s on Russian territory, including the decision process, escalation risks, sanctions, frozen assets and peace talks. Minister Brekelmans confirmed Ukraine may use them within international law, declined to disclose cabinet deliberations or escalation analyses, and gave general, largely non-specific answers on sanctions and peace efforts.
The deliberations of the Council of Ministers are secret.
De beraadslagingen van de Ministerraad zijn geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Supermarkt “rommelt” wéér met statiegeld, winkel ontkent’

An SP MP asked whether deposit refunds must always be paid in cash after a report that a supermarket refused cash refunds and whether the rules should be amended. The state secretary replied that the regulation requires refunds but not cash specifically, that Verpact must study refund methods by 1 November 2024, and that the deposit scheme will be evaluated and adjusted where needed.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management does not have such data.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat beschikt niet over dergelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Kent over het stopzetten van het Programma Schoolmaaltijden

MPs Dijk and Van Kent asked the Prime Minister about halting the School Meals Programme, citing a letter from 2,100 schools, the Red Cross and the Jeugdeducatiefonds, and asked how the government would secure funding. The state secretary replied that the programme will be continued structurally after 2024 with €135 million per year, with details to follow.
That is why the cabinet has decided to continue the programme structurally after 2024.
Daarom heeft het kabinet besloten het programma structureel voort te zetten na 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the government how it will respond to reports that residents near heavy industry pay on average 7 percent more in healthcare costs, and what it will do to protect them. The government says health effects of industry are known and points to the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, existing permit and enforcement reforms, and studies by RIVM, but rejects charging polluting firms directly for residents' healthcare costs.
That is therefore an incentive for the cabinet to work on further improving the living environment for residents near industry.
Dat is voor het kabinet dan ook een aansporing om te werken aan het verder verbeteren van de leefomgeving voor omwonenden van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat zeeschuim onveilig is door vervuiling met PFAS

An SP MP asked the government about news that sea foam is unsafe due to PFAS pollution, including whether beach visitors were informed of tightened advice, what warnings were issued, and whether PFAS production should be halted and damages recovered from polluters. The minister replied that the advice is unchanged apart from clarifying wording, that no warning signs were placed, that producers cannot yet be identified, and that a full production stop is rejected in favour of a broad EU ban.
The advice on PFAS in sea foam is unchanged.
Het advies omtrent PFAS in zeeschuim is ongewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat minder milieucontroles plaatsvinden door personeelstekorten bij omgevingsdiensten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that staff shortages at environmental services (omgevingsdiensten) mean fewer environmental inspections, asking about inspection backlogs, risks, recruitment and measures. The State Secretary acknowledged the concern, said the government lacks exact per-service data on backlogs and that municipalities and provinces are responsible for capacity, and pointed to a recruitment campaign and a budget to repeat it.

I do not have information on the exact number of environmental inspections per environmental service that have been left undone or incompletely carried out due to understaffing or failure to meet their own quality requirements.

Ik beschik niet over informatie over het exacte aantal milieucontroles dat per omgevingsdienst is blijven liggen of onvolledig is uitgevoerd vanwege onderbezetting of het niet voldoen aan de eigen kwaliteitseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de problemen met communicatieapparatuur aan boord van bussen van Qbuzz

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about recurring failures of on-board communication and emergency systems in Qbuzz buses, including a June 2024 stoppage, and whether the IVU-box and payment system are linked. The State Secretary answered that the June incident was a data-processing fault unrelated to earlier ones, that the payment system is separate, and that the concession authority can enforce performance, with Qbuzz listing remedial measures but no commitment to report back to Parliament.
The OV-bureau Groningen-Drenthe can hold Qbuzz to account for this and can enforce performance under the concession.
Het OV-bureau Groningen-Drenthe kan Qbuzz hierop aanspreken en kan op basis van de concessie prestaties afdwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over hinder en omgevingsrisico’s door afvalverwerkingsindustrie in Sluiskil

An MP asked the Minister about dust nuisance and health risks from waste processor Heros in Sluiskil, including lead and iron in bottom ash, monitoring, enforcement and exemptions from new dust rules. The State Secretary answered that provincial monitoring found no exceedance of limits and no evidence of bottom ash deposition, that additional source research is being done by the province and municipality, and that a study on the effects of the new rules on the metal recycling and waste sectors will be carried out.
Carrying out additional measurements is the responsibility of the competent authority.
Het uitvoeren van extra metingen is aan het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het noodgedwongen stoppen van het lokale beleid inzake beschermingsbewind in de gemeente Groningen

MP Van Kent (SP) asks why Groningen municipality had to stop steering people to its non-commercial municipal trustee for debt administration after a court ruling, and whether the government will act to restore local control over bewind. The State Secretary answers that the court ruling is respected, the choice of trustee rests with the sub-district judge, municipalities may still offer bewind, a study on public organisation of bewind is planned for Q2 2025, and the advisory right and convenant options will be evaluated.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, we respect the court's judgment in the Groningen case.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 1 respecteren we het oordeel van de rechter in de casus Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat rondom Chemours eieren vol PFAS zijn aangetroffen

An SP MP asked the government about reports of PFAS levels in backyard hen eggs near Chemours, including health risks, causes, public warnings, swimming advice and a national PFAS ban. The state secretary answered that the findings are unwelcome but not new, that the source is unknown and is being investigated by municipalities and RIVM, and that a European ban is preferred over a national one.
The RIVM research confirms the picture that was also obtained from other research in recent months and shared with the House.
Het onderzoek van het RIVM bevestigt het beeld dat de afgelopen maanden ook uit ander onderzoek is verkregen en met de Kamer is gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat Chemours een vergunning aanvraagt voor TFA

An SP MP asked the Infrastructure minister about Chemours' permit application for TFA emissions, drinking water effects, whether emissions should be barred until proven safe, and available abatement techniques. The government answered that the competent authority will assess the permit, that RIVM advised an indicative drinking water guideline, that emissions require proof of safety under the environmental law duty of care, and that PFAS emissions should be reduced as far as possible with support for local authorities.
It is up to the competent authority to assess this permit application.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om deze vergunningaanvraag te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat bij Chemours tweemaal PFAS is vrijgekomen als gevolg van stroomstoringen

An MP asked the minister how PFAS and other substances could be released from Chemours and Delrin during emergency shutdowns caused by grid failures, and asked for substance overviews, research results and monitoring improvements. The state secretary answered that the province of Zuid-Holland is the competent authority, that investigations are ongoing with results to be published later, and that RIVM and an industry-residents action agenda are studying monitoring improvements expected in early 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de arbeidsomstandigheden in het regionale openbaar vervoer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about sick leave, staff shortages, workload and temporary-agency use among regional public transport drivers, including Arriva's reported 30 percent absence in Twente. The minister answered that employers are responsible for staffing, that the ministry and provinces hold no staffing data, and that the NOVB only shares lessons without agreements on working conditions.
IenW has no insight into the staff records of the various transport companies.
IenW heeft geen inzicht in de personeelsbestanden van de verschillende vervoersbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over varend ontgassen

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Kent (SP) asked whether fraudulent reclassification of substances (omkatten) to evade the sailing-degassing ban is undermining the ban, and whether fines, degassing facilities, and enforcement capacity are adequate. Minister Harbers answered that the practice is known and deplored, fines are a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, enforcement will intensify but is only partly in place, and the sector is responsible for building degassing installations.
Supervision of sailing degassing will intensify after 1 July.
Het toezicht op varend ontgassen zal na 1 juli intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het NOS-artikel van 16 februari 2024: ‘Prorail: “Vervangen spoor Vroomshoop kost mogelijk miljoenen”’

An SP MP asked the government about the costs of replacing asbestos roofs after a fire near Vroomshoop, including insurance coverage, who pays for cleanup when owners cannot, and loans and other support for roof owners. The minister answered that the government has no insight into insurer conditions, that the owner is primarily liable for cleanup, that a loan fund exists for low-income private owners with a possible wider opening under study, and that a communication programme with advisory support is starting.
The Ministry of IenW has no insight into the extent to which insurers provide coverage, nor into the owners' own resources.
Het Ministerie van IenW heeft geen zicht op de mate waarin verzekeraars dekking bieden en evenmin over de eigen middelen van de eigenaren.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat gepensioneerden zich niet serieus genomen voelen

An SP MP asked the minister how she responds to complaints by pensioner organisations that they are not taken seriously in the ABP pension transition plan, whether gepensioneerden are properly involved through the hearing right, and whether they have the information needed to assess the plan. The minister says the hearing right is a statutory safeguard, that social partners are responsible for giving it substance and have held discussions with the associations, and that she expects information to be shared but notes some information may belong to a later phase.
It is up to the social partners to give substance to the hearing right.
Het is aan de sociale partners om het hoorrecht vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de financiële situatie van de gemeente Vlissingen

An SP MP asked ministers about the financial distress of Vlissingen municipality, including cuts affecting care, income support and children's activities such as swimming lessons, and whether minimum-level provision can be guaranteed. The minister answered that individual cases are the municipality's responsibility, that municipalities have policy discretion, that the inspector's list of options was not a recommendation, and that a new cabinet must decide on the division of responsibilities; most answers were substantive but several deflected or declined to guarantee outcomes.
It is up to the municipality of Vlissingen to decide how it deals with this.
Het is aan de gemeente Vlissingen om te bepalen hoe zij hiermee omgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Kathman over de recente faillissementen in de winkelstraat

MPs Van Kent and Kathmann asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about bankruptcies in shopping streets, workers' position in insolvency, the pending Wovof bill, director liability, and union access to company information. The answers were given orally on 12 March 2024, and this written reply refers to those oral answers.
The written questions from MPs Van Kent and Kathmann about the recent bankruptcies in the shopping street were answered through oral questions (2024Z03962) on 12 March 2024.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Kent en Kathman over de recente faillissementen in de winkelstraat zijn beantwoord middels mondelinge vragen ( 2024Z03962 ) op 12 maart 2024.
Antwoord op het lid Van Kent over ‘misgelopen lijfrentepolis of pensioen in Radar-uitzending’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about slow transfers of pension and annuity capital between banks and insurers, which cost consumers money, and asked who supervises this, whether the transfer period should be extended, and whether a secure online process is possible. The minister said DNB, AFM and Kifid received few complaints, the voluntary PSK protocol is sufficient for now, no supervisor has a legal basis to enforce it, the period should not be lengthened, and industry will be urged to go digital while the minister monitors compliance.
I will contact these parties to monitor the extent to which follow-up is given to this.
Ik zal in contact treden met deze partijen om te monitoren in hoeverre hier opvolging aan wordt gegeven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Synhaeve, Mohandis, Van Kent, Ceder en Koekkoek over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof Den Haag dat de Nederlandse Staat en twee drinkwaterbedrijven onrechtmatig handelen door niet al het r

MPs asked the government to respond to a Hague Court of Appeal ruling that the State and two water companies acted unlawfully by not preventing children from losing access to drinking water, and about measures, a water fund and changes to disconnection rules. The minister answered that the companies will restore supply to occupied homes with children, that a study on child protection including a water fund will be sent to parliament before summer, and that the disconnection regulation will be reviewed.
The judgment calls for action in two areas.
Het arrest vraagt om actie op twee gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over “de chaos bij busvervoerder EBS”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about service cuts and disruption at bus operator EBS in Flevoland, Gelderland, Overijssel and Noord-Holland, including staff shortages, vehicle faults, and whether concessions could be taken in-house by provinces. The State Secretary answered that the concession authorities manage the operator, that the reduced timetable is temporary with staff recruitment underway, that tendering has improved public transport, and that in-house takeover would require a change to the Wet personenvervoer 2000 which is not currently planned.
The decentralised public transport authorities, as concession grantors, are competent to amend or enforce the agreements made with operators in concessions.
De decentrale ov-autoriteiten zijn als concessieverleners bevoegd om de afspraken die in concessies worden gemaakt met vervoerders te wijzigen dan wel te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het nieuws dat werknemers op Schiphol worden blootgesteld aan kankerverwekkende stoffen

The SP MP Van Kent asked ministers about reports that Schiphol platform workers are exposed to carcinogenic aircraft engine emissions, and what measures, health monitoring and compensation exist. The minister answered that the Arbeidsinspectie's demands require Schiphol and employers to do more, cited phased measures such as APU limits and a green zone by 2027, said the Gezondheidsraad is reviewing classification of kerosene engine emissions, and declined to commit to immediate mandatory electrification or a site visit.
I have asked the Health Council to determine whether kerosene engine emissions as a whole should be classified as carcinogenic.
Ik heb de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd te bepalen of kerosinemotoremissie als geheel als kankerverwekkend moet worden geclassificeerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Zo worden Oekraïners onder valse voorwendselen door schimmige uitzendbureaus naar Nederland gehaald'

Van Kent (SP) asked the minister about a report that Ukrainians are recruited under false pretences by dubious staffing agencies and posted to the Netherlands via A1 certificates. The minister condemned the practice, said detachment of third-country nationals is legal but abused through sham constructions, and described enforcement steps, EU-level efforts and the lack of sanction data.
I continuously bring this to the attention of employer organisations.
Ik breng dit continu onder de aandacht van werkgeversorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het rapport ‘De (on)menselijke maat van het UWV’

MPs Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report by a patient group on UWV assessments of ME/CVS patients, including alleged disbelief, outdated prognoses, and whether the 2018 Health Council advice was acted on. The minister acknowledged the patients' experiences, defended UWV's recognition of ME/CVS and individualised assessments, and announced a file review of the 59 patients with a dedicated team, plus an ongoing inventory of input on the adopted motion for a protocol.
Therefore UWV will carry out a file review of the 59 patients from the report, by a team set up specifically for this purpose.
Daarom zal UWV een dossieronderzoek uitvoeren naar de 59 patiënten uit het rapport, door een speciaal daarvoor ingesteld team.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "geluidsnormen op de werkvloer"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about noise limits in workplaces such as gymnasiums after a Pointer broadcast, and about Labour Inspectorate inspections, violations and risk-assessment (RI&E) compliance. The minister answered that employers are primarily responsible, that the Inspectorate found no noise-related violations in about 40 gym and 50 swimming pool inspections, and that RI&E compliance is being addressed under the Arbovisie 2040.
The risk of health damage from noise emerges as relatively less of a priority in those risk analyses.
Het risico op gezondheidsschade door geluid komt als relatief minder prioritair uit die risicoanalyses naar voren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over aanhoudende problemen met het busvervoer van Arriva in Twente

An SP MP asked the state secretary about persistent problems with Arriva bus services in Twente, including high workload, high trip cancellations, and passenger compensation after the concession change. The state secretary largely deferred to the province and operator and the social partners, promising talks with the sector and unions but declining a direct role in working conditions.
I have no role in the discussions about working conditions.
Ik heb geen rol in de gesprekken over de arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de gevolgen van recente branden waarbij asbest is vrijgekomen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Social Affairs about the health risks and clean-up after recent asbestos-releasing fires, including whether workers cleaning up in Vroomshoop lacked protective equipment and how often such fires occur. The government answered that local authorities and implementing bodies are responsible for safety measures, clean-up and resident information, that asbestos-fire incidents are not centrally registered, that the Arbeidsinspectie found no reports of unprotected workers, and that it will inform parliament before summer on encouraging removal of asbestos roofs.
The number of fires in which asbestos is released is not centrally registered.
Het aantal branden waarbij asbest vrij komt, wordt niet centraal geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over olievervuiling op Bonaire

An MP from the SP asked the cabinet about oil pollution on the coast of Bonaire, including the environmental damage, the source (possibly the abandoned tanker Gulfstream), and whether the owner can be held liable. The government answered that the impact on nature appears limited for now, the long-term damage is not yet known, the situation is said to be under control, and liability is still being examined because the ship's owner has not been identified.
It is being examined whether there are possibilities to recover the damage.
Er wordt bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om schade te kunnen verhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de AOW-leeftijd en de ontwikkeling van de levensverwachting

MP Van Kent asks why the AOW pension age is raised even though life expectancy is no longer expected to rise, and whether the law can be changed so the age can also fall. The minister says the age is linked to CBS forecasts, that lowering it would require a law change which the cabinet will not pursue, and that the pension-age link is set five years ahead to give certainty.
If desired, the AOW age can only be lowered to 67 for 2028 and 2029 through a one-off law amendment.
Indien gewenst, kan de AOW-leeftijd alleen per wetswijziging eenmalig voor 2028 en 2029 verlaagd worden naar 67 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de problemen met communicatiesystemen aan boord van bussen bij Qbuzz

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about reported failures of on-board communication systems (IVU-box) on Qbuzz buses, raising safety concerns, a union survey of drivers, and whether an Arbeidsinspectie investigation should follow. The state secretary answered that safety was never at risk, that only the payment system had occasional start-up delays, that the matter is governed by concession agreements between the concession authority and operator, and that no inspectorate investigation is warranted.
I therefore see no reason to have an investigation carried out into the functioning of the IVU-box based on these findings.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om op basis van deze bevindingen een onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de werking van de IVU-box.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over kernwapenoefeningen op luchtmachtbasis Volkel

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked whether the 312 squadron at Volkel takes part in NATO nuclear sharing, whether it has trained on the B61-12 bomb since 2021, and whether the F-16 is planned to carry it, and about the timing of F-35 transition and bomb deliveries. The ministers confirmed Nederland's NATO nuclear task at Volkel but declined to give details on training, transition timing, or weapons numbers and locations, citing security and alliance arrangements.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about details relating to the Netherlands' nuclear weapons task.
Om veiligheidsredenen kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over details die verband houden met de kernwapentaak van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over “het advies van de landsadvocaat over invaren in het nieuwe pensioenstelsel”

Opposition MP Van Kent asked the minister, citing a professor's concerns and the state law adviser's advice, whether invaren under the new pensions system can violate property rights and cut pensions by 5-10%, and how many funds have low coverage ratios and how many are closed. The minister answered that invaren is legally defensible under the three property-rights criteria, that cuts are possible depending on coverage ratio, that DNB reports one fund below 100%, and that 22 closed funds cover about 200,000 people; she refers individuals with grievances to the fund, the pension disputes body or the courts.
It nevertheless cannot be ruled out that an individual may experience a disproportionately heavy burden as a result of invaren.
Het blijft evenwel niet uitgesloten dat een individu als gevolg van het invaren een onevenredig zware last ervaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de geklapte onderhandelingen over de regeling voor zware beroepen om op tijd te kunnen stoppen met werken

An SP MP asks the minister why negotiations on an early-retirement scheme for heavy occupations collapsed, whether a structural rather than temporary scheme is needed, and how many workers use the RVU. The minister says social partners are responsible, talks are paused, she will inform parliament in spring 2024, and she declines to set overarching criteria for heavy work.
Drawing up overarching minimum criteria from the government is therefore not appropriate.
Het opstellen van overkoepelende minimumcriteria vanuit de overheid is dan ook niet passend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de plannen voor het huisvesten van arbeidsmigranten in de gemeente Bergen op Zoom

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior about a planned housing site for 425 migrant workers on Havendijk in Bergen op Zoom, objecting to the lack of prior community dialogue and the strain on GP and police capacity. The minister answers largely by pointing to municipal responsibility, describes outreach to residents before the 2023 purchase agreement, and cites the forthcoming effect-report instrument for new business without committing to halt the project.
I am of the view that the weighing of economic interests from the establishment of businesses and safeguarding liveability must be done by the municipality concerned.
Ik ben van mening dat de afweging tussen economische belangen door vestiging van bedrijvigheid en het bewaken van de leefbaarheid door de desbetreffende gemeente moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over ‘de wachtlijst voor een WIA-indicatie’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the six-month wait for a WIA disability assessment, the low advance payment (around 1,000 euros per month), whether it is possible to live on that amount, and whether UWV actively informs people about the advance. The minister confirmed waits average 21 weeks and that UWV is working toward a uniform national wait, explained that advances depend on the applicant's daily wage and can be topped up under the Toeslagenwet but never exceed prior income, and described UWV's service calls that offer the advance.
Resolving the mismatch and thereby reducing waiting times therefore has my highest priority.
Het oplossen van de mismatch en daarmee het terugdringen van de wachttijden heeft dan ook mijn hoogste prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het voorgenomen besluit om arbeidsmigranten te huisvesten in het buurtschap Vrilkhoven, gelegen in Liempde (gemeente Boxtel)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing 400 migrant workers for slaughterhouse Vion in a hamlet near Boxtel should be opposed, whether the national government's lawyer should have been deployed against concerned residents, and whether the business model relying on mass labour migration is acceptable. The Minister replied that the decision rests with the municipality, pointed to ongoing municipal dialogue, a complaint-management system and the BER instrument under development, and said the Landsadvocaat review found the permit process was carefully conducted.
I am of the view that the weighing of economic interests from establishing business activity against safeguarding liveability must take place at the relevant municipality.
Ik ben van mening dat de afweging tussen economische belangen door vestiging van bedrijvigheid en het bewaken van de leefbaarheid door de desbetreffende gemeente moet plaatsvinden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over een dreigend massaontslag bij metaalbedrijf KME

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a feared mass layoff at metals firm KME in Zutphen, following a foreign takeover, and whether foreign investors who restructure Dutch firms are acceptable. The minister answered that restructuring is the company's own responsibility, that an open economy welcomes foreign investment, that the cause is rising energy and material costs, and that the government will review any support request if one is submitted.
It is up to the company itself to determine its own strategy as long as it complies with applicable laws and regulations.
Het is aan het bedrijf zelf om de eigen strategie te bepalen zolang het zich houdt aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Kent over de storting van ballaststenen in Apeldoorn

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Social Affairs about quartz-containing ballast stored in an Apeldoorn residential area, including health risks, whether work should be halted, inspection and permit issues, and ProRail's compliance with quartz-free ballast requirements. The government answered that ProRail and BAM bear the legal responsibility, an independent investigation has been commissioned, the Labour Inspectorate is requesting information and will enforce as needed, and it is awaiting the outcomes of further research and a municipal fact report, while noting that the transition to quartz-free ballast is constrained by market availability.
It is understandable that residents want to know whether the way they were exposed to quartz dust poses health risks.
Het is begrijpelijk dat de bewoners willen weten of de manier waarop zij zijn blootgesteld aan kwartsstof gezondheidsrisico’s met zich meebrengt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de sociale werkplaatsen met grote tekorten kampen

An SP MP asks the minister about reported large financial and staffing shortfalls at sheltered workshops (sociale werkplaatsen) and why extra funding covers only a fifth of the gap. The minister replies that municipalities are primarily responsible, cites a €2,157 per-place increase for sheltered work and a €63.9 million reserve, and states that a full picture of the shortfall cannot be given.
As also indicated in the answer to question 3, a complete picture of the financial result and any shortfalls cannot be given.
Zoals ook is aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 3, is geen volledig beeld te geven van het financieel resultaat en eventuele tekorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de sluiting van papierfabriek De Hoop in Eerbeek

The SP MP Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Stora Enso's plan to close the De Hoop paper mill in Eerbeek with 185 job losses, its timing after the takeover, the regional labour market outlook, what the government will do to protect workers, and whether UWV has received a dismissal request. The Minister replied that closure is an entrepreneurial decision, outlined the regional labour market (growth below the national average, industry weakening but skilled-labour shortages), explained the consultation and UWV dismissal-permit procedures, and declined to confirm any specific dismissal request for confidentiality reasons.
Because of the confidentiality of the information, I do not make statements about any dismissal applications submitted by individual companies.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van de informatie doe ik geen uitspraken over eventueel door individuele bedrijven ingediende ontslagaanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'UWV keerde miljoenen STAP-budget uit voor spookcursisten'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that UWV paid millions in STAP training budget for courses that were never completed, and why no sanctions or repayments were enforced. The minister answered that participants are generally not pursued for repayment except in cases of evident fraud, that about a third of awards had proof of participation so far with 93% of those completed, and that no further communication change or enforcement step is planned.
Situations of evident fraud by participants have not yet been shown.
Situaties van evidente fraude door deelnemers zijn nog niet gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het NRC-artikel 'Een op negen flitsbezorgers van Getir betrokken bij een verkeersongeluk’

MP Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about NRC reporting that one in nine Getir flash couriers was involved in a traffic accident, and about Labour Inspectorate checks and traffic safety measures for flash delivery. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, noted the inspectorate's 12 May 2023 checks with dozens of violations under further investigation, pointed to earlier enforcement and a planned ban for under-16s, and said SWOV research on road risks is still ongoing.
About companies that were or were not part of this check, and about any specific findings, the Labour Inspectorate makes no statements at this stage.
Over bedrijven die al dan niet onderdeel waren van deze controle, alsmede over eventuele specifieke bevindingen, doet de Arbeidsinspectie in dit stadium geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de stakingen bij de sociale werkvoorziening

An SP MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about strikes at sheltered employment, including demands for a 10.15% wage rise, a higher travel allowance and equal treatment with municipal staff, and what meeting these would cost the central government. The minister replied that the central government is not a party to the collective agreements, that the VNG and Cedris must negotiate them, and that municipalities decide how to spend the general fund on them, while giving headcount estimates and funding compensation figures.
The central government is not a party to the collective agreements.
De Rijksoverheid is geen partij in de cao's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Marijnissen over de staking bij VDL Nedcar

MPs Van Kent and Marijnissen asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the strike at VDL Nedcar, the government's response to the planned end of the BMW contract, and the dates and content of contacts between ministers and VDL management and between ministries. The minister acknowledged the job losses and the union dispute, but repeatedly declined to disclose the contents, dates or preparatory documents of the contacts, citing business confidentiality and an ongoing process.
For this reason the cabinet is generally reluctant to provide specific information about this.
Om die reden is het kabinet over het algemeen terughoudend met het geven van specifieke informatie hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over een toekomstige huisvestingslocatie voor arbeidsmigranten in Andel

An SP MP asked why a permit for housing 274 migrant workers in Andel proceeded despite over 900 objections, and whether local democracy and trust in politics are harmed. The minister replied that the permit is a municipal decision with no legal grounds for refusal, that the municipality added conditions and an impact analysis in response to objections, and that national support tools (a business-effect report, VNG programme) are being developed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de toenemende kinderarmoede

The SP MP Van Kent asked the Minister for Poverty Policy about rising child poverty, the CPB forecast of higher poverty in 2024, the link to corporate dividends, profits and taxes, and food affordability, and whether the government would halve child poverty. The minister answered that the government remains committed to halving child poverty by 2025, points to income measures and the minimum wage increase, says further decisions on 2024 purchasing-power measures come in August, and says it will inform parliament about the poverty strategy in May.
As Minister for Poverty Policy I remain committed to halving the number of children growing up in poverty.
Als Minister voor Armoedebeleid blijf ik mij inzetten voor het halveren van het aantal kinderen dat in armoede opgroeit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over een nieuwe ronde van het STAP-budget

An SP MP asked the ministers about a technical failure during the February 2023 STAP training-budget application round, about low-value courses (such as alternative-medicine and crypto courses) still listed on the scheme and promoted by influencers, and whether STAP is still the right instrument. The ministers acknowledged the outage and said the scheme is being tightened, that the Toetsingskamer STAP removed over 5,000 courses, and that the government stands by the STAP approach while promising a letter before summer.
During the past application periods the Toetsingskamer STAP investigated and, as a result, removed more than 5,000 courses from the offer, partly voluntarily and partly through exclusion decisions.
Tijdens de afgelopen tijdvakken heeft de Toetsingskamer STAP onderzoek gedaan en naar aanleiding daarvan meer dan 5.000 opleidingen uit het aanbod verwijderd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Internationals massaal uitgebuit in Groninger horeca: 'We geven je al eten, wil je ook nog geld?''

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of exploitation of international students in Groningen hospitality, and what steps have been taken to protect them. The minister condemns the abuses, says the Labour Inspectorate has received no matching reports and needs concrete leads, and lists existing information, enforcement and municipal measures.
The Labour Inspectorate calls on anyone with concrete leads on the described labour abuses to report them to the Labour Inspectorate.
De Arbeidsinspectie roept een ieder die weet heeft van concrete aangrijpingspunten bij de beschreven arbeidsmisstanden, deze te melden bij de Arbeidsinspectie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Wetgeving stratenmakers structureel overtreden: ‘Pakkans klein’’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that road-paving workers routinely violate rules requiring machine use over manual labour, and what the Labour Inspectorate does about it. The minister acknowledged the health risks, explained the employer's duty to mechanise where possible, described risk-based inspection priorities, and said the Inspectorate will study why physical strain persists, but did not provide inspection or violation counts.
Even though the Working Conditions Act requires machines to be used as much as possible and these machines are also available.
Dit terwijl op grond van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet zo veel als mogelijk machines gebruikt moeten worden en deze machines ook beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de plannen voor het huisvesten van arbeidsmigranten bij het dorp Riel

An SP MP asked the minister whether the plan to house 366 migrant workers next to the village of Riel, with 2,900 residents, was handled properly and whether it is excessive. The minister answered that the municipality of Tilburg must weigh local interests, that the neighbouring municipality of Goirle objects and a court case is likely, and that the government supports municipalities and is working on Roemer advice measures.
I am of the view that this is a consideration the municipality concerned must make.
Ik ben van mening dat dit een afweging is die de desbetreffende gemeente moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over misstanden bij Weener XL

An SP MP asked the minister about reported abuses at sheltered employer Weener XL, including pressure to work through illness, withheld wages, intimidation, and unaddressed complaints, and about the legality of wage deductions for benefit recipients. The minister called the reports worrying, pointed to an independent investigation commissioned by the 's-Hertogenbosch municipality, and said oversight of sanctions and the company lies with the municipality and the employer rather than the national government.
It is therefore for them, and not for me, to judge the number of disciplinary measures imposed and whether this is in line with legislation and policy.
Het is daarom aan hen- en niet aan mij- om een oordeel te vellen over het aantal opgelegde disciplinaire maatregelen en of dit in lijn is met wetgeving en beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "Hoe een handvol slechtbetaalde flexwerkers een miljardenconcern op de knieën dwong"
