An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report on Mediahuis depot workers winning a court case establishing employment rather than false self-employment, and about which sectors have underpaid workers in sham self-employment. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, said identifying sham self-employment requires individual investigation, pointed to pilot data and a SEO study flagging certain sectors as higher risk, and promised intensified enforcement, legal clarity and an accessible legal route for workers by summer 2023.
The cabinet intends to restore the balance and make the rules on working as a self-employed person and with self-employed persons more future-proof.
Het kabinet is van plan om de balans te herstellen en regels rondom het werken als zelfstandige en met zelfstandigen toekomstbestendiger te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Hoe jouw pakketje leidt tot onrust in het Brabantse dorpje Riel'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about local unrest in Riel over housing for hundreds of migrant workers, whether employment agencies were consulted, what action is taken, and data on migrant workers and homelessness. The minister acknowledges the tension, refers housing decisions to municipalities, promises an effect-assessment follow-up and a monitoring system, but says many figures are unavailable and does not commit to restricting EU labour mobility.
Moreover, the BRP registers only residents and non-residents (and therefore no separate category of migrant workers).
Bovendien worden in de BRP alleen ingezetenen en niet-ingezetenen geregistreerd (en dus geen speciale categorie arbeidsmigranten).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Pouw-Verweij, Den Haan, Van Kent, Léon de Jong en Ephraim over onbegrijpelijke en op het eerste oog onjuiste scenario’s die DNB gemaakt heeft op basis van de adviezen van de commi

MPs from several parties asked the Minister for Pensions why the 2022 Parameter Committee lowered the expected stock return while DNB's scenario charts appeared to show higher returns, and about standard deviation, validation and the release of draft DNB calculations. The minister answered that the scenarios follow the committee's advice, that the charts are consistent with it, and declined to share draft DNB reports, citing the value of confidential expert exchange, while committing to answer by a set date.
I do not consider it appropriate to share draft reports with your House.
Ik vind het niet opportuun om conceptrapportages met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat in Arnhem mensen na aanvraag 14 weken moeten wachten voor ze energietoeslag ontvangen

An SP MP asked the minister about reported waiting times of up to 14 weeks for the energy allowance in Arnhem and related delays in Doetinchem, and whether gemeenten should receive extra funds. The minister answered that waiting times in Arnhem have fallen to four weeks, that gemeenten bear the implementation burden and staff shortages, and that she remains in talks with the VNG without committing to new funding.
I am and remain in discussion with the VNG and municipalities about the implementation.
Ik ben en blijf met de VNG en gemeenten in gesprek over de uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Palland over het aanblijvende gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat

MPs Van Kent and Palland asked why the unanimously adopted motion on the AOW-gap for self-employed people who were already ill before the AOW age rise has seen no progress, and when the initiators would be involved. The minister acknowledges the delay, states that a two-year extension of the Overbruggingsuitkering is proposed as the solution, and promises a technical briefing and letters to affected people.
I regret the delay that has arisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de ‘Uber Files’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 'Uber Files', alleging Uber's aggressive lobbying on bogus self-employment law, its disregard for the law, its contacts with ministry officials, pressure on officials, and enforcement of court rulings on driver employment status. The minister replied that stakeholder contact is normal and Uber is subject to the same law, listed several dated meetings with Uber on platform work, noted the Belastingdienst cannot discuss individual cases due to tax secrecy, and promised a broader letter on the zzp/bogus self-employment approach in autumn.

Because of the confidentiality obligation under article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, I cannot provide information about the Tax Authority's supervision and enforcement regarding individual companies.

Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet Rijksbelastingen kan ik over het toezicht en de handhaving door de Belastingdienst bij individuele bedrijven geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over 'het bericht dat tienduizenden mensen die arbeidsongeschikt zijn door de WIA in armoede leven'

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that tens of thousands of people unable to work due to disability fall into poverty under the WIA, including the 35% threshold, the restverdiencapaciteit rules and whether hardship will be addressed. The minister acknowledges the hardship, says the government is examining it, and commits to a broader review with social partners and an independent commission, but declines to commit extra funds or a specific timeline.
I take this problem seriously and am examining it as part of my approach to hardship in the WIA, as announced in the coalition agreement.
Ik neem dit probleem serieus en onderzoek het in het kader van mijn aanpak van hardheden in de WIA, zoals aangekondigd in het coalitieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de FNV uit de SER subcommissie Grenswaarden Stoffen op de Werkplek is gestapt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the FNV left the SER subcommittee on hazardous-substance limit values and what is being done about bad compliance and low inspection of dangerous substances. The minister regrets the FNV's departure, says compliance is still too low, reports 2021 inspection figures, and says she is still seeking the FNV's return while awaiting the SER's response.
However, I cannot meet the FNV's wish to have the SER give instructions to the NLA to inspect specific substances.
Ik kan echter niet tegemoet komen aan de wens van de FNV om de SER aanwijzingen aan de NLA te laten geven om specifieke stoffen te inspecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Vreemdelingen worden uitgebuit in horeca Groningen. 'En het treurige is dat ze nog blij zijn met 2 euro per uur'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that migrants are exploited in Groningen hospitality for around 2 euros an hour, asking about inspection signals, registration of victims, reception-centre protections and measures against undocumented former asylum seekers working illegally. The minister said the Labour Inspectorate found some Wav and minimum-wage violations in Groningen hospitality checks but no signs of serious disadvantage or exploitation, reported a few ongoing investigations, and described existing information and monitoring measures without announcing new ones.
I do not make statements about possible investigations by the Labour Inspectorate.
Over eventuele onderzoeken door de Arbeidsinspectie doe ik geen uitspraken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked the Ministers of SZW and the Prime Minister which measures the ministry has taken after the childcare benefits scandal regarding harsh and disproportionate effects of laws and their information management. The government answered that departments are inventorying harsh laws under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, that independent research and a chat-message retention policy exist, and that further letters and action plans will follow.
To implement the Ploumen/Jetten motion, each department carries out an inventory of laws and regulations that turn out harshly for people.
1 , 2 , 3 Antwoord 1 Ter uitvoering van de motie Ploumen/Jetten 4 verricht elk departement een inventarisatie naar wet- en regelgeving die hardvochtig uitpakt voor mensen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de Primark personeel wil ontslaan

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would stop Primark from dismissing staff and rehiring them on worse terms, and whether UWV would facilitate the layoffs. The minister said Primark had withdrawn the dismissal plan, that employers may decide on personnel strategy within the law, and that UWV independently tests redundancy dismissals.
For a legally valid redundancy dismissal there must be a structural loss of jobs.
Voor een rechtsgeldig bedrijfseconomisch ontslag moet sprake zijn van een structureel verval van arbeidsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Allemaal dezelfde stempel van de commerciële keuringsarts’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that UWV's contracted psychiatrist agency Psyon issues near-uniform diagnoses favouring work capacity, and about the reliability of UWV's own assessments and court review. The minister replied that UWV found Psyon's quality adequate, that no steering on outcomes exists, that it sees insufficient reason to intervene or stop the contract, and that no re-assessment is planned.
UWV concluded that the content of the articles for the time being gives no reason to doubt the quality delivered by Psyon.
UWV heeft geconcludeerd dat de inhoud van de artikelen vooralsnog geen aanleiding geeft om te twijfelen aan de door Psyon geleverde kwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de themarapportage maaltijd- en flitsbezorging van de Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie

MPs Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Labour Inspectorate's thematic report on meal and flash delivery, including its conclusions on bogus self-employment, performance pressure, child labour and working conditions. The minister responded point by point, stressing employer responsibility, existing rules and the Inspectorate's enforcement, while committing to further enforcement steps, a broader ban consideration for flash delivery under 16, and a letter on the coalition's bogus self-employment measures.
I will send your House a outline letter before the summer on the elaboration of the coalition agreement.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor de zomer een hoofdlijnenbrief sturen over deze uitwerking van het coalitieakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘Oekraïense arbeiders in Westland uitgebuit: ‘Verwerpelijk’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report of exploitation of Ukrainian workers in Westland, and whether the free movement of labour should be replaced by work permits. The minister condemned the situation, said the Labour Inspectorate has opened investigations and is handling reports via a special team, and pointed to measures such as a notification duty, while declining to give details on individual companies until investigations conclude.
As long as the investigation has not been concluded, further information can only be shared in a confidential setting.
Zolang het onderzoek niet is afgerond, kan nadere informatie alleen in een besloten kader worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over het bericht “Schandalen PostNL bij ons niet minder erg dan in België”

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked ministers whether the abuses at PostNL in Belgium are a scandal, whether Dutch oversight of parcel delivery fails, what will be done to end such practices, what they think of Belgian plans to require firms to employ many couriers directly, and why Dutch postal workers still generate scandals. The minister declined to address the ongoing Belgian case, described Arbeidsinspectie and ILT enforcement and a multi-year strategy with large clients, said generic measures are preferred but sector-specific ones may be warranted, and noted the 80% employment rule applies only to letter delivery, not parcels.
I cannot go into an ongoing legal procedure such as the case in the article in your question, which moreover took place in a neighbouring country.
Op een lopende juridische procedure zoals de casus in het artikel uit uw vraag, die zich bovendien in een buurland heeft voorgedaan, kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over problemen die mensen met long Covid ervaren met onder andere het UWV

MPs Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about long-Covid patients being poorly assessed by UWV, inconsistent WIA outcomes, lack of a financial safety net for self-employed and other workers, UWV targets, case counts, and an information campaign. The Minister answered that UWV treats all claims equally and individually, that no separate long-Covid policy or instructions are planned, that no targets restrict WIA or Ziektewet inflow, and that some measures and registration steps are underway.
The number of awards or rejections plays no role in the steering and assessment of insurance physicians or their managers.
Het aantal toekenningen of afwijzingen speelt geen rol bij de aansturing en beoordeling van verzekeringsartsen of hun leidinggevenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Van Kent en Alkaya over de compensatie voor de gestegen energie- en brandstofprijzen

SP MPs asked why the 120% of social minimum income test for the one-off energy allowance counts the single-parent supplement of the child-related budget as income while excluding the child budget itself, and questioned how income is defined and applied across municipalities. The minister explained that the child budget including the single-parent supplement is excluded from income under the Participatiewet, acknowledged that the concept of income is hard for citizens to grasp, and said municipalities have discretion in specialist assistance while the wage increase was not feasible in time.
For social assistance benefits, a supplement under the child-related budget is a benefit within the meaning of the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes.
Voor bijstandsuitkeringen geldt dat een toeslag in het kader van het kindgebonden budget een tegemoetkoming is in de zin van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Palland over gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat

MPs Van Kent (SP) and Palland (CDA) asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions why a unanimously adopted motion on compensating self-employed people affected by the AOW-gap has made no visible progress, and whether the initiators have been informed. The answer notes the questions were already answered during question hour on 19 April 2022, pointing to a separate reply rather than providing substance here.

The written questions from MP Van Kent (SP) to the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions on the lack of progress on the unanimously adopted motion on the AOW-gap were answered during question hour on 19 April 2022.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Kent (SP) aan de Minister voor Armoedebeleid, Participatie en Pensioenen over gebrek aan voortgang bij de unaniem aangenomen motie aanpak AOW-hiaat ( 2022Z03459 ) zijn beantwoord tijdens het vragenuur van 19 april 2022 ( 2022Z07752 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat de overheidswebsite plat lag vanwege run op aanvraag duizend euro

MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked why the STAP training-budget website crashed on opening, whether demand was foreseeable, how many people were blocked, why there was no transition rule for people who started retraining before 1 March 2022, and how training providers are admitted to the register. The ministers acknowledge technical problems and UWV's capacity shortfall, promise improvements and monthly monitoring, but do not give exact figures for blocked applicants and largely explain the existing selection and register procedures.
It is difficult to estimate how many people were unable to submit an application due to the technical problems and rapid exhaustion of the budget.
Het is lastig om in te schatten hoeveel mensen door de technische problemen en snelle uitputting geen aanvraag hebben kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de politie is gestuit op ‘Roemeense slaven’

The SP MP Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of Romanian workers living in substandard housing in Dutch slaughterhouse-linked labour arrangements, asking about rent, minimum-wage deductions, agency accountability and tighter rules. The minister answered that enforcement is ongoing, cross-border cooperation with North Rhine-Westphalia is being used, a Good Landlordship bill is pending before the Council of State, and a certification scheme and the advisory team's recommendations are being implemented, though no sanctions have yet been imposed and details cannot be given on ongoing investigations.
I cannot go further into ongoing investigations.
Op lopende onderzoeken kan ik verder niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over werken zonder loon en verdringing van betaalde arbeid bij WerkSaam

An SP MP asked the minister about FNV allegations of unpaid work and displacement of paid jobs at the social development company WerkSaam, and about the financial incentives behind such schemes. The minister answered that municipalities bear responsibility for supervising these companies, that a Berenschot study commissioned by motion is nearly finished, that the Labour Inspectorate investigates only sector-level risks, and that the government will share the findings and a Divosa handreiking with municipalities.
It is therefore for the mayors and aldermen and municipal councils to make statements about the functioning of individual social development companies.
Het is daarom aan de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders en gemeenteraden om uitspraken te doen over het functioneren van individuele sociaal ontwikkelbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over problemen bij beslag op minimumuitkeringen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked whether minimum benefit recipients are left below subsistence when enforcement agents collect small positive differences after indexation, and how often this happens. The minister replied that borrowers can ask for the protected allowance to be recalculated after a structural income change, that the issue will be reviewed in the evaluation of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet in 2022/2023, and that the suggested legislative fixes are not adequate.
A citizen, but also their debt assistant or protective administrator, can ask the enforcing parties to recalculate the protected allowance after a structural change in their circumstances.

Een burger, maar ook diens schuldhulpverlener of beschermingsbewindvoerder, kan bij een structurele wijziging van zijn omstandigheden de beslagleggende partijen vragen om de beslagvrije voet opnieuw vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de Hoogvliet medewerkers een bonus geeft als ze zich niet ziek melden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether bonuses paid to supermarket staff for not reporting sick are dangerous and whether the government will act. The minister said employers are primarily responsible for healthy working conditions, that such bonuses must not pressure sick or COVID-infected staff to come to work, and that she sees no direct action needed beyond sectoral agreements.
I think it is important that employers commit in a positive way to keeping employees fit and healthy.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat werkgevers zich op een positieve manier inzetten om werknemers fit en gezond te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de staking van veerschippers bij de Maasveren

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they would intervene when the Maasveren ferry company sidelines the FNV union in wage negotiations with striking ferry crews, and whether the ferries should be brought into public hands. The ministers replied that collective bargaining is a matter for social partners under freedom of contract, that ferry responsibility lies with municipalities and provinces, and that they would not take further action.
In the Netherlands the principle of freedom of contract applies. Social partners themselves decide with whom they sit down at the table and make agreements.
In Nederland geldt het principe van contractsvrijheid. Sociale partners bepalen zelf met wie ze om tafel gaan zitten en afspraken maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de plannen tot halvering van de jonggehandicaptenkorting

An SP MP asked whether the cabinet still plans to halve the young disabled persons' tax credit (jonggehandicaptenkorting) to 415 euro by 2025, arguing it increases inequality and poverty for Wajong recipients, and asked the government to drop it. The minister answered that the decision will be taken in the spring budget process based on the CPB forecast, that minimum wage increases will pass through to Wajong benefits, and that she invited activist Anne Houtsma to discuss her experiences with the ministry.
The cabinet will make a final decision on the young disabled persons' tax credit during the spring budget decision-making.
Het kabinet neemt een definitief besluit over de jonggehandicaptenkorting tijdens de voorjaarsbesluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over Long COVID en de wet poortwachter

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether Long COVID, a poorly understood and possibly chronic condition, should be handled under the Wet verbetering poortwachter reintegration rules and whether social security policy should be changed for Long COVID patients. The Minister replies that the rules apply equally regardless of cause, that tailored reintegration is possible within existing policy, and that no policy change is needed.
I see no need to change social security policy for Long COVID patients.
Zie ik geen noodzaak om het beleid rond de sociale zekerheid voor Long COVID-patiënten aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over “de restitutie van transitievergoeding voor werkgevers.”

An SP MP asked whether employers lose the right to recover the transition payment when a worker with a fast-tracked full incapacity benefit (IVA) leaves via a settlement agreement before the 104-week sick-pay period ends, and whether this is being litigated. The minister confirms the rule under Article 7:673e BW, says UWV has won all past appeals and 12 are pending, and rejects changing the rule because it would undermine the dismissal ban during sickness.
No, I do not agree with that.
Nee, daar ben ik het niet mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat verzekeraars jagen op miljarden in het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.

An SP MP asked the government about reports that insurers are targeting pension assets of company pension funds under the new pension system, including the effects on participants, solidarity, insurer profits, lobbying and meetings with insurers. The Minister replied that the choice of pension provider is for employers and funds, that a careful process with DNB oversight and fund-body rights applies to transfers, and that the government does not expect pension interests to be harmed, while many questions were answered only generally or said the information is not available.
It is not possible to provide an overview of the requested information, because this information is not available.
Het is niet mogelijk om een overzicht van de gevraagde informatie te geven, omdat deze informatie niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over “het bericht dat bijstandsgerechtigden in de knel komen door hoge terugvorderingen”

MPs asked the minister why benefit recipients face high recovery claims despite gemeente relaxations, why courts seem to review reasonableness weakly, and about a motion on a €1,200 gift exemption. The minister promised a policy plan with gemeenten and said the motion would be included, but gave no firm timeline and pointed to existing municipal discretion.

Within the Participatiewet process I explicitly seek solutions in which the judge can explicitly review decisions for their reasonableness, precisely to prevent situations like those that came to light in the childcare benefits affair.

In het kader van het traject rond de Participatiewet zoek ik wel nadrukkelijk naar oplossingen waarbij de rechter beslissingen expliciet op hun redelijkheid kan toetsen, juist om situaties zoals die bij de Toeslagenaffaire naar boven kwamen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de te lage thuiswerkvergoeding in het licht van de stijgende prijzen en corona-lockdown

An SP MP asked the government whether the 2 euro per-day telework allowance, set against rising prices and a COVID lockdown, should be raised, and whether the Nibud should recalculate it, while also questioning wage growth and poverty. The ministers answered that the allowance would not be adjusted early, only indexed from 2023, and pointed to energy-tax cuts and a municipal compensation scheme instead.
The cabinet sees no reason to adjust the flat-rate allowance because of the higher inflation, which is mainly a consequence of rising energy prices.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding het forfait aan te passen vanwege de hogere inflatie die vooral een gevolg is van de stijgende energieprijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het onlangs gesloten coalitieakkoord (Hoofdstuk arbeidsmarkt en inkomen)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister for Poverty Policy about the labour market and income chapter of the new coalition agreement, including regulation of flexible contracts, WW duration, the AOW link to the minimum wage, arbeidsmigranten and UWV. The government mostly answered that the advisory reports serve as a guideline and that details will follow after further elaboration, while confirming the AOW will be decoupled from the extra minimum wage increase.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this when the elaboration takes place.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Leijten over “de verplichting door gemeenten tot een alimentatieverzoek als al vaststaat dat dit geen kans van slagen heeft”

SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that municipalities can require welfare recipients to file hopeless alimony claims, as criticized by a court, and asked about scope, costs, cost recovery and ending such practices. The State Secretary acknowledged the court's criticism, said such obligations must be used carefully and not where a claim has no chance, declined a broad inventory as unfeasible, and committed to alerting municipalities in Gemeentenieuws.
I consider a broad inventory as you propose too far-reaching in that light, and I also consider such an inventory unfeasible.
Ik vind een brede inventarisatie zoals u voorstelt in dat licht te vergaand en ik acht een dergelijke inventarisatie ook onuitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Kent over de situatie van arbeidsmigranten in Boskoop

An SP MP asked the government whether it considers living conditions for migrant workers in a Boskoop accommodation (beds on the floor, housing separated only by a fence) inhumane, and asked for sanctions on the agency and inspections of this and other locations. The minister replied that the municipality reports no violations after two unannounced inspections, points to planned Goed Verhuurderschap legislation and a housing handbook, and sees no reason for further checks.
It is after all the responsibility of the municipality to oversee compliance with the granted permits and adherence to the Building Decree.
Het is immers de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om toe te zien op de naleving van de verleende vergunningen en het voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de petitie van 700 distributiemedewerkers van GXO

MP Van Kent asked the State Secretary about a petition by 700 GXO distribution workers concerning a security check during breaks, H&M's refusal to accept the petition, and whether an unannounced inspection would be carried out. The State Secretary answered that employers are primarily responsible for safe work, that break rules are enforced civilly and via the Inspectorate SZW, that individual cases cannot be commented on, and that the Inspectorate conducts risk-based, often unannounced inspections and investigates all reports submitted via works councils or unions.
No statements are made about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over een gemeente die gesprekken over uitkeringen filmt

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked whether filming benefit conversations in the municipality of Dronten is acceptable, whether it undermines trust, and how the municipality complies with privacy law. The minister answered that filming privacy-sensitive talks needs a legal basis and must be necessary and proportionate, that the municipality has halted filming pending a review, and that the Dutch data protection authority and courts will judge its admissibility.
At present filming has been completely halted and the municipality is carrying out a review examining which means can be used and the advantages and disadvantages of each.
Op dit moment is het filmen geheel stil gelegd en voert de gemeente een onderzoek uit waarin gekeken wordt welke middelen kunnen worden ingezet en wat per middel de voor- en nadelen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de oproep van de FNV om Black Friday dit jaar over te slaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs and the Minister for Health whether Black Friday should be cancelled given FNV's call and last year's crowding and infection risks for retail staff. The government answered that employers remain responsible for safe workplaces, that retailers spread Black Friday over longer periods, that burgemeesters retain intervention powers, and that this year's Black Friday proceeded safely without needing intervention.
Intervention by the mayors has therefore not proven necessary.
Ingrijpen door de burgemeesters is daardoor niet nodig gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mogelijk onterecht in rekening gebrachte kosten door de deurwaarder

Two SP MPs asked whether bailiffs may charge debtors €84.64-€85.36 for bank-account information requests under art. 475aa Rv even without subsequently seizing funds, and whether this is justified. The Minister defended the separate tariff as comparable to EAPO work, rejected evidence of abuse, promised to raise transparency and tariff concerns with the bailiffs' association, but refused to drop the tariff.
I will continue to raise the practical operation of this bank-inquiry arrangement in my regular discussions with the KBvG.
Ik zal in mijn reguliere gesprekken met de KBvG aandacht blijven vragen voor de praktijkwerking van onderhavige regeling omtrent bankbevragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat zieke uitzendkrachten worden ontslagen terwijl dat wettelijk niet mag

An SP MP asked the state secretary how the government responds to reports that sick temporary agency workers are being dismissed despite the legal prohibition, and whether the uitzendbeding (temp-agency clause) can be invoked during illness, including questions on cao enforcement and preventing agencies from ignoring court rulings. The state secretary answered that the question is pending before the Hoge Raad, declined to anticipate the outcome, said new routes to avoid responsibility are undesirable, and stated UWV will not refuse benefits in the meantime.
I do not want to anticipate the outcome of the mentioned court case, since it is still before the court.
Ik wil niet op de uitkomst van de genoemde rechtszaak vooruitlopen nu deze nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de situatie van arbeidsmigranten in Boskoop

An SP MP asks the government about housing conditions for migrant workers in Boskoop, including a visitor being confronted by police, mould, windowless rooms, SNF certification enforcement, and the Roemer committee recommendations on floor space and separate leases. The minister answers that residents may receive visitors, that SNF inspects and handles complaints but cannot share company-specific data, and outlines the Goed Verhuurderschap bill and planned measures, often without a concrete commitment on timing.
I cannot make a statement about this specific situation.
Ik kan geen uitspraak doen over deze specifieke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het gebruik van de deeltijd-WW nu werk afneemt door de stijgende energieprijzen

An SP MP asked whether companies can use short-time work (werktijdverkorting) exemptions because of rising energy prices, and what the government will do to prevent dismissals and fund retraining. The Secretary of State said energy price rises are a normal business risk that rarely qualifies for an exemption, that no firm currently has one, and pointed to existing retraining schemes and tax relief for businesses.
There are no companies that have an exemption from the ban on short-time work citing rising energy prices.
Er zijn geen bedrijven die onder verwijzing naar de stijgende energieprijzen een ontheffing hebben van het verbod op werktijdverkorting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Ceder over de situatie van arbeidsmigranten in Tiel

MPs Van Kent (SP) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about homeless EU labour migrants living outdoors in Tiel and how the government will implement the motion Segers/Marijnissen calling for a tailored plan. The State Secretary says the municipality offered help and cleared the camp, and that an interdepartmental Plan van Aanpak for vulnerable homeless EU citizens is being finalised with the VNG and G4 and will be sent to parliament once agreed.
Once the necessary coordination, interdepartmental and with municipalities, is completed, the plan of action will be sent to your House.
Zodra de daarvoor benodigde afstemming, interdepartementaal en met gemeenten, is afgerond, wordt het plan van aanpak aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het wijzigen van het asbeststelsel

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Social Affairs why the government plans to drop air measurements by accredited laboratories after certain asbestos removal projects, weakening independent final inspection, and questions the cost savings, the reliance on models, and the removal of certification. The State Secretary rejects the concerns, arguing that air measurements are unnecessary where fibres are not expected, that the change is risk-based, and that certification remains for higher-risk applications.
Performing air measurements to establish whether it is safe is not always necessary and should only be used in situations where fibres could actually be expected in the air.

Het doen van luchtmetingen om vast te kunnen stellen of het veilig is, is daarbij niet altijd nodig en zou alleen ingezet moeten worden in situaties waarin ook daadwerkelijk vezels in de lucht te verwachten zouden kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht 'Fouten UWV brengen mensen in financiële problemen'

An SP MP asks the minister about reports that UWV errors push people into financial trouble and whether affected people can be compensated through debt forgiveness or repayment of net amounts. The state secretary acknowledges the problems, states that legal rules require recovery of undue benefits with only a narrow hardship clause, and promises to review the debtor policy and examine net-amount recovery by mid-2022.
What Mr Camps said is correct.
Het klopt wat de heer Camps heeft gezegd.
Antwoord op Vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat er gekort gaat worden bij Reiswerk Pensioenen na de overgang naar pensioenfonds PGB

An SP MP asks the minister why pension entitlements at Reiswerk Pensioenen face cuts of nearly 20% after a collective transfer to Pensioenfonds PGB, and whether individual members should have consent rights and property protection. The Staatssecretaris defends the liquidation transfer as legally permitted and in members' collective interest, leaves the court case and specific judgment to the judiciary, and rejects calls to abandon the new pension contract.
It is not for me to pronounce on a specific case.
Het is niet aan mij om een uitspraak te doen over een specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat 77 duizend mensen hun baan zijn verloren sinds de invoering van de Wet Arbeidsmarkt in Balans

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that 77,000 people lost their jobs after the Wet Arbeidsmarkt in Balans was introduced, and whether this undermines the law's aim of job security. The Minister answered that it is too early to draw conclusions from a short, partly COVID-affected ABN Amro study, that a formal evaluation is planned for 2025, and that employers' anticipatory dismissals of flex workers were foreseen.
In my view it is still really too early to draw conclusions about the Wab on the basis of this study.
Het is naar mijn mening op dit moment nog echt te vroeg om conclusies over de Wab te trekken op basis van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "omstreden risicoprofilering door gemeente Nissewaard"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the municipality of Nissewaard's risk-profiling algorithm for detecting welfare fraud, and whether similar practices elsewhere should be stopped and how their legality is ensured. The government replied that municipalities are primarily responsible under the GDPR and that the State Secretary has only stewardship of the Participatiewet; it declined to take national action on other municipalities' algorithms, while promising to inform municipalities of TNO's findings and pointing to existing guidance and ongoing inventories.
I am not aware whether other municipalities use the services of Totta Data Lab.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte of ook andere gemeenten gebruik maken van de diensten van Totta Data Lab.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het onterecht korten van leningen op de bijstand

An SP MP asked the minister why Rotterdam cut a benefit recipient's social assistance over a loan from his brother used to pay rent arrears, and whether loans should count as income. The state secretary acknowledges such cuts can produce undesirable outcomes, says the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling turned on urgent reasons rather than banning loan deductions, and promises to inform municipalities of nuance and to address hardship in a future Participatiewet plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Kent over "het moeten inleveren van een aangepaste bus"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why UWV is reclaiming an adapted vehicle from a disabled self-employed woman, whether people with disabilities are entitled to such aids when starting a business, what the municipality can do, and what will be done to help similar cases. The State Secretary said UWV's transport provision ends when training ends and self-employed people have no entitlement to transport for work, that UWV tries to arrange a smooth transition, that the municipality has now solved the case via a Wmo vehicle adaptation, and that the rules will not be changed but the case will be included in an evaluation with UWV.
I cannot go into the specific case in my answer, but will address your questions in general terms below.
Ik kan in mijn beantwoording niet specifiek ingaan op betreffende casus, maar zal in onderstaande beantwoording in algemene termen ingaan op uw vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over mogelijke problemen bij de cao Participatiewet voorkomen

An SP MP asked whether a new cao for Participatiewet workers could cause back-pay problems that reduce rent and care allowances, and whether a communication plan is needed. The minister argued the cao has no retroactive effect, so no back pay arises, noted that income changes must be reported to the Tax Authority, and declined a dedicated communication plan, promising only to share the questions with social partners.
That means there is no retroactive effect, so back payments and/or debts could not arise.
Dat betekent dat er geen sprake is van terugwerkende kracht waardoor nabetalingen en/of schulden zouden kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "schrijnende situaties door de kostendelersnorm"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about hardship cases caused by the cost-sharer norm (kostendelersnorm) in social assistance, including municipalities' scope for exceptions and motions asking for exemptions for homeless people, carers and young people. The state secretary answered that municipalities may temporarily set the norm aside in acute cases, but that categorical exemptions are not possible, that a different design would need legislation, and that municipal reluctance to use discretion will be raised with VNG and Divosa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug, Gijs van Dijk, en Van Kent, over het artikel “Mensen in financiële nood door achterstand bij UWV”

MPs from GroenLinks, PvdA and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV backlogs in WIA disability claims, forcing people into advance payments they must repay, and about hardship, shortages of insurance physicians and debt recovery rules. The minister answered with figures on advance payments and repayments, explained the causes of delays and the lack of a reimbursable-advance alternative, and committed to further talks with UWV and a letter setting out a solution.
I will engage further with VNG and UWV to assess whether this framework is adequate.
Ik ga nader in gesprek met VNG en UWV om te bezien of dit kader toereikend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "grote tekorten voor de Participatiewet bij gemeenten"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a structural shortfall of about 1.5 billion euros per year for municipalities under the Participatiewet, and about the support given to the new group of young disabled people. The state secretary said the financial situation has been studied before, that the shortfall figure cannot be confirmed as stated, and that the report was commissioned by VNG and is for the next cabinet to weigh.
It is up to a next cabinet to weigh the outcome of this research and other relevant research in this area and to decide whether, and if so how much, should be invested in municipal services.

Het is aan een volgend kabinet om de uitkomst van dit onderzoek en andere relevante onderzoeken op dit terrein te wegen en te besluiten of, en zo ja hoeveel, er geïnvesteerd moet worden in dienstverlening vanuit gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Kent over de uitspraak van de rechter omtrent het te laat afronden van de inburgering

MP Van Kent (SP) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that annulled a fine and waived a loan for a late civic integration course, and what this means for others and for the new integration law. The minister accepts the ruling, grants a longer deadline, says a broader review of the system is underway with a letter promised after summer, and notes the new law will include a hardship clause.
I have taken note of the court's ruling. I accept the ruling and will not appeal.
Van de uitspraak van de rechtbank heb ik kennisgenomen. Ik leg me neer bij de uitspraak en stel geen hoger beroep in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Peters over het bericht ‘Rijk belemmert gemeenten in armoedebeleid’

MPs Van Kent and Peters asked whether low-income people should build a financial buffer, what asset norms apply to local tax relief (kwijtschelding), and whether the government will raise the asset threshold to match welfare norms. The minister says no general buffer norm exists, asset norms are set per scheme, local municipalities set their own norms, and raising the kwijtschelding asset threshold is not decided by this caretaker cabinet because of poverty-trap and tax-burden effects, leaving the decision to a next cabinet.
Because of that complexity and its caretaker status, the cabinet leaves the decision on this to a next cabinet.
Vanwege die complexiteit en zijn demissionaire status laat het kabinet de besluitvorming hierover over aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nieuwe deurwaarderswet brengt schuldenaars in problemen’

MPs Van Kent and Ceder asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the new attachment-free allowance rules (fictitious housing costs) leave debtors with too little to live on. The minister defended the fictitious housing-cost method as a deliberate choice, said adjustments to the Recofa calculation for the protected amount are being prepared, and promised an evaluation and external study.
The law contains a hardship clause.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het afsluiten van een CAO in de uitzendsector tussen de LBV en de ABU

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new temp-sector CAO agreed with a non-independent union (LBV) undermined employers' reliability, whether it conflicted with expected regulation of flexible work, and whether contacts with the ABU and NBBU should be suspended. The minister declined to judge the parties or the CAO, stated that the government will not stop contacts with sector employer organisations, and said the future of driekwart dwingend recht is for the next cabinet.
I therefore do not consider it wise to break off or suspend those contacts.
Ik vind het dan ook niet verstandig om die contacten te verbreken of op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "over UWV gedupeerden bij Kafkaëske keuringen”

The MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's wrongful re-assessments of about 2,100 people by Ondersteuningsteam Noord and what will be done to prevent such failures and restore benefits. The Minister acknowledges errors and inadequate attention to people's circumstances, describes a meldpunt, individual case-by-case remedies, an external evaluation, and commitments to report back on outcomes.
In the case of those re-assessed by Ondersteuningsteam Noord, people were affected as a result of careless conduct by the government.
In de zaak van de herbeoordeelden door Ondersteuningsteam Noord zijn mensen getroffen als gevolg van onzorgvuldig handelen van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Kent over het bericht dat illegale schoonmaakmiddelen gebruikt worden in de luchtvaartindustrie

An SP MP asks why illegal, allegedly prohibited and hazardous cleaning agents are used to disinfect aircraft when approved alternatives exist, and whether the ministers agreed to the exemptions. The state secretary answers that no authorised biocide could be used on aircraft surfaces, so temporary exemptions were granted on Ctgb advice with conditions, that RIVM advises ordinary cleaning, and that the employer and Inspectie SZW are responsible for worker safety.
I am authorised to grant an exemption if a need for it is established.
Ik ben bevoegd een vrijstelling te verlenen indien hiervoor een noodzaak wordt vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat Just Eat Takeaway de databeschermingswet AVG overtreedt in Duitsland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Just Eat Takeaway's app, reportedly breaching GDPR in Germany, is also used in the Netherlands, what employee data employers may store, and whether the government will investigate. The minister could neither confirm nor deny the app's Dutch use, outlined general GDPR rules, and referred any investigation to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, which is independent.
It is up to the AP whether it sees reason to conduct an investigation.
Het is aan de AP of zij aanleiding ziet onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van Kent over het bericht 'Betere bescherming arbeidsmigranten kan niet wachten op nieuw kabinet'

MPs from D66 and SP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of migrant workers found in degrading conditions on a farm in Limburg, including inspection roles, sanctions, the welfare of the workers and the registration of migrant workers. The minister answered that inspections were carried out by the Inspectorate SZW, police and municipality, that investigations are ongoing, that the workers were traced to Belgium, and that the implementation of the Roemer taskforce recommendations is being pursued with some measures awaiting a new cabinet.
The investigation into this incident has not yet been completed and I cannot therefore assess it at this time.
Het onderzoek naar dit voorval is op dit moment nog niet afgerond en ik kan dit derhalve nog niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "het bericht dat burgers opgejaagd worden en hun privacy wordt geschonden"

An SP MP asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about reports that municipalities monitor welfare recipients' privacy, including waste-pass use, and about the role of the Inlichtingenbureau in data-matching and fraud detection. The minister answered that municipalities may investigate individual cases within legal limits, that the Inlichtingenbureau acts on statutory tasks under ministerial oversight and does not itself investigate fraud, and that a fraud law overhaul is under way.
The decisions taken by the college are open to objection and appeal by the citizen.
De door het college genomen beslissingen zijn vatbaar voor bezwaar en beroep door de burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat miljoenen mensen dit jaar geen vakantiegeld krijgen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he shares concern that millions of workers may not receive holiday pay this year despite it being legally required and covered by the NOW subsidy, and what he will do about it. The minister acknowledged the situation is worrying, pointed to the NOW uplift covering holiday pay, said the government does not know the specific circumstances of non-payment, and said he will keep discussing the matter with employer and union organisations, without a concrete new measure.
I do not know in what situation or under what circumstances employers choose not to pay holiday allowance, pay it later or pay less.
Ik weet niet in welke situatie of onder welke omstandigheden werkgevers ervoor kiezen om de vakantiebijslag niet, later of in mindere mate uit te betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het duperen van bijstandontvangers met schulden

SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about benefit recipients with debts who were given too low a protected minimum (beslagvrije voet) because of errors in the new debt-collection system, asking about remedies, deputies' responsibilities, and fixes. The minister acknowledged the problems, explained they stem from implementation issues and gemeenten's vacation-allowance reporting, described repayment efforts via the KBvG, and committed to keeping the House informed and to exploring a permanent solution.
I will keep your House regularly informed of progress.
Ik zal uw Kamer regelmatig op de te hoogte houden van de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het Jaarverslag 2020 van de Inspectie SZW

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the minister to respond to the Inspectie SZW 2020 annual report, which found violations in every checked food-delivery employer, and asked about enforcement, protection of delivery workers including bogus self-employed, and Spain's employment presumption. The minister acknowledged the violations, described inspection and enforcement steps, the 2021 extra focus on delivery, and said the government is working on a legal presumption for platform workers.
As a result of the increased pressure on this sector and the violations found last year, the Inspectie SZW is investing extra in this area in 2021.
Als gevolg van de toegenomen druk op deze sector en de vorig jaar geconstateerde overtredingen investeert de Inspectie SZW in 2021 extra hierop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de opkomst van digitale monitoring tijdens het thuiswerken

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about digital monitoring of employees during home working, union concerns, complaints to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and whether the Inspectie SZW can act. The minister answers that monitoring is subject to strict GDPR conditions, that the AP rather than the Inspectie oversees this, that few complaints have been filed, and that employers and employees should agree on monitoring themselves.
There is no overview of how ministries, government agencies or implementing organisations use monitoring software.
Er is geen overzicht van de wijze waarop ministeries, overheidsinstanties of uitvoeringsorganisaties gebruik maken van monitoringsoftware.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Alkaya over het bericht dat ProRail Spoorwerkers jarenlang heeft blootgesteld aan kankerverwekkend kwartsstof

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Infrastructure how ProRail and the labour inspectorate allowed rail workers to be exposed to carcinogenic quartz dust for years, and what will be done about enforcement, compensation and immediate remedies. The ministers answered that the inspectorate was aware of the risk since 2008, that ProRail and contractors acknowledged duty-of-care failures, that an inspectorate investigation into ProRail is ongoing, and that a compensation scheme for occupational disease victims is being prepared.
The Inspectorate SZW has started an investigation into ProRail's compliance in its role as employer and client and is in discussion with ProRail about improvements in its safety and health policy.

De Inspectie SZW is een onderzoek gestart naar de naleving door ProRail in haar rol als werkgever en als opdrachtgever en is met ProRail in gesprek over verbeteringen in het veiligheids- en gezondheidsbeleid van ProRail.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat honderden Jumbo-medewerkers op zoek moeten naar een nieuwe baan

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Jumbo's reorganisation eliminating jobs, pay gaps between cashiers and executives, workload, the cao negotiations and winstdeling legislation. The minister answered that reorganisation and pay are matters for the company and social partners, that the works council was consulted, that no forced dismissals are currently planned, and that the minimum wage decision is left to a future cabinet.
However, the cabinet is not responsible for the remuneration of executives of private companies.
Het kabinet gaat echter niet over de beloningen van bestuurders van private ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de grote verschillen tussen hoe gemeenten omgaan met de TONK

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the TONK emergency cost support differs strongly by municipality in amount and duration, and whether a minimum amount or common criteria would be set. The Minister answered that TONK runs under the special assistance framework, giving municipalities policy discretion, that the government urged generous application and doubled the budget, and that binding conditions are not appropriate given the decentralised nature of the scheme.
I cannot and do not want to set further conditions here; that does not fit the decentralised character of the TONK.
Nadere voorwaarden kan en wil ik hierbij niet stellen; dat past niet bij het decentrale karakter van de TONK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over berichtgeving van de NOS over het uitkeren van winst in het buitenland na ontvangst van NOW-subsidie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is acceptable that companies receiving NOW wage subsidy have parent companies paying out dividends and bonuses, including abroad, and requested overviews, totals and job-loss figures. The minister defended the design of the ban (applying to the applicant entity and, for subsidiaries, the group), said the data on which parent companies paid out cannot be provided before final settlement, and that job-loss figures are unknown and not collected.
Dergelijke gegevens kan ik u niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de coronabesmetting van minister Ollongren

An SP MP asked why the car used by minister Ollongren had no partition screen between driver and passenger, whether the protocol covered a minister who learns they are infected, and whether the 25 March incident was evaluated. The government answered that RIVM rules are followed, screens can be fitted on request and some cars have them, a protocol for ministerial transport exists and the driver was supported and the protocol reinforced.
Following what happened, FMHaaglanden provided the driver in question with extra support.
Naar aanleiding van hetgeen is gebeurd heeft FMHaaglanden de betreffende chauffeur extra begeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over "de crisissteunmaatregelen voor amateursportverenigingen"

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked why amateur sports clubs filing nil payroll returns for June 2020 are excluded from NOW 3.0 wage support while others get a fallback month, and asked for a fix. The minister says the rules are not unjust, points to the TASO scheme as a compensation route, and says the government is examining widening TASO for the first two quarters of 2021 without changing the NOW reference month.
In addition, it is being examined whether the TASO scheme for the first and second quarters of 2021 can be widened to support sports associations as appropriately as possible with wage costs.
Daarnaast wordt onderzocht of de TASO-regeling voor het eerste en tweede kwartaal van 2021 kan worden verruimd om sportverenigingen zo passend mogelijk te ondersteunen in de loonkosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de coronabesmetting van minister Ollongren

An SP MP asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Health about Minister Ollongren entering her official car with driver shortly after learning she had COVID-19, and about whether driver and workplace protections were followed. The government answers that the protocol for official transport was followed, the minister tested as a contact and did not need quarantine, and the driver's employer met its duty of care, while withholding further driver details on privacy grounds.
For reasons of privacy, no further information is provided about the driver.
Vanwege privacy wordt geen verdere informatie verstrekt over de chauffeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Laçin en Van Kent over het vrijkomen van kankerverwekkend chroom-6 bij werkzaamheden aan de Onyxkolencentrale

MPs asked whether chromium-6 released during maintenance at the Onyx coal plant exposed workers, whether independent investigation and compensation are in place, and whether the plant closes on 1 January 2021 and how much subsidy goes to workers. The minister replied that the Inspectorate found no proven exposure but could not exclude it, ordered dust clean-up and tighter controls, said closure timing depends on subsidy conditions, and noted that employer liability and a planned hardship scheme for occupational disease are being developed.
That is not known to me.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over 'onveilige distributiecentra'

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that seven in ten distribution centres violated COVID and safety rules, and about enforcement, sanctions and worker safety. The minister acknowledged the concern, described Inspectorate SZW's inspections, enforcement tools and the temporary shutdown power, but declined to provide a list of individual violations and gave no exact figures for migrant workers infected at work.
I cannot make statements about individual companies or ongoing investigations, nor provide lists.
Over individuele bedrijven of lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen of lijsten aanleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over blootstelling van werknemers aan vervuilde en schadelijke lucht op luchthaven Schiphol

Two MPs (Lacin and Van Kent, SP) asked the ministers of Infrastructure and Water Management and of Social Affairs about workers' exposure to jet exhaust and ultrafine particles at Schiphol, including use of Copenhagen-style push-back, single-engine taxiing, an inspectorate review, and worker involvement in the measurement programme. The ministers answered that employers are responsible for protective measures, that TNO's measurement programme was delayed by Covid-19 and will start in Q2 2021 with a worker sounding board, and that they decline to adopt the Danish approach or to ask the Inspectorate to investigate now.

The measurement programme that TNO, in consultation with RIVM, formulated on the basis of scientific insights and considerations, will be presented and discussed in this sounding board before the measurements are carried out.

Het meetprogramma dat TNO in overleg met het RIVM op basis van wetenschappelijke inzichten en afwegingen heeft geformuleerd, wordt vóór de metingen uitgevoerd in deze klankbordgroep gepresenteerd en besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht dat Maersk 24 Nederlandse werknemers op straat zet

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked ministers about Maersk removing 24 Dutch seafarers' ships from the Dutch flag and whether the company was replacing them with cheaper foreign workers. The minister regrets the reflagging but says it is an internal company matter, that the flag state governs crew conditions, and that social dumping through flag choice would be regarded as undesirable, while declining to comment on the union agreement or intervene with Maersk.
Since this concerns individual company policy, it is not for me to form a judgement on this choice.
Aangezien het hier om individueel bedrijfsbeleid gaat, is het niet aan mij om een oordeel over deze keuze te vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het maximum SV-loonbedrag in de NOW

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the planned reduction of the NOW wage-subsidy ceiling was reversed, how this fits with stricter support for self-employed, in which sectors such wages occur, and whether the ceiling will be lowered. The minister answered that the lockdown extension makes a cut undesirable, explained the sector breakdown from the November 2020 payment data, declined a company-level breakdown on workload grounds, and refused to lower the ceiling.
Breaking down by company is very labour-intensive and given the workload I did not ask UWV to do this.
Het uitsplitsen in bedrijven is zeer arbeidsintensief en gezien de werkdruk heb ik UWV dit niet gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over onderzoeken naar het veilig houden van asbestdakensanering

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked about the safety of the asbestos roof removal acceleration, the Arcadis exposure report, the TNO-based certification exemption and the Productenbesluit asbest. The government answered that certification for asbestos roofs is now proposed in the Arboregeling consultation, that the report was delivered on 1 February 2021 after delay, and that a revised Productenbesluit asbest is in preparation for 2022.

It is now known that the amendment to the Arboregeling put to internet consultation by the Minister of SZW proposes to include asbestos roofs among the asbestos applications subject to the certification requirement.

Inmiddels is bekend dat in de wijziging van de Arboregeling zoals door de Minister van SZW in internetconsultatie is gebracht, is voorgesteld de asbestdaken op te nemen bij de asbesttoepassingen waarvoor de certificatieplicht zal gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de sluiting van Niemeyer

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the planned closure of BAT Niemeyer in Groningen, its job losses, a Berenschot scenario, the loss of the Royal warrant, and whether the government would intervene. The minister acknowledged the regional job impact and the works council's alternatives but said closure strategy is the company's responsibility and declined to mediate, noting only UWV's role in unemployment support.
I see no general role for me, as Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, to actively intervene in that, and see no reason in this specific case to deviate from this line.
Ik zie in het algemeen geen rol voor mij, als Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, om mij daar actief in te mengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat de Inspectie SZW onterecht hoge boetes gaf aan werkgevers

An MP asked whether the Labour Inspectorate (Inspectie SZW) wrongly imposed high fines on employers, how often fines are reduced on appeal, and whether there are quotas or cost-recovery pressures behind fine-setting. The minister answered that about 15% of fines paid in 2019 were partly refunded, that such reductions do not automatically mean the original fine was wrong, that no quotas or cost-recovery targets exist, and that a study on understandability of regulations will be conducted in the first half of 2021.
The 15% figure gives an indication of the share of refunds, but for a proper answer to how often an Inspectie SZW fine is reduced at the objection and appeal stages, a multi-year overview is better.

Het percentage van 15% geeft dan ook wel een indicatie van het percentage terugbetalingen, maar voor een goed antwoord op de vraag in hoeveel gevallen een boete van de Inspectie SZW in de volgende stadia van bezwaar en (hoger) beroep wordt verlaagd, is een langjarig overzicht beter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over "het gebruik van NOW in de eredivisie"

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked whether Eredivisie clubs spending 74 million euros on transfers while receiving NOW wage subsidies was acceptable, and about the club aid package, adviser Klaas Dijkhof's role, and bonuses. The minister answered that the NOW uses a 20% revenue-loss threshold and group-level assessment, that transfer figures could not be verified because they are confidential, that further support is only a last resort after clubs exhaust their own options, and that bonuses are barred under NOW rules, with the minister referring the adviser question to Dijkhof himself.
Since this involves commercially sensitive information, it is not possible to verify the stated amounts.
Aangezien het hier bedrijfsgevoelige informatie betreft, is het niet mogelijk om de genoemde bedragen te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over vrachtwagenchauffeurs die hun cabine niet meer uitkomen

SP MPs asked whether truck drivers confined to their cabins during COVID measures lack humane conditions, such as access to toilets and showers, and what structural fix the government will provide. The State Secretary answered that employers must cover rest facilities, that the government relies on calls to petrol stations and rest areas to keep sanitary facilities open, and that talks with the sector are ongoing, without committing to a structural solution.
In addition, the Ministry of IenW keeps a close watch on industry organisations, so that any signals about the availability of sanitary facilities for drivers can be picked up in time.
Daarnaast houdt het Ministerie van IenW de vinger aan de pols bij brancheorganisaties, om eventuele signalen over de beschikbaarheid van sanitair voor chauffeurs tijdig op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Jasper van Dijk en van Kent over cashen op kosten van de belastingbetaler

SP MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Rechtsbescherming about a case where a business owner allegedly used NOW wage subsidies, let a company go bankrupt, dismissed staff and profited, and whether bailiffs' market structure should be reversed. The minister replied that individual bankruptcies are for the courts and the independent curator and BFT supervisor, that UWV paid wages after the bankruptcy request and will recover via the curator, and that the government will not reverse market competition for bailiffs, though it will correct tariffs and ban price agreements that endanger independence.
It is not for me to judge bankruptcies in individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om te oordelen over faillissement in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over het bericht dat banken mogen discrimineren op leeftijd

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked the Finance Minister whether banks may discriminate by age after a Kifid ruling upheld a bank's refusal of an overdraft facility to a customer aged 61-67 due to income uncertainty linked to retirement. The minister said discrimination is prohibited and the government opposes it, but declined to comment on individual Kifid rulings, excluded this case from the Kifid evaluation, and only appealed to banks to take a human-centred approach.
As Minister of Finance, I do not comment on rulings in individual cases of independent dispute resolution bodies, including this Kifid ruling.
Als Minister van Financiën spreek ik mij niet uit over uitspraken in individuele gevallen van onafhankelijke geschillenbeslechtingsinstanties, waaronder deze uitspraak van het Kifid.
Antwoord  op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over het kwijtraken van toeslagen door transitievergoedingen

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked whether transitievergoedingen (transition payments on dismissal) can push low-income people over the income thresholds and cause toeslagen (benefit supplements) to be reclaimed, and whether these payments could be excluded from the income test or averaged more easily. The state secretary acknowledged the payments can raise the income test and lead to reclaims, but rejected exempting them, said the Belastingdienst cannot count how often this happens, and said the averaging threshold will stay.
The benefit supplement system serves a different purpose. It provides targeted income support to guarantee financial access to care, childcare and a rental home.
Het toeslagenstelsel dient een ander doel. Het biedt gerichte inkomensondersteuning om de financiële toegankelijkheid van zorg, kinderopvang en een huurwoning te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat festivalorganisator Thuishaven steun van de overheid ontvangt, maar toch niet alle medewerkers doorbetaalt

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether festival organiser Thuishaven, which received NOW wage subsidy, may choose not to pay flexible workers, and whether the government will intervene. The minister replied that NOW subsidy is calculated on the January 2020 payroll and reduced if payroll falls, that employers decide how to allocate the funds, and that UWV will review compliance afterwards without a specific review of this firm announced.
For every employer that has applied for and received NOW, the UWV determines the final subsidy amount afterwards, assessing whether and how the conditions of the NOW have been met.

Voor iedere werkgever die NOW heeft aangevraagd en ontvangen geldt dat UWV de definitieve hoogte van de subsidie achteraf vaststelt, waarbij wordt beoordeeld of en hoe aan de voorwaarden van de NOW is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over problemen voor sociale ondernemingen met de Tijdelijke Noodmaatregel voor Overbrugging Werkgelegenheid (NOW)

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked whether talks with Cedris stalled, whether social workplaces will get compensation, and whether the NOW wage subsidy should be opened to them. The State Secretary replied that the Wsw grant was raised by €90 million for compensation, that social enterprises are treated like other firms for revenue loss under the NOW, and that no further commitment to municipalities is given beyond referring to the earlier letter.
Social workplaces and social entrepreneurs are not treated differently from other companies and institutions in the scheme when assessing revenue loss for the NOW.
Sociale werkvoorzieningen en sociaal ondernemers worden in de regeling niet anders behandeld dan andere bedrijven en instellingen bij de beoordeling van het omzetverlies voor de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de borging van veilig en gezond werken bij het verwijderen van asbesthoudende vensterbanken

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs why the Sci 547 committee rejected a request to classify asbestos-containing window sills as risk class 1, how this fits a 2019 pilot and a 2009 letter, whether workers were exposed above limits, and why the CCvD Asbest proposal was not adopted. The State Secretary replies that the committee has since approved the downgrade to risk class 1, that the ministry did not authorise the pilot, that exposure measurements stay below the limit value, and that the CCvD proposal conflicted with existing regulation and certification principles.
With the opening of the Validation and Innovation Point (VIP) the Sci 547 Committee has indeed been dissolved and no new applications for innovative working methods have been handled by it since.

Met de opening van het Validatie- en Innovatiepunt (VIP) is inderdaad de Commissie Sci 547 opgeheven en zijn door de Commissie Sci 547 geen nieuwe aanvragen voor innovatieve werkwijzen meer in behandeling genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over de beantwoording van eerdere schriftelijke vragen over het bericht dat de Technische Unie de stakingsregels breekt

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a 50,000 euro advance payment from employers to the union AVV, which they say is not a member of the relevant social fund, breaches ILO Convention 98 and whether any supervision of such arrangements exists. The minister answered that cao parties may structure employer contributions freely within law, that whether this case breaches the ILO convention is not for him to judge, and described ILO and national supervisory mechanisms.
Whether there is a conflict with the ILO convention in this case, for example because a payment was made in advance, is not for me to assess.
Of in deze casus sprake is van strijdigheid met het ILO-verdrag, bijvoorbeeld omdat er een betaling vooraf is gedaan, is niet aan mij om te beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de nadere uitwerking van de NOW-regeling waaruit blijkt dat een horecaondernemer niet 10 procent van de loonkosten zelf moet doorbetalen maar ruim 35 procent

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a hospitality entrepreneur who found that under the NOW scheme he must bear over 35 percent of wage costs himself instead of the 10 percent communicated, and whether the scheme should be applied more generously. The Minister answered that the 30 percent flat-rate surcharge is a standardized, not sector-specific, approximation, that the scheme was communicated as tied to revenue loss, that no individual adjustment is feasible, and that the flat-rate surcharge was raised to 1.4 percent for the second NOW.
No, as already explained above, it is unfeasible to do justice to specific cases.
Nee, zoals hierboven al toegelicht is het ondoenlijk om recht te doen aan specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over de toepassing van werktijdverkorting en de economische gevolgen van de coronacrisis

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked about the uptake and processing of werktijdverkorting applications, UWV capacity, payment delays, and compensation for self-employed workers during the coronavirus crisis. Minister Koolmees answered that the wtv scheme was withdrawn in favour of the NOW scheme run by UWV, that 130,000+ employers had applied, that WW payments remain on time, and that self-employed workers are covered via the Tozo.
Therefore it was decided to withdraw the wtv scheme and to work on introducing and opening the new temporary Emergency Measure for Bridging Employment Retention (NOW).
Daarom is besloten om de wtv-regeling in te trekken, en te werken aan de invoering en openstelling van de nieuwe tijdelijke Noodmaatregel Overbrugging voor Werkbehoud (NOW).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Leijten en Van Kent over kinderopvangtoeslag in werkloosheid tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs of the SP asked whether childcare allowance is stopped after three months of unemployment during the coronavirus crisis and whether the government will extend that period to six months given weak job prospects and childcare waiting lists. The State Secretary answered that parents keep the allowance for three months and can use remaining hours until year-end under the annual system, and declined to extend the period because past extensions had limited effect and the economic outlook is uncertain.

Given the room that the existing unemployment period and the annual system already offer, and given the limited effects in the past, the uncertainty about the economic outlook and its effect on waiting lists, I do not consider it opportune to extend the unemployment period.

Gegeven de ruimte die de bestaande werkloosheidstermijn en de jaarsystematiek reeds bieden, en gegeven de beperkte effecten in het verleden, de onzekerheid over het economische beeld en het effect daarvan op wachtlijsten, vind ik het niet opportuun om de werkloosheidstermijn te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over onrust onder werknemers over arbeidsomstandigheden en behoud van baan

SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that employees are pressured, dismissed or made to work in unsafe conditions during the coronavirus crisis, and about employer obligations, sick leave rights, forced holiday, and NOW wage subsidy conditions. The government answered that such treatment is unacceptable, that employers must follow emergency rules and safety duties with enforcement by Inspectie SZW and police, and that NOW conditions and dismissal consequences apply, while declining to comment on individual cases and pointing to other bodies or existing rules.
I cannot judge individual reports, but in general I find it unacceptable that employees are pressured, dismissed or made to work in unsafe conditions in connection with the coronavirus.
