Ik kan niet oordelen over individuele meldingen, maar in algemene zin vind ik het niet acceptabel dat werknemers in verband met het coronavirus onder druk worden gezet, ontslagen of onder onveilige arbeidsomstandigheden moeten werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over welke bedrijven er een beroep doen op de Tijdelijke Noodmaatregel Overbrugging Werkgelegenheid (NOW)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about which firms, sectors and sizes applied for the NOW wage subsidy, the contract types, subsidy percentages and the cost effect of a lower wage ceiling. The minister reported 114,049 applications and 103,737 grants by sector and firm size, but said contract-type data is unavailable and wage-distribution questions can only be estimated from CBS data.
What type of employment contract (permanent, temporary, on-call/substitute and zero-hour) did those applications relate to, broken down by sector and firm size?
Op wat voor type arbeidscontract (vast, tijdelijk, oproep/inval en nuluren) hadden die aanvragen betrekking, uitgesplitst naar sector en bedrijfsgrootte klein, middelgroot, groot en zeer groot?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het vervallen van de AOW-partnertoeslag tijdens de coronacrisis

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the AOW partner allowance should lapse when a younger partner temporarily returns to work in healthcare during the coronavirus crisis, and whether a temporary concession would be made. The minister agreed and said the SVB was asked to deviate from current rules and revive the partner allowance after such work ends, for as long as the COVID-19 emergency measures apply.

Following this, I have asked the SVB, in the case where a younger partner of an AOW recipient has started (more) working in a critical profession as a result of the coronavirus crisis and this work lasts longer than three months, to deviate from the current policy rules and to revive the right to partner allowance after the work ends.

Naar aanleiding hiervan heb ik de SVB verzocht in het geval een jongere partner van een AOW-gerechtigde als gevolg van de coronacrisis (meer) is gaan werken in een cruciaal beroep en deze werkzaamheden langer dan drie maanden voortduren, af te wijken van de huidige beleidsregels en het recht op partnertoeslag na de beëindiging van de werkzaamheden te laten herleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht 'Afhandelaars Schiphol eisen steunpakket van 25,5 miljoen euro'

Two SP MPs asked why five ground-handling companies at Schiphol, facing 3,000 possible layoffs, were not helped by the NOW wage subsidy, and whether the government would investigate market structure and wages in ground handling. The minister said NOW conditions prohibit layoffs for economic reasons, that losses may be too small and January payroll is used as reference, and declined a separate study of ground handling, citing the ongoing EU review of Directive 96/67.
Question 5: Are you willing to investigate the organisation of ground handling at Schiphol?
Vraag 5 Bent u bereid om onderzoek te doen naar de inrichting van grondafhandeling op Schiphol
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat uitzendbureau Fides arbeidsmigranten oproept zich niets aan te trekken van het coronavirus

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a staffing agency's social media posts urging Polish migrant workers to ignore coronavirus risks were acceptable and whether it would be contacted or referred to the labour inspectorate. The minister said the agency removed the posts after the sector association intervened, that the inspectorate can act on complaints, and that RIVM information is available in several languages.
Fides took immediate action on the signal and removed the post.
Fides heeft op grond van het signaal direct actie ondernomen en de uiting verwijderd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat werkgevers in zee gaan met kleine vakbonden om cao’s te sluiten met voor hen gunstige voorwaarden

MP Van Kent (SP) asked whether the government would act on reports that employers are signing collective agreements with small, employer-friendly unions such as AVV, LBV and Qlix, and whether representativeness tests should be introduced. Minister Koolmees replied that concluding collective agreements is a matter for employers and unions, that current satisfaction data give no reason for structural reform, and that he is willing to put the issue on the agenda with social partners.
I am willing to place the subject on the agenda with the social partners and discuss it with them.
Daarom ben ik bereid het onderwerp te agenderen bij de sociale partners en met hen hierover in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat bij een reorganisatie bij bandenfabriek Apollo Vredestein in Enschede 750 medewerkers op straat staan

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a planned reorganisation at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede that would cost 750 jobs, and whether the government would intervene. The minister said the decision is a business-economic choice still subject to works council and union review, that officials are in contact with the province, municipality and company, and that the company and UWV handle job-to-job support and a social plan.
It is up to the entrepreneur himself to organise his business and to decide at which location he has the production of various products carried out.
Het is aan de ondernemer zelf om zijn bedrijf in te richten en te besluiten op welke locatie hij de productie van verschillende producten laat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palland, Amhaouch, Wiersma, Verhoeven, Bruins, Gijs van Dijk, Van Kent en Stoffer over het aangekondigde massaontslag bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs asked the government about the announced loss of 750 jobs at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, a new Hungarian plant that received subsidies, and whether EU state aid rules were breached, and whether the government would press the Commission or the company. The minister replied that the Commission judged the Hungarian aid compatible with the internal market, saw no reason to contact the Commission or Hungary, said there were no prior warnings of reorganisation in contacts with the owner and the Enschede management, and left the social plan to the company while pointing to a regional deal.
Should further study of the case give cause for it, I will bring this to the attention of the Commission and my colleagues involved.
Mocht er na verdere bestudering van de casus aanleiding toe zijn dan zal ik dat bij de Commissie en mijn collega's die hierbij zijn betrokken onder de aandacht te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over een tegemoetkoming vanwege de Coronamaatregelen aan werkenden en mensen met een uitkering

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the minister whether people already on benefits, flex workers, self-employed people, WW and WIA recipients could receive crisis support, with extended benefit periods and wage-level benefits. The minister answered that the measures target workers and businesses, that the NOW wage subsidy is being designed, that WW and WIA extensions are not currently considered, and that benefit application procedures will be sped up.
Once the scheme is in place, I would gladly discuss it with you.
Zodra de regeling er is ga ik daar graag met u over in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "stijgende instroom arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering"

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether abolishing early-retirement schemes, which removed the healthy-worker effect, was foreseen, and whether the rise in WIA inflow should prompt reviewing those schemes. The minister acknowledges the inflow rise is larger than expected, says selection effects were likely not explicitly considered, promises further analysis via motion Brenk/van Dijk, but refuses to revise the early-retirement policy in line with the Pensioenakkoord.
Following motion Brenk/van Dijk, I will examine whether further analyses are possible to explain the rise in WIA inflow.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Brenk/van Dijk 5 zal ik onderzoeken of er nog nadere analyses mogelijk zijn om de stijging van de WIA-instroom te verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "de toename van het aantal mensen met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering (WIA)"

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the rising inflow into the WIA disability benefit, including whether early-retirement schemes should be reinstated and why the number of disabled people is growing. The minister attributes the rise to a stronger labour market, the higher pension age and rising employment of older workers, says there is a shortage of occupational physicians, and declines to reinstate early-retirement schemes beyond the pension agreement.
The final quantitative figures on WIA benefits for 2019 are not yet known at this time.
De definitieve kwantitatieve cijfers over de WIA-uitkeringen voor 2019 zijn op dit moment nog niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over het bericht dat de Technische Unie de stakingsregels breekt

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a Technische Unie strike was being undermined by temporary staff, whether the Inspectorate was investigating, and about employers refusing talks with FNV and the allowance paid to AVV. The Minister answered that Waadi bans temporary replacement workers during strikes, the Inspectorate has begun an inspection whose details he cannot disclose, and that collective bargaining and courts, not the Minister, judge compliance.
I cannot provide further information about the timing and content of ongoing investigations.
Over de termijn en de inhoud van lopende onderzoeken kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over "het bericht dat het Lage-inkomensvoordeel (LIV) een kapitaal kost per extra werkende persoon"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about SEO research suggesting the Lage-inkomensvoordeel (LIV) wage subsidy costs a large sum per additional worker, and whether it and the youth LIV should be scrapped or redirected. The minister acknowledged a modest employment effect, said costs may not outweigh the jobs created, and announced talks with employers on a more effective use of the Wtl instruments, with results to be reported in early 2020.
That is why the pension agreement provides for examining with employers a more effective use of the full set of instruments in the Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein (Wtl).
Daarom is in het pensioenakkoord afgesproken om met werkgevers een effectievere invulling van het geheel aan instrumenten in de Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein (Wtl) te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat het concurrentiebeding vaak oneigenlijk wordt gebruikt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers misuse non-compete clauses to retain staff in a tight labour market, and whether Dutch law should require compensation as in several other European countries. The minister acknowledged possible misuse, noted the Wwz rule requiring serious business interests for temporary contracts and judicial power to award compensation, provided court case figures showing no rise, and said he will study whether to impose conditions including mandatory compensation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat er een miljardenstrop dreigt voor de overheid door de nieuwe zzp-wet

Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister whether the planned self-employment declaration could cost the state billions in premium and tax revenue, why no study had been done, why it is needed, and how it is enforced. The Minister replied that effects are complex to model, a labour-market study is under way and will be sent to parliament with the bill, and that the Belastingdienst and UWV supervise the declaration while the Inspectie SZW has no role.
At the VAO on labour market policy of 4 September, I committed to sending the results of this labour-market effects study to your House at the same time as the bill is submitted.

Ik heb tijdens het VAO arbeidsmarktbeleid van 4 september jl. toegezegd uw Kamer de uitkomsten van dit arbeidsmarkteffectenonderzoek gelijktijdig met de indiening van het wetsvoorstel te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat bezorgers van online supermarkt Picnic de noodklok luiden over de arbeidsomstandigheden

An SP MP asked the government about reports that Picnic delivery workers complain about working conditions, unsafe delivery vans, dismissals of workers in contact with FNV, reliance on temp agency staff, and whether Picnic falls under existing collective agreements. The state secretary replied that employers are responsible for safe conditions, that the Inspectorate SZW monitors the sector through a risk-based programme and investigates complaints, that Picnic reports improvements and an electric cart pilot, that dismissals for union contact are not valid grounds, and that collective agreement coverage is for social partners to decide.
Whether an investigation is ongoing at a specific company is not public information.
Of bij een specifiek bedrijf wel of niet een onderzoek loopt, is geen openbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Kent over het bericht 'AOW en zwaar werk'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers' calls for early AOW retirement for heavy-work occupations, a Austrian-style list of arduous jobs, exemption from AOW premiums, linking AOW age to years worked, and CPB and life-expectancy forecasts. The minister rejects a generic heavy-work scheme as unworkable, points to pension-deal measures for sector-level early retirement, says a study on linking to 45 years of service will finish next year, and states the CPB variant study is no longer needed.
Abolishing the AOW premium obligation for people in heavy occupations will not be feasible given the demarcation questions described above.
Het laten vervallen van de premieplicht AOW voor mensen met een zwaar beroep zal gelet op de hiervoor beschreven afbakeningsvragen niet uitvoerbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Laçin over "Een tankstationhouder die af wil van zijn "wurgcontract"

MPs Van Kent and Laçin asked whether franchise contracts between oil companies and petrol station operators can amount to disguised employment, and whether the Labour Inspectorate checks them. The minister answered that parties have full contractual freedom, the government has no view on the contracts, and the Inspectorate does not currently see franchising as a priority risk, though it will monitor reports.
These concern agreements between two private parties. I therefore have no view of them.
Dit betreffen overeenkomsten tussen twee private partijen. Daarop heb ik dus geen zicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Bedrijven maken al plannen om de payrollwet te omzeilen’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he finds it worrying that companies are already devising schemes to circumvent the new payroll law, and how he will monitor such constructions. The minister answered that the law's boundary between payrolling and temp work is sufficiently clear, that enforcement rests mainly with firms, clients, unions and courts, and that he will keep a close watch and has already written to parliament on contracting.
Of course I always want to keep a finger on the pulse to prevent new constructions involving unfair competition on employment conditions.
Natuurlijk wil ik altijd vinger aan de pols houden om nieuwe constructies waarbij sprake is van oneigenlijke concurrentie op arbeidsvoorwaarden te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Reactie Expertise Centrum Asbest & Vezels op de commotie rondom de risico’s van blootstelling aan asbest’

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked the ministers about an opinion piece from the Expertise Centrum Asbest & Vezels criticising asbestos policy, including whether the debate has shifted towards cost, whether asbestos is dangerous only with long exposure, and whether the ministers will meet the centre on the roof-asbestos ban and certification of removal firms. The minister answered that health risks remain central, that asbestos is carcinogenic and removal is required where it poses a risk, that officials will make contact with the centre, and that the government will report on implementation this autumn.
However, I also placed an important caveat on the cost calculations made in this report.
Ik heb echter ook een belangrijke kanttekening geplaatst bij de berekeningen van de kosten die in dit rapport gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over ‘de arbeidsomstandigheden bij online supermarkt Picnic’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about working conditions at online supermarket Picnic, including lifting instructions, use of NIOSH and DUTCH methods, electric carts, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should inspect the distribution centres. The State Secretary answered that employers are responsible for compliance, that the Inspectorate follows the sector risk-based and will forward the questions, but declined to say whether a specific company is under investigation.
I am happy to forward your questions and my answers to the Inspectorate SZW so that the Inspectorate can take them into account in its work.
Ik ben graag bereid uw vragen en mijn antwoorden aan de Inspectie SZW door te geleiden zodat de Inspectie deze kan betrekken bij haar werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat Shell van plan is stakers te korten op hun salaris

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Shell's plan to cut striking workers' wages at Pernis and Moerdijk is consistent with the right to strike, and whether the company should be called to account. The minister confirmed that strikes are a social right and that employers may not dismiss or otherwise punish strikers, but may withhold pay for strike hours under Dutch civil law, leaving disputes to the courts and declining to intervene in the collective bargaining.
Strikes are a matter between employers and trade unions. It is up to them to conduct collective negotiations and give substance to the right to collective action. I play no role in this.
Stakingen zijn een zaak tussen werkgevers en vakbonden. Het is aan hen om collectieve onderhandelingen te voeren en invulling te geven aan het recht op collectief optreden. Ik speel hierin geen rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Werkgever worstelt met transitievergoeding bij ontslag na langdurige ziekte’

MPs Wiersma and Van Kent asked the minister about employers' uncertainty over compensation for the transition payment when dismissing long-term sick workers, including which documents are required and where employers can get help. The minister answered that UWV is implementing the scheme from 1 April 2020, that documents and an information campaign will follow, and that a bank statement alone is not sufficient for compensation.
I will ensure together with UWV that information on the precise documents employers must provide to UWV from 1 April 2020 forms part of this information campaign.
Ik zal samen met UWV zorgen dat de informatie over de precieze documenten die werkgevers vanaf 1 april 2020 aan UWV moeten verstrekken onderdeel vormt van deze voorlichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Smeulders, Renkema en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat de distributiecentra van Picnic niet veilig zijn

MPs from SP, GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of high workload, unsafe equipment and poor pay at online supermarket Picnic, including whether the Inspectorate SZW would investigate, whether its risk assessment was in order, and whether it should fall under the supermarket collective agreement. The Minister answered that employers are responsible for safe work and workload, that the Inspectorate acts on complaints and risk-based priorities without commenting on specific investigations, that no company collective agreement is registered for Picnic and interpreting the scope of sector agreements is for the social partners, and that the government is taking measures against competition on labour conditions.
No statements are made about whether the Inspectorate SZW is conducting an investigation or not.
Er worden geen uitlatingen gedaan of de Inspectie SZW al dan niet onderzoek doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ‘856.000 Nederlanders in loondienst bouwen geen pensioen op’

MP Van Kent asked whether around 35,000 call-centre workers building no pension is accurate, why temp workers avoid employment, how many collective agreements regulate no pension, how to extend pension coverage, and whether toilet restrictions in call centres harm health, and asked for a Labour Inspectorate investigation. Minister Koolmees confirmed the pension gap, said pensions are primarily for social partners, found nearly all major CAOs refer to a pension scheme, said working conditions are employers' responsibility and the Inspectorate will not investigate on media signals alone.
Media signals alone are insufficient grounds to ask the Labour Inspectorate to investigate working conditions and workload at call centres.
Enkel signalen in de media zijn onvoldoende aanleiding om de Inspectie SZW te verzoeken onderzoek te doen naar de arbeidsomstandigheden en werkdruk bij klantcontactcentra.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht "856.000 Nederlanders in loondienst bouwen geen pensioen op"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that 856,000 employees have no pension accrual, including one in three temp agency workers despite the mandatory scheme, and about measures against employers not offering pensions. The minister acknowledges the problem stems largely from exempt groups and administrative lags, says the pension fund StiPP is responsible for enforcement, and promises a sector study on shortening the waiting period and further information to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de personeelsuitbuiting en soms ook mensenhandel die chuil gaat achter de idyllische wereld van riviercruises

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports of exploitation of river cruise staff, including excessive hours, unpaid overtime and possible trafficking. The State Secretary said the Working Time Decree for inland shipping allows long hours, that the Labour Inspectorate has fined operators and keeps attention on the sector, but declined to commit to new measures beyond its existing programme.
I therefore see no reason to point this out to the Inspectorate.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om de Inspectie hierop te wijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over uitstel van het verschijnen van het onderzoek naar de blootstelling aan asbestvezels bij werkzaamheden met straalgrit

An SP MP asked why the publication of an investigation into worker exposure to asbestos-contaminated blasting grit keeps being postponed, and what is being done for workers left uncertain for a year. The state secretary replied that additional RIVM research was needed for careful assessment, that TNO and RIVM reports are sent alongside the answers, and that the Arbobesluit requires employers to keep lists of exposed workers.
On the basis of the TNO and RIVM reports, which you receive in parallel with these answers, a definitive answer can be given.
Op basis van de rapporten van TNO en RIVM, die u parallel aan deze antwoorden ontvangt, kan uitsluitsel worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de nieuwe ontslagwet slecht is voor werknemers

The SP MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new dismissal law harms employees, citing an Inspectorate SZW report on UWV's business-economic dismissal review, including claims that employers replace dismissed staff with cheaper flex workers and supply false information. The minister rejects the claim that the law is bad for workers, notes that the Inspectorate's findings rest on perceptions that may differ from reality, and announces better information for employees on the re-employment condition and UWV follow-up.
UWV acts carefully by checking the information supplied by the employer for completeness and consistency.
Het UWV handelt zorgvuldig door de door de werkgever aangeleverde informatie te controleren op volledigheid en consistentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Smeulders en Van Kent over onderbetaling journalisten door payrolling

MPs Van Dijk, Smeulders and Van Kent asked the ministers about public broadcasting journalists being underpaid through payrolling, including questions on pensions, the regeringsakkoord, zzp collective bargaining and flex allowances. The ministers answered that the Wab bill will extend equal pay and adequate pensions to payroll workers, that broadcasters must set their own budgets and wage terms under the cao, and declined to research the effects on journalistic quality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over verplichte diensten op zaterdagmiddag bij VDL Nedcar die in strijd zijn met de Arbeidstijdenwet

An SP MP asked the state secretary whether mandatory Saturday-afternoon shifts at VDL Nedcar, imposed after a strike and allegedly in breach of the Working Hours Act, were lawful, and what would be done about it. The secretary said the shifts were not in themselves unlawful, that the Labour Inspectorate would investigate complaints, that VDL Nedcar had reduced the planned overtime, and that no reason was seen yet to assume a breach.
Reports of possible breaches of the Working Hours Act will be investigated by the Labour Inspectorate and, if breaches are actually found, will lead to an enforcement procedure and possibly a fine.

Meldingen van mogelijke overtredingen van de Arbeidstijdenwet zullen door de Inspectie SZW onderzocht worden en indien er daadwerkelijk sprake blijkt van overtredingen, leiden tot een handhavingstraject en mogelijk tot boeteoplegging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) opnieuw privégegevens lekt

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the minister about a UWV data leak exposing personal data of 2,400 clients in Noord-Holland, and whether UWV's explanation, systems, GDPR compliance and past promised measures are adequate. The minister attributes the leak to human error, describes apology letters, a technical measure to block certain file types in Q2 2019, and admits earlier measures were insufficient.
UWV will introduce a technical measure in the second quarter of 2019 that makes sending certain files, such as xcel files, impossible.
Het UWV zal in het tweede kwartaal 2019 een technische maatregel invoeren die het verzenden van bepaalde bestanden, zoals xcel bestanden, onmogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat wanbetaling van freelance-journalisten in de hand wordt gewerkt door de overheid

SP MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked whether freelance journalists are underpaid, whether minimum rates and collective bargaining should be allowed, and whether labour inspections target abuses at publishers. The minister answered that the government wants more protection for low-paid self-employed workers through a rule presuming an employment contract, that collective rate-setting by freelancers is restricted by competition law, and that inspections are risk-based without commenting on ongoing investigations.
I do not make any statements about possible ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het online platform Temper dat zich wel degelijk als werkgever gedraagt

An SP MP asked the minister about the online platform Temper, which allegedly acts as an employer toward (pseudo-)self-employed hospitality workers through low rates, fees and restrictions, and whether it falls under the Waadi intermediary law and the government's enforcement tools. The minister answered that whether Temper is an employer or a temporary-work intermediary depends on facts that cannot be judged from a website, that courts decide, that the Inspectie SZW and Belastingdienst can investigate on complaint or risk-based supervision, and declined to comment on individual cases.
Whether this is the case at Temper depends on the facts and circumstances under which work is performed, which cannot be established solely on the basis of a text on a website.
Of dit bij Temper het geval is hangt af van de feiten en omstandigheden waaronder wordt gewerkt en dat kan niet worden vastgesteld alleen op basis van een tekst op een website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk over “de pakketsorteerders die via een schijnconstructie worden ingehuurd bij PostNL”

MPs Van Kent and Van Dijk asked the State Secretary about PostNL using a contracting scheme to hire parcel sorters outside the post CAO, heavy lifting limits, sick-leave practices and their call to ban parcels over 23 kg. The government answered that enforcement of CAOs is primarily for social partners, that the Labour Inspectorate can only report findings, that the Arbowet and NIOSH method govern lifting, and that the motion was rejected.
It is therefore not for the Labour Inspectorate to take further steps, even if in an investigation under article 8 of the Waadi it has established that the wage-ratio provision was not complied with.

Het is dus niet aan de Inspectie SZW om nadere stappen te nemen, ook niet als zij bij een onderzoek op grond van artikel 8 van de Waadi heeft vastgesteld dat het loonverhoudingsvoorschrift zoals vastgelegd in de Waadi niet is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Gijs van Dijk over de inwerkingtreding van de handhaving op schijnzelfstandigheid per 1 juli aanstaande

MPs Van Kent and Gijs van Dijk asked how the Tax Authority and Inspectorate SZW would enforce against sham self-employment from 1 July 2018, including evident bad-faith employers such as Deliveroo. The minister answered that enforcement continues only against the most serious cases within existing capacity, outlined a supervision plan with at least 100 client visits, and noted the heavy burden of proof and the lengthy appeal and criminal route.
Supervision and enforcement of the DBA Act take place within existing capacity.
Toezicht en handhaving van de wet DBA vindt plaats binnen de bestaande capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "een lagere WIA-uitkering door dagloonbesluit".

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked whether the daily-wage rules (Dagloonbesluit) unfairly lower a WIA benefit compared with the Ziektewet, and whether the rules should be repaired. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained the reference-period and daily-wage calculation, and said there is no reason to change the rules.
There is no reason to change the daily-wage rules for the WIA.
Er is geen aanleiding om de dagloonregels voor de WIA te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Kent over het ontduiken van het minimumloon door Sandd

MPs Alkaya and Van Kent asked whether postal company Sandd is evading the minimum wage by paying couriers on fixed norm hours rather than actual hours worked, and how the 80% employment norm was met. The minister answers that the minimum wage applies per hour worked, that the Inspectorate SZW is aware of the FNV complaint, that ACM found postal firms compliant with the 80% norm, and that a sector-wide collective agreement is for social partners to decide.
I cannot make statements about the specific situation at Sandd.
Over de specifieke situatie bij Sandd kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over ”de aanvulling op de WW-uitkering voor mensen die vierwekelijks worden uitbetaald”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unemployment benefit top-ups are disadvantaged for workers paid every four weeks, causing a missed December payment, and asked for a monthly-payment fix. The minister answered that the timing is not undesirable since higher December wages offset it, that a worked example shows four-weekly payees receive slightly more over the year, and that no change to employer reporting rules is planned.
It is therefore more favourable for the salary to be paid every four weeks rather than monthly.
Het is dus gunstiger dat het salaris per vier weken in plaats van per maand wordt betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de hoogte van de beltarieven bij UWV

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether UWV may charge callers more than the basic tariff, arguing that consumers calling traders may not be charged extra. The Minister answered that UWV is a public body, not a trader, so the consumer-rights rule does not apply, and declined to order UWV to change its phone tariffs, though UWV is examining a switch to a usage-only number.
UWV is currently examining the possibility of switching to a different type of telephone number, where only the usage tariff applies.
UWV onderzoekt echter op dit moment de mogelijkheid om over te stappen naar een ander type telefoonnummer, waarbij alleen het gebruikstarief wordt gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over achterblijvende lonen in Europa

MPs Van Dijk and Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the divergence between productivity and wage growth in Europe and the Netherlands, the fall in disposable income since 2008, rising living costs, and whether the government will act on wages. The minister acknowledged the falling labour share, explained differences between disposable income measures showing rising household income since 2008, noted modest inflation, and said wage policy is for social partners while he will raise available wage room with them.
As promised to the House during the SZW budget debate, I am drawing the available wage room to the attention of social partners.
Zoals aan de Kamer toegezegd tijdens de Begrotingsbehandeling van SZW, breng ik de loonruimte onder de aandacht bij sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht ’45 jaar werk is genoeg!’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government would accommodate the Bouw & Infra demand for a flexible AOW age linked to 45 years of work, and whether it would support wage increases of 5.35%. The minister rejected linking AOW to a 45-year work record as unworkable, citing lack of registration and the universal nature of AOW, and said wage policy is left to sectoral bargaining parties.
Linking the AOW age to a 45-year work record is not a feasible route and also runs counter to the character of the AOW.
Het koppelen van de AOW-leeftijd aan een arbeidsverleden van 45 jaar is geen begaanbare weg en staat ook haaks op het karakter van de AOW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent, Özdil en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat flexwerk verder oprukt, vooral onder jongeren

MPs Van Kent, Özdil and Van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that insecure contracts are spreading, especially among young people, and about the Wet arbeidsmarkt in balans. Minister Koolmees acknowledged the trend, said he shares concerns about its consequences for housing and family formation, and said the government will send the Wab bill to parliament in Q3 2018.
To tackle the growing divide on the labour market, I want to make it more attractive and less risky for employers to offer people a permanent contract.
Om de groeiende tweedeling op de arbeidsmarkt aan te pakken, wil ik het voor werkgevers aantrekkelijker en minder risicovol maken om mensen een vast contract aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het doorspelen van medische gegevens van personeel door Jumbo-supermarkten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Jumbo supermarkets' requests for employees' medical data, passed to an outside firm to claim wage subsidies, violate the rules and what action will stop it. The government answered that employers may not process such health data under the Wbp, that the franchisee acted without head-office approval and was warned, and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, not the Inspectie SZW, is competent and is aware of the case.
Since there is no violation under the Arbo Act, there is no ground for the Labour Inspectorate to enforce.
Er is, aangezien er geen overtreding is op basis van de Arbowet, geen grond voor de Inspectie SZW om te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over de risico’s van gespoten purschuim

MPs Beckerman and Van Kent asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that workers and a family became ill from sprayed PUR foam, and how responsibility and damages should be handled. The minister answered that employers and the installing firm are primarily responsible, victims can pursue civil claims, and the diagnostic protocol was co-funded by the sector, but declined to recognise damage and did not answer the question on the sector's influence in full detail, and refused to answer within 48 hours.
It is not for me to recognise damage.
Het is niet aan mij om schade te erkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over partnerschap

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why a child moving in with a parent can make the parent and child legal partners, cutting off childcare and health-related allowances, while inheritance tax treats children differently, and whether partner criteria across laws should be harmonised. The State Secretary defends the objective partner criteria in the AWR and tax/allowance laws, including the household rule for blood relatives in the first degree aged 27 or over, and says there is no need to harmonise partner definitions across social-security schemes.
As I indicated earlier, the basic partner concept also applies to gift and inheritance tax, and because of its specific nature a number of additional requirements apply.
Zoals ik hiervoor al heb aangegeven geldt het basispartnerbegrip ook in de schenk- en erfbelasting en is vanwege het specifieke karakter ervan een aantal aanvullende eisen gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over onderdelen in de Arbeidstijdenrichtlijn die niet in overeenstemming zijn met het verslag van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether the Dutch Working Time Act conflicts with the EU Working Time Directive and the Commission's implementation report, in particular the 16-week reference period for night work and the absence of special protection categories. The State Secretary disagreed with the Commission on the reference period, citing SER advice and a 2012 evaluation, and declined to amend the law for either point.
I do not share the European Commission's view.
Ik deel die mening van de Europese Commissie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de aanhoudende problemen met slapende dienstverbanden waardoor werknemers geen aanspraak kunnen maken op hun transitievergoeding

MP Van Kent asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employees whose employers keep their contracts dormant after long illness, blocking the transition payment, and about the timeline and effect of the controversial bill 34 699. The minister answered that UWV's implementation test is pending, a target effective date of 1 January 2020 is aimed for, and that he sees no reason to financially support workers who go to court.
I aim to have the measure take effect from 1 January 2020.
Ik streef ernaar om de maatregel met ingang van 1 januari 2020 in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Kent over de risico’s voor de volksgezondheid van gespoten purschuim

Two SP members asked the Ministers of Interior and of Social Affairs about health risks of sprayed polyurethane foam insulation, including whether residents are protected, whether certified firms follow the 2013 guidelines, and whether isocyanates are listed as substances of very high concern. The Minister replied that TNO and RPS studies did not establish causality but precautions were taken, that the Bouwbesluit 2012 will be amended to require residents to leave and forced ventilation, that a diagnostic protocol exists, and that the REACH restriction proposal is pending.
I therefore want to include this as a requirement in the Bouwbesluit 2012.
Ik wil dit daarom als eis opnemen in het Bouwbesluit 2012.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat het ministerie van SZW tegen de afspraken in nog altijd schoonmakers inhuurt via uitzendbureaus

An MP asked whether the Ministry of Social Affairs still hires cleaners through temp agencies despite agreements to bring them in-house, and whether a new tender for temporary cleaners at DJI breaches those agreements. The minister answered that the tender covers temporary workers for the Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie on all government buildings as a stopgap for absences, that cleaners are being transferred gradually as contracts expire, and declined to withdraw the tender.
Action is being taken in line with the agreements made.
Er wordt gehandeld in lijn met gemaakte afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman en Van Kent over het bericht dat de bouw zich niets aantrekt van de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether the construction sector ignores recommendations from the Dutch Safety Board (OVV) and how recurring recommendations on coordination, responsibility, safety awareness and risk assessment will be implemented. The minister acknowledges the problem, lists steps taken (guidelines, a Kwaliteitsborging bill, Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit changes, a study on a central party for site safety) and commits to further follow-up, though some recommendations remain unaddressed.
It is currently being examined how a single central party can be made responsible for safeguarding site safety at construction sites.
Er wordt momenteel nagegaan hoe één centrale partij verantwoordelijk kan worden gemaakt voor de borging van de omgevingsveiligheid bij bouwplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Van Kent over Sweatshop Schiphol

MPs Laçin and Van Kent asked about reports of precarious 'sweatshop' conditions at Schiphol, including rotating workers between contracts to avoid permanent employment, and the government's role. Minister Koolmees answered that such practices are undesirable but that employers are primarily responsible, pointed to planned contract-cost measures and existing research, and declined to take shareholder action or to answer in time for the committee debate.
I cannot make a statement about the situation at an individual company.
Over de situatie bij een individueel bedrijf kan ik geen uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Kent en Lacin over werklozen die bij de NS met levensgevaarlijke chroomverf moesten werken

Three SP MPs asked the ministers about unemployed Tilburg workers exposed to chromium-6 paint in an NS-linked re-integration project, including whether authorities intervened, whether victims get compensation, and whether a damages fund should be set up. The government said the Tilburg municipality remains ultimately responsible, an independent RIVM investigation is underway with results expected August 2018, and it will decide on compensation after that, while also tightening REACH and exposure rules.
I would first like to await the results of this investigation; these are expected at the end of August 2018.
Ik wil graag eerst de resultaten van dit onderzoek afwachten; deze worden eind augustus 2018 verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Özdil over het bericht dat werknemers met een tijdelijk contract er fors op achteruit gaan bij ziekte

MPs Van Kent and Özdil asked whether the planned removal of the labour tax credit and income-dependent combination credit for sick temporary workers, who lose their jobs and move to the Sickness Benefit Act, which can cost up to 3,000 euro net per year, was a deliberate choice that punishes illness. The minister replied that the measure aligns tax treatment with unemployed people on WW, applies from 1 January 2020 only to new cases, will be elaborated with the State Secretary of Finance, and will involve social partners.
The cabinet intends to abolish the labour tax credit and the IACK from 1 January 2020 for ZW beneficiaries who no longer have an employer.
Het kabinet is voornemens om de arbeidskorting en IACK per 1 januari 2020 af te schaffen voor ZW-gerechtigden die geen werkgever (meer) hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de uitzending van EenVandaag dat het opnieuw klachten regent over supermarktketen Aldi

An SP MP asked the minister about an EenVandaag report on high workload, pressure and intimidation at supermarket chain Aldi, and whether the Labour Inspectorate had been monitoring Aldi since its 2013 enforcement action. The state secretary answered that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate can investigate on complaints and found Aldi compliant after 2013-2014 action, and that no further sanctions or changes to the Inspectorate's approach are planned.
It is the responsibility of companies to comply with laws and regulations.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van bedrijven om zich aan wet- en regelgeving te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat maaltijdbezorger Deliveroo alle koeriers in loondienst gaat vervangen door (schijn)zelfstandigen

MP Van Kent asked the minister whether Deliveroo's replacement of employed couriers with (pseudo-)self-employed workers could be addressed, including the bargaining position of couriers, Inspectorate enforcement and the demands of the Riders Union. Minister Asscher answered that he has no insight into the couriers' bargaining position, that he does not comment on specific Inspectorate investigations, and that he finds collective organising by couriers a suitable means.
I do not make any statements about possible concrete investigations by the Inspectorate SZW.
Over eventuele concrete onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat met asbest besmet straalgrit gebruikt is door 140 bedrijven

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that asbestos-contaminated blasting grit from Eurogrit was used by about 140 firms, including questions on worker safety, exposure norms, and whether one national inspectorate should replace the fragmented oversight. The minister answered that inspectorates are investigating origin and exposure, applying the strictest risk class during cleanup, and cooperating, but declined to commit to merging inspectorates, arguing that merging does not automatically improve inspection.
Merging organisations does not by definition result in a better inspectorate.
Het samenvoegen van organisaties levert niet per definitie een betere inspectie op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de werkwijze van de commerciële arbodienst GOED

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the practices of commercial occupational health service GOED, including alleged use of doctors without specialist training, and whether the system is structurally flawed. The minister said the system functions adequately, incidents are handled within existing channels, certificates can be suspended, and eigenrisicodragerschap for sickness benefit should be kept.
I have no enforcement power over occupational health services if a person falsely presents themselves as an occupational physician.
Ik heb geen handhavende bevoegdheid bij arbodiensten indien een persoon zich ten onrechte uitgeeft voor bedrijfsarts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat maaltijdbezorger Deliveroo alle koeriers in loondienst gaat vervangen door (schijn)zelfstandigen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Deliveroo replacing employed couriers with (pseudo-)self-employed workers is acceptable, and about the resulting risks and enforcement gaps. The minister answered that individual status is for courts to decide, pointed to existing protections, and announced an independent gig-economy study due in spring 2018 plus minimum-wage and sham-arrangement measures.
It is for a judge, and not for me, to assess the facts and circumstances of an individual case and to rule on whether someone works under an employment contract or not.

Het is aan een rechter, en niet aan mij, om de feiten en omstandigheden van een individueel geval te beoordelen en een uitspraak te doen over de vragen of iemand werkzaam is in dienstbetrekking of niet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het rapport 'Eerder stoppen met werken voor zware beroepen'

MP Van Kent (SP) asked the state secretary about an EIB report proposing early retirement for heavy occupations, including the definition of such jobs, a 15-year work requirement, a cost estimate of 120 million euro, comparison with other EU states, and whether it is fair that low-educated workers with shorter life expectancy may retire earlier. The state secretary responded that the report does not find a workable definition or financing solution, that the cost depends on design, that education is not a suitable criterion and the AOW is a universal scheme, and that other countries use diverse sectoral arrangements.
Unfortunately I must conclude that with this report the 'egg of Columbus' has also not yet been found for this file.
Helaas moet ik concluderen dat met dit rapport ook het «ei van Columbus» nog niet is gevonden op dit dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Kent over "pensioen en zware beroepen".

SP MPs asked the state secretary for Social Affairs whether the rising pension age is unattainable for heavy-work occupations and why incapacity inflow among metal workers has doubled, and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that social partners are primarily responsible for sustainable employability, pointed to prevention and retraining initiatives and ESF support, said a separate heavy-occupations scheme proved unworkable, and attributed the rise in WIA inflow mainly to former unemployed people falling sick after the 2014 crisis.
Social partners are primarily responsible for working longer.
Sociale partners zijn primair aan zet bij langer doorwerken van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Leijten over het bericht 'Elke maand honderden euro’s minder pensioen door Belastingdienst'

SP MPs asked why about 61,000 pensioners living in the Netherlands would lose hundreds of euros net per month under the new Dutch-German tax treaty, whether earlier assurances that seniors would not be affected were correct, and whether those affected were adequately informed. The state secretary answered that the 2013 income calculations, based on 2012 figures, may no longer reflect the situation given later tax changes, that the €15,000 threshold is intentional to reduce administrative burdens, that no change to the treaty is planned, and that affected residents were informed through the 2016 tax return and online channels.
It is therefore quite possible that the situation of these pensioners differs from what could be inferred from the income calculations made at the time.
Het is daarom goed mogelijk dat de situatie van deze gepensioneerden anders is dan uit de destijds gemaakte inkomensberekeningen kon worden opgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat een zieke die zijn baan verliest niet ‘gestraft’ mag worden met een lagere WW-uitkering

An MP asked whether the minister would respond to a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that sick workers losing their jobs must not receive a lower WW unemployment benefit, and whether benefits wrongly calculated since 2015 would be compensated. The minister announced amended regulations and a one-off compensation scheme, but said UWV systems changes will take time and that corrections will be made only in specific cases the court identified.
At my request, UWV has informed me that it is examining from which date and in what way the new regulations can be applied to new WW benefit applications.

Het UWV heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat het de mogelijkheden onderzoekt met ingang van welke datum en op welke manier de nieuwe regelgeving kan worden toegepast op nieuwe aanvragen om WW-uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de gevolgen van betaaldata van de WW sinds 1 juli 2015

MP Van Kent asks whether the shift of WW unemployment benefit payments to monthly payment in arrears since July 2015 causes payment problems, and whether a choice between two payment options should be introduced. Minister Asscher replies he knows of no problem signals beyond advance requests, that advances are rare, and that he prefers keeping the existing system, explaining the drawbacks of the alternative option.

Based on information from UWV, apart from requests for advance payment, I am aware of no signals that people are getting into trouble because the WW benefit is only paid after the end of the month to which it relates.

Er zijn mij op basis van informatie van UWV, behoudens verzoeken om bevoorschotting, geen signalen bekend dat mensen in problemen komen doordat de WW-uitkering pas wordt betaald na afloop van de maand waarop deze betrekking heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de werkwijze van de commerciële arbodienst GOED

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a private occupational health service (GOED) that pressured sick employees, including breast cancer patients, to return to work and used non-physician 'employability experts'. The minister called the pressure unacceptable, explained the legal role of company doctors and certifying bodies, and reported that a Nivel study on task delegation is underway with legislative changes already made.
Pressuring sick people to return to work when it has not been established that they are able to do so is, in my view, not acceptable.
Het onder druk zetten van zieke mensen om weer aan het werk te gaan wanneer niet is vastgesteld dat zij daartoe in staat zijn, vind ik niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de derde monitor artsencapaciteit UWV

Deputy Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's third monitor on physician capacity: whether assessment quality suffers under workload, whether assessments are done by registered insurance physicians or delegated to trainees, the number and duration of delayed claim assessments, and whether Wajong re-assessments should stop until backlogs are cleared. The minister answered that UWV assures quality safeguards apply regardless of workload, registered physicians remain responsible, about 2,188 claim assessments were delayed in April 2017 (up from 1,535 in 2015), no advance-payment delays exist, and he refused to halt Wajong re-assessments.
UWV monitors whether it can carry out its task at the desired quality level and I follow this.
UWV monitort of het zijn taak op het gewenste kwaliteitsniveau uit kan voeren en ik volg dit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat stageplekken soms ‘verkapte werkplekken zijn, waar je geen cent voor krijgt’

MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked the ministers whether internships are sometimes disguised regular jobs without pay, how often complaints occur, whether complaints are reported to SBB and the Inspectorate, what the rules on allowances are, and whether a study or safeguards are needed. The minister answers that abuse occurs mainly after graduation, that a sector analysis is underway, that complaints are few and under-reported, that the Inspectorate handles individual reports but does not mediate them, and that no extra study of in-school internships is needed.
To better map the extent of internship abuse after graduation in problem sectors, the Minister of SZW is having a study carried out.
Om de omvang van stagemisbruik na afstuderen in probleemsectoren beter in beeld te brengen laat de Minister van SZW een onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over de uitzending van Tros Radar Extra over oudere werklozen die nauwelijks kans op een baan hebben

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers about a Tros Radar report on older unemployed people with very little chance of work, including low re-employment odds, income loss from short jobs, home-ownership and benefit rules, the job-search obligation, and basic income. The government said it is acting through the 50-plus action plan, that the re-employment chance is well above 3%, that asset rules allow municipal loans against a home, and that it is not pursuing basic income, while pointing to municipal experimentation powers.
The cabinet also considers unemployment among people over fifty to still be too high.
Het kabinet is eveneens van mening dat de werkloosheid onder vijftigplussers nog steeds te hoog is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de constructie van De Wit thuiszorgorganisatie

MPs Marijnissen and Van Kent asked about thuiszorgorganisatie De Wit employing 'zorg-au pairs' from Eastern Europe under Wlz care, inspection history, language requirements, pay and oversight. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate issued an aanwijzing after repeated non-compliance, that foreign care workers are allowed if qualified, that a WTZi reform bill is in preparation, and that topfunctionaris pay is not publicly disclosed because the organisation lacks a WTZi licence.
It is up to the institution itself whether and how it wants to be transparent about the pay of its top officials.
Het is aan de instelling zelf of en hoe zij transparant wil zijn over bezoldigingen van haar topfunctionarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Kent over de dreigende overname van AkzoNobel door PPG Industries

MPs Hijink and Van Kent asked whether activist investor Elliott's demand that the AkzoNobel supervisory board chair resign, and reported sharing of price-sensitive information with PPG, is realistic as serving the company's continuity and how the government views this conduct. The minister answered that the matter falls under the Dutch corporate law framework (shareholder meetings, 10% and 3% thresholds, Code response times), declined to confirm the information-sharing allegation because the AFM is responsible and bound by confidentiality, and stated that shareholders may pursue their interests within bounds of reasonableness, with greater responsibility for larger stakes.
Because of the confidentiality obligation resting on the AFM, no statements can be made about this.
Vanwege de op de AFM rustende geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen hierover geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Kent over de dreigende overname van AkzoNobel door PPG Industries

MPs Hijink and Van Kent asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a possible hostile takeover of AkzoNobel by PPG, the role of the AkzoNobel foundation, competition and job effects, works council protections, and whether the Wet ongewenste zeggenschap telecommunicatie could protect firms of national importance. The minister answered that boards must weigh stakeholder interests, that the priority-share foundation can appoint management in a hostile bid, that competition authorities would review any merger, and that the telecom bill covers only national security and public order, not jobs or headquarters.
It is not possible to state the consequences of a possible split for employment; this depends heavily on what the parties involved agree.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gevolgen van een eventuele splitsing op de werkgelegenheid te geven, dit is sterk afhankelijk van wat de betrokken partijen afspreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over werknemersbelangen bij flitsfaillissementen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked how the government will protect employee interests in 'flash bankruptcies' (pre-pack restructurings), in light of an Advocate-General's opinion on the EU Business Transfer Directive and the Estro case. The minister answered that the opinion is non-binding, the CJEU ruling is awaited, the matter will be discussed with social partners in the WCO III preparations, and he will report back in a summer progress letter.

I am certainly willing to keep your House informed and propose that I will update you in the next progress letter on the bankruptcy law recalibration programme, due in the summer, on the state of affairs.

Ik ben zeker bereid uw Kamer op de hoogte te houden en stel voor dat ik u in de eerst volgende voortgangsbrief in het kader van het programma herijking van het faillissementsrecht die in de zomer zal uitkomen, in zal lichten over de stand van zaken.

m: Motie Heerts c.s. over versterking van de goede eigenschappen van de kantonrechtspraak
Asks the government, in reorganising court locations, to strengthen the qualities of cantonal justice such as speed and accessibility.
requests the government, in further developing the revision of the judicial map, to give attention to strengthening the good qualities of cantonal justice
verzoekt de regering bij de verdere uitwerking van de herziening van de gerechtelijke kaart aandacht te besteden aan de versterking van de goede eigenschappen van de kantonrechtspraak
Motie Van Vroonhoven/Heerts over het opzetten van een deugdelijk toezichtsysteem
Asks the government to help set up a sound supervision system for the quality of legal advisers working for insurers and trade unions.
requests the government to play a role in setting up a sound supervision system that ensures the quality of services by litigating legal advisers
verzoekt de regering een rol te spelen bij het opzetten van een deugdelijk toezichtsysteem dat de kwaliteit van diensten door procederende juridische adviseurs borgt
Motie Van Vroonhoven-Kok/Heerts over informele geschilbeslechting
Asks the government to develop a light cantonal court system where judges act as arbiters deciding cases by binding advice.
to develop a light cantonal court system in which the cantonal judge can act as an arbiter
een systeem van een «kantonrechtspraak light» uit te werken, waarbij aan de kantonrechter de mogelijkheid wordt geboden, als een arbiter op te treden
Motie Heerts c.s. over onderzoek naar het instrument verkennend onderzoek
Asks the government to study and propose how the preliminary criminal investigation phase can be made a more usable tool, including for seizing unlawfully obtained assets.
calls on the government to examine how the preliminary investigation in the Code of Criminal Procedure can become a more usable investigative instrument.
roept de regering op te onderzoeken hoe het verkennend onderzoek in het Wetboek van Strafvordering een meer bruikbaar onderzoeksinstrument kan worden
Motie Heerts c.s. over voorstellen voor conservatoir beslag op betaalde borgsommen
Asks the government to propose measures allowing conservatory seizure of bail sums already paid, to secure future fines, confiscation or victim compensation.
calls on the government to come with proposals that contribute to conservatory seizure being easily possible on imposed bail sums after payment
roept de regering op te komen met voorstellen die ertoe bijdragen dat op opgelegde borgsommen na betaling eenvoudig conservatoir beslag gelegd kan worden
Motie Heerts c.s. over onderzoek naar het afromen van wederrechtelijk verkregen vermogen
Asks the government to investigate how much money the tax authority actually skims from illegally obtained wealth and send the findings to the House.
requests the government to investigate how much money the tax authority can skim from wealth regarded as illegally obtained and send this research to the House
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoeveel geld de fiscus weet af te romen van vermogen dat als wederrechtelijk verkregen gezien kan worden en dit onderzoek aan de Kamer te zenden
Motie Van Vroonhoven-Kok en Heerts over betalen van proceskosten door de partij die mediation geweigerd heeft
Asks the government to develop a proposal letting judges order a party that refused mediation to pay court costs.
requests the government to develop a proposal giving the judge the possibility to order a party that refused mediation to pay the procedural costs
verzoekt de regering een voorstel uit te werken dat erop ziet, de rechter de mogelijkheid te geven, een partij die mediation geweigerd heeft in de proceskosten te veroordelen
Motie Gerkens c.s. over de landelijk coördinator georganiseerde en financieel-economische criminaliteit
Asks the government to give the national coordinator for organised and financial-economic crime binding authority to enforce solutions rather than only discuss them.
requests the government to ensure the national coordinator for organised and financial-economic crime receives sufficient powers to bring about solutions and push through

verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat de landelijk coördinator georganiseerde en financieel-economische criminaliteit voldoende bevoegdheden krijgt om oplossingen te bewerkstelligen en door te pakken
Motie Anker en Heerts over het legestarief
Asks the government to introduce a family tariff for the fee for a regular residence permit for an indefinite period, after the fee doubles, and to inform the House.
requests the government, when raising the fee for a regular residence permit for an indefinite period, to provide a family tariff and inform the House about it

verzoekt de regering om bij de verhoging van het legestarief voor de afdoening van een aanvraag tot het verlenen van een verblijfsvergunning regulier voor onbepaalde tijd te voorzien in een gezinstarief en de Kamer hierover te informeren
Motie Azough c.s. over collectieve schadevergoedingsmogelijkheden
Asks the government to investigate how consumer groups can bring collective damages claims under current law and how to improve these possibilities.
requests the government to investigate how groups of consumers with the same experiences can bring collective damages actions under current law
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken hoe groepen consumenten met dezelfde ervaringen collectieve schadevergoedingsacties onder huidig recht kunnen ondernemen
Motie Azough c.s. over een consistent communicatiebeleid
Motion asking the government for a plan to professionalise consistent communication by the Public Prosecution Service and judiciary, with readable verdicts.
requests the government to provide in the short term an action plan
verzoekt de regering om op korte termijn te voorzien in een plan van aanpak
Motie Van Hijum c.s. over verruiming van het "onmisbaarheidscriterium" en/of de toepassing daarvan
Asks the government to widen the 'indispensability criterion' in redundancy dismissals so employers can retain essential knowledge and competences, after consulting social partners.
requests the government to make it possible to take employees' knowledge and competences into account when dismissing
verzoekt de regering het mogelijk te maken om bij ontslag rekening te houden met de kennis en competenties van werknemers
Motie Heerts en Teeven over een landelijk projectteam lading- en winkeldiefstal bij de politie
Asks the government to set up a national police project team, a specialised public prosecutor and a specialised judge for cargo and shop theft.
requests the government to come with proposals leading to a national police project team on cargo and shop theft
verzoekt de regering om te komen met voorstellen die moeten leiden tot een landelijk projectteam lading- en winkeldiefstal bij de politie
Motie Heerts c.s. over arbeid en onderwijs in detentie
Asks the government to inform the Chamber how education and work in detention can be introduced on a cost-covering basis and what role employers could play.
requests the government to inform the Chamber on how sufficient education and work in detention (cost-covering) can be introduced
verzoekt de regering de Kamer te informeren op welke manier er voldoende onderwijs en arbeid in detentie (kostendekkend) kunnen worden ingevoerd
Motie Anker c.s. over uitbreiding van het FF Kappe-project
Asks the government to extend the FF Kappe youth project to other municipalities and to send the parliament the timetable for harmonising behaviour-influencing measures.
also requests the government to submit to the House the timetable for harmonising all behaviour-influencing measures before 1 May 2009
verzoekt de regering tevens het tijdpad met betrekking tot de stroomlijning van alle gedragsbeïnvloedende maatregelen voor 1 mei 2009 aan de Kamer te overleggen
Amendement van het lid Joldersma c.s. om de taakstelling voor Slachtofferhulp voor het jaar 2009 ongedaan te maken
Amendment reverses the 2009 budget cut (taakstelling) for Slachtofferhulp Nederland, the victim support organisation, and asks to end the cut in multi-year projections.
This amendment aims to reverse the budget cut for Slachtofferhulp for the year 2009.
Dit amendement wil de taakstelling voor Slachtofferhulp voor het jaar 2009 ongedaan maken.
qa: Vragen van de leden Heerts, Eijsink (beiden PvdA) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Defensie over de rol van Nederlandse militairen bij een actie op 7 augustus 2002 (ingezonden 12 april 2010).

MPs Heerts, Eijsink and Peters asked the Justice and Defence ministers about the role of Dutch soldiers in a 7 August 2002 shooting incident in Afghanistan, including reporting procedures, the OM investigation, KCT involvement, and access to the full dossier. The government answered that reporting went to the ISAF command, that the OM investigated Dutch involvement, that KCT units were not involved in the incident, and that only partial, anonymised documents could be released due to classification and identifiability.
The documents mentioned under 5 and 6 cannot be made public due to their classification.
De onder 5 en 6 genoemde documenten kunnen vanwege de rubricering niet openbaar worden gemaakt.

Vragen van de leden Heerts en Van der Veen (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over het artikel «Medische missers slecht vergoed» (ingezonden 16 april 2010).

MPs Heerts and Van der Veen asked the Justice and Health ministers whether insurers slow down settlement of medical malpractice claims, whether the complaints committee for care institutions is adequate, and whether professional parties focus too much on euros. The minister acknowledges slow settlement at times, points to the voluntary code on medical liability (GMA) and the planned Wet Cliëntenrechten Zorg with a binding complaints body capped at 25,000 euro (initially 10,000 euro).
A component of the Wcz is that all care providers are obliged to join a dispute body.
Een onderdeel van de Wcz is dat alle zorgaanbieders verplicht worden zich bij een geschilleninstantie aan te sluiten.
Vragen van de leden Arib en Heerts (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Justitie over het verlenen van verlof aan pooierboy M. O. (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

Two Labour MPs asked the Justice Minister why pimp-boyfriend M.O. (a suspected trafficker of minors) was granted temporary release from pre-trial detention, whether victims were informed, and about planned changes to Article 80 Sv limiting judges' discretion. The minister explained the court suspension, the notification of victims (most informed by letter or phone around 28 April), and that the proposed law change would have shifted such leave decisions to the prison director.
The Amsterdam Court of Appeal ordered the suspension of pre-trial detention from 26 April 2010 until the next hearing on 16 July 2010.
Het gerechtshof te Amsterdam heeft met ingang van 26 april 2010 de schorsing van de voorlopige hechtenis gelast tot de volgende zitting op 16 juli 2010

m: Motie van het lid Mutluer c.s. over uitspreken dat de Kamer onder bepaalde voorwaarden instemt met decharge voor de jaarverantwoording 2024 van JenV

Conditionally agrees to discharge (decharge) of the Ministry of Justice and Security's 2024 accountability report, conditional on concrete plans in the 2026 budget on case throughput information, implementation tests, victims' information, and correcting errors.
declares that the House agrees to discharge the 2024 accountability report of the Ministry of Justice and Security, on condition that
spreekt uit dat de Kamer instemt met decharge voor de jaarverantwoording 2024 van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, onder de voorwaarde
Motie van de leden Aardema en Boswijk over onderzoek naar de mogelijkheden om de procedures voor boa's op het gebied van ID-check en kentekenregister te vergemakkelijken
Asks the government to examine ways to ease enforcement procedures for municipal enforcement officers (boa's) on ID checks and the vehicle registry.
requests the government to examine whether there are possibilities to ease these procedures
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of er toch mogelijkheden zijn om deze procedures te vergemakkelijken
Motie van het lid Aardema over bewerkstelligen dat werkgevers en werknemers op korte termijn weer gaan overleggen over de Regeling Vervroegde Uittreding voor politiepersoneel
Asks the government to get employers and employee unions talking again soon about extending the early retirement scheme for police personnel.
requests the government to ensure that employers and employees resume negotiations in the short term
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat werkgevers en werknemers op korte termijn weer gaan overleggen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smitskam en Aardema over het bericht ‘Aanpak winkeldieven stokt door gebrekkige medewerking van politie’

MPs Smitskam and Aardema asked whether police will again promptly provide suspects' identity details to shopkeepers so they can claim damages, and what will be done about the reported drop in such disclosures and the possible effect of not prosecuting minor theft. The minister answered that the ministry is mapping bottlenecks with police and business, that police acknowledge fewer disclosures and are working to restore them, and that a national framework will be updated, but declined to pre-empt the outcomes of ongoing talks on the other questions.
The police acknowledges that there has been a decline in the number of disclosures in cases of shoplifting and is trying to restore this in consultation with the parties involved.
De politie erkent dat er sprake is van een terugval in het aantal verstrekkingen bij winkeldiefstal en probeert dit te herstellen in overleg met betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Mutluer, Michon-Derkzen, Van Nispen en Aardema over het bericht ‘Politiehack van 62.000 medewerkers is gevaarlijk: naam agent is handelswaar’

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police data breach exposing contact details of about 62,000 officers, including timing of notification, risks to officers and families, and safeguards against similar leaks. The minister answered that work contact details and occasionally private contact details were exposed, that a pass-the-cookie attack by likely state actors was used, that notification was delayed in part, and that measures are being taken but investigations are ongoing and the wider lessons for government systems are limited.
In the interest of the ongoing investigations, I cannot say anything about that.
In het belang van de lopende onderzoeken kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aardema en Faber-van de Klashorst  over het politieoptreden bij de Pro Palestina demonstratie in Amsterdam van week 19

MPs Aardema and Faber-van de Klashorst asked the Minister of Justice and Security why police did not intervene promptly at the Pro-Palestine demonstration in Amsterdam in week 19, covering masked protesters, violence, the length of the occupation, arrests, costs, intelligence investigation and funding. The minister answered most questions by referring to the Amsterdam mayor's letter to the municipal council, stating that the public order responsibility lies with local authorities, and gave substantive answers only on intelligence limits and on the Wtmo transparency bill.
Responsibility for facilitating and protecting the right to demonstrate rests with local authorities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het faciliteren en beschermen van het demonstratierecht is belegd bij het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aardema over de leegloop bij de recherche

An MP asked the Justice Minister about staff shortages and outflow in the criminal investigation (recherche) branch of the police, including training and lateral-entry routes. The minister confirmed the shortage, described training and intake options, and pointed to the police labour market strategy and past capacity increases.
At present we are dealing with understaffing in investigation, so those choices must be sharpened.
Op dit moment hebben we te maken met onderbezetting in de opsporing, waardoor die keuzes scherp gemaakt moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Aardema over pro-Palestina demonstratie plaats in Amsterdam

MPs Faber-van de Klashorst and Aardema asked whether the government would prosecute or act against a GroenLinks politician who displayed the slogan 'viva viva INTIFADA' at a pro-Palestinian demonstration in Amsterdam. The Minister said the slogan is condemnable, that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, that police did not notice it during the event, and that no complaint or criminal investigation has been started.

Assessing whether a criminal offence may have occurred in an individual case is primarily the responsibility of the Public Prosecution Service and, if the case is brought before the court, ultimately reserved for the judge.

De beoordeling of er mogelijk sprake is van een strafbaar feit in een individueel geval is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Ministerie en – mits de zaak wordt aangebracht bij de rechtbank – uiteindelijk is die beoordeling voorbehouden aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema, Claassen, Faber-van de Klashorst en Aardema over het toenemend geweld tegen zorgverleners

PVV MPs asked the health and justice ministers about rising violence against care workers, including reporting of assaults, sentencing, protective equipment costs, a ban on community sentences, mandatory anti-aggression courses and refusing treatment of violent patients. The minister answered at length, citing ongoing consultations, regional meetings and a pending sentencing study, while declining to give several figures or a cost overview.
No, I do not have an overview of this at my disposal.
Nee, ik heb hier geen overzicht van tot mijn beschikking.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 12 over facultatieve bindende correctieve referenda voor provincies en gemeenten
