Lets provinces and municipalities decide by their own ordinance whether their decisions are subject to a binding corrective referendum, removing the national law's power to exempt certain local decisions.
This amendment deletes in this context the possibility that the law may determine that binding referenda cannot be held on certain decentralised decisions
Dit amendement schrapt in dit kader de mogelijkheid dat bij wet kan worden bepaald dat over bepaalde decentrale besluiten geen bindende referenda mogelijk kunnen worden gemaakt
Amendement van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over het schrappen van de bepaling over provincies en gemeenten
Deletes the provision that would have imposed a binding corrective referendum on municipal and provincial decisions, leaving subnational governments free to decide whether to hold referendums.

Unilaterally introducing by constitution a binding corrective referendum on decisions of municipalities and provinces, as the national government, conflicts with the autonomy of municipalities and provinces.
Het bij Grondwet als rijksoverheid eenzijdig invoeren van een bindend correctief referendum over besluiten van gemeenten en provincies is in strijd met de autonomie van gemeenten en provincies.
Amendement van het lid Van Gent over het nog meer in lijn brengen van het wetsvoorstel met een passage van het regeerakkoord over de bedenktijd
Adds a clause so the Dutch cooling-off period for listed companies must be lifted by the court if similar protective measures are active and not ended after a written request.
This amendment aims to align the bill better with this text, so that an unreasonable accumulation of protective measures is legally prevented.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe het wetsvoorstel beter te laten aansluiten bij deze tekst, zodat een onredelijke stapeling van beschermingsmaatregelen wettelijk wordt tegengegaan.
Motie van het lid Ziengs c.s. over uitvoering geven aan de motie-Ziengs/Van der Molen over de aanwezigheid van Kamerleden bij officiële herdenkingen
Asks the Presidium of the House to finally implement the earlier motion on MPs attending official commemorations on behalf of the House.
requests the Presidium to implement the motion after all
verzoekt het presidium, alsnog uitvoering te geven aan de motie
Motie van de leden Ziengs en Van Gent over een herdenkingenregister
Asks the Presidium, with the National Committee for 4 and 5 May, to create a commemorations register and designate the staff adviser on protocol as central contact point for MPs and organisers.
requests the Presidium, in consultation with the National Committee 4 and 5 May, to arrive at a commemorations register
verzoekt het presidium, om in overleg met het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei te komen tot een herdenkingenregister
Motie van de leden Van Dam en Van Gent over hanteerbaar maken van de WHOA voor mkb'ers
Asks the government to draw up a plan for knowledge sharing on the WHOA insolvency-settlement law so SMEs can use it more easily, and to inform the House.
requests the government, as soon as possible after this law enters into force, to draw up a plan for knowledge sharing about the WHOA
verzoekt de regering, zo spoedig mogelijk na inwerkingtreding van deze wet een plan op te stellen voor kennisuitwisseling over de WHOA
Amendement van de leden Van Gent en Van Dam over een evaluatie binnen 3 jaar
Requires the Minister for Legal Protection to send Parliament an evaluation of the effectiveness and effects of the out-of-court homologation act within three years.
Our Minister for Legal Protection sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within three years of its entry into force.
Onze Minister voor Rechtsbescherming zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Amendement van de leden Van Gent en Van Dam over meervoudig stemrecht voor alle rechtsvormen
Allows articles of association of all legal forms to grant a named or functional board member or supervisory director more than one vote, up to the combined votes of the others.
The articles of association may provide that a named or functionally designated board member is given more than one vote.
De statuten kunnen bepalen dat een met name of in functie aangeduide bestuurder meer dan één stem wordt toegekend.
Amendement van de leden Van Gent en Van Dam over belet- en ontstentenisregeling voor alle rechtsvormen
Requires articles of association of associations, cooperatives, mutual insurers and foundations to provide for replacement of all board or supervisory members, aligning with the NV and BV rules.
The articles of association shall contain rules on how the tasks and powers are provisionally provided for in case of absence or incapacity of all directors.
De statuten bevatten voorschriften omtrent de wijze waarop in de uitoefening van de taken en bevoegdheden voorlopig wordt voorzien in geval van ontstentenis of belet van alle bestuurders.
Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. over extra middelen voor fractieondersteuning
Amendment raising parliamentary budgets by about 10 million euro for party group support in both chambers, structurally.
to create more room for support to the parliamentary groups
om zo meer ruimte te scheppen voor ondersteuning van de fracties
Amendement van de leden Van Gent en Van Dam over een evaluatiebepaling
Adds a clause requiring the Minister for Legal Protection to report to the States General within five years on the effectiveness of the Wet bestuur en toezicht rechtspersonen.
Within five years of entry into force, the Minister for Legal Protection sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this act in practice.

Onze Minister voor Rechtsbescherming zendt binnen vijf jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de Wet bestuur en toezicht rechtspersonen aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk

Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Gent en Snels ter vervanging van nr. 18 over besluiten inzake het bezoldigingsbeleid met drie vierden van de uitgebrachte stemmen tenzij de statuten een kle
Amendment requires a three-quarters majority of votes cast at the shareholder meeting to adopt remuneration policy, unless the articles set a lower majority.
For a decision adopting the remuneration policy, a majority of at least three quarters of the votes cast is required
Voor een besluit tot vaststelling van het bezoldigingsbeleid is een meerderheid van ten minste drie vierden van de uitgebrachte stemmen vereist

Amendement van de leden Van Gent en Sneller ter vervanging van nr. 9 over het laten vervallen van de uitzondering voor kleine en middelgrote beursvennootschappen om het bezoldigingsverslag ter adviser
Amendment removes the exemption for small and medium listed companies so their remuneration report is put to an advisory shareholder vote.
in article 135b the third paragraph lapses
vervalt in artikel 135b het derde lid

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Gent ter vervanging van nr. 8  over besluiten inzake het bezoldigingsbeleid met drie vierden van de uitgebrachte stemmen tenzij de statuten een kleinere meerderhei
Requires a three-quarters majority of votes cast at the general meeting to adopt remuneration policy unless the articles set a lower majority.
A decision to adopt the remuneration policy requires a majority of at least three quarters of the votes cast.
Voor een besluit tot vaststelling van het bezoldigingsbeleid is een meerderheid van ten minste drie vierden van de uitgebrachte stemmen vereist

Amendement van het lid Van Gent over het laten vervallen van de uitzondering voor kleine en middelgrote beursvennootschappen om het bezoldigingsverslag ter adviserende stemming aan de algemene vergade
Removes the exemption that lets small and medium-sized listed companies skip an advisory shareholder vote on the remuneration report.
In article I, part D, paragraph 3 of article 135b is deleted.
In artikel I, onderdeel D, vervalt in artikel 135b het derde lid.
Amendement van het lid Van Gent over besluiten inzake het bezoldigingsbeleid met drie vierden van de uitgebrachte stemmen tenzij de statuten een volstrekte meerderheid toelaten
Requires a three-quarters majority of votes cast at shareholder meetings to adopt remuneration policy unless the articles allow an absolute majority.
A decision to adopt the remuneration policy requires at least three-quarters of votes cast
Voor een besluit tot vaststelling van het bezoldigingsbeleid is een meerderheid van ten minste drie vierden van de uitgebrachte stemmen vereist
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van Gent en Van der Staaij ter vervanging van nr. 16 over een opt-in in bepaalde gevallen
Amends the collective action rules so a court may order class members to declare in advance that they will be bound by a settlement reached during the proceedings.
The court may only give this order if sufficient insight exists into the basis of a settlement to be reached
De rechter kan dit bevel alleen geven, indien: a. voldoende zicht bestaat op de uitgangspunten van een te bereiken overeenkomst
Amendement van het lid Van Gent c.s. over versterking van de ontvankelijkheidseisen voor bepaalde vorderingen
Tightens admissibility requirements for ideal-purpose collective damages claims so they must meet the representativeness and Dutch-link conditions too.
Therefore the submitters propose that ideal-purpose claims must also meet the above requirements, just like all other claims
Daarom stellen de indieners met dit amendement voor dat ideële vorderingen ook aan bovenstaande vereisten moeten voldoen, net zoals alle overige vorderingen.
Amendement van het lid Van Gent c.s. over geen schadevergoeding in geld bij bepaalde rechtsvorderingen
Amendment to the class action damages act to bar monetary damages in claims brought by ideal-purpose organisations with very limited financial interest.
When applying this paragraph, the legal claim cannot be aimed at monetary damages.
Bij toepassing van dit lid kan de rechtsvordering niet strekken tot schadevergoeding in geld.
Amendement van de leden Van Gent en Van der Staaij over een opt-in in bepaalde gevallen
Amendment to collective action law lets courts order class members to opt in in advance to a settlement under defined conditions.
The judge may only give this order if sufficient insight exists into the principles of the settlement
De rechter kan dit bevel alleen geven, indien: a. voldoende zicht bestaat
Amendement van het lid Van Gent c.s. over aanscherping van de vereiste nauwe band met de Nederlandse rechtssfeer
Requires that, beyond a connection through the defendant's Dutch establishment, additional circumstances show sufficient ties to the Dutch legal sphere for mass damage claims.
and additional circumstances point to sufficient connection with the Dutch legal sphere
en bijkomende omstandigheden wijzen op voldoende verbondenheid met de Nederlandse rechtssfeer
Amendement van het lid Van Gent c.s. over verbetering van het overgangsrecht
Changes transitional law for collective damages claims so the new regime applies only to events on or after 15 November 2016.
this amendment therefore provides that a claim under the new law is only possible if the damage-causing event took place on or after 15 November 2016
daarom regelt dit amendement dat een rechtsvordering op grond van het nieuwe recht slechts mogelijk is als de schadeveroorzakende gebeurtenis heeft plaatsgevonden op of na 15 november 2016
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Gent ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het invoeren van het familiaal verschoningsrecht
Introduces a family testimony privilege allowing persons not to provide information to a parliamentary inquiry committee if it would expose close relatives to criminal conviction.
No one is obliged to provide information to the committee, insofar as they would thereby expose a blood or family relative in the direct line to the danger of criminal conviction
Niemand is verplicht informatie aan de commissie te verstrekken, voor zover hij daardoor een bloed- of aanverwant in de rechte lijn
Amendement van het lid Van Gent over het invoeren van het familiaal verschoningsrecht
Adds a family testimonial privilege to the parliamentary inquiry act so that no one must provide information that would expose a close relative to criminal conviction.
No one is obliged to provide information to the committee insofar as it would expose a blood or family relative in the direct line to criminal conviction
Niemand is verplicht informatie aan de commissie te verstrekken, voor zover hij daardoor een bloed- of aanverwant in de rechte lijn
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Zoektocht naar 70 duizend extra stembureau leden: veel meer mensen nodig dan normaal' in de uitzending van WNL op maandag 30 november 2020

MPs Smals and Van Gent asked the ministers how they would address a shortage of about 70,000 polling station workers for the March 2021 elections, including whether vocational (mbo) students could fill roles, as an alternative to internships. The minister confirmed the proposals are being explored with the MBO council, VNG and other partners, and promised a January survey of municipalities and a possible regional or national reserve pool.
To get a good picture of the situation regarding the number of required polling station members, I will hold a survey among municipalities in early January.
Om een goed beeld te krijgen van de stand van zaken rond het aantal benodigde stembureauleden houd ik begin januari een peiling onder de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent, Middendorp en Van der Molen over het nieuws dat de uitslag van de Tweede Kamerverkiezingen kwetsbaar is voor hackers

MPs Van Gent, Middendorp and Van der Molen asked the Minister of the Interior whether election results are vulnerable to hacking through the counting software, whether manual checks exist, and whether publication of polling station reports is timely. The minister answered only by referring to a separate reaction to a report from the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen, so none of the seven questions were answered on substance.
For answering these questions I refer to my response to the report of the foundation Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen.
Voor de beantwoording van deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn reactie op het rapport van de stichting Tegen Hackbare Verkiezingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Van Gent over Demonstratie tegen omstreden pedopartij

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Van Gent asked whether the Dutch party PVND, seen as a successor to the banned Martijn association, should be banned, whether it violates children's rights, and whether convicted offenders could be stripped of passive voting rights. The Minister of Justice answered that the OM is investigating and will not comment on ongoing inquiries, that deprivation of voting rights is only possible as a court-imposed sanction for serious offences against the state, and that a Political Parties Act is in preparation.
The Public Prosecution Service is conducting an investigation. No statements are made about ongoing investigations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doet onderzoek. Over lopende onderzoeken worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Wiersma over het voorstel van een aantal hoogleraren voor een wijziging van de Auteurswet ten behoeve van online clasroom use

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a proposal by 24 professors to extend the copyright classroom-use exemption (art. 12(5) Auteurswet) to online teaching. The minister agreed to clarify the law, including via an amendment to the implementing bill, and said a private-education point is constrained by EU Directive limits on commercial use.

I will therefore clarify this in the law, even though I have (fortunately) not yet received word that rights holders have raised obstacles to providing distance education, with or without presentations.

Ik zal dit daarom in de wet verduidelijken, ook al heeft mij (gelukkig) nog niet het bericht bereikt dat rechthebbenden tegen het verzorgen van onderwijs op afstand al dan niet ondersteund door presentaties drempels zouden hebben opgeworpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Middendorp 'Zit u op LinkedIn? Dan gooit Lusha uw privénummer mogelijk op straat'

MPs Van Gent and Middendorp asked whether the data-protection regulator had investigated the service Lusha, which may expose private phone numbers scraped from LinkedIn, whether its practices comply with the GDPR and Dutch implementing law, and how the regulator can act against non-EU providers. The minister answered that the Dutch Data Protection Authority is independent and does not comment on possible investigations, explained the legal bases and territorial scope of the GDPR, and said the GDPR's technology-neutral framework will be reviewed, while declining to add this case to the evaluation.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) would be the body that could conduct this investigation.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) zou de instantie zijn, die dit onderzoek zou kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Voetbaltv daagt privacywaakhond AP voor de rechter om uitblijven besluit’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about the Dutch privacy regulator AP taking VoetbalTV to court over its failure to issue a decision, and about inconsistent GDPR enforcement across EU states. The minister answered that the AP acts independently, that consistency is pursued via the EDPB, that a decision is now before the court so the AP cannot comment on its content, and that the matter will be raised with the AP after the summer recess.
Under Article 52 of the GDPR, each supervisory authority acts with complete independence in performing its tasks and exercising its powers under the regulation.

Op grond van artikel 52 van de AVG treedt elke toezichthoudende autoriteit volledig onafhankelijk op bij de uitvoering van de taken en de uitoefening van de bevoegdheden die haar overeenkomstig deze verordening zijn toegewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Bosch en Van Gent over het stemmen per volmacht

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Interior about proxy voting, including reports of vote fraud linked to paid proxy cards, higher proxy shares in some polling stations, and OSCE criticism. The Minister answered that in-person voting is preferred, that early voting experiments are currently not affordable, that the Public Prosecution Service investigates signals of canvassing, and that the government plans to restrict the proxy scheme in the Caribbean Netherlands before 2023.

In the evaluation of the 2019 elections I informed the House that, due to recurring objections from executive boards, island councils and international observers, I will prepare a bill ahead of the 2023 island council elections restricting the proxy voting scheme in the Caribbean Netherlands.

In de evaluatie van de verkiezingen van 2019 heb ik uw Kamer laten weten dat ik, vanwege terugkerende bezwaren van bestuurscolleges, eilandsraden en internationale waarnemers, een wetsvoorstel ga voorbereiden in aanloop naar de eilandsraadsverkiezingen in 2023, waarmee de volmachtregeling in Caribisch Nederland wordt beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Gent over het bericht dat grote stukken strand op Walcheren zijn weggeslagen door storm Ciara

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reported beach erosion on Walcheren after storm Ciara, the damage assessment, and why sand nourishment at Dishoek was delayed, including whether the nitrogen (PAS) ruling affected it. The minister answered that only a small stretch needed urgent action, that an accelerated sand nourishment at Dishoek is being prepared for completion before autumn 2020, that talks with the province and municipalities are ongoing, and that the PAS ruling delayed the nourishment programme.

At present an accelerated sand nourishment is being prepared for the Dishoek location on Walcheren for reasons of water safety, planned to be completed before the start of the autumn 2020 storm season.

Op dit moment wordt voor de locatie Dishoek op Walcheren omwille van de waterveiligheid een versnelde zandsuppletie voorbereid, die gepland is om voor de aanvang van het stormseizoen najaar 2020 gereed te zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het bericht ‘KNLTB in beroep tegen uitspraak AP’ en ‘Boete voor tennisbond vanwege verkoop van persoonsgegevens’

MPs Heerema and Van Gent asked the ministers about the Dutch data protection authority's fine on the KNLTB tennis federation for selling personal data and its interpretation of 'legitimate interest' under the GDPR, including whether the fine was proportionate and why no alternative intervention was used. The minister answered that the GDPR is binding EU law, that the AP acts independently and cannot be instructed, that the KNLTB's appeal is pending so details cannot be given, and that the sports sector will draft new guidelines by mid-2020.
It is for the AP to impose a proportionate sanction; it makes its own independent assessment in this.
Het is aan de AP om een proportionele sanctie op te leggen, zij maakt hierin onafhankelijk haar eigen afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over een mogelijk cookiewall-verbod

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a possible ban on cookiewalls, how freely given consent works under the GDPR and Telecommunications Act, the roles of the Dutch data protection authority (AP) and competition authority (ACM), and the state of EU negotiations. The minister answered that consent must be genuinely free, that the Netherlands supports a cookiewall ban in the EU ePrivacy regulation, and that the Council is unlikely to adopt it, while the enforcement and EU details are largely left to the AP and to the negotiations.
It is for the supervisory authority, in this case the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), and ultimately for the court, to interpret what this means in a specific case.
Het is aan de toezichthouder, in casu de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (hierna: AP), en uiteindelijk aan de rechter, om duiden wat dit in een concreet geval betekent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Middendorp over de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens

MPs Van Gent and Middendorp asked whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) gives unclear guidance, particularly on cookies, and whether an external review should address its advisory role. The minister replied that the AP offers general and specific guidance, that cookiewalls are not permitted under the GDPR consent rules, and that the planned external review focuses mainly on the AP's financing, with guidance being one of its statutory tasks.
That is why it is possible for organisations and their data protection officers to submit specific questions to the AP in addition to general guidance.
Daarom is het voor organisaties en hun functionarissen gegevensbescherming (FG's) mogelijk, om naast algemene voorlichting, ook specifieke vragen aan de AP voor te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Bosman en van Gent over het bericht ‘Afschieten honderden damherten op Haringvreter had voorkomen kunnen worden’

MPs from the VVD asked the minister whether an overpopulation of fallow deer on the Haringvreter, which has reduced breeding birds and orchids, could have been prevented by earlier culling permits and why population recovery needs several winters. The minister confirmed the permit history and damage, said several winters of culling are needed, and committed to including such cases in the review of wildlife management.
Yes, it is my intention to include practical situations such as those on the Haringvreter in the evaluation of wildlife management, as requested in the Von Martels motion.
Antwoord 9 Ja, het is mijn voornemen bij de evaluatie van het faunabeheer, zoals gevraagd in de motie-Von Martels 2 , praktijksituaties als die op de Haringvreter, mede te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over het bericht 'Websites overtreden massaal cookiewallverbod'

VVD MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that websites widely violate the cookiewall ban, the Dutch Data Protection Authority's view that cookiewalls are not allowed, practice in other EU countries, competitive effects on Dutch media, how consent for tracking cookies can be obtained, and how the Telecommunications Act, ePrivacy Directive and GDPR relate. The minister answered that cookiewalls do not give freely given consent under GDPR, that consent cannot be obtained via general terms, that Dutch rules apply to foreign firms targeting Dutch users, and that Dutch government supports an explicit cookiewall ban in the forthcoming ePrivacy Regulation.
That is why the Netherlands, in line with the Verhoeven motion, advocates a ban on these so-called cookiewalls.
Daarom pleit Nederland in lijn met de motie Verhoeven voor een verbod op deze zogenoemde cookiewalls.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Gent over de berichten ‘De schrikbarende stijging die niemand kan verklaren’ en ‘Verkeersanalyse provincie nutteloos door Privacywet’

MPs Dijkstra and Van Gent asked whether the GDPR (AVG) prevents provinces from analysing traffic accidents, after reports that the increase in road deaths in Brabant could not be explained. The minister acknowledged that special personal data cannot currently be supplied due to a missing legal basis, that a bill is expected early next year, and pointed to aggregated data, in-depth studies and data sharing as alternatives.
However, special personal data cannot currently be supplied.
Bijzondere persoonsgegevens kunnen op dit moment echter niet worden geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Twitter blokkeert Wilders’

MPs Middendorp and Van Gent asked the government about reports that Twitter had blocked MP Wilders' account and whether this affects freedom of expression and the EU disinformation action plan. The Minister replied that Twitter found Wilders violated its hateful conduct policy and asked him to remove a tweet, that Twitter is a private contractual matter outside ministerial control, and that the government will push platforms for more transparency, but could not answer all questions in time.
As Minister, I do not decide on the terms of use of social media platforms such as Twitter.
Als Minister ga ik niet over de gebruiksregels van sociale media als Twitter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange, Van Gent en Peters over inning van alimentatie

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the collection of child maintenance owed by ex-partners who do not pay, including whether preferential collection priority should be studied and how other countries handle it. The minister agreed that non-payment is undesirable, promised a study of preference and collection by LBIO to be reported after the summer, and argued that existing enforcement adequately secures payment.
By letter of 27 February I informed you of the advantages and disadvantages of preference for child maintenance claims.
Antwoord 3 Bij Kamerbrief van 27 februari jongstleden heb ik u geïnformeerd over de voor en- nadelen van preferentie voor kinderalimentatievorderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Koopmans over het niet tijdig ontvangen van stemdocumenten door Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Van Gent and Koopmans asked the ministers why Dutch citizens abroad had not received their voting documents on time for the 2019 European Parliament election, and how many ballots arrived on time. The minister answered that The Hague municipality organises the vote, that most voters received ballots by email, that postal ballots were delayed until 25 April 2019 pending Council of State rulings, and that the government aims to ease voting abroad.
The Ministry of the Interior evaluates every election and, for elections in which Dutch citizens abroad may vote, receives data from The Hague municipality on abroad-voter participation.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (BZK) evalueert elke verkiezing en ontvangt daarvoor, als het om verkiezingen gaat waarvoor Nederlanders in het buitenland kunnen stemmen, van de gemeente Den Haag gegevens over de deelname van kiezers in het buitenland aan de betreffende verkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gent over apps waarmee je de telefoon van anderen kan spioneren

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about spy apps that let someone secretly monitor a partner, child or employee's phone, and whether their use is criminal or unlawful. The minister said the Criminal Code already penalises installing, selling and advertising such software and secret recording, and commissioned TILT research, due early 2020, on licensing to better regulate their use.

That is why I asked the Tilburg Institute for Law, Technology, and Society (TILT) of Tilburg University to examine how the use of spying products by citizens can be better regulated so that citizens' privacy can be better protected.

Daarom heb ik het Tilburg Institute for Law, Technology, and Society (TILT), van de Universiteit Tilburg verzocht te onderzoeken hoe het gebruik van spionageproducten door burgers beter kan worden gereguleerd zodat de privacy van burgers nog beter kan worden beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent, Van den Bosch en Lodders over de afgelopen provinciale statenverkiezingen

MPs of the VVD asked the Minister of Interior Affairs who pays for recounts of votes in provincial elections, whether municipalities are funded for this, and whether electronic vote counting could reduce recount costs and frequency. The minister answered that municipalities organise elections and recounts are part of that task funded via the municipal fund, and that electronic counting would require a new ballot paper being tested first, without clearly reducing recount risk in the Flevoland case.
Carrying out any recount (and therefore also its funding) is part of organising the election.
Het uitvoeren van een eventuele hertelling (en dus ook de bekostiging daarvan) is onderdeel van de organisatie van de verkiezing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Gent over het plaatsen van (bewerkte) foto’s en filmpjes van leerkrachten in klaslokalen op internet

Two VVD MPs asked whether pupils posting edited photos and videos of teachers online is a growing problem, whether this breaches GDPR, and what sanctions apply. The minister said schools should set their own rules on phone use, that Kennisnet and the School and Safety foundation will be supported, that lawfulness under GDPR is for the Dutch data protection authority or courts to judge, and that the government does not hold figures on sanctions imposed.
The data on the number of sanctions is not known to me.
De gegevens over het aantal sancties zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Gent over de mogelijkheid tot ‘politiek verlof’ voor militairen

Two VVD MPs asked whether soldiers deployed abroad can temporarily give up their municipal council seat via 'political leave', and whether the law should allow this. The government answers that the Constitution offers no basis for replacing councillors deployed abroad, the only substitution being for pregnancy, childbirth or long-term illness, and it sees no need to introduce a replacement option.
The Constitution provides no basis for replacing councillors who are sent abroad for their profession, whether voluntarily or not.
De Grondwet biedt geen grondslag voor vervanging van raadsleden die voor hun beroep al dan niet vrijwillig worden uitgezonden naar het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Wantrouwen: het verkeerde uitgangspunt’

Two VVD MPs asked why patients must give separate consent forms before treating doctors can share medical records, and whether opt-out or broader one-time consent is possible. The minister replied that the GDPR requires explicit consent, ruling out opt-out and blanket consent, and that the GTS programme is exploring a registered-consent scenario, to be discussed with parliament.

The medical professional confidentiality (laid down in the WGBO) guarantees that everyone can freely seek help from a healthcare provider and that patients can be fully open with their treating physician.
Het medisch beroepsgeheim (vastgelegd in de WGBO) garandeert dat iedereen vrijelijk voor hulp bij een zorgverlener kan aankloppen en dat patiënten volledig open naar hun behandelaar kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gent en Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het inschrijven bij de gemeente Amsterdam

MPs Van Gent and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the refusal to register a child born abroad to two fathers in Amsterdam, whether Dutch law requires a mother on the birth certificate, and whether the Staatscommissie's review of parenthood addresses the issue. The minister explained that foreign birth certificates are refused recognition when they conflict with Dutch public order, that the mother-on-certificate principle is treated as fundamental, and that the government's response to the Staatscommissie's proposals and related studies will follow in early 2019.
A child must, where possible, be enabled through the birth certificate to know its maternal descent.
Een kind moet, indien mogelijk, aan de hand van de geboorteakte in staat worden gesteld zijn afstamming van moederszijde te kennen.

qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over malafide bewindvoerders die stelen van kwetsbare cliënten

MP Van Nispen asks about a bewindvoerder who stole from vulnerable clients, why such a person could be appointed and continue, and whether funds, lifetime bans or a public system should be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledges the abuse is unacceptable, describes existing quality requirements, court supervision, annual accounts and dismissal and registry measures, and says a WODC study on publicly organised guardianship is underway.
As soon as abuses come to light, the district judge can suspend or dismiss a guardian.
Zodra er misstanden aan het licht komen, kan de kantonrechter een bewindvoerder schorsen 3 , dan wel ontslaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over beloningsverschillen binnen de rechterlijke macht,

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a 3.5% starting-salary gap between female and male judges- and prosecutors-in-training and whether the government would tackle it. The state secretary admitted the gap, agreed with the judiciary to replace the last-earned-salary criterion with unweighted work experience, and said the government will leave the detailed implementation to the employers.
On 18 July, the Dutch Association for the Judiciary (NVvR) and I reached agreement that the old arrangement, scaling based on last-earned salary, will be abandoned.
Op 18 juli jl. zijn de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak (NVvR) en ik tot overeenstemming gekomen dat de oude afspraak – inschaling op basis van het laatstverdiende loon – wordt losgelaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over pleegzorg

An MP asked the government about foster care screening after a case of a 10-year-old girl in Vlaardingen, covering the Raad voor de Kinderbescherming certificate, motives of prospective foster parents, periodic screening, Veilig Thuis procedures, and whether children are interviewed privately. The State Secretary answered each question in detail, describing existing procedures and periodic checks while committing to no new measures.
Ensuring safety is fundamental when placing a foster child in a (new) foster family.
Het borgen van de veiligheid is fundamenteel bij het plaatsen van een pleegkind in een (nieuw) pleeggezin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het tekort aan sociaal advocaten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the shortage of social lawyers, whose numbers are falling while retirements rise, and about low fees and recruitment. The Secretary of State replied that the signals were already known, pointed to existing measures (training subsidy, education outreach, fee reviews by the Van der Meer II commission due end 2024), and said causes of attrition are not yet clear.
Sufficient supply of social lawyers is needed to make access to justice effective.
Er is voldoende aanbod van sociaal advocaten nodig om toegang tot het recht te kunnen effectueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het noodgedwongen stoppen van het lokale beleid inzake beschermingsbewind in de gemeente Groningen

MP Van Kent (SP) asks why Groningen municipality had to stop steering people to its non-commercial municipal trustee for debt administration after a court ruling, and whether the government will act to restore local control over bewind. The State Secretary answers that the court ruling is respected, the choice of trustee rests with the sub-district judge, municipalities may still offer bewind, a study on public organisation of bewind is planned for Q2 2025, and the advisory right and convenant options will be evaluated.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, we respect the court's judgment in the Groningen case.
Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 1 respecteren we het oordeel van de rechter in de casus Groningen.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Boswijk over het bericht ‘Universiteit: anderhalf miljoen euro schade na studentenprotesten’

MP Boswijk (CDA) asked the Justice and Security Minister about damage and arrests following student protests at universities, and how damage can be recovered from individual rioters. The minister says damage at the University of Amsterdam is estimated at 1.5 million euros, arrests are only available for Amsterdam (about 200 people), snelrecht is used where possible, and recovery is possible via insurers, civil or criminal (victim joinder) routes, with a review of a national compensation fund ongoing.
It is not possible to provide reliable national figures on the number of people arrested or prosecuted following the riots at universities.
Het is niet mogelijk om betrouwbare landelijke cijfers te geven van het aantal aangehouden of vervolgde personen naar aanleiding van de rellen bij de universiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het artikel ‘In de schulden na een erfenis: ‘Ik kreeg dit ineens op mijn bord’’

MP Ceder asked about inheritance debts, the differing collection practices of national agencies (UWV, SVB), municipalities and the Tax Authority, the uptake of beneficiary acceptance, and whether beneficiary acceptance should be the default. The Staatssecretaris answered that agencies must recover undue benefits from heirs with maatwerk options and a debt-free minimum, that uniform policy will follow the pending IBO and civil enforcement reviews, and that default beneficiary acceptance was rejected as burdensome for most heirs.
A cabinet response to the IBO on problematic debts is still to follow.
Een kabinetsreactie op het IBO problematische schulden volgt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over inzage in en onderzoek naar archieven met betrekking tot adopties uit Chili

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection about access to and investigation of archives on adoptions from Chile, including documents now held by FIOM and whether they will be opened without restrictions. The minister said FIOM has opened dossier access, is discussing permanent archiving of non-personal material, and will review the scope of access in new adoption legislation, but declined to commission a separate investigation into the Chilean adoptions, citing an ongoing criminal investigation in Chile.
In the context of the new adoption legislation, I am examining the possibilities to make access to dossiers as unrestricted and complete as possible.
In het kader van de nieuwe adoptiewetgeving onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om de inzage van dossiers zo onbeperkt en volledig mogelijk te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over signalen dat een grote groep mensen ten onrechte een brief heeft ontvangen van de IND waarin wordt aangegeven dat zij geen rechtmatig verblijf zouden hebben in Nede

MPs Van Nispen and Dijk asked why Dienst Toeslagen sent letters stopping allowances based on IND residence codes, causing distress and wrongful loss of benefits for some EU citizens, and asked about compensation, legal aid and prevention. The government admits a system design error, says about 800 letters were sent with 180 later reinstated, and defends the approach while promising to reinstate and not claw back benefits where residence is confirmed.
The cabinet finds it highly undesirable that persons who are not lawfully residing in the Netherlands and therefore have no entitlement to allowances receive them.
Het kabinet vindt het zeer onwenselijk dat personen niet rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus geen recht hebben op toeslagen deze ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de rechtsbescherming van ouders en kinderen bij spoedverzoeken aan de kinderrechter

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about inadequate legal protection of parents and children in urgent court applications for out-of-home placement, citing an article on procedural shortcomings and ECHR Articles 6 and 8. The minister acknowledged the need for improvement, pointed to a forthcoming bill (contours to Parliament in autumn 2024), an ongoing legal aid pilot to 31 December 2024, and ongoing fact-finding work, but declined to commit to immediate measures.
The contours of the bill will be communicated to the House in the autumn of this year.
Over de contouren van het wetsvoorstel wordt uw Kamer in het najaar van dit jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-van de Klashorst over de geweldsexplosie in detentiecentrum Rotterdam

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the government did not actively inform parliament about a violent uprising by foreign nationals at Detentiecentrum Rotterdam, injuring seven staff, and about aftercare, prosecution, detention regime and deportation status. The minister answered that the incident was listed in the monthly DJI incident list, that one foreign national was reported to police, that information on injuries and individual cases was withheld on privacy grounds, and that the public prosecution service decides on prosecution.
Whether the House of Representatives is additionally actively informed about an incident is a consideration made per incident.
Of de Tweede Kamer daarnaast nog actief over een incident wordt geïnformeerd is een afweging die per incident gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over nog steeds geen terugkeer ontvoerde dochter Madeline

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection what steps have been taken to reunite a 10-year-old girl with her father in the Philippines, despite an arrest warrant and a court order for her return. The minister replies that the case is a domestic matter for Philippine authorities, that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs provides consular assistance but cannot discuss substance for privacy reasons, and that no contact with the Philippine Central Authority has occurred.
Nevertheless, as Minister for Legal Protection I have no instruments at my disposal to take steps.
Desondanks heb ik als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen instrumenten tot mijn beschikking om stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mensen met schulden en zzp’ers die in de knel komen door te strenge regels voor de aanvraag van rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked whether people with debts are excluded from legal aid because their taxable income exceeds the Wrb limit, whether disposable income should be used, why that was abolished in 2006, and whether self-employed people are unfairly excluded. The minister confirmed the exclusion, acknowledged hardship cases, announced a temporary discretionary scheme for seizure cases and a study of lower middle incomes, but refused to change the rules for now.
Currently it is being explored whether a temporary legal basis can be created for the Council to deviate from the Wrb means-test system in these cases.
Momenteel wordt nader verkend of er een tijdelijke grondslag voor de Raad gecreëerd kan worden om in deze gevallen af te wijken van de systematiek voor de draagkrachttoetsing van de Wrb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Ceder over de noodzaak tot verplichte leeftijdscontrole bij BNPL-diensten

MPs Mohandis and Ceder asked the government about minors using Buy Now, Pay Later services, the lack of mandatory age verification, the effect of the revised Consumer Credit Directive, fees, and sanctions. The minister acknowledged the risks, reported that BNPL providers committed from 1 June to verify all users' age, and said the government is still working out how to make age verification legally mandatory and will report after the summer.
The cabinet is currently working out how age verification can be made mandatory.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment uit hoe leeftijdscontrole verplicht gesteld kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het mediabericht dat de gemeente Soest een besluit zou hebben genomen om bingo te verbieden

An MP asked the government whether the municipality of Soest banned senior bingo afternoons under the Betting and Gaming Act, and whether the rules should be changed. The state secretary answered that no municipal ban exists, that bingo in private settings or without prizes is allowed, and that an exception for small games in hospitality venues will be added to the Alcohol Act.
I will add an exception to the Alcohol Act for organising small games of chance, such as bingo, in hospitality venues
Ik ga in de Alcoholwet een uitzondering opnemen voor het organiseren van kleine kansspelen, zoals bingo's, in horecalokaliteiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lahlah over het onvoldoende benutten van mediation in strafzaken

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why mediation in criminal cases is underused, despite benefits for victims and suspects, and what barriers and legal or budgetary changes are needed. The minister agrees mediation is valuable, cites WODC findings on untapped potential, and promises a policy response after summer on embedding mediation in the process, a possible statutory right to request mediation in the new Criminal Procedure Code, and says budget is sufficient.

I will examine with the Public Prosecution Service and the judiciary whether and which fixed moments in the criminal process can be found at which the possibility of mediation can be considered by default and in time.

Ik zal met het OM en de rechtspraak onderzoeken of en zo ja welke vaste momenten te vinden zijn in het strafproces waarop de mogelijkheid van mediation in ieder geval standaard en tijdig kan worden overwogen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Faber-Van de Klashorst over onvoldoende toezicht door reclassering op personen die als opgelegde maatregel een enkelband dragen

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why probation supervision of juveniles wearing ankle monitors is insufficient and what the government will do about it. The minister replies that electronic monitoring is not meant to prevent recidivism, describes the 24/7 alert and follow-up arrangements, and says the shortfall stems from workload and capacity in local-government-funded youth probation, with the government mainly offering funding programmes and talks with VNG and VWS.

That is why, through the Preventie met Gezag programme, 27 municipalities are being funded to deploy the intensive youth probation approach called Straatkracht, within which youth probation has more time.

Daarom worden vanuit het programma Preventie met Gezag 27 gemeenten gefinancierd die de intensieve jeugdreclasseringsaanpak, genaamd Straatkracht, inzetten waarbinnen de jeugdreclassering meer tijd heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Krul over het bericht 'Zijn rechtszaken over misbruik straks niet meer openbaar?'

MPs Boswijk and Krul asked whether victims of sexual offences, including minors, can have criminal hearings held behind closed doors, and whether the rules should be extended in light of a Belgian proposal. The minister confirmed judges may order closed-door hearings on request, that no figures exist on how often this is granted, and that existing rules suffice, so no change is planned.
Neither the Public Prosecution Service nor the judiciary has figures available on the number of granted requests.
Zowel bij het Openbaar Ministerie als bij de rechterlijke macht zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal toegewezen verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel ‘Aantal tbs’ers wéér gestegen, maar geen plek in klinieken: krijgen enorme bedragen uitgekeerd.’

An MP asks how the Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing en Jeugdbescherming sets the passant compensation for tbs patients held in prisons awaiting clinic placement, whether it is binding, whether it can be suspended, and what share of payments goes to victims as damages. The minister explains the amounts follow civil case law and the Hoge Raad/ECHR basis for the four-month limit, that suspending payments would likely fail in court, and gives a table showing 24-51% of payments were withheld for victim damages in 2021-2023.
Deviating downward from the standard amounts is expected to result in passants litigating for higher amounts.
Naar beneden afwijken van de standaardbedragen zal naar verwachting tot gevolg hebben dat passanten zullen procederen voor hogere bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitermark over het bericht ‘Ook mensen met een paar jaar cel niet in gevangenis door personeelstekort’

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that some offenders with multi-year prison sentences are not being summoned to prison due to staff shortages, including those with sentences near four and five years, and asked for breakdowns by sentence length, offence type, and the self-surrender criteria. The Minister confirmed that twelve outstanding self-surrenders have sentences over three years (highest about 4.5 years), that 87.1% have 90 days or less remaining, explained the CJIB assessment framework and the temporary summons stop for adult male self-surrenders, and said the one-week deadline could not be met.
Due to the potential traceability to individuals, I do not provide information on individual cases.
In verband met de potentiële herleidbaarheid naar personen verstrek ik geen informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vondeling over het bericht dat er steeds meer malafide letselspecialisten zijn

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of increasingly fraudulent injury-claim specialists taking money from victims, and about measures against them. The minister said no figures exist, pointed to the NKL quality mark and a pending WODC study with a policy response due in Q3 2024, and declined to make such specialists a protected profession pending that research.
I want to await the content of this study. The results of this study will appear before the summer recess.
Ik wil de inhoud van dit onderzoek afwachten. De resultaten van dit onderzoek zullen voor het zomerreces verschijnen.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht 'Rechter gefrustreerd: klinieken willen verward persoon niet opnemen'

Two SP MPs asked, after a court ruling, how the government will ensure a man with a court-ordered care measure is placed in a secure care facility rather than left homeless, and what is being done about the wider placement problem. The minister answered that a place was found and the man admitted from 29 March 2024, acknowledged that secure specialist places are scarce, and said a work agenda and a letter on the Wzd and forensic care alignment will follow before summer.
As far as we are aware, that information is also not registered.
Voor zover ons bekend wordt die informatie ook niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het al dan niet starten met re-integratie activiteiten door een levenslanggestrafte

An MP asked why relatives of life-sentenced prisoners cannot access the Pieter Baan Centrum report before being heard by the Adviescollege Levenslang Gestraften, and whether this makes the hearing illusory or secondarily victimising. The minister answered that no legal basis for access currently exists, that the government is examining whether one should be created, and that privacy and confidentiality interests must still be weighed.
There currently exists no legal basis for access to or copies of documents forming part of the Adviescollege levenslanggestraften's advice for victims and relatives.

Er bestaat op dit moment geen wettelijke grondslag voor inzage in of afschrift van stukken die onderdeel uitmaken van het advies van het Adviescollege levenslanggestraften voor slachtoffers en nabestaanden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de documentaire ‘Jehovah – Van God Los’ over seksueel misbruik in de gemeenschap van Jehovah’s Getuigen, harde uitsluiting uit de gemeenschap en zelfs suïcides

An MP asked the Ministers about a documentary on sexual abuse, shunning and suicides within Jehovah's Witnesses, asking about internal handling of abuse reports, the confidentiality of internal records, the ANBI status of religious organisations, and whether shunning should be criminalised. The government answered that victims must be able to report to Dutch authorities, that privacy rules apply to the community's records, that the ANBI rules are neutral but the government can speak out, that a helpline platform and further research are planned, and that criminalising exclusion is not appropriate.
Regardless of the internal procedures of a religious community, victims must in all cases have the possibility to report crimes within the Dutch legal system.
Ongeacht de interne procedures van een religieuze gemeenschap, moeten slachtoffers in alle gevallen de mogelijkheid hebben om binnen het Nederlandse rechtssysteem aangifte te doen van misdrijven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over barrières voor sociaal advocaten om toeslagenouders juridisch bij te staan

SP MPs asked the government why the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand reverted the temporary 0.5 unit weighting for childcare-benefit (toeslagen) cases, lowering the number of parents each lawyer can help, and raised concerns about information withholding, procedural obstacles and the position of children in the restoration scheme. The State Secretary answered that the reversion restores standard policy now that the restoration workload has started, that information sharing has been improved, and that no new independent route for children before the Commissie Werkelijke Schade is planned.
It is not desirable that a different quality standard is applied to the assistance of affected parents than to regular cases.
Het is niet wenselijk dat er voor de bijstand van gedupeerde ouders een andere kwaliteitsstandaard wordt gehanteerd dan voor reguliere zaken.
Antwoord op van het lid Lahlah over het bericht ‘de veiligheid in vrouwengevangenis is onvoldoende’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about sexual misconduct and safety in the women's prison Nieuwersluis, including implementation of inspection and RCGOG recommendations, complaint accessibility, focal persons, and timelines. The minister answers that recommendations have been adopted and partly implemented, with some measures still being worked out and progress to be reported in the next progress letter.
In my response I indicated that I adopt all recommendations of the Inspection report.
In mijn reactie heb ik aangegeven alle aanbevelingen van het Inspectierapport over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Uitermark over het bericht ‘Rechter Haags gerechtshof geschorst na valse ondertekeningen in 43 vonnissen’

An MP asked the Minister whether 43 judgments signed with a false panel of three judges at the Hague Court of Appeal, which generated about 110,000 euro extra income, reflect perverse financing incentives in the judiciary, and asked for investigation of that and of workload effects. The Minister answered that the Raad voor de rechtspraak reports no financial gain for the judge and no likely impact on parties, that the Court has repaid the excess, that an external investigation is commissioned, and that the Minister will await its results and a workload exploration before drawing conclusions.
This does not alter the fact that the Council for the Judiciary sees reason to now commission an external investigation to rule out that a similar method was used elsewhere.
Dit laat onverlet dat de Raad voor de rechtspraak aanleiding ziet nu een extern onderzoek te laten uitvoeren om uit te sluiten dat een vergelijkbare werkwijze elders is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Ellian over het bericht 'Aanpak stalking schiet vijf jaar na moord op Hümeyra nog altijd te kort'

MPs Becker and Ellian (VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about stalking enforcement after the murder of Hümeyra, a femicide plan, a definition of femicide, a victim device for stalkers, the SASH risk tool, and whether serious domestic abuse could be handled via fast-track justice. The Minister answered that a femicide plan is due in April 2024, outlined a definition, reported on the victim device pilot, and rejected fast-track prosecution as unsuitable for domestic abuse cases.
I have asked the Research and Documentation Centre (WODC) to explore how we can routinely carry out such a structured analysis of cases in the Netherlands.
Ik heb het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Datacentrum (WODC) gevraagd om te verkennen hoe we een dergelijke gestructureerde analyse van casussen standaard kunnen uitvoeren in Nederland
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over het rapport ‘Eenzaam gesloten’ van Jason Bhugwandass

An MP asked the Minister and State Secretary about the 'Eenzaam gesloten' report on ZIKOS units in closed youth care, rights violations, the Woodbrookers reopening under a new name, and whether closed youth care should be phased out by 2030. The State Secretary answered that closed youth care is being transformed toward small-scale care, that former justice buildings will be divested by agreement with municipalities, that the Inspectorate's supervision is ongoing, and that closed placements remain necessary for a limited group of youths.
Until the inspection reports are published, the IGJ cannot go further into the findings and the supervision.
Tot de openbaarmaking van de inspectierapporten kan de IGJ niet verder ingaan op de bevindingen en het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de toepassing van de meldbriefprocedure en ondertoezichtstellingen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the use of the meldbrief procedure and child protection supervision orders (ondertoezichtstellingen), including the share of supervised children receiving no youth care, regional variation, and why the procedure was dropped without statutory anchoring. The minister gave detailed statistics, said the procedure is being abolished at all courts by 1 July, and explained that the procedure was never meant to be abolished when the legal basis was removed.
On 8 March, at the LOVF meeting, it was decided to abolish the meldbrief procedure at all courts.
Op 8 maart is tijdens de vergadering van het LOVF besloten de meldbriefprocedure bij alle gerechten af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Gezinshuiszorg faalt: kwetsbare kinderen onvoldoende beschermd'

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the state secretary and minister about a news report that vulnerable children in family-home youth care were insufficiently protected, questioning the IGJ's oversight, the lack of a reliable count of family homes, the case for a profit ban, and measures against abuses. The state secretary acknowledged the failures, explained risk-based inspection and the planned bills and measures, but rejected a general profit ban.
That is why it is also essential that municipalities set quality requirements during contracting, as laid down in the Quality Criteria for Family Homes.
Daarom is het ook essentieel dat bij de contractering gemeenten kwaliteitseisen stellen zoals neergelegd in de Kwaliteitscriteria Gezinshuizen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'Aantal tbs’ers wéér gestegen, maar geen plek in klinieken: krijgen enorme bedragen uitgekeerd.'

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about reports that the number of tbs patients rose while clinic places stayed short, and that the state pays compensation to those held in prisons while waiting. Minister Weerwind answers in detail with waiting-time and payout figures, acknowledges staff shortages and capacity strain, and says he has asked WODC to study the effects of prison detention on tbs treatment, but gives no firm capacity commitments.
I have therefore asked the Research and Documentation Centre (WODC) to carry out research into this.
Ik heb daarom het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Datacentrum (WODC) gevraagd hier een onderzoek naar uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Faber-van de Klashorst en Vondeling over een moeder die voor gerechtigheid vecht na de dood van haar zoon

MPs Vondeling and Faber-van de Klashorst asked about the case of a 22-year-old killed by a driver who was speeding and under the influence, including why he was released from pre-trial detention, why the hearing took 14 months, whether sentences are too low, and whether friends of victims should get speaking rights in court. The Minister declined to comment on the pending case, pointed to 2020 tougher traffic-offence laws, ongoing reforms on driving bans and drink-driving, and said speaking rights for close friends will be considered in the new Code of Criminal Procedure.
No statements will be made about the present case, as it is still before the judge, and any investigation results are subject to the judge's assessment.
Over de onderhavige zaak worden geen mededelingen gedaan, nu deze nog onder de rechter is, en eventuele onderzoeksresultaten aan het oordeel van de rechter onderworpen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en PSV in zee gingen met dubieuze Aziatische gokbedrijven'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether Ajax and PSV's sponsorship deals with Asian gambling firms were adequately vetted for money-laundering risks, and about the legal framework, supervision, the planned gambling sponsorship ban and Curaçao's gambling reform. The government answered that football clubs are not gatekeepers under the Wwft, that supervisors' investigations are confidential, that the sponsorship ban applies from 1 July 2025 with no acceleration, and that the Curaçao law is delayed but being monitored.
Whether supervisors are investigating particular cases or entities is supervisory-confidential information.
Of toezichthouders onderzoek doen naar bepaalde casussen of entiteiten is toezichtsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de Kamerleden Vondeling en Crijns over het bericht dat uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen stilzwijgend worden verlengd

MPs Vondeling and Crijns asked whether child out-of-home placements and supervision orders are extended without a court hearing via the 'meldbrief' procedure, and whether this is extra-legal. The minister acknowledged roughly 4,000 yearly extensions decided without a hearing (under 30%), said the meldbrief procedure is problematic, and promised the LOVF is seeking an alternative, while maintaining the judge decides whether to hold a hearing.
The National Consultation on Family and Youth Law has indicated, in consultation with my ministry, that it gives high priority to finding an alternative to the current meldbrief procedure.

Het Landelijk Overleg Vakinhoud Familie- en jeugdrecht (LOVF) heeft in overleg met mijn ministerie aangegeven hoge prioriteit te geven aan het zoeken naar een alternatief voor de huidige procedure met de meldbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Diederik van Dijk over het bericht ‘Milieuorganisatie stapt naar de rechter om renovatie Binnenhof te stoppen’

MPs Flach and Van Dijk asked about an environmental group's court appeal to halt the Binnenhof renovation over nitrogen permits, its standing as a cooperative, and possible delays. The minister answered that the appeal is pending before the court, that a nature permit was granted in January 2024, that delay effects will be reported in the next progress report, and that the court decides on standing.
I cannot go into the substance of this appeal procedure or the arguments to be made, because this case is before the court.
Op de inhoud van deze beroepsprocedure en de te voeren argumenten kan ik nu niet ingaan, omdat deze zaak voorligt bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de rol van de deken van de Amsterdamse Orde van Advocaten bijeen kort-geding tegen een landelijk dagblad

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the Amsterdam bar dean intervened in a summary proceeding by advocate Royce de Vries against the Algemeen Dagblad, and whether this is acceptable given press freedom and source protection. The minister answered that assessing such interventions is up to the local dean and the courts, that the minister will not comment on a pending case, and declined to discuss with the bar association.
It is for the judge to assess the positions taken by a party to the proceedings, and not for me.
Het is aan de rechter om de door een procespartij ingenomen standpunten te beoordelen en niet aan mij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een oplichter die meerdere malen met succes vrouwen heeft opgelicht en niet te stoppen lijkt

MP Van Nispen asked the ministers why a suspected romance fraudster who defrauded several women keeps operating, whether the civil route is realistic for victims, and what can be done to stop him. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that victims can always report to the police and pursue civil claims, and that it is working on lowering court fees and on fraud prevention and the role of notaries and guardianship bodies.
Let me first state that I do not comment on individual cases.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat ik geen uitspraken doe over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitermark en Joseph over het bericht 'Richard (35) zit zonder strafblad al 12 jaar opgesloten in tbs-kliniek tussen zware criminelen: hij is niet de enige'

MPs Uitermark and Joseph asked about reports that a psychiatric patient without a criminal sentence has been held for 12 years in a tbs clinic, and about shortages of care places. The minister said seven people without a criminal title are in a level-4 setting for treatment reasons, that a plan of action with sector partners is underway to create temporary and permanent places for about sixty people, and that co-placement is in principle undesirable but may be clinically justified.
I cannot go into the case mentioned in the article and therefore cannot give a judgement on the reporting on this point.
Ik kan hier niet ingaan op de in het artikel genoemde casus en daarom ook geen oordeel geven over de berichtgeving op dit punt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Geen plek meer in daklozenopvang in Utrecht en Amersfoort: 'Mensen slapen noodgedwongen op straat'

MP Kat asks how landlords select tenants, whether they may run credit checks and BKR queries, and whether people under protective administration (beschermingsbewind) are wrongly refused housing and how this is protected. The minister answers that landlords must follow the Wet goed verhuurderschap and anti-discrimination law, that protective administration is not a protected characteristic and is not a valid reason for refusal per sector bodies, and that no legal change is needed.
Having a protective administrator is moreover not discrimination. It is not a legally protected personal characteristic.
Het hebben van een beschermingsbewindvoerder is bovendien geen discriminatie. Het betreft geen persoonskenmerk dat wettelijk is beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over corruptie bij DJI

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a DJI selection officer reportedly bribed, and about integrity complaints, investigations, sanctions and dismissals at DJI over five years, plus counts of contraband and information leaks. The minister confirmed the Rijksrecherche and DJI's Bureau Integriteit are investigating, declined substantive comment on ongoing probes, and provided yearly tables of complaints, investigations, measures, dismissals and integrity violations.
I cannot make any substantive statements about these investigations since they have not yet been concluded.
Ik kan verder geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over deze onderzoeken aangezien deze nog niet zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de conclusies van het inspectierapport ‘vernietiging adoptiedossiers’ en de rechtsbescherming van geadopteerden

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the inspection report on destruction of adoption files, the timeliness and suitability of INEA services, the complaints route, transfer and digitisation of files, and oversight. The Minister mostly referred to earlier policy, stated that the Archiefwet does not apply to private intermediaries but the Wobka and AVG do, promised to address the Wobka and an oversight role for the Inspectie JenV, and declined to establish an independent investigation or complaints point.
I therefore see no added value in an independent reporting point.
Ik zie daarom geen meerwaarde in een onafhankelijk meldpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over ‘Kritiek rechters op uitstel celstraffen’

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about judges' criticism that temporarily not summoning male adult self-reporters to prison undermines judicial authority, and about related measures such as electronic monitoring, reduced prison regimes, and easing criteria for the Limited Security Ward. The minister replied that the measure is a temporary emergency response to staff shortages, that sentences will in principle still be executed, and that further measures are being explored with partners, with commitments to inform parliament.
A person sentenced by a judge to a prison term will in principle always actually serve detention.
Een persoon die door de rechter is veroordeeld tot een gevangenisstraf zal in beginsel altijd daadwerkelijk detentie ondergaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het persbericht ‘Griffierechten verlaagd’ om een verhoging van de griffierechten aan te kondigen

An SP MP asked why a government press release framed a partial indexation of court fees as a fee reduction, and whether this improves access to justice. The minister defended the framing, stating fees are about 13.5% lower than if full indexation had applied, backed by a structural 27 million euro, and pointed to a broader access-to-justice programme.
Not indexing for 2023 and partially applying indexation for 2024 means court fees for litigants are structurally about 13.5% lower than if the indexations had been fully applied.
Het niet indexeren voor 2023 en het gedeeltelijk doorvoeren van de indexering voor 2024 betekent voor rechtzoekenden dat de griffierechten structureel circa 13,5% lager uitkomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vondeling en Markuszower over ‘overvolle gevangenissen en Tbs-klinieken’

PVV MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many convicted offenders are free because prisons and tbs clinics are full, whether convicted criminals should never escape their sentences, and what will be done to ensure all sentenced criminals are imprisoned. The Minister answered that 636 adult male self-reporters are temporarily not being called up, that about 150 tbs-passanten are held in prisons, and that the measure is a temporary emergency to be lifted as soon as staffing allows, with further measures being examined.
Not admitting self-reporters is a temporary emergency measure due to staff shortages at DJI, so that not all cells can be used.
Het niet opnemen van zelfmelders is een tijdelijke noodmaatregel als gevolg van persoonstekort bij DJI waardoor niet alle cellen inzetbaar zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruyning over de meldbriefprocedure, die de rechtspraak gebruikt om zittingen te voorkomen als een verlenging van een ondertoezichtstelling of uithuisplaatsing wordt verzocht

MP Bruyning asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the meldbrief procedure, under which courts skip hearings in requests to extend child protection supervision or out-of-home placement, questioning its legal basis, its compliance with ECHR Article 6 and 8, and the effect on parents' access to court. The minister answered that roughly 30% of extension cases are decided without a hearing, that no data exist on whether help was provided, that the legal basis was kept via the Procesreglement, and that an alternative to the procedure is being sought.

The Landelijk Overleg Vakinhoud Familie- en jeugdrecht (LOVF), in consultation with my ministry, has indicated it gives high priority to finding an alternative to the meldbrief procedure in its current form.

Het Landelijk Overleg Vakinhoud Familie- en jeugdrecht (LOVF) heeft in overleg met mijn ministerie aangegeven hoge prioriteit te geven aan het zoeken naar een alternatief voor de meldbriefprocedure in de huidige vorm
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het doorprocederen tegen geadopteerden

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why the state keeps appealing against adoptees such as Mr Noordoven, delays a Woo document request, and does not reimburse their litigation costs. The minister defends the appeal as clarifying legal questions, says the Woo request is complex and not tied to the civil case, and only states that settlement talks on compensation are ongoing without disclosing outcomes.
I cannot provide any information on the outcome of these discussions.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over de uitkomst van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haga over de casus van mevrouw Passemiers bij de Jeugdbescherming

MP Van Haga asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Passemiers case: why courts set aside favourable reports on returning the children, police conduct during an out-of-home placement, the handling of complaints, and why visits and weekend stays were refused. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, citing privacy and the separation of powers, but stated that treatment requires consent and that the 'samen, tenzij' sibling principle will be enshrined in the Jeugdwet.
It is not appropriate for the Minister for Legal Protection to intervene in individual cases and/or to judge decisions of the judiciary.
Het past niet om als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming te treden in individuele zaken en/of te oordelen over beslissingen van de rechterlijke macht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat rechters het vonnis al klaar hadden liggen voor de uitspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that judges had drafted verdicts before hearings, which he said could undermine trust in the judiciary. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said the Hague Court of Appeal disputes their accuracy, called draft verdicts exceptional, and declined to order a survey of courts or consult the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
In my view this does not show bias before the verdict has been formally determined by the judges.
Naar mijn mening geeft dit geen blijk van vooringenomenheid voordat de uitspraak formeel is vastgesteld door de rechters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het artikel ‘Cowboys azen op miljoenen die Rijk investeert in jeugdcriminaliteit’

MP Mutluer asked the ministers about a Trouw report that outside providers are targeting Rijk funds for youth crime prevention, and about how spending is controlled and made effective. The ministers answered that municipalities are warned to be critical of providers, that a monitoring cycle, evaluations and a WODC study will track effectiveness, and they gave a budget overview and an update on the Drop In youth-work research.

To stimulate and facilitate municipalities within the learning approach of Preventie met gezag, we share scientific knowledge on risk and protective factors and the active ingredients based on them with them.

Om gemeenten binnen (de lerende aanpak van) Preventie met gezag te stimuleren en faciliteren delen wij wetenschappelijke kennis ten aanzien van risico- en beschermende factoren en daarop gebaseerde werkzame bestanddelen met hen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat online casino’s spelers misleiden om overmatig te gaan gokken

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Consumentenbond report that major online casinos mislead players into excessive gambling, including high default stakes, hidden bonus conditions, unwanted bonus harassment and state-owned operators' conduct. The minister responded that the Kansspelautoriteit is responsible for enforcement, that talks with operators and the Consumentenbond are underway, that stricter rules and a responsible-gaming package are being prepared, and that the Wet koa will be evaluated before drawing conclusions.
The Consumentenbond has not made its research data public.
De Consumentenbond heeft haar onderzoeksgegevens niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van Nispen over inzage door geadopteerden in hun eigen adoptiedossier

MPs Ellian and Van Nispen asked why people adopted within the Netherlands still lack unhindered access to their adoption and separation files, which are held in fragmented places, and what interests could outweigh that access. The minister acknowledged the fragmentation and outlined transfers to the National Archives, noting that access rights are strong but not absolute and that private institutions fall outside government control.
An adoptee or relinquished person has the right to information about their origins.
Een afgestane of geadopteerde heeft het recht op afstammingsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Kat en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het bericht dat AI-sites teksten van nieuwsmedia gebruiken zonder daar bronvermelding aan toe tevoegen

MPs asked whether AI sites reusing news texts without attribution, and the scope of the copyright text-and-data-mining exception, breach copyright and should be curbed. The government answered that the exception may cover scraping even of paywalled articles if access was lawfully obtained and no reservation was made, that attribution is not a legal condition, and that the EU AI Act and copyright evaluation will be used to address the issue.
Attribution is therefore not a condition for lawfully making a reproduction within text and data mining.
