Bronvermelding is dus geen voorwaarde voor het rechtmatig kunnen maken van een reproductie in het kader van tekst- en datamining.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de risico’s en onregelmatigheden in de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting

The MP asks about a SIM card found in a detainee's clothing at the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting, whether spreading of detainees in the EBI is still possible, how contact between Holleeder and Razzouki is allowed, and how unwanted communication between detainees is prevented. The minister says the SIM card was found in an incoming jacket in a non-detainee area, that spreading is currently possible, declines to discuss individual cases, and points to monitoring measures and a bill expanding powers to restrict communication.
I will not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krul en Kuik over begeleiding van probleemjongeren door de krijgsmacht

CDA MPs Krul and Kuik asked whether the Landmacht's BBJ-KL programme for at-risk youth, with 240 participants and 28 becoming soldiers, is successful, and whether it should be improved, expanded, linked to Justice's Preventie met Gezag, or combined with work and education. The State Secretary for Defence answered that the programme is not a core Defence task but is partly successful (136 returned to school or work), that expansion is capped at 200 youths a year with no added staff, that municipalities can refer youths, and that cooperation with Justice is being considered while broader goals are rejected.
Municipalities can refer youths to this guidance programme.
Gemeenten kunnen jongeren voordragen voor dit begeleidingstraject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuik en Bikker over het bericht dat influencers via Telegram slachtoffers voor duizenden euro’s oplichten door neppe sportuitslagen te helpen promoten

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that influencers promote fake sports results on Telegram to defraud young people, and about the harms of matchfixing and gambling. The minister answered that the influencers are described as inciting followers to crimes, that fraud prevention campaigns and gambling-integrity rules are in place, that the online gambling law will be evaluated in 2024, and that further measures on advertising and responsible gambling are planned.
I am aware of the report about influencers who lure young people into the arms of fraudsters.
Ik ben bekend met het bericht over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Van der Woude over het artikel ‘Exorcisten ’De Laatste Reformatie’ onder vuur: duiveluitdrijvingen bij kinderen en wegbidden autisme’

MPs Becker and Van der Woude asked about reports of exorcisms of children and prayer to cure autism by the group De Laatste Reformatie, covering child protection, reporting routes, foreign contacts, visas and a promised law on informal education. The government condemned such practices, pointed to Veilig Thuis, the police and existing child protection tools, declined a new investigation or legal measures against the group citing religious freedom, and said it had no knowledge of a promised study on the scale of exorcisms.
I do not intend to investigate this further.
Ik ben niet voornemens dit nader te onderzoeken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Temmink over het bericht dat de gemeente Den Haag, in navolging van de gemeente Deventer, cameradrones toepast bij het inspecteren van dakkapellen en uitbouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Temmink asked about municipalities using camera drones to inspect dakkapellen and extensions, raising privacy, DPIA, aviation permit, retention, anonymisation and legality concerns. The Minister answered that municipalities are responsible for privacy compliance, that Deventer and Den Haag have taken steps (DPIA, notices, blurring, limited retention), and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and courts will judge lawfulness.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for compliance with privacy legislation.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de conclusies van het inspectierapport ‘vernietiging adoptiedossiers’

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection, in 27 numbered questions, about the inspection report on the destruction of intercountry adoption files, the state's liability and compensation, oversight of adoption intermediaries, and adoptees' access to records. The minister answered that no information about adoptees themselves was lost, that compensation is not planned in favour of expanded support through the INEA centre, and that the state continues to defend pending civil claims.
I see no reason to stop defending the currently ongoing proceedings.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om niet langer verweer te voeren in de thans lopende procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuws dat Sociaal Raadslieden moeten stoppen met hun werk waardoor een belangrijke toegang tot het recht voor mensen wegvalt

An MP asked the minister about news that the social legal aid service (Sociaal Raadslieden) in Breda would close due to budget cuts, and about its wider importance and funding. The minister replied that the proposal was reversed, that funding and provision are municipal responsibilities, and that a Divosa inventory of first-line legal aid across municipalities is expected in October 2023.
Social legal aid work is a responsibility of the municipality. The municipality is autonomous in this and is directed by the municipal council.
Het sociaal raadsliedenwerk is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente. De gemeente is hierin autonoom en wordt daarin aangestuurd door de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Omtzigt over feitenonderzoek in de jeugdbescherming

MPs Kwint and Omtzigt asked why the action plan to improve fact-finding in youth protection (feitenonderzoek jeugdbescherming) produced few real improvements, what the government will do, and whether children were wrongly placed out of the home. The Minister replied that the evaluation found many actions were taken but only partly implemented, that further improvements are planned, and that no evidence of wrongful out-of-home placements due to poor fact-finding has been found.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de berichtgeving betreffende Lysander de R. die de dienst uitmaakte in de gevangenis en de motorclub MC Hardliners

An MP asked the ministers about reports that prisoner Lysander de R. enjoyed privileges and led the MC Hardliners from prison despite internal staff reports, and why he was not moved to a stricter regime or the club banned earlier. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, described general selection and transfer procedures, and said the OM has now filed for a ban on the club.
I do not go into the situation regarding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het hoger beroep van moeders die gedwongen hun kind moesten afstaan in de periode 1956 tot en met 1984.

The SP MP Van Nispen asks whether the government honours the motion calling on the state to waive limitation defences in past domestic adoption cases, including the appeal by Trudy Scheele-Gertsen and Bureau Clara Wichmann. Minister Weerwind replies that limitation must remain available for legal certainty and a fair engagement with the past, that the state is not categorically excluding it, and that the independent commission's findings will be followed by appropriate consequences, to be reported around late 2024.
Being able to invoke limitation in legal proceedings is, in my view, essential for a balanced engagement with the past and for the proper functioning of the rule of law.
Het kunnen doen van een beroep op verjaring in een juridische procedure is mijns inziens essentieel voor een evenwichtige omgang met het verleden en voor het goed functioneren van de rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de zaak Willem Engel

Member Van Haga asked the ministers about the Willem Engel case, including alleged prosecution influence on a VOG decision, a GRIP registration, monitoring and a media campaign against Engel and Viruswaarheid, and the minister's public statements. The minister denied OM instructions and media campaigns, declined to discuss individual cases, and stated that intelligence services do not comment on their work.
As I also indicated in the earlier answer, I cannot make statements about specific VOG applications.
Zoals ik in de eerdere beantwoording ook aangaf, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over specifieke VOG-aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de plaatsing uit de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting van een van de grootste criminele kopstukken van Nederland

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the transfer of a major criminal leader out of the Extra Secure Facility (EBI) and the risks of moving high-risk prisoners to less restrictive regimes. The minister declined to comment on individual cases, described the annual placement review and appeal route, and pointed to additional measures such as a bill expanding powers to restrict communications.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker  en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Keer op keer werd de minister gewaarschuwd, en nu heeft Nederland 450.000 nieuwe gokkers'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether the government was warned about online gambling advertising increasing youth gambling after the 2021 Kansspelen op afstand law, and about the Finance Ministry's dealings with Nederlandse Loterij and the gambling sector. The minister declined to answer the historical questions substantively, promising a Kamerbrief after a document search, and summarised later advertising restrictions and the Finance Ministry's shareholder pressure on Nederlandse Loterij.
Answering these questions is only possible after a thorough search of information and communication systems and archives within my ministry.
Beantwoording van deze vragen acht ik alleen mogelijk na een grondige zoekslag in informatie- en communicatiesystemen en archieven binnen mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de schokkende adoptiemisstanden in Chili en het verhaal van de geadopteerde Mirjam Hunze

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about alleged child abduction and illegal adoption practices in Chile involving a Dutch nun, and about the Fiom files and a risk that records passed through the nun's heirs could be lost. The Minister acknowledged the cases, said an ongoing criminal investigation in Chile should be awaited, noted that Inea has received documents from the heirs and is inventorying them, and offered openness to talk with affected adoptees.
The Dutch embassy in Chile has confirmed that a criminal investigation is underway in Chile into several cases of alleged illegal adoption practices.
Door de Nederlandse ambassade in Chili is bevestigd dat er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Chili loopt naar meerdere gevallen van vermeende illegale adoptiepraktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het re-integratie traject van Bennie S.

An MP (Ellian, VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the re-integration track of a life-sentenced prisoner, including a December 2022 letter to victims' relatives, unanswered correspondence from a relative, and how victims and relatives can be heard in the review procedure. The Minister declined to discuss the individual case, acknowledged that communication with relatives needs improvement, and promised follow-up information in a progress letter in early 2024.
I cannot go into the specific circumstances of an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke omstandigheden van een individueel geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de borging van de kwaliteit van familierechtelijke onderzoeken

An MP asked whether the NIFP intends to stop mediating and quality-assuring family-law forensic reports, why, and how independent reporters' quality and access to expertise will be protected. The minister confirmed NIFP announced this in late 2022 due to workload and waiting times, that talks on alternative arrangements are ongoing, that the independent reporter remains responsible for quality, and that the government will report progress in spring 2024 without committing to specific interim steps.
I consider it important that the right of parents and children to counter-expertise, and the quality and independence of the reports, remain preserved.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat het recht van ouders en kinderen op contra-expertise, de kwaliteit en de onafhankelijkheid van de rapportages behouden blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de positieve resultaten van de evaluatie Huizen van het Recht en de vervolgplannen van het Kabinet

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the positive findings of the evaluation of the Huis van het Recht pilot in Heerlen and the government's follow-up plans. The minister welcomed the findings as valuable, declined a detailed policy response pending a WODC overarching analysis expected in early 2024, and promised to inform parliament on the national follow-up afterwards.
A comprehensive policy response to this specific evaluation report is not something I consider opportune.
Een uitgebreide beleidsreactie op dit specifieke evaluatierapport vind ik niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan  over het aan banden leggen van ChatGPT vanwege privacyzorgen

MP Van Raan asked the government about ChatGPT's alleged use of unlawfully obtained personal data, copyrighted press articles and biased sources, and whether the Dutch DPA should impose an urgent ban. The minister replied that the government lacks information to verify the claims, that the Dutch DPA has already asked OpenAI for clarification, and that a government vision on generative AI is forthcoming by year end.
I have no information position that enables me to verify the factual accuracy of investigative journalism concerning the conduct of an organisation in the private sector.
Ik heb geen informatiepositie die mij in staat stelt om de feitelijke juistheid te verifiëren van onderzoeksjournalistiek die ziet op de handelwijze van een organisatie in de private sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de grote toegevoegde waarde die rechtswinkels hebben voor eerstelijns rechtshulpverlening

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the value of law shops for first-line legal aid, their under-resourcing, and the lack of coverage in some regions. The minister agreed on the importance of collaboration with the bar and professionalisation, noted no proof yet that law shops relieve the legal process, and said mapping of first-line provision by Divosa is due in October 2023 while declining to set up new law shops or invest directly.
Divosa has therefore been asked to carry out a mapping study of independent first-line provision in all Dutch municipalities.
Daarom is Divosa gevraagd om een inventariserend onderzoek naar de onafhankelijke eerstelijnsvoorzieningen in alle gemeenten in Nederland te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de detentie van Willem Holleeder en zijn ziekenhuisbezoek

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how security is arranged for a high-risk EBI detainee during hospital stays, including visits, post, and whether Willem Holleeder's EBI regime was maintained at Leiden UMC, and about his placement alongside another detainee. The minister answered in general terms, declining to discuss individual detainees or security details, while pointing to safety plans, LBB guards, a planned bill for further restrictions, and a study into temporary high-security cells.
I will not go into the situation surrounding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rahimi en Ellian over het bericht 'Ambtenaar vervalste meerdere rapporten over beveiliging DigiD-aansluiting'

MPs Rahimi and Ellian asked about reports that an official at Justis falsified security audit reports for DigiD connections, including the 2020 Suwinet report. The minister answers that the official acted outside his assigned duties, four-eyes checks were introduced, digital signing and mandatory digital submission from 2024 were adopted, and a risk assessment and cause investigation are ongoing.
After the manipulation was discovered, the audit process at Justis was improved and tightened, for example by introducing the four-eyes principle.
Na de constatering van de manipulatie is bij Justis het auditproces verbeterd en aangescherpt, zo is bijvoorbeeld het vierogenprincipe ingevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een slachtoffers die na jaren procederen nog steeds geen geld heeft teruggekregen van hun bewezen oplichters en het opzetten van een fonds voor slachtoffers van oplichting

Van Nispen (SP) asked why a couple defrauded of 141,000 euro has, after five years of civil litigation, recovered nothing, and whether a state fund for fraud victims should be set up with the state recovering from perpetrators. The minister said he cannot comment on the individual case, pointed to criminal-case damages claims, civil enforcement by bailiffs and bank data procedures, announced lower court fees, and declined to create a victim fund or to investigate one.
I cannot go into this individual case, but I understand that having to litigate for years to recover the amount owed is extremely frustrating and can produce distressing situations.

Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele kwestie maar ik begrijp dat het jarenlang moeten procederen om het verschuldigde bedrag terug te krijgen buitengewoon frustrerend is en schrijnende situaties kan opleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de geblokkeerde herbenoeming van klokkenluiders bij het College voor de Rechten van de Mens

Leijten (SP) asks the Minister whether blocking the reappointment of whistleblowers at the College voor de Rechten van de Mens amounts to disadvantaging them, who is responsible for their protection, and why Parliament was not informed earlier. The Minister says protection duties apply, an independent Sorgdrager commission is investigating, the Minister cannot undo the Raad van Advies decision because of the College's independence, and Parliament was informed later after media coverage.
I have taken note of the decision of the College's Advisory Council shared on 3 April 2023 with the College members and the ministry.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van de beslissing van de Raad van Advies van het College die op 3 april 2023 is gedeeld met de leden van het College en met het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de totstandkoming van de brief over de toekomst van interlandelijke adoptie

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how the letter on the future of intercountry adoption was drafted, after press reports that an earlier draft proposed ending adoption and that D66 objected to it. The minister answers that his view has not changed, only the implementation: adoption remains possible in a stricter system, the five-year phase-out deadline was dropped, and he rejects the claim of backroom politics and declines to resubmit the decision to parliament.
On balance I have concluded that children's interests are best served when they can be safely cared for in their own country, culture, and close to their biological family.
Ik heb alles overwegend geconcludeerd dat de belangen van kinderen het beste zijn gediend wanneer zij in het eigen land, cultuur, dicht bij de biologische familie, veilig kunnen worden opgevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de stappen die hij op korte termijn gaat nemen om de knelpunten in de sociaal advocatuur te verbeteren

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection what short-term steps will address shortages in social legal aid, including VSAN criticism of indexation, advance payments and training subsidies. The minister replies that the plan covers short, medium and long term measures, keeps the 1 January 2024 indexation date, is examining reinstating advance payments, and states no extra short-term funds are available.
In the short term, no additional financial resources are available on top of that.
Op de korte termijn zijn daarbovenop geen extra financiële middelen beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over de petitie 'Een voldoende gebleken uiterste wil moet, ook zonder testament, worden gevolgd'

A D66 MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether an unsigned draft will should be valid when it clearly reflects the deceased's wishes, following a petition. The minister rejected a general rule, arguing signature and notarial formalities are needed for legal certainty, leaving exceptions to judicial assessment, and promised no legislative change.
I consider it of great importance that the last will is carried out in accordance with what the testator actually wanted.
Ik vind het van groot belang dat de uiterste wil wordt uitgevoerd overeenkomstig hetgeen de erflater werkelijk heeft gewild.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het bericht 'Vrouwen in gevangenis Nieuwersluis slachtoffer van seksuele misstanden'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of sexual abuse of female detainees by staff at Nieuwersluis prison, including when signals first arrived, why generic measures came late, supervision of male staff searching women, and whether similar problems exist in other institutions. The minister answered that signals were handled by the internal integrity bureau, that specific and DJI-wide measures have been taken and the Inspectorate's recommendations accepted, and that similar meldingen occur in men's prisons too.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Sneller over het persbericht van het Openbaar Ministerie ‘Nieuw college, nieuwe accenten‘

MPs Van der Werf and Sneller asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's announcement that it will focus less on crime prevention, asking about its reasons, effects on prevention programmes, and the coalition agreement. The minister said the OM remains committed to prevention, that the shift is about focusing on core enforcement and faster case handling, and that the coalition agreement commitments will be implemented.
The OM has assured me that the agreements made in the context of the Coalition Agreement are simply being implemented.
Het OM heeft mij verzekerd dat de afspraken die in het kader van het Coalitieakkoord zijn gemaakt gewoon worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Inleg verdubbeld, maar goede doelen winnen nauwelijks bij Koning Toto'

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether the state should be obliged to direct a substantial share of lottery and online gambling proceeds to sport and good causes, and what has been done under the Heerema/Mutluer motion on redirecting additional online gambling revenue. The minister answers that good-causes allocation is not a goal of gambling policy, cites the sport allocation figures, and says the matter will be assessed in the Koa law evaluation in 2024 and an exploration due before the 2024 budget debate.
Payment to good causes, however, is not a goal of gambling policy.
Afdracht aan goede doelen is echter niet een doel van het kansspelbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over geweld tegen jeugdzorgmedewerkers

An MP asked the government about rising aggression against youth care workers, the causes, complaint follow-up, prevention measures and information on incidents. The State Secretary answered that employers are primarily responsible, that no systematic data on incidents or sick leave is kept, and pointed to existing measures and planned regional meetings.
I do not know how many youth care workers drop out as a result of aggression in the work situation.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel jeugdzorgmedewerkers uitvallen als gevolg van agressie tijdens de werksituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over toezicht op geprivilegieerde gesprekken in de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether supervision of privileged (lawyer) communication with detainees in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting is justified, given family pressure on a lawyer-intermediary and the reach of Article 38(7) Pbw. The Minister replied that supervising the content of privileged contact is not permitted except in exceptional circumstances, and pointed to a bill allowing visual supervision and limiting detainees' legal assistants to two, without addressing the individual case.
I do not go into individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een onterecht veroordeelde man opnieuw achter de tralies is beland mede door toedoen van de Nederlandse overheid

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Dutch state contributed to a wrongly convicted man being re-jailed in Spain after a pardon was granted, and what the state would do to free him and compensate him. The minister declined to discuss the individual case on privacy grounds, referred to general procedures for pardons and information-sharing with foreign authorities, and said the handling would be reviewed if found inadequate.
I cannot provide you with detailed information on this without going into the particulars of the individual case.
Ik kan u hierover geen gedetailleerde informatie verschaffen zonder in te gaan op de bijzonderheden van de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen en Kuik over de handhaving van het aanstaande verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen door de Kansspelautoriteit

MPs asked whether the Kansspelautoriteit's chair signalled soft enforcement of the upcoming ban on untargeted online gambling advertising, and whether the regulator should fine every breach. The minister replied that enforcement is the regulator's responsibility, that normative talks precede fines, that operators had enough preparation time, and declined to discuss the chair's statements with the regulator.
It is up to the Ksa to give further substance to how it supervises and enforces compliance with the advertising ban.
Het is aan de Ksa om nader invulling te geven aan de wijze waarop zij toezicht houdt en handhaaft op naleving van het reclameverbod.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mogelijke vernietigen van adoptiedossiers door de Centrale autoriteit Internationale Kinderaangelegenheden en de rechten van geadopteerden in Nederland

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether adoption files were destroyed by intermediaries or the Central Authority, what remedies adoptees have, and whether the government will centralise access to files. The minister answered that about 50 metres of files were destroyed in 1999 under a 1978 retention list, that the files held little descent data, that INEA and an overview page will support adoptees, and that full centralisation is not feasible.
It is known that about 50 metres of files were destroyed in 1999, but it is unknown how many files this involved.
Er is bekend dat er ongeveer 50 meter aan dossiers in 1999 zijn vernietigd, onbekend is om hoeveel dossiers het hierbij ging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over drugsgebruik in gevangenissen

Member Kuik (CDA) asked the Justice and Health ministers about suspected widespread Spice use in Ter Apel prison, its health risks and detectability, sanctions for smuggling, addiction care, and measures to stop smuggling. Minister Weerwind answered that smuggling and use are punishable, detection is difficult and under study with new technology, no confirmed Spice deaths are known, and DJI is expanding information and reviewing foreign approaches, though no additional mortality testing is planned.
In addition, DJI also focuses on prevention of use and information provision.
Daarnaast zet DJI ook in op preventie van gebruik en voorlichting.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over rechtvaardige compensaties voor SBF-ers die door privatiseringen onder andere ministeries werkten dan het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (J&V) en nog geen uitzicht he

An SP MP asked why former SBF employees of privatised TBS clinics and youth institutions have not been compensated like Justice and Security civil servants, and whether the clinics should be held to earlier agreements. The Minister replied that compensation is the responsibility of the privatised clinics and institutions as employers, not the state, and declined to direct them.
It is the responsibility of the privatised clinic or institution to determine whether compensation is due to the SBF leave employee of that clinic or institution.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de verzelfstandigde kliniek of inrichting om na te gaan of een compensatie aan de orde is voor de SBF-verlofmedewerker van die kliniek of inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het hoger beroep van moeders die gedwongen hun kind moesten afstaan in de periode 1956 tot en met 1984

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the appeal by mothers forced to give up their children (1956-1984) seeking state recognition, the court's finding that the state did not act culpably, the expectation that the state would not invoke limitation periods, and what the government will do. The minister said an independent inquiry runs to end 2024, that the state will assess any limitation defence case by case under Supreme Court criteria, and that projects on dossier access and psychosocial support are underway.
That is why I consider it important that an independent commission now investigates what happened in the period 1956-1984.
Daarom vind ik het belangrijk dat er nu door een onafhankelijke commissie onderzoek wordt gedaan naar wat er in de periode 1956–1984 heeft plaatsgevonden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het ontbreken van een keurmerk voor mediators

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why mediators lack a quality mark, following a news report on a divorce mediation gone wrong, and why implementation of a 2022 motion for a central mediator register is slow. The minister says the register is being developed in consultation with the field, a quality-mark option is among those explored, and he will inform parliament shortly after the summer recess.
I have taken up the implementation of that motion.
Ik heb de uitvoering van die motie ter hand genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het rapport van de ADR over eMates.

MP Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Auditdienst Rijk report on the eMates messaging service used by prisons, including why contact was sought despite a rejected motion, the limited audit depth, unlawful data processing risks, and oversight gaps. The Minister answered that DJI ended cooperation with eMates, that the audit gave sufficient insight for that decision, that data-breach and settlement questions are still under legal review, and that an in-house alternative is being studied.
Following the ADR's findings, DJI decided to permanently end its cooperation with the messaging service.
Naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van de ADR heeft DJI besloten de medewerking aan de berichtenservice definitief te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitsluiting van de rechtstoegang voor mensen die op papier een hoger inkomen hebben dan de grens van de Wet op de rechtsbijstand

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about middle-income people who fall outside legal aid income limits and about self-employed people without staff being excluded from legal aid for business matters. The Minister acknowledged the signals and some distressing cases, pointed to alternatives such as legal expenses insurance and social lawyers, and committed to further research and to continued talks with the Juridisch Loket on improving access.
That is why I will first carry out further research into this, so that I can then make well-founded choices to actually help people who fall between the cracks.
Daarom ga ik daar eerst nader onderzoek naar doen, om vervolgens goed onderbouwde keuzes te kunnen maken om mensen die tussen wal en schip vallen daadwerkelijk te helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer 'Betalingsregelingen bij uitvoeringsorganisaties van het Rijk

MP Ceder asks how the government views the Court of Audit finding that people with tailored payment arrangements may still fall into hardship because the subsistence minimum is insufficiently protected, and what will be done about it, including common norms, automatic insight into debts, and ways to reduce the effort required. The minister commits to working with agencies on protecting the subsistence minimum, exploring legal changes for shared debt visibility, and developing a government debt overview, while the Tax Authority says it cannot yet guarantee the minimum due to limited information on private debts.
I want to investigate whether it is possible to amend the laws and regulations on this point.
Ik wil onderzoeken of het mogelijk is om de wet- en regelgeving op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van den Hil en Ellian over het bericht ‘Geef crisisdienst direct toegang tot hoger beveiligde bedden’

Two VVD MPs asked whether the government will give crisis services direct access to high-security psychiatric beds, how many such beds exist per province, and what it will do about shortages. The minister rejected direct access, citing the need for proper assessment and placement, reported 1737 secured beds in 2022 and pointed to a dashboard, a coordination point, regional inventories and a joint evaluation as measures.
We do not consider it desirable to give crisis services direct access to high-security care.
We vinden het niet wenselijk om crisisdiensten direct toegang te geven tot de (hoog) beveiligde zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kamminga en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Zelensky wil actie tegen Russische gokbedrijven op Curaçao’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that Ukraine sanctioned Curaçao-based online gambling firms, and about oversight of those firms. The minister answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and supervision, that Nederland has no direct role, and that a new independent gaming regulator is planned under the Landspakket with a target of end-2023.
Curaçao is an autonomous country within the Kingdom and has its own gambling legislation and regulations.
Curaçao is een autonoom land binnen het Koninkrijk en heeft eigen kansspelwet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Van der Werf en Wuite over het niet tenuitvoerleggen van gevangenisstraffen op Sint Maarten

Dutch MPs asked why at least 136 convicted persons on Sint Maarten were not serving prison sentences due to lack of detention capacity, and about the effects on rule of law, investment imbalance and a new prison. The government answered that prison administration is a national responsibility of Sint Maarten, outlined Dutch funding and the UNOPS new-prison project (target 2028), and described temporary transfers of detainees to the Netherlands while declining to give the size of the shortage.
Prison administration is a matter for the constituent country.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Ellian over het document ‘Bestuursrecht en verklaring omtrent het gedrag’

MPs Heerema and Ellian asked whether people with a history of sexual intimidation or abuse should be barred from coaching children, and why sport disciplinary rulings are not factored into VOG screening after the sport register was closed. The minister acknowledged the lack of data linkage, said the Ministry of Justice considers disciplinary rulings unsuitable for VOG screening because they fall outside criminal law, and said the sport register closure is under discussion toward a future integrity centre.
The Ministry of Justice and Security, responsible for VOG screening, considers it undesirable to include disciplinary rulings in VOG screening because disciplinary law falls outside criminal law.

Het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, verantwoordelijk voor de VOG screening, acht het niet wenselijk tuchtrechtelijke uitspraken te betrekken bij de VOG screening omdat het tuchtrecht buiten het strafrecht valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Markuszower over het bericht ‘Dader verkrachting verdacht van nieuwe verkrachting tijdens proefverlof’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a convicted rapist was granted leave in 2022 and whether such offenders should never get leave; the minister declined to discuss individual cases, described the leave regime and responsible officials, and rejected the call for categorical exclusion and life imprisonment. The answers restate existing rules without committing to any new action.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over de moord op een gedetineerde door zijn celgenoot in Krimpen aan den IJssel

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the murder of a detainee by his cellmate in Krimpen aan den IJssel, including whether the placement decision, the double-cell policy, notification of relatives and prevention measures were adequate. The minister said a DJI incident investigation and a police inquiry are ongoing, described the placement criteria and the policy on double cells, and deferred conclusions and further measures until the investigation results are available.
I am awaiting the results of the investigation and will share the conclusions with your House.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek af en zal de conclusies met uw Kamer delen.

Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uitspraak op 14 april 2023 van de Rechtbank Midden-Nederland waarin een nadere beslistermijn voor alle zaken bij de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT) tot juli

An MP asks the State Secretary for Finance and the Minister for Legal Protection whether a court ruling postponing UHT's decision deadline to July 2024 undermines access to justice and rule of law under the Constitution and ECHR, and about the state's appeal, dossier delays and court–government consultation. The government replies that legal protection remains available, that the ruling does not block access to court, that it has appealed the ruling, and that a delayed UHT decision is not a constitutional violation; it declines to give some detail on dossiers and says it will share consultation minutes.
Parents retain unchanged the right to file an appeal for failure to decide in time.
Ouders hebben onveranderd het recht een beroep niet-tijdig beslissen in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Sneller over het bericht ‘Journalist Ana van Es werd opgeroepen om te getuigen. ‘Dit schrikt bronnen af’, zegt haar advocaat'

D66 MPs asked whether summoning journalist Ana van Es as a witness, and the resulting risk to source protection, is acceptable under the Wet bronbescherming in strafzaken. The ministers said they cannot comment on individual criminal cases, pointed to the law's safeguards and its evaluation, and stated that journalists may refuse to answer questions about sources even when summoned.
It is not for me to comment on individual criminal cases.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op individuele strafzaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over het nieuws dat kringloopwinkels zich grote zorgen maken om het moeten bijhouden van een verplicht register voor alle binnengekomen producten middels het Digitaal

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about concerns from thrift shops over a mandatory product register via the Digitaal Opkopers Register, and whether it serves to prevent handling stolen goods and money laundering. The minister answered that the registration duty already exists, that it will be narrowed to theft-sensitive goods with a limited regime for free-donated items, and that a proportionate arrangement is being negotiated with the trade association.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen inzake de betrokkenheid van het Ministerie van J&V en de DJI bij de zaak Engel

Rep. Van Haga asks the Ministers of Legal Protection and Justice & Security why the OM shared a summons with Justis, why a VOG decision was taken on 23 March 2022, why access to a prison was refused, and about the Engel case and NCTV involvement. The ministers answer that the VOG process and information requests follow fixed procedure, that no political instruction occurred, that no access was refused, and that information about an ongoing criminal case is withheld in the interest of the State and privacy.
Beyond being informed about this case, she has no other involvement in this case.
Naast dat zij geïnformeerd is in deze zaak heeft zij verder geen betrokkenheid bij deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de gevolgen voor mensen als de Staat blijft procederen

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether the State should be more restrained in appealing against citizens who already won in first instance, given the financial and mental burden, and whether the framework 'Behoorlijk omgaan met schadeclaims' and the Leijten/Ellian motion on the State as litigant will be applied. The minister acknowledges the burden, says the existing framework requires restraint and weighing of individual interests and that its current relevance will be reviewed, with a government update expected around summer.
As I indicated above, there is a framework within central government to ensure proper handling of damage claims within central government.
Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven, bestaat er binnen de rijksoverheid een kader om een behoorlijke omgang met schadeclaims binnen de rijksoverheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er opnieuw minder sociaal advocaten actief zijn in het stelstel

Senator Van Nispen (SP) asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that fewer social lawyers are active in the legal aid system despite rising case numbers, and about the causes, the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand's warnings, fees, training costs, the point system and a proposal from the Vereniging Advocatenbelangen. The minister acknowledges the shortage risk, points to a plan of action with training subsidies, pay improvements and a possible fund, and commits to further work and a progress report before summer.
In the coming period I will intensively work on strengthening the social legal profession so that possible shortages are prevented.
De komende tijd ga ik intensief aan de slag met de versterking van de sociale advocatuur zodat mogelijke tekorten worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het risico op genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the government about calls to female genital mutilation in a religious setting, whether such statements incite violence, which legal or administrative tools exist, and how girls at risk abroad are protected. The government answered that incitement to violence is criminal regardless of context, that statements not amounting to crime cannot be countered administratively, and it outlined prevention measures, airport alertness indicators, and a planned bill on informal education.

Statements about female genital mutilation that do not constitute a criminal offence are protected by freedom of expression under Article 7 of the Constitution and Article 10 of the European Convention on Human Rights.

Uitlatingen over vrouwelijke genitale verminking die geen strafbaar feit opleveren, worden beschermd door de vrijheid van meningsuiting, hetgeen is vervat in artikel 7 van de Grondwet en artikel 10 van het Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden (EVRM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over Nederlanders in detentie in het buitenland

MP Sneller asked the Justice and Rule of Law ministers about Dutch nationals detained abroad, the EU evaluation of the WETS transfer procedure (administrative rather than judicial, with limited rights for convicted persons) and the WOTS procedure, including the binding test, transparency and evaluation. Minister Weerwind answered that the procedure is compatible with the framework decision, that the convicted person's rights are adequately protected, and that he will send a policy response before the summer recess; he defended the binding test and gave partial, sometimes data-limited figures.
My policy response to the evaluation report of the Council of the European Union will be sent to your House before the summer recess.
Mijn beleidsreactie op het evaluatierapport van de Raad van de Europese Unie zal ik uw Kamer voor het zomerreces doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over proceskostenvergoedingen in Mulderzaken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether procedural cost awards in Mulderzaken (traffic fine appeals) flow to no-cure-no-pay agencies, how high they are, and whether incentives are perverse. The minister confirmed such awards occur, reported rising totals up to 5.6 million euro in 2021, commissioned WODC research on abuse of the cost scheme, but did not yet give the average per case.
In the short term it cannot be answered what average amount is involved per case. I will inform the House of this later, once I have received the data.
Op deze korte termijn kan niet beantwoord worden welk bedrag er gemiddeld per zaak gemoeid is. Hierover zal ik uw Kamer, zodra ik de gegevens ontvangen heb, alsnog informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de dood van een gedetineerde in een meerpersoonscel

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the death of a detainee in a shared cell at PI Krimpen aan den IJssel, the screening of prisoners for shared cells, occupancy rates, rights protection, and staff risks. The minister expressed sympathy, described screening criteria and the complaint routes, and said a calamity investigation is underway and that measures will follow from its results.
Following this incident, DJI has started a calamity investigation to gain more insight into the circumstances and background.
DJI is naar aanleiding van dit incident een calamiteitenonderzoek gestart om meer inzicht te krijgen in de toedracht en achtergronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over jongeren met een licht verstandelijke beperking in de criminaliteit

MP Mutluer asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about young people with mild intellectual disabilities being recruited into crime and exploited, and about police, care and information gaps. The government acknowledges overrepresentation in youth justice and difficulty for police in recognising the disability, points to ongoing prevention programmes, a forthcoming WODC study and a care-continuity study, but declines to launch new pilots.
We will ask the Scientific Research and Documentation Centre to conduct research on this, and will inform the House about it.
Wij zullen het Wetenschappelijk Onderzoek- en Documentatiecentrum vragen om hier onderzoek naar te doen, en zullen uw Kamer hierover informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over dilemma’s bij schuldhulpverleners om te kunnen handelen in het belang van cliënten als ontstaan effect van het recent aangenomen wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Wsnp

An MP asked about dilemmas for debt counsellors who, pending the entry into force of the amended Wsnp (debt rescheduling act), must weigh filing petitions now against a shorter 18-month term from 1 January 2024, and asked for a clear policy with the judiciary and other partners. The Minister acknowledges the problem, says the new rules apply on entry into force with no transitional law, and states that the government is consulting partners to bring the law into force as soon as possible.
That is why I am now consulting with practitioners to bring the new law into force as soon as possible.
Daarom ben ik nu in overleg met de praktijk om de nieuwe wet zo spoedig mogelijk in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht ‘IS-vrouwen waren geen brave huismoeders – ze deden in wapens, explosieven en slaven, volgens het OM’

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Ellian asked why IS returnees, repatriated at their own request to attend their trials, are largely absent from substantive hearings, and whether Yazidi victims' rights are thereby harmed. The Minister says the victim-rights law's appearance duty is not yet in force, that courts can order attendance, that trial absence is for judges to decide, and that a new implementation date will be announced in April 2023.

In general terms, I would say it goes against my sense of justice if a suspect of terrorist offences, who deliberately travelled to ISIS territory and was then repatriated to the Netherlands by the Dutch State because they wish to be present in person at their criminal case, were then not present at the substantive hearing of the case.

In algemene zin wil ik aangeven dat het tegen mijn rechtvaardigheidsgevoel ingaat indien een verdachte van terroristische misdrijven, die bewust is uitgereisd naar ISIS-gebied en daarna door de Nederlandse Staat naar Nederland is gerepatrieerd omdat hij/zij in persoon aanwezig wil zijn bij de strafzaak, vervolgens niet bij de inhoudelijke behandeling van de strafzaak aanwezig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat rechters en officieren voor het eerst in de Nederlandse geschiedenis willen gaan staken

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about judges and prosecutors threatening a first-ever strike over their collective labour agreement and workload, and about related warnings from the judiciary's association. The minister acknowledged the right to strike, pointed to large investments in the judiciary and prosecution service, and said he would answer the substantive questions once negotiations resume, which they did on 23 March.
Because the negotiations are still ongoing, I cannot yet make further statements on this.
Vanwege de nog lopende besprekingen kan ik hier nog geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Experts wereldwijd roepen op tot afschaffing draagmoederschap’

Member Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the minister whether the government will act on a global expert call to abolish surrogacy and whether this changes its position. The minister rejects the abolition call, says a regulatory bill for responsible surrogacy is being prepared, and notes ongoing international efforts without committing to a ban.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Meer geld naar gokreclames in aanloop naar verbod’

MPs Van Nispen, Bikker and Mutluer asked why gambling advertising spending rose despite industry self-regulation promises, and when the promised ban would take effect. The Minister said a ban on untargeted online gambling advertising takes effect by 1 July 2023, that self-regulation is insufficient, and that he has repeatedly urged restraint from state-owned gambling companies.
The ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling will be adopted shortly and takes effect by 1 July 2023 at the latest.
Het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen wordt binnenkort vastgesteld en treedt uiterlijk per 1 juli 2023 in werking.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de koppeling van persoonsgegevens van uithuisgeplaatste kinderen en onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsingen en het kinderopvangtoeslagschandaal, waar de Kamer al in 202

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Legal Protection and state secretaries about linking personal data of children placed out of home, independent research into out-of-home placements and the childcare benefits scandal, and why the bill on temporary data exchange did not include an independent-research objective as the 2021 motion requested. The government answered that independent research now exists via a Hamer commission, a CBS study found no group-level link to child protection measures, and the Inspectorate's second study is ongoing, while several answers note data handling and procedural constraints.
I sent the House a memorandum of amendment to the bill Temporary Law on Exchange of Personal Data UHP KOT on 16 March 2023.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 16 maart 2023 een nota van wijziging op het wetsvoorstel Tijdelijke wet uitwisseling persoonsgegevens UHP KOT toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij en Mutluer over het bericht 'Zorgen om online gokken in de klas: ‘Ze denken snel geld te verdienen’'

MPs from four parties asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health how minors gain access to online gambling accounts, whether gambling operators take age checks seriously, and when a ban on gambling advertising takes effect, including whether a two-strikes model should apply. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the Kansspelautoriteit has received no signals of circumvention, promises awareness activities and a ban on untargeted gambling ads by 1 July 2023, but rejects a two-strikes model as not fitting proportionate enforcement.
That is why I am doing everything I can to bring the ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling into effect as soon as possible.
Daarom stel ik alles in het werk om het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen zo snel mogelijk in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

D66 MPs asked ministers whether the Utrecht court ruling that the mayor could not impose an online area ban (ruling it an impermissible restriction of free expression reserved to national legislation) should be accepted, and what alternatives exist to tackle online incitement. The government declined to comment on the pending case, outlined administrative measures and a framework for mayoral powers, and said it would consider alternatives without committing to a specific legislative proposal.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to make statements about individual and/or pending cases.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om uitspraken te doen over individuele en/of lopende zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de nadelige positie waarin vaders zich bevinden na een scheiding

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about research suggesting fathers fare worse than mothers after contested divorces, including bias in the professional system and the advice of an expert team on parental alienation. The minister said the full pilot report is still being studied, stated that the state's policy is based on equal parenting, announced further training and a Digiplein platform, and said that decisions on tougher measures await a WODC study expected in April 2023.
The definitive and complete research report I received very recently and it is still being studied.
Het definitieve en volledige onderzoeksrapport heb ik zeer recent ontvangen en wordt momenteel nog bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat de politie kleine criminaliteit laat schieten

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a press report that police in Oost-Nederland leave minor crimes such as fraud, animal cruelty and small cannabis cultivation unpursued, and about the internal guidance document behind this and its impact on victims. The minister confirmed the document is an operational tool still under discussion with mayors, said it is not a list of crimes never pursued, acknowledged capacity shortages, and pointed to extra police capacity, restorative justice and the selectivity framework.
I cannot share it with your House for now, because it is still under discussion with the mayors in the Oost-Nederland regional unit.
Ik kan het nu nog niet delen met uw Kamer, omdat het nog onderwerp van bespreking is met de burgemeesters in de regionale eenheid Oost-Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over kinderontvoeringen naar Polen en het negeren van een Europees Aanhoudingsbevel

An MP asked about a Dutch mother who allegedly abducted four children to Poland, Polish courts' use of Hague Convention refusal grounds, and Poland's refusal to execute a European Arrest Warrant. The government acknowledges some enforcement problems rooted in Polish national law, cites an EU Court ruling and a Commission infringement procedure, and promises a protocol on holding states accountable by summer 2023.
I cannot comment on a judicial decision of another EU member state in an individual case.
Op een rechterlijke beslissing van een andere lidstaat van de Europese Unie in een individuele zaak kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rajkowski en Van den Hil over het bericht ‘Ik heb je data nodig, want ik wil weten hoe duur je bent’

MPs Rajkowski and Van den Hil asked, after press reports, about the legal basis for the Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit's mandatory one-off collection of patient-level mental health data, who can see the data, why it is needed, and whether patients can access logs. The minister answered that the NZa's powers rest on the Wmg and AVG, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens found the collection lawful with conditions, data are stored securely with logging and a non-linkage guarantee, but patients cannot ask the NZa who viewed their data and must ask their provider instead.
It is not always known to clients and patients which data are shared with whom.
Het is niet altijd bekend bij cliënten en patiënten welke gegevens met wie worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verkuijlen over het bericht 'Pubers met granaten en tonnen winst door cybercrime: 'Almere visvijver criminelen''

An MP asked why Almere, described as a breeding ground for youth recruited into organised crime, was not included in the 'Preventie met Gezag' programme, and on what criteria municipalities were selected. The minister answered that Almere is being considered for inclusion after a preselection of eight municipalities, that funding per municipality is listed, and that effectiveness will be monitored through a learning approach.
Almere has been selected to be included in the Preventie met Gezag approach.
Almere is geselecteerd om te worden opgenomen binnen de aanpak Preventie met Gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de betrokkenheid van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de DJI bij de zaak Engel

MP Van Haga asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the ministry and DJI were involved in the Engel case, including a VOG (certificate of good conduct) refusal based on a draft summons, whether instructions were given, whether confidentiality was requested, and why he was not allowed to visit Engel at PI Hoogvliet. The minister declined to discuss specific VOG and court procedures, denied instructions or ministry contact with the prison, and described the general VOG and confidentiality procedures.
I do not make statements about specific VOG applications.
Over specifieke VOG-aanvragen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de klokkenluider Huig Plug

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the whistleblower Huig Plug, the Scheveningen prison hospital JCvSZ, the CALOC report and inspection responses, the internal inquiry, dismissals and alleged intimidation. The minister answers that the CALOC report is not released for privacy and medical reasons, that the Inspectorate of Justice and Security received the notice but took no further action, that the whistleblower was not recognised as such, and that the scope of the inquiry was unchanged.

I do not release this report. CALOC reports are intended solely for internal use and, once the investigation is completed, become the property of the Director of the facility where the incident occurred.

Ik geef dit rapport niet vrij. CALOC-rapporten zijn uitsluitend bestemd voor intern gebruik en worden na afronding van het onderzoek daarvan eigendom van de Vestigingsdirecteur van de vestiging waar het incident heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat er toch weer jeugddelinquenten geplaatst worden in Cadier en Keer

An MP asked whether juvenile offenders are being placed in closed youth care facilities (Cadier en Keer) alongside vulnerable youths, and why the small-scale juvenile justice facilities (KVJJ) are under-used. The Minister replies that the reported sequence is incorrect since closed youth care placement always requires a separate civil court authorisation, and defends the mixed-group approach while announcing a review of KVJJ placement criteria with results expected by June 2023.
Placement in closed youth care always requires a separate (civil law) authorisation from the children's judge.
Voor de plaatsing in de gesloten jeugdhulp is altijd een afzonderlijke (civielrechtelijke) machtiging van de kinderrechter vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Sneller over het bericht 'Een witbrood stelen om de kinderen te laten eten: de oneindige spiraal van schulden en criminaliteit'

MPs Kat and Sneller asked about a press report linking debt to recidivism, the share of prisoners with debts and access to debt assistance, CJIB debt-relief rules, and judges' knowledge of defendants' finances. The minister acknowledges the debt-crime link and describes existing debt-support routes and reclassering initiatives, but gives no current figures on prisoners receiving debt help and says a fuller answer on the probation thesis' recommendations will follow by end 2023.
There is no recent data available on the total percentage of detainees who struggle with debts.
Er zijn geen recente gegevens bekend over het totale percentage gedetineerden dat kampt met schulden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering, Wassenberg en Van Esch over het zwijgcontract dat omwonenden van eendenslachterij Tomassen Duck-To in Ermelo moesten tekenen om te voorkomen dat zij bezwaar maken tegen de overl

Three PvdD MPs asked whether a clause requiring residents near the Ermelo duck slaughterhouse to pay 10,000 euro if they objected to nuisance, reportedly via a chain clause in purchase contracts, undermines their legal rights. The government answered that private parties may agree such terms within limits set by law, public order and good morals, that courts decide admissibility, and that residents remain free to have the clause tested in civil court.
Agreements that restrict access to justice too much will quickly be inadmissible within these limits.
Afspraken die de toegang tot het recht te zeer beperken zullen binnen deze grenzen al snel ontoelaatbaar zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de ernstige tekortkomingen bij jeugdgevangenissen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about inspectorates' warnings that youth detention facilities have reached a critical limit, including whether judges and placement decisions reflect shortages and whether minors are placed in adult prisons. The minister confirmed the warnings, acknowledged shortages, and said additional measures were taken, but gave partial answers and denied any opname-stop or minors in adult prisons, while noting that young adults may be held in remand centres.
I have not held talks with the inspectorates about this inspection letter.
Ik ben over deze inspectiebrief niet in gesprek geweest met de inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het artikel 'Achternaam minderjarige wijzigen'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether foster children's surnames can be changed to a biological parent's name, and related questions on consent and hardship clauses. The minister answered that changes are restricted to cases meeting care-period conditions, that consent depends on custody rather than biological parenthood, and that article 7 of the decree functions as a hardship clause.
In my view, a change in the law is not necessary for the situation described in question 5.
Mijns inziens is een wetswijziging voor de situatie zoals beschreven in vraag 5 niet nodig
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het gebrek aan hulp aan gestrafte jongeren

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about reports that half of court-ordered help for young offenders is not provided or provided too late, and whether this raises reoffending. The government says such non-delivery is not registered, accepts that specialist help is needed and that it may contribute to reoffending, and points to ongoing procurement reforms and an exploration of youth-justice help without committing to central national arrangement.
I am working with the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport and the Association of Dutch Municipalities on the bill 'Act improving the availability of care for young people'.

Ik werk samen met de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS) en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) aan het wetvoorstel «Wet verbetering beschikbaarheid zorg voor jeugdigen»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan hulp voor nabestaanden van moord met psychische problematiek

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the lack of help for relatives bereaved by murder who develop complicated grief, including whether insurers, occupational health services and mental health waiting lists are barriers. The ministers acknowledge the impact and need for tailored support, deny signals of insufficient recognition or insurer refusal, and point to existing waiting-list agreements and planned monitoring without committing to new concrete steps.
However, which assistance and support a person has been helped with can differ per bereaved person.
Met welke bijstand en ondersteuning iemand is geholpen kan evenwel per nabestaande verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Sneller en Kat over het bericht 'Gokbedrijven probeerden ondanks verbod via wk-pools nieuwe klanten te lokken'

MPs Romke de Jong, Sneller and Kat asked the government about reports that gambling firms, including state holding Nederlandse Loterij, advertised via World Cup pools despite a ban, and about the state's oversight as shareholder. The government answered that it was unaware of the World Cup pool ads, that the Gaming Authority fined Nederlandse Loterij for advertising aimed at young adults, that it has voiced concerns to the holdings, and that it is evaluating the shareholding while declining to disclose the number of young players.
This information is not known to me or to my colleague the Minister for Legal Protection because it concerns confidential business information.
Deze informatie is bij mij of mijn collega de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet bekend omdat dit vertrouwelijke bedrijfsinformatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over een onderzoek naar de oorzaken van de verharding van jeugdcriminaliteit

An MP asks the Justice and Security and Legal Protection ministers whether juvenile crime is becoming more violent and whether comprehensive research into its causes exists. The ministers acknowledge a rise in serious juvenile offences, list ongoing and completed studies (EPIC, WODC deelstudies, Bureau Beke), and say they agree overarching research is important without committing to a new study.
We also believe such research is of great importance and that is why it has been set in motion.
Wij zijn ook van mening dat dergelijk onderzoek van groot belang is en daarom is dat in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de voortgang van interlandelijke adoptie

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the phase-out of intercountry adoption programmes would let pending adoption files, especially US cases, be completed or taken over by the new central mediation body (CBO), and whether affected parents had been promised that their procedures would be finished. The Minister confirmed that files in phase-out countries will not be transferred to the CBO, that existing mediators may continue until mid-2025, and that parents can switch to a continuing country instead.

Not burdening the CBO with the files in countries of origin with which the adoption relationship is ended does not mean that the adoption procedures of these prospective adoptive parents stop immediately.

Het niet belasten van de CBO met de dossiers die in landen van herkomst liggen waarmee de adoptierelatie wordt beëindigd houdt overigens niet in dat de adoptieprocedures van deze aspirant-adoptiefouders per direct stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van der Staaij, Bikker en Kuik over het bericht ‘Hulpverleners zien alarmerende groei probleemgedrag met online gokken’

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Bikker, Kuik) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising gambling addiction after the online gambling market was opened, and about enforcement, the Cruks self-exclusion register, and the gambling advertising ban. The minister answered that reliable data are not yet available, promised a monitor with first results in autumn 2023, said the Kansspelautoriteit is investigating operators' duty of care and that stricter limits may follow, noted a Cruks redesign due April 2023, and said the advertising ban decision is being finalised after Council of State advice.
That is why I want to monitor developments over a longer period to strengthen the information position and to be able to form a reliable picture.
Daarom wil ik de ontwikkelingen over een langere tijd monitoren om de informatiepositie te versterken en een betrouwbaar beeld te kunnen vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de communicatie tussen familieleden van en met AIT-en EBI gedetineerden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the prosecution's claim that relatives of Ridouan Taghi are part of his criminal organisation justifies restricting their communication with him, and why such contact is permitted. The minister declined to comment on individual detainees, stated that contact may be restricted when misuse is suspected, and said a bill tightening supervision under the Penitentiary Principles Act is expected in April 2023.
I will not go into the situation surrounding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de problemen in de klinieken in het terbeschikking (tbs-)stelsel

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about problems in tbs clinics, including capacity pressure, staff workload, incidents, bureaucracy, quality and security measures, and aftercare for staff with trauma. The minister acknowledges capacity pressure and staffing problems, denies the system is unsustainable, and describes measures such as new places, a quality framework, security works and a new procurement strategy, while declining to comment on an ongoing lawsuit.
Because the lawsuit you refer to is still ongoing, I cannot go into this further.
Omdat de rechtszaak waar u aan refereert nog loopt, kan ik hier verder niet op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het aansturen van een criminele organisatie vanuit detentie door Benaouf A.

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a criminal kingpin, Benaouf A., could direct a criminal organisation from detention and why he was not placed in the EBI high-security prison. The minister condemned the situation, said the government prioritises combating criminal conduct in detention, and pointed to a revised placement regulation and planned information-sharing and intensive-supervision measures, while declining to discuss individual cases.
I will not go into the situation surrounding individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Werner en Agnes Mulder over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, dat 6 jaar geleden is ontvoerd naar India

Two CDA MPs asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Dutch girl Insiya, abducted to India six years ago, and what has been done to restore her contact with her mother and return her to the Netherlands. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government raises the case with Indian authorities, relies on Indian court proceedings with no timeline for return, and that India has said the father's pending cases cannot be pursued in the local courts.
Unfortunately, no timeframe can currently be given for Insiya's return.
Er is helaas op dit moment geen termijn te geven voor de terugkeer van Insiya.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Leijten over de rechtsstaat en beloofde verbeteringen na het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Omtzigt and Leijten asked the government about progress on promises made after the childcare benefits scandal, including the eleven 'buikpijn' cases, the implementation of softer legal discretion, the role of inspectorates and ombudsman signals, the Landsadvocaat, and the Ministerial Commission on the childcare benefits recovery. The minister answered that the cases are being pursued by the relevant departments, gave progress updates across the reaction to the 'Ongekend onrecht' report, and said the Landsadvocaat and commission data are not available as overviews, while promising ongoing reporting to parliament.
No overviews are available of that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Chris Simons over de vertraging bij de realisatie van het Justitieel Complex Vlissingen

MPs Ellian and Chris Simons asked why the Justitieel Complex Vlissingen (EBI) is delayed to around eight years, whether Zeeland faces abandonment, how to provide high-security cells sooner, and whether tendering can be accelerated. Minister Weerwind answered that the delay is regrettable but the project is not cancelled, that an EBI-plus or mini-EBI is only being studied, and that EU tender rules and a switch to partly secret tendering cause the extra time.
The arrival of the JCV is absolutely not up for discussion.
De komst van het JCV staat absoluut niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk en Knops over de toegang tot veteranenzorg ‘achter slot en grendel’

Two MPs from the CDA asked why veterans in detention may not be placed in the Military Penitentiary Centre in Stroe, which has low occupancy, and what cooperation exists between Justice, Defence and the Netherlands Veterans Institute. The ministers answered that an exploration of placing some detained veterans there is underway with results due in Q1 2023, that a convenant covering certain non-military detainees was signed on 6 December 2022, and that veterans in detention are identified at intake and linked to veteran care.
The outcomes will be reported to the House in more detail in the first quarter of this year.
Over de uitkomsten wordt uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van dit jaar nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Dekker-Abdulaziz over het online gebiedsverbod

Two D66 MPs asked the government about Almelo's municipal bylaw banning online posts that could cause physical disruption of public order, including enforcement, constitutional free-speech concerns under Article 7 of the Constitution, and the lack of a promised legal framework for municipal online monitoring. The Justice Minister answered that municipalities are primarily responsible for their bylaws, that enforcement rests with the mayor, that the censorship ban limits municipalities, and that the promised guidance on social media monitoring is delayed to Q1 2023.
I have understanding for the search by municipalities for ways to maintain public order where the cause lies in online conduct.
Ik heb begrip voor de zoektocht van gemeenten naar manieren om de openbare orde te handhaven als de oorzaak is gelegen in online gedragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Mensen met schulden merken niets van hogere lonen en uitkeringen'

An MP asked the ministers whether debt-relief recipients benefit from the higher minimum wage through an adjusted beslagvrije voet, and about fee indexation for bewindvoerders. The government answered that recalculation happens during 2023 on request or annually, promised a proactive joint approach with the enforcement chain, and explained that trustee fees are not indexed in 2023 due to the formula's reference year.
We are urgently taking steps to ensure that financially vulnerable people quickly feel the effects of the minimum wage increase in their wallets.
Wij zetten met urgentie stappen om te bewerkstelligen dat financieel kwetsbare mensen de gevolgen van de stijging van het wettelijk minimumloon snel merken in hun portemonnee.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel: ‘De rechtspraak is kennelijk alleen openbaar voorzover het de rechter behaagt’

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a press report that a court refused a person access to a judgment on grounds of insufficient interest, and why publication of judgments matters. The Minister replies that the decision to release judgments to non-parties lies with the independent judiciary under the Code of Criminal Procedure, that publication on rechtspraak.nl is the broader form of openness, and that he will inform parliament further in early 2023.
It is not for a minister to decide whether a court judgment is provided to someone other than a party to the proceedings or a lawyer.
Het is niet aan een bewindspersoon om te bepalen of een rechterlijke uitspraak wordt verstrekt aan iemand anders dan een procespartij of advocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ellian en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Adviescommissie stapt op omdat minister ongeschikte notarissen benoemt'
