MPs Knops, Ellian and Van Nispen asked why the Minister for Legal Protection appointed candidate notaries against negative advice from the advisory committee, which resigned, and about delays and information to parliament. The minister confirmed the resignation and that he departed from negative advice in three cases in 2022, after hearing and objection procedures, and committed to clarifying the notion of personal suitability and informing parliament.
In all three cases, after inserting a comment phase with a view to the required care and legal obligation and in one case an objection phase, I concluded that appointment would be justified.

In alle drie de gevallen ben ik – na het inlassen van een zienswijzefase met het oog op de vereiste zorgvuldigheid en wettelijke verplichting en in een geval een bezwaarfase – tot de conclusie gekomen dat benoeming verantwoord zou zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht 'Adviescommissie stapt op omdat minister ongeschikte notarissen benoemt'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the minister overrode negative advice from the notary-candidate advisory commission (CTN) on integrity and suitability, and how the appointment process works. The minister confirmed three overrides in 2022, explained the procedure, and stated that integrity violations cannot be ruled out but that appointments proceed only when concerns are adequately addressed; a new interim commission was appointed.
In 2022 I departed from a negative advice of the CTN in three cases.
In 2022 ben ik in drie gevallen afgeweken van een negatief advies van de CTN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Tbs'er ontsnapt tijdens begeleid verlof, verdacht van neersteken vrouw’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a tbs patient who escaped during escorted leave and allegedly stabbed a woman, and about measures to prevent recurrence and tighter leave conditions. The minister described the leave assessment process (clinic, advisory committee AVT, DJI decision), said an electronic tag pilot is being evaluated, reported that the incident is being reviewed, and declined to tighten leave conditions given the rarity of escapes.
I will not go into individual cases substantively. Moreover, the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Op individuele gevallen ga ik inhoudelijk niet in. Bovendien loopt het opsporingsonderzoek nog.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse staat geen zicht heeft op Nederlanders die in het buitenland een gevangenisstraf hebben uitgezeten en daarna terugkeren naar Neder

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether the state can monitor Dutch citizens returning after serving prison sentences abroad, and whether transfer rules should be relaxed. The minister acknowledged the gap for sex offenders convicted outside the EU and UK, said an options study will be reported in Q1 2023, but defended the current transfer criteria and the five-year binding test.

I share the concern that there is currently insufficient oversight, because information about a conviction outside the European Union for a sex offence cannot currently be taken into account when assessing an application for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

Ik deel de zorg dat daar nu onvoldoende zicht op is, omdat informatie over een veroordeling buiten de Europese Unie (EU) voor een zedenmisdrijf nu niet meegenomen kan worden bij de beoordeling van een aanvraag voor een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat iemand 2,5 jaar onterecht vast zat na machtsmisbruik van de Nederlandse overheid

An MP asked the ministers about a man who was wrongly held for 2.5 years after the Dutch state misused its power in a transfer-of-sentence procedure, and why rule-of-law protection failed. The minister regretted the situation, acknowledged the state acted unlawfully, declined to discuss the individual case further, and said the IOS department has introduced a framework to prevent similar cases.
The Dutch state acknowledged in this procedure that it acted unlawfully by subjecting the person to a second transfer-of-sentence procedure.
De Nederlandse staat heeft in deze procedure erkend dat ze onrechtmatig heeft gehandeld door betrokkene aan een tweede procedure van strafoverdracht te onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het innen van een schadevergoedingsmaatregel voor slachtoffers

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers why a victim of online extortion, a vulnerable young man, has received none of the damages awarded by the court, and what is being done to improve collection of compensation orders. Minister Weerwind replied that the CJIB uses a range of collection instruments with a reasonable success rate, that a victim advance scheme exists, that the Donner committee reform is still being developed with a letter promised by 1 June 2023, and that improvements will be considered without committing to specific new measures.
I cannot go into this individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rudmer Heerema over de uitspraak van de Rechtbank Amsterdam tussen de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) en de Koninklijke Nederlandse Lawn Tennis Bond (KNLTB)

MPs Ellian and Heerema asked the ministers about court rulings on the Dutch data protection authority (AP) and its fine on the KNLTB, including whether a European Commission letter criticising the AP's strict reading of 'legitimate interest' was withheld. The minister answered that the matter is pending before the courts and the CJEU, that the Commission letter was not shared with the cabinet and is confidential within court proceedings, and that the cabinet will not intervene in the independent AP.
Assessing which documents are necessary for resolving a dispute is for the judge, not the cabinet.
De beoordeling welke stukken voor de beslechting van een geschil noodzakelijk zijn, is aan de rechter, niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over uitbetalingen van geld en speelwinst door online kansspelaanbieders

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked whether online gambling operators deliberately delay payouts, whether they should pay out instantly, and whether cancelling a withdrawal after requesting it should be banned. The Minister for Legal Protection replied that delays may be justified by fraud checks, that operators must pay 'without undue delay' under the Bkoa, that the Kansspelautoriteit supervises this and has an ongoing investigation into the duty of care, and that no intervention such as banning cancellation is warranted for now.
It is up to the Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) to supervise whether gambling providers comply with this.
Het is aan de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) om toezicht te houden op dat kansspelaanbieders zich hieraan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over jeugdbescherming

An SP MP asked the Minister about reports that children were placed out of home without a judge's involvement, and about inequality in child protection measures by income, education and migration background. The Minister explains that voluntary placements require parental consent and can be revisited, notes there is no reliable data on their number, and says the government will work on monitoring, clearer distinction between voluntary and coercive routes, and reducing unequal chances of child protection measures.
There is no reliable, meaningful data available on the number of voluntary out-of-home placements.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare, betekenisvolle gegevens over het aantal vrijwillige uithuisplaatsingen beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het gevaar dat er een Nederlands filiaal van de Londense shariarechtbank Al-Haddad wordt geopend en Nederlanders naar het VK afreizen om daar shariarecht te laten spreken

An MP asked the government whether a Dutch branch of the London sharia court Al-Haddad should be prevented, how many Dutch Muslims use sharia arbitration abroad, and what concrete steps will protect vulnerable women and neighbourhoods. The minister called religious courts overriding Dutch law unacceptable, said the Public Prosecution Service can act and that existing law allows dissolving organisations threatening public order, but said no data exists on use of foreign sharia courts and gave no new concrete measures.
I have no authority or legal basis to investigate this at the level of individuals.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheid of grondslag om hier, op persoonsniveau, onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Richardson, Van den Hil en Verkuijlen over het bericht ‘Tientallen klachten van misbruik en mishandeling in Gelders jeugddorp’

MPs asked the state secretary about reports of abuse and mistreatment at the Glind youth village, including whether inspectors had prior signals and what is being done about the care provider and former foster children. The government answered that the IGJ received several signals and reports since 2018 and will handle them, that Pluryn set up a helpline and is commissioning research, and that existing complaint channels exist, while declining to disclose details of individual reports citing confidentiality and privacy.
The IGJ never makes statements about the precise content of reports and how they are handled.
Over de precieze inhoud van meldingen en de afhandeling doet de IGJ nooit mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de ontwikkelingen omtrent ouderverstoting

Written questions from MP Westerveld on parental alienation and child contact loss asked what the government is doing to implement the Expert Team's recommendations, including on the Scheiden zonder Schade programme and mindset change. Minister Weerwind answers that a new experiment 'Een goed begin' with a Scheidingsadviesteam is running, that no current figures on child contact loss exist, and that concrete agreements and further letters to Parliament are still forthcoming.
There are no current figures on the number of children who no longer see one of their parents.
Er zijn geen actuele cijfers over het aantal kinderen dat één van beide ouders niet meer ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de tientallen klachten over misbruik en mishandeling in jeugddorp De Glind

An MP asked whether the government would investigate dozens of complaints of abuse and mistreatment at the De Glind youth village and whether youth-care reporting duties are enforced. The state secretary said the provider Pluryn will commission an independent investigation, noted mandatory incident reporting to the IGJ, and announced follow-up research on abuse patterns in youth care.
Pluryn has indicated that it will have an investigation carried out by an independent party into the misconduct that took place.
Pluryn heeft laten weten dat zij een onderzoek gaan laten uitvoeren naar de misstanden die hebben plaatsgevonden door een onafhankelijke partij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de misstanden bij de Glind en de Tijdelijke regeling financiële tegemoetkoming voor slachtoffers van geweld in de jeugdzorg

An MP asks the State Secretary and Minister about abuse at Jeugddorp De Glind, whether investigations are independent, where victims can report, whether perpetrators still work in youth care, criminal prosecution, safety measures, and whether the compensation scheme should be extended beyond 31 December 2022. The government answers that Pluryn will conduct its own investigation, points to existing reporting channels and the IGJ, notes that the scheme ends in December 2022 and that it sees no reason to extend it, and reports 18,955 applications with long processing delays.
I agree that thorough and independent research must be carried out.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat grondig en onafhankelijk onderzoek gedaan moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de documentaire ‘Taken – Kinderen van de Staat’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about the documentary on child protection, the IGJ findings on unjustified out-of-home placements, decentralised youth care, financing, workforce shortages and compensation. The government acknowledged serious problems, promised a reform agenda and a plan to improve legal protection, but rejected re-auditing all placements and any compensation scheme.
In all cases examined, multiple problems existed in the family, such as addiction, debt, domestic violence or parenting problems.
In alle onderzochte zaken speelden meerdere problemen in het gezin, zoals verslaving, schulden, huiselijk geweld of opvoedproblemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het voortbestaan van een onrechtmatige toestand van huwelijkse gevangenschap en de mogelijke verjaring

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the ongoing unlawful state of forced marriage (huwelijkse gevangenschap) can become time-barred, how many women sought legal aid or consular help, and what the government will do about funding, training and international cooperation. The minister answers that a pending bill makes the duty to cooperate in dissolving such a marriage legally enforceable and not subject to limitation, that the register cannot show how many cases were funded, that the fee point increase was raised to 19 points in 2022 but no further increase is planned, and that consular help is limited and the topic will be raised in EU and bilateral channels.
It can never, and therefore also not after a lapse of time, be required of anyone to remain bound in a religious or belief-based union that they do not wish to maintain.
Het kan nooit, en dus ook niet na verloop van tijd, van iemand worden gevergd dat hij blijft vastzitten in een religieuze of levensbeschouwelijke verbintenis die hij niet wenst.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht dat het Chinese TikTok bij het gebruik van de in-app browser alle toetsaanslagen vastlegt en daarmee wachtwoorden en creditcardgegevens kan verzamelen

An MP asked the government about reports that TikTok's in-app browser may record keystrokes, including passwords and credit card data, and what should be done about it. The minister answered that data protection supervision is the task of the independent regulator, that the government will raise the principles with TikTok in a meeting, and that the government will strengthen oversight, without itself investigating or ordering deletion.
Overseeing and enforcing the lawfulness of data processing in the private sector is not a task of the cabinet but of the supervisory authority.
Antwoord 4 Het houden van toezicht op en het handhaven van de rechtmatigheid van gegevensverwerkingen in de private sector is geen taak van het kabinet, maar van de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het over het (niet) gebruiken van beschikbare informatie om advocaat T. te weren uit de EBI Vught

MP Sneller (D66) asks the Minister for Legal Protection why available police information about lawyer Youssef T.'s links to a criminal organisation was not used to bar him from the EBI, and why it was not shared with the bar dean. The minister answers that the information (a DLIO report) could not serve as evidence, was not sufficient to justify refusal, and that details are withheld due to the ongoing criminal case, with the bulk of questions answered in general terms.
Since these concern individual legal-position matters and because this case is still before the criminal court, I will not provide these documents to your House.
Aangezien het hier om rechtspositionele individuele aangelegenheden gaat en omdat deze zaak nog onder de strafrechter is verstrek ik deze stukken niet aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld n Bikker  over de aanpak van zelfbenoemde ‘afvalcoaches” en pro-ana websites

MPs Westerveld and Bikker asked the government about self-declared 'afvalcoaches' and pro-ana websites exploiting vulnerable minors, including the lack of progress on an online investigation strategy, capacity, prior warnings, and blocking sites. The Minister answered that a multi-track approach is in place, the police exploration of an online investigation strategy is ongoing with results expected early 2023, individual cases cannot be discussed, and a blanket ban on pro-ana sites is not deemed opportune.
Unfortunately, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Helaas kan niet worden ingegaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Ellian en Bikker over het bericht 'Justitie Den Haag schrapt 53 zaken: Wietkwekers en drugsdealers ontlopen straf'

MPs Michon-Derkzen, Ellian and Bikker asked the Justice Minister about reports that the Den Haag public prosecution service had requested inadmissibility in 53 old drug-related cases, and whether this signals impunity and why cases were left pending. The minister called it a bad signal, explained the cases were mostly confiscation and older drug cases with no direct victims, that the prosecution service had discretion, and that backlog and capacity measures are underway.
The prosecution service cannot state what the sentencing demand in the cases would have been.
Het OM kan niet aangeven wat de strafeis in de zaken zou zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over een incident van grensoverschrijdend gedrag binnen de tbs-kliniek Oostvaarders in Almere

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a sexual misconduct incident by an employee at the Oostvaarderskliniek tbs clinic, its adequacy of response, incident figures for that clinic and other tbs clinics, and whether the Inspectorate should investigate. The Minister found the individual response adequate but, given multiple reports, announced an external investigation, an interim director, Inspectorate involvement, and provided incident data while acknowledging inconsistent registration definitions.
The Inspectorate of Justice and Security will be involved in setting up the investigation.
De Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid zal bij de opzet van het onderzoek betrokken worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de negatieve gevolgen van langer wachten met de start van een TBS-behandeling.

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the negative effects of delaying the start of TBS treatment when prison sentences are imposed first, and about the scope of court advice under art. 37b Sr. The minister answered that the court's advice can be used but that most cases are decided individually, with prison care and pre-passant preparation in place.
Inquiry with the Dutch Custodial Institutions Agency shows that between 2018 and 2022 there were eight cases in which the court gave advice to start TBS treatment earlier.

Navraag bij de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) levert op dat tussen 2018 en 2022 acht keer een zaak aan de orde is geweest waarin de rechter een advies heeft gegeven om eerder te starten met een tbs-behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rechtsbescherming van gedupeerden van het kinderopvangtoeslagenschandaal

The SP MP Van Nispen asked why childcare benefit scandal victims must go to court to enforce statutory decision deadlines and obtain access to their files, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges that many decisions are overdue (41,335 applications past the one-year deadline as of 30 September 2022), points to capacity constraints, prioritisation and ongoing improvement measures, and says it will report in the 12th progress report.
Unfortunately, it is not succeeding in giving parents a decision within the statutory deadlines for the integral assessment and objections.
Het lukt helaas niet om ouders binnen de wettelijke termijnen uitsluitsel te geven bij de integrale beoordeling en bezwaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over dat de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen pas in actie komt na een rechterlijke uitspraak

An SP MP asks why the Dutch tax authority's Herstel Toeslagen unit only acts on childcare-benefit victims' files after court rulings, and how this squares with the law and costs. The government answers that files are handled in order of registration with priority for urgent cases, that late-decision appeals are a consequence of the system rather than deliberate policy, and that it will report further in the next progress report.
As a result, late-decision appeals cut across the processing order based on date of registration.
Hierdoor doorkruisen de beroepen niet tijdig de behandelvolgorde op basis van volgorde van aanmelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Raemakers over het bericht dat kleinschalige jeugdgevangenissen weinig gebruikt worden

An MP from D66 asks the Minister for Legal Protection why small-scale youth detention facilities (KVJJ) are underused, including the role of the central Divisie Individuele Zaken in placement decisions and the placement criteria. The Minister acknowledges low occupancy, defends central placement by DIZ to ensure uniformity, and says the criteria are being revised by autumn 2022 with a monitor report due April 2023.
No. Since the decision to include the KVJJ in the system, the placement process and DIZ's role have been aligned with the broader placement process.
Nee. Sinds het besluit om de KVJJ op te nemen in het stelsel, is het plaatsingsproces van de KVJJ en de rol van DIZ daarin in lijn gebracht met het bredere plaatsingsproces
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat kleinschalige jeugdgevangenissen leegstaan

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why five small-scale youth detention units (KVJJ) are largely empty, how placement decisions are made, and whether the DIZ division rather than judges should decide placement. The minister answers that the units are underused due to slow referral, that placement criteria are being revised, and that centralised DIZ decision-making ensures uniformity, while promising a monitor report in April 2023.
Judges can give advice on the place of enforcement (such as a KVJJ).
Rechters kunnen over de plaats van tenuitvoerlegging (zoals een KVJJ) advies uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het niet weigeren van de toegang tot de EBI aan de advocaat en neef van Ridouan T.

An MP asked why the EBI prison did not refuse access to lawyer Youssef Taghi, nephew of Ridouan Taghi, despite known criminal contacts, and why the Dean's investigation was given weight over police and prosecution information. The Minister explains access was granted after the Dean found no misuse of privileged status, that police and prosecution judged their information insufficient to justify refusal, and that family ties alone are not a legal ground to refuse.
The mere existence of a family relationship between detainee and lawyer is, under the regulations, not a ground for refusal.
Alleen het bestaan van een familierelatie tussen gedetineerde en advocaat is conform de regelgeving geen weigeringsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat gedetineerden niet met verlof kunnen vanwege maandenlange wachttijden bij de verlofaanvraag

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that detainees convicted of serious violent or sexual offences were denied leave because of months-long waits for psychologists to complete risk assessments. The minister acknowledged the delays, attributed them to an overly broad November 2021 amendment to the leave regulation, and said the wording is being corrected with interim measures from 6 September 2022.

The amendment provided that a risk assessment and offence analysis become mandatory for re-integration leave of detainees convicted of a serious violent or sexual offence who are transferred to a forensic care institution.

Met de wijziging werd geregeld dat een risicotaxatie en delictanalyse verplicht worden betrokken bij het re-integratieverlof van gedetineerden die zijn veroordeeld voor een ernstig gewelds- en zedenmisdrijf
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de mogelijk tweede open communicatielijn van Ridouan Taghi

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether Ridouan Taghi has a second open communication line that could be abused, and whether access to the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting can be denied when in doubt. The minister could not guarantee no misuse of privileged contacts, announced possible visual monitoring for a limited group in a legislative change, and explained that lawyer access can be refused only on a reasoned, fact-based decision such as a GRIP report, not on doubt alone.
For a limited group of detainees, I will, within the safeguards that apply, include the possibility of visual supervision of these conversations in the amendment of the Penitentiary Principles Act.

Voor een beperkte groep gedetineerden ga ik, binnen de waarborgen die hiervoor gelden, de mogelijkheid om visueel toezicht te houden op deze gesprekken meenemen in de wijziging van de Penitentiaire beginselenwet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de tbs-capaciteit

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the rise in TBS (forensic psychiatric) orders, bed capacity, staffing, waiting prisoners, and staff workload and wellbeing. The Minister confirmed a 58% rise in orders since 2017, outlined capacity growth, budget increases, procurement changes and recruitment efforts, while acknowledging waiting lists and a tight labour market.
As of 5 September 2022, 118 people in the prison system are waiting for a place in a TBS clinic, 73 of them in a Penitentiary Psychiatric Centre (PPC).
Op peildatum 5 september 2022 wachten er 118 personen in het gevangeniswezen op een plek in een TBS-kliniek, waarvan 73 in een Penitentiair Psychiatrisch Centrum (PPC).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops en Kuik over het bericht ‘Amalia in vizier Mocro-maffia’

CDA MPs Knops and Kuik asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a newspaper report that criminal networks were targeting Princess Amalia, and about alleged undermining of the rule of law in the Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI). The minister acknowledged the report, said the government is taking far-reaching steps against organised crime in detention, including a planned bill for stronger individual restrictions on the most dangerous detainees and tighter EBI contact rules, while describing Italy's 41bis regime as not involving strict isolation.
I expect to submit this bill to your House in the first quarter of 2023.
Ik verwacht dit wetsvoorstel in het eerste kwartaal van 2023 bij uw Kamer in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het bericht dat leden van de zogenoemde Mocro-Maffia vanuit de gevangenis nieuwe misdrijven voorbereiden

An MP asked whether authorities fear that imprisoned leaders of the Mocro-maffia still prepare crimes from detention, and what has been done to stop this. The minister confirms the concern, says current measures are insufficient for a specific group, and announces stricter EBI detention regime and new legislation, while declining to discuss specific investigations.
I cannot go into any criminal investigations or the indications underlying them at this moment.
Op eventuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken en aanwijzingen die daaraan ten grondslag liggen kan ik op dit moment niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht over gratieverlening aan Masmeijer

MP Ellian (VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection why clemency was granted to Frank Masmeijer, on what legal basis, whether advice from the prosecution and courts was obtained and what it said, and how victims and public interest were weighed. The Minister explained the Gratiewet criteria, that the Arnhem-Leeuwarden court advised positively while the OM advised negatively, that the Belgian conditional release rules were considered, and that individual clemency cases are not usually reported to Parliament, while promising partial publication of the advice.
It is not usual to inform the House about individual cases, in particular because of the protection of the privacy of the person(s) concerned.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om uw Kamer te informeren over individuele zaken, met name vanwege de bescherming van de privacy van betrokkene(n).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verlenen van gratie en de motivering van dat besluit

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how often clemency has been granted, why clemency was given to a convicted Dutch presenter serving nine years, and how the decision was motivated. The minister gave yearly clemency figures, said the decision was case-specific and based on a positive Belgian-law-informed advice from the court, declined to discuss details citing privacy, and said reasons are only given in the decision if a request is refused.
Given the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot go into the substance of this case further.
Gelet op de privacy van de betrokkene kan ik verder niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat TBS-patiënten die geriatrische zorg nodig hebben nu nergens terecht kunnen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that TBS patients needing geriatric care have nowhere suitable to go, and whether a dedicated facility was planned. The minister confirmed there are no specialised units yet, explained the current arrangements via FPCs and DJI, and said a specialised unit is being scoped and an option is included in the 2024 tender, with updates promised in a June 2023 letter.
I will keep you informed of progress in the forensic care progress letter of June 2023.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van de voortgang in de voortgangsbrief forensische zorg van juni 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht over 'Oud presentator eerder vrij na gratie - Openbaar Ministerie adviseerde tegen gratie’

The MP Stoffer asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the pardon (gratie) granted to Frank Masmeijer despite a negative Public Prosecution Service advice, including whether the procedure followed the Gratiewet, why the judiciary gave no public advice, and the policy on pardons. The Minister answers that the procedure followed the law, the pardon was conditional, the Court of Appeal's positive advice was decisive, and advice from courts is generally binding in practice, with some advice documents to be published by Justis.
The Court of Appeal gave advice on a pardon request in this case and also had the Public Prosecution Service's advice available to it.
Het gerechtshof heeft in deze zaak een advies gegeven op een gratieverzoek waarin het ook over het advies van het OM beschikte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de noodzaak van onderzoek naar misstanden in vrouwengevangenissen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reported abuses in women's prisons, including alleged sexual misconduct by a guard at PI Nieuwersluis, abuse of power and denial of medical care elsewhere, and when the Inspectorate last examined these prisons. The Minister confirmed the Inspectorate is investigating the Nieuwersluis case and has been asked to widen its inquiry, but said the Inspectorate sets its own scope and the Minister cannot instruct it to investigate specific topics.
I have informed the Inspectorate JenV of this and asked it to include these reports in its investigation and, if there is reason to do so, to extend it to the other women's prisons.

Ik heb de Inspectie JenV hiervan op de hoogte gesteld en gevraagd deze meldingen te betrekken in haar onderzoek en indien nodig uit te breiden naar de andere vrouwengevangenissen als daar aanleiding toe is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over de mogelijkheid in het erfrecht dat de dader erft van een slachtoffer

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether a man found not criminally liable and sentenced only to TBS, who killed his wife, may inherit from her, and whether inheritance law should be tightened so perpetrators cannot benefit. The Minister acknowledged the outcome feels very unjust but declined substantive comment because the case is under appeal, explained the limited unworthiness grounds in Article 4:3 BW, and said he will await the procedure before considering broadening those grounds.
I first want to await the further procedure before examining whether it is necessary to expand the unworthiness grounds of Article 4:3 BW.
Ik wil nu eerst de verdere procedure afwachten voordat ik ga onderzoeken of het nodig is om de onwaardigheidsgronden van artikel 4:3 BW uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over justitiële dwalingen en de reactie daarop

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how she views a court finding of a miscarriage of justice, whether excuses are due, whether the system is working and whether the novum criterion for review should be loosened. The Minister regrets the wrongful conviction, defends the current review regime as balanced, says excuses are primarily for the organisations involved and that the novum criterion will not be changed.
For a detailed justification of that position I refer to the letter in question.
Voor een uitgebreide motivering van dat standpunt verwijs ik naar de bedoelde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht 'Vrijheid voor leider Bende van Venlo lonkt na zeven moorden'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a press report that the life-sentenced Venlo gang leader could move toward release, including why a treatment placement was now allowed despite earlier negative advice and whether victims were consulted. The minister answered that the placement is for treatment on a waiting list, not a reintegration step, that the Advisory Board's negative advice was followed, and that victims were informed only when freedoms are involved.
The Advisory Board will issue another follow-up advice in P.'s case on the reintegration phase in 2023.
Het Adviescollege brengt in 2023 weer een vervolgadvies uit in de zaak P. omtrent de re-integratiefase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het problematisch tekort aan sociaal advocaten

Van Nispen (SP) asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a predicted shortage of social lawyers, whether raising their fees is the remedy, whether research will be done on narrowing fee gaps with commercial lawyers, and whether tariffs and hours will be kept current. The minister acknowledges the report's concerns, says fees were structurally improved from January 2022 with a repricing process underway, declines to study fee gaps with commercial lawyers citing limited public funds, and plans additional research on regional spread and supply and demand.
I am not going to commission research into the differing fees for commercial and social lawyers.
Een onderzoek naar uiteenlopende vergoedingen voor de commerciële en sociale advocatuur ga ik niet laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht 'Kantonrechter ontslaat Langhenkel als bewindvoerder'

MP Kat asked the ministers about the dismissal of bewindvoerder Langhenkel and related oversight failures, including court actions, complaint and fraud statistics, and quality-control outcomes. The government answered that it regrets the situation, that six liability claims arose (three settled, three judgments), and that many data points are not held by the judiciary, with a promised follow-up on stricter standards and court oversight.
In how many cases since 2019 has the client or successor bewindvoerder objected to the final account of the (ex officio) dismissed bewindvoerder?
In hoeveel gevallen vanaf 2019 tot heden heeft de cliënt of opvolgend bewindvoerder bezwaar gemaakt tegen de eindafrekening en -verantwoording van de (ambtshalve) ontslagen bewindvoerder?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de detentie van Naoufal F.

MP Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection why Naoufal F., a senior figure in Ridouan Taghi's criminal network, is detained outside an intensive supervision unit, is not classed as extreme risk, and can have frequent contact with fellow inmates. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, answered in general terms on AIT placement and risk assessment, and said new rules are being prepared so that leaders of criminal networks can be placed in a stricter regime.
I will not go into the situation of individual detainees.
Ik ga niet in op de situatie rondom individuele gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over Het beroep op vrijstelling wegens richtingbezwaren

MP Bisschop asked the government whether a Zuid-Holland Zuid truancy region's practice of asking parents for their specific religion or belief when claiming exemption on grounds of objection to a school's denomination is lawful, whether it breaches GDPR and due-care principles, and whether it wrongly involves youth health care and Veilig Thuis. Minister Wiersma answered that asking for the specific belief is necessary and lawful under the Supreme Court's case law and the GDPR, that the municipality rather than the minister is responsible for enforcement, that a well-argued exemption alone is not grounds for a Veilig Thuis report, and that the regional policy document has been adjusted on that point.
Enforcement of compulsory education is first and foremost a matter for the municipal authorities concerned.
De handhaving van de leerplicht is op de eerste plaats een zaak van de betrokken gemeentebesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht over de kennelijke aanstaande vrijlating van de Appie A.

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why life-sentenced prisoner Appie A. was being prepared for reintegration, whether a positive advisory opinion existed, how his dangerousness was assessed, whether he would be pardoned, and what role victims' relatives played. The minister answered that the Adviescollege Levenslanggestraften gave a positive advice on which he approved admission to the reintegration phase, that release was too early to discuss, that the pardon request was still in the advisory stage, and described the pardon criteria and victim involvement.
In the case of Appie A., on the basis of a positive advice from the ACL and the above-mentioned investigations, I decided to admit Appie A. to the reintegration phase.
In de zaak Appie A. heb ik op basis van een positief advies van het ACL en de hierboven genoemde onderzoeken besloten Appie A. toe te laten tot de re-integratiefase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de uitvoering van de motie ‘per direct nadere maatregelen invoeren in de EBI in Vught’

An MP (Ellian, VVD) asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a letter on implementing the motion for immediate additional measures in the Vught EBI had not been sent, when implementation would happen, and why an answer took seven weeks. The minister replied that the letter has since been sent, that a fourth placement ground (D-ground) is being added with automatic application of the motion's measures via house rules pending advice from the RSJ, and that the timing was delayed by the search for a workable approach.

Therefore the regulations will be amended with a fourth ground (the D-ground) so that placement in the EBI also becomes possible for the threat emanating from someone's role and position in a criminal network.
Daarom wordt de regelgeving aangepast met een vierde grond (de D-grond) zodat plaatsing in de EBI ook mogelijk wordt bij de dreiging die uitgaat van iemands rol en positie in een crimineel netwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ’Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked why the minister did not answer earlier questions about the dropping of 1,500 criminal cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, including a list of the cases and advance notice of such actions. The minister replied that the cases are mostly minor offences, that a detailed list would consume scarce capacity, that he would have informed parliament only when such a sweeping decision is repeated, and that all cases including those with victims are being reassessed.
For this reason I did not ask the Public Prosecution Service to draw up a detailed overview of all cases.
Om deze reden heb ik het OM niet gevraagd om een gedetailleerd overzicht van alle zaken op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht dat de Hoge Raad het colorverbod in de Algemene plaatselijke verordening (APV) onverbindend heeft verklaard

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the colour (club-patch) ban in municipal bylaws (APV) should be dropped after the Supreme Court ruled it invalid, how many municipalities had it, and how wearing banned clubs' colours is enforced. The minister confirmed the ruling, said wearing colours of banned clubs is undesirable and can be prosecuted under existing criminal and civil rules, and will ask the national expert consultation (LSO) whether existing powers suffice, with advice expected end 2022.
I will go into this further in answering question 4.
Ik ga hier nader op in bij de beantwoording van vraag 4.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over het bericht ‘ADO Den Haag vindt in Funland nieuwe hoofdpartner jeugdopleiding’ en over het aangekondigde verbod op sponsoring van sportclubs door aanbieders van kansspelen in he

An MP asked whether gambling operators (Hommerson Funland and Sir Winston) sponsoring ADO Den Haag youth kits and shirts breaches the ban on gambling advertising aimed at minors, and asked about the scope and timing of the planned sponsorship ban. The ministers acknowledged that such sponsorship must not target minors and that the Gambling Authority can intervene, but said the planned sponsorship ban covers only online gambling and that a two-year transition period is proposed.
If a licence holder does not comply with these rules, the Gambling Authority (Ksa) as supervisor can intervene.
Indien een vergunninghouder zich niet houdt aan deze regels kan de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) als toezichthouder ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over de 1500 geseponeerde zaken bij rechtbank Gelderland

An MP asks whether victims learned of the dismissal of 1,500 cases at Gelderland court through the media before receiving OM notices, and about compensation, restorative justice and victims' speaking rights in OM penal orders. The minister acknowledges the communication could have been better, explains compensation for victims of cases dismissed for delay, and says the speaking-rights issue will be discussed with the College of Procurators-General.
The OM attaches great value to careful communication towards victims.
Het OM hecht grote waarde aan een zorgvuldige communicatie richting slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Arib over het tegenhouden van onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why independent research into child removals of childcare-benefit parents was reportedly blocked, and whether the judiciary can investigate its own judges. The Minister replied that an Inspectorate investigation is underway, a research commission is being set up, and the judiciary has started its own reflection and file review with an external advisory committee, so no new study is needed.

At this moment I see no reason to initiate further research because the inspectorate investigation is already underway, the research commission is in preparation, and the judiciary has started a reflection process and will conduct file research into the out-of-home placements.

Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nog een onderzoek te initiëren omdat het inspectieonderzoek al loopt, de onderzoekscommissie in voorbereiding is en de rechtspraak een reflectietraject is gestart en dossieronderzoek naar de uithuisplaatsingen gaat doen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel Onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders tegengehouden

MP Omtzigt asked the government why it did not inform parliament earlier about an independent RUG study into child removals in the childcare benefits affair, and whether the study should be commissioned. The Minister answered that the government had no involvement, that the judiciary decided not to cooperate, that CBS data rules do not allow the requested linkage, and that no new study is currently planned because an inspection and an independent commission are underway.
I have always informed your House about how independent research would take place, namely by the Inspectorate of Justice and Security (IJenV) and additionally by an investigative commission.

Ik heb uw Kamer steeds geïnformeerd over de manier waarop onafhankelijk onderzoek zou plaatsvinden, namelijk door de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid (IJenV) en aanvullend door een onderzoekscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Leijten over het gestrande onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsingen van kinderen door schuldenproblematiek en/of het toeslagenschandaal

MPs Marijnissen and Leijten asked why an independent study into child removals linked to debt problems and the childcare benefits scandal stalled, and whether the minister had intervened. The minister replied that he had no involvement, that the judiciary chose not to co-operate with Groningen because cases are still pending, that an Inspectorate study and a planned independent commission are under way, and that he sees no reason for another study now.
In addition, at the request of your House I am working on establishing an independent investigation committee.
Daarnaast werk ik op verzoek van uw Kamer aan de instelling van een onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders tegengehouden’

An SGP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why an independent Groningen University study into the role of debts in child out-of-home placements of childcare-benefit families had stalled. The minister replied that the study had not started because pending cases cannot yet be examined, that the Inspectorate and an inquiry commission already cover the issue, and that debt alone is not a ground for placement.
For that reason, it is not appropriate to have a third party examine court case files.
Daarom past het niet om door een derde partij onderzoek laten doen naar rechtbankdossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over het artikel 'Onafhankelijk onderzoek naar uithuisplaatsing kinderen toeslagenouders tegengehouden'

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why independent research by Groningen University into out-of-home placements of children of childcare-benefit parents was blocked by the judiciary, and how the process will be accelerated. The Minister says the judiciary will do its own file research with an external supervisory committee, the Inspectorate is conducting its own study, and an independent investigative commission is being set up with a chair to be found, expected to start this autumn.
The Council for the Judiciary has indicated that research into those cases by a third party cannot be considered.
De Raad voor de Rechtspraak heeft aangegeven dat onderzoek naar die zaken door een derde partij niet aan de orde kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Markuszower en Maeijer over het bericht 'Zonder onderzoek draaien we om hete brij'

MPs Markuszower and Maeijer asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether an independent inquiry is needed into the role of judges in out-of-home placements of children from the childcare benefits scandal, and how further placements due to debt problems will be prevented. The minister answered that an Inspectorate inquiry is underway, an independent inquiry commission is being prepared, the judiciary will review files itself, and no further inquiry is needed, while stating that debt alone is no ground for placement.

At this moment I see no reason for another inquiry because the inspectorate investigation is already underway, an inquiry commission is being prepared, the judiciary itself will conduct file research, and a reflection process of family and youth judges is ongoing.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding voor nog een onderzoek omdat het inspectieonderzoek al loopt, er een onderzoekscommissie in voorbereiding is, de Rechtspraak zelf dossieronderzoek zal gaan doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Ginneken over de hoorplicht bij beroepen tegen verkeersboetes

MPs Sneller and Van Ginneken asked whether the Public Prosecution Service (OM) has failed for years to inform traffic-fine objectors of their right to be heard, whether it wrongly dismissed appeals as manifestly unfounded, and how the appeal threshold increase affects citizens' protection. The minister acknowledged the OM did not actively communicate the hearing right, said talks are underway to restore it, disputed the 90% manifestly-unfounded figure (1.9% actually), and defended the appeal-threshold rise as restoring the legislator's original intent.
The OM reports that persons who themselves indicated they wish to be heard are in fact heard.
Het OM meldt dat betrokkenen die zelf hebben aangegeven gehoord te willen worden, ook daadwerkelijk zijn gehoord.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over kinderen die uit huis geplaatst zijn, het toeslagenschandaal en de schadevergoeding die zij krijgen uitgekeerd, terwijl ze nog uit huis geplaatst zijn

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, compensation payments to those children, who controls the money, and whether expert analyses and rights protections are available. The minister answered that a support team has worked with 202 parents and 429 children, that a child compensation scheme exists with parents or guardians controlling minors' money under the civil code, and that contra-analyses and family-analysis instruments face waiting lists and are being piloted.
The investigation by the Inspectorate of Justice and Security and the independent inquiry committee should provide more insight into this.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid en van de onafhankelijke onderzoekscommissie moet hier meer inzicht in bieden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over 'het bericht dat de Nederlandse Staat onaanvaardbaar heeft gehandeld door zich te beroepen op de verjaringstermijn in een zaak omtrent interlandelijke adoptie'

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court ruling that the State acted unacceptably by invoking the limitation period in an intercountry adoption case, and what it means for other adoption cases and out-of-court settlement. The Minister says the State no longer relied on limitation in this case, that limitation defences in domestic adoption cases must be assessed case by case, that cassation is still being considered, and that out-of-court resolution will be sought where appropriate.
Given that a decision on cassation still has to be made, I cannot say anything about this at this moment.
Daar kan ik – gegeven het feit dat nog over cassatie moet worden beslist – op dit moment nog niets over zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht dat een slachtoffer erin is geslaagd een hoger beroep af te dwingen na een strafproces

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a victim who forced an appeal after a criminal trial because his victim rights were not guaranteed, and whether the public prosecution service (OM) should be required to appeal when victim rights are clearly breached. The minister answered that the OM has wide policy discretion, that the victim's kort geding succeeded only temporarily and the OM later withdrew the appeal with reasons, that the OM must weigh whether an appeal could lead to a different outcome, and that no instruction or obligation to appeal is planned.
The OM is granted a large degree of policy discretion given its tasks and position in the Dutch legal system.
Het OM komt een grote mate van beleidsvrijheid toe gelet op de taken en de plaats van het OM in het Nederlands rechtsbestel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de klokkenluider Huig Plug

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about whistleblower Huig Plug, staff departures at the JCvSZ prison hospital, and whether the Inspectorate of Justice and Security (Inspectie J&V) suppressed whistleblower reports and handled a complaint against itself improperly. The minister answers that staff departure reasons are withheld for privacy, inspection interview records and the identity of reporters are confidential, the complaint was handled under the General Administrative Law Act, the Inspectorate's move is delayed, the Integrity Commission could not act on the anonymous reports, and no new investigation is warranted because prior inspections found no misconduct.
No, the Inspectorate does not in principle report that to me, because it concerns supervision-confidential information.
Nee, dat meldt de Inspectie en Veiligheid mij in beginsel niet, omdat dat toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Van Nispen en Knops over de open communicatie vanuit de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI)

MPs Ellian, Van Nispen and Knops asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that communication from the EBI high-security prison stayed open without oversight, and why authorities did not intervene despite warnings. The minister denied that unsupervised communication was possible, explained the handling of the lawyer-impersonation case and the FBI-sourced tip, and promised a letter on implementing the Ellian motion while withholding details of ongoing criminal investigations.
As is known, I can share little or no information publicly about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik zoals bekend geen tot weinig informatie (openlijk) delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de open communicatie vanuit de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI)

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the open communication from the EBI via lawyer Youssef T. and the deken's findings, including whether signals were used to restrict access. The minister answered that ongoing criminal investigations limit disclosure, that information from a foreign police force could not be shared with the prison service, and that the lawyer's access was restricted once grounds emerged.
While the criminal investigation into Ridouan T. and Youssef T. is ongoing, I of course cannot provide information about those investigations.
Hangende het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar Ridouan T. en Youssef T. kan ik vanzelfsprekend geen informatie geven over die onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over ongecontroleerd contact tijdens zittingsdagen door Ridouan Taghi

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether Ridouan Taghi could have uncontrolled contact with co-defendants on court days in the Marengo trial and what measures would prevent it, including implementing a motion on video-link hearings for EBI detainees. The Minister answered that the court is responsible for order in the courtroom, that supervision and security measures are in place, and that the WODC study on 41-bis elements is awaited, with a plan for four justice complexes and a planned amendment to the Besluit videoconferentie.
The precise content of the package of security measures cannot be specified due to security interests.
De precieze inhoud van het pakket veiligheidsmaatregelen kan vanwege veiligheidsbelangen niet worden gespecificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht Woonadressen van advocaten duiken geregeld op in strafdossiers

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether lawyers' home addresses appearing in criminal case files, including unredacted addresses when other parties are anonymised, is acceptable and what will be done about it. The minister called this highly undesirable, said there is no reason to record such addresses or call metadata in case files, and stated that the parties, including the OM, are discussing with the bar how to prevent it.
There is no reason or necessity whatsoever to include the (shielded) private addresses of lawyers, or other confidants, in the criminal case file.
Er bestaat geen enkele reden of noodzaak om (afgeschermde) privéadressen van advocaten, of andere geheimhouders, in het strafdossier op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het ziekenhuisbezoek van een gedetineerde

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how leave decisions for detainees, including unguarded hospital visits, weigh offence type, addiction and flight risk, following a report of a detainee who fled during such a visit. The minister explained the Rtvi criteria, the director's risk assessment and possible guarding measures, but gave no commitment to change the framework.
When there is a serious suspicion that the detainee will try to evade detention, leave is refused.
Wanneer het ernstig vermoeden bestaat dat de gedetineerde zal proberen zich aan de detentie te onttrekken, wordt het verlof geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nispen over het toezicht op beheer van erfrechtelijke aanspraken van minderjarigen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why supervision of parents' and guardians' management of minors' inheritance rights has been absent in practice and why the promised bill on better supervision has not yet been sent to parliament. The minister acknowledges the case is distressing but questions whether it is a widespread problem, and says the bill is delayed due to reprioritisation; he promises to reconsider the researchers' recommendations and report this autumn.
More effective protection of minors' assets through better supervision of the management by parents and guardians therefore has my attention.
Effectievere bescherming van het vermogen van minderjarigen door beter toezicht op het bewind van ouders en voogden heeft daarom mijn aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de oproep van de Consumentenbond om het gebruik van lootboxes in videogames te reguleren

An SP MP asked the government whether it would regulate loot boxes in video games (manipulative design, misleading odds, pay-to-win, addiction, age rating) following a Consumentenbond call. The government answered that consumer-protection information duties and ACM enforcement apply, that a Europe-wide consultation starts in Q4 2022, that a Trimbos report and a parliamentary motion are being considered with a letter promised after the summer, and that prevention and PEGI age ratings (not 18+ for loot boxes) remain the approach.
The cabinet is currently considering several policy initiatives based on these recommendations. Your House will be informed about this after the summer.
Het kabinet beraadt zich op dit moment op een aantal beleidsinitiatieven op basis van deze aanbevelingen. Uw Kamer wordt hierover na de zomer bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de sponsordeal van Ajax en Unibet

An MP asked the ministers whether the Ajax-Unibet online gambling sponsorship deal, and the normalisation of gambling it may cause, is acceptable given the planned ban on gambling advertising. The minister answered that sponsorship is currently lawful within the rules, that the ban on role models in gambling ads applies from 30 June 2022, and that sponsorship by online gambling operators will be phased out via amendments to the Besluit Wrvk.
As Minister for Legal Protection, I have no view on individual sponsorship agreements.
Ik heb als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming geen opvatting over individuele sponsorovereenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de noodzaak tot het wettelijk verankeren van zaakstoedeling in de rechtspraak

An MP asked whether random case allocation in the judiciary should be anchored in law, given the Court's Article 6 case law and the Venice Commission standards. The Minister replied that objective, transparent criteria are essential, that formal statutory codification is not strictly required, and that the judiciary's Code will be evaluated after two years with a comparative study of allocation models, without committing to a bill.
I will ask the Council for the Judiciary to evaluate the operation of the rules on case allocation drawn up by the judiciary, two years after the Case Allocation Code took effect.
Ik zal de Raad voor de rechtspraak vragen om de werking van de door de Rechtspraak opgestelde regels voor de toedeling van zaken te evalueren, 2 jaar na inwerkingtreding van de Code Zaakstoedeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan aandacht voor de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand op rechtenopleidingen

MP Van Nispen asked whether law degree programmes neglect subsidised legal aid (sociale advocatuur), citing individualism, career focus and possible influence from large law firms, and what should change. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that curricula are for institutions to decide, that shortages are being studied by the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that talks with universities and the NOvA are ongoing, and that the internship scheme has been reopened.
Talks are being held with universities and universities of applied sciences on whether the curriculum sufficiently connects with social legal practice.
Met de universiteiten en hogescholen worden gesprekken gevoerd of binnen het curriculum voldoende aansluiting bestaat met de sociale advocatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het Kremlin aan de Zuidas

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether law firm Houthoff profited from work for sanctioned Russian state banks such as Sberbank, whether it should have done client due diligence, and whether prosecution, confiscation, and a legal framework for supervising lawyers are possible. The minister answered that the Amsterdam bar supervisor found no sanctions breach, declined to comment on the individual case, said prosecution depends on concrete signals, and said a legal framework for lawyer sanctions supervision is being prepared with an outline letter promised before the budget debates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de toepassing van de strafbeschikking op delicten waarop een maximumgevangenisstraf van meer dan zes jaar staat

An MP asks why the Public Prosecution Service imposed penal orders (strafbeschikkingen) for serious violent and sexual offences carrying more than six years' imprisonment, which the Code of Criminal Procedure does not allow, and how victims' interests are protected. The Minister says dagvaarden is the starting point, the cases are being examined through file research with results expected after summer, victims' wishes play a central role, and the Prosecution Service will be asked to ensure practice complies with the law.
After the summer I will receive the results of the file research from the Public Prosecution Service, after which I will inform the House of Representatives.
Na de zomer zal ik van het Openbaar Ministerie de resultaten van het dossieronderzoek ontvangen, waarna ik uw Kamer zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt’

MPs Ellian and Michon-Derkzen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that about 1,500 criminal cases in Gelderland were dropped due to a shortage of judges, and whether similar sepots would occur in other districts. The Minister confirmed the reports, said the cases are light politierechter matters (no sex or youth cases, VPT cases screened as light), that about 90% will be seponeerd, and that similar large-scale decisions elsewhere are not expected.
The 1,500 cases concern so-called police-judge cases.
De 1.500 zaken betreffen zogenoemde politierechter zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en van der Staaij over het bericht 'Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Public Prosecution Service dropping about 1,500 cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, and its effects on victims, trust in justice, other districts and the appeal route. The minister regrets the situation, explains the capacity shortage and recruitment measures, and says victims can object to a dismissal only via article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure while cases are being reviewed.
Where victims relied on a judge making an independent ruling on the case they were involved in, this is now not happening.
Daar waar slachtoffers erop vertrouwden dat een rechter een onafhankelijk oordeel zou vellen over de zaak waar ze bij betrokken waren, gebeurt dit nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verkuijlen en De Neef over het artikel ‘Noodkreet kinderrechters: veroordeelde jongeren krijgen niet de hulp die ze nodig hebben’

MPs Verkuijlen and De Neef asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health about reports that convicted youths do not receive timely specialised youth care ordered by juvenile judges, including waiting lists, municipal budget constraints, lighter treatment advice from the Child Protection Council, and priority for these youths. The minister acknowledged the urgency, said regional procurement obligations and a support programme are being pursued, but gave no national figures on waiting lists and stated there is no plan to give these youths priority.
Municipalities are responsible for organising youth care, including youth care for young people in the criminal law context.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het organiseren van jeugdhulp, waaronder jeugdhulp voor jongeren in het strafrechtelijk kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over de uitvoering van het jeugdstrafrecht en het (op tijd) ontbreken van de juiste hulp voor jongeren

An MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about long waiting times for court-ordered youth treatment and whether this increases reoffending and pretrial detention. The minister acknowledged the problem, said no data exist on youths waiting in detention, found no link to recidivism, attributed waits to municipal procurement gaps, and pointed to a planned law and a support programme.
No figures are available on the number of young people held in detention waiting for treatment.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal jongeren dat in detentie wacht op een behandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het Ceder en Bikker over het bericht ‘Curaçaos roulette’

MPs Ceder and Bikker asked about the Argos report on weak supervision of Curaçao's online gambling sector, its risks, Dutch involvement, and whether the Kingdom should intervene. The government acknowledged insufficient oversight, pointed to Kingdom package measures H.2 and H.19 for reform, and said licensing and enforcement fall under Curaçao's autonomy, with technical assistance offered.
The cabinet nonetheless recognises the statements made in the broadcast and endorses the finding that there is insufficient effective control and supervision of the online gambling sector in Curaçao.

Het kabinet herkent evenwel de uitlatingen die in de uitzending zijn gedaan en onderschrijft de constatering dat er onvoldoende effectieve controle en toezicht is op de online kansspelsector in Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Kat  over het bericht ‘Weer minder mensen in de wettelijke schuldsanering’ van het CBS

MPs Ceder and Kat asked the government why the number of people admitted to the statutory debt restructuring regime (Wsnp) keeps falling and whether the entry threshold is too high, and whether it will consult municipalities and others. The minister answers that admission criteria are applied too strictly, points to a pending bill to loosen them, and says advice will be sought from practitioners, with a letter to parliament planned for September 2022.
It is not intended that people who would benefit from a Wsnp procedure remain in a municipal debt assistance procedure if it is clear that this offers no solution to their debt problem.

Het is niet de bedoeling dat mensen, die gebaat zijn bij een Wsnp-traject, in een gemeentelijk schuldhulpverleningstraject blijven indien duidelijk is dat dit geen oplossing biedt voor de schuldenproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht “Tbs-kliniek Nijmegen: ontsnapping ging te snel om in te grijpen”

An SGP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about the escape of two tbs detainees from the Pompe clinic in Nijmegen, including whether staffing shortages and the unfinished second fence were to blame and whether new security measures would follow. Minister Weerwind answered that the Inspectorate is investigating, extra fences, wire and cameras have been added, one escapee was arrested, and all top-security clinics are being reviewed.
I consider it important that it is looked at very carefully how the escape could happen. The Inspectorate of Justice and Security is doing that.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat heel nauwkeurig wordt gekeken hoe de ontvluchting heeft kunnen gebeuren. Dat doet de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrief van de NVvR over de werkdruk rechtspraak en OM

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to the NVvR open letter on high workload and overtime at the judiciary and the Public Prosecution Service, and what it will do to reduce workload and safeguard quality. The minister acknowledges the high workload, points to measures already taken (extra officers and judges, structural extra budget, ICT improvements, time-use study follow-up) and says the issue is under discussion with the Raad voor de rechtspraak and the College van procureurs-generaal, without committing to new parliamentary reporting beyond existing channels.
As indicated, the discussion on workload is ongoing.
Zoals aangegeven is het gesprek over werkdruk gaande.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over de gijzeling in de lagere school in Bovensmilde, in 1977

Ellian (VVD) asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the 1977 Bovensmilde school hostage-taking, its surviving victims' lasting PTSD and unmet need for help, the state's past compensation and support, UWV disability assessments, and the neglected memorial. Minister Weerwind responds that he is willing to meet the victims, that support via Slachtofferhulp Nederland is available, and that he cannot assess 1977 government conduct in general, pending such a meeting.
I am happy to be willing, from the Ministry, if there is a need, to enter into conversation with the victims of this hostage-taking.
Ik ben graag bereid om vanuit het Ministerie, als daaraan behoefte bestaat, met de slachtoffers van deze gijzeling in gesprek te gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat het aantal gokverslaafden is toegenomen sinds de opening van kansspelmarkt en dat inmiddels al 100 miljoen euro aan gokreclames is uitgegeven

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked whether gambling addiction has risen since the online gambling market opened and whether gambling advertising, speed limits and fragmented spending limits are adequately controlled. The Minister answered that no baseline existed, LADIS data will return by autumn, that speed limits are being studied, that untargeted ads are being restricted and role-model advertising banned from 30 June 2022, and that a cross-operator limit is under investigation.
I see no added value in separately requesting data from addiction clinics outside this system in the meantime.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde in het tussentijds buiten dit systeem om uitvragen van gegevens bij verslavingsklinieken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de problemen die ongehuwd samenwonenden kunnen ondervinden als hun relatie ten einde komt

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the financial problems unmarried cohabiting partners face after a long relationship ends, and whether alimony, a share in accumulated assets, or a judicial fairness correction should be introduced for them. The minister stressed partner autonomy and personal responsibility, said unmarried partners can make their own agreements, and promised a substantive response to the alimony research report after the summer, including on partner alimony for unmarried cohabitants.
After the summer I will send Parliament a substantive response to the report and in that context respond on partner alimony for unmarried cohabitants.
Na de zomer zal ik een inhoudelijke reactie op het rapport aan uw Kamer toezenden en in dat kader met een reactie komen omtrent partneralimentatie voor ongehuwd samenwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat tragische beelden op internet massaal gedeeld worden, tot groot verdriet van nabestaanden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about widely shared footage of a fatal accident, the family's plea to stop sharing it, and whether a low-threshold reporting facility for victims of online privacy violations, as requested in an earlier motion, has been set up. The minister said the facility is an ambition for this cabinet period, agreed in principle that next-of-kin should be relieved of repeated reporting, but stressed that a legal framework must first be developed and fundamental rights considered.
It is my ambition to establish this facility and have it operational still within the current cabinet period.
Het is mijn ambitie om deze voorziening nog in de huidige kabinetsperiode tot stand te brengen en operationeel te hebben
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Jasper van Dijk over het gebruik van hacksoftware, zoals Pegasus, in Nederland

MPs Omtzigt and Van Dijk asked about Dutch use of hacking software such as Pegasus, including purchases, users, offences, targets, supplier screening, statistics, and the Wet CCIII evaluation. The government answered that police buy commercial intrusion software under judicial authorization, that operational details and expenditures cannot be disclosed for protection of methods, and that the Wet CCIII evaluation is delayed and expected after summer 2022.

Providing third parties with information on which specific software the police hold and use for this special investigative power entails unacceptable risks for the usability of those means and thereby for the investigative interest.

Het verstrekken van informatie aan derden over welke specifieke software de politie beschikt en gebruikt bij de inzet van deze bijzondere opsporingsbevoegdheid, brengt onaanvaardbare risico’s met zich mee voor de inzetbaarheid van die middelen en daarmee het opsporingsbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht ‘Sittardse gevangenis zet tbs’er per ongeluk op straat’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a case in which a tbs detainee was wrongly released onto the street after a Sittard prison failed to record his status, and about measures to prevent recurrence and the link to the Court of Audit report on forensic care. The minister said agreements with chain partners were made to share status information, that the Court of Audit report does not concern day-to-day information exchange, and that a quality framework and trajectory indicators are being developed.
DJI has made or reconfirmed agreements with the chain partners involved to prevent recurrence.
DJI heeft met de betrokken ketenpartners afspraken gemaakt dan wel herbevestigd om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘België wil verbod op gokreclames: Gokken is het nieuwe roken’

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about Belgium's plan to ban gambling advertising, the rise in online gambling hours and young people gambling since legalisation, and what the government will do about problem gambling. The minister rejects a total ban, announces a ban on untargeted advertising for risky games via an amendment to the advertising decree, and says data on gambling addiction will only be available again in the autumn.
That is why I am taking additional measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Westerveld over seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag in de jeugdzorg

MPs Ceder and Westerveld asked the State Secretary and Minister about sexual boundary violations in youth care, including 414 reports reported by the Inspectorate, the role of victim protection, supervision and prosecution. The government acknowledges the problem as shocking, describes measures following the De Winter report, the AKJ advocacy system and IGJ supervision, and says it sees no structural gap in prosecution while admitting it cannot count prosecuted cases in youth care.

In addition, extra investment has been made in advocacy work (AKJ) to offer young people a listening ear; they will also more often explicitly ask about experiences of violence during their visits to institutions.
Daarnaast is extra geïnvesteerd in vertrouwenswerk (AKJ) om jongeren een luisterend oor te bieden; zij gaan tevens vaker expliciet vragen naar ervaringen van geweld bij hun bezoeken aan instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat de Belgische overheid gokreclames aan banden gaat leggen

Two MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Belgium's plan to restrict gambling advertising and about the status of Dutch measures to curb risky gambling ads, speech limits, bonus communication and youth gambling. The Minister answered that the Besluit werving, reclame en verslavingspreventie will be amended for consultation before summer, that the rolmodel ban takes effect 30 June 2022, that sector self-commitments are still being implemented with new figures promised in autumn, and that the Ksa has sufficient capacity.
The draft decree is currently being worked out and is on track to go to consultation before the summer.
Het conceptbesluit wordt momenteel uitgewerkt en ligt op koers om voor de zomer in consultatie te worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Ginneken over het artikel 'Zo werd Myrthe Reuver de dupe van haar data: ‘Ze geloven in eerste instantie het systeem’'

MPs Kat and Van Ginneken asked the ministers about a newspaper report on credit assessments by credit-information bureaus based on general data, possibly including incorrect data from former residents, and about notification, objection, retention periods and BKR registrations. The government answered that such assessments on general data are undesirable, that incorrect data processing is unlawful, that GDPR rights apply, that the Dutch industry code sets an 8-year retention, and that the BKR retention period of five years is retained while a draft law on credit registration is prepared.
Processing incorrect personal data to arrive at the score is therefore unlawful.
Het verwerken van foutieve persoonsgegevens om tot de score te komen is dan ook onrechtmatig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het aantal meldingen van agressie- en geweldsincidenten in de jeugdgevangenissen toeneemt
