An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising aggression and violence incidents in youth detention centres, staffing, working conditions, group sizes, closures and Horsterveen. The minister attributes the rise partly to higher occupancy, a tougher population, COVID measures and stricter registration, reports a decline since 2021, and outlines staffing measures, the VOM programme, and temporary measures, while rejecting changes to group sizes and making Horsterveen permanent.
Let me first state that aggression and violence against young people and staff in the youth detention centres is unacceptable.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat agressie en geweld tegen jongeren en personeel in de justitiële jeugdinrichtingen (hierna: de JJI's) onacceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over  het kosteloos wijzigen van de geslachtsnaam voor slachtoffers van incest

An SP MP asked whether free name change for incest victims should be extended to cases where the perpetrator is a non-namegiving relative such as a brother or uncle. The minister answered that free change is limited to cases where the perpetrator is the namegiving parent, that he sees no reason to drop the cost-recovery principle, but will review the AMvB rules on name change in 2023 and take the wish into account.
I currently see no reason and financial room to abandon the principle that government services must be cost-covering.
Ik zie thans geen reden en financiële ruimte om het uitgangspunt los te laten dat diensten van de overheid kostendekkend moeten worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over concept vonnissen en inloopkamers

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a draft verdict accidentally published by the Rotterdam court and about the use of the inloopkamer (intake chamber) with legal clerks drafting judgments. The Minister answered that the publication was an unfortunate mistake without legal effect, that criminal cases normally do not use draft verdicts, and that the judge remains responsible for judgments and random case allocation applies.
The court's view written in the verdict already drafted in that case following the completed hearing on 2 February was not final, because pleadings were still to be held in that case.

Het oordeel van de rechtbank dat was opgeschreven in het vonnis dat in die zaak al gemaakt was naar aanleiding van de afgeronde behandeling van de zaak op 2 februari was niet definitief, omdat er in die zaak nog gepleit zou worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een incident in justitiële jeugdinrichting Den Hey-Acker

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a fatal stabbing at the Den Hey-Acker youth detention facility, staff concerns about rising offender severity, and whether structural change is needed. The minister said four inspectorates are investigating with results expected in Q1 2023, listed interim measures such as a knife ban and staff coaching, and said he will await the inspectorates' findings before adding measures.
The inspectorates are examining how Rijks JJI Den Hey-Acker acted before, during and after the incident and what lessons and improvement points there are.
De inspecties onderzoeken hoe Rijks JJI Den Hey-Acker heeft gehandeld in de aanloop naar, tijdens en na het incident en welke leer- en verbeterpunten er zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Sneller over het artikel 'Rechters maken schulden van de zwakkeren juist erger'

MPs Kat and Sneller asked whether courts handle around 5,000 default debt collection judgments weekly, why debtors fail to appear, and what has been done with the Raad voor de rechtspraak's recommendations on debt cases. The minister says default judgments have fallen below that level, outlines reforms such as a planned legal basis for courts to impose payment arrangements, a debt officer pilot, lower court fees and a shorter good-faith test, and commits to further letters on cost stacking and experiments.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ceder over het aantal doorplaatsingen van uit huis geplaatste kinderen

MPs Westerveld and Ceder asked about the frequency of re-placements of children taken out of their homes, what concrete steps followed the Het Vergeten Kind report and the StroomOp action plan, and whether targets were met. The State Secretary answered that re-placements are not registered nationally, that some targets such as the under-5% overplacement goal were not met though numbers fell, and that a plan for the future of closed youth care will be sent before summer.
The number of re-placements is not registered nationally.
Het aantal doorplaatsingen wordt niet landelijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘aanpak dronesmokkel gevangenissen schiet al drie jaar nauwelijks op’

Oppositional MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection why drone smuggling into prisons has hardly been tackled in three years, whether staff are at increased risk, why solutions take so long, whether staff and unions are consulted, and whether no-fly zones exist around prisons. The Minister denies the approach is failing, reports declining but still high contraband finds, describes drone detection systems operational in five prisons with rollout planned, and says talks are ongoing with the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management on a flight ban, while staff and unions are consulted through existing works-council channels.
There is an ongoing struggle against contraband; there is no question of a failing approach.
Er is sprake van een continue strijd tegen contrabande, er is geen sprake van een falende aanpak.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het Nederlandse meisje Insiya, die 5 jaar geleden ontvoerd is naar India en de pogingen die de Nederlandse regering onderneemt om haar terug te krijgen in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Legal Protection what concrete steps the government has taken to bring Dutch child Insiya back from India, whether Dutch court rulings oblige her return, and whether the state visit from India would be used to raise the case. The ministers answered that diplomatic requests, repeated raising in bilateral talks, and handing over Dutch rulings to Indian authorities continue, but that Dutch rulings are not automatically binding in India and the mother must seek enforcement before an Indian court.
The Netherlands closely monitors the rulings in the proceedings in India.
Nederland volgt uitspraken in de procedures in India nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de uithuisgeplaatste kinderen in het toeslagenschandaal

Omtzigt asks the government, after the unanimously adopted motion on children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, why the independent investigation has not started, how many such placements persist and how many were reviewed, what is being done about abuse and forced removals, and what has been done to prevent a repeat. The minister answers that an Inspectorate investigation is underway, the Ondersteuningsteam is supporting families, reviews are part of regular youth protection work, and the government cannot give figures on reviews or abuse, while proposing talks with parliament on a possible commission.
I have no insight into the number of reassessments or requests that have taken place in this context.
Ik heb geen zicht op het aantal herbeoordelingen of verzoeken dat in dit kader heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over de vergunningsprocedure voor nieuwe toetreders tot de online kansspelmarkt

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked the minister about the licensing of new online gambling operators, including an overview of pending applications, transparency about applicants, and welcome bonuses for young players. The minister declined to name applicants with pending licence requests (citing reputational harm), explained the Ksa's criteria and six-month timeline, rejected public consultation on applications, and said the Ksa supervises bonus rules for 18-24 year olds.
The Ksa cannot provide the requested overview of names.
De Ksa kan het gevraagde overzicht van namen niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude en Ellian over het bericht 'Geen open wetenschap over de rug van werknemers'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether universities require open access for nearly all publications, including works written outside employment, and whether this conflicts with article 25fa of the Copyright Act, which covers only short scientific works. The minister answered that open access is broader than article 25fa, that universities request but do not oblige staff, that the government sees open access as a shared responsibility and will keep consulting stakeholders, but made no concrete commitment to change the rules.
Article 25fa of the Copyright Act therefore grants creators of a short scientific work a right, not an obligation.
Artikel 25fa Aw verleent makers van een kort werk van wetenschap dus een bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het toezicht op de naleving van de sancties tegen Rusland op de Zuidas

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether a 2019 Houthoff case breached Russia sanctions, who supervises sanctions compliance across four bodies, whether capacity is sufficient, and why only 14 administrative fines but no criminal action since 2015. The minister answered that law firms lack supervision and a statutory regulation is being prepared, that prosecution is for the OM, that additional capacity is being assessed, and that a national sanctions coordinator was appointed.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that criminal action was taken against violations of sectoral sanctions measures concerning the sanctioned flow of goods.
Het OM heeft aangegeven dat strafrechtelijk is opgetreden tegen overtreding van sectorale sanctiemaatregelen aangaande de gesanctioneerde goederenstroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Toezichthouder heeft dubbel gevoel bij reclames WOZ-aanslag’

An MP asked the government about rising WOZ property-valuation objections, the profits and public fees of no-cure-no-pay firms, their success rates versus citizens filing themselves, and the Waarderingskamer's advice. The government confirmed the trends, defended low-threshold legal protection including via no-cure-no-pay firms, and promised its reaction to the report before summer.
Yes, it is important that citizens' legal protection against the determination of the WOZ value is low-threshold.
Ja, het is belangrijk dat de rechtsbescherming van de burger tegen de vaststelling van de WOZ-waarde laagdrempelig is.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Kat over het artikel ‘Bewindvoerder steelt 160.000 euro van cliënten’

An MP asked the government about a court-appointed administrator (bewindvoerder) who embezzled client funds, including how many similar cases exist, how supervision and complaints worked, and how client recovery and quality rules are being tightened. The minister answered that three similar cases are known since 2019, that the administrator was suspended and dismissed promptly by the Limburg court once signals arose, and outlined existing supervision, criminal complaints, client damage recovery and ongoing reform of quality requirements.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zaak van Patrick Noordoven en het feit dat de Staat in hoger beroep gaat tegen een eerdere uitspraak in deze zaak

An SP MP asked why the State is appealing a court ruling that found it acted unlawfully toward adoptee Patrick Noordoven, and how it can justify continuing the litigation. The Minister of Legal Protection declined to discuss the grounds of appeal because the case is pending, pointed to the State's apologies and to planned support for adoptees, and refused to withdraw the appeal.
On the grounds of the appeal I make no statements, as is usual in pending proceedings.
Op de gronden van het hoger beroep doe ik – zoals gebruikelijk in een lopende procedure – een mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderhouden van contacten van achterblijvers met gedetineerden en het opschorten van de e-mail-service eMates

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the eMates email service for detainees was suspended, questioning the speed, lack of consultation and impact on detainees and families. The minister answered that the suspension follows a Public Prosecution Service concern, that an independent audit (about three months) will assess risks to personal data and security before any resumption, and that alternative contact channels remain available.
When the investigation is completed, a decision will be made on whether and under which conditions the eMates messaging service can be resumed.
Wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond zal besloten worden of en onder welke condities de berichtenservice via eMates kan worden hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mutluer over het uitsluitbeleid van Jehovah’s Getuigen

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the shunning policy of Jehovah's Witnesses, its psychological harm, research, possible criminal or tax measures, and steps taken to protect victims. The minister acknowledges the harm, notes shunning is not itself a crime but related conduct may fall under existing criminal provisions, promises a cabinet reaction by 1 June, and reports an expert commission reviewing ANBI tax status.
I am closely following the reports about the complaint filed by the Dutch Committee Against JW's Shunning: Now is the time.
Ik volg de berichtgeving omtrent de aangifte die is gedaan door het Dutch Committee Against JW's Shunning: Now is the time daarom nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rajkowski inzake het bericht ‘Ddos'er die fiscus, banken en Tweakers aanviel, krijgt 200 uur taakstraf’

MPs Rajkowski and Ellian asked about a news report on a DDoS attacker sentenced to 200 hours of community service, including whether such attacks on vital services are treated as aggravating, conviction numbers, recidivism, the Hack_Right intervention and delays in criminal cases. The Minister answered that attacks on vital infrastructure can raise the maximum sentence, gave limited conviction figures, said recidivism data are unavailable, described Hack_Right and planned funding, and declined to analyse published judgments on reasonable-time violations as too time-consuming.
Examining published judgments on rechtspraak.nl is very time-consuming and current capacity does not allow such research to be carried out.
Het onderzoeken van gepubliceerde uitspraken op rechtspraak.nl is zeer tijdrovend en de huidige capaciteit laat het momenteel niet toe een dergelijk onderzoek uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over enkele deurwaardergerelateerde zaken

MP Van Nispen asks whether serving full underlying documents on third parties in attachment proceedings violates debtor privacy, whether a pilot replacing summons with written petitions reduces human contact, and asks the minister to reflect on this. The minister agrees in principle to reconsider the privacy-sensitive service requirement in a future Rv amendment after consultation, and describes the Amsterdam 'Zorgzaken' pilot as structurally embedded and expanded, while monitoring whether vulnerable debtors lose information.

At a future amendment of the Rv this will therefore be taken into account, after consultation with the Council for the Judiciary and the Royal Professional Association of Court Bailiffs on how best to shape it.

Bij een volgende wetswijziging van het Rv zal dit daarom worden meegenomen, na afstemmening met de Raad voor de rechtspraak en de Koninklijke Beroepsorganisatie van Gerechtsdeurwaarders over hoe dit het beste vorm kan worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Ondernemers sneller in problemen door uitzondering in faillissementswet’

MPs Ellian and Rahimi asked whether the WHOA out-of-court insolvency settlement scheme works in practice, and what the Supreme Court ruling that pension premiums fall under the employee exception means for restructurings. The minister reported about 200 declarations and 23 homologation decisions so far, said an evaluation is planned by end 2023, and promised to discuss the consultation results with the insolvency sector and social partners before summer and inform the House in autumn.
How often a WHOA process has led to a settlement before the court became involved is not known, because the vast majority of these processes take place in confidentiality.
Hoe vaak een WHOA-traject heeft geresulteerd in een akkoord nog voordat de rechter daarbij aan te pas kwam, is niet bekend omdat veruit de meeste van deze trajecten in beslotenheid plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over AirTags

An MP asks whether AirTags pose stalking and privacy risks, whether the Wet Belaging is adequate given that stalking is a complaint offence, and how the GDPR and anti-stalking policy apply. The minister answers that the existing legal framework is sufficient, that Apple has added anti-misuse safeguards, that the GDPR's household exemption applies and enforcement is for the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, and points to ongoing stalking-prevention and victim-support efforts.
Of course, the cabinet is closely monitoring developments.
Uiteraard houdt het kabinet de ontwikkelingen nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de vandalen van de coronarellen het betalen van aangerichte schade ontlopen

An SP MP asked why perpetrators of the January 2021 Covid-protest riots have paid little of the damage they caused, and why a victim-damage fund was never set up. The Minister of Justice answered that about 55 convicted rioters were ordered to pay about €551,000, of which only about €36,700 had been collected by January 2022, that the government compensated affected businesses and took over their claims, and that it is still examining how to recover these amounts from perpetrators.
However, I can assure you that it is my ambition to have perpetrators pay as much as possible for the damage caused.
Ik kan u echter verzekeren dat het mijn ambitie is om daders zoveel als mogelijk te laten betalen voor de aangerichte schade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Ellian over het bericht dat veel vandalen de forse schade van de coronarellen niet hoeven te vergoeden

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Ellian asked whether perpetrators of damage during the 2021 COVID curfew riots are escaping paying compensation, and why enforcement differs between regions. The Minister acknowledges that offenders should pay, reports that about 55 perpetrators have compensation orders totalling roughly €551,000 with €36,700 collected so far, and says that cessation of claims to the state for the Regeling Bedrijvenschade is being examined with the OM, while noting that full recovery will not be possible in all cases.
Figures on criminal-procedure claims for damages orders are not recorded, so it cannot be shown whether there are large differences between regions.
Cijfers rondom het strafrechtelijk vorderen van de schademaatregelen worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Nispen over signalen dat verzekeraars en gemeenten mogelijk weer afspraken zouden willen maken over Wmo-regresrecht

An SP MP asked whether insurers and municipalities might again agree to buy out Wmo recourse rights for injury claims, and whether victims are being passed between municipality and insurer. The government answered that victims keep the freedom to choose between municipality and insurer, that no new convenant is planned, that VNG and the insurers' association keep talking, and that it sees no added value in raising the matter again with them.
In practice the victim has the freedom to choose between the municipality and the insurer.
In de praktijk heeft het slachtoffer de vrijheid om te kiezen tussen gemeente en verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over uithuisgeplaatste kinderen en het toeslagenschandaal

An MP asked the government about children placed out of home in the childcare benefits scandal, including reunification prospects, complaint procedures at the youth care inspectorate and certified institutions, the scope of the inspectorates' investigation, and legal protection for parents and children. The minister answered at length, often stating that the inspectorates lack competence to handle individual complaints, declined to name the investigators, and said the requested two-week deadline could not be met.
I am not willing to give you the names of the staff (officials) of the inspectorates who carry out the investigation.
Ik ben niet bereid u de namen te geven van de medewerkers (ambtenaren) van de inspecties die het onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over problemen bij beslag op minimumuitkeringen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked whether minimum benefit recipients are left below subsistence when enforcement agents collect small positive differences after indexation, and how often this happens. The minister replied that borrowers can ask for the protected allowance to be recalculated after a structural income change, that the issue will be reviewed in the evaluation of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet in 2022/2023, and that the suggested legislative fixes are not adequate.
A citizen, but also their debt assistant or protective administrator, can ask the enforcing parties to recalculate the protected allowance after a structural change in their circumstances.

Een burger, maar ook diens schuldhulpverlener of beschermingsbewindvoerder, kan bij een structurele wijziging van zijn omstandigheden de beslagleggende partijen vragen om de beslagvrije voet opnieuw vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mogelijke schendingen van het verschoningsrecht door OM en FIOD

MP Van Nispen asked whether the OM and FIOD have breached legal privilege (verschoningsrecht) for lawyers, how they handle privileged material, whether the Landsadvocaat was consulted, who supervises the geheimhouder-officier van justitie, and whether an independent review or central body is needed. The Minister explains the procedures (rechter-commissaris review, geheimhouder-officier and -medewerker, Hoge Raad 2020 ruling, OM guidance being updated) and says the PG at the Hoge Raad supervises the OM, declining to add a new review power for now.
In the interest of ongoing cases I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan in het belang van lopende zaken niet op individuele zaken ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over gokken door minderjarigen

An MP asked whether minors could deposit money into online gambling accounts via third-party bank accounts and what enforcement was planned. The minister said the Kansspelautoriteit has acted against one operator, that third-party deposits are already prohibited, and that no further signals are known, while noting that Holland Casino fixed a related issue.
Should an operator violate the law, the Kansspelautoriteit will take action against it.
Mocht een aanbieder de wet overtreden zal de Kansspelautoriteit daartegen actie ondernemen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het feit dat advocatenkantoor Van Doorne N.V. door ITV is ingeschakeld om onderzoek te doen naar de ernstige situatie rondom de voormalig deelnemers van The Voice of Holland

MP Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection about ITV hiring law firm Van Doorne to investigate abuses at The Voice of Holland, and whether victims approaching the firm, which acts for ITV, harms their legal position. The minister answered that the firm may investigate if it has the expertise, that victims should report to police, and that the WODC study on self-investigation will be awaited, with the minister promising to inform parliament.

I will inform your House after the WODC study is completed and will then consider whether, and if so which, steps should be taken regarding the current practice of companies having their own investigations carried out.

Ik zal uw Kamer informeren na afronding van het WODC-onderzoek en ik zal dan bezien of en zo ja, welke stappen dienen te worden genomen met betrekking tot de huidige werkwijze waarin bedrijven zelf onderzoek laten verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Westerveld over terugplaatsingen na uithuisplaatsingen

MPs Ceder and Westerveld asked the ministers how to reduce long out-of-home placements of children, what the government knows about returns home, and whether returns will be registered. The minister answers that reunification is a goal, lists measures and a WODC study, and says registration of returns will be explored with partners, but no reliable national figures on returns currently exist.
I am willing to improve registration on this point.
Ik ben bereid de registratie op dit punt te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan maatwerk bij het Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau (CJIB)

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Nationale ombudsman's finding that the OM and CJIB failed to provide tailored treatment in enforcing a compensation measure, including whether a EUR 6,000 surcharge should be removed. The minister answered that the surcharges are set by law with no room to undo them, that the ombudsman's recommendation to deduct them was not followed, and that the CJIB has since expanded payment-arrangement and debt-relief options.
Only the recommendation to deduct the legally imposed surcharges from the outstanding amount has not been followed.
Enkel de aanbeveling om de wettelijke opgelegde verhogingen in mindering te brengen op het openstaande bedrag is niet opgevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het bericht 'Moordenaar broer kroongetuige gaf tot moord Peter R. lezingen in gevangenis'

MP Ellian asked why a prisoner sentenced to up to 28 years for murder, described by the court as cold and ruthless, was allowed to give lectures to fellow inmates on resocialisation, and how selection for such activities is made. The minister regrets the impact on relatives, admits the decision-making underweighted the societal context and victim interests, explains the D&R-plan criteria (security, behaviour, victim interests), and says lessons will be used to improve future decisions.
The murder of Peter R. de Vries showed that the decision-making had insufficiently considered the societal context of the offence for which this prisoner was convicted.
De moord op Peter R. de Vries deed inzien dat bij de besluitvorming te weinig rekening was gehouden met de maatschappelijke context van het delict waarvoor deze gedetineerde is veroordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht over coronabesmettingen in het gevangeniswezen en maatregelen om het virus buiten te houden, zoals 2G

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about COVID-19 infections in prisons, detainee and visitor hardship, whether the 2G-style visit rules are proportionate and lawful, and whether prison measures should be reviewed. The minister reported 199 infections, denied that visits require full vaccination or prior infection (a negative test suffices), and said measures follow government policy and RIVM guidance with a letter to parliament promised for early March.
I will inform your House at the beginning of March about the current state of affairs.
Ik informeer uw Kamer begin maart over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over toenemende intimidaties in het gevangeniswezen

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about rising intimidation of prison staff, reported in a union survey, and whether staffing levels, vetting, and workplace culture are adequate. The minister acknowledges the concern, says a link to staffing is hard to establish, and lists recruitment, vetting (VOG), security and training measures, with a promise to inform parliament in the next progress letter.
On the outcome of these talks I will inform your House in the next progress letter on the vision for the prison system.
Over de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken zal ik uw Kamer bij de volgende voortgangsbrief over de visie op het gevangeniswezen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellian over het artikel ‘Oud-tbs’er Zouo A. vrijdag voorgeleid in Nederland voor dodelijke schietpartij’

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a former tbs (forensic psychiatric) patient suspected of a fatal shooting, whether risk assessment tools and the reclassering were adequate, and whether the Inspectorate would investigate. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, defended the RISC/OXREC risk instruments and recidivism data, and said the Inspectorate is awaiting the reclassering's internal evaluation before deciding further action.
It does not befit me to go into an individual case.
Het past mij niet om op een individuele casus in te gaan.
